jobs.title: System Development Troubleshooter

titleByLocale.it: Risoluzione dei problemi di sviluppo del sistema

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories, and doctors’ offices. The company employs over 2200 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics main sites.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

( Please note that this vacancy is currently not linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.)

The Position

In a global and cross-functional environment, the System Development department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

As a System Integration Troubleshooter, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on the development or product care of complex diagnostics systems consisting of fluidcs, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical and biochemistry elements.

As System Integration Troubleshooter, your main responsibilities will consist of (but will not be limited to):

• Conducting root-cause investigations of systemic issues found during development or escalated from field or Operations in all lifecycle phases (from early feasibility to product care), and collaborate with other functions do develop solutions for complex issues

• Building up subject matter expertise and providing support to the RMD Development Teams (Assay-, Software- and Instrument-Development), Global Customer Support (GCS), Case Investigation and Resolution (CIR) and Operations. This requires close cross-department interaction to gather all information needed to ensure high-quality support.

• Responsible for internal repair visits, retrofitting of mechanical parts, configuration management monitoring and tracking and installing or updating of the Instrument Software.

• Independent Planning of assigned Workpackages and continuously monitoring and tracking of the working progress.

• Conduct integration development activities on system component level, thereby closely interact with project teams, and participating and coordinating with other internal groups and departments.

• Performing statistical data analysis to support root-cause investigation & problem solving, risk assessment, product development and process improvement.

Who you are

You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

To be successful in this role (you provide):

• Degree in Biomedical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• Ability to work independently, handling cross-departmental development tasks

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and German

• Strong analytical and interdisciplinary thinking

• Experience in statistical data analysis

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche Diagnostics International in Rotkreuz is a leading provider of diagnostic systems solutions, and the largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems in Switzerland. We are more than 2’700 passionate colleagues from over 65 nationalities. Find out more abo

jobs.title: Praktikum für Pharmaziestudenten (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The Position
Dein Team

Als Pharmazeut/in im Praktikum hast Du im Rahmen des 6-monatigen Praktikantenprogramms für angehende Apotheker die Möglichkeit, einen spannenden Einblick in die pharmazeutische Industrie zu erhalten. Hierbei lernst Du die Arbeit eines Apothekers in der pharmazeutischen Industrie umfassend kennen.Mögliche Einsatzgebiete sindz. B. die Zulassung, Produktion, Qualitätssicherung oder Qualitätskontrolle von Arzneimitteln und Medizinprodukten Außerdem wird Dir während des gesamten Praktikums ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite stehen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Je nach Bereich unterstützt Du bei der Herstellung, Kontrolle und Qualitätssicherung der vom Betrieb hergestellten Produkte (Arzneimittel / Medizinprodukte) oder deren Einsatzstoffe

• Du koordinierst und erstellst die Dokumentation, zb Arbeitsanweisungen

• Außerdem kümmerst Du dich um die Bearbeitung von Projekten lokal und global

• Zudem unterstützt Du durch Deine Mitarbeit verschiedenen Recherchen zB für Abweichungen oder Reklamationen

• Du lernst dabei typische Aufgabengebiete eines Apothekers (gemäß AMG und AMWHV) kennen

Dein Profil

• Du hast den zweiten Abschnitt der Pharmazeutischen Prüfung (zweites Staatsexamen) erfolgreich abgelegt und kannst gute Studienleistungen vorweisen

• Entsprechend der Approbationsordnung für Apotheker möchtest Du nun die Hälfte deines praktischen Jahrs dazu nutzen, die pharmazeutische Industrie näher kennenzulernen

• Idealerweise hast Du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Industrie gesammelt

• Durch Deine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise begeisterst Du ebenso wie durch Dein analytisches Denken

• Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, freust Dich auf die Arbeit im Team und bringst Engagement und Eigeninitiative mit

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (37,5 Stundenwoche)

• 1958€ Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiter-Kantine

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Vernetzung mit anderen Praktikanten

Zeitraum: 6 Monate, Startmöglichkeiten: jährlich zum 01. Mai und 01. November.
Generisch suchen wir Pharmazeuten für Standort: Grenzach, Ludwigsburg, Mannheim, Penzberg (Du kannst Deine Standort-Präferenz bei der Bewerbung eingeben.)

Für eine vollständige Bewerbung bitten wir Dich, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf, ein für die Stelle passendes Anschreiben und relevante Zeugnisse hinzuzufügen. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need more support?
Our Talent Acquisition Team welcomes your questions. Please send an email to
germany.talent_acquisition@roche.com

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche Pharma AG at Grenzach-Wyhlen is steering central elements of the technical quality control for the whole European region. For the German market clinical research, marketing and all sales activities are located there. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it: La posizione del vostro team Come farmacista nello stage, hai l'opportunità di acquisire una visione emozionante dell'industria farmaceutica all'interno del programma di stage di 6 mesi per i futuri farmacisti. Imparerai sul lavoro di un farmacista nell'industria farmaceutica. Le possibili aree di applicazione sono, ad esempio, l'autorizzazione, la produzione, l'assicurazione della qualità o il controllo di qualità dei medicinali e dei dispositivi medici. Inoltre, una persona di contatto competente sarà al vostro fianco durante l'intero stage. I vostri compiti - A seconda della zona, supportate la produzione, il controllo e la garanzia di qualità dei prodotti prodotti dall'azienda (medicine/prodotti medici) o dei loro ingredienti - coordinate e avviare la documentazione, ad esempio istruzioni di lavoro - Stai aiutando a elaborare progetti localmente e globalmente Attraverso la tua collaborazione, imparerai varie ricerche, ad esempio per deviazioni o reclami - imparerai aree tipiche di responsabilità di un farmacista (secondo AMG e AMWHV) a conoscere il tuo profilo - Hai archiviato con successo la seconda sezione dell'esame farmaceutico (secondo esame di stato) e puoi fornire buoni servizi di studio - secondo le regole di approvazione per i farmacisti rapidi). Contatto Per una domanda completa, vi chiediamo di aggiungere un CV corrente, una lettera adatta e certificati pertinenti. Si prega di notare che non è possibile aggiungere ulteriori documenti dopo l'invio della domanda. Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione! Contattaci Hai bisogno di più supporto? Il nostro Talent Acquisition Team accoglie le vostre domande. Si prega di inviare a e-mail a germany. talento acquisizioni@roche.com Chi siamo a Roche, più di 100.000 persone in 100 paesi stanno spingendo indietro le frontiere della salute. Lavorando insieme, siamo diventati uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca al mondo. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità. La Roche Pharma AG di Grenzach-Wyhlen sta guidando elementi centrali del controllo tecnico della qualità per tutta la regione europea. Per il mercato tedesco ricerca clinica, marketing e tutte le attività di vendita si trovano lì. Dal vostro inizio con Roche, il nostro team motivato vuole accogliervi e supportarvi. Sono disponibili opportunità per lo sviluppo personale, orari di lavoro flessibili, pacchetti di compensazione interessanti e programmi speciali di assistenza familiare. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The position of your team As a pharmacist in the internship, you have the opportunity to gain an exciting insight into the pharmaceutical industry within the 6-month internship program for prospective pharmacists. You will learn about the work of a pharmacist in the pharmaceutical industry. Possible areas of application are, for example, the authorisation, production, quality assurance or quality control of medicines and medical devices. In addition, a competent contact person will be at your side during the entire internship.
• Your tasks - Depending on the area, you support the production, control and quality assurance of the products produced by the company (medicines/medical products) or their ingredients - you coordinate and start the documentation, e.g. work instructions - You are helping to process projects locally and globally Through your cooperation, you will learn various researches, e.g. for deviations or complaints - you will learn typical areas of responsibility of a pharmacist (according to AMG and AMWHV) to know your profile - You have successfully filed the second section of the pharmaceutical exam (second state exam) and you can provide good study services - according to the rules of approval for pharmacists, you now want to get to know half of your practical industry You've already gained first practical experience in the industry - Your structured, solution-oriented and independent way of working You as well as through your analytical thinking - you have a quick opinion, enjoy working in the team and bring engagement and initiative with your advantages - Flexible working hours (37.5 hours week) - 1958€ Compensation per month for a full-time internship - Beneficiary food prices (-50%). descriptionByLocale.fr:
La position de votre équipe En tant que pharmacien dans le stage, vous avez l'occasion d'obtenir un aperçu passionnant de l'industrie pharmaceutique dans le cadre du programme de stage de 6 mois pour les pharmaciens potentiels. Vous apprendrez le travail d'un pharmacien dans l'industrie pharmaceutique. Les domaines d'application possibles sont, par exemple, l'autorisation, la production, l'assurance de la qualité ou le contrôle de la qualité des médicaments et des dispositifs médicaux. De plus, une personne de contact compétente sera à vos côtés pendant tout le stage.
• Vos tâches - Selon la région, vous soutenez la production, le contrôle et l'assurance qualité des produits produits par l'entreprise (médicaments/produits médicaux) ou leurs ingrédients - vous coordonnez et commencez la documentation, par exemple les instructions de travail - Vous aidez à traiter des projets à l'échelle locale et mondiale Grâce à votre coopération, vous apprendrez diverses recherches, par exemple pour les déviations ou les plaintes - vous apprendrez les domaines de responsabilité typiques d'un pharmacien (selon AMG et AMWHV) pour connaître votre profil - Vous avez réussi la deuxième section de l'examen pharmaceutique (deuxième examen d'état) et vous pouvez fournir de bons services d'étude - selon les règles d'approbation pour les pharmaciens, vous voulez maintenant connaître la moitié de votre industrie pratique Vous avez déjà acquis une première expérience pratique dans l'industrie - Votre façon structurée, orientée vers la solution et indépendante de travailler Vous aussi bien que par votre pensée analytique - vous avez une opinion rapide, aimez travailler en équipe et apportez de l'engagement et de l'initiative avec vos avantages - Horaires de travail flexibles (37,5 heures semaine) - 1958€ Compensation par mois pour un stage à temps plein - Prix des aliments bénéficiaires (-50%). Contacto Pour une demande complète, nous vous demandons d'ajouter un CV actuel, une lettre appropriée et des certificats pertinents. jobs.description:
The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

Roche is a global healthcare company - founded 125 years ago in Basel, Switzerland, offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (1 office day/week on average) and provide fully remote working conditions (even after the pandemic situation).

What we do:
The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region . Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your day to day responsibilities are:

As a T&E Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates.
As a qualified expert , you:

• Verify T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handle integration between Concur and SAP

• Support the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Work collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Take responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participate in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

• Clearly document all compliance assessment (i.e. assessment results) activities in concur during claim processing

What can you bring to our team:
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Appreciative mindset and customer focus

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and focus on identifying potential improvement areas

• Interest to gain experiences in SAP / Financial Compliance

• Proficiency in English and any European language

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: free language courses, a wide range of training & learning opportunities, long-term career opportunities, lateral and vertical career moves, exciting projects & assignments, etc.

• Excellent benefits and flexibility : competitive salary and cafeteria package, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move sport pass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, Themed Holiday party, people-focused company culture, annual bonus in March, etc.

• Great opportunity in a truly international work environment with high-profile colleagues and excellent in-house learning and networking opportunities, plus an opportunity to make your mark at Roche. We will make sure your daily work will make an impact and you will be able to learn a lot along the way.

*Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing recruitment or selection process, but a position we are frequently recruiting for or we are planning to open in the near future.

We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Hebrew

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Roche promuove la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione, rappresentando le comunità che serviamo. Quando si tratta di assistenza sanitaria su scala globale, la diversità è un ingrediente essenziale per il successo. Crediamo che l’inclusione sia fondamentale per comprendere le diverse esigenze sanitarie delle persone. Insieme, abbracciamo l'individualità e condividiamo una passione per la cura eccezionale. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione
• Cerchiamo di aderire al nostro TALENT POOL al nostro Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest! Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche . Mansioni Il reparto Audit e Compliance fornisce servizi per gli affiliati nella regione EMEA. Le nostre aree principali sono: Compliance Finanziaria, Autorizzazione SAP, Compliance Viaggi e Spese. In qualità di Analista di Compliance Viaggi e Spese, sarai responsabile del lavoro con il finanziamento, l'audit, la conformità e altri dipartimenti di affiliati Roche selezionati. In questa posizione ti concentrerai su: - Verificare le richieste di spesa di T&E dal punto di vista IVA - Gestione dell'integrazione tra Concur e SAP - Sostenere la preparazione di report e materiale formativo laddove richiesto su base periodica per affrontare gli aggiornamenti del processo di monitoraggio della conformità - Lavorare in collaborazione con il team per identificare le opportunità di migliorare la documentazione di conformità (ad esempio manuali di revisione, codifica dei motivi di ritorno ecc.) - Assumersi la responsabilità di valutare la conformità dei reclami sulle spese dei dipendenti in modo tempestivo e accurato, nei confronti delle politiche, delle procedure e dei requisiti normativi esterni della Società. - Partecipazione a programmi di conformità, progetti e altri compiti ad-hoc assegnati dal supervisore/HOD.
• Requisiti
• Stiamo cercando qualcuno che sia automotivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, hai: - Almeno 1 anno di esperienza in una posizione rilevante nel campo delle Finanze/Accounting - Corso di laurea in Contabilità, Finanza o Business correlati campo - Buone competenze amministrative e di comunicazione - Alto impegno a mantenere / migliorare i livelli di servizio - mentalità aperta e focus del cliente - Proficienza in inglese ed ebraico Desirable: - Conoscenza dei principi finanziari e contabili - Esperienza in SAP / Concur system Cosa aspetti In cambio vi forniamo: - opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera. - Ottimi benefici e flessibilità: pacchetto salariale competitivo e caffetteria, indennità di lingua (se la posizione richiede lingua extra), bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare Sportpass, coaching / opportunità di mentoring, programma amico, team building, festa. Garantiamo anche la flessibilità, per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio: l'ufficio è una pratica comune (1 giorno/settimana in media, e forniamo condizioni di lavoro completamente remote all'interno dell'Ungheria). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia. - Una comunità diversificata globale, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. Contatto *Si prega di notare che questa è una requisizione per scopi di costruzione Talent Pool, il che significa che non può necessariamente riflettere un'apertura corrente con in corso

Im globalen Umgang mit der Gesundheitsversorgung ist Vielfalt ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Erfolgs. Wir sind der Meinung, dass die Einbeziehung Schlüssel zum Verständnis der vielfältigen Gesundheitsbedürfnisse der Menschen ist. Gemeinsam umarmen wir die Individualität und teilen eine Leidenschaft für außergewöhnliche Sorgfalt. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Wir sind auf der Suche nach Ihnen, unserem TALENT POOL im Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest beizutreten! Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist, was uns innovativ treibt. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche . Mansion Die Abteilung Audit und Compliance bietet Dienstleistungen für die Partner in der Region EMEA. Unsere Hauptbereiche sind: Finanzkonformität, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance. Als Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst sind Sie für die Zusammenarbeit mit Finanzen, Audits, Compliance und anderen Abteilungen ausgewählter Roche-Partner verantwortlich. In dieser Position konzentrieren Sie sich auf: - Überprüfung von T&E-Kostenansprüchen aus der Sicht der Mehrwertsteuer - Handhabung der Integration zwischen Concur und SAP - Unterstützung der Erstellung von Berichten und Schulungsmaterial, sofern dies regelmäßig erforderlich ist, um Aktualisierungen des Compliance-Überwachungsprozesses zu adressieren - Arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem Team, um Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Compliance-Dokumente zu identifizieren (z.B. Überprüfungshandbücher, Retouren-Kodierung usw.) - Verantwortung für die Beurteilung der Einhaltung der Schadensersatzansprüche der Arbeitnehmer rechtzeitig und genau gegenüber den Politiken, Verfahren und externen regulatorischen
• Anforderungen des Unternehmens. - Teilnahme an Compliance-Programmen, Projekten und anderen Ad-hoc-
• Aufgaben, die von Supervisor/HOD zugewiesen werden. Voraussetzungen Wir suchen jemanden, der selbst motiviert ist, wirklich leidenschaftlich über seinen Job ist und versteht, dass die Bereitstellung eines hochwertigen Service für die Organisation entscheidend ist. Als ideales Teammitglied sind Sie offen, um einen Unterschied zu machen und offen für eine ständige Entwicklung. Darüber hinaus haben Sie: - mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung in einer relevanten Position im Bereich Finance/Accounting - Bachelor-Abschluss in Rechnungswesen, Finanzen oder Business-bezogene Bereich - Gute administrative und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - Hohes Engagement für die Aufrechterhaltung / Verbesserung der Service-Level - Offene Einstellung und Kundenfokus - Proficiency in English und Hebrew Desirable: - Wissen über Finanzen und Rechnungslegung Prinzipien - Erfahrung in SAP / Concur System
• Cosa offriamo Im Austausch bieten wir Ihnen: - Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen.
• Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungschancen, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Schulungen, die Möglichkeit internationaler
• Aufgaben, interne Positionsänderungen und die Chance, Ihre eigene Karriere zu gestalten. - Ausgezeichnete Vorteile & Flexibilität: wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Sprachzulage (wenn die Position erfordert zusätzliche Sprache), Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Mitarbeiter-Hilfe-Programm, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring Gelegenheit, Buddy-Programm, Team-Gebäude, Urlaubsparty. Wir sorgen auch für Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden: Heimbüro ist eine gängige Praxis (1 Bürotag/Woche im Durchschnitt, und wir bieten voll entfernte Arbeitsbedingungen in Ungarn). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit für die Freiheit in der Arbeit, wo Ihr Unternehmen und Ihr Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren. - Eine weltweit vielfältige Gemeinschaft, wo wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren wir, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet, eine starke, inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, so dass Sie immer die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen. Contatto *Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine Voraussetzung für Talent Pool-Gebäude ist, was bedeutet, dass es nicht notwendigerweise eine aktuelle Öffnung mit laufender

Descrizione Roche favorise la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion, représentant les communautés que nous servons. Lorsqu'il s'agit de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, la diversité est un élément essentiel du succès. Nous croyons que l'inclusion est essentielle pour comprendre les besoins de santé variés des gens. Ensemble, nous acceptons l'individualité et partageons une passion pour les soins exceptionnels. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Nous sommes à votre recherche pour rejoindre notre TALENT POOL à notre Roche Services & Solutions Center à Budapest ! Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Voilà ce qui fait de nous Roche. Mansioni Le service de vérification et de conformité fournit des services aux affiliés de la région de l'EMEA. Nos principaux domaines couverts sont les suivants : Conformité financière, Autorisation SAP, Conformité aux frais de voyage et de déplacement. En tant qu'analyste de la conformité aux frais et aux frais, vous serez responsable de travailler avec les ministères des Finances, de la Vérification, de la Conformité et d'autres départements des affiliés sélectionnés de Roche. Dans ce poste, vous vous concentrerez sur : - la vérification des demandes de remboursement de frais de T&E du point de vue de la TVA - la gestion de l'intégration entre Concur et SAP - l'appui à la préparation des rapports et du matériel de formation, au besoin, sur une base périodique afin de tenir compte des mises à jour du processus de surveillance de la conformité - la collaboration avec l'équipe pour déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer les documents de conformité (p. ex. manuels d'examen, codage des motifs de retour, etc.) - Prendre la responsabilité d'évaluer la conformité des demandes de remboursement des dépenses des employés en temps opportun et avec exactitude, en regard des politiques, procédures et exigences réglementaires externes de la Société. - Participer à des programmes de conformité, des projets et d'autres tâches ponctuelles assignées par le superviseur ou le directeur de projet.
• Requisiti Nous recherchons quelqu'un qui est automotivé, vraiment passionné par son travail et qui comprend que fournir un service de haute qualité est crucial pour l'organisation. En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant. En outre, vous avez: - Au moins 1 an d'expérience dans un poste pertinent dans le domaine de la finance/comptabilité - Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finance, ou domaine lié aux affaires - Bonnes compétences administratives et de communication - Engagement élevé pour maintenir / améliorer les niveaux de service - Esprit ouvert et orientation client - Compétence en anglais et hébreu Désirable: - Connaissance des principes financiers et comptables - Expérience dans le système SAP / Concur
• Cosa offriamo En échange, nous vous fournissons : - Des opportunités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage.
• Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constant, des cours et des formations linguistiques gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position internes et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière. - Excellents avantages et flexibilité : salaire concurrentiel et forfait cafétéria, allocation linguistique (si le poste nécessite une langue supplémentaire), bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances. Nous assurons également la flexibilité, pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre: le bureau à domicile est une pratique courante (1 jour/semaine de bureau en moyenne, et nous fournissons des conditions de travail totalement éloignées en Hongrie). Nous créons l'occasion pour la liberté de travailler, où votre vie privée et professionnelle coexistent en harmonie. - Une communauté mondiale diversifiée, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Arabic

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

*Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Your Opportunity Planning and Financial Management:
• Proactively acquires a deep understanding of the external environment (healthcare system, policies and reforms) to anticipate future trends and formulates a strategic view of market, competition and products erosion in short term and long term
• Localize and define life cycle management strategy for products in charge.
• Develop a deep understanding of key stakeholders, including key accounts, payers, patient advocacy groups, professional associations, and policymakers, and develop development plans for the top clinical opinion leaders for the therapy area.
• Build marketing plans analyzing the relevant markets and defining long- and short-term qualitative and quantitative objectives.
• Where relevant, implement the launch excellence framework to build leading launch plans.
• Translates the brand plan into a strong actionable operational plan with clear goals, actions, accountabilities, and measures across the cross-functional team.
• Sets responsible and challenging goals with appropriate KPIs for the brand that have a clear positive impact on business performance.
• Ensure brand-in-charge performance Resource Management / Marketing Excellence
• Ensuring the good implementation of tactical plans by collaborating with cross-functional team (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)
• Ensuring supply and healthy stock.
• Optimizing segmentation and targeting strategies for the products under management.
• Build brand communication package implement for activities to make sure quality and brand engagement & reach
• Key in charge for the Brand KPIs (Lead, Lag), sales performance, and A&P Tactical Market Plan / Implementation
• Achieving Marketing objectives as agreed with management, managing the development and implementation of marketing plans consistent with approval strategy
• Ensuring the achievement of products’ budget in the approved BP and integrated marketing plan.
• Accountable for ensuring compliance’s rules & ethical code when working with healthcare professionals to strengthen the company’s image.
• Ensure all the support for the sales team/MA team comply with relevant acts, legal demand and ethical standards and in line with marketing plan
• Innovation and MCM apply in activities Who you are
• Bachelor's or master's degree in Health/Science/Pharmaceutical or Medical disciplines
• Multinational companies' experiences in healthcare industry
• At least 3 year experience in Pharma / Diagnostic industry Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Cerchiamo di aderire al nostro TALENT POOL al nostro Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest! Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. • Handling integration between Concur and SAP
• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process
• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Good administrative & communication skills
• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels
• Open mindset and customer focus

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

Wir sind der Meinung, dass die Einbeziehung Schlüssel zum Verständnis der vielfältigen Gesundheitsbedürfnisse der Menschen ist. Gemeinsam umarmen wir die Individualität und teilen eine Leidenschaft für außergewöhnliche Sorgfalt. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Wir sind auf der Suche nach Ihnen, unserem TALENT POOL im Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest beizutreten! Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist, was uns innovare treibt. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche . • Aufgaben, die von Supervisor/HOD zugewiesen werden. Wir sorgen auch für Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden: Heimbüro ist eine gängige Praxis (1 Bürotag/Woche im Durchschnitt, und wir bieten voll entfernte Arbeitsbedingungen in Ungarn). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit für die Freiheit in der Arbeit, wo Ihr Unternehmen und Ihr Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren. - Eine weltweit vielfältige Gemeinschaft, wo wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren wir, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet, eine starke, inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, so dass Sie immer die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Roche favorise la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion, représentant les communautés que nous servons. Lorsqu'il s'agit de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, la diversité est un élément essentiel du succès. Nous croyons que l'inclusion est essentielle pour comprendre les besoins de santé variés des gens. Ensemble, nous acceptons l'individualité et partageons une passion pour les soins exceptionnels. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Nous sommes à votre recherche pour rejoindre notre TALENT POOL à notre Roche Services & Solutions Center à Budapest ! Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Voilà ce qui fait de nous Roche. Mansioni Le service de vérification et de conformité fournit des services aux affiliés de la région de l'EMEA. Nos principaux domaines couverts sont les suivants : Conformité financière, Autorisation SAP, Conformité aux frais de voyage et de déplacement. En tant qu'analyste de la conformité aux frais et aux frais, vous serez responsable de travailler avec les ministères des Finances, de la Vérification, de la Conformité et d'autres départements des affiliés sélectionnés de Roche. Dans ce poste, vous vous concentrerez sur : - la vérification des demandes de remboursement de frais de T&E du point de vue de la TVA - la gestion de l'intégration entre Concur et SAP - l'appui à la préparation des rapports et du matériel de formation, au besoin, sur une base périodique afin de tenir compte des mises à jour du processus de surveillance de la conformité - la collaboration avec l'équipe pour déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer les documents de conformité (p. ex. manuels d'examen, codage des motifs de retour, etc.) - Prendre la responsabilité d'évaluer la conformité des demandes de remboursement des dépenses des employés en temps opportun et avec exactitude, en regard des politiques, procédures et exigences réglementaires externes de la Société. - Participer à des programmes de conformité, des projets et d'autres tâches ponctuelles assignées par le superviseur ou le directeur de projet.
• Requisiti Nous recherchons quelqu'un qui est automotivé, vraiment passionné par son travail et qui comprend que fournir un service de haute qualité est crucial pour l'organisation. En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant. En outre, vous avez: - Au moins 1 an d'expérience dans un poste pertinent dans le domaine de la finance/comptabilité - Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finance, ou domaine lié aux affaires - Bonnes compétences administratives et de communication - Engagement élevé pour maintenir / améliorer les niveaux de service - Esprit ouvert et orientation client - Compétence en anglais et espagnol
• Requisiti Desiderabili - Connaissance des principes financiers et comptables - Expérience dans le système SAP / Concur En échange, nous vous fournissons : - Des opportunités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage.
• Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constant, des cours et des formations linguistiques gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position internes et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière. - Excellents avantages et flexibilité : salaire concurrentiel et forfait cafétéria, allocation linguistique (si le poste nécessite une langue supplémentaire), bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances. Nous assurons également la flexibilité, pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre: le bureau à domicile est une pratique courante (1 jour/semaine de bureau en moyenne, et nous fournissons des conditions de travail totalement éloignées en Hongrie). Nous créons l'occasion pour la liberté de travailler, où votre vie privée et professionnelle coexistent en harmonie. - Une communauté mondiale diversifiée, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, donc vous avez toujours la chance de partager votre opinion. Contatto *Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'une demande à des fins de construction de la piscine Talent, ce qui signifie qu'elle peut ne pas nécessairement refléter une ouverture actuelle avec

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Turkish

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

*Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing

• Cerchiamo di aderire al nostro TALENT POOL al nostro Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest! Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche . • Requisiti
• Stiamo cercando qualcuno che sia automotivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, hai: - Almeno 1 anno di esperienza in una posizione rilevante nel campo delle Finanze/Accounting - Corso di laurea in Contabilità, Finanza o Business correlati campo - Buone competenze amministrative e di comunicazione - Alto impegno a mantenere / migliorare i livelli di servizio - mentalità aperta e focus del cliente - Proficienza in inglese e turco
• Requisiti Desiderabili - Conoscenza dei principi finanziari e contabili - Esperienza in SAP / Concur system In cambio vi forniamo: - opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera. - Ottimi benefici e flessibilità: pacchetto salariale competitivo e caffetteria, indennità di lingua (se la posizione richiede lingua extra), bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare Sportpass, coaching / opportunità di mentoring, programma amico, team building, festa. Garantiamo anche la flessibilità, per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio: l'ufficio è una pratica comune (1 giorno/settimana in media, e forniamo condizioni di lavoro completamente remote all'interno dell'Ungheria). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia. - Una comunità diversificata globale, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. Contatto *Si prega di notare che questa è una requisizione per scopi di costruzione Talent Pool, il che significa che non può necessariamente riflettere un'apertura corrente con in corso

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Position
Die Abteilung
In der Abteilung People Relations arbeiten wir in einem kollegialen Team an der Entwicklung kreativer und innovativer Lösungen zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung und Flexibilisierung der Arbeitsbedingungen. In einer leistungsorientierten Umgebung, die von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Aufrichtigkeit und Vertrauen getragen wird, bieten wir Dir den Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten.

Dein Referendariat

Im Rahmen Deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast Du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, den Alltag eines People Relations Partner in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen. Dabei wirst Du insbesondere mit folgenden Aufgaben vertraut:

• Du bearbeitest Fragestellungen aus dem Bereich des nationalen und internationalen Arbeitsrechts

• Du erarbeitest gutachterliche Stellungnahmen zu arbeits-, betriebsverfassungs- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragestellungen und wirkst an Vertragsgestaltungen mit

• Du bist an der Beratung von Führungskräften und People & Culture Mitarbeitenden in personalrechtlichen Themen beteiligt

• Du nimmst an der Vorbereitung von Verhandlungen mit den Arbeitnehmervertretungen teil

• Du erarbeitest selbstständig Teilprojekte

Dein Profil

• Du bist Rechtsreferendar (m/w/d) und möchtest Deine Wahlstation in einem global agierenden Unternehmen absolvieren

• Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung hast Du mit Erfolg bestanden

• Du hast Kenntnisse in und Interesse an Arbeitsrecht sowie wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen

• Du handelst selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich und bist aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung, mobiles Arbeiten und attraktive Vergütung

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (- 50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Attraktive Standorte mit zahlreichen Benefits

• Moderne IT-Ausstattung und Teilnahme an Team-Events

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden/Referendaren

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben online hoch. Bitte ergänze den möglichen Anfangs- und Endzeitpunkt Deines Referendariates.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.
With round about 8,000 employees Mannheim is the third largest Roche site in the world. It headquarters the Diabetes Care business unit and the sales organization of diagnostics products and is the hub of the worldwide diagnostics business. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Roche promuove la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione, rappresentando le comunità che serviamo. Quando si tratta di assistenza sanitaria su scala globale, la diversità è un ingrediente essenziale per il successo. Crediamo che l’inclusione sia la chiave per comprendere le diverse esigenze sanitarie delle persone. Insieme, abbracciamo l'individualità e condividiamo una passione per la cura eccezionale. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Nel dipartimento People Relations, lavoriamo in un team collegiale per sviluppare soluzioni creative e innovative per la continua ottimizzazione e flessibilità delle condizioni di lavoro. In un ambiente orientato alle prestazioni sostenuto da reciproco apprezzamento, sincerità e fiducia, vi offriamo lo spazio per il lavoro indipendente. Il tuo Referendariat Nell'ambito della vostra elezione legale, avete l'opportunità di conoscere la vita quotidiana di un People Relations Partner in un grande gruppo internazionale. Conoscerete i seguenti compiti:
• State lavorando su questioni relative al diritto del lavoro nazionale e internazionale
• Fornirete opinioni esperte su problemi di lavoro, di affari e di assicurazione sociale, e troverete contratti con
• Sei coinvolto nella consulenza di dirigenti e persone e dipendenti di cultura in materia personale
• Partecipa alla preparazione dei negoziati con i rappresentanti dei lavoratori Sviluppi in modo indipendente il tuo profilo
• Sei un esperto legale (m/w/d) e vuoi completare la tua stazione elettorale in una società attiva a livello globale
• Hai superato con successo la prima verifica legale
• Hai conoscenza e interesse del diritto del lavoro e dei contesti economici
• Sei esperto in inglese e non hai paura di parlare con i clienti internazionali I vostri vantaggi
• Distribuzione flessibile del tempo, lavoro mobile e remunerazione attraente
• Vantaggi nella nostra mensa del personale
• Luoghi interessanti con numerosi vantaggi
• Attrezzature IT moderne e la partecipazione agli eventi del team
• Networking con altri studenti / referenti La vostra domanda Si prega di caricare il vostro CV e una lettera di motivazione online. Si prega di integrare l'orario di inizio e fine del vostro referendum. Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione! Il tuo contatto con noi! Con la gente. Per le persone. Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Date un'occhiata alle nostre FAQ, le troverete via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Chi siamo a Roche, più di 100.000 persone in 100 paesi stanno spingendo indietro le frontiere della salute. Lavorando insieme, siamo diventati uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca al mondo. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità. Con circa 8.000 dipendenti Mannheim è il terzo sito Roche più grande del mondo. Ha sede l'unità aziendale Diabetes Care e l'organizzazione di vendita di prodotti diagnostici ed è il fulcro dell'attività di diagnostica mondiale. Dal vostro inizio con Roche, il nostro team motivato vuole accogliervi e supportarvi. Sono disponibili opportunità per lo sviluppo personale, orari di lavoro flessibili, pacchetti di compensazione interessanti e programmi speciali di assistenza familiare. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung
Unsere Gruppe beschäftigt sich mit viel Leidenschaft mit Prozess Innovation für die biotechnologische Einsatzstoffproduktion. Zusammen mit den Produktions- und Entwicklungsabteilungen arbeiten wir an neuen Technologien und Konzepten für unsere Roche Prozesse. Wir suchen dabei nach etablierten Technologien, die wir auf unsere Prozesse adaptieren können oder denken diese, wenn notwendig, komplett neu. Unser Team setzt sich aus Studenten im Master- und Bachelorstudium zusammen, dass durch PhD Studenten komplettiert wird. Werde auch du Teil von uns!

Deine Aufgaben

• Du gestaltest und Führst Dein eigenes Projekt

• Du führst eine umfangreiche Literaturrecherche durch, um den Status Quo zu erfassen und zu bewerten

• Du erarbeitest eigene Lösungskonzepte

• Du führst Machbarkeitsstudien durch

• Du bewertest deine Lösungskonzepte und sprichst eine Empfehlung für das weitere Vorgehen aus

Dein Profil

• Du wissbegierig und liebst es, dich mit neuen Themen zu beschäftigen

• Dein Arbeitsstil ist proaktiv, deine Vorgehensweise strukturiert

• Du liebst Diskussion und siehst sie als Möglichkeit, deine Lösungsansätze besser zu machen

• Du bist Student mit Schwerpunkt Materialfluss und Logistikkonzepte oder du bist Maschinenstudent oder vergleichbar.

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients

Deine Vorteile

• Du sammelst wertvolle Erfahrung im Projektmanagement

• Du wendest dein Fachwissen an und vertiefst dieses

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• Monatliche Vergütung

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Deine Bewerbung
Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Zeitraum : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Dein Kontakt zu uns! With people. For people.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche at Penzberg, near Munich, employs more than 7,000 people. The site is one of the largest biotechnology centers in Europe and the only Roche site with research, development and production for both Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics under one roof. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Position:

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, das Dir die Möglichkeit bietet, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich zu wachsen? Möchtest Du Deine theoretischen Kenntnisse in einem praxisorientierten Umfeld anwenden und in einem hochrelevanten und dynamischen Bereich mit globaler Bedeutung tätig werden? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und profitiere von individueller Betreuung und regelmäßigem Feedback, um Dein Potenzial voll auszuschöpfen.

Über uns:

Unsere Abteilung Marketing Molecular Solutions am Standort Mannheim (Division Roche Diagnostics) verantwortet die Marketingplanung, Strategieentwicklung und das Produktmanagement im Bereich der Gewebediagnostik und Women’s Health in Deutschland. Wir suchen mit dieser dauerhaft ausgeschriebenen Stelle immer wieder motivierte Talente, die mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft der Diagnostik gestalten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben:

In Deinem Praktikum übernimmst Du vielfältige Aufgaben und trägst maßgeblich zur Unterstützung des Marketing- und Produktmanagements bei:

• Du übernimmst die Durchführung von (Teil-)Projekten zur Unterstützung des Produktmanagements, darunter die Optimierung von Prozessen und Reportings.

• Du führst Markt- und Potentialanalysen durch, um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und hilfst bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Multi-Channel-Marketingkampagnen

• Du bist aktiv an der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Marketingkampagnen beteiligt, um unsere Produkte erfolgreich am Markt zu positionieren.

• In Zusammenarbeit mit externen Agenturen entwickelst Du kreative Kommunikationsmittel (z. B. Werbebroschüren, Anzeigen) oder setzt Deine eigenen Ideen bei der Erstellung von Marketingmaterialien um.

• Du bereitest wissenschaftliche und produktbezogene Informationen auf und unterstützt unser Vertriebsteam dabei, diese gezielt und effektiv einzusetzen.

• Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Durchführung von Schulungen und Events

Wer Du bist:

• Studienstatus: Du bist eingeschriebene/r Student/in der Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, wie z.B. Biologie, Betriebswirtschaftslehre und Gesundheitsmanagement und befindest Dich bereits in einem fortgeschrittenen Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Auch ein Praktikum in Deinem Gap Year ist bei uns möglich.

• Erfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Marketing und Vertrieb sind von Vorteil.

• Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest proaktiv, eigenverantwortlich und mit hoher Motivation. Deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hilft Dir dabei, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu verstehen und umzusetzen.

• Interessen: Du begeisterst Dich für Biologie, komplexe Erkrankungen und Herausforderungen im Gesundheitsmarkt.

• Technische Fähigkeiten: Unsere Arbeit basiert hauptsächlich auf Google-Tools wie G-Sheets und G-Slides. Vorkenntnisse sind daher ein Plus, aber mit Excel- oder PowerPoint-Erfahrung wirst Du Dich schnell einfinden . Sehr gute Deutsch- (C-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B-Niveau) runden Dein Profil ab.

Deine Vorteile:

• Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden und Praktikant:innen (online/offline)

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (Teil der Arbeitszeit im Homeoffice möglich)

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Nutzung verschiedenster Learning-Angebote, wie z.B. LinkedIn Learning

• Hospitationsmöglichkeiten

Deine Bewerbung:

Bitte füge einen aktuellen Lebenslauf und relevante Zeugnisse bei. Ein Anschreiben hilft uns, mehr über Dich und Deine Eignung für die Stelle zu erfahren. Ein Motivationsschreiben
