Wir suchen mit dieser dauerhaft ausgeschriebenen Stelle immer wieder motivierte Talente, die mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft der Diagnostik gestalten wollen. Deine Aufgaben: In Deinem Praktikum übernimmst Du vielfältige Aufgaben und trägst maßgeblich zur Unterstützung des Marketing- und Produktmanagements bei:
• Du übernimmst die Durchführung von (Teil-)Projekten zur Unterstützung des Produktmanagements, darunter die Optimierung von Prozessen und Reportings.
• Du führst Markt- und Potentialanalysen durch, um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und hilfst bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Multi-Channel-Marketingkampagnen
• Du bist aktiv an der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Marketingkampagnen beteiligt, um unsere Produkte erfolgreich am Markt zu positionieren.
• In Zusammenarbeit mit externen Agenturen entwickelst Du kreative Kommunikationsmittel (z. B. Werbebroschüren, Anzeigen) oder setzt Deine eigenen Ideen bei der Erstellung von Marketingmaterialien um.
• Du bereitest wissenschaftliche und produktbezogene Informationen auf und unterstützt unser Vertriebsteam dabei, diese gezielt und effektiv einzusetzen.
• Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Durchführung von Schulungen und Events Wer Du bist:
• Studienstatus: Du bist eingeschriebene/r Student/in der Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, wie z.B. Biologie, Betriebswirtschaftslehre und Gesundheitsmanagement und befindest Dich bereits in einem fortgeschrittenen Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Auch ein Praktikum in Deinem Gap Year ist bei uns möglich.
• Erfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Marketing und Vertrieb sind von Vorteil.
• Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest proaktiv, eigenverantwortlich und mit hoher Motivation. Deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hilft Dir dabei, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu verstehen und umzusetzen.
• Interessen: Du begeisterst Dich für Biologie, komplexe Erkrankungen und Herausforderungen im Gesundheitsmarkt.
• Technische Fähigkeiten: Unsere Arbeit basiert hauptsächlich auf Google-Tools wie G-Sheets und G-Slides. Vorkenntnisse sind daher ein Plus, aber mit Excel- oder PowerPoint-Erfahrung wirst Du Dich schnell einfinden . Sehr gute Deutsch- (C-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B-Niveau) runden Dein Profil ab. Deine Vorteile:
• Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden und Praktikant:innen (online/offline)
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (Teil der Arbeitszeit im Homeoffice möglich)
• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine
• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus
• Nutzung verschiedenster Learning-Angebote, wie z.B. LinkedIn Learning
• Hospitationsmöglichkeiten Deine Bewerbung: Bitte füge einen aktuellen Lebenslauf und relevante Zeugnisse bei. Ein Anschreiben hilft uns, mehr über Dich und Deine Eignung für die Stelle zu erfahren. Ein Motivationsschreiben

jobs.title: Customer Identity & Access Management Analyst

titleByLocale.fr: Analyste de la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès des clients

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Customer Identity & Access Management Analyst

We focus on the long - term, leading investment in research and development, striving to improve lives today and for generations to come. In Roche Informatics we are a diverse team of open and friendly people, enthusiastic about technological novelties and efficient IT solutions.

The opportunity:

• Participate in all aspect of the implementation of Enterprise CIAM strategies, policies, and procedures, ensuring they align with overall security and risk management objectives

• Assist with the delivery of CIAM projects and programs, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to a high standard of quality

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure CIAM solutions are integrated with existing systems and processes.

• Perform security assessments and identify potential improvements.

• Participate in incident response and troubleshooting efforts

• To stay aware of operational challenges and opportunities; works with support teams to provide internal escalation support as needed

• Actively focus on self-development in creating actionable plans to improve.

• Assist in the evaluation of solutions and their feasibility to Customer-Facing Application owners in a variety of environments including backend (PHP, Java, .NET), and client-side (REST, JavaScript) while ensuring procedures, processes and documentation are in compliance with regulatory guidelines and organizational standards,

• Demonstrate business awareness and understand the needs of the Application owners, and any other supporting IT Partner organization.

Who you are:

• 2 years of experience in administering and/or implementing CIAM or IAM solutions

• Experience in integrating with other solutions including APIs

• Someone who wants to influence their own development, demonstrate intellectual curiosity, a self-starter and embrace continuous improvement.

• Are execution-oriented with an agile mindset and looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field

• Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively

• Excited to help our customers to improve their consumer journeys

What you bring:

• Backend Development skills with at least one server platform such as .NET, Java, PHP.

• Front-end Development skills with at least one server platform such as HTML, CSS, REST, JavaScript and JS Libraries.

• SAP CDC (Gigya) Technical expertise.

• Experience in integration projects involving identity management aspects and web development and customer facing experience.

• Experience with SAML and OIDC

• Understanding of Identity and Access Management, and Customer Identity Management,

• Strong verbal and written English with excellent communication, negotiation and documentation skills.

• Awareness of Agile techniques like Scrum, SAFe, etc are a plus for this position.

At Roche, we believe in diversity and inclusion as essential values for our success. We have special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. If you have a disability, for us it is a plus, and we have special benefits for you: Go ahead and present your candidacy!

APPLY DIRECTLY
Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche IT first-hand? Check out our blog!
https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.
…..
Administratorem Pani/Pana danych

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Roche promuove la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione, rappresentando le comunità che serviamo. Quando si tratta di assistenza sanitaria su scala globale, la diversità è un ingrediente essenziale per il successo. Crediamo che l’inclusione sia fondamentale per comprendere le diverse esigenze sanitarie delle persone. Insieme, abbracciamo l'individualità e condividiamo una passione per la cura eccezionale. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Analizzatore di gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso del cliente Ci concentriamo sul lungo termine, che porta gli investimenti nella ricerca e nello sviluppo, cercando di migliorare le vite di oggi e per le generazioni a venire. In Roche Informatics siamo un team di persone aperte e amichevoli, entusiasti delle novità tecnologiche e delle soluzioni IT efficienti. L'opportunità - Partecipare a tutti gli aspetti dell'implementazione di strategie, politiche e procedure Enterprise CIAM, assicurando che si allineano con gli obiettivi generali di sicurezza e gestione dei rischi - Assistere con la consegna di progetti e programmi CIAM, assicurando che siano completati nel tempo, nel budget, e ad un alto livello di qualità - Lavorare a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali per garantire che le soluzioni CIAM siano integrate con sistemi e processi esistenti. - Eseguire le valutazioni di sicurezza e identificare potenziali miglioramenti. - Partecipare alla risposta degli incidenti e alla risoluzione dei problemi - Per rimanere consapevoli delle sfide e delle opportunità operative; lavorare con i team di supporto per fornire il supporto all'escalation interna secondo le necessità - Concentrarsi attivamente sull'autosviluppo nella creazione di piani attuabili per migliorare. - Assistere nella valutazione di soluzioni e la loro fattibilità ai proprietari di applicazioni di Customer-Facing in una varietà di ambienti tra cui backend (PHP, Java, .NET), e client-side (REST, JavaScript) assicurando al contempo procedure, processi e documentazione sono conformi alle linee guida normative e agli standard organizzativi, - Dimostrare la consapevolezza aziendale e comprendere le esigenze dei proprietari delle applicazioni, e qualsiasi altra organizzazione partner IT.
• Requisiti - 2 anni di esperienza nell'amministrazione e/o nell'attuazione delle soluzioni CIAM o IAM - Esperienza nell'integrazione con altre soluzioni tra cui API - Qualcuno che vuole influenzare il proprio sviluppo, dimostrare curiosità intellettuale, un auto-starter e abbracciare il miglioramento continuo. - Sono orientati all'esecuzione con una mentalità agile e alla ricerca di una società in cui si ha la possibilità di perseguire i vostri interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie. - Corso di laurea in Informatica, sicurezza delle informazioni, o un campo relativo - Conoscenza dei principi della sicurezza informatica e delle migliori pratiche - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e gestire il tempo in modo efficace - Eccitato per aiutare i nostri clienti a migliorare i loro viaggi di consumo Cosa significa? - Backend Capacità di sviluppo con almeno una piattaforma server come .NET, Java, PHP. - Capacità di sviluppo front-end con almeno una piattaforma server come HTML, CSS, REST, JavaScript e JS Libraries. - SAP CDC (Gigya) Competenza tecnica. - Esperienza in progetti di integrazione che coinvolgono aspetti di gestione dell'identità e sviluppo del web e l'esperienza del cliente. - Esperienza con SAML e OIDC - Comprensione dell'identità e della gestione dell'accesso e della gestione dell'identità del cliente, - Forte inglese verbale e scritto con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e documentazione. - La consapevolezza delle tecniche Agile come Scrum, SAFe, ecc sono un vantaggio per questa posizione. Contatto A Roche, crediamo nella diversità e nell'inclusione come valori essenziali per il nostro successo. Abbiamo un interesse particolare per integrare le persone con disabilità nelle nostre squadre. Se avete una disabilità, per noi è un plus, e abbiamo benefici speciali per voi: Avanti e presentare la vostra candidatura! DIRETTA APPLICA Vuoi sapere com'è essere parte di Roche IT di prima mano? Guarda il nostro blog! https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche Se sentite questa offerta si adatta ad un tuo amico, sentitevi liberi di condividerla. .... Amministratore Pani/Pana danych

Im globalen Umgang mit der Gesundheitsversorgung ist Vielfalt ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Erfolgs. Gemeinsam umarmen wir Individualität und teilen eine Leidenschaft für außergewöhnliche Sorgfalt. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. In Roche Informatics sind wir ein vielfältiges Team offener und freundlicher Menschen, begeistert von technologischen Neuheiten und effizienten IT-Lösungen. L'opportunità - Nehmen Sie an allen Aspekten der Umsetzung von Enterprise CIAM-Strategien, -Politiken und -verfahren teil, um sicherzustellen, dass sie sich an die Ziele des Gesamtsicherheits- und Risikomanagements anpassen - Assist mit der Lieferung von CIAM-Projekten und -Programmen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie pünktlich, im Budget und zu einem hohen Qualitätsstandard abgeschlossen werden - Arbeiten Sie eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass CIAM-Lösungen mit bestehenden Systemen und Prozessen integriert werden. - Sicherheitsbewertungen durchführen und mögliche Verbesserungen identifizieren. - Beteiligen Sie sich an Vorfallreaktionen und Fehlerbehebungen - Um sich der operativen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten bewusst zu bleiben; arbeitet mit Unterstützungsteams zusammen, um bei Bedarf interne Eskalationsunterstützung zu bieten - Konzentrieren Sie sich aktiv auf die Selbstentwicklung bei der Erstellung von Aktionsplänen zur Verbesserung. - Befindet sich bei der Bewertung von Lösungen und deren Machbarkeit gegenüber Kundenwunsch-Anwendungsbesitzern in einer Vielzahl von Umgebungen wie Backend (PHP, Java, .NET) und Client-Seite (REST, JavaScript) bei der Sicherstellung von Verfahren, Prozessen und Dokumentationen in Übereinstimmung mit regulatorischen Richtlinien und organisatorischen Standards, - Demonstrieren Sie das Geschäftsbewusstsein und verstehen Sie die Bedürfnisse der Anwendungsbesitzer und jede andere unterstützende IT-Partner-Organisation. Voraussetzungen - 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung und/oder Implementierung von CIAM- oder IAM-Lösungen - Erfahrung in der Integration mit anderen Lösungen, einschließlich APIs - Jemand, der ihre eigene Entwicklung beeinflussen will, zeigt die intellektuelle Neugier, einen Selbststarter und umschließt ständige Verbesserung. - Sind mit einer agilen Einstellung hingerichtet und auf der Suche nach einem Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Interessen über Funktionen und Geographien zu verfolgen. - Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationssicherheit oder einem verwandten Bereich - Kenntnisse von Cybersicherheitsprinzipien und bewährten Praktiken - Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten und Zeit effektiv zu verwalten - Erregt, unseren Kunden zu helfen, ihre Verbraucherreisen zu verbessern Cosa porti - Backend Development Fähigkeiten mit mindestens einer Serverplattform wie .NET, Java, PHP. - Front-end Entwicklungskompetenzen mit mindestens einer Serverplattform wie HTML, CSS, REST, JavaScript und JS Libraries. - SAP CDC (Gigya) Technische Expertise. - Erfahrung in Integrationsprojekten mit Aspekten des Identitätsmanagements, der Webentwicklung und der Erfahrung des Kunden. - Erfahrung mit SAML und OIDC - Verständnis von Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement und Customer Identity Management, - Starke mündliche und schriftliche englische Sprache mit exzellenten Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Dokumentationsfähigkeiten. - Bewusstsein für agile Techniken wie Scrum, SAFe, etc sind ein Plus für diese Position. Lorsqu'il s'agit de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, la diversité est un élément essentiel du succès. Nous croyons que l'inclusion est essentielle pour comprendre les besoins de santé variés des gens. Ensemble, nous acceptons l'individualité et partageons une passion pour les soins exceptionnels. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Analyste de la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès des clients Nous nous concentrons sur l'investissement à long terme, moteur de la recherche et du développement, qui vise à améliorer la vie d'aujourd'hui et celle des générations à venir. Dans Roche Informatique, nous sommes une équipe diversifiée de personnes ouvertes et amicales, enthousiastes aux nouveautés technologiques et aux solutions informatiques efficaces. L'opportunità - Participer à tous les aspects de la mise en oeuvre des stratégies, politiques et procédures du CMEI d'entreprise, en s'assurant qu'elles cadrent avec les objectifs généraux de sécurité et de gestion des risques - Aider à la réalisation des projets et programmes du CMEI, en s'assurant qu'ils sont achevés dans les délais, dans les limites du budget et à un niveau de qualité élevé - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes interfonctionnelles pour s'assurer que les solutions du CMEI sont intégrées aux systèmes et processus existants. - Effectuer des évaluations de sécurité et identifier les améliorations possibles. - Participer à l'intervention en cas d'incident et à la résolution des problèmes - Tenir compte des difficultés et des possibilités opérationnelles; travailler avec les équipes d'appui pour fournir un soutien interne en cas de besoin - Mettre activement l'accent sur l'auto-développement pour élaborer des plans d'action à améliorer. - Aider à l'évaluation des solutions et de leur faisabilité pour les propriétaires d'applications face au client dans divers environnements, dont le backend (PHP, Java, .NET) et côté client (REST, JavaScript) tout en veillant à ce que les procédures, les processus et la documentation soient conformes aux lignes directrices réglementaires et aux normes organisationnelles, - Démontrer la sensibilisation des entreprises et comprendre les besoins des propriétaires d'applications et de tout autre organisme partenaire en TI.
• Requisiti - 2 ans d'expérience dans l'administration et/ou la mise en œuvre de solutions CIAM ou IAM - Expérience dans l'intégration avec d'autres solutions, y compris les API - Quelqu'un qui veut influencer son propre développement, démontrer sa curiosité intellectuelle, un auto-démarrage et embrasser l'amélioration continue. - Oui. Sont orientés vers l'exécution avec un état d'esprit agile et à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous avez la possibilité de poursuivre vos intérêts à travers des fonctions et des géographies. - Baccalauréat en informatique, sécurité de l'information ou un domaine connexe - Connaissance des principes de cybersécurité et des meilleures pratiques - Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et de gérer efficacement le temps - Excité pour aider nos clients à améliorer leurs parcours de consommation Cosa porti - Compétences de développement backend avec au moins une plateforme serveur comme .NET, Java, PHP. - Compétences de développement frontal avec au moins une plate-forme serveur comme HTML, CSS, REST, JavaScript et JS Libraries. - SAP CDC (Gigya) Expertise technique. - Expérience dans les projets d'intégration impliquant des aspects de gestion de l'identité et de développement web et l'expérience client. - Expérience avec SAML et OIDC - Compréhension de la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès, et gestion de l'identité des clients, - Anglais verbal et écrit fort avec d'excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et documentation. - La sensibilisation aux techniques agiles comme Scrum, SAFe, etc. sont un atout pour cette position. Contatto Chez Roche, nous croyons en la diversité et l'inclusion comme valeurs essentielles à notre succès. Nous avons un intérêt particulier à intégrer les personnes handicapées dans nos équipes. Si vous avez un handicap, pour nous c'est un plus, et nous avons des avantages spéciaux pour vous: Allez-y et présentez votre candidature! jobs.title: Rechtsreferendar (m/w/d) - Datenschutz
jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Position
Deine Abteilung

Als Referendar der Rechtswissenschaft (m/w/d) unterstützt und begleitest Du die Roche-Datenschutzorganisation bei allen Anliegen innerhalb des Datenschutzrechts und angrenzender rechtlicher Themenfelder. Du gewinnst so Einblicke in ein global tätiges Healthcare-Unternehmen und erhältst die Möglichkeit, Deine rechtlichen Kenntnisse in spannenden Projekten und im Austausch mit Deinen Kolleg:innen der Rechtsabteilungen anzuwenden und auszubauen. Die Tätigkeit kann nach Absprache ganz oder teilweise im Home Office sowie an den Standorten Mannheim, Penzberg (Großraum München) oder Grenzach erfolgen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du bearbeitest Fragestellungen aus dem Bereich des Datenschutzrechts und unterstützt den Datenschutzbeauftragten der deutschen Roche-Gesellschaften

• Du hilfst bei der Ausgestaltung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Datenschutzprozesse

• Du beteiligst Dich an der Durchführung von Datenschutz-Reviews/-Audits

• Du berätst Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende in datenschutzrechtlichen Themen

• Du arbeitest selbstständig in Teilprojekten mit Bezug zum Datenschutz und Datenschutz-Management

Dein Profil

• Du bist Referendar (m/w/d) der Rechtswissenschaft und möchtest Deine Wahlstation in einem global agierenden Unternehmen absolvieren

• Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung hast Du mit überdurchschnittlichem Erfolg bestanden

• Du hast idealerweise erste Kenntnisse im und ein gesteigertes Interesse am Datenschutzrecht

• Deine Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch Professionalität, Teamfähigkeit und Kreativität aus

• Du handelst selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich und bist aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung und Home-Office

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Attraktive Standorte mit zahlreichen Benefits

• Moderne IT-Ausstattung und Teilnahme an Team-Events

• Vernetzung mit anderen Rechtsreferendaren (online/offline)

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben online hoch.

Bitte gib an, für welchen Zeitraum Du Deine Referendariatsstation vorgesehen hast.

Zeitraum: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von mind. 3 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.
With round about 8,000 employees Mannheim is the third largest Roche site in the world. It headquarters the Diabetes Care business unit and the sales organization of diagnostics products and is the hub of the worldwide diagnostics business. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Career Conversion Programme (CCP) (Train-and-Place) for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals Manufacturing Executives/Professionals is a talent development programme aimed at building the next generation of skilled manpower for Singapore’s Biopharmaceuticals manufacturing industry in anticipation of hiring demand. This programme is jointly supported by the Workforce Singapore (WSG) and Workforce Advancement Federation (WAF).

The training programme consists of 15 months of local attachment with Roche.

The Opportunity

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or Engineering, or equivalent qualifications such as a Diploma, NITEC, or similar.

• Experience in biologics is a plus.

• Must possess strong problem-solving abilities, interpersonal communication, and teamwork skills.

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.
• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.
• Troubleshoot equipment and process problems.
• Support process improvement efforts.
• Operate computers for process control and data entry.
• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.
• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirements. Report safely incidents and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.
• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses, and hazards as soon as practicable.
• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.
• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications
• Fresh Graduate with degree in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or Diploma or NITEC or equivalent holders.
• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills. The Career Conversion Programme (CCP) (Train-and-Place) for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals Manufacturing Executives/Professionals is a talent development programme aimed at building the next generation of skilled manpower for Singapore’s Biopharmaceuticals manufacturing industry in anticipation of hiring demand. This programme is jointly supported by the Workforce Singapore (WSG) and Workforce Advancement Federation (WAF). The training programme consists of 15 months of local attachment with Roche. Who we are At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be:

• Co-ordinate with SSC KL Finance teams (AP, GAMA, AR, TR, T&E, Compliance and Procurement) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with month-end close checklist.

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, accountable for the financial accuracy of the affiliate’s Financials. Responsible of all Internal Controls of Financial Reporting (ICFR) documentation and internal controls matters, act as owner for the ICFR tools – INVOLVE and BWISE

• Review monthly balance sheet reconciliation – follow up on open items and rectify any anomalies encountered. Submission other reporting packages accurately and within specified timeline i.e. Sustainability, Insurance reporting. Responsible of IFRS 16 Leasing related matters i.e SimSol /Planon . Review and provide approval for all manual journal entries for posting by SSC KL team. Responsible for all management accounting aspects i.e. Period cost allocation, COPA allocation, SSC allocation, etc

• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.

• Treasury : Cash flow management - forecast current and future cash flow requirement and arrangement for necessary fund transfers (if required). Responsible for all treasury matters i.e. FX deal, credit facilities, payment request, banking matters.

• Master Data : Managing of master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Others activities which include : Preparation of statutory taxes calculations and reconciliation, including tax reporting and liaising with Tax Consultant. Preparation of audit related schedules and documentation, including liaising with the Auditor. Participate in any compliance audits and responding to audit queries. Identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation. Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory.

Who you are :

• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.

• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.

• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Able to commit for business travel when required.

• Proficient in English, Japa

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1) 进行数据整理及分析，洞察业务机会和风险，协助区域生态群负责人制定属地化一体化策略，包含学术平台的搭建和资源布局、准入与安全运营、创新平台和患者可支付性的提升等所有和提升诊疗水平和患者全程管理相关的举措。
2) 负责生态群内各平台和项目的协同，确保资源的有效实施和整合，最大化资源使用效率
3) 合理布局患者解决方案团队的工作重点，支持到生态圈负责人的各项关键任务的落地实施
4) 对接圈外（总部）的医学/法务合规/准入/市场/培训等跨部门，建立沟通和合作机制，确保生态圈内外部的及时精准的传递
5) 负责团队管理和人员辅导，不断促进团队的工作效能，打造敏捷的工作氛围和方式

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
• 成长性思维和快速学习能力
• 具备业务敏锐度和市场洞察、规划能力
• 优秀的沟和资源整合能力
• 合作伙伴及大客户管理能力
• 团队管理或无职权情况下的团队管理经验

Years of Working Experience工作年限
• 8年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先
• 有跨职能、或者治疗领域经验优先

Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
• 本科及以上学历（医学、药学、市场相关更优）

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche China consists of the full value chain of Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics fields, from early research, clinical development, manufacturing to commercialization. With more than 7,000 employees, Roche China is now working to develop itself into Roche's third global strategic center after Basel and San Francisco, and making sustained efforts to fulfill its long-term commitment to China, so as to meet Chinese patients’ unmet needs.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be:

• Co-ordinate with SSC KL Finance teams (AP, GAMA, AR, TR, T&E, Compliance and Procurement) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with month-end close checklist.

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, accountable for the financial accuracy of the affiliate’s Financials. Responsible of all Internal Controls of Financial Reporting (ICFR) documentation and internal controls matters, act as owner for the ICFR tools – INVOLVE and BWISE

• Review monthly balance sheet reconciliation – follow up on open items and rectify any anomalies encountered. Submission other reporting packages accurately and within specified timeline i.e. Sustainability, Insurance reporting. Responsible of IFRS 16 Leasing related matters i.e SimSol /Planon . Review and provide approval for all manual journal entries for posting by SSC KL team. Responsible for all management accounting aspects i.e. Period cost allocation, COPA allocation, SSC allocation, etc

• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.

• Treasury : Cash flow management - forecast current and future cash flow requirement and arrangement for necessary fund transfers (if required). Responsible for all treasury matters i.e. FX deal, credit facilities, payment request, banking matters.

• Master Data : Managing of master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Others activities which include : Preparation of statutory taxes calculations and reconciliation, including tax reporting and liaising with Tax Consultant. Preparation of audit related schedules and documentation, including liaising with the Auditor. Participate in any compliance audits and responding to audit queries. Identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation. Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory.

Who you are :

• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.

• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.

• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Able to commit for business travel when required.

• Proficient in English, Japa

jobs.title: Rechtsreferendar (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind
Bei Roche leisten über 94.000 Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt. Vom ersten Tag an werden Sie bei Roche von einem kollegialen Team aufgenommen und unterstützt. Neben zahlreichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen und einer attraktiven Vergütung erwarten Sie Angebote zum Thema Familie Beruf.

Was Sie erwartet
Ihr Referendariat im Bereich Rechtswissenschaften beinhaltet folgende Themen:

• Unterstützung der Anwälte der Rechtsabteilung bei der umfassenden rechtlichen Beratung der Fachabteilungen

• Bearbeitung verschiedener typischer wirtschafts- und pharmarechtlicher Fragestellungen aus dem Alltag eines Syndikusrechtsanwaltes

• Verhandlungen mit Vertragspartnern und Regelung außergerichtlicher Streitigkeiten

• Kostenlose Unterkunft im Roche Boardinghaus ab einer Entfernung zum Wohnort von mind. 100 km

• Die Möglichkeit aus dem Home Office heraus zu arbeiten

Wer Sie sind
Für Ihr Referendariat im Bereich Rechtswissenschaften bringen Sie folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Sie sind Referendar (m/w/d) der Rechtswissenschaft

• Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung mit kleinem Prädikat haben Sie bereits erfolgreich bestanden

• Ihre Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch Professionalität, Teamfähigkeit, Kreativität und Verhandlungsgeschick aus

• Sie handeln selbständig und eigenverantwortlich und sind aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege

Referendaren (m/w/d) wird die Absolvierung der Pflichtwahl oder Anwaltsstation (Teilableistung in Wirtschaftsunternehmen bis zu 4 Monaten) geboten.

Für weiterführende Informationen besuchen Sie bitte: https://www.roche.de/about/standorte/grenzach

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche Pharma AG at Grenzach-Wyhlen is steering central elements of the technical quality control for the whole European region. For the German market clinical research, marketing and all sales activities are located there. Grenzach-Wyhlen is the location of Roche Deutschland Holding GmbH. From here, the German Roche Group coordinates the financial activities of the national organization. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

jobs.title: Development Engineer (contract 80-100%)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department within R&D is responsible for workflow optimization and successfully integrating hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a Development Engineer, you will work as a cross-functional team on automating and tooling to maintain and further develop launched complex diagnostic systems.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Elaborating on (Cobots-)Robotics concepts within a laboratory environment towards our vision of a dark lab by fully automating laboratory operations and workflows.

• Programming, testing, and maintaining of newly created and existing automated solutions within our laboratories.

• Supporting our Integration Teams in the installation and troubleshooting of Robotics Solutions within our laboratory environment

• Plan, coordinate, and execute work packages within your area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating topics or issues to the team and management.

• Be able to work as an individual and as part of a team.

Who you are:

• You are graduated with a bachelor's or master preferably in computer science, with specific knowledge in, e.g., robotics and/or vision, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or systems engineering or equivalent.

• Knowledge of professional Software development with one or more programming languages (e.g. UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)

• You are excited to work as a professional in the medical diagnostics industry.

• Excellent spoken and written command of English (German is advantageous).

• You can communicate appropriately with different target groups.

• You are motivated to build, manage, and foster relationships and networks within the department and the related projects.

• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues conceptual and creative thinking.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today, and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Who We Are
Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories, and doctors’ offices. The company employs over 2200 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics main sites.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a Lab Technician, you will work as a cross-functional team to maintain and further develop launched complex diagnostic systems.
In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Responsible for laboratories supervision and laboratory equipment

• Representing the working group in the quality team for laboratories

• Support of R&D and validation projects

• Carry out and analyze molecular biology experiments following established SOPs

• Ordering, tracking, and accepting test samples and consumables according to SOPs

• Independent communication with other departments

• Report experimental results to project managers in a timely manner

Who you are

You are someone who wants to influence your development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

The ideal candidate for our dynamic, international team will have the following skills and experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in biology or related field preferred.

• Experience and willingness to work in a highly regulated industry and labs with biosafety levels 1 and 2.

• Enthusiastic team player with good communication and collaboration skills. Solution-oriented, autonomous, and proactive working style.

• Experience in statistical data analysis

• You write and speak English fluently; German is a plus.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position

( Please note that this vacancy is currently not linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.)
In a global and cross-functional environment, the System Development department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.
As a System Development Software Tester, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on the development of new complex diagnostics systems consisting of fluidics, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical, and biochemistry elements.
As a Software Testergineer in the new Analyzer Project, your main responsibilities will consist of (but will not be limited to):

• Plan and execution of the work packages within the area of responsibility, including reporting and escalation of issues to the management.

• Experienced with Windows and Linux Operations System

• Know-how in setting up an automated testing environment and familiar in using data analysis tools to provide statistical data to the management

• Experienced in using Network Protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, and SSL)

• Familiar in using Gateways, Firewalls and using Remote Access

• Subject matter expert for Communications protocols between instruments and Laboratory informations systems(LIS). Provide guidance and support to others. Flexibility to transfer knowledge to different tasks/subprojects within SD.

• Experimental design and execution of the experiments in the lab. Creation of Test Cases based on Product Requirements. Execution of Test Cases, analysis of the results, and creation of the respective regulatory documents. Issue tracking and verification of bug fixes/Anomalies.

• Generate required documentation/procedures/technical reports in support of daily activities and be able to author official documents in English (e.g., Design history Files) for the preparation of milestones. Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to own or other groups.

• Coordinate efforts with other functional areas to accomplish tasks: Hardware-, Software-, Consumables-, Assay-and Algorithm-Development.

Who you are

You’re someone who wants to influence your development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

To be successful in this role (you provide):

• Degree in a technical or life sciences discipline (e.g., Software- or Electrical Engineering,

• Electronic/Automation, Bio- and Process-Engineering,) or related job experience.

• Minimum 1 years of work experience in the development of diagnostic systems in a System Development or related field

• Ability to work independently, handling cross-departmental development tasks

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and German

• Strong analytical and interdisciplinary thinking

• Experience in statistical data analysis

• Experience in and willingness to work in a highly regulated industry and labs with biosafety levels S1and S2

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and successfully integrating hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

As a Development Engineer, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team, working on Nucleic Acid Purification, PCR and Sequencing, on developing complex diagnostics systems. You will perform hands-on experiments, Hardware (HW) and Software (SW) testing, including evaluation of system performance, error handling, and reliability improvements.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today, and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Plan and execute the work packages within the area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating issues to management.

• Subject matter expert for an assigned area of responsibility. Provide guidance and support to team members.

• Generate required documentation/procedures/technical reports.

• Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to team and management.

• Experimental design and execution of the experiments in the biosafety levels S1 and S2 laboratory.

• Creation of Test Cases based on Product Requirements. Execution of Test Cases, analysis of the results, and creation of the respective regulatory documents. Issue tracking and verification of bug fixes/Anomalies.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems. Document and maintain software functionality.

• Coordinate efforts with other functional areas to accomplish tasks: Hardware, Software-, Consumables-and Assay-Development.

You are someone who wants to influence your development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. A job title is not considered the final definition of who you are but the starting point.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

Key Responsibilities:

• Data Excellence: Review and set up new suppliers, customers, or change existing vendor/customer details in SAP, adhering to our Vendor Master Data SOP.

• Accuracy in Action: Enter vendor data accurately in MDGS platform, including bank details and change requests, ensuring data integrity.

• Quality Assurance: Approve data and enhancements based on supporting, verifying bank details as per SOP and ICFR requirements.

• Collaborative Validation: Validate records sent by business for user requests, maintaining data accuracy.

• Continuous Improvement: Provide data and root cause analysis for process enhancements, supporting a culture of continuous improvement.

Key Accountabilities:

• Data Integrity Champion: Ensure accuracy and integrity of master data for vendors and customers, adhering to corporate policies and procedures.

• Compliance Steward: Monitor and resolve emails in the vendor master email box, ensuring adherence to Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR) and local statutory requirements.

• Efficiency Enabler: Timely creation, verification, and cleanup of vendor and customer master data, supporting business requirements seamlessly.

• Support Maestro: Provide timely helpdesk support, training, and collaboration with internal stakeholders for master data processes.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Excellent communication skills in English, fostering effective collaboration.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in transactional accounting or shared service environment, with exposure to master data management.

• Proficiency in SAP or other ERP accounting systems, as well as MS Office tools.

• Experience in shared services or business process outsourcing is a plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
Roche Data Scientists are essential leaders in driving and implementing a broad range of quantitative drug development strategies; they bring data to life and enable the organization to make the best possible data-driven decisions.
As a Data Scientist at Roche Pharma, you’ll actively shape the future of healthcare as a member of Data and Statistical Sciences (DSS) within Product Development (PD) and PD Data Sciences (PDD).
You will be responsible for the strategic and analytical activities of the molecules and devices in our pipeline on a level matching your seniority.
DSS activities span multiple therapeutic areas, a wide range of data types, and collaborations with a variety of experts, all with the goal to develop innovative healthcare solutions for patients and society.
Your responsibilities in support of our PDD products may include a wide variety of contributions: partnering with key stakeholders, working on the molecule portfolio, supporting specialized business areas, or contributing to key initiatives that shape our technical, business and healthcare environments. You may be a work product owner and leader, quantitative expert on a project team, or driver of key internal or external relationships.

Key Accountabilities
Data Sciences Leadership

• Accountable for the development and implementation of Data Sciences products.

• Lead and/ or support multiple elements of the drug development process across various phases of clinical trials.

• Lead and/ or support regular review of opportunities to simplify and innovate, and collaborate with experts in DSS, PDD and beyond to accelerate and deliver patient benefits faster.

• Lead and/ or support prioritization efforts, demonstrating urgency and taking smart risks to make considered decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Drug Development Strategy and Execution

• Lead or contribute technical expertise to multiple elements of the business, including: strategic planning; communication; and implementation.

Mansioni Roche Data Les scientifiques sont des leaders essentiels dans la conduite et la mise en oeuvre d'un large éventail de stratégies quantitatives de développement des médicaments; ils mettent les données à jour et permettent à l'organisation de prendre les meilleures décisions possibles en fonction des données. En tant que Data Scientist chez Roche Pharma, vous façonnerez activement l'avenir des soins de santé en tant que membre de Data and Statistical Sciences (DSS) au sein du développement de produits (PD) et de PD Data Sciences (PDD). Évolution des carrières - Chercher continuellement des occasions d'élargir les connaissances, les capacités et les compétences afin de permettre aux talents de s'intégrer dans différents domaines de spécialité et de maladie. - Le partage des connaissances au sein du SSD, de la DDP et au-delà. - Agir en tant qu'entraîneur, mentor ou ami pour aider les collègues à grandir et à se développer. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （1）协助在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2）协助进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3）协助开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4）协助及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （1）在校大学生
• （2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at Roche Diagnostics Germany!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As an Account Manager at Roche Sequencing Solutions, you will be at the forefront of revolutionizing the sequencing landscape. Embrace this unique opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic team and drive our innovative products to market success.

The Opportunity
As an Account Manager, you will:

• Identify and Cultivate Leads: Discover sales opportunities, cultivate new business relationships, and engage key decision-makers in the sequencing community.

• Execute Growth Plans: Develop and monitor regional commercial growth plans, focusing on key success metrics to achieve revenue and strategic goals.

• Optimize Sales Opportunities: Manage sales opportunities effectively through Salesforce/CRM.

• Present and Consult: Conduct product presentations and consultative discussions to showcase the value of our sequencing solutions.

• Drive Technical Sales: Provide technical expertise throughout the sales process, including application consultations and data analysis support.

• Enhance Brand Visibility: Represent Roche at conferences, trade shows, and networking events to establish thought leadership and engage potential customers.

• Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with marketing, product management, service, and support teams to align sales efforts with company objectives and customer needs.

• Regional Execution: Partner with subregional teams across Europe to develop and implement strategic plans for successful market penetration.

Who You Are
You possess:

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Life Science, Business, or a related field.

• Sales Experience: Proven experience in selling capital equipment within the diagnostics/life sciences industry.

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Next Generation Sequencing and related genomic techniques.

• Strategic and Negotiation Skills: Demonstrated excellence in negotiation, strategic planning, and organizational abilities.

• Consultative Selling: Ability to identify technical needs and provide business solutions.

• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Strong business acumen and drive to navigate complex sales processes.

• Communication Skills: Ability to deliver impactful group presentations and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Travel Requirements: Willingness to undertake national and international travel.

• Preferred Experience: 5+ years in a clinical research or academic laboratory environment, experience selling Sequencers for NGS applications, and proficiency in NGS data analysis.

• Language Skills: Fluent in English. Knowledge of German and/or other European languages is an advantage.

Join Roche Sequencing Solutions to make a difference in the genomic landscape and deliver state-of-the-art sequencing solutions to the world. Apply now and become a part of a company dedicated to innovation and excellence.

Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing recruitment or selection process, but a position we are frequently recruiting for or we are planning to open in the near future.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Q&V and Digitalization Quality

titleByLocale.en: Head of Q&V and Digitalization Quality

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities

Technical responsibilities

• Oversee and guide the technical strategy and direction of validation activities for PT Shanghai in the preparation and execution of validation protocols, including facility, utilities, equipment, cleaning, and computer system validation.

• Review and approve site Validation Master Plan (VMP)/project plans and ensure the strategy meets business and regulatory requirements. As needed, review/approve validation protocols, engineering change orders, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP), engineering commissioning and turnover packages.

• Provide input and review for site-specific and corporate validation procedures and shared practices as applicable and in accordance with the requirements set forth in the governing quality standards in partnership with Global Quality.

• Oversee and guide execution of the validation of tech transfer oversight, new facility expansions and construction projects.

• Review and approve all relevant Quality Validation and other Site documentation and ensure documentation supports a compliant state.

• Provide expert interpretation and application of regulatory guidelines to ensure operations, facilities and documentation meet Roche standards and regulatory requirements.

• ensuring that the department ensures quality oversight of the qualification and validation processes. This applies across the entire lifecycle of the processes and equipment. This includes:

• Plant qualification of production equipment and the entire infrastructure (pharmaceutical water, HVAC, process gases).

• Validation of production, cleaning and transport processes

• Validation of computer systems and software (CSV), including ensuring current data integrity requirements.

• Oversight of product and process transfers from or to other locations and partners

• Other activities assigned.

Leadership responsibilities

• Establish and lead a competitive team to ensure the delivery and good performance through strong team work and shared responsibilities

• Create an environment of strong team spirit, timely and effective communications, sense of urgency, high motivation and inspire teams to achieve goals in the immediate and longer term. Be an active and visible change agent, promoting flexible and open mindsets to new opportunities.

• As a leader within the Quality Leadership team, drive network activities and alignment, cross-functional planning, and decision making.

Qualification and Experience
Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor Degree or above (Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical, bioengineering, Chemistry or other relevant discipline is preferred).

Leadership Competencies

• Leads by example

• Strong leadership, teamwork and management skills

• Ability to effectively communicate and influence across all levels of the organization

• Good accountability of problem solving

• Empower and trust people to make decisions

• Discover and develop the potential in people

Job Required Competencies

• 10 or more years' work experience in the pharmaceutical or related industry

• 3 or more years' people management experience

• 5 or more years' experience in a commercially licensed GMP facility

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

• Expert knowledge of Quality System, Quality Validation and QA principles, practices and standards for the pharmaceutical industry.

• Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical, biotechnology or medical device related product operations including local and international qual

jobs.title: Head of Molecular Lab
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Us
At Roche, we are committed to making a meaningful impact on society through innovative healthcare solutions. We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment where you can grow, learn, and contribute to cutting-edge advancements in diagnostics. Join us to be part of a purpose-driven company that values diversity, flexibility, and professional development.

The Opportunity
As the Head of Molecular Lab , you will report to the designated executive leader and be based in China. This pivotal role combines strategic vision with operational excellence, driving the growth and success of our Molecular Diagnostics division. You will collaborate with global teams, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of diagnostics in China.

What You Will Be Working On

• Act as the key interface with Regional/Global Marketing Groups to secure resources and align strategies.

• Lead product launch processes, ensuring milestones are met and compliance standards are upheld.

• Represent Roche in business partnerships and key customer interactions to foster strong relationships.

• Oversee sales, marketing, and customer service operations to maximize effectiveness.

• Mentor and develop talent to build a high-performing team and ensure robust succession planning.

• Develop and implement strategies for distributor management, pricing, and regulatory compliance.

• Identify market opportunities, monitor industry trends, and drive innovative business initiatives.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a science/medical-related field; MBA or postgraduate qualifications are a plus.

• Experience: 15+ years in sales and marketing management within multinational pharmaceutical/medical device companies, preferably in In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD).

• Skills: Proficiency in English (written and spoken), strong command of MS Office, and deep industry/market expertise.

• Values: Alignment with Roche’s core values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion.

• Leadership: Proven ability to drive operational excellence, manage P&L, and inspire teams.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: T&E Compliance Analyst (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Coordinates and manages compliance activities for the assigned affiliate in the assigned division. Evaluates existing and evolving healthcare and privacy compliance, ethics and related legislation and regulations and other marketplace/industry dynamics to determine requirements for Roche policies and procedures. Assess the employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

Manages and completes internal and external reporting regarding the affiliate's healthcare, privacy, ethics and related compliance. Responds to inquiries and provides guidance and advice on compliance and resources to support business operations, team and individual adherence. Where observed, escalates actual or potential compliance violations or other issues to relevant colleagues or management, according to local, regional and/or global policies and procedures.

Role Responsibilities:
Operational

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e. assessment results) activities in concur during claim processing

• Escalates issues and recommend resolution plans in a timely manner to the RSS Line Manager and Affiliate (where required)

• Support the preparation of reports and training material on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• In collaboration with Reporting Line Manager make appropriate recommendation to HOD for process improvement and be part of the solution provision activities

Qualifications and Experience

• University degree or equivalent experience or above (prefer business, law or finance related major)

• More than 2 years’ experience in compliance reviews or its equivalent and its implementation in a highly regulated environment or in audit firms

• Strong analytical skills, be able to assess the facts with professional skepticism

• Strong communications skills, Fluent in both written and spoken English and Japanese as this role will required to support Roche Japan counterpart

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks efficiently

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.
