Con sede a Basilea, Svizzera, il nostro team di circa 700 esperti lavora in collaborazione per dare vita alla nostra visione, offrendo soluzioni efficaci che supportano la nostra missione e sostengono i nostri valori fondamentali. L'opportunità Nella posizione, si fornisce la direzione strategica e la leadership per la produzione di sostanze stupefacenti cliniche e commerciali, garantendo l'allineamento con la visione a lungo termine di PTDC. In questo modo guiderai e supervisionerai la produzione di sostanze stupefacenti cliniche e commerciali, garantendo efficienza, conformità e innovazione. Sarete anche responsabili di: - Guidare la scala-up e il trasferimento dei processi di Drug Substance per la fornitura clinica e commerciale. - Assicurare la produzione sicura, conforme e conveniente di lotti clinici e commerciali. - Qualità campione, conformità normativa e eccellenza operativa, mantenendo uno stato "pronto ispezioni" e promuovere una forte cultura Sicurezza, Salute e Ambiente all'interno dell'organizzazione. - Guidare l'eccellenza operativa incorporando strategie digitali e basate sui dati per l'ottimizzazione e l'efficienza dei processi. - Anticipare e mitigare i rischi tecnici, operativi e scientifici, promuovendo l'innovazione nella produzione di sostanze stupefacenti. - Guidare, allenare e sviluppare un team altamente performante, promuovere una cultura di responsabilità e crescita professionale, nonché la collaborazione interfunzionale con partner interni ed esterni per guidare l'innovazione di processo. Chi sei? Porti un'esperienza significativa in un ruolo di leadership all'interno della fornitura di sostanze chimiche e droghe sintetiche Molecole cliniche e commerciali e goditi la formazione e la navigazione attraverso complessità. Con le vostre forti capacità di leadership creativa (secondo il modello VACC di Visionary, Architetto, Coach, Catalyst), si costruisce prospettive all'avanguardia e rimuovere gli ostacoli con l'obiettivo di sviluppare le persone e ampliare le competenze tecniche. Più lontano, si porta: - Conoscere in modo eccezionale le linee guida e gli standard normativi per lo sviluppo e la produzione di sostanze stupefacenti e le pratiche dei requisiti CGMP e SHE - Consistente track record di sviluppo di organizzazioni e team diversificati e performanti con elevati standard per l'eccellenza scientifica, la guida dell'innovazione e l'efficacia operativa - Abilitato nella gestione di complesse relazioni con gli stakeholder, di importanti iniziative trasformative, e di garantire un processo decisionale rapido e ad alto impatto. - Forte acume aziendale, con la capacità di identificare e risolvere proattivamente i problemi che influenzano la direzione aziendale e guidare i cambiamenti all'interno del settore Contatto (senza informazioni fornite)

• Consistent track record of developing diverse, high performing organizations and teams with high standards for scientific excellence, driving innovation and operational effectiveness

• Strong business acumen, with the ability to proactively identify and resolve issues that influence business direction and drive changes within the industry o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity:

• Provide expert scientific guidance and strategic input to project teams and leadership within our Analytical R&D department.

• Act as a senior mentor for NDA authoring and drive due diligence processes, providing expert scientific input that shapes key decisions.

• Lead the resolution of complex CMC issues, overseeing root cause analyses and ensuring timely, collaborative solutions.

• Leverage your extensive experience in pharmaceutical research and development to shape our scientific strategies and roadmaps.

• Serve as a critical link between different teams, collaborating with cross-functional partners to tackle scientific challenges and identify new opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement by analyzing common risks across our portfolio and designing innovative, portfolio-wide solutions.

• Spearhead and implement strategic cross-functional projects, such as R&D Excellence initiatives, to enhance our operational effectiveness.

• Contribute to the future of our team by training, mentoring, and guiding other scientific staff, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and growth.

Who you are:

• You have an advanced degree (Ph.D. preferred) in a relevant scientific discipline such as Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry or a related field.

• You bring extensive experience in pharmaceutical research and development, with deep scientific knowledge in the analytical development of parenterals and combination products with devices ideally including experience with various synthetic molecule modalities like oligonucleotides, peptides or classical small molecules.

• You possess a proven track record of success in NDA preparation and the transfer of projects to commercial manufacturing.

• You are a strategic problem-solver with strong analytical skills, capable of identifying and mitigating scientific risks and opportunities.

• You are a highly effective communicator with excellent interpersonal skills, able to influence and collaborate across diverse teams.

• You thrive in a collaborative team environment, actively participating in scientific discussions and decision-making processes.

• You stay abreast of the latest scientific advancements and trends, continuously applying new knowledge to drive innovation.

• You are a natural mentor , passionate about training and guiding other scientific professionals.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

## Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. ## Mansioni - Fornire una guida scientifica esperta e un contributo strategico ai team di progetto e alla leadership all'interno del nostro dipartimento di R&D analitico. - Atto come mentore senior per NDA che autorizza e guida i processi di due diligence, fornendo un contributo scientifico esperto che forma le decisioni chiave. - Guidare la risoluzione di complessi problemi CMC, supervisionare le analisi delle cause root e garantire soluzioni tempestive e collaborative. - Leva la tua vasta esperienza nella ricerca e sviluppo farmaceutico per modellare le nostre strategie scientifiche e roadmap. - Servire come collegamento critico tra diversi team, collaborando con partner interfunzionali per affrontare le sfide scientifiche e identificare nuove opportunità. - Migliorare continuamente analizzando i rischi comuni attraverso il nostro portafoglio e progettando soluzioni innovative a livello di portafoglio. - Spearhead e implementare progetti strategici interfunzionali, come iniziative di R&D Excellence, per migliorare la nostra efficacia operativa. - Contribuisci al futuro del nostro team formando, guidando e guidando altri collaboratori scientifici, promuovendo una cultura della condivisione e della crescita della conoscenza. #
• Requisiti # - Hai una laurea avanzata (Ph.D. preferito) in una disciplina scientifica rilevante come le scienze farmaceutiche, la chimica o un campo correlato. - Lei porta una vasta esperienza nella ricerca e nello sviluppo farmaceutico, con profonda conoscenza scientifica nello sviluppo analitico dei genitori e dei prodotti di combinazione con i dispositivi idealmente compreso l'esperienza con varie modalità di molecola sintetica come oligonucleotidi, peptidi o molecole piccole classiche. - Possiedi un comprovato record di successo nella preparazione dell'NDA e il trasferimento di progetti alla produzione commerciale. - Sei un problem-solver strategico con forti capacità analitiche, in grado di identificare e mitigare i rischi e le opportunità scientifiche. - Sei un comunicatore altamente efficace con eccellenti capacità interpersonali, in grado di influenzare e collaborare tra diverse squadre. - Lei prospera in un ambiente di team collaborativo, partecipa attivamente a discussioni scientifiche e processi decisionali. - Rimani al passo con gli ultimi progressi scientifici e le tendenze, applicando continuamente nuove conoscenze per guidare l'innovazione. - Sei un mentore naturale, appassionato di formazione e guida di altri professionisti scientifici. # Cosa # Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. ## Contatto Pronto a portare le vostre qualità uniche a Roche e fare un impatto? Applicare ora e unirsi a noi nella nostra missione per plasmare il futuro della salute.

jobs.title: Medical Director — Multiple Sclerosis
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
Neuroscience & Rare Diseases represent a major focus area where we are committed to realizing our long-term vision of changing lives of patients with severe brain disorders. Our preclinical research and early clinical development activities center around large and rare indications. With unparalleled strengths across diverse disciplines, Roche is uniquely positioned to lead in transforming science into medicines for patients with disorders of the nervous system.
To achieve our goals, we are seeking a Medical Director, focusing on multiple sclerosis.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will lead and/or support early-stage clinical projects from entry into a human through proof of mechanism and proof of concept, to transform molecules into new medicines in an area with huge unmet medical needs.
You will leverage your expertise to translate innovative molecules into potentially transformative therapies for patients with severe brain disorders. By marrying science and strategy, you will design rigorous and efficient clinical experiments that will support robust decision-making, to get promising therapies to patients as soon as possible.

Your main responsibilities are:

• Lead and/or support cross-functional teams to design and execute clinical development plans from Phase 1 through Phase 2 (proof-of-concept)

• Coach Clinical Scientists in a line- or functional-manager status

• Closely interface with project team leaders as well as safety, clinical pharmacology, clinical operations, biostatistics, regulatory, research and biomarker groups and other members of project teams

• Lead and/or support internal stakeholder management and governance interactions around project plans and therapeutic area strategy

• Lead and/or support external engagements with advisory boards, site investigators, health authorities, and other key stakeholders

• Provide clinical input to programs in discovery research

• Lead scientific communications and disseminate the results of clinical trials in the form of conference presentations and journal publications

Who you are

• You have an MD or MD/PhD with a speciality in neuroimmunology, multiple sclerosis, or a similar field. Board certification and fellowship training or research experience in relevant areas is preferred.

• You bring at least 5 years of experience in longitudinal clinical research, preferably in drug development or clinical trials.

• You hold a strong track record of scientific excellence in the field, evidenced by substantial achievement in designing and implementing clinical trials and/or a high level of scholarship in industry or academia.

• You have experience in clinical drug development within the industry, ideally in the early stages of clinical development.

• As a leader,

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'Azienda Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED ) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Neuroscienze & Malattie Rare rappresentano una importante area di attenzione in cui ci impegniamo a realizzare la nostra visione a lungo termine del cambiamento di vite di pazienti con gravi disturbi cerebrali. La nostra ricerca preclinica e le prime attività di sviluppo clinico si concentrano intorno a grandi e rare indicazioni. Con punti di forza senza pari in diverse discipline, Roche è posizionato in modo unico per condurre a trasformare la scienza in farmaci per i pazienti con disturbi del sistema nervoso. Per raggiungere i nostri obiettivi, stiamo cercando un direttore medico, concentrandosi sulla sclerosi multipla. L'Opportunità In questo ruolo, guiderai e/o supporterai i progetti clinici del primo stadio dall'ingresso in un umano attraverso la prova di meccanismo e la prova del concetto, per trasformare le molecole in nuovi farmaci in un'area con enormi esigenze mediche non metriche. Leverai la tua esperienza per tradurre molecole innovative in terapie potenzialmente trasformative per i pazienti con disturbi cerebrali gravi. Sposando scienza e strategia, si progettano rigorosi ed efficienti esperimenti clinici che supporteranno il processo decisionale robusto, per ottenere terapie promettenti ai pazienti il più presto possibile. Mansioni - Piombo e/o supporto di team interfunzionali per progettare ed eseguire piani di sviluppo clinici dalla Fase 1 alla Fase 2 (protezione del concetto) - Allenatore di scienziati clinici in uno stato linea- o funzionale-manager - Interfaccia ravvicinata con i leader del team di progetto e sicurezza, farmacologia clinica, operazioni cliniche, biostatistica, gruppi normativi, di ricerca e di biomarcatori e altri membri dei team di progetto - Guidare e/o sostenere la gestione interna degli stakeholder e le interazioni di governance intorno ai piani di progetto e alla strategia di area terapeutica - Guidare e/o sostenere gli impegni esterni con consiglieri, ricercatori del sito, autorità sanitarie e altri stakeholder chiave - Fornire input clinici ai programmi di ricerca alla scoperta - Guidare le comunicazioni scientifiche e diffondere i risultati delle sperimentazioni cliniche sotto forma di presentazioni di conferenze e pubblicazioni di riviste
• Requisiti - Hai un MD o MD/PhD con una specializzazione in neuroimmunologia, sclerosi multipla, o un campo simile. È preferibile la certificazione e la formazione di borsa di studio o l'esperienza di ricerca in settori rilevanti. - Porti almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella ricerca clinica longitudinale, preferibilmente nello sviluppo della droga o negli studi clinici. - Lei ha un forte record di eccellenza scientifica nel campo, evidenziato da un sostanziale successo nella progettazione e nell'attuazione di studi clinici e/o un alto livello di borsa di studio nell'industria o nell'accademia. - Hai esperienza nello sviluppo di farmaci clinici all'interno del settore, idealmente nelle prime fasi di sviluppo clinico. - Come leader, Cosa? jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Account Manager at Roche Sequencing Solutions, you will be at the forefront of revolutionizing the sequencing landscape. Embrace this outstanding opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic team and drive our innovative products to market success.

The Opportunity
As an Account Manager, you will:

• Identify and Cultivate Leads : Discover sales opportunities, cultivate new business relationships, and engage key decision-makers in the sequencing community.

• Implement Growth Plans : Develop and monitor regional commercial growth plans, focusing on key success metrics to achieve revenue and strategic goals.

• Optimize Sales Opportunities : Manage sales opportunities effectively through Salesforce/CRM.

• Present and Consult : Conduct product presentations and consultative discussions to showcase the value of our sequencing solutions.

• Drive Technical Sales : Provide technical expertise throughout the sales process, including application consultations and data analysis support.

• Improve Brand Visibility : Represent Roche at conferences, trade shows, and networking events to establish thought leadership and engage potential customers.

• Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with marketing, product management, service, and support teams to align sales efforts with company objectives and customer needs.

• Regional Execution : Partner with subregional teams across Europe to develop and implement strategic plans for successful market penetration.

Who You Are
You possess:

• Educational Background : Bachelor’s degree in Life Science, Business, or a related field.

• Sales Experience : Confirmed experience in selling capital equipment within the diagnostics/life sciences industry.

• Technical Knowledge : Deep understanding of Next Generation Sequencing and related genomic techniques.

• Strategic and Negotiation Skills : Demonstrated excellence in negotiation, strategic planning, and organizational abilities.

• Consultative Selling : Ability to identify technical needs and provide business solutions.

• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Strong eye for business and drive to navigate complex sales processes.

• Communication Skills : Ability to deliver impactful group presentations and communicate effectively with diverse collaborators.

• Travel Requirements : Willingness to undertake national and international travel.

• Preferred Experience : 5+ years in a clinical research or academic laboratory environment, experience selling Sequencers for NGS applications, and proficiency in NGS data analysis.

• Language Skills : Native Level of Japanese and Proficiency in English.

Join Roche Sequencing Solutions to make a difference in the genomic landscape and deliver innovative sequencing solutions to the world. Apply now and bec

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

Objetivo del Puesto:

Apoyar el desarrollo de las actividades planeadas en pro de fortalecer el sistema integrado de gestión desde el ámbito ambiental por medio de la aplicación de la normativa vigente, así como el desarrollo de medidas acordes a las necesidades actuales y futuras de la organización, además del seguimiento de políticas y
disposiciones ya existentes.

Lo anterior, busca velar por generar el menor número de impactos ambientales posibles, asociados a la prestación de bienes y servicios contemplados en el enfoque empresarial y propiciando un ambiente laboral y natural saludable para todas y todos los colaboradores de la empresa.

Responsabilidades Principales:

• Adelantar iniciativas de gestión ambiental,

• Apoyar el plan de mitigación de huella de carbono y compensación de la misma.

• Apoyar la estimación de indicadores de gestión ambiental, resultados y planes de acción, así como la formulación de nuevos KPI acordes con la gestión.

• Realizar control de generación de residuos en todas las sedes.

• Apoyar las iniciativas de economía circular.

• Apoyar el plan de antifalsificación desde la gestión de residuos.

• Apoyo en el manejo de proveedores externos para la gestión de residuos.

• Apoyo en los reportes a las entidades ambientales competentes.

• Formular proyectos que aporten a la gestión ambiental de la organización.

Responsabilidades:

• Contribuir a la comunicación efectiva entre la organización y los colaboradores, facilitando la divulgación de información en temas relacionados con seguridad, salud en el trabajo, medio ambiente y bienestar.

titleByLocale.it: Stage nella gestione globale dei materiali clinici (Kaiseraugst)
titleByLocale.en: Internship in Global Clinical Materials Management (Kaiseraugst)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Join our innovative and purpose-driven team within PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, where we work to ensure life-changing medicines reach patients who need them the most. As a Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) in our Production Enablement function, you will play a pivotal role in leading procurement and supply planning for clinical trials, driving operational excellence, and collaborating with global partners in a dynamic, inclusive environment. Together, we make a difference while optimizing quality, cost, and timely delivery of vital clinical supplies.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will have the chance to make a meaningful impact by taking on the following key responsibilities:

• Ensure seamless availability of drug products and packaging materials to meet clinical manufacturing requirements, guaranteeing timely production of investigational medical products.

• Maintain accurate master data for drug products in SAP systems, including defining, compiling, and continuously updating product-specific data and documents.

• Manage purchase orders for development, partner, and commercial drug products from both internal and external suppliers using the appropriate procurement systems.

• Lead supplier relationship management by monitoring supplier performance through KPIs, driving continuous improvements, and fostering transparent collaborations.

• Ensure batch availability and readiness of drug products and packaging materials for downstream manufacturing processes.

• Proactively identify, address, and resolve supply chain and procurement issues to ensure smooth global clinical supply operations.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an inclusive, innovative, and international environment to drive excellence in clinical supply chain management.

• Contribute to a high-performing team culture where teamwork, professional growth, and delivering impact for patients are prioritized.

Who You Are

These qualities and experiences make you an ideal candidate for this role:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences or Supply Chain Management, with experience in SAP systems and the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry as a valuable asset.

• You are a clear and professional communicator, both in writing and verbally, with excellent English skills (basic knowledge of German is a plus).

• You excel in building trustful relationships with diverse business partners, demonstrating high cultural awareness and social competence in international and cross-functional settings.

• You are a problem solver with keen attention to detail, strong decision-making abilities, and an understanding of technical systems, allowing you to quickly learn and adapt to new challenges.

• You thrive in collaborative environments and bring well-developed teamwork, negotiation, and organizational skills to complex situations.

Planned start date: December 2025
Duration: 12 months
Ready to apply? Please upload the following documents: your updated CV, a cover letter, and copies of your diplomas.
For Non-EU/EFTA citizens: Due to regulations, you must provide a letter from your university confirming that an internship is mandatory for your studies and specifying the required length of the internship. Please upload this letter, along with your enrollment certificate, CV, and cover letter.

We are looking forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La posizione Unisciti al nostro team innovativo e mirato all'interno di PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, dove lavoriamo per garantire che i farmaci che cambiano la vita raggiungano i pazienti che ne hanno più bisogno. In qualità di Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) nella nostra funzione di Production Enablement, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella pianificazione di approvvigionamento e fornitura leader per gli studi clinici, nella guida dell'eccellenza operativa e nella collaborazione con partner globali in un ambiente dinamico e inclusivo. Insieme, facciamo la differenza ottimizzando la qualità, il costo e la consegna tempestiva di forniture cliniche vitali. Responsabilità In questo ruolo, avrete la possibilità di avere un impatto significativo assumendo le seguenti responsabilità chiave: - Assicurare la disponibilità senza soluzione di continuità di prodotti farmaceutici e materiali di imballaggio per soddisfare i requisiti di produzione clinica, garantendo la produzione tempestiva di prodotti medici investigativi. - Mantenere dati master accurati per i prodotti farmaceutici nei sistemi SAP, tra cui la definizione, la compilazione e l'aggiornamento continuo dei dati e dei documenti specifici del prodotto. - Gestire gli ordini di acquisto per lo sviluppo, partner e prodotti di droga commerciali da fornitori sia interni che esterni utilizzando i sistemi di approvvigionamento appropriati. - Gestione dei rapporti dei fornitori di piombo monitorando le prestazioni dei fornitori tramite KPI, guidando miglioramenti continui e promuovendo collaborazioni trasparenti. - Assicurare la disponibilità e la disponibilità di prodotti farmaceutici e materiali di imballaggio per i processi produttivi a valle. - Identificare, affrontare e risolvere i problemi della supply chain e degli approvvigionamenti per garantire operazioni di approvvigionamento clinico a livello globale. - Collaborare con team interfunzionali in un ambiente inclusivo, innovativo e internazionale per guidare l'eccellenza nella gestione della supply chain clinica. - Contribuire a una cultura di squadra altamente performante in cui il lavoro di squadra, la crescita professionale e la fornitura di impatto per i pazienti sono prioritari.
• Requisiti Queste qualità ed esperienze ti rendono un candidato ideale per questo ruolo: - Lei ha una laurea o Master in Scienze della Vita o Gestione della Supply Chain, con esperienza nei sistemi SAP e l'industria farmaceutica o biofarmaceutica come un bene prezioso. - Lei è un comunicatore chiaro e professionale, sia per iscritto che verbalmente, con eccellenti competenze inglesi (la conoscenza di base del tedesco è un plus). - Si eccelle nella costruzione di relazioni fiduciose con diversi partner commerciali, dimostrando alta consapevolezza culturale e competenza sociale in contesti internazionali e interfunzionali. - Lei è un risolutore di problemi con molta attenzione ai dettagli, forti capacità decisionali e una comprensione dei sistemi tecnici, permettendo di imparare e adattarsi rapidamente alle nuove sfide. - Tu prosperi in ambienti collaborativi e porti competenze di teamwork, negoziazione e organizzazione ben sviluppate a situazioni complesse. Posizione - Data di inizio prevista: dicembre 2025 - Durata: 12 mesi Vieni qui. Pronto per l'applicazione? Si prega di caricare i seguenti documenti: il vostro CV aggiornato, una lettera di copertura e copie dei vostri diplomi. Per i cittadini non UE/EFTA: A causa di regolamenti, è necessario fornire una lettera dalla vostra università confermando che uno stage è obbligatorio per i vostri studi e specificando la lunghezza necessaria dello stage. Si prega di caricare questa lettera, insieme al certificato di iscrizione, CV e lettera di copertura. Contatto Siamo lieti della vostra applicazione! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Mansion Die Position Begleiten Sie unser innovatives und zielorientiertes Team im PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, wo wir arbeiten, um zu gewährleisten, dass lebensverändernde Medikamente Patienten erreichen, die sie am meisten benötigen. Als Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) in unserer Production Enablement Funktion übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der führenden Beschaffungs- und Versorgungsplanung für klinische Studien, der operativen Exzellenz und der Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Partnern in einer dynamischen, inklusiven Umgebung. Gemeinsam machen wir einen Unterschied, indem wir Qualität, Kosten und rechtzeitige Lieferung von wichtigen klinischen Versorgungen optimieren. In den Warenkorb In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, eine sinnvolle Wirkung zu erzielen, indem Sie die folgenden Hauptverantwortlichkeiten einnehmen: - Sicherstellung der nahtlosen Verfügbarkeit von Arzneimitteln und Verpackungsmaterialien, um die
• Anforderungen an die klinische Herstellung zu erfüllen und eine zeitnahe Produktion von medizinischen Untersuchungsprodukten zu gewährleisten. - Erhalten Sie genaue Stammdaten für Arzneimittel in SAP-Systemen, einschließlich der Definition, Erstellung und fortlaufenden Aktualisierung produktspezifischer Daten und Dokumente. - Kaufaufträge für Entwicklungs-, Partner- und kommerzielle Arzneimittel sowohl von internen als auch externen Lieferanten mit den entsprechenden Beschaffungssystemen verwalten. - Führen Sie das Lieferantenbeziehungsmanagement durch die Überwachung der Lieferantenleistung durch KPIs, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und die Förderung transparenter Kooperationen. - Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit und Bereitschaft von Arzneimitteln und Verpackungsmaterialien für nachgelagerte Fertigungsprozesse. - Proaktiv zu identifizieren, zu adressieren und Probleme der Lieferkette und Beschaffung zu lösen, um reibungslose globale klinische Versorgung zu gewährleisten. - Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams in einem integrativen, innovativen und internationalen Umfeld, um Exzellenz in der klinischen Supply Chain Management zu fördern. - Beitrag zu einer hochperformierenden Teamkultur, in der Teamarbeit, professionelles Wachstum und die Bereitstellung von Auswirkungen für Patienten priorisiert werden. En tant que gestionnaire mondial des matériaux cliniques (GCMM) dans notre fonction d'activation de la production, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la planification des achats et des approvisionnements pour les essais cliniques, la conduite de l'excellence opérationnelle et la collaboration avec des partenaires mondiaux dans un environnement dynamique et inclusif. Ensemble, nous faisons une différence tout en optimisant la qualité, le coût et la livraison en temps opportun des fournitures cliniques vitales. jobs.title: Accounts Payable Analyst (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Receive, sort, verify, handle exceptions, bar code, scan, and pre-archive Accounts Payable (AP) documents for further processing.

• Validate and process Purchase Order (PO) and contract-based invoices, non-PO invoices, prepayments, and down payments.

• Review supplier open items (due invoices, credit notes, debit balances, etc.) before executing payments.

• Handle internal and external queries and resolve them within the agreed timeline.

• Investigate and reverse non-successful payments.

• Perform supplier statement of account reconciliation and follow up on open items for closure.

• Perform month-end closing activities, including purchasing accrual according to the closing timetable/ schedule.

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, or yearly reporting, such as monthly KPI reports and other operational reports based on affiliate requirements.

• Reconcile AP balance sheet accounts and clear aged items (e.g., GR/IR, GIT, suspense account).

• Participate in compliance audits, prepare statutory audit reports & respond to audit queries as necessary.

• Troubleshoot AP issues (workflow, OCR, BOT, process) and work with respective teams (IT, Automation& GBPS) for resolution

• Participate & support implementation of projects/ initiatives from global, business partners & RSS.

• Engage in system integration and testing.

• Initiate and drive process improvement projects.

• Provide technical mentorship to team members and conduct internal process training for new joiners.

• Process suppliers and intercompany invoices accurately and within the predefined KPIs

• Ensure timely payment of suppliers and Intercompany invoices in accordance with agreed payment terms & Intercompany payment schedule

• Respond promptly to internal and external queries, adhering to predefined KPIs.

• Perform timely and accurate AP month-end closing activities, including purchasing accruals, and provide related reports.

• Create and maintain up-to-date work documentation and processes in compliance with ICFR, group policies, guidelines, and local statutory/legal requirements within agreed timelines

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English & Japanese Languages.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are

jobs.title: Arbeitssicherheitsexperte (m/w/d) Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit / SiFa
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir streben danach, das Leben von Patient:innen heute und für zukünftige Generationen zu verbessern. Dabei ist es uns auch wichtig, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen selbst nach der Arbeit gesund nach Hause gehen können. Deshalb koordinieren wir in der Abteilung Site Safety als Expert:innen Dienstleistungen bzgl. Arbeitsschutz und Anlagensicherheit bei der Gestaltung, Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung der Prozesse. Die Sicherheit der Menschen, der Umwelt und der technischen Anlagen sowie die Nachhaltigkeit und Qualität von effizienten, gesetzes- und Roche-konformen Prozessen und Produkten stehen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Dafür ergreifen wir erfolgreich die Initiative und handeln leidenschaftlich und eigenverantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Um unsere Mission bestmöglich zu erfüllen, suchen wir eine:n Expert:in, der/die es versteht, unseren Leistungen durch Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen ein Gesicht zu geben. Folgende Tätigkeiten gehören dazu:

• Als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit in der Abteilung Site Safety Penzberg bist Du als kompetente:r Ansprechpartner:in zu Themen der Arbeits- und Anlagensicherheit am Standort Penzberg tätig.

• Du arbeitest in einer Matrixstruktur und unterstützt Fachabteilungen und Führungskräfte am Standort in der sicherheitstechnischen Beratung hinsichtlich des Arbeitsschutzes und der Anlagensicherheit.

• Planen, koordinieren, moderieren: Du erstellst Gefährdungsbeurteilungen, legst durch Begehungen, Ereignis- und Unfallanalysen usw. Maßnahmen für einen sicheren Betrieb fest und hältst diese nach.

• Im Rahmen von Neu- und Umbauprojekten bist Du im Projektteam aktiver Partner und erstellst, koordinierst und moderierst, sicherheitsrelevante Dokumente, wie z.B. SHE-Konzepte, -Checklisten und Reviews.

• Du analysierst Ereignisse von Maßnahmen zur zukünftigen Vermeidung und trägst dadurch zur stetigen Verbesserung bei.

• Nicht zuletzt “coachst” du Führungskräfte und moderierst Programme zur Verbesserung der Sicherheitskultur und vermittelst Dein Wissen im Rahmen von Schulungen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium des Ingenieurwesens mit Fachrichtung Verfahrenstechnik, Sicherheitstechnik oder einen Master in Naturwissenschaften erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position, idealerweise in der Industrie mit.

• Du bist in der Lage, Gefahren in Ex-Bereichen und in der chemisch- / pharmazeutischen Produktion zu erkennen und beurteilen sowie Sicherheitskonzepte zu erarbeiten und diese gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholdern nachzuhalten.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Основні обов'язки:

• Інсталяція та валідація: Проведення монтажу, налаштування, валідації та введення в експлуатацію нових лабораторних систем Roche .

• Технічне обслуговування: Виконання планового та профілактичного обслуговування обладнання згідно з міжнародними стандартами та регламентами компанії.

• Діагностика та ремонт: Оперативна діагностика несправностей (як на місці у клієнта, так і за допомогою засобів віддаленої підтримки) та проведення ремонтних робіт будь-якої складності.

• Технічна підтримка: Надання професійних консультацій та навчання персоналу лабораторій (лікарів-лаборантів, біологів, інженерів клієнта) щодо правил експлуатації та догляду за обладнанням.

• Модернізація: Встановлення оновлень програмного забезпечення та апаратних модифікацій (апгрейдів) систем.

• Звітність та документація: Своєчасне та точне ведення всієї сервісної документації, заповнення актів виконаних робіт та звітів у корпоративній CRM-системі (відповідно до стандартів ISO та внутрішніх політик).

• Управління запчастинами: Ефективне управління власним складом запасних частин.

Вимоги до кандидата:

• Освіта: Вища технічна освіта (біомедична інженерія, електроніка, радіотехніка, метрологія, ІТ або суміжні спеціальності).

• Досвід роботи: Від 2-х років на посаді сервісного інженера з медичним або складним лабораторним обладнанням.

• Технічні знання: Глибоке розуміння принципів роботи електроніки, механіки, оптики та гідравліки.

• ІТ-навички: Впевнений користувач ПК. Розуміння принципів роботи комп'ютерних мереж (TCP/IP, LIS/HIS інтеграція) .

• Мови:
Українська – вільно.
Англійська – не нижче рівня Intermediate (B1). Обов'язкова вимога для читання технічної документації, проходження навчань у виробника та листування з глобальною підтримкою.

• Мобільність: Наявність водійського посвідчення категорії «В» та досвід водіння.

• Готовність до відряджень: Робота має роз'їзний характер, готовність до регулярних відряджень по Україні.

• Особисті якості: Висока клієнтоорієнтованість, відмінні комунікативні навички, відповідальність, аналітичний склад розуму, вміння працювати в режимі багатозадачності та самостійно приймати рішення.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key activities & Deliverables

• Co-ordinate and execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with work instructions and month end close checklist

• Perform and analyse booking accounting transactions, working and calculations are executed on timely and accurately

• Clearing of open items in accounts

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, cost center checks and transaction posting checks

• Ensure accruals are properly justified and correctly posted

• To ensure all journals are performed accurately and timely

• Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliation, highlight and rectify any anomalies encountered

• Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reporting packages accurately and within specified timescale

Documentation & Controlling

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required

• Participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries

Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations

• Initiate and execute the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Work collaboratively with customers and stakeholders

• Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

Coaching/Sharing

• Support the review entries posted by the team to ensure accuracy

• Extends coaching and guidance to juniors in daily operation

• Support the when there are any ad hoc activities or projects

• Contribute inputs/findings to establish a knowledge database of issue encountered, proposed resolution steps to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge and lesson learnt across the teams

Qualifications & Experience Required

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English.

• Minimum 5 years working experiences in the related field, preferable in the area of General Accounting and Management Accounting

• SAP knowledge or other ERP accounting systems and MS Office tools

• Proficiency in English and Japanese language are mandatory with good communication skill (writing and speaking).

Desirable qualifications

• External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing engagement will be preferable

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Mission

We, the Digital Biomarker (dBM) and Remote Patient Management (RPM) Chapter in Roche Information Solutions (RIS), are an integrated team of scientists, technologists, data analysts and operations experts, that leverages mobile technologies like smartphones and wearables to bring the power of sensor measures to patients everywhere: in clinical drug trials and clinical care.

We drive research, workflows and analytics for Digital Biomarkers and Remote Patient Management
in RIS. Together with our partners, we invent, design and deliver solution capabilities, products and services for better clinical research and improved healthcare outcomes.
We co-create innovative digital remote monitoring concepts for sensitive and meaningful drug development endpoints, implement them in technology solutions, develop health related outcome measures with the data, seek community- and regulatory acceptance of corresponding endpoints and offer them to Biopharma companies and research institutes for use in clinical trials.
We are also establishing the scientific foundations for remote disease monitoring and screening solutions in clinical practice and enable patients and healthcare providers to leverage the power of sensor data for better outcomes in the management of neurological disease, diabetes and others.

The Opportunity:

• Establish the digital science capability of the Digital Biomarker (dBM) and Remote Patient Management (RPM) chapter in RIS Data, Analytics & Research (DA&R).

• Develop a roadmap and lead the development of novel digital outcome measures for use in clinical trials and clinical care and drive regulatory and community acceptance.

• Lead (establish, grow and mature) the digital biomarker science team serving the full range of RIS needs, from digital biomarker research to clinically validated algorithms for use in RIS products

• Represent Science in the dBM&RPM chapter leadership team and contribute to the evolution of the chapter

• In the Roche Group, collaborate with stakeholders in clinical development, biomarker, and translational science and technologies, patient-centered outcomes research, data science, regulatory, privacy, IP and pharmaceutical sciences

• Leverage your recognition as a respected Digital Biomarker expert and advocate in the global research and development community to drive the acceptance of digital endpoints through cross-industry task forces and the communication of results at conferences and in peer-reviewed publications.

• Be a major driver of change internally at Roche and externally in the community as well as with regulators to unlock the full potential of Digital Health Technology in support of clinical trials and clinical use.

Who you are:

• Scientific university degree (PhD. level) in a quantitative natural science or medical discipline with a focus on large-scale data analysis and an outstanding publication record

• 10+ years professional experience in the pharmaceutical or related industry, ideally directly impacting decision making in clinical drug or medical device development

• Intrinsic passion for transforming healthcare using digital technology to modernize clinical endpoints in drug development and clinical care

• Extensive senior level leadership experience in a large organization

• Ability to establish internal and external networks

• Recognized as a digital health leader by the community

• Extensive experience in the design and analysis of complex and long-term clinical experiments

• P

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La posizione Missione lavorativa Noi, il Digital Biomarker (dBM) e il Capitolo Gestione Paziente Remota (RPM) in Roche Information Solutions (RIS), siamo un team integrato di scienziati, tecnologi, analisti di dati e esperti operativi, che sfrutta le tecnologie mobili come smartphone e wearables per portare la potenza delle misure sensoriali a pazienti ovunque: negli studi clinici sulla droga e nella cura clinica. Noi guidiamo ricerca, workflow e analisi per i biomarcatori digitali e la gestione dei pazienti remota in RIS. Insieme ai nostri partner, inventiamo, progettiamo e forniamo capacità di soluzione, prodotti e servizi per una migliore ricerca clinica e migliori risultati sanitari. Co-creare innovativi concetti di monitoraggio remoto digitale per gli endpoint sensibili e significativi di sviluppo della droga, implementarli in soluzioni tecnologiche, sviluppare misure di esito relative alla salute con i dati, cercare l'accettazione comunitaria e normativa dei corrispondenti endpoint e offrire loro alle aziende Biopharma e agli istituti di ricerca per l'uso in studi clinici. Stiamo anche stabilendo le basi scientifiche per il monitoraggio e le soluzioni di screening delle malattie remote nella pratica clinica e consentire ai pazienti e ai fornitori di assistenza sanitaria di sfruttare la potenza dei dati dei sensori per ottenere risultati migliori nella gestione delle malattie neurologiche, del diabete e altri. Responsabilità - Stabilire la capacità di scienza digitale del capitolo Digital Biomarker (dBM) e Gestione Paziente Remota (RPM) in RIS Data, Analytics & Research (DA&R). - Sviluppare una roadmap e condurre lo sviluppo di nuove misure di esito digitale per l'uso in studi clinici e la cura clinica e guidare la regolazione e l'accettazione della comunità. - Lead (stabilire, crescere e maturare) il team di scienza biomarcatrice digitale che serve la gamma completa delle esigenze RIS, dalla ricerca digitale di biomarcatori agli algoritmi convalidati clinicamente per l'uso nei prodotti RIS - Rappresentare la Scienza nel team di leadership del capitolo dBM&RPM e contribuire all'evoluzione del capitolo - Nel Gruppo Roche, collaborare con gli stakeholder nello sviluppo clinico, nel biomarcatore e nelle tecnologie traduttive, nella ricerca dei risultati concentrati sui pazienti, nella scienza dei dati, nella regolamentazione, nella privacy, nell'IP e nelle scienze farmaceutiche - Leva il tuo riconoscimento come esperto di Digital Biomarker e sostenitore nella comunità globale di ricerca e sviluppo per guidare l'accettazione degli endpoint digitali attraverso le task force di cross-industry e la comunicazione dei risultati alle conferenze e nelle pubblicazioni peer-reviewed. - Essere un grande driver di cambiamento internamente a Roche ed esternamente nella comunità, così come con i regolatori per sbloccare il pieno potenziale della tecnologia della salute digitale a sostegno di studi clinici e uso clinico.
• Requisiti - Grado universitario scientifico (livello PhD) in una scienza naturale quantitativa o in una disciplina medica con un focus sull'analisi dei dati su larga scala e un record di pubblicazione eccezionale - 10+ anni di esperienza professionale nel settore farmaceutico o relativo, idealmente direttamente impatto processo decisionale nello sviluppo di farmaci clinici o dispositivi medici - Passione intrinseca per trasformare la salute utilizzando la tecnologia digitale per modernizzare gli endpoint clinici nello sviluppo della droga e nella cura clinica - Ampia esperienza di leadership di livello senior in una grande organizzazione - Capacità di stabilire reti interne ed esterne - Riconosciuto come leader della salute digitale dalla comunità - Ampia esperienza nella progettazione e nell'analisi di esperimenti clinici complessi e a lungo termine Contatto (senza informazioni fornite)

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Mansioni La position Mission emploi Nous, le Biomarqueur numérique (dBM) et le chapitre Gestion à distance des patients (RPM) de Roche Information Solutions (RIS), sommes une équipe intégrée de scientifiques, de technologues, d'analystes de données et d'experts opérationnels, qui exploite les technologies mobiles comme les smartphones et les portables pour apporter la puissance des mesures de capteurs aux patients partout : dans les essais cliniques et les soins cliniques. Nous dirigeons la recherche, les flux de travail et l'analyse pour les biomarqueurs numériques et la gestion à distance des patients dans RIS. Avec nos partenaires, nous inventons, concevons et fournissons des capacités de solutions, des produits et des services pour une meilleure recherche clinique et de meilleurs résultats en matière de santé. Nous co-créons des concepts novateurs de surveillance numérique à distance pour les paramètres de développement des médicaments sensibles et significatifs, nous les mettons en oeuvre dans des solutions technologiques, nous élaborons des mesures des résultats liés à la santé avec les données, nous recherchons l'acceptation communautaire et réglementaire des paramètres correspondants et nous les offrons aux entreprises biopharmaceutiques et aux instituts de recherche pour qu'ils les utilisent dans les essais cliniques. Nous établissons également les bases scientifiques des solutions de surveillance et de dépistage des maladies à distance dans la pratique clinique et nous permettons aux patients et aux fournisseurs de soins de santé d'exploiter la puissance des données de capteur pour de meilleurs résultats dans la gestion des maladies neurologiques, du diabète et d'autres. Responsabilité - Établir la capacité scientifique numérique du chapitre Biomarqueur numérique (dBM) et Gestion à distance des patients (RPM) dans les données, l'analyse et la recherche sur les SIR (DA&R). - Élaborer une feuille de route et diriger l'élaboration de nouvelles mesures numériques des résultats à utiliser dans les essais cliniques et les soins cliniques et favoriser l'acceptation réglementaire et communautaire. - Plomb (établissement, croissance et maturité) l'équipe de biomarqueurs numériques qui répond à toute la gamme des besoins en RIS, de la recherche en biomarqueurs numériques aux algorithmes validés cliniquement pour une utilisation dans les produits RIS - Représenter les sciences dans l'équipe de direction du chapitre DBM&RPM et contribuer à l'évolution du chapitre - Au sein du groupe Roche, collaborer avec les intervenants du développement clinique, biomarqueur et des sciences et technologies translationnelles, recherche sur les résultats axés sur le patient, science des données, réglementation, protection de la vie privée, propriété intellectuelle et sciences pharmaceutiques - Tirez profit de votre reconnaissance en tant qu'expert en biomarqueurs numériques respecté et plaidez auprès de la communauté mondiale de la recherche et du développement pour favoriser l'acceptation des paramètres numériques par des groupes de travail intersectoriels et la communication des résultats lors de conférences et dans des publications évaluées par des pairs. - Être un moteur important de changement à l'interne à Roche et à l'externe dans la collectivité ainsi qu'avec les organismes de réglementation pour libérer tout le potentiel de la technologie numérique de la santé à l'appui des essais cliniques et de l'utilisation clinique.
• Requisiti - Diplôme universitaire scientifique (niveau de doctorat) dans une discipline quantitative de sciences naturelles ou de médecine mettant l'accent sur l'analyse de données à grande échelle et une publication exceptionnelle - 10 ans et plus d'expérience professionnelle dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou connexe, idéalement impactant directement la prise de décision dans le développement de médicaments ou d'instruments médicaux cliniques - Passion intrinsèque pour transformer les soins de santé en utilisant la technologie numérique pour moderniser les paramètres cliniques dans le développement des médicaments et les soins cliniques - Expérience approfondie des cadres supérieurs dans une grande organisation - Capacité d'établir des réseaux internes et externes - Reconnue comme un leader de la santé numérique par la communauté - Expérience approfondie dans la conception et l'analyse d'expériences cliniques complexes et à long terme Contatto (aucune information fournie)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bist Du bereit, Dein Know-how im Explosionsschutz und der Anlagensicherheit in einer hochmodernen chemischen Produktion einzubringen? Möchtest Du durch Eigenverantwortung, technische Expertise und pragmatische Lösungen aktiv die Compliance und Sicherheit unserer Anlagen gestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres agilen Teams in Penzberg!

Dein Beitrag – Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft
In dieser Schlüsselrolle stellst Du sicher, dass die Anlagensicherheit – insbesondere der Explosionsschutz – in unserer chemischen Produktion jederzeit gewährleistet ist. Du übernimmst dabei selbstständig Verantwortung für zentrale Aufgaben:

• Technische Expertise & Dokumentation: Du führst technische Prüfungen (als zur Prüfung befähigte Person nach BetrSichV oder mit vergleichbarer Erfahrung) durch und erstellst die zugehörigen Dokumente zum Explosionsschutz.

• Problemlösung & Umsetzung: Du findest und bewertest technische sowie organisatorische Lösungen, begleitest deren Machbarkeit und sorgst als aktiver Partner für die zielorientierte Umsetzung im Produktionsbetrieb.

• Compliance & Digitalisierung: Du verknüpfst, pflegst und nutzt Daten zur Betriebscompliance, um maximale Sicherheit zu gewährleisten und treibst die Digitalisierung von Dokumenten voran.

• Zusammenarbeit & Change Management: Im Matrix-Umfeld engagierst Du Dich aktiv mit Sicherheits-, Produktions- und Technikeinheiten für den betrieblichen Bedarf und lebst das Management of Change.

• Fachliche Führung & Weiterentwicklung: Durch Deine fachliche Führung ermöglichst Du eine effiziente Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Schnittstellen. Du hältst Dich kontinuierlich auf dem Stand der Technik (Fortbildungen, Messen etc.).

Was uns ausmacht – Dein zukünftiges Team und Umfeld
Als Teil von Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist der Bereich DOZ essentiell für die termingerechte Produktion chemischer und biochemischer Einsatzstoffe.

• Das Team: Wir sind eine agile, 45-köpfige Abteilung, die nahezu alle Einheiten der Division Diagnostics mit wichtigen Produkten beliefert.

• Deine Gruppe: Wir sind der zentrale Partner für die Betriebscompliance, chemische Sicherheit, Anlagen- und Explosionsschutz sowie Umweltschutz in der chemischen Produktion. Kontinuierliches Verbessern, gemeinsames Lernen und Vielfalt zeichnen uns aus.

Dein Profil – Mit diesen Kompetenzen überzeugst Du uns
Du bist eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit einem starken Fokus auf technische Sicherheit und pragmatische Umsetzung:

• Ausbildung/Studium: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektroniker, Mechatroniker, Industriemechaniker o.ä.) mit langjähriger praktischer Erfahrung mit Produktionsanlagen oder ein erfolgreiches Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau o.ä.) mit zusätzlicher praktischer Anwendung in der betrieblichen Compliance und vertieftem Wissen im technischen Explosionsschutz.

• Spezialisierung: Fundierte, nachgewiesene fachliche Spezialisierung im betrieblichen Explosionsschutz (z.B. Prüfwesen, Befähigung als "zur Prüfung befähigte Person", Sachkunde nach ATEX RL 2014/34/EU).

• Praxis: Praktische Erfahrung in diverser industrieller Produktion (Technika, Labore, Produktionsbetrieb) und idealerweise aus relevanten Gremien/Berufsverbänden.

• Arbeitsweise: Du bist verantwortungsbewusst, engagiert, strukturiert und zeichnest Dich durch eine selbstständige, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise aus. Du motivierst Dich durch die technische Umsetzung sicherer Lösungen.

• IT & Kommunikation: Gute Englisch- und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. R

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche in 50 Worten:
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird.
Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben.
Das macht uns zu Roche.

Deine Abteilung
Die Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH vertreibt zukunftsweisende Diagnostika zur Blutanalyse sowie Laborkonzepte und -lösungen in Kliniken und Laborinstituten. In den kommenden Jahren wird eine große Anzahl an Systemen im Markt ausgetauscht. Damit wir diese große Herausforderung bewältigen, suchen wir in unserem neuen, zukunftsweisenden Pre-Configuration Center Unterstützung. Die neue Gerätegeneration (cobas pro & cobas pure) wird hier kundenspezifisch betriebsbereit vorinstalliert und für die Implementierung im Kundenlabor vorbereitet. Wir sind stolz darauf, wer wir sind, was wir tun und wie wir es tun und haben dabei ein klares Ziel vor Augen:
Doing now what patients need next.

Deine Hauptaufgaben, nach einer ausführlichen Einarbeitung, sind dabei:

• Ergebnisorientierte Geräte-Vorbereitung im Pre-Configuration Center.

• Installation, Justage und Inbetriebnahme (Software, Applikation & finale Testung) von komplexen Roche Standardanalysengeräten z.B. cobas pure / cobas pro inkl. cobas c 703 nach Zielvereinbarungen.

• Termingerechter und fachgerechter Aufbau (applikativ u. technisch) sowie ggf. Reparatur von Roche-Systemen mit einfachem Schwierigkeitsgrad, einschließlich abschließendem Test- nzw. Routinelauf inkl. Dokumentation (im CRM System)

• Durchführung der elektrotechnischen Sicherheitsüberprüfung und Endabnahme der vorkonfigurierten Systeme vor der Auslieferung.

• Mitwirkung bei der Datensicherung sowie der Erstellung und Pflege der Dokumentation (z.B. Installations- und Inbetriebnahme Pläne) gemäß den Anforderungen und internen Vorgaben.

• Selbstständige Fehlersuche und Beseitigung von Störungen an Analysesystemen und elektronisch gesteuerten Anlagen und Maschinen.

• Termingerechte Berichterstattung und unverzügliche Meldung kritischer Probleme/Reklamationen an das Roche Customer Support Center.

• Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Pflichten eines Medizinprodukteberaters gem. § 31 MPG (siehe Anlage) und Sicherstellung der vorgabenkonformen Reklamationsbearbeitung.

Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast eine anerkannte und abgeschlossene mindestens zweijährige Berufsausbildung mit Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechanik, IT-Systemelektronik, oder vergleichbar

• Idealerweise hast Du bereits erste Berufserfahrung im technischen Bereich

• Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Technischen-Systemen (Fluidic, Elektronik, Messtechnik, Messtechnik, IT)

• Du kannst idealerweise Steuerungs / Betriebssoftware anwenden.

• Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch; Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind wünschenswert.

Diese Arbeit erfordert eine Zuverlässigkeitsüberprüfung für Luftfracht (ZÜP), die eventuell während der Einarbeitungszeit absolviert werden kann.

Standort:
Der Dienstsitz ist in Monsheim, nähe Worms.

Diese Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Für eine vollständige Bewerbung bitten wir Dich, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf, ein für die Stelle passendes Motivationsschreiben und relevante Zeugnisse hinzuzufügen. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

• Durchführung der elektrotechnischen Sicherheitsüberprüfung und Endabnahme der vorkonfigurierten Systeme vor der Auslieferung.

• Selbstständige Fehlersuche und Beseitigung von Störungen an Analysesystemen und elektronisch gesteuerten Anlagen und Maschinen.
• Termingerechte Berichterstattung und unverzügliche Meldung kritischer Probleme/Reklamationen an das Roche Customer Support Center.
• Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Pflichten eines Medizinprodukteberaters gem. § 31 MPG (siehe Anlage) und Sicherstellung der vorgabenkonformen Reklamationsbearbeitung. Das bringst Du mit
• Du hast eine anerkannte und abgeschlossene mindestens zweijährige Berufsausbildung mit Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechanik, IT-Systemelektronik, oder vergleichbar
• Idealerweise hast Du bereits erste Berufserfahrung im technischen Bereich
• Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Technischen-Systemen (Fluidic, Elektronik, Messtechnik, Messtechnik, IT)
• Du kannst idealerweise Steuerungs / Betriebssoftware anwenden.
• Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch; Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind wünschenswert. jobs.title: Travel & Expense Compliance Analyst (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity：

- Operational

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies*, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

Note: *The number of affiliates supported will be determined by operational requirements

• Participate in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by Line Manager/Global Lead.

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e. assessment results) activities in concur during claim processing

• Escalates issues and recommend resolution plans in a timely manner to the RSS Line Manager and Affiliate (where required)

• Support the preparation of reports and training material on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

- Continuous Improvement

• As part of day-to-day operations work collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc)

• In collaboration with Reporting Line Manager make appropriate recommendation to Global Lead for process improvement and be part of the solution provision activities

Who you are:

• University degree or above.business, law or finance related major

• More than 2 years’ experience in compliance reviews or its equivalent and its implementation in a highly regulated environment or in audit firms ( Applications by individuals with less than 2 years’ experience will be at the Associate Compliance Analyst level)

• Fluent in both written and spoken English and Japanese

• Strong analytical skills, be able to assess the facts with professional skepticism

• Thinks out of the box, challenges the status quo and with excellent team work with s trong communications skills

• Motivated and takes full ownership of personal developmen and Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks efficiently

• Understanding of pharma business risks is preffered

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 1. 职位职责：
• （1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息

titleByLocale.de: 治疗领域经理-眼科治疗领域
titleByLocale.fr: 治疗领域经理-眼科治疗领域

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a) 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b) 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c) 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点
3. 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育
4. 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

Years of Working Experience工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
•在试用期内通过RDPAC考试
•在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程
