jobs.title: Quality Solution Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Quality Solutions Lead within our PDQ, you will work within a team of experts and collaborate with peers within the function and across the organization to identify, design and execute fit-for-purpose quality solutions, driving the delivery and sustainability of a robust and regulatory compliance Quality Management System (QMS) ，drive quality culture and implement in China. You will ensure the timely completion of quality solution deliverables and partner with business/stakeholder, overseeing and providing technical expertise in the delivery of high quality solutions to deliver regulatory compliant and high quality processes. You will also contribute to functional, cross-functional, enterprise-wide or external initiatives that shape our technical landscape, business and healthcare environments. You will need strong strategic, collaboration and communication skills, as well as an entrepreneurial mindset, to evolve the way we design and deliver the QMS and to enable accelerated delivery medicines and access for our patients.

As a Quality Solutions Lead , you will be accountable to implement and deliver quality solutions to demonstrate confidence in our QMS in order to accelerate regulatory review and approval for medicines and integrated healthcare solutions. You will partner with cross-functional teams and external partners and work with considerable independence. Contributes to the continual improvement of internal processes and system support.

As a Senior Quality Solutions Lead , you will be accountable to deliver quality solutions through designing innovative/new/efficient quality solutions to demonstrate confidence in our QMS in order to accelerate regulatory review and approval for medicines and integrated healthcare solutions. We will look to you to contribute to complex cross-functional or cross chapter squads taking a leading role and navigating situations within the QMS landscape.

Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities :

• QUALITY SOLUTIONS : Deliver quality solutions which enable Roche to meet regulations/standards /HA expectations, in an efficient and effective way. Activities may include, but are not limited to:

○ Regulatory Intelligence - proactively analyzes regulatory landscape and assesses impact of emerging and changes to existing regulations to Roche processes.
○ Process design & procedures development - partners with business to design processes, maximally leveraging automation and system workflow, development of performance metrics/signals/evidence-based oversight measures.
○ Process deployment - partners with the business to implement processes, including delivery of training/performance solutions to demonstrate qualification and competency of business to execute processes.
○ Continuous Improvement - drives process improvement activities, leveraging Quality Analytics & Insights and strong decision making for and with Global Process Owners; partner with the business to proactively identify, analyze and improve existing processes and create solutions to optimize performance, meet best practice standards or improve quality and the user experience for customers and end-users.

• QMS EXCELLENCE: Demonstrate process integrity to health authorities

○ Develop process strategies and proactively manage timelines to ensure successful oversight and delivery of quality solutions, including the implementation and adoption of new technologies and solutions that drive efficiency and cost savings.
○ Continuously improve internal proc

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come leader di soluzioni di qualità all'interno del nostro PDQ, lavorerai all'interno di un team di esperti e collaborerai con coetanei all'interno della funzione e in tutta l'organizzazione per identificare, progettare ed eseguire soluzioni di qualità fit-for-purpose, guidando la consegna e la sostenibilità di una conformità robusta e regolamentare Quality Management System (QMS) , guidando la cultura della qualità e l'implementazione in Cina. Ti garantirai il completamento tempestivo delle soluzioni di qualità consegnabili e partner con business/stakeholder, supervisionando e fornendo competenze tecniche nella fornitura di soluzioni di alta qualità per fornire conformi normativi e processi di alta qualità. Contribuirai anche a iniziative funzionali, interfunzionali, aziendali o esterne che modellano il nostro ambiente tecnico, aziendale e sanitario. Avrete bisogno di forti capacità strategiche, di collaborazione e di comunicazione, nonché di una mentalità imprenditoriale, per evolvere il nostro modo di progettare e consegnare il QMS e per consentire farmaci di consegna accelerati e l'accesso per i nostri pazienti. Come leader di soluzioni di qualità, sarete responsabili di implementare e fornire soluzioni di qualità per dimostrare la fiducia nel nostro QMS al fine di accelerare la revisione e l'approvazione normativa per i farmaci e soluzioni sanitarie integrate. Potrai collaborare con team interfunzionali e partner esterni e lavorare con notevole indipendenza. Contribuisce al miglioramento continuo dei processi interni e del supporto del sistema. In qualità di Senior Quality Solutions Lead, sarete responsabili di fornire soluzioni di qualità attraverso la progettazione di soluzioni di qualità innovative/nuove/efficienti per dimostrare la fiducia nel nostro QMS al fine di accelerare la revisione normativa e l'approvazione per i farmaci e le soluzioni sanitarie integrate. Vi cercheremo di contribuire a complesse squadre di capitoli trasversali o incrociati assumendo un ruolo di primo piano e navigando situazioni all'interno del paesaggio QMS. Responsabilità e responsabilità primarie:
• SOLUZIONI DI QUALITÀ: fornire soluzioni di qualità che consentano a Roche di soddisfare le normative/standard /HA aspettative, in modo efficiente ed efficace. Le attività possono includere, ma non sono limitate a: ○ Regulatory Intelligence - analizza proattivamente il paesaggio normativo e valuta l'impatto di emergenze e modifiche alle normative esistenti ai processi Roche. ○ Sviluppo di processi e procedure - partner con processi di business to design, sfruttando al massimo l'automazione e il flusso di lavoro di sistema, lo sviluppo di metriche/segnali di performance/misure di supervisione basate sulle prove. ○ Distribuzione di processi - partner con l'azienda per implementare processi, compresa la fornitura di soluzioni di formazione/performance per dimostrare la qualifica e la competenza del business per eseguire i processi. ○ Miglioramento continuo - guida le attività di miglioramento del processo, sfruttando Quality Analytics & Insights e il forte processo decisionale per e con Global Process Owners; partner con il business per identificare, analizzare e migliorare i processi esistenti e creare soluzioni per ottimizzare le prestazioni, soddisfare i migliori standard di pratica o migliorare la qualità e l'esperienza degli utenti per i clienti e gli utenti finali.
• ESCELLENZA QMS: Dimostrare l'integrità del processo alle autorità sanitarie ○ Sviluppare strategie di processo e gestire in modo proattivo le linee temporali per garantire una corretta supervisione e consegna di soluzioni di qualità, tra cui l'implementazione e l'adozione di nuove tecnologie e soluzioni che favoriscano l'efficienza e il risparmio di costi. ○ Migliorare continuamente il proc interno

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Particle Design team at Roche is dedicated to developing robust and efficient processes for small molecule drug substances. This team works at the intersection of chemical engineering, physical chemistry, and pharmaceutical science to define and control the final solid forms and solid-state attributes required for optimal drug product quality and manufacturing. We are seeking a seasoned leader to lead this team within the Synthetic Molecules Pharmaceutical & Solid State Development organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in solid state sciences and late stage drug substance / drug product process development, excellent interpersonal skills for interdisciplinary collaboration, and serve as a strong role model for cross-functional collaboration and collective leadership.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and develop a high performing team: Directly lead and manage the "Particle Design" section, which includes approximately 20 employees. Hire, mentor and develop team members within the organization. Identify skills, potential and aspirations of employees in the team, and coach them on current performance and future potential.

• Shape strategic direction: Play an active role in the PTDC-P Leadership Team and PTDC-eLT. Proactively develop and implement strategies for the section and the overall organization.

• Drive portfolio delivery: Ensure development, scale up and successful commercialization of robust, phase-appropriate manufacturing processes for the finishing step (e.g. crystallization and isolation, milling) of Roche’s synthetic molecule drug substance portfolio. Scout and deploy innovative, state-of-the-art methodologies in crystallization and co-processing to optimize solid-state properties.

• Ensure technical excellence: Coach the team members in leading scientific/technical discussions with internal teams (e.g., RED (Research and Early Development) project teams, synthetic chemists, analytical scientists, formulation scientists) to plan, execute, and resolve project-related challenges, and develop sound control strategies.

• Champion project success: Organize internal and external resources for the efficient handling of the project portfolio. Coordinate work processes and scope with partners and stakeholders within the TDT (technical development teams).

• Foster strong partnerships: Promote and organize the collaboration of the Solid State Science group with internal and external clients and partners, including REDs, internal/ external commercial manufacturing, CMO site management, Regulatory Affairs, and PTDC.

Be responsible for proactive resource planning, creating credit applications, and managing capital investments for the section. A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il team di Particle Design di Roche è dedicato allo sviluppo di processi robusti ed efficienti per le piccole sostanze molecolari. Questo team lavora all'intersezione dell'ingegneria chimica, della chimica fisica e della scienza farmaceutica per definire e controllare le forme solide finali e gli attributi a stato solido necessari per una migliore qualità e produzione del prodotto della droga. Siamo alla ricerca di un leader esperto per guidare questa squadra all'interno dell'organizzazione Sintetico Molecules Pharmaceutical & Solid State Development. Il candidato ideale avrà un forte background in scienze statali solide e sviluppo del processo di droga in fase avanzata / droga, eccellenti competenze interpersonali per la collaborazione interdisciplinare, e servire come un modello di ruolo forte per la collaborazione interfunzionale e la leadership collettiva. L'opportunità:
• Guidare e sviluppare un team ad alte prestazioni: Direttamente guidare e gestire la sezione "Particle Design", che comprende circa 20 dipendenti. Hire, mentore e sviluppare membri del team all'interno dell'organizzazione. Identificare le competenze, le potenzialità e le aspirazioni dei dipendenti nella squadra, e allenarli sulle prestazioni attuali e sul potenziale futuro.
• Forma direzione strategica: gioca un ruolo attivo nel team di leadership PTDC-P e PTDC-eLT. Proattivamente sviluppare e implementare strategie per la sezione e l'organizzazione generale.
• Consegna del portafoglio di unità: Assicurare lo sviluppo, scalare e commercializzare con successo i processi di produzione robusti e appropriati in fase per la fase di finitura (ad esempio cristallizzazione e isolamento, fresatura) del portafoglio di sostanze chimiche sintetiche di Roche. Esplora e distribuisci metodologie innovative e all'avanguardia in cristallizzazione e co-elaborazione per ottimizzare le proprietà a stato solido.
• Assicurare l'eccellenza tecnica: allenare i membri del team nelle principali discussioni scientifiche/tecniche con i team di progetto interni (ad esempio, RED (Research and Early Development), i chimici sintetici, gli scienziati analitici, gli scienziati della formulazione) per pianificare, eseguire e risolvere le sfide legate al progetto e sviluppare strategie di controllo del suono.
• Successo del progetto Champion: Organizza risorse interne ed esterne per la gestione efficiente del portafoglio di progetto. Coordinare i processi di lavoro e la portata con partner e stakeholder all'interno del TDT ( team di sviluppo tecnico).
• Promuovere e organizzare la collaborazione del gruppo Solid State Science con clienti e partner interni ed esterni, tra cui RED, produzione commerciale interna/esterno, gestione del sito CMO, affari regolamentari e PTDC.
• Gestire le risorse e la conformità: garantire moderni standard di attrezzature e supporto di sistema nei laboratori. Sii responsabile della pianificazione proattiva delle risorse, della creazione di applicazioni di credito e della gestione degli investimenti per la sezione. Assicurare la piena adesione a politiche, procedure e standard rilevanti per la sicurezza, la salute e la protezione ambientale (SHE). Chi sei:
• Ph.D. in un campo rilevante (ad esempio chimica organica, c fisica

jobs.title: 副总监 - 医院战略合作

titleByLocale.en: 副总监 - 医院战略合作
titleByLocale.de: 副总监 - 医院战略合作
titleByLocale.fr: 副总监 - 医院战略合作

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 您是谁：
• 作为医院战略合作部门区域负责人，您将带领团队 与负责区域的外部医疗机构建立长期、深度、多元的战略伙伴关系，从而全面助力医院实现高质量发展目标。

您的主要职责：
• 1、与负责区域的外部医疗机构建立长期、深度、多元的战略伙伴关系。作为医院非临床各职能科室的首要对接窗口，充分依托罗氏的创新资源禀赋，为医院提供一体化支持方案，从而全面助力医院实现高质量发展目标。
• 1.1 了解和挖掘所负责区域关键医院业务和学术发展需求，并提供相应的学术支持
• 1.2 设计和实施区域品牌项目，培养区域的讲者，打造公司在区域的影响力
• 1.3 部门合作推动所负责区域关键医院与公司的战略合作关系

2、负责所属区域关键医院的准入工作
• 2.1根据部门与业务共识的医院准入目标，确保在开发成功率和有效执行
• 2.2 推动需开发医院的药事会、临采流程，提供关键医院药学部解决方案
• 2.3 负责所属区域关键医院的已准入状态的维护；将医院总控影响降到最低；维护好与关键医院医保办合作

• 3、负责所属区域关键医院业务计划（Account planning）制定
• 3.1完成和完善区域关键医院的 项目及预算计划
• 3.2 监督SAM执行所负责关键医院的计划执行
• 3.3 协同业务和跨部门一起完善和落实相关项目的落地和高效执行

4、负责团队和人员管理
• 4.1按时准确完成日常工作和相关报告，严格遵守和执行公司的合规政策
• 4.2负责区域T&E费用预算审核及实际费用审核，对预算负责
• 4.3 根据团队业绩考核目标，定期辅导和跟进计划执行，以确保业务目标达成

5、 参与或带领部门或跨部门的相关项目

我们期待这样的你加入：
• 1，具备医院准入，市场准入或医药销售二线管理工作经验。
• 2， 具备项目管理能力，辅导及提升团队项目管理知识及流程；辅导团队设计项目；能对风险及突发事件处理及预防。
• 3， 具备团队合作能力，能建立跨部门沟通合作机制；具有全局观和全面思考能力，从公司策略角度引导开展区域及跨区域活动会议，促成跨区域内部合作，形成品牌项目。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Leader digitale del flusso di valore del prodotto (Lab Connected)

titleByLocale.de: Digital Product Value Stream Leader (Connected Lab)
titleByLocale.fr: Digital Product Value Stream Leader (Connected Lab)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The opportunity:
The Digital Product Value Stream Leader is a strategic leadership role responsible for owning the end-to-end lifecycle and commercial success of Roche Diagnostics China’s "Connected Lab"; digital portfolio. This role
requires a visionary leader who will define the long-term strategic direction and vision, as well as a roadmap for connected laboratory solutions, ensuring alignment with Roche’s broader digital ecosystem and the specific needs of the Chinese market.

In this capacity, you will lead, coach and empower a team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of agility, customer-centricity, and outcome-based delivery. This role serves as a critical bridge, ensuring seamless synergy between technical engineering, commercial go-to-market strategies, and customer experience,
ensuring that our digital value stream maximizes laboratory efficiency, data connectivity, and diagnostic value. You will also be accountable for the P&L performance, adoption, and sustained growth of the Connected Lab product suite.

You will:

• Value Stream Strategy: Define and execute a cohesive digital stratgy for the Connected Lab value stream, transitioning products from concept to launch and maturity while ensuring seamless ineration with laboratory hardware and middleware.

• Team Leadership: Build, coach, and lead a high-performing team of Product Managers; drive functional excellence in product disovery, backlog prioritization, and roadmap planning.

• Lifecycle Management: Oversee the complete product lifecycle (PLM) for the portfolio, making data-driven decisions on investment, iteration, and sunsetting to maximize ROI.

• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the primary interface beween local R&D, Global teams, Commercial, and Customer Support to remove bottlenecks and ensure timely delivery of value to customers.

• Market Success: Deeply understand the China diagnostics landscape to drive product-market fit, ensuring solutions address local regulatory requirements, workflow challenges, and digital trends.

Who you are:

• Master or bachelor's degree in IT, Finance, Business or Biomedical Sciences

• Deep curiosity about the healthcare ecosystem with a fluency in common business models and knowledge of the competitive landscape for digital health and diagnostics

• Exceptional problem-solving and analytical tills, ability to work alone as product business owner to drive the projects forward.

• Leadership skills, including strategic thinking, creativity, integrity, trust, accountability, credibility, judgment, persuasion/influence, fairness and high ethical standards.

• Ability to positively approach new challenges and opportunities, using creative thought processes to uniquely solve problems

• Ability to build and execute processes with a mindset toward the future

• Strong strategic planning skills

• High tolerance for ambiguity

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to multi-task and meet deadlines

• Organized, detail-oriented

• High level of written and oral communication skills

• 12+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Medical Information, Scientific Communications, or Clinical Informatics, preferably in a pharmaceutical, medical device, or health technology setting.

Who we are

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche bewegt uns täglich die Frage: Was brauchen Patient:innen jetzt? Als Customer Partnering Manager (m/w/d) im Bereich Ophthalmologie bist Du die Antwort darauf. Du gestaltest aktiv die Versorgungslandschaft für Menschen mit neovaskulärer, altersbedingter Makuladegeneration (nAMD) und Diabetischem Makulaödem (DMÖ) und schaffst so einen echten Mehrwert – für Patient:innen, das Gesundheitssystem und für uns.

Dein neues Team
Dich erwartet ein cross-funktionales und engagiertes Team, das eng zusammenarbeitet, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für Patient:innen zu erzielen. Wir leben eine offene Feedbackkultur und freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit Dir neue Wege zu gehen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Customer Partnering Manager (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Ophthalmologie aktiv mit. Deine Aufgaben sind dabei so wirkungsvoll wie vielfältig:

• Wirkungsvolle Strategien entwickeln: Du analysierst die Versorgungswege von Patient:innen (Patient Journey), identifizierst Hürden sowie Chancen und leitest daraus wirkungsvolle Maßnahmen ab.

• Wissenstransfer auf Augenhöhe: Du führst einen fundierten wissenschaftlichen Austausch mit medizinischen Expert:innen und stellst die korrekte und angemessene Anwendung unserer etablierten Medikamente sicher.

• Partnerschaften gestalten: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Zielkund:innen und baust nachhaltige, partnerschaftliche Beziehungen entlang der gesamten Patient Journey auf.

• Netzwerke beleben: Du planst und gestaltest proaktiv Fortbildungsveranstaltungen sowie Produktschulungen für Ärzt:innen und medizinisches Fachpersonal, sowohl digital als auch vor Ort.

• Versorgung optimieren: Du gestaltest die regionalen Versorgungsstrukturen aktiv mit, um unser Portfolio im Sinne der Patient:innen optimal zu positionieren.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke und strategisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die mit Leidenschaft Brücken zwischen Wissenschaft und Praxis baut.

• Deine Basis: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (z.B. in Medizin, Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften) und erfüllst die Voraussetzungen als Pharmaberater:in nach §75 AMG.

• Deine Erfahrung: Du bringst bereits Erfahrung aus der pharmazeutischen Industrie mit, idealerweise im wissenschaftlichen Außendienst oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle.

• Dein Antrieb: Erfolgreiche und mit Freude und Überzeugung geführte Verkaufsgespräche sind Dein Beitrag zur Versorgung von Patient:innen mit unseren innovativen Produkten.

• Deine Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst souverän und partnerschaftlich auf Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl persönlich als auch über digitale Kanäle, und kannst komplexe wissenschaftliche Inhalte klar vermitteln.

• Dein Teamgeist: Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional im Team, schätzt eine offene Feedbackkultur und besitzt eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis für die Mobilität in Deiner Region.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Paid Media Specialist is responsible for supporting and partnering with our Business Partners in executing on the paid media strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The role is expert in all aspects of paid campaign management across different channels and platforms and is able to build out reporting metrics that supports the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Planning, executing, and optimizing global digital marketing campaigns across key channels such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Display, in close collaboration with digital marketing managers and social media leads worldwide. This includes a focus on media buying, strategically purchasing ad space to reach our target audiences effectively and efficiently through our media agency.

• Monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders, managing key KPIs and budgets, and continuously driving improvements

• Conducting A/B testing and audience optimization to refine targeting, ad copy, landing pages, and bidding strategies, ensuring data-driven enhancements and higher conversion rates

• Staying up to date with industry trends and best practices, leveraging research and insights to keep campaign strategies at the forefront, while discovering and learning the pharma advertising space

• Contributing to process optimization and knowledge sharing, establishing process governance, collaborating cross-functionally to align campaign goals, share learnings, and strengthen team capabilities

Who you are:

• You have a degree in Business or Marketing (BSc/MSc) and bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience in paid media campaign management, running campaigns across platforms focusing mainly on LinkedIn Ads, and have a good understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Display Advertising

• You are analytical and data-driven, with strong technical skills, and have experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics. You know how to develop effective strategies, analyze performance, and continuously optimize campaigns for better results

• You are an excellent communicator with a C1-level English proficiency, confident in managing global stakeholders, collaborating with agencies and digital managers, and engaging with senior leaders to drive campaign success.

• You have a consultancy mindset, proactively providing insights and recommendations, developing actionable plans, and contributing to process improvements and best practices within the team

• You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, are detail-oriented and well-organized, and bring a passion for digital technologies along with strong project management skills to keep initiatives on track

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,

The Position We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest! The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design. The Paid Media Specialist is responsible for supporting and partnering with our Business Partners in executing on the paid media strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The role is expert in all aspects of paid campaign management across different channels and platforms and is able to build out reporting metrics that supports the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives. The Opportunity:
• Planning, executing, and optimizing global digital marketing campaigns across key channels such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Display, in close collaboration with digital marketing managers and social media leads worldwide. This includes a focus on media buying, strategically purchasing ad space to reach our target audiences effectively and efficiently through our media agency.
• Monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders, managing key KPIs and budgets, and continuously driving improvements
• Conducting A/B testing and audience optimization to refine targeting, ad copy, landing pages, and bidding strategies, ensuring data-driven enhancements and higher conversion rates
• Staying up to date with industry trends and best practices, leveraging research and insights to keep campaign strategies at the forefront, while discovering and learning the pharma advertising space
• Contributing to process optimization and knowledge sharing, establishing process governance, collaborating cross-functionally to align campaign goals, share learnings, and strengthen team capabilities Who you are:
• You have a degree in Business or Marketing (BSc/MSc) and bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience in paid media campaign management, running campaigns across platforms focusing mainly on LinkedIn Ads, and have a good understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Display Advertising
• You are analytical and data-driven, with strong technical skills, and have experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics. You know how to develop effective strategies, analyze performance, and continuously optimize campaigns for better results
• You are an excellent communicator with a C1-level English proficiency, confident in managing global stakeholders, collaborating with agencies and digital managers, and engaging with senior leaders to drive campaign success.
• You have a consultancy mindset, proactively providing insights and recommendations, developing actionable plans, and contributing to process improvements and best practices within the team
• You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, are detail-oriented and well-organized, and bring a passion for digital technologies along with strong project management skills to keep initiatives on track In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
PTE is the department within Roche’s PT - Pharma Technical Operations - that leads Operational Excellence, Digital, and Advanced Analytics capabilities. As part of PTE, Operational Excellence empowers Roche PT teams to achieve their performance goals by cultivating a strong, inclusive, and cross-functional community. We focus on embedding Lean thinking, driving continuous improvement, and thoughtfully advancing Digital and Analytics solutions to deliver tangible business value.

Operational Excellence champions a culture of continuous improvement—promoting Lean as a way of working, simplifying complex processes, and enabling teams to address root causes effectively. Our mission is to build lasting capabilities that enable smarter, faster, and more sustainable ways of working, ultimately benefiting both our colleagues and patients.

The Global Operational Excellence Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for PTT — our MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability organization — acts as the primary liaison between PTT teams and the global OE strategy and execution. This role drives alignment, leads Lean and continuous improvement initiatives, and fosters a culture of operational excellence across the PTT organization.

The Opportunity:

• Architect: Collaborate with senior management to identify and prioritize improvement opportunities and integrate Operational Excellence (OE) with Digital & Analytics Technologies to create a joint roadmap. Educate and influence senior leaders on using OE/Lean and digital measures to drive outcomes.

• Catalyst: Support key decision-making, take accountability for improvement plan execution and outcomes, and lead complex improvement initiatives combining OE and Digital methodologies. Monitor performance, promote Lean practices, and identify and address potential roadblocks.

• Coach: Guide senior and function managers on Lean Leadership, build skills and mindsets across the network, and facilitate a unified digital community.

• Collaboration & Leadership: Engage PTT Leaders to uncover needs and remove barriers. Align with other PT OE Partners to ensure cohesive, cross-functional solutions. Communicate clearly, foster collaboration, and bring high energy and ownership.

What You Bring:

• M.Sc., or Bachelor’s in a relevant field preferred; Engineering, Manufacturing Science, Biology, Chemistry etc. MBA a plus.

• At least 5 years of Operational Excellence / Lean experience with strong systemic and analytical thinking.

• Experience in biotech or pharma is a must. Ideally you have a background in Biologics manufacturing.

• Deep MSAT/Engineering understanding.

• Ability to influence and drive sustainable change across complex stakeholder groups.

• Leadership strength in both vision and execution, especially in behavioral transformation.

• Growth mindset, digital fluency, and comfort in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione PTE è il dipartimento di Roche’s PT - Pharma Technical Operations - che conduce le funzionalità di Operational Excellence, Digital e Advanced Analytics. Nell'ambito di PTE, l'Eccellenza Operativa consente ai team Roche PT di raggiungere i propri obiettivi di performance coltivando una comunità forte, inclusiva e interfunzionale. Ci concentriamo sull'integrazione del pensiero Lean, sul miglioramento continuo e su soluzioni di Digital e Analytics mirate per offrire un valore commerciale tangibile. L'Eccellenza Operativa sostiene una cultura del miglioramento continuo, promuovendo Lean come modo di lavorare, semplificando i processi complessi e consentendo ai team di affrontare efficacemente le cause della radice. La nostra missione è quella di costruire capacità durevoli che consentano modi di lavorare più intelligenti, più veloci e più sostenibili, in ultima analisi, beneficiano sia dei nostri colleghi che dei nostri pazienti. Il Global Operational Excellence Single Point of Contact (SPOC) per PTT — la nostra organizzazione MSAT, Engineering e Sustainability — funge da collegamento primario tra i team PTT e la strategia globale OE ed esecuzione. Questo ruolo guida l'allineamento, conduce iniziative di miglioramento continuo e magra, e promuove una cultura di eccellenza operativa attraverso l'organizzazione PTT. L'opportunità:
• Architetto: collaborare con la gestione senior per identificare e privilegiare le opportunità di miglioramento e integrare l'eccellenza operativa (OE) con Digital & Analytics Technologies per creare una roadmap congiunta. Educare e influenzare i leader senior sull'utilizzo di OE/Lean e misure digitali per guidare i risultati.
• Catalizzatore: Sostenere il processo decisionale chiave, prendere in considerazione l'esecuzione e i risultati del piano di miglioramento, e portare complesse iniziative di miglioramento che combinano metodologie OE e Digital. Monitorare le prestazioni, promuovere le pratiche magre e identificare e affrontare potenziali blocchi stradali.
• Coach: Guida senior e responsabili delle funzioni su Leadership Lean, costruire competenze e mentalità in tutta la rete, e facilitare una comunità digitale unificata.
• Collaborazione e leadership: Engage PTT Leader per scoprire le esigenze e rimuovere le barriere. Allineare con altri partner PT OE per garantire soluzioni coessive e interfunzionali. Comunicare chiaramente, promuovere la collaborazione e portare alta energia e proprietà. Cosa porti:
• M.Sc., o Bachelor in un campo rilevante preferito; Ingegneria, Scienza manifatturiera, Biologia, Chimica ecc MBA a plus.
• Almeno 5 anni di Eccellenza Operativa / Esperienza matura con forte pensiero sistemico e analitico.
• L'esperienza nella biotecnologia o nel farmaco è un must. Idealmente avete uno sfondo nella produzione di Biologics.
• Profonda comprensione MSAT/Engineering.
• Capacità di influenzare e guidare un cambiamento sostenibile attraverso gruppi di stakeholder complessi.
• Forza di leadership sia nella visione che nell'esecuzione, soprattutto nella trasformazione comportamentale.
• Mindset di crescita, fluidità digitale e comfort in ambienti dinamici e veloci. jobs.title: 实习医药信息顾问
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （1 ）在校大学生
• （2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4 ）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力
• tag #LI-DNI

A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Commercial Excellence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a strategic visionary and execution-focused leader to become our Head of Commercial Excellence, China. This is a critical role designed to build the strategic "connective tissue" across our entire China commercial operation. You will be the architect of our capabilities, processes, and systems, empowering our teams to achieve peak performance in one of the world's most dynamic healthcare markets.
Your mission is to transform data into strategy and strategy into flawless execution, ensuring we are agile, data-driven, and perfectly aligned to win.

What You’ll Do:

• Develop Strategic Vision: Act as a key partner to the China Leadership Team, crafting and championing a 3-5 year Commercial Excellence roadmap to shape our future.

• Architect Go-To-Market Strategy: Lead the integrated GTM strategy, ensuring seamless and compliant alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Market Access teams.

• Drive Sales & Field Force Excellence: Lead Field Force Effectiveness (FFE), including segmentation, targeting, territory design, and incentive compensation to foster a high-performance culture.

• Enable Marketing & Launch Excellence: Partner with brand teams on omnichannel marketing and own a best-in-class launch excellence framework for flawless product introductions.

• Power Data-Driven Decisions: Build a robust data and analytics powerhouse to deliver actionable insights and sophisticated models for pricing, access, and strategy.

• Optimize Commercial Technology: Oversee the commercial tech stack (e.g., CRM, AI tools), ensuring maximum adoption and ROI to enable our teams.

• Lead & Inspire a High-Performing Team: Train, mentor, and lead a multi-disciplinary Commercial Excellence team, fostering a culture of agility and continuous improvement.

• Build Future-Ready Capabilities: Design and deploy comprehensive training programs to develop the strategic capabilities of our commercial field force and cross-functional teams.

Who You Are:

• You bring 15+ years in the pharma/biotech industry, with at least 5-7 years in a senior Commercial Excellence leadership role.

• You have a non-negotiable, proven track record and deep, applied understanding of the mainland China healthcare ecosystem, policy landscape, and digital environment.

• You seamlessly pivot between building a 5-year strategic vision and driving a 30-day operational sprint to enable execution.

• You demonstrate exceptional leadership with proven experience building, inspiring, and developing high-performing, cross-functional teams.

• You possess superior analytical skills, with a history of leveraging data to challenge conventions and drive business performance.

• You foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, championing a data-driven mindset across the organization.

• You hold an advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD preferred) and are fluent in both Mandarin Chinese and English.

• You are energized by the "green-light" to innovate, build, and transform how we operate.

What We Offer:

• A high-visibility, high-impact leadership role with significant future career development opportunities within a top-tier global enterprise.

• The unique opportunity to architect and shape the commercial future in our most critical market.

• A mandate to innovate—to build, transform, and implement your strategic vision.

• A competitive executive compensation package, including bonus and long-term incentives.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together,

● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagement
of Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PD
of Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager

jobs.title: Analyst (Business Operations)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) was established to drive analytics and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

The Opportunity:
As the Analyst (Business Operations) , you will join the GATE team to manage critical data contracts, third-party agreements (TPA), and related finance and budgetary processes.

In this role, you will act as a key liaison between US business partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders. Your mission is to ensure the efficient, compliant, and timely execution of all data agreements, with a specific focus on the Pharmaceutical/Life Sciences domain.

Key Responsibilities

Contract & Agreement Management

• End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Process Data Contracts and Third-Party Agreements (TPA) from initiation to completion, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Procurement, Legal) and external vendors.

• Vendor Onboarding: Lead the onboarding process for new vendors by collaborating with the Vendor Master Data team to obtain necessary approvals and system setup.

• Compliance & Access: Partner with stakeholders to validate appropriate use cases and data sources for TPAs to prevent discrepancies and unauthorized access.

• System Administration: Oversee the efficient and accurate processing of all documents, preventing oversights and ensuring seamless execution.

• Issue Resolution: Oversee daily communication and ensure the smooth resolution of any issues related to the TPA process.

Financial & Budget Operations

• Budget Tracking: Continuously update the master contract and budget tracking sheet to monitor contract statuses and accurately track total expenditure (spent-to-date) against budget metrics.

• Financial Reconciliation: Perform data validation, resolve Purchase Order (PO) amount discrepancies with the Finance reporting system, and accurately manage year-wise accruals for multi-year contracts.

• Procurement Support: Facilitate full service contract processing for Data Management by collaborating directly with the Procurement team to secure necessary Purchase Orders (POs).

• WBS Management: Submit SMART Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code requests for contracts requiring multiple splits, and accurately process WBS and Change Order requests when applicable.

Data & Process Optimization

• Process Improvement: Document and maintain current workflows, identifying and implementing opportunities for process optimization within contract operations.

• Data Analysis: Conduct data assessments, gap analyses, and ad hoc data analyses to provide valuable insights for decision-making.

• Inquiry Handling: Efficiently handle incoming data inquiries, sourcing and implementing solutions, and retrieving data for ad hoc requests.

Who You Are

Experience

• Professional Background: 2+ years of professional experience in a Business Analyst, Finance Operations, or Contracts Management role.

• Contract Expertise: Knowledge in managing and processing Data Contracts and Third-Party Agreements (TPA), demonstrating a strong process-oriented approach.

• Forecasting: Aware of forecasting and predicting financial trends based on historical data.

• Industry Knowledge: Experience in the Pharma, Life Science, or Biotech domain is a significant advantage.

Skills & Competencies

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to interact professionally and effectively with senior leadership and diverse stakeholders.

• Technical Prof

The Position
Como Practicante de Comunicación Interna, te unirás a un equipo dinámico donde tu creatividad será clave para fortalecer nuestra cultura y conectar a nuestros colaboradores. En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad única de desarrollar contenido visual impactante y dar voz a las historias que nos definen como organización. Trabajarás de la mano con diversas áreas del negocio para innovar en nuestros canales y estrategias de comunicación interna.

La Oportunidad

• Creas y desarrollas contenidos atractivos en formatos escritos, digitales y audiovisuales para potenciar nuestros canales internos.

• Capturas y editas material fotográfico y de video, asegurando una alta calidad visual en la cobertura de nuestros eventos corporativos.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The opportunity
As the Ecosystem Enabler, you are a member of the Affiliate Enabling Team and shape how Roche Central Asia delivers impact across the portfolio. You connect strategy to execution across three Disease Areas, strengthen customer engagement and digital/omnichannel excellence, and build the capabilities and operating model that enable high performance.
You role model an agile leadership stance (VACC: Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach)—creating clarity of direction, enabling empowered teams, and accelerating learning and performance. You operate with an enterprise mindset, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and partner closely across functions and countries to ensure disciplined execution and sustainable outcomes for patients and the healthcare system.

Key responsibilities

Strategy, outcomes and performance

• Co-create, with the Affiliate Enabling Team, the affiliate’s near- and long-term strategic direction and translate it into clear outcomes, priorities and execution plans.

• Lead integrated portfolio planning across the three Disease Areas to ensure coherence, focus, and disciplined delivery.

• Ensure responsible resource and budget stewardship, enabling the highest-impact opportunities and sustainable execution.

• Establish and maintain fit-for-purpose governance, planning routines and performance reviews to drive execution quality.

Disease Area leadership

• Provide strategic direction and enable execution across the affiliate’s three Disease Areas (end-to-end: strategy, customer engagement approach, and delivery through squads/teams).

• Ensure disease area strategies are insight-led and differentiated, with clear choices on priorities, target segments and value communication.

• Drive alignment across Disease Areas on shared capabilities, ways of working, and cross-portfolio opportunities.

Customer engagement and digital/omnichannel enablement

• Strengthen customer engagement by streamlining touchpoints and improving end-to-end experience for key audiences (HCPs, payers, patients, partners).

• Lead the affiliate’s digital/omnichannel strategy and execution, ensuring coordinated, measurable, customer-relevant content and initiatives.

• Drive data- and insights-led decision making by leading analysis of trends, customer insights, and performance indicators that inform priorities and improve effectiveness.

Ecosystem shaping and external partnerships

• Lead and coordinate participation in national and regional healthcare programs/projects aligned with public health priorities and Roche’s commitments.

• Build trusted partnerships and engage with key stakeholders (health authorities, payers/funds, NGOs, partners) on strategic and project-related topics.

Leadership, capability building and culture

• Lead, develop and empower leaders and teams across the three Disease Areas and Digital/Omnichannel capability.

• Act as an agile leader (VACC): set direction (Visionary), shape fit-for-purpose structures and routines (Architect), unlock energy and momentum (Catalyst), and develop people and capabilities (Coach).

• Create an environment of trust, accountability and collaboration across squads/chapters/functions, enabling high-performing, self-managed teams.

• Enable timely decisions on cross-ecosystem topics where alignment is needed, ensuring clarity on priorities, ownership and ways of working.

• Drive talent attraction and development, succession planning, rotations and recognition across the ecosystem.

• Ensure compliance, in

jobs.title: Senior Scientist - Cell Culture Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
JOB DESCRIPTION
SENIOR SCIENTIST OF Biologics CMC
at China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR)

POSITION
At Roche, over 90,000 colleagues are working together and doing what patients need next. Our ambition is to deliver novel therapeutics, diagnostic solutions and insights to patients with game changing clinical benefits. China Innovation Center of Roche is seeking a talented and experienced Senior/Principal Scientist in Biologics CMC group for developing cell line development and cell culture strategy and driving execution of strategies to support biologics discovery and development programs. The final position offered depends on the experience level of the candidate. The successful candidate will work with dynamic and highly motivated teams to drive the discovery and development of antibody therapeutics for unmet medical needs. The position requires effective collaboration on multidisciplinary teams with members from multiple functions of CICoR, and interfaces with Discovery, CMC, Pharma Technical Development (PTD), Quality, Regulatory and external CRO/CDMO partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop cell line development and cell culture process development strategy as a part of overall project technical development strategy to support IND and early clinical development

• Drive cell line development and cell culture process development activities in collaboration with Roche TDTs and Roche qualified CDMO partners, including development and scale-up of mammalian cell culture and harvest process, from seed train to bioreactor harvest for production of biologics, lead clone selection, and process optimization. Author, review and/or approve technical reports for documenting process development activities

• Support technology transfer of manufacturing processes from biotech partners to Roche or a Roche CDMO partner, or from one Roche site/CDMO partner to another Roche site/CDMO partner

• Ensure cGMP compliance with ICH guidelines and regulatory requirements

• Serve as a CLD and CCPD technical SME on biologics technical development teams, CMC due diligence teams and CDMO assessment/qualification teams

• Drive transient CHO expression and purification to support discovery and preclinical projects in collaboration with Discovery teams

• Close communication and collaboration with Discovery, CMC, Quality, Technical Regulatory and PTD to ensure alignment and E2E mindset

• Participate in due diligence to evaluate external opportunities for in-licensing of assets or technologies

• May serve as CMC lead that designs and executes project CMC development strategies and risk mitigation strategies, drives planning and operational excellence of early development CMC projects, manages seamless collaboration with CMC-related functions to deliver biologics CMC projects

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Qualification and experience
The candidate qualifications include a Ph.D. in Biology, Protein Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemical Engineering or related field, including at least 5 years of recent CLD and/or CCPD experience preferably in a biotech or pharma setting, or a MS in above areas with at least 8 years of relevant experience. A track record of effective support in drug discovery and development programs.
Competencies
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated competence in the following areas:

• Hands-on experience in bioreactors for biopharmaceutical/biologic production, experience in leading mammalian cell culture process development activities

• Understanding of cell biolo

titleByLocale.de: Principal Device Ingenieur with Pen- / Autoinjector expertise

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

The Device Engineering section combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. Additionally, you will take on strategic responsibilities and contribute to efforts led by the Device Engineering leadership team.
This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Act as project leader / team leader / technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market

• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product

• Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans and DHF creation/maintenance DHF), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality and cost constraints, resulting in state-of–the-art drug delivery devices

• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30)

Who you are:

• You have university level education (engineering degree or related discipline).

• You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development with experience in pharma or other closely-regulated environments, under current Good Practice (cGxP), Quality System Regulation (QSR), or similar working practices.

• You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.

• You have sound knowledge of legislation, regulation, industry standards, and guidance within the area of combination products and medical devices.

• You have experience with Health Authority interactions.

• You have demonstrable knowledge of drug delivery devices, parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, manufacturing processes, and reliability engineering.

• You possess excellent documentation, presentation, interpersonal communication skills and strategic thinking.

• You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable.

La posizione Il dipartimento di sviluppo del dispositivo all'interno di Roche Technical Development è responsabile per lo sviluppo e il supporto dei dispositivi di distribuzione della droga per il portafoglio prodotti. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support. The Device Engineering section combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities. The opportunity: In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. Additionally, you will take on strategic responsibilities and contribute to efforts led by the Device Engineering leadership team. This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.
• Act as project leader / team leader / technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market
• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product
• Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans and DHF creation/maintenance DHF), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.
• Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality and cost constraints, resulting in state-of–the-art drug delivery devices
• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30) Who you are:
• You have university level education (engineering degree or related discipline).
• You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development with experience in pharma or other closely-regulated environments, under current Good Practice (cGxP), Quality System Regulation (QSR), or similar working practices.
• You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.
• You have sound knowledge of legislation, regulation, industry standards, and guidance within the area of combination products and medical devices.
• You have experience with Health Authority interactions.
• You have demonstrable knowledge of drug delivery devices, parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, manufacturing processes, and reliability engineering.
• You possess excellent documentation, presentation, interpersonal communication skills and strategic thinking.
• You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Abteilung für Geräteentwicklung in Roche Technical Development ist für die Entwicklung und Unterstützung von Medikamentenliefergeräten für das Produktportfolio verantwortlich. Unsere Aktivitäten umfassen eine Reihe von Engineering-Disziplinen von der Definitionsphase der Anforderungen bis hin zur Vermarktung und Vermarktung von Produkten. Der Bereich Device Engineering kombiniert Design, Engineering, Testing und Fertigung, um zuverlässige und sichere Medikamentenliefergeräte zu entwickeln, die den Bedürfnissen von Patienten, Gesundheitsdienstleistern und Gesundheitsbehörden entsprechen. Die Gelegenheit: In dieser Funktion engagieren Sie sich mit einer umfassenden funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit, insbesondere mit Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical und Commercial Teams. Darüber hinaus übernehmen Sie strategische Verantwortung und tragen zu Anstrengungen des Teams für Gerätetechnik bei. Diese Rolle berichtet an den Abschnittsleiter für Gerätetechnik und ist in die Roche-Geräteentwicklungsfunktion integriert.
• Aktivieren Sie als Projektleiter / Teamleiter / technischer Experte, um Kombinationsprodukte und medizinische Geräte erfolgreich auf den Markt zu bringen
• Evaluierung neuer und bahnbrechender Technologien. Anwendung von theoretischem Engineering-Wissen, um robuste technische Produktanforderungen zu etablieren und Engineering-Design-Lösungen zu entwickeln, um sicherzustellen, dass Geräte das erforderliche Maß an Leistung während der gesamten Lebensdauer des Produktes halten
• Dokumentation zur Designsteuerung (Design Development Plans, Benutzeranforderungen Spezifikationen, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans und DHF Erstellung/Wartung DHF), Konformitätsbewertungen und Risikomanagementdokumentation.
• Prognose- und Planressourcenanforderungen für Geräteentwicklungsprojekte. Projekte innerhalb der vereinbarten Zeit, Qualität und Kostenzwänge durchführen, was zu hochmodernen Medikamentenliefergeräten führt
• Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Landschaft anwenden, um normkonforme Designs zu gewährleisten (z.B. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 und 21 CFR 820.30) Wer du bist:
• Sie haben Hochschulbildung (Ausbildungsabschluss oder damit verbundene Disziplin).
• Sie haben einen mindestens 10-jährigen Erfahrungsnachweis in der Entwicklung von Maschinen- und Medikamentenliefergeräten mit Erfahrung in Pharma oder anderen eng regulierten Umgebungen, unter der aktuellen Good Practice (cGxP), der Qualitätssystemverordnung (QSR) oder ähnlichen Arbeitspraktiken.
• Sie haben Hand-on Pen Injektor / Auto Injektor Entwicklung Know-how.
• Sie haben fundierte Kenntnisse über Gesetzgebung, Regulierung, Industriestandards und Beratung im Bereich der Kombinationsprodukte und Medizinprodukte.
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit Interaktionen der Gesundheitsbehörde.
• Sie haben nachweisbare Kenntnisse über Arzneimittelliefergeräte, parenterale Medikamentenlieferung, Risikobewertung, Toleranzanalyse, statistische Techniken, Prozessfähigkeit, Fertigungsprozesse und Zuverlässigkeitstechnik.
• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Dokumentation, Präsentation, zwischenmenschliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und strategisches Denken.
• Sie haben einen ausgezeichneten Befehl der englischen Sprache; Englischkenntnisse sind bevorzugt. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und zu halten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Le service de développement des dispositifs au sein de Roche Technical Development est responsable de la mise au point et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison des médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie, de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et le soutien des produits commercialisés. La section Ingénierie des appareils combine la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la fabrication pour mettre au point des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments fiables et sécuritaires qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des fournisseurs de soins de santé et des autorités sanitaires. L'occasion : Dans ce rôle, vous vous engagerez dans une collaboration interfonctionnelle étendue, en particulier avec des équipes d'assurance de la qualité (AQ), d'affaires réglementaires, cliniques et commerciales. De plus, vous assumerez des responsabilités stratégiques et contribuerez aux efforts menés par l'équipe de direction du génie des appareils. Ce rôle relève du chef de section de l'ingénierie des appareils et est intégré à la fonction de développement des appareils Roche.
• Agir en tant que chef de projet / chef d'équipe / expert technique pour réussir à mettre sur le marché des produits combinés et des dispositifs médicaux
• Évaluation des technologies nouvelles et révolutionnaires. Application des connaissances théoriques en ingénierie, pour établir des exigences techniques robustes du produit, et développer des solutions de conception technique pour assurer que les appareils maintiennent le niveau de performance requis tout au long de la durée de vie du produit
• Documentation de contrôle de conception de l'auteur (plans de conception, spécifications des exigences d'utilisation, entrées de conception, sorties de conception, plans de vérification de conception et DHF création/entretien DHF), évaluations de conformité et documentation de gestion des risques.
• Prévision et planification des demandes de ressources pour les projets de développement d'appareils. Exécuter les projets dans les délais, la qualité et les contraintes de coûts convenus, ce qui se traduira par des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments à la fine pointe de la technologie
• Appliquer les connaissances du paysage réglementaire pour assurer des conceptions conformes aux normes (par exemple ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 et 21 CFR 820.30) Qui vous êtes:
• Vous avez une formation de niveau universitaire (diplôme d'ingénierie ou discipline connexe).
• Vous disposez d'une expérience de 10 ans au moins en génie mécanique et en développement d'appareils de livraison de médicaments ayant une expérience dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou d'autres environnements étroitement réglementés, dans le cadre des bonnes pratiques actuelles (cGxP), de la réglementation du système de qualité (RSQ) ou de pratiques de travail semblables.
• Vous avez une expertise pratique en développement d'injecteurs Pen / Auto.
• Vous avez une bonne connaissance de la législation, de la réglementation, des normes de l'industrie et des conseils dans le domaine des produits combinés et des instruments médicaux.
• Vous avez une expérience des interactions avec les autorités sanitaires.
• Vous avez une connaissance démontrable des dispositifs d'administration de médicaments, de la prestation parentérale de médicaments, de l'évaluation des risques, de l'analyse de tolérance, des techniques statistiques, de la capacité des procédés, des procédés de fabrication et de l'ingénierie de la fiabilité.
• Vous possédez une excellente documentation, présentation, compétences en communication interpersonnelle et pensée stratégique.
• Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de la langue anglaise; la maîtrise de l'allemand est préférable. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics.
