È necessario essere in grado di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente per scoprire il fattore causa/causale radice di un problema SW malfunzionamento/SW, e anche essere in grado di conoscere i requisiti del software, correggere il processo di bug (anche se non li si corregge) e la manutenzione generale del codice, tutto in un ambiente Agile dove si potrebbe contribuire con le proprie idee e proposte in un team in continuo miglioramento A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità:
• Contabile per la tempestiva gestione dei singoli casi (informazioni, reclami, potenziali segnalabili e problemi di sicurezza) secondo i requisiti e le normative del Sistema di Qualità ISO, e le esigenze delle Organizzazioni del Paese tra cui creazione, accettazione, classificazione, indagine, documentazione completa, risoluzione dei problemi in loco e risoluzione dei casi.
• Sostiene i casi nell'area assegnata, potenzialmente richiedendo la consultazione con più membri del team senior sugli aspetti tecnici o legati al processo.
• Interfaccia con gli Affiliati e si assume la responsabilità per una tempestiva comunicazione di informazioni di qualità relative alle Organizzazioni del Paese. Supporta iniziative e misure per mantenere interfacce potenziate con organizzazioni di paesi e rappresentanti regionali.
• Analizza i dati utilizzando misure statistiche per determinare un potenziale problema di prestazioni del prodotto.
• Responsabile di casi di escalation che non possono essere risolti direttamente a livelli appropriati e avviando ulteriori indagini e comunicando le informazioni relative ai casi, se del caso.
• Assicura che i casi siano conformi e conformi ai processi, agli standard e ai regolamenti di qualità stabiliti. Chi sei:
• Possiedi una laurea in bioinformatica, biologia computazionale, ingegneria biomedica, informatica o un campo relativo all'IT.
• Le forti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) sono essenziali
• L'esperienza di lavoro nell'area del Software correlato o bioinformatica e/o nelle funzioni relative al supporto è desiderata.
• Esperienza di lettura codice sorgente
• Si desidera la comprensione delle piattaforme di cloud computing e la gestione dell'esperienza nell'infrastruttura di premessa (compresi i server e i cluster di calcolo ad alte prestazioni).
• È possibile leggere e debug codice sorgente di diversi linguaggi di programmazione per comprendere la causa principale dei problemi segnalati. Applicare se sei:
• Alla ricerca di un'opportunità per continuare a crescere nella tua carriera mescolando sia i campi tecnici (IT) che quelli medici.
• Imparatore di tecnologia veloce.
• Un giocatore di squadra che crede veramente che insieme possiamo andare oltre.
• Non ha paura di fallire e imparare.
• Confortevole con incertezza.
• Alla ricerca di uno scopo in cui il vostro lavoro avrà un impatto reale sulla vita del paziente. Il tuo lavoro
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Complaint Handling Engineer - Medical Software you will be dealing with complaints concerning Digital Solutions quality and product performance of Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions. data communication, apps algorithms. As a member of the Digital Solutions Chapter, you will be working in a very transversal Software environment having the opportunity to work with cutting edge technologies and different programming languages for on-premise and cloud-based software. You need to be able to read and understand source code in order to find out the root cause/causal factor of a SW malfunction/SW issue, and also be able to learn about Software requirements, fixing bugs process (even if you will not fix them) and general code maintenance, all of it in an Agile environment where you could contribute with your own ideas and proposals in a team continuously improving At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events. The Opportunity:
• Accountable for the timely handling of individual cases (Inquiry, Complaint, Potential Reportable and Safety issues) according to ISO Quality System requirements and regulations, and needs of the Country Organizations including creation, acceptance, classification, investigation, complete documentation, on-site trouble-shooting and resolution of cases.
• Resolves cases in the assigned area, potentially requiring consultation with more senior team members on technical or process-related aspects.
• Interface with Affiliates and assumes responsibility for timely communication of quality related information to the Country Organizations. Supports initiatives and measures to maintain enhanced interfaces with country organizations and regional representatives.
• Analyzes data using statistical measures for determining a potential product performance issue.
• Responsible for escalating cases which cannot be directly resolved to appropriate levels and initiating further investigation and communicating case derived information as appropriate.
• Ensures cases are compliant and conform to established quality processes, standards, and regulations. Who you are:
• You own a degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, computer science, or an IT related field.
• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential
• Work experience in the area of Software related or bioinformatics and/or in support related functions is desired.
• Experience reading source code
• Understanding of cloud computing platforms as well as experience managing on premise infrastructure (including servers and high performance computing clusters) is desired.
• You are able to read and or debug source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues. Apply if you are:
• Looking for an opportunity to continue growing in your career while mixing both the technical (IT) and medical fields.
• Quick technology learner.
• A team player who truly believes that together we can go further.
• Not afraid to fail and learn.
• Comfortable with uncertainty.
• Looking for a purpose where your work will have a real impact on patient lives. Your work

Datenkommunikation, Apps Algorithmen. • Behebung von Fällen im zugewiesenen Bereich, die möglicherweise eine Konsultation mit höheren Teammitgliedern zu technischen oder prozessbezogenen Aspekten erfordern.
• Schnittstelle mit Affiliates und übernimmt die Verantwortung für die rechtzeitige Kommunikation von qualitativ hochwertigen Informationen mit den Landorganisationen. Unterstützt Initiativen und Maßnahmen zur Aufrechterhaltung verbesserter Schnittstellen mit Landorganisationen und regionalen Vertretern.

• Verantwortlich für die Eskalation von Fällen, die nicht direkt auf geeignete Ebenen gelöst werden können, und die Einleitung weiterer Untersuchungen und die Übermittlung von Fallinformationen als angemessen.

• Sie sind in der Lage, Quellcode verschiedener Programmiersprachen zu lesen und oder zu debuggen, um die Ursache von gemeldeten Problemen zu verstehen. Anwenden, wenn Sie sind:
• Auf der Suche nach einer Möglichkeit, in Ihrer Karriere weiter zu wachsen und gleichzeitig die technischen (IT) und medizinischen Felder zu mischen.
• Schneller Techniker.
• Ein Teamplayer, der wirklich glaubt, dass wir gemeinsam weiter gehen können.
• Keine Angst zu scheitern und zu lernen.
• Bequem mit Unsicherheit.
• Auf der Suche nach einem Zweck, wo Ihre Arbeit einen echten Einfluss auf das Patientenleben haben wird. Ihre Arbeit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant qu'ingénieur chargé du traitement des plaintes - Services médicaux Logiciels que vous traiterez des plaintes concernant la qualité des solutions numériques et la performance du produit des systèmes d'information hôpital/laboratoire (HIS/LIS), des réseaux de données médicales, des solutions intermédiaires. communication de données, algorithmes d'applications. En tant que membre du chapitre Solutions numériques, vous travaillerez dans un environnement logiciel très transversal ayant la possibilité de travailler avec des technologies de pointe et différents langages de programmation pour des logiciels sur site et basés sur le cloud. Vous devez être en mesure de lire et comprendre le code source afin de découvrir la cause racine / facteur causal d'un problème SW dysfonctionnement/SW, et aussi être en mesure d'apprendre sur les exigences du logiciel, la correction des bogues processus (même si vous ne les corrigerez pas) et la maintenance générale du code, tout cela dans un environnement Agile où vous pourriez contribuer avec vos propres idées et propositions dans une équipe en constante amélioration Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. La possibilité :
• Responsable du traitement en temps voulu des cas individuels (questions d'enquête, de plainte, de déclaration éventuelle et de sécurité) conformément aux exigences et règlements du système qualité ISO, et des besoins des organisations de pays, y compris la création, l'acceptation, la classification, l'enquête, la documentation complète, le dépannage sur place et le règlement des cas.
• Résoudre les cas dans le domaine assigné, ce qui pourrait nécessiter des consultations avec des membres plus expérimentés de l'équipe sur les aspects techniques ou liés aux processus.
• Interface avec les affiliés et prise en charge de la communication en temps voulu d'informations de qualité aux organisations de pays. Appuie les initiatives et les mesures visant à maintenir des interfaces renforcées avec les organisations de pays et les représentants régionaux.
• Analyser les données en utilisant des mesures statistiques pour déterminer un problème potentiel de performance du produit.
• Responsable de l'escalade des affaires qui ne peuvent être résolues directement à des niveaux appropriés et de l'ouverture d'une enquête plus approfondie et de la communication, le cas échéant, de l'information dérivée des affaires.
• S'assurer que les dossiers sont conformes aux processus, aux normes et aux règlements établis en matière de qualité. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous possédez un diplôme en bioinformatique, en biologie informatique, en génie biomédical, en informatique ou en informatique.
• De solides compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé) sont essentielles
• Une expérience de travail dans le domaine des logiciels ou de la bioinformatique et/ou des fonctions de soutien est souhaitée.
• Expérience de lecture du code source
• La compréhension des plateformes de calcul en nuage ainsi que l'expérience de gestion sur l'infrastructure de base (y compris les serveurs et les clusters de calcul à haute performance) est souhaitée.
• Vous pouvez lire et ou déboguer le code source de différents langages de programmation pour comprendre la cause profonde des problèmes signalés. Si vous êtes :
• Vous cherchez l'occasion de poursuivre votre carrière tout en mélangeant les domaines techniques (IT) et médicaux.
• Apprentisseur de technologie rapide.
• Un joueur d'équipe qui croit vraiment que nous pouvons aller plus loin ensemble.
• Ne pas avoir peur d'échouer et d'apprendre.
• Confortable avec l'incertitude.
• La recherche d'un but où votre travail aura un impact réel sur la vie des patients. Votre travail

jobs.title: Intern - Direct Procurement
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Intern - Direct Procurement

Contract type: Contract of mandate (umowa zlecenie) for 12 months
Availability: 5 days per week, 25 - 40 hours per week
Place of work: Warsaw Office or Remote

Join our procurement team as an operational and administrative support specialist! This is an ideal opportunity for someone starting their career to learn procurement processes from the inside, gain experience working in SAP , and participate in the department's digital transformation. You will support us in ensuring supply continuity and building professional relationships with our suppliers.

The Opportunity:

Operational and Systems Support:

• SAP Order Management: Support in creating and processing orders, as well as monitoring delivery deadlines to clients.

• Vendor Database Management: Setting up new vendors and unblocking existing accounts in the system.

• Material Data Administration: Creating new material indexes in the system and performing regular price list updates.

P rocess and Quality Support:

• Contractor Verification: Conducting supplier Due Diligence to secure current business operations and updating the Preferred Supplier List (LPD) .

• Documentation Oversight: Managing specialized documentation related to medical devices ( IVD/MD ).

• Fulfilment Monitoring: Supervising the status of order fulfillment and informing partners about delivery schedules.

Administrative Tasks and Innovation:

• Contract Workflow and Archiving: Managing the signing process and circulation of documents with suppliers, and archiving documents within systems ( MyBuy ).

• Communication and AI: Maintaining the Procurement Intranet site and providing substantive oversight of materials for the AI assistant .

Who you are:

• You own a University Degree or you are still studying

• You are meticulous and accurate when working with data and IT systems.

• You have strong time management skills and the ability to prioritize tasks.

• You have great communication skills and a desire to work in a dynamic, modern environment.

• You are proficient in Polish & English

What you get:

• Flexibility: A contract of mandate ( umowa zlecenie ) that can easily be adjusted to your university schedule.

• Modern Toolkit: Opportunity to learn SAP and MyBuy tools within international structures.

• Exposure to Innovation: The chance to co-create solutions based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in procurement.

• Expert Development: Working within a team of "team players" who focus on knowledge sharing and substantive support.

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche first-hand? Check out our blog!
https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche

Contact the Data Protection Officer at: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Specjalista / Specjalistka ds. Serwisu Technicznego (Service Engineer)

W Roche Diagnostics skupiamy się na wprowadzaniu innowacyjnych rozwiązań w obszarze medycyny laboratoryjnej. W Polsce działamy od kilkudziesięciu lat i należymy do wiodących pracodawców na światowym rynku diagnostycznym. Opracowujemy i wdrażamy rozwiązania diagnostyczne, które odpowiadają dzisiejszym wyzwaniom i są przygotowane na przyszłe potrzeby.

Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Specjalisty lub Specjalistki ds. Serwisu Technicznego z województwa kujawsko-pomorskiego:

Zadania:

• Instalacje i wdrażanie aparatury laboratoryjnej

• Naprawy gwarancyjne i pogwarancyjne sprzętu

• Szkolenia klientów z obsługi aparatury i systemów laboratoryjnych

• Pomoc techniczna dla klientów

• Raportowanie wyników pracy

O Tobie:

• Mieszkasz na terenie województwa kujawsko-pomorskiego

• Posiadasz wyższe wykształcenie techniczne (preferowane: mechanika precyzyjna, elektronika lub pokrewne specjalności)

• Z łatwością potrafisz zrozumieć potrzeby Klienta i efektywnie się komunikować

• Posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B

• Dobrze znasz język angielski (min. B2)

• Umiesz priorytetyzować zadania i pracować pod presją czasu

• Doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku będzie dodatkowym atutem

Oferujemy:

• Zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę tymczasową

• Atrakcyjny pakiet benefitów

• Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze w międzynarodowym środowisku

• Możliwość rozwoju zawodowego

• Stanowisko z możliwością wdrażania własnych inicjatyw

• Program szkoleniowy i wdrożeniowy

Brzmi interesująco? Nie czekaj - aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Poland. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests condu

jobs.title: 治疗领域专员_ GI
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.en: 区域经理 - 市场准入- 辽宁区域
titleByLocale.de: 区域经理 - 市场准入- 辽宁区域
titleByLocale.fr: 区域经理 - 市场准入- 辽宁区域

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position)（职位的首要职能）

• 建立并维系 与区域政府决策部门及核心智囊机构的战略合作关系； 制定并落地 区域市场准入策略，推动产品 加速纳入 多层次医疗保障体系并实现报销覆盖最大化； 深度协同 区域业务团队，确保持续、顺畅的医保落地与报销执行。 Establish and cultivate strategic partnerships with regional government authorities and key think tanks. Formulate and execute regional market access strategies to accelerate product inclusion into multi-level reimbursement schemes and maximize coverage. Collaborate closely with the Regional Business Team to ensure seamless reimbursement implementation.

• 确保区域准入策略与产品核心策略的深度协同 ；基于全生命周期管理要求及新政策环境，制定并落地区域市场准入计划。通过 优化医保报销政策 、 前瞻性化解准入风险与壁垒 ，持续最大化患者的用药可及性。 Ensure strategic alignment between regional market access initiatives and core product strategies. Formulate and execute regional access plans grounded in lifecycle management and the evolving policy landscape. Optimize reimbursement policies , proactively mitigate risks and barriers , and maximize patient accessibility.

• 确保中央准入策略在团队内的协同与高效执行 ；建立并维护区域内医疗及卫生技术（HTA）领域的关键利益相关者关系； 全方位支持 从中央到省级及区域层面的市场准入工作。 Ensure alignment and execution of central market access strategies within the team. Manage key stakeholders in the medical and health technology (HTA) sectors. Provide comprehensive support for market access initiatives at national, provincial, and regional levels.

• 构建并运营 区域市场准入平台，确立与政府部门的 长期战略合作 机制，统筹相关项目的落地实施。 深度研判 区域医药政策趋势，为业务决策提供智力支持，并 赋能 区域业务团队，确保政策信息的精准传达与应用。 Establish and operate regional market access platforms , ensuring the effective execution of collaborative projects. Cultivate long-term strategic partnerships with government authorities. Analyze and interpret key regional healthcare policies to support business decision-making, while empowering local commercial teams with actionable policy intelligence.

• 构建区域跨职能协作与资源整合平台 ，统筹各部门资源以最大化利用效率； 强化 部门间协调机制，确保公司级项目中的深度协同，共同 驱动 区域业务目标的达成。 Establish a cross-functional collaboration and resource integration platform within the region. Orchestrate inter-departmental coordination to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring seamless synergy on corporate projects to drive the achievement of business objectives.

Q ualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications教育程度 / 所获资格证书 : 本科及以上, 医学、药学、药经或相关领域优先考虑
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and policy affairs. 至少 2 年医药行业及政策事务相关工作经验。

• Specialization: Possess at least 4 years (please verify) of experience in reimbursement account management. 具备至少 2 年政府客户管理经验。

• Project Management: Proven track record in project management and execution. 具备出色的项目管理与落地执行能力。

• Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication and networking skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong professional relationships. 卓越的人际沟通与影响力，善于建立并维护稳固的业务关系网。

• Personal Attributes: Proactive, passionate, and highly self-motivated. 工作积极主动，富有激情，具备高度的自我驱动力。

• Teamwork: Strong sense of accountability, dedication, and a collaborative team spirit. 强烈的责任心与敬业精神，优秀的团队协作意识。

• Language: Proficiency in written and spoken English. 优秀的英语听说读写能力（可作为工作语言）。

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in data analysis and presentation (PowerPoint/Excel). 精通 PPT 制作及数据分析技能。

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
目标与计划管理
1.基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性
2.分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

客户管理与区域合作
1.率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动
2.同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益
3.和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

团队管理
1.参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划
2.吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展
3.打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

财务和合规管理
1.分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标
2.确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

工作经验
• 7 年以上销售，市场，医学或准入工作经验
• 跨地区/跨部门/跨疾病领域的工作经验优先
• 团队管理经验

教育程度/所获资格证书
• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about people, communication, and making a real difference in a global organization? If you excel at coaching, building relationships, and solving complex problems, we want you! Join our People Support Solutions team as a Talent Acquisition Partner and leverage your expertise in human interaction to launch a career in global talent acquisition.

The Opportunity:

• Launch your career in Talent Acquisition by learning to manage the full recruiting lifecycle within a supportive global team.

• Act as a key communication partner for hiring managers and senior leaders, applying your coaching and interpersonal skills to guide them through the hiring process.

• Learn to conduct in-depth candidate assessments , focusing on evaluating core competencies and fit.

• Manage and optimize the candidate experience , ensuring clear, consistent communication from application to offer.

• Utilize advanced HR technology (Workday) to streamline recruiting activities and support crucial data management.

• Collaborate closely on internal talent management efforts, including succession planning and internal mobility, applying a strategic lens to organizational needs.

• Contribute to process innovation , helping us challenge the status quo and continuously improve our talent search strategies.

Who You Are:

• Advanced language skills in German and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory.

• 2-3 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science or equivalent work experience is required

• You possess a strong customer-centric, growth, and agile mindset , thriving in ambiguous and multicultural environments.

• You demonstrate proven stakeholder management and influencing skills , with the ability to manage expectations and build trust with diverse partners.

• You are capable of working independently , effectively managing multiple, competing priorities, and driving toward results with a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mil

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung
Als Pharmazeut/in im Praktikum hast Du im Rahmen des 6-monatigen Praktikantenprogramms für angehende Apotheker die Möglichkeit, einen spannenden Einblick in die pharmazeutische Industrie zu erhalten. Hierbei lernst Du die Arbeit eines Apothekers in der pharmazeutischen Industrie umfassend kennen. Außerdem wird Dir während des gesamten Praktikums ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite stehen.
Wir sind das Team der Quality Compliance in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing in Mannheim und treiben mit viel Engagement und Leidenschaft alle Quality Compliance Themen (u.a. Lokale Quality Management System Implementierungen und Inspektionen) voran. Wir sind aktuell 8 Quality Compliance Manager und 1 Quality Compliance Lead und möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) einen Einblick in die lokale Umsetzung des Quality Management Systems (QMS) und das „Daily business“ eines Inspection Managements geben.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du unterstützt den German Translation Coordinator bei der Umsetzung von globalen QMS Änderungen in die deutsch sprachigen Versionen

• Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Behörden Inspektionen und Kunden Audits

• Du bist in die Routine Arbeit des Quality Compliance Teams involviert und lernst dabei typische Aufgabengebiete eines Apothekers (gemäß AMG und AMWHV) kennen

Dein Profil

• Du hast den zweiten Abschnitt der Pharmazeutischen Prüfung (zweites Staatsexamen) erfolgreich abgelegt und kannst gute Studienleistungen vorweisen

• Entsprechend der Approbationsordnung für Apotheker möchtest Du nun die Hälfte Deines praktischen Jahrs dazu nutzen, die pharmazeutische Industrie im Bereich Qualitäts Sicherung und Compliance näher kennenzulernen

• Idealerweise hast Du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Industrie gesammelt

• Durch Deine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise begeisterst Du ebenso wie durch Dein analytisches Denken

• Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, freust Dich auf die Arbeit im Team und bringst Engagement und Eigeninitiative mit

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (37,5 Stundenwoche)

• 2.268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Vernetzung mit anderen Praktikanten

Deine Bewerbung
Für eine vollständige Bewerbung bitten wir Dich, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf und ein für die Stelle passendes Anschreiben hochzuladen .

Zeitraum : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportu

titleByLocale.it: Global Business Process Specialista - Travel & Expense (1 Year Fixed-Term)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Travel & Expense GBPS , you will be part of the Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Business Process Management (BPM) organization. In this role you will actively contribute to the implementation of the end-to-end BPM strategy for corporate Travel & Expense (T&E) management. You are responsible for the global, cross divisional, state-of-the-art process design and you work in close collaboration with stakeholders from Finance, Procurement & IT, to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions.

Please note that this is a 1 year fixed-term role with a possibility to extend for another year.

The Opportunity

Your main responsibilities include:

• Actively contribute to the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, according to guardrails set by the E2E Global Business Process Owner (GBPO) and Global Business Process Managers (GBPMs)

• Deliver lean cross-divisional processes & solutions, with maximum standardization and harmonization

• Ensure documentation of process requirements, implementation through guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

• Drive efficiencies and improvements (incl. automation) across E2E business process, RSS Operations, affiliates and IT.

• Manage prioritization, justification and realization of change requests and initiatives in line with the strategic roadmap, with support of the GBPMs and other Global Business Process Specialists

• Contribute to partner projects, providing advice and guidance

• Supporting the development of agile ways of working in teams and the organization

Who you are

A successful candidate will have a customer orientated (agile) and design thinking mindset. Completed degree in Business, Finance or related field and a minimum 2-3 years of professional experience in Finance, Procurement or IT.
You demonstrated your ability of working in cross-functional projects (preferably transformation of nature) and cross-functional teams.

For this position, you bring the following qualifications:

• Solid background in Finance or Procurement with proven Business Process Management skills.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, leading to effective decision-making.

• Strong influencing and communication skills (written and verbal in English is essential) for working with international teams and complex stakeholder networks.

• Familiarity with upstream Finance & Procurement processes and systems is a plus.

• Good understanding of End-to-End (E2E) travel & expense processes and systems, along with technical expertise in SAP ERP & Concur.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating

jobs.title: Systemverantwortliche/-r Infrastruktur
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation. Klassische Vorgesetzte suchst du bei uns vergebens.

Der Circle “Energieversorgung” stellt den zuverlässigen, behördenkonformen und kostenbewussten Betrieb der Heiz-, Kühl- und Prozessmedien, inklusive der Ver- und Entsorgung sicher.

Die Möglichkeit
Du bist verantwortlich für den Betrieb, Störungsbehebung, Instandhaltung und kontinuierliche Optimierungen (Energie, Kosten).

Als Systemverantwortliche/-r Infrastruktur umfasst Dein Aufgabengebiet die folgenden Tätigkeiten:

• Betreiben von Energieverbundsystemen, industriellen Kälteanlagen/ Wärmepumpen und der Wasserversorgunganlagen (zB. Grundwasserbrunnen, Rheinwasserfassung)

• Instandhaltungs- und Störungsbehebung inkl. Pikettdienst

• kontinuierliche Optimierungen

• Betreuung und Koordination von Fremdfirmen

• Durchführung von Kontrollgängen und Datenerfassung

• Logbücher führen SAP

• Analyse und Interpretation von Energieverbräuchen sowie Ableitung von Optimierungsmassnahmen

• Mitarbeit in Projekten

Des Weiteren bist Du verantwortlich für die Gestaltung Deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, das aktive Einbringen und die Mitarbeit im Interesse des OneRoche Gedanken und für die a ktive Mitarbeit im selbstorganisierenden Teams.

Wer Du bist
Du schätzt es, in einer leistungsorientierten und agilen Umgebung zu arbeiten, die von gegenseitigem Respekt, Diskussion und Zusammenarbeit getragen wird. Dann ist Roche für Dich der Ausgangspunkt für ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungschancen. Du bist eine positiv denkende, integere und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten.

Als erfolgreicher Systemverantwortliche/-r Infrastruktur bringst Du Folgendes mit:

• eine abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z.B. Kältesystem-Monteur EFZ oder vergleichbar) und idealerweise eine Weiterbildung als Instandhaltungsfachmann oder einer Höheren Fachschule HF.

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Betrieb und der Instandhaltung von NH3 Kälteanlagen, Grundwasseranlagen und Energiesystemen ist von Vorteil

• Praktische Erfahrung in einem GMP-Umfeld sowie p raktische Erfahrung in der Energieversorgung ist von Vorteil.

• In der Bedienung von Prozessleitsystemen der genannten Systeme bist Du geübt.

• Gute IT-Kenntnisse (SAP, Google Workspace, MS365)

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

Darüber hinaus bist du ein guter Teamplayer und hast eine selbständige und selbstorganisierte Arbeitsweise. Du bringst das Verständnis und gute Orientierungsfähigkeit innerhalb einer Matrix-Organisation mit.

Setze dein Know-how ein und gestalte den Bereich 'Energieversorgung' am Standort Basel mit. Bewirb dich jetzt !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicate

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) ​, we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units to become more data-driven, more digitally adept and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence , the Computational Biology department focuses on furthering our understanding of disease, patient populations, and target biology by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across pRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated computational scientist to join our Research Oncology sub-unit of Computational Biology. You will be a member of a team of world-leading computational scientists with the express aim of developing a competitive advantage for pRED through the application of computational biology in the Oncology space. You will also be part of the wider Computational Biology and Medicine unit within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence drawing on the shared experience and expertise of colleagues globally.
To ensure successful delivery for the portfolio, you collaborate with other subunits in Computation Biology and/or Computational Medicine where needed. Our collective success in the Oncology sub-unit and our contribution to pRED/Pharma goals will be the measure of your impact.
In this role, you will:

• Drive and execute the data and analytics strategy for your area, working closely with stakeholders to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.

• Generate clear, high-value insights from complex data to support decision-making and help advance projects toward meaningful patient impact.

• Act as a trusted partner to scientists and cross-functional teams, collaborating to shape priorities and deliver on shared goals.

• Contribute to a collaborative and inclusive team environment by sharing expertise, supporting peers, and actively engaging in a feedback-rich culture.

• Contribute to continuously improving how we work, helping to strengthen Computational Biology as a key driver of innovation and impact within pRED

Who you are

• You hold a PhD in Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field, with a strong foundation in data-driven problem solving, statistical modeling, and machine learning.

• You bring a solid understanding of cancer biology and are motivated to apply data science to drive impact in drug discovery and decision-making.

• You have strong expertise in AI/ML and modern AI-driven workflows, ideally including hands-on experience with LLMs, AI-assisted coding, or agentic workflows applied to biological problems.

• You are proficient in R and/or Python and comfortable working in Linux/Unix environments, including processing data on HPC/cloud platforms.

• You have experience working with large-scale biological datasets (e.g., genomics, transcriptomics, spatial omics/imaging), ideally including cancer cell depen

A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza è un’organizzazione globale che consente alle unità di Ricerca e Sviluppo Anticipato di Roche di diventare più basate sui dati, più digitalmente adattate e meglio preparate per le sfide del futuro. All'interno del Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza, il dipartimento di Biologia Computazionale si concentra sull'ulteriore comprensione delle malattie, delle popolazioni dei pazienti e della biologia di destinazione, avendo accesso ai più grandi dataset Pharma R&D al mondo. In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso pRED, creiamo migliori farmaci aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura basata sui dati. L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato computazionale altamente motivato per unire la nostra sotto-unità di ricerca oncologia della biologia computazionale. Sarete membri di un team di scienziati computazionali leader nel mondo con l'obiettivo preciso di sviluppare un vantaggio competitivo per la pRED attraverso l'applicazione della biologia computazionale nello spazio Oncology. Sarete anche parte della più ampia unità Computational Biology and Medicine all'interno del Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza che traccia l'esperienza condivisa e le competenze dei colleghi a livello globale. Per garantire la consegna di successo per il portafoglio, si collabora con altri subunità in Biologia di Computazione e/o Medicina Computazionale dove necessario. Il nostro successo collettivo nella sottounità Oncology e il nostro contributo agli obiettivi pRED/Pharma saranno la misura del vostro impatto. In questo ruolo, voi:
• Guidare ed eseguire la strategia di dati e analisi per la tua area, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder per concentrarsi sulle opportunità di impatto più alto.
• Generare intuizioni chiare e di alto valore da dati complessi per supportare il processo decisionale e contribuire ad avanzare progetti verso un impatto significativo del paziente.
• Agire come partner affidabile per gli scienziati e le squadre interfunzionali, collaborare per modellare le priorità e fornire obiettivi condivisi.
• Contribuire a un ambiente di team collaborativo e inclusivo condividendo competenze, supportando i coetanei e impegnandosi attivamente in una cultura ricca di feedback.
• Contribuire a migliorare continuamente come lavoriamo, contribuendo a rafforzare la Biologia Computazionale come un driver chiave dell'innovazione e dell'impatto all'interno di pRED Chi sei
• Ha un PhD in Bioinformatica, Biostatistica, o un campo quantitativo correlato, con una solida base nella risoluzione dei problemi data-driven, modellazione statistica e machine learning.
• Si porta una solida comprensione della biologia del cancro e sono motivati ad applicare la scienza dei dati per guidare l'impatto nella scoperta della droga e nel processo decisionale.
• Hai una forte esperienza nei flussi di lavoro AI/ML e AI-driven moderni, tra cui l'esperienza hands-on con LLM, codifica assistita da AI, o flussi di lavoro agentici applicati a problemi biologici.
• Sei esperto in R e/o Python e di lavorare in ambienti Linux/Unix, inclusi i dati di elaborazione sulle piattaforme HPC/cloud.
• Hai esperienza di lavoro con set di dati biologici su larga scala (ad esempio, genomica, transcriptomics, omics spaziale/imaging), idealmente compreso depen cellulare tumorale

• Erzeugen Sie klare, hochwertige Erkenntnisse aus komplexen Daten, um die Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen und Projekte in Richtung sinnvoller Patientenwirkung zu fördern.
• Aktivieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Partner Wissenschaftlern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um Prioritäten zu formen und gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen.
• Beitrag zu einer kollaborativen und integrativen Teamumgebung durch Erfahrungsaustausch, Unterstützung von Peers und aktives Engagement in einer rückgekoppelten Kultur.
• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Funktionsweise und zur Stärkung der Computational Biology als Schlüsseltreiber von Innovation und Wirkung innerhalb von pRED Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Doktortitel in Bioinformatik, Biostatistik oder ein damit verbundenes quantitatives Feld, mit einer starken Grundlage in datengesteuerter Problemlösung, statistischer Modellierung und maschinellem Lernen.
• Sie bringen ein solides Verständnis der Krebsbiologie und sind motiviert, die Datenwissenschaft anzuwenden, um Auswirkungen in der Drogenentdeckung und Entscheidungsfindung zu treiben.
• Sie verfügen über ein starkes Know-how in KI/ML und modernen KI-getriebenen Workflows, idealerweise inklusive Hand-on-Erfahrung mit LLMs, AI-assisted Codierung oder agierenden Workflows, die auf biologische Probleme angewendet werden.
• Sie sind in R und/oder Python kompetent und komfortabel in Linux/Unix-Umgebungen, einschließlich der Verarbeitung von Daten auf HPC/Cloud-Plattformen.
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit umfangreichen biologischen Datensätzen (z.B. Genomik, Transkriptomik, räumliche Omics/Imaging), ideal einschließlich Krebszellendepen

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED ) Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles est une organisation mondiale qui permet aux unités de recherche et de développement précoce de Roches de devenir plus axées sur les données, plus performantes sur le plan numérique et mieux préparées aux défis de l'avenir. Au sein du Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles , le département de biologie computationnelle s'efforce de mieux comprendre les maladies, les populations de patients et la biologie cible en ayant accès aux plus grands ensembles de données de R-D pharmaceutique au monde. En partenariat avec nos scientifiques, nous créons de meilleurs médicaments en augmentant chaque partie de la R-D grâce à notre culture axée sur les données. L'opportunité Nous cherchons un scientifique computationnel très motivé pour rejoindre notre sous-unité de recherche en biologie computationnelle. Vous serez membre d'une équipe de scientifiques informatiques de premier plan dans le but exprès de développer un avantage concurrentiel pour pRED par l'application de la biologie computationnelle dans l'espace Oncologie. Vous ferez également partie de l'unité de biologie et de médecine computationnelles au sein du Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles, en s'appuyant sur l'expérience et l'expertise partagées de collègues à l'échelle mondiale. Pour assurer une prestation réussie pour le portefeuille, vous collaborez avec d'autres sous-unités en biologie de calcul et/ou en médecine computationnelle au besoin. Notre succès collectif dans la sous-unité Oncologie et notre contribution aux objectifs pRED/Pharma seront la mesure de votre impact. Dans ce rôle, vous :

• Générer des informations claires et de grande valeur à partir de données complexes pour appuyer la prise de décision et aider à faire avancer les projets vers un impact significatif sur le patient.
• Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance des scientifiques et des équipes interfonctionnelles, en collaborant à l'élaboration des priorités et à la réalisation d'objectifs communs.
• Contribuer à un environnement d'équipe collaboratif et inclusif en partageant l'expertise, en appuyant les pairs et en s'engageant activement dans une culture riche en commentaires.
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre fonctionnement, en aidant à renforcer la biologie computationnelle en tant que moteur clé de l'innovation et de l'impact au sein de pRED Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en bioinformatique, en biostatistique ou dans un domaine quantitatif connexe, avec une base solide pour la résolution de problèmes, la modélisation statistique et l'apprentissage automatique.
• Vous apportez une compréhension solide de la biologie du cancer et êtes motivé à appliquer la science des données pour stimuler l'impact dans la découverte de médicaments et la prise de décisions.
• Vous disposez d'une solide expertise en AI/ML et de workflows modernes, incluant idéalement une expérience pratique avec les LLM, le codage assisté par AI ou les workflows agents appliqués à des problèmes biologiques.
• Vous êtes compétent en R et / ou Python et confortable de travailler dans les environnements Linux/Unix, y compris le traitement des données sur les plateformes HPC/cloud.
• Vous avez l'expérience de travailler avec des ensembles de données biologiques à grande échelle (p. ex. génomique, transcriptomique, omique spatiale/imagerie), y compris idéalement le depen de cellules cancéreuses

jobs.title: Senior Intelligence Manager (Measurement)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Group Communications (GC) is responsible for creating a lasting positive image of Roche and representing the company's voice on a Group level. We communicate Roche’s strategy and how we deliver on our purpose of “Doing now what patients need next” to Roche colleagues and external audiences. We drive integrated and global campaigns and provide platforms for communications business partners as well as our affiliates to engage with audiences. We contribute to building trust of key stakeholders, managing Roche’s brand and reputation, and building a favorable environment for our business. We aspire to be innovative, forward-looking, creative, and courageous, representing a strong, integrated corporate brand and audience experience where people can thrive, learn new skills, and create great things together.

The Role
The Senior Intelligence Manager (Measurement) is responsible for defining, enabling, and scaling how Roche measures the impact of its digital communications across internal and external audiences. This role goes beyond performance tracking, focusing on building and enhancing the foundations that make measurement effective, consistent, and scalable while shaping how data is collected, structured, and activated across the organization. You will work across measurement frameworks, data architecture, and emerging discovery ecosystems to ensure Roche not only understands performance but is equipped to continuously improve it.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Intelligence Manager, you will have the chance to shape the future of our digital impact and data architecture.

• Measure and Report Performance: Track Roche’s paid and organic activity across global channels, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and narratives that inform business strategies.

• Define Measurement Frameworks: Evolve frameworks for both holistic and campaign-specific KPIs to enable benchmarking, optimisation, and long-term organisational learning.

• Design Data Ecosystems: Partner with IT and data engineering to design scalable data pipelines, ensuring automated ingestion and integration of data into centralised environments like data lakes.

• Establish Data Standards: Set best practices for data layers and tracking frameworks to ensure consistent, accurate data collection across all platforms, channels, and markets.

• Drive Research and Insights: Derive insights from social and audience data using analytics, listening, and custom research to build a single source of truth for communications performance.

• Innovate with Emerging Tech: Explore measurement approaches for Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) to improve Roche’s visibility within AI-driven search and discovery environments.

• Enable Global Collaboration: Partner with Internal Communications to align standards and coach colleagues, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making and technical excellence.

Who You Are
We are looking for a strategic thinker who blends technical expertise with the ability to influence and collaborate across a global organisation.

• Experienced Expert: You possess a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in social media intelligence or digital analysis.

• Technical Proficient: You are adept at using tools such as Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Google Analytics, Snowflake, and Power BI, with preferred experience in Tableau, Data Studio, or Python.

• Analytical Strategist: You have proven abilities in measurement, critical thinking, and deci

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Group Communications (GC) è responsabile della creazione di un'immagine positiva duratura di Roche e della rappresentazione della voce dell'azienda a livello di Gruppo. Comunichiamo la strategia di Roche e come distribuiamo sul nostro scopo di “fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno accanto” ai colleghi Roche e al pubblico esterno. Noi guidiamo campagne integrate e globali e forniamo piattaforme per i partner commerciali di comunicazione e le nostre affiliate per coinvolgere il pubblico. Contribuiamo a costruire la fiducia dei principali stakeholder, la gestione del marchio e della reputazione di Roche, e la costruzione di un ambiente favorevole per il nostro business. Noi aspiriamo ad essere innovativi, all'avanguardia, creativi e coraggiosi, rappresentando un'esperienza consolidata e integrata del brand aziendale e del pubblico in cui le persone possono prosperare, imparare nuove competenze e creare grandi cose insieme. Il ruolo Il Senior Intelligence Manager (Measurement) è responsabile di definire, abilitare e scalare come Roche misura l'impatto delle sue comunicazioni digitali attraverso il pubblico interno ed esterno. Questo ruolo va oltre il monitoraggio delle prestazioni, concentrandosi sulla costruzione e migliorare le basi che rendono la misurazione efficace, coerente e scalabile durante la modellazione come i dati vengono raccolti, strutturati e attivati in tutta l'organizzazione. Potrai lavorare attraverso i framework di misura, l'architettura dei dati e gli ecosistemi di scoperta emergenti per garantire che Roche non solo comprenda le prestazioni, ma è attrezzato per migliorare continuamente. L'opportunità Come Senior Intelligence Manager, avrai la possibilità di plasmare il futuro del nostro impatto digitale e dell'architettura dei dati.
• Misura e report Performance: Traccia l’attività pagata e organica di Roche nei canali globali, traducendo i dati complessi in chiare e attuabili intuizioni e narrazioni che informano le strategie aziendali.
• Definire i framework di misura: Evolve framework per KPI olistici e specifici per le campagne per consentire il benchmarking, l'ottimizzazione e l'apprendimento organizzativo a lungo termine.
• Design Data Ecosystems: Partner dell'IT e dell'ingegneria dei dati per la progettazione di datadotti scalabili, garantendo l'ingestione automatizzata e l'integrazione dei dati in ambienti centralizzati come data lake.
• Stabilire gli standard di dati: impostare le migliori pratiche per gli strati di dati e i framework di monitoraggio per garantire una raccolta coerente e accurata dei dati su tutte le piattaforme, canali e mercati.
• Drive Research and Insights: approfondimenti di dati sociali e di pubblico utilizzando analisi, ascolto e ricerca personalizzata per costruire un'unica fonte di verità per le prestazioni delle comunicazioni.
• Innovare con Emerging Tech: Esplora gli approcci di misura per l'ottimizzazione del motore Generativo (GEO) per migliorare la visibilità di Roche all'interno di ambienti di ricerca e scoperta basati su AI.
• Abilitare la collaborazione globale: collaborare con le comunicazioni interne per allineare gli standard e i colleghi di coach, promuovere una cultura del processo decisionale e dell'eccellenza tecnica basata sui dati. Chi sei Stiamo cercando un pensatore strategico che fonde competenze tecniche con la capacità di influenzare e collaborare in un'organizzazione globale.
• Esperto esperto: possiedi un diploma di laurea o equivalente e un minimo di 7 anni di esperienza rilevante nell'intelligenza dei social media o nell'analisi digitale.
• Technical Proficient: Lei è abile nell'utilizzo di strumenti come Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Google Analytics, Snowflake e Power BI, con esperienza preferita in Tableau, Data Studio o Python.
• Strategista analitico: hai comprovate capacità di misura, pensiero critico e deci

• Define Measurement Frameworks: Entwickeln Sie Frameworks für ganzheitliche und kampagnenspezifische KPIs, um Benchmarking, Optimierung und langfristiges organisatorisches Lernen zu ermöglichen.

ASPIRE is a Roche-wide, enterprise business transformation program that aims at harmonizing, simplifying and automating business processes to enable us to focus our efforts even more on doing now what patients need next.
Scaled Agile Framework® (SAFe®) was adopted for ASPIRE to design and execute incremental builds with fast, integrated learning cycles, by applying the same cadence with cross-functional planning and decentralizing decision making, enabling us to further accelerate agility.

Disclosure Note: The role is open on a fixed-term basis until 31/12/2029.

The Opportunity

• Manage the product roadmap, prioritize the team backlog in alignment with the ART Backlog, and determine Agile team capacity allocation.

• Prioritize issue resolution, coordinate User Stories, and ensure approval against Definition of Done, also responsible for user story definition and acceptance criteria.

• Participate in exploration activities to further learn customer needs, ensure features meet Definition of Ready, and deliver input to program execution and incremental planning.

• Engage and collaborate with Product Management, Business SMEs, Data owners, and operational teams to align on E2E data governance processes and collaboratively reduce master data defects.

• Work to ensure training, consistency, and accuracy of master data across systems.

• Demonstrate expertise in SAP-MDG systems, Business partners data, workflow processes, and business improvements experience driven by in-depth business partners business process knowledge.

• Support vision and strategy for Master Data Governance, deployments, testing, creation of master data for other teams, and foster relationships to achieve project goals and objectives.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development.

• Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, with over 5 years of master data management experience in the Business Partners Data domain.

• Over 3 years of experience with Enterprise Applications, such as SAP-MDG, and a deep understanding of governance impacts on both business process management and IT.

• Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, and other business partners -specific data privacy regulations, alongside robust interpersonal, communication, and networking skills.

• Proven track record of delivering in a matrixed organization across geographies and divisions, with a strong focus on quality, attention to detail, and the ability to make decisions in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

• Agile mindset and experience working with Agile Organizations, outstanding customer service, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a background in consulting or business management services as a strong plus.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Ca

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Foodlicious ist unser Tagesgeschäft
Aus der Taverne Roche ist in über 30 Jahren ein erfolgreiches Gastronomieunternehmen im Bereich der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie entstanden. Die Tavero AG ist eine 100% Tochtergesellschaft der F. Hoffmann-La Roche. An den Standorten Basel und Kaiseraugst beschäftigen wir rund 350 Mitarbeitende aus über 41 Nationen.
Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl Staff Restaurants, die vielfältigen Genuss bieten, als auch Fine Dining Restaurants mit gehobener Küche und exzellentem Service. Darüber hinaus gibt es Restaurants mit Köstlichkeiten aus aller Welt, Kaffee in allen Varianten, gezaubert von unseren Baristi, sowie die höchstgelegenen Lounges der Schweiz – traumhafte Afterwork-Spots über den Dächern der Stadt. Grab'n'Go-Angebote von Sushi bis Burger und der erste und einzige Club in der Geschichte von Roche ergänzen unser Angebot.
Zusätzlich bieten wir unseren Gästen Sitzungszimmer- und Eventcatering für bis zu 1.500 Personen an. Die öffentlichen Gastronomien, das Schöpfli im Park und das Chez Jeannot im Museum Tinguely, runden unser Angebot ab.

Wir suchen per sofort eine:n Chef de Partie, Tournant für die Tavero AG in Basel.

Deine Aufgaben

• Abwechselnder Arbeitseinsatz auf allen Posten in den Betrieben Gäste- und Direktionsrestaurant Panorama, Lounge 47, Pebbels Lounge, Schöpfli und Science Club

• Termingerechte Bereitstellung und Produktion aller Angebotskomponenten

• Zubereitung nach Rezeptur, inkl. Degustation und kontinuierlichem Verbesserungsprozess

• Ideenreichtum und Kreativität sind deine Antreiber

• Du bringst die Liebe zum Beruf auf den Teller

• Selbstständiges Führen eines Postens

• Erstellen der benötigten Mise en Place und verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Ablauf auf deinem Posten

• Einhalten von Hygienebestimmungen (TQM / HACCP)

• Wirtschaftlicher und korrekter Umgang mit Lebensmittel bei der Lagerung und/sowie bei deren Verarbeitung

• Sichere Warenbewirtschaftung sowie interne und externe Bestellungen tätigen

• Arbeitszeiten in der Regel zwischen 6.00 und 22.00 Uhr, mit Ausnahmen auch Abendeinsätze möglich

Dein Profil

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Kochausbildung (EFZ) und verfügst über mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (exkl. Ausbildungsjahre) in der gehobenen Gastronomie

• Du hast einschlägige Erfahrungen in allen Küchenbereichen

• Du entwickelst gerne neue Rezepte und bist kreativ in der Angebotsplanung

• Du bist ein Organisationstalent und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Du besitzt ein Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Du hast Kenntnisse der Schweizer Lebensmittelgesetzgebung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healt

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Foodlicious è la nostra attività quotidiana In oltre 30 anni, Taverne Roche ha sviluppato un'azienda gastronomica di successo. Tavero AG è una controllata al 100% di F. Hoffmann-La Roche. Nei siti di Basilea e Kaiseraugst utilizziamo circa 350 dipendenti provenienti da oltre 41 nazioni. La nostra offerta comprende sia i ristoranti del personale che offrono una varietà di piaceri, così come i ristoranti di Fine Dining con cucina raffinata e un servizio eccellente. Inoltre, ci sono ristoranti con prelibatezze da tutto il mondo, caffè in tutte le varianti, incantati dai nostri baristi, così come i saloni più alti in Svizzera – posti di lavoro fantastici sui tetti della città. Grab'n'Go offre da sushi a Burger e il primo e unico club nella storia di Roche completano la nostra offerta. Inoltre, offriamo ai nostri ospiti sala riunioni e catering per eventi fino a 1.500 persone. La gastronomia pubblica, lo Schöpfli nel parco e il Chez Jeannot nel Museo Tinguely completano la nostra offerta. Stiamo cercando un:n Chef de Partie, Tournant per Tavero AG a Basilea. I tuoi compiti
• Cambio di lavoro su tutti gli articoli nelle aziende Ristorante Guest and directors Panorama, Lounge 47, Pebbels Lounge, Schöpfli e Science Club
• Fornitura e produzione di tutti i componenti di fornitura
• Preparazione secondo la ricetta, tra cui degustazione e processo di miglioramento continuo
• Idee ricche e creatività sono i vostri piloti
• Portate l'amore a lavorare sul piatto
• Autogovernare un post
• Creare la mise necessaria in atto e responsabile della corsa liscia sul tuo post
• Manutenzione delle norme igieniche (TQM / HACCP)
• Gestione economica e corretta del cibo durante lo stoccaggio e/o la lavorazione
• Gestione sicura dei beni e ordini interni ed esterni
• Ore lavorative di solito tra 6.00 e 22.00, con eccezioni anche serate possibili Il tuo profilo
• Hai una formazione completa di cucina (EFZ) e hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale (esclusi anni di formazione)
• Hai esperienza rilevante in tutte le aree della cucina
• Ti piace sviluppare nuove ricette e sono creativi nell'offerta di pianificazione
• Sei un'istituzione organizzativa e hai un forte senso di responsabilità
• Hai una capacità di esecuzione
• Avete un modo indipendente di lavorare e di assumersi la responsabilità
• Le abilità di squadra e l'affidabilità sono autoevidenti
• Conoscete la legislazione alimentare svizzera
• Hai una buona conoscenza di tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura per essere in grado di consigliare i tuoi clienti in modo competente
• In un mondo digitale, vogliamo anche garantire una gestione sicura dei programmi informatici (MS Office) Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un guaritore
