jobs.title: Principal Test Automation Engineer ( AI - first )

titleByLocale.it: Principal Test Automation Ingegnere ( AI - first )
titleByLocale.en: Principal Test Automation Engineer ( AI - first )
titleByLocale.de: Principal Test Automation Ingenieur ( AI - first )
titleByLocale.fr: Principal Test Automation Ingénieur ( AI - first )

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are seeking a Principal Test Automation Engineer ( AI - first ) to own quality engineering strategy and automation for our greenfield Prenatal Screening product - a regulated clinical diagnostic solution for first-trimester trisomy and preeclampsia risk assessment. This is not a blank canvas: quality and traceability obligations are built into the foundation from day one. As the platform matures, there may be an opportunity to expand your scope further within the portfolio.

This is not a QA management role - it is a hands-on engineering role. As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will create automations, define and enforce the standards, establish the foundational frameworks, and embed quality into the daily engineering workflow - working with the whole team through code review, tooling and technical guidance. You will apply AI tooling and agentic testing approaches to enable sustainable quality at scale, in an environment where software quality is a patient safety requirement.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

• Design and implement a risk-based, layered testing strategy - minimizing risk by coverage through unit, integration and API tests, reserving E2E automation for critical user journeys

• Use AI tooling as a primary driver of quality - agentic test generation, AI-assisted coverage analysis, resilient and maintainable automation. Shifting the balance from manual testing effort to intelligent, scalable automation

• Shape quality engineering practices across the diagnostic solutions portfolio by defining shared standards, patterns, and tooling that raise the quality bar beyond the immediate product squad

• Define and enforce testing standards, patterns, and best practices, enabling developers to own quality as part of their everyday workflow

• Bootstrap and define Playwright automation patterns and reference implementations that the development teams adopt and extends

• Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines for fast, reliable feedback on every commit

• Support the team in meeting medical software quality obligations by contributing to traceability, auditability and compliance processes

• Evaluate and selectively adopt AI-driven testing tools applicable to regulated healthcare software

Who You Are:

The “AI-first” Mindset

Beyond technical mastery, we value quality engineers who treat AI as a core partner in their workflow:

• Agentic Testing: Enabling teams in leveraging AI agents to automate routine quality tasks, e.g. test generation, failure triage, flaky test maintenance, so engineering effort focuses on what requires human judgment.

• SDLC Optimization: Using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) to accelerate test design, coverage analysis, and quality pipeline improvements.

• Regulated Awareness: Understanding that AI-generated test artifacts in a medical software context require validation, traceability, and human oversight - and building that into the workflow from the start.

Technical skills:

• Deep understanding of testing strategy designs - test pyramid thinking, shift-left practices, test isolation strategies, test parallelism, parametrization

• Hands-on experience with highly scalable testing

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stiamo cercando un Principal Test Automation Engineer (IA - primo ) di possedere la strategia di ingegneria di qualità e l'automazione per il nostro prodotto di screening prenatale di campo verde - una soluzione diagnostica clinica regolamentata per la trisomia del primo trimestre e la valutazione del rischio preeclampsia. Questa non è una tela vuota: gli obblighi di qualità e di tracciabilità sono integrati nella fondazione dal primo giorno. Man mano che la piattaforma matura, potrebbe esserci l'opportunità di espandere ulteriormente la tua portata all'interno del portafoglio. Questo non è un ruolo di gestione QA - è un ruolo di ingegneria pratico. Come contributore individuale di livello principale, creerai automazione, defini e applica gli standard, istituirai i quadri di base, e incorpora la qualità nel flusso di lavoro di ingegneria quotidiana - lavorando con l'intero team attraverso la revisione del codice, l'utensile e la guida tecnica. Si applicheranno gli approcci di tooling AI e test agentic per consentire la qualità sostenibile in scala, in un ambiente in cui la qualità del software è un requisito di sicurezza del paziente. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità:
• Progettare e implementare una strategia di test basata sul rischio, a strati - minimizzare il rischio attraverso la copertura attraverso test di unità, integrazione e API, riservando l'automazione E2E per i viaggi di utenti critici
• Utilizzare gli strumenti AI come driver primario di qualità - generazione di test agentic, analisi di copertura assistita da AI, automazione resiliente e manutenbile. Spostare l'equilibrio dallo sforzo di test manuale all'automazione intelligente e scalabile
• Pratica di ingegneria della qualità della forma attraverso il portafoglio soluzioni diagnostiche definendo standard condivisi, modelli e strumenti che sollevano la barra di qualità al di là della squadra di prodotto immediata
• Definire e applicare standard di prova, modelli e best practice, consentendo agli sviluppatori di possedere qualità come parte del flusso di lavoro quotidiano
• Bootstrap e definire modelli di automazione Playwright e implementazioni di riferimento che i team di sviluppo adottano e si estende
• Integrare i test nelle tubazioni CI/CD per un feedback veloce e affidabile su ogni commit
• Sostenere il team nel soddisfare gli obblighi di qualità del software medico contribuendo a tracciabilità, verificabilità e processi di conformità
• Valutare e adottare selettivamente strumenti di test basati su AI applicabili al software sanitario regolamentato Chi sei? Il “AI-first” Mindset Oltre alla padronanza tecnica, apprezziamo gli ingegneri di qualità che trattano l'IA come partner principale nel loro flusso di lavoro:
• Testazione Agentica: consentire ai team di sfruttare gli agenti dell'IA di automatizzare i compiti di qualità di routine, ad esempio la generazione di test, il triage di guasto, la manutenzione di test sfacciata, quindi lo sforzo di ingegneria si concentra su ciò che richiede il giudizio umano.
• Ottimizzazione SDLC: l'utilizzo di strumenti AI (Claude Code, Cursor o equivalente) per accelerare la progettazione di test, l'analisi della copertura e i miglioramenti della pipeline di qualità.
• Consapevolezza regolamentata: Capire che gli artefatti di prova generati dall'IA in un contesto software medico richiedono la validazione, la tracciabilità e la supervisione umana - e la costruzione che nel flusso di lavoro dall'inizio. Competenze tecniche:
• Profonda comprensione dei progetti di strategia di test - testare il pensiero piramidale, pratiche a turni, strategie di isolamento di prova, parallelismo di prova, parametrizzazione
• Esperienza pratica con test altamente scalabili

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
规范诊疗
•基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域相关科学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案。
•基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识。
•运用专业知识，向病理科医生传递诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升。

学科建设
•拜访临床及病理医生，维护客户关系，按时按质的完成相关客户洞见，尤其重点专家对于疾病领域洞见的收集并进行总结/分析/反馈。
•组织/协调/整合各类疾病领域学术会议，推动建立疾病领域治疗规范。
•与PI和Sub-PI合作，使符合入组标准的患者及时入组。

团队协作
•主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 多产品资源整合能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度 /所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Within the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE), the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization drives the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems. We integrate digital technologies across Research and Early Development to power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making for scientists to ultimately result in outcomes for patients worldwide.

As an engineer for the Automation Core team within the Engineering - Lab Automation team, you will be a key contributor to the architecture and delivery of core automation control and data frameworks in the research labs. You will empower our scientists with reliable, interconnected systems, taking ownership of significant features to ensure the development of scalable and reliable integration solutions.

The Opportunity

To excel in this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering and laboratory research in drug discovery through the following responsibilities:

• Build the Framework: Design and deploy robust and complex, cross-vendor frameworks for integrating with automated systems and workcells in labs.

• Partner with Scientists: Collaborate directly with end-users and product managers to rapidly iterate and translate complex needs into technical solutions.

• Span the Stack: Apply best practices in distributed systems and data engineering, contributing across the technology stack wherever needed.

• Senior Scope: Act as a key contributor by owning significant components of the framework and providing technical guidance to the team

• Principal Scope: Drive the technical roadmap for the core automation control and data frameworks, ensuring alignment with the strategic needs of our drug discovery organizations.

Who You Are

You are a driven engineer who thrives at the intersection of software design and scientific innovation, meeting the following minimum criteria:

• Background: You hold at least a B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 4+ years of experience as a backend, data or product engineer.

• Core Stack: Strong passion for software engineering with expert-level proficiency in Python and/or Java, with deep expertise in cloud-native architectures (ideally AWS) and distributed systems.

• Innovative Mindset : You are passionate about continuous engagement with end-users and have an interest in modern trends, such as AI-assisted coding and front-end development with TypeScript/JavaScript.

• Leadership & Communication : You are a skilled communicator capable of building trusted partnerships with scientists and defining high-level technical architecture for complex work.

• Principal Experience: 7+ years of progressive software architecture experience specifically within the Biotech/Pharma industry.

• Principal Domain Expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of lab workflows, integrated workcells, and automation control systems (e.g., liquid handlers, robotic arms) is essential.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Au sein du Centre d'excellence en sciences informatiques (CoE), l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduit à la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données. Nous intégrons les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour alimenter la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions pour que les scientifiques puissent finalement obtenir des résultats pour les patients du monde entier. En tant qu'ingénieur pour l'équipe Automation Core au sein de l'équipe Engineering - Lab Automation, vous serez un contributeur clé à l'architecture et à la livraison du contrôle d'automatisation de base et des cadres de données dans les laboratoires de recherche. Vous autonomiserez nos scientifiques avec des systèmes fiables et interconnectés, en prenant en charge des fonctionnalités importantes pour assurer le développement de solutions d'intégration évolutives et fiables. L'opportunité Pour exceller dans ce rôle, vous comblerez l'écart entre le génie logiciel complexe et la recherche en laboratoire en matière de découverte de médicaments grâce aux responsabilités suivantes :
• Construisez le cadre : Concevez et déployez des cadres robustes et complexes pour intégrer les systèmes automatisés et les cellules de travail dans les laboratoires.
• Partenariat avec les scientifiques: Collaborer directement avec les utilisateurs finaux et les gestionnaires de produits pour intégrer rapidement et traduire des besoins complexes en solutions techniques.
• Span the Stack: Appliquer les meilleures pratiques dans les systèmes distribués et l'ingénierie des données, en contribuant à travers la pile de technologie chaque fois que nécessaire.
• Portée supérieure: agir en tant que facteur clé en possédant des éléments importants du cadre et en fournissant des conseils techniques à l'équipe
• Domaine d'application principal: Diriger la feuille de route technique pour le contrôle d'automatisation de base et les cadres de données, en assurant l'alignement sur les besoins stratégiques de nos organisations de découverte de drogues. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un ingénieur motivé qui prospère à l'intersection de la conception logicielle et de l'innovation scientifique, répondant aux critères minimums suivants:
• Contexte: Vous possédez au moins un B.S. en informatique, en ingénierie, ou un domaine connexe, avec 4+ années d'expérience en tant que moteur, ingénieur de données ou de produits.
• Core Stack: forte passion pour l'ingénierie logicielle avec une compétence de niveau expert en Python et/ou Java, avec une expertise profonde dans les architectures cloud-natives (idéalement AWS) et les systèmes distribués.
• Mindset innovant : Vous êtes passionné par un engagement continu auprès des utilisateurs finaux et vous intéressez aux tendances modernes, telles que le codage assisté par l'IA et le développement frontal avec TypeScript/JavaScript.
• Leadership & Communication : Vous êtes un communicateur compétent capable de construire des partenariats de confiance avec des scientifiques et de définir une architecture technique de haut niveau pour un travail complexe.
• Expérience principale: 7+ ans d'expérience en architecture logicielle progressive spécifiquement au sein de l'industrie Biotech/Pharma.
• Expertise principale : Une connaissance approfondie et pratique des flux de travail en laboratoire, des cellules de travail intégrées et des systèmes de contrôle d'automatisation (p. ex., gestionnaires de liquides, bras robotiques) est essentielle. Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes

jobs.title: Patient Safety Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Patient Safety Intern will embark on a growth journey upon joining Roche. The intern will develop fundamental knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and Safety Risk Management throughout the lifecycle of a product and enabling safe access to innovative treatments for the patients, ensuring optimal beneﬁt-risk balance for a therapeutic product.

At the end of the internship, the intern should achieve the following;

• To understand and apply pre-marketing pharmacovigilance requirements in Asia Paciﬁc

• To understand and apply post-marketing pharmacovigilance requirements in Asia Paciﬁc

• To understand EU Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) and its implementation in global processes

• To be able to accurately assess and independently complete some basic Pharmacovigilance requirements

• Demonstrate soft skills, project management and presentation skills

Qualiﬁcations:

• Currently pursuing a degree in Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or Pharmaceutical Science.

• Preferably a student who can commit from July 2026 to December 2026 .

• Willing to work at our Singapore oﬃce located in Paya Lebar Quarter .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
At Roche/Genentech, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and making medicines more convenient and accessible to patients while investing in our planet to reduce the carbon footprint. We are fearless in both decision and action. That is why we come to work each day.

Who We Are

Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to millions of patients worldwide. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine from the development process through clinical trials and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of the production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is an integral part of this mission. As an organization of over 2,500 people globally, PTD is responsible for developing the manufacturing processes, products, analytical methods, and Chemistry, Manufacturing & Controls (CMC) strategies to deliver all new products in Roche’s pipeline. This work encompasses the full range of development functions, including biologics, synthetic molecules, devices, clinical supply chain management, and project and portfolio management.

PTD applies leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical-stage products globally, reliably delivering the pipeline and supporting commercial manufacturing operations. We excel through innovation, collaboration, dedication, and mutual respect, continuously improving what we do to ensure Roche’s supply of quality products to patients. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, technical excellence, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

The Opportunity

As the Global Head of Device Development, you are an enterprise leader and a key contributor to the One Pharma Strategy (OPS). You are responsible for realization of the Device and Delivery Systems (DDS) strategy, ensuring Roche remains the industry benchmark for patient-centric delivery technologies.
You will lead a strong technical organization of 120 + scientific and engineering professionals with different experiences and backgrounds. Your mission is to transform PTD’s device and combination product capabilities to support an unprecedented late-stage portfolio, driving speed, volume, and technical excellence. You are a member of the PTD Leadership Team and a
primary influencer across R&D (gRED, pRED), Product Development (PD), and Global Product Strategy (GPS).

Key 
• Responsibilities

1. Strategic Enterprise Leadership & Portfolio Management

● Shape the end-to-end platform strategy under DDS, from early-stage design through industrialization and commercial lifecycle management to create a maximum of impact.
● Lead and support the company-wide Technical Development (CMC) device portfolio. Ensure breadth and depth of the technical capabilities, shared learning, and continuous improvement culture.
● Act as the primary decision-maker for development technology investments and platform selection in conjunction with PT device community leaders. Chair the Global Device Review Forum (GDRF) and serve as a key member of the LSTDC (Late Stage Technical Development Committee) for combination product topics.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche/Genentech, crediamo che sia urgente fornire soluzioni mediche in questo momento – anche mentre sviluppiamo innovazioni per il futuro. Siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti e rendere le medicine più convenienti e accessibili ai pazienti mentre investiamo nel nostro pianeta per ridurre l'impronta di carbonio. Siamo senza paura sia nella decisione che nell'azione. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Chi siamo Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) è l'organizzazione che produce e fornisce le terapie innovative di Roche a milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. PT è coinvolto nella produzione di ogni farmaco Roche dal processo di sviluppo attraverso studi clinici e continua a maturità del prodotto. La nostra organizzazione coordina tutti gli aspetti della produzione di farmaci Roche in tutte le aree di malattia e forme di dosaggio. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) è parte integrante di questa missione. Eccelleremo attraverso innovazione, collaborazione, dedizione e rispetto reciproco, migliorando continuamente ciò che facciamo per garantire la fornitura di prodotti di qualità ai pazienti. Condurrai una forte organizzazione tecnica di 120 + professionisti scientifici e ingegneristici con diverse esperienze e sfondi. La vostra missione è quella di trasformare le capacità di prodotto di PTD e combinazione per supportare un portafoglio senza precedenti, velocità di guida, volume e eccellenza tecnica. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche/Genentech glauben wir, dass es jetzt dringend ist, medizinische Lösungen zu liefern – auch wenn wir Innovationen für die Zukunft entwickeln. Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern und Arzneimittel für Patienten bequemer und zugänglich zu machen, während wir in unseren Planeten investieren, um den CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Wir sind furchtlos in Entscheidung und Tat. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wer wir sind Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) ist die Organisation, die Roches bahnbrechende Therapien auf Millionen von Patienten weltweit produziert und liefert. PT beteiligt sich an der Herstellung jeder Roche-Medikament aus dem Entwicklungsprozess durch klinische Studien und die Fortsetzung der Produktreife. Unsere Organisation koordiniert alle Aspekte der Produktion von Roche-Medizinen in allen Krankheitsgebieten und Dosierungsformen. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) ist integraler Bestandteil dieser Mission. Als Organisation von über 2.500 Menschen weltweit ist die PTD verantwortlich für die Entwicklung der Fertigungsprozesse, Produkte, Analysemethoden und Chemie, Manufacturing & Controls (CMC) Strategien, um alle neuen Produkte in der Roche-Pipeline zu liefern. Diese Arbeit umfasst die gesamte Bandbreite an Entwicklungsfunktionen, darunter Biologik, synthetische Moleküle, Geräte, klinische Supply Chain Management und Projekt- und Portfoliomanagement. PTD setzt führendes technisches Know-how für die Konstruktion, Entwicklung, Lieferung und Registrierung von klinisch-stufigen Produkten weltweit, zuverlässig für die Pipeline und die Unterstützung kommerzieller Fertigungsbetriebe ein. Wir zeichnen uns durch Innovation, Zusammenarbeit, Engagement und gegenseitige Achtung aus und verbessern kontinuierlich das, was wir tun, um die Versorgung von Roche mit Qualitätsprodukten für Patienten zu gewährleisten. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, technischer Exzellenz, unerklärlicher Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun das heute, um morgen besser zu werden. Die Chance Als Global Head of Device Development sind Sie ein Unternehmensleiter und ein wichtiger Beitrag zur One Pharma Strategie (OPS). Sie sind für die Umsetzung der Strategie Geräte- und Liefersysteme (DDS) verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass Roche weiterhin der Branchen-Benchmark für patientenzentrierte Liefertechnologien bleibt. Sie führen eine starke technische Organisation von 120 + wissenschaftlichen und technischen Fachleuten mit verschiedenen Erfahrungen und Hintergründen. Ihre Mission ist es, das Gerät und die Kombination von Produktfunktionen von PTD zu transformieren, um ein beispielloses Portfolio in der Spätphase, Fahrgeschwindigkeit, Volumen und technische Exzellenz zu unterstützen. Sie sind Mitglied des PTD Leadership Teams und Primärinfluencer über R&D (gRED, pRED), Produktentwicklung (PD) und Global Product Strategy (GPS). Schlüssel
• Aufgaben 1. Strategisches Unternehmen Leadership & Portfolio Management ● Gestalten Sie die End-to-End-Plattform-Strategie unter DDS, vom frühen Design über die Industrialisierung und das kommerzielle Lifecycle-Management bis hin zu einem Maximum an Wirkung. ● Führen und unterstützen Sie das unternehmensweite Portfolio an technischen Entwicklungen (CMC). Gewährleistung der Breite und Tiefe der technischen Fähigkeiten, des gemeinsamen Lernens und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserungskultur. ● Aktivieren Sie als primärer Entscheidungsträger für entwicklungstechnische Investitionen und Plattformauswahl in Verbindung mit PT-Geräten-Gemeinschaftsführern. Lehrstuhl für das Global Device Review Forum (GDRF) und fungiert als zentrales Mitglied des LSTDC (Late Stage Technical Development Committee) für Kombinationsproduktthemen. ● Partner erfolgreich mit internen Stakeholdern, um die externe Fertigungsnetzwerkstrategie zu beeinflussen

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche/Genentech, nous pensons qu'il est urgent de fournir des solutions médicales dès maintenant – même si nous développons des innovations pour l'avenir. Nous sommes passionnés de transformer les vies des patients et de rendre les médicaments plus pratiques et accessibles aux patients tout en investissant dans notre planète pour réduire l'empreinte carbone. Nous sommes intrépides dans la décision et l'action. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler chaque jour. Qui nous sommes Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) est l'organisation qui fabrique et livre des thérapies révolutionnaires à des millions de patients dans le monde entier. PT est impliqué dans la production de chaque médicament Roche depuis le processus de développement jusqu'aux essais cliniques et jusqu'à la maturité du produit. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) fait partie intégrante de cette mission. En tant qu'organisation de plus de 2 500 personnes à l'échelle mondiale, PTD est responsable du développement des procédés de fabrication, des produits, des méthodes d'analyse et des stratégies de chimie, de fabrication et de contrôle (CMC) pour livrer tous les nouveaux produits dans le pipeline de Roche. Ce travail englobe toute la gamme des fonctions de développement, y compris les produits biologiques, les molécules synthétiques, les dispositifs, la gestion clinique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la gestion de projets et de portefeuilles. La PTD applique une expertise technique de premier plan à la conception, au développement, à l'approvisionnement et à l'enregistrement des produits en phase clinique à l'échelle mondiale, à la livraison fiable du pipeline et au soutien des activités de fabrication commerciale. Nous excellons par l'innovation, la collaboration, le dévouement et le respect mutuel, en améliorant continuellement ce que nous faisons pour assurer la fourniture de produits de qualité aux patients. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'excellence technique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. L'opportunité En tant que responsable mondial du développement des appareils, vous êtes un chef d'entreprise et un contributeur clé à la stratégie One Pharma (OPS). Vous êtes responsable de la mise en œuvre de la stratégie des systèmes d'appareils et de livraison (SDS), assurant que Roche demeure la référence de l'industrie pour les technologies de livraison axées sur le patient. Vous dirigerez une organisation technique forte de 120 professionnels scientifiques et d'ingénierie avec des expériences et des antécédents différents. Votre mission est de transformer l'appareil et la combinaison des capacités du produit PTD, pour soutenir un portefeuille de dernière étape sans précédent, la vitesse, le volume et l'excellence technique. Vous êtes membre de l'équipe de leadership de la PTD l'influence principale sur la R-D (RED, RED), le développement des produits (PD) et la Stratégie mondiale des produits (GPS). Clé
• Responsabilités 1. Leadership stratégique d'entreprise et gestion de portefeuille ● Former la stratégie de la plate-forme de bout en bout dans le cadre du DDS, depuis la conception en début de phase jusqu'à l'industrialisation et la gestion du cycle de vie commercial pour créer un maximum d'impact. ● Diriger et soutenir le portefeuille de dispositifs de développement technique (CMC) à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Assurer l'étendue et la profondeur des capacités techniques, l'apprentissage partagé et la culture d'amélioration continue. ● Agir en tant que premier décideur pour les investissements technologiques de développement et la sélection des plates -formes en collaboration avec les dirigeants communautaires des dispositifs de PT. Présider le Forum mondial d'examen des dispositifs (GDRF) et être un membre clé du LSTDC (Late Stage Technical Development Committee) pour les sujets de produits combinés. ● S'associer avec succès avec les intervenants internes pour influencer la stratégie du réseau de fabrication externe, en

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （1）协助在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2）协助进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3）协助开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4）协助及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （1）在校大学生
• （2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Project Engineer/SME - Commissioning and Qualification
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
Leads, supports or advises Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) activities related to manufacturing and storage facilities and systems, laboratory buildings and equipment, utilities generating and distributing facilities and systems, generally in conjunction with CAPEX projects. Contributes to Right First Time delivery of those facilities and systems in quality, on time and in budget which is compliant to GMP, Chinese laws and represents Roche in an adequate way.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities

• Directs the planning, organization, and coordination of commissioning and qualification activities of manufacturing and storage facilities and systems, laboratory buildings and equipment, utilities and infrastructure.

• Review of respective Engineering, Commissioning and Qualification documents of CAPEX projects in scope.

• Identification of quality issues in CAPEX projects in scope of work of the Commissioning and Qualification Manager in cooperation with Project Managers and Engineers, analysis of those and mutual development of mitigation measures.

• Develops commissioning and qualification plans and schedules for the respective facilities and systems incl. material, staffing and budgeting.

• Leads and coordinates commissioning and qualification teams and/or participates in such teams.

• Works in cooperation with the Project Manager, Engineering, Automation, User, Suppliers and Quality Unit to achieve a smooth handover of the systems to the owner and operational personnel.

• Contributes to, or leads the development of procedures, guidelines and other documents related to commissioning and qualification as needed or participates in respective teams.

• Participates in quality meetings or contributes to those as delegate of the Engineering.

• Performs and supports coaching, training and development of qualification and commissioning engineers.

• Conduct business in full compliance to Behavior in Business and Behavior in Competition.

Responsibilities:

• Ensures compliance with Roche Quality Standards, with applicable health authorities' requirements and with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) for qualification activities in scope of work of the Qualification Engineer.

• Provides reliable qualification schedules for CAPEX projects based on duly described project scope and requirements.

• Provides reliable commissioning plans and schedules for CAPEX projects based on duly described project scope and requirements.

• Provides realistic cost estimates of qualification and commissioning work based on duly described project scope, requirements and anticipated schedule of the particular project or sub-project.

Experience:

• Field experience in commissioning and qualification activities of diagnostics / pharmaceutical / biotech manufacturing facilities and systems for mid- and large-sized investment projects.

• Solid collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams in international environments.

• Excellent communication skills in Chinese and English, further languages are beneficial. Proficiency in both spoken and written English.

•

Education & Qualifications:
Master or Bachelor degree in engineering, in natural science or pharmaceutics with long time experience in diagnostics / pharmaceutical / biotech industries.
In depth diagnostics / pharmaceutical / biotech Commissioning and Qualification knowledge. Strong experience in GMP, GEP and application of Quality Systems.

Who we are
A healthier fu

jobs.title: RA Senior Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsibilities
Key roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

1. Portfolio Management

• Oversee and is accountable for regulatory strategy, risk mitigation and HA interactions of product portfolios, ensuring alignment with organization objectives and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure regulatory activities through the product life cycle, including CTA, initial licensure and later management are appropriately actioned and managed.

• Collaborate with and influence industry associations and Health Authorities on key portfolio and regulatory policy matters

• Act as an advisor for the member of the Portfolio Team to consult with and a subject matter expert in regulatory strategy, and lead/contribute to the generation of regulatory knowledge and insights.

• Accountable for building partnerships with PDR global and key stakeholders from other functions to ensure the strategic business goals/prioritizations alignment, issue escalation and conflict solving.

• Establish fit-for-purpose ways of working and effectiveness of the Portfolio Team

2. People Management

• Ensure the necessary regulatory science knowledge and multiple sub-function domain expertise and resources are available to deliver the work and foster growth and development of the team

• Responsible for leading (VACC), mentoring, and developing a diverse team of professionals within the product and community matrix.

• Role model and supports talent flow within, into, and out of the portfolio team

• Builds an implementable and robust succession plan for the future Portfolio Team Lead

• Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning; boost team members to take ownership of their development and contributions.

• Manage team performance, including goal setting and regular evaluations, ensuring the long-term success of both individuals and the organization.

3. Community Management

• Build, nurture, and lead cross-team communities that drive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation across the organization.

• Act as a central point of contact within the community matrix, aligning community initiatives with function goals and ensuring consistent communication and engagement across teams.

• Develop and implement strategies that enhance community cohesion, break down silos, and create an environment where all members can contribute to the organization’s success.

Requirements/qualifications:
The ideal person for this role will have the following experience, skills and attributes:

• Proven experience in drug development, a deep understanding of the regulatory science/requirements, full product lifecycle and the ability to manage complex product portfolios.

• Demonstrated expertise in people management, with a strong track record of leading, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

• Experience or track record of managing dynamic cross-functional projects/initiatives, which require great collaboration, engagement, and knowledge sharing across diverse teams.

• Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to influence and inspire stakeholders internally and externally, including NMPA and its affiliated organizations.

• The candidate should have a University or higher degree in pharmaceutical or life sciences with 10+ years of experience in R&D based pharmaceutical companies.

• The candidate is open minded and collaborative with a growth mindset and purpose-led.

• Excellent Chin

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione responsabilità I ruoli chiave e le responsabilità includono, ma non sono limitati ai seguenti: 1. Gestione del portafoglio
• Controllare ed è responsabile per la strategia di regolamentazione, la mitigazione dei rischi e le interazioni HA dei portafogli di prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi organizzativi e i requisiti normativi.
• Assicurare le attività di regolamentazione attraverso il ciclo di vita del prodotto, tra cui CTA, la licenza iniziale e la gestione successiva sono opportunamente attivati e gestiti.
• Collaborare con e influenzare le associazioni del settore e le autorità sanitarie su portafogli chiave e questioni di politica regolamentare
• Agire come consulente per il membro del team Portfolio per consultare e un esperto di materia nella strategia di regolamentazione, e portare/contribuire alla generazione di conoscenze e approfondimenti normativi.
• Contabile per la costruzione di partenariati con gli stakeholder globali e chiave della RDT da altre funzioni per garantire l'allineamento strategico degli obiettivi aziendali/prioritizations, l'escalation e la risoluzione dei conflitti.
• Stabilire modi di lavoro e di efficacia adatti all'uso del Team Portfolio 2. Gestione delle persone
• Assicurare la necessaria conoscenza delle scienze regolamentari e competenze e risorse di dominio sotto-funzione multiple sono disponibili per fornire il lavoro e promuovere la crescita e lo sviluppo del team
• Responsabile per il leader (VACC), mentoring, e lo sviluppo di un team diversificato di professionisti all'interno del prodotto e della matrice comunitaria.
• Modello Role e supporta il flusso di talento all'interno, all'interno e all'esterno del team di portafoglio
• Costruire un piano di successione attuabile e robusto per il futuro Portfolio Team Lead
• Promuovere una cultura della trasparenza, della responsabilità, dell'innovazione e dell'apprendimento continuo; rafforzare i membri del team per prendere possesso del loro sviluppo e dei loro contributi.
• Gestire le prestazioni del team, tra cui l'impostazione degli obiettivi e le valutazioni regolari, garantendo il successo a lungo termine sia delle persone che dell'organizzazione. 3. Gestione della Comunità
• Costruire, coltivare e guidare comunità trasversali che guidano la collaborazione, la condivisione delle conoscenze e l'innovazione in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Agire come punto centrale di contatto all'interno della matrice della comunità, allineare le iniziative della comunità con gli obiettivi di funzione e garantire una comunicazione coerente e un impegno tra le squadre.
• Sviluppare e implementare strategie che migliorano la coesione della comunità, abbattere i silos e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i membri possono contribuire al successo dell’organizzazione. Requisiti/qualifica: La persona ideale per questo ruolo avrà la seguente esperienza, abilità e attributi:
• Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo della droga, una profonda comprensione della scienza e dei requisiti normativi, del ciclo di vita completo del prodotto e della capacità di gestire portafogli di prodotti complessi.
• Competenza dimostrata nella gestione delle persone, con un forte record di leader, sviluppo e mantenimento di squadre ad alto rendimento.
• Esperienza o track record di gestione di progetti/iniziativi interfunzionali dinamici, che richiedono una grande collaborazione, impegno e condivisione delle conoscenze in diversi team.
• Forte leadership, comunicazione e capacità organizzative, con la capacità di influenzare e ispirare gli stakeholder internamente ed esternamente, tra cui NMPA e le sue organizzazioni affiliate.
• Il candidato dovrebbe avere una laurea in scienze farmaceutiche o di vita con 10 anni di esperienza nelle aziende farmaceutiche basate su R&D.
• Il candidato è aperto e collaborativo con una mentalità di crescita e orientato allo scopo.
• Eccellente mento

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Aufgaben Zu den wichtigsten Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten gehören, sind aber nicht auf folgende beschränkt: 1. Portfolio Management
• Überwachung und Rechenschaftspflicht für Regulierungsstrategien, Risikominderungen und HA-Interaktionen von Produktportfolios, Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf Organisationsziele und regulatorische Anforderungen.
• Gewährleistung regulatorischer Aktivitäten durch den Produktlebenszyklus, einschließlich CTA, Erstlizenzierung und spätere Verwaltung werden entsprechend gehandelt und verwaltet.
• Zusammenarbeit und Einfluss von Branchenverbänden und Gesundheitsbehörden auf zentrale Portfolio- und Regulierungsfragen
• Aktivieren Sie als Berater des Portfolio-Teams, um sich mit einem Fachexperten in der Regulierungsstrategie zu beraten und der Generation regulatorischer Kenntnisse und Erkenntnisse beizutragen.
• Berechnungsfähig für den Aufbau von Partnerschaften mit PDR Global und Schlüsselstakeholdern aus anderen Funktionen, um die strategischen Geschäftsziele/Prioritisierungen Ausrichtung, Eskalation und Konfliktlösung zu gewährleisten.
• Schaffung von geeigneten Arbeits- und Effektivitätsmöglichkeiten des Portfolio-Teams 2. Personalmanagement
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass das notwendige regulatorische Wissenschaftswissen und mehrere Subfunktions-Domains zur Verfügung stehen, um die Arbeit zu liefern und Wachstum und Entwicklung des Teams zu fördern
• Verantwortung für führende (VACC), Mentoring und Entwicklung eines vielfältigen Teams von Fachleuten innerhalb der Produkt- und Community-Matrix.
• Rollenmodell und unterstützt Talentfluss innerhalb, in und außerhalb des Portfolio-Teams
• Erstellt einen umsetzbaren und robusten Nachfolgeplan für den zukünftigen Portfolio Team Lead
• Förderung einer Kultur der Transparenz, der Rechenschaftspflicht, der Innovation und des kontinuierlichen Lernens; stärkt die Teammitglieder dabei, sich an ihre Entwicklung und Beiträge zu beteiligen.
• Teamleistung verwalten, einschließlich Zielsetzung und regelmäßige Bewertungen, um den langfristigen Erfolg sowohl von Einzelpersonen als auch von der Organisation sicherzustellen. 3. Gemeinschaftsmanagement
• Aufbauen, Pflegen und Lead Cross-Team-Communities, die Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und Innovation in der gesamten Organisation vorantreiben.
• Aktivieren Sie als zentraler Ansprechpartner innerhalb der Community-Matrix, richten Sie Gemeinschaftsinitiativen mit Funktionszielen aus und gewährleisten Sie eine konsequente Kommunikation und Engagement in Teams.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Strategic Account Executive

The Opportunity:
This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories.

Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives (capital instruments & reagents) in targeted Anatomic Pathology labs within the assigned geography. This role is focused on the region’s largest customers, large strategic scenarios, reference labs and competitive opportunities. Must maintain & grow existing accounts & develop new accounts in the assigned geography. Develop partnerships with all levels of Buying Influences to include: C-Suite, Lab Directors, Lab Managers, Histotechnologist, Safety Officers, Materials Management, etc. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers.

This is a field based role: the territory includes Michigan (Detroit, Ann Arbor, Grand Rapids). Prefer candidate to reside in Detroit area. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory border. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role.

Job Facts:

• Meet with customers to discuss their evolving needs and to assess the quality of our company’s relationship with them

• Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders

• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates customer needs on an ongoing basis.

• Achieves assigned sales quota in designated strategic accounts.

• Closely coordinates company executive involvement and Customer Service Representatives to ensure customer satisfaction and problem resolution.

• Customer focused selling skills are a must to drive consistent results & partnerships.

Who you are (minimum qualifications):

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

• Experience working with multiple call points (lab managers, directors, clinicians, c-suite)

• Proven leadership abilities

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Excellent oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations

• Hands on experience with CRM software and MS Office (particularly MS Excel)

• Strong negotiation skills with a problem-solving attitude

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love

Your Opportunity

• Co-create with DAN, PPOCs, local Enablers and other functions to build DA/TA integrated strategies and OBP (DA affiliate outcomes: LTO, MTO & STO) - aligned with global and regional strategies.

• Support DAN, PPOCs on building and reviewing business planning, re-define go-to-market model

• Collaborate with PPOCs to engage with local stakeholders/partners to provide and validate local market competition and customers insights

• Support DAN and PPOCs on market research to gain market insights for building strategies

• Lead and collaborate with PPOCs and other stakeholders to conduct the short term, mid term and long term forecasting of business for related TAs

• Co-create with DAN and PPOCs to create promotional materials and build digital marketing contents for both HCPs and patients

• Provide input, develop and adaptation to all promotional materials in local language in alignment with Roche code of conduct and local regulations

• Give advices for email/App/HCP platform campaign content

• Support PPOCs on Email/App/HCP platform campaign deployment

• Provide input for the development of, and develop Digital Integrated Personalized Offerings

• Internal training:

• Provide input and adaptation to all training materials required in local languages.

• Local Marketing Enablers may be required to conduct the training for PPOCs in the local language

• Collaborate with DAN and PPOCs for implementing OBP. Prioritize efforts to DA/TA Work Packages requiring highly localized insights and/or activities

• Promotional & medical events management (i.e. national level events/webinars)

• Collaborate with PPOCs to manage Grant/ Sponsorship/ Donation

• Co-create with PPOCs and other enablers on stakeholders mapping, managing relationships with local HCP organizations

• Lead the access and pricing strategy for all DA related products.

• Collaborate with Access and other functions to develop and deploy pricing strategies (including PN, FPS)

• Lead the deployment of FPS/PSP programs in alignment with DA strategies.

• Collaborate with the Access & Policy Chapter in HTA assessment, reimbursement listing

• Coordinate with local distributors to ensure drug supply to patients (including formulary listing)

• Coordinate with other functions for monthly rolling forecast and supply planning to ensure drug availability.

Who you are

• Must-have University degree in Pharmacy/Medical

• Additional Master / MBA is an advantage

• Additional Master / Bachelor Degree of Marketing is an advantage

• At least 3 years of hands-on experiences in Brand Management of MNC pharmaceuticals

• Excellent commercial/financing abilities and familiar with budgeting/forecasting process

• Competent Market analytics

• Experience in developing/ launching new business(es)/ product(s).

• Product life cycle management: vision & strategies

• Market, HCP & Competitive Insight – applicable level

• Branding & Positioning Management – applicable level

• Marketing Analytics – applicable level

jobs.title: Market Access and Policy Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role scope :

• Develop and implement market access strategies/solutions for strategic products covering reimbursement, pricing, pharmacoeconomics/HTA strategy, and policy-related strategy to maximize patient access and portfolio value.

• Shape sustainable pricing strategies from pre-launch through lifecycle management, aligned with overall portfolio and long-term business objectives.

• Prioritize pipeline assets and define access pathways to ensure successful future launches.

• Ensure payer relevant evidence is generated through clinical trials, health economic modeling, real-world evidence studies, systematic literature research and meta-analysis effectively to demonstrate the value comprehensively.

• Translate evidence into compelling value propositions tailored to Taiwan payer and policy environment.

• Identify patient access opportunities and/or issues/barriers and develop access solutions to address them and create access for patients for Roche innovations in self-pay market

• Engage external stakeholders to remove access barriers and deliver value based discussion for Roche products.

• Reimbursement:

• Work cross functionally with PPOC, Marketing, and Medical stakeholders to develop the reimbursement strategy and engagement plan with KOL and advocacy groups.

• Collect data and prepare a dossier for the National Health Insurance Administration (NHIA) submission. Highlight the key evidence and product value proposition for the payer.

• Support policy shaping activities to support patient access as appropriate.

• Lead negotiation and contracting processes to secure an optimal outcome for the company

• Collaborate with the global team and other affiliates through the network to ensure alignment on the access and pricing strategy.

• Contribute to the planning and execution of our policy and health system shaping activities to ensure the system is ready and willing to recognize, value, and reimburse our future innovations.

Qualifications:

• Good compliance track record. No material compliance violation has been identified in the past 5 years.

Education:

• A bachelor degree in the field (pharmacy, nursing, public health, economics, public policy). An advanced (Master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

Working Experience:

• Experience working on reimbursement applications and self-pay strategy is preferred

• Some prior commercial experience within the pharmaceutical, medical device, or broader healthcare industry is essential.

• Familiar with NHIA process of medical devices and key stakeholders.

Skills & Knowledge:

• Strong business acumen with ability to think strategically.

• Deep appreciation of science and ability to translate scientific information into strategy. Ability to take evidence and other complex data and convert them into easy to understand deliverables that can support commercial use.

• Possess an understanding of the access landscape, relevant stakeholder groups, value assessment/HTA methods and pricing concepts.

• Possess an understanding of how policies are made within the healthcare system, including identifying key institutions and stakeholders involved and the importance of policy in shaping the healthcare environment.

• A collaborative attitude and ability to manage multiple demands and priorities on time, influence without authority, gain alignment and drive decision making.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills are a must with a strong track record of delivering results in a matrix-based environmen

jobs.title: Product Specialist Trainee (Portuguese speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Product Specialist Trainee, your main responsibility will be to provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines. You will be responsible for maintaining excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers to ensure a rapid resolution of any issues or requests raised. This position offers a hybrid work arrangement. You will have the flexibility to work remotely while also having the opportunity to collaborate and engage with colleagues in the office.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines

• Maintain excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely manner

• Document and escalate complex issues to higher-level support teams when necessary

• Provide training and guidance to customers on the operation and maintenance of our analyzers

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction

Required Profile:

• Students of Biomedical Engineering, Biomedicine, or Health and Life Sciences.

• Ability to make curricular and/or extracurricular internship agreements

• Fluent in Spanish and English (conversational and good writing skills), Portuguese is a must

• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills

• Interest in new technologies

• Analytical thinking

What do we offer?

During the internship, you will get an insight into a global company. As a Product Specialist Trainee, you will have the opportunity to gain practical experience and develop your skills in the following areas:

• Learn the functioning of a microbiology and/or anatomical pathology laboratory.

• Receive specific product training on Roche's offerings in these areas.

• Enhance your communication, troubleshooting and customer service skills and expand your network within the company.

• Develop essential core skills such as customer interaction, critical thinking, intercultural collaboration, and resilience.

• Provide remote support to customers and field specialists, assisting with troubleshooting, application usage, and implementing new protocols.

Additionally, you will have the chance to collaborate with cross-functional and collaborate with global teams when necessary. This internship will provide valuable hands-on experience and the opportunity to contribute to customer satisfaction.

You will learn what "Customer centricity" means and how the Global Customer Support of Roche Diagnostics implements this in its daily work.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Institute of Human Biology (IHB), embedded within Roche’s Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) Division, is a leading research institute focused on accelerating the development of transformative medicines. It specializes in developing novel and robust human model systems that functionally resemble human physiology and disease. By bridging the gap between academic discovery and industrial application, IHB facilitates the rapid translation of groundbreaking science into patient-focused solutions.

The Opportunity

We are building next-generation human kidney models by tackling a central unsolved problem in the field: how to generate organotypic, vascularized kidney organoids that show enhanced maturation.

As part of a newly funded IHB fellowship, you will drive an ambitious research program at the interface of stem cell biology, vascular biology, and single-cell genomics, with the goal of creating translationally relevant systems for drug discovery and safety.

In this role, you will define innovative approaches to uncover the biological principles of vascular–parenchymal interaction, ultimately helping to establish a new class of human model systems through the following responsibilities:

• Drive the development of vascularized iPSC-derived kidney organoids, with a focus on tissue specification and maturation

• Use single-cell genomics to dissect endothelial specification, nephron maturation, and cell–cell communication

• Work closely with bioengineers to integrate biology into perfusable, next-generation culture systems

• Translate biological insights into functional, predictive models relevant for human kidney safety

Who You Are

• A scientist with a PhD and a strong track record in iPSC-derived 3D tissue models or organoids. To qualify for this early-career position, you must have completed your doctoral studies within the last four years.

• Experienced in generating and analysing single-cell transcriptomic data and comfortable translating complex datasets into biological insight

• Scientifically ambitious, with the ability to drive new concepts rather than follow established protocols

• Ideally with a strong background in developmental biology, with expertise in kidney, vascular, or related organ systems

Additional Information

You will be embedded in a highly interdisciplinary ecosystem at IHB, working with leading experts in bioengineering, stem cell biology, and computational analysis, and closely connected to Roche’s drug discovery and safety teams.
This is a unique opportunity to define how human kidney models are built and used in the future—from fundamental biology to direct impact on drug development.

Application Process

To apply, please submit the following materials:

• Current CV: Please provide a comprehensive CV, including a full list of your peer-reviewed publications.

• Professional References: Include contact details for two references who can speak to your scientific expertise and professional character.

• Ph.D. Documentation: Provide an official diploma or certificate confirming your degree (if already obtained).

• Timeline & Availability: The start date of this position is 1st September 2026.

The initial duration is for 2 years, with the potential for extension.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Istituto di Biologia Umana (IHB), incorporato all'interno della Divisione Ricerca e Sviluppo Anticipato di Roche, è un istituto di ricerca leader incentrato sull'accelerazione dello sviluppo di farmaci trasformativi. Si specializza nello sviluppo di nuovi e robusti sistemi di modello umano che assomigliano funzionale alla fisiologia e alla malattia umana. Separando il divario tra la scoperta accademica e l'applicazione industriale, IHB facilita la rapida traduzione della scienza innovativa in soluzioni orientate ai pazienti. L'opportunità Stiamo costruendo modelli renali umani di nuova generazione affrontando un problema centrale non risolto nel campo: come generare organotipi, organoidi renali vascolarizzati che mostrano una maggiore maturazione. Come parte di una borsa IHB appena finanziata, guiderai un ambizioso programma di ricerca all'interfaccia di biologia delle cellule staminali, biologia vascolare e genomica monocellulare, con l'obiettivo di creare sistemi traduttivamente rilevanti per la scoperta e la sicurezza della droga. In questo ruolo, definirete approcci innovativi per scoprire i principi biologici dell'interazione vascolare-parenchimale, contribuendo infine a stabilire una nuova classe di sistemi di modello umano attraverso le seguenti responsabilità:
• Guidare lo sviluppo di organoidi renali derivati da iPSC vascolarizzati, con un focus sulle specifiche del tessuto e la maturazione
• Utilizzare genomica a singola cella per dissezionare le specifiche endoteliali, la maturazione del nefro e la comunicazione cellulare
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i bioingegneria per integrare la biologia in sistemi di cultura profusi e di prossima generazione
• Tradurre intuizioni biologiche in modelli funzionali e predittivi rilevanti per la sicurezza dei reni umani Chi sei
• Uno scienziato con un dottorato di ricerca e un forte record di traccia nei modelli 3D derivati da iPSC o organoidi. Per qualificarsi per questa posizione di primo soccorso, devi aver completato gli studi di dottorato negli ultimi quattro anni.
• Sperimentato nella generazione e nell'analisi di dati transcriptomici monocellulari e nella comoda traduzione di set di dati complessi in una visione biologica
• Scientificamente ambizioso, con la capacità di guidare nuovi concetti piuttosto che seguire i protocolli stabiliti
• Idealmente con un forte background in biologia dello sviluppo, con esperienza in sistemi di organi renali, vascolari o correlati Informazioni aggiuntive Sarete incorporati in un ecosistema altamente interdisciplinare in IHB, lavorando con i principali esperti in bioingegneria, biologia delle cellule staminali e analisi computazionali, e strettamente collegati ai team di scoperta e sicurezza della droga di Roche. Questa è un'opportunità unica per definire come i modelli renali umani sono costruiti e utilizzati in futuro, dalla biologia fondamentale all'impatto diretto sullo sviluppo della droga. Processo di applicazione Per applicare, si prega di inviare i seguenti materiali:
• CV attuale: Si prega di fornire un CV completo, tra cui un elenco completo delle pubblicazioni peer-reviewed.
• Riferimenti professionali: Includere i dettagli di contatto per due riferimenti che possono parlare con la vostra competenza scientifica e carattere professionale.
• Ph.D. Documentazione: Fornire un diploma ufficiale o un certificato che confermi il diploma (se già ottenuto).
• Timeline & Disponibilità: La data di inizio di questa posizione è 1 settembre 2026. La durata iniziale è di 2 anni, con il potenziale di estensione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire.
