Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'Institut de biologie humaine (IHB), qui fait partie intégrante de la Division de la recherche et du développement précoce (PRED) de Roches Pharma, est un institut de recherche de premier plan axé sur l'accélération du développement des médicaments transformateurs. Il se spécialise dans le développement de systèmes de modèles humains nouveaux et robustes qui ressemblent fonctionnellement à la physiologie et à la maladie humaines. En comblant l'écart entre la découverte académique et l'application industrielle, l'IHB facilite la traduction rapide de la science révolutionnaire en solutions axées sur le patient. L'opportunité Nous construisons des modèles rénaux humains de nouvelle génération en s'attaquant à un problème central non résolu dans le domaine : comment générer des organoides rénaux organotypiques et vasculaires qui montrent une maturation accrue. Dans le cadre d'une bourse nouvellement financée de la DGSI, vous dirigerez un ambitieux programme de recherche à l'interface de la biologie des cellules souches, de la biologie vasculaire et de la génomique monocellulaire, dans le but de créer des systèmes translationnels pertinents pour la découverte et l'innocuité des médicaments. Dans ce rôle, vous définirez des approches novatrices pour découvrir les principes biologiques de l'interaction vasculaire-parenchymique, en fin de compte aider à établir une nouvelle classe de systèmes modèles humains par les responsabilités suivantes:
• Favoriser le développement d'organoïdes rénaux dérivés de l'iPSC vasculaires, en mettant l'accent sur la spécification des tissus et la maturation
• Utilisez la génomique monocellulaire pour disséquer les spécifications endothéliales, la maturation du néphron et la communication cellulaire
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les bioingénieurs pour intégrer la biologie dans les systèmes culturels perfusables de la prochaine génération
• Traduire les connaissances biologiques en modèles fonctionnels et prédictifs pertinents pour la sécurité rénale humaine Qui vous êtes
• Un scientifique avec un doctorat et une solide expérience dans les modèles de tissus 3D ou organoïdes dérivés de l'iPSC. Pour être admissible à ce poste de début de carrière, vous devez avoir terminé vos études de doctorat au cours des quatre dernières années.
• Expérience dans la production et l'analyse de données transcriptomiques monocellulaires et la traduction confortable de ensembles de données complexes en données biologiques
• Scientifiquement ambitieux, avec la capacité de conduire de nouveaux concepts plutôt que de suivre des protocoles établis
• Idéalement avec une solide expérience en biologie du développement, avec une expertise dans les systèmes rénaux, vasculaires ou apparentés Informations complémentaires Vous serez intégré dans un écosystème hautement interdisciplinaire à l'IHB, en collaboration avec des experts de premier plan en bioingénierie, biologie des cellules souches et analyse computationnelle, et étroitement lié aux équipes Roches de découverte de médicaments et de sécurité. Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de définir comment les modèles rénaux humains sont construits et utilisés à l'avenir, de la biologie fondamentale à l'impact direct sur le développement des médicaments. Processus de demande Pour postuler, veuillez soumettre les documents suivants :
• CV actuel: Veuillez fournir un CV complet, y compris une liste complète de vos publications évaluées par les pairs.
• Références professionnelles : Inclure les coordonnées de deux références qui peuvent parler de votre expertise scientifique et de votre caractère professionnel.
• Doctorat : fournir un diplôme ou un certificat officiel confirmant votre diplôme (si déjà obtenu).
• Chronologie et disponibilité: La date de début de cette position est le 1er septembre 2026. La durée initiale est de deux ans, avec un potentiel de prolongation. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. jobs.title: MarTech Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Marketing Technologies (MarTech) embedded within the GPS Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI) function, will bring together key business and IT capabilities with the ambition to add meaning and value to all Roche’s customer interactions through a single, common, integrated customer-centric technology ecosystem.

The Marketing Technologies (MarTech) Business Operations Manager is a critical role dedicated to ensuring that our technology investments translate into tangible business performance.
Rather than focusing on technical maintenance, you will oversee a business readiness framework, designing the governance and operational structures that allow our teams to capitalize on new tools without disrupting core performance. You are the custodian of the "run state," responsible for ensuring that the business outcomes and growth are enhanced through the effective use of technology.
A primary driver of success for this role is the continuous evolution of our business processes. Your objective is to ensure that our operational model is not just stable, but a competitive advantage, delivering measurable improvements in speed-to-market, cost-to-serve, and overall organisational productivity.

The Opportunity
As the Business Operations Manager, you are responsible for implementing changes and managing the service model to ensure the long-term operational success and sustainability of our business platforms. You will support the Business Operations Lead in managing the entire transition from project-led implementation to a stable, continuous, and high-performing "business as usual" (BAU) state.

• Audit existing business workflows to identify inefficiencies; lead the design and implementation of "to-be" processes that maximize the value of our technology stack while simplifying user experience

• Implementation of the "run-state" governance required to manage ongoing business process changes. You will ensure that any future technical iterations are prioritized based on their ability to deliver business value and organizational stability

• Partner with end users to assess how technical shifts impact the user and operational layers of the business, ensuring that resource allocation is optimized for new ways of working and relevant services are resourced and trained appropriately

• Identifies gaps in the operational model that translate into missed/lost value realisation and propose tactics to capitalise on missed opportunities

• Operationalise the 'run-state' governance framework for managing ongoing business process, solution, data and user changes after go-live

• Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to process speed, cost-to-serve, and operational friction, driving a culture of continuous improvement

• Manage stakeholder alignment (with vendors, RDT/IT, and business) to ensure all transition plans and the future "run" model are co-created and fully supported

Who you are

• Mise en oeuvre de la gouvernance « d'État » nécessaire pour gérer les changements continus des processus opérationnels. Vous veillerez à ce que les futures itérations techniques soient hiérarchisées en fonction de leur capacité à fournir la valeur opérationnelle et la stabilité organisationnelle
• Établir des partenariats avec les utilisateurs finals afin d'évaluer l'impact des changements techniques sur les niveaux d'utilisation et d'exploitation de l'entreprise, en veillant à ce que l'allocation des ressources soit optimisée pour de nouvelles méthodes de travail et que les services pertinents soient dotés de ressources et formés de manière appropriée;
• Indique les lacunes du modèle opérationnel qui se traduisent par une réalisation de valeur manquée/perdue et propose des tactiques pour tirer parti des occasions manquées
• Mettre en œuvre le cadre de gouvernance de l'état de fonctionnement pour gérer les processus, les solutions, les données et les changements d'utilisateur en cours après la mise en service
• Établir et surveiller des indicateurs clés de performance (ICP) liés à la vitesse du processus, au coût de service et au frottement opérationnel, ce qui entraîne une culture d'amélioration continue
• Gérer l'alignement des parties prenantes (avec les fournisseurs, le RDT/IT et les entreprises) afin de s'assurer que tous les plans de transition et le modèle futur de gestion sont co-créés et pleinement pris en charge Qui vous êtes La réussite de ce rôle exige un chef de file hautement structuré et axé sur les processus, qui comprend parfaitement les opérations et la gestion des services. Vous êtes la main ferme qui assure que la vision stratégique du programme devient une réalité opérationnelle stable, fiable et en constante amélioration. Les principales caractéristiques sont les suivantes:
• > 3 ans d'expérience en opérations commerciales, prestation de services dans un environnement mondial à grande échelle avec une bonne compréhension de la façon de gérer et de soutenir les plates-formes d'entreprise dans une « entreprise comme d'habitude »

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Team Lead Engineering Primary Data Analysis, Aggregation and Reporting

The Biometrics team is pivotal in drug development, managing the acquisition, ingestion, curation, and analysis of clinical trial and real-world data to enable comprehensive regulatory filings. By ensuring data quality, applying advanced analytics, and adhering to regulatory standards, the team transforms complex datasets into actionable insights. Their work underpins evidence-based decisions, accelerates drug development timelines, and ensures successful regulatory submissions, enabling innovative therapies to reach patients efficiently.

As a Team Lead you will spearhead a high-performing team focused on establishing a simplified, scalable advanced analytics ecosystem. This role is at the forefront of our digital transformation, leveraging AI and machine learning to accelerate primary data analysis for clinical development. You will balance technical visionary leadership with a focus on people development to ensure our data workflows meet the highest production standards.

The Opportunity

• Lead and inspire a high-performing engineering team, fostering an environment of innovation in AI and machine learning.

• Drive the end-to-end delivery of validated, production-grade automated workflows to accelerate clinical data analysis.

• Architect a scalable analytics ecosystem that serves as the foundation for enterprise-wide digital transformation.

• Define an AI driven technical roadmap and platform strategy to consolidate, onboard and host a diverse portfolio of future analytics use cases.

• Refine data analytics workflows to ensure high-quality data ingestion, curation, and actionable insights for regulatory filings.

• Empower team members by supporting self-defined career journeys and removing roadblocks to their professional growth.

• Manage senior stakeholders across Pharma Development, negotiating priorities to align technology with business objectives.

• Champion engineering excellence by implementing initiatives that improve collaboration and psychological safety across development teams.

Who you are

• Proven Engineering Leader: You have 10+ years of experience in people leadership or program management, with a track record of building high-performing teams.

• AI & Machine Learning Expert: You possess deep technical know-how in AI/ML frameworks and their application in advanced analytics ecosystems.

• Data Analytics Specialist: You have extensive experience managing complex data content and primary analysis within a regulated environment.

• Technologically Savvy: You have a strong understanding of software development, process architecture, and modern service delivery methodologies.

• Sector Experienced: Y ou bring 2+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry.

• Academic Background: You hold a Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

• VACC Leader: Y ou demonstrate Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach behaviors, effectively navigating ambiguity and complex organizational boundaries.

What you get*:

• Salary range 23,300 - 43,300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 20%).

• Company car or car allowance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Progr

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Team Lead Engineering Primärdatenanalyse, Aggregation und Reporting Das Biometrics-Team ist bei der Entwicklung von Arzneimitteln von zentraler Bedeutung, bei der Verwaltung von Akquisition, Einnahme, Heilung und Analyse von klinischen Studien und realen Daten, um umfassende regulatorische Einreichungen zu ermöglichen. Durch die Sicherstellung der Datenqualität, die Anwendung fortschrittlicher Analysen und die Einhaltung regulatorischer Standards verwandelt das Team komplexe Datensätze in handlungsfähige Erkenntnisse. Ihre Arbeit untermauert evidenzbasierte Entscheidungen, beschleunigt die Zeitpläne für die Entwicklung von Arzneimitteln und sorgt für erfolgreiche regulatorische Einreichungen und ermöglicht innovative Therapien, um Patienten effizient zu erreichen. Als Team Lead werden Sie ein hochperforming Team speerhead auf die Schaffung eines vereinfachten, skalierbaren fortgeschrittenen Analyse-Ökosystems konzentriert. Diese Rolle steht im Vordergrund unserer digitalen Transformation, der Nutzung von KI und maschinellem Lernen, um die primäre Datenanalyse für die klinische Entwicklung zu beschleunigen. Sie werden technische visionäre Führung mit einem Fokus auf die Menschenentwicklung ausgleichen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Daten-Workflows den höchsten Produktionsstandards entsprechen. Die Chance
• Führen und inspirieren ein hochperformierendes Engineering-Team, das eine Innovationsumgebung im KI- und maschinellen Lernen fördert.
• Führen Sie die End-to-End-Lieferung von validierten, produktionsfähigen automatisierten Workflows aus, um die klinische Datenanalyse zu beschleunigen.
• Architekt eines skalierbaren Analytik-Ökosystems, das als Grundlage für unternehmensweite digitale Transformation dient.
• Definieren Sie eine KI-getriebene technische Roadmap und Plattformstrategie, um ein vielfältiges Portfolio zukünftiger Analytics Use Cases zu konsolidieren, an Bord zu bringen und zu hosten.
• Verfeinern von Datenanalyse-Workflows, um qualitativ hochwertige Datenaufnahmen, Heilungen und aktionsfähige Einblicke für regulatorische Einreichungen zu gewährleisten.
• Empower-Team-Mitglieder, indem sie selbstdefinierte Karrierereisen unterstützen und Straßensperren zu ihrem beruflichen Wachstum entfernen.
• Verwalten Sie ältere Interessenvertreter in der Pharma-Entwicklung und verhandeln Sie Prioritäten, um die Technologie mit Geschäftszielen auszurichten.
• Champion-Engineering-Exzellenz durch die Umsetzung von Initiativen, die die Zusammenarbeit und die psychologische Sicherheit in Entwicklungsteams verbessern. Wer bist du?
• Proven Engineering Leader: Sie haben 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Personenführung oder Programmmanagement, mit einem Rekord des Aufbaus hochperforming Teams.
• KI & Machine Learning Expert: Sie verfügen über tiefes technisches Know-how in KI/ML-Frameworks und deren Anwendung in fortgeschrittenen Analytik-Ökosystemen.
• Data Analytics Spezialist: Sie haben umfangreiche Erfahrungen bei der Verwaltung komplexer Dateninhalte und Primäranalysen in einer geregelten Umgebung.
• Technisch Savvy: Sie haben ein starkes Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung, Prozessarchitektur und moderne Service-Lieferung Methoden.
• Sektor Erfahren: Y ou bringt 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- oder regulierten Medizintechnikindustrie.
• Akademischer Hintergrund: Sie halten einen Bachelor- oder Fortgeschrittenen Abschluss in Business, Information Technology oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• VACC Leader: Y ou demonstrieren Visionäre, Architekt, Katalysator und Coach Verhaltensweisen, effektiv navigieren Mehrdeutigkeit und komplexe organisatorische Grenzen. Was du bekommst*:
• Salary Range 23.300 - 43.300 PLN brutto auf der Grundlage des Arbeitsvertrags.
• Jährliche Bonuszahlung auf Basis Ihrer Leistung (Ziel 20%).
• Firmenwagen oder Autozulage.
• Dediziertes Ausbildungsbudget (Ausbildung, Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, diversifizierte Karrierewege usw.).
• Freitagserneuerung (2 Freitage pro Quartal verfügbar).

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chef d'équipe Génie Analyse des données primaires, regroupement et rapports L'équipe de biométrie joue un rôle central dans le développement des médicaments, en gérant l'acquisition, l'ingestion, la guérison et l'analyse des données des essais cliniques et du monde réel afin de permettre des dépôts réglementaires complets. En assurant la qualité des données, en appliquant des analyses avancées et en respectant les normes réglementaires, l'équipe transforme des ensembles de données complexes en informations exploitables. Leur travail sous-tend des décisions fondées sur des données probantes, accélère les délais de mise au point des médicaments et assure la réussite des présentations réglementaires, ce qui permet aux thérapies innovatrices de toucher efficacement les patients. Vous équilibrerez le leadership technique visionnaire en mettant l'accent sur le développement des personnes pour garantir que nos flux de données répondent aux normes de production les plus élevées. L'opportunité
• Diriger et inspirer une équipe d'ingénieurs hautement performante, favorisant un environnement d'innovation dans l'IA et l'apprentissage automatique.

• Architecte un écosystème analytique évolutif qui sert de base à la transformation numérique à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• Affiner les flux de travail d'analyse des données afin d'assurer une ingestion de données de haute qualité, la guérison et des informations exploitables pour les dépôts réglementaires.
• Autonomiser les membres de l'équipe en soutenant des parcours professionnels définis et en supprimant les obstacles à leur développement professionnel.
• Gérer les principaux intervenants dans l'ensemble de Pharma Development, négocier les priorités pour aligner la technologie sur les objectifs opérationnels.
• Champion de l'excellence en ingénierie en mettant en oeuvre des initiatives qui améliorent la collaboration et la sécurité psychologique entre les équipes de développement. Qui vous êtes
• Responsable d'ingénierie éprouvé : Vous avez plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans le leadership des personnes ou la gestion de programme, avec un bilan de la construction d'équipes performantes.
• Expert en IA & Machine Learning: Vous possédez un savoir-faire technique profond dans les cadres IA/ML et leur application dans les écosystèmes analytiques avancés.
• Data Analytics Specialist: Vous avez une vaste expérience de gestion de contenu de données complexes et d'analyse primaire dans un environnement réglementé.
• Technologie Savvy: Vous avez une bonne compréhension du développement logiciel, de l'architecture des processus et des méthodologies modernes de prestation de services.
• Secteur expérimenté: Vous apportez 2+ ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie, ou la technologie de la santé réglementée.
• Contexte académique: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'un diplôme avancé en affaires, technologie de l'information ou un domaine technique connexe.
• Leader du VACC : Vous démontrez des comportements visionnaires, architecturaux, catalyseurs et entraîneurs, naviguant efficacement dans l'ambiguïté et les limites organisationnelles complexes. Ce que vous obtenez*:
• Échelle salariale 23 300 - 43 300 PLN brut sur la base du contrat de travail.
• Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance (objectif 20%).
• L'allocation de voiture de l'entreprise.
• Budget dédié à la formation (formation, certifications, conférences, parcours professionnels diversifiés, etc.).
• Recharger les vendredis (2 vendredis par trimestre disponibles).

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Maintenance Specialist, you will perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electro-mechanical equipment used in the manufacturing process. You will dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches or drawings. You’ll use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts. You will rebuild manufacturing equipment as required. You will also perform equipment modifications as directed by manufacturing engineers. You may use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

The Maintenance Specialist position will entail specialized knowledge of a particular area, system, or equipment and requires specific training and certification. You will apply some advanced skill to the position or specialization. You may adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Your duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks. You will resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels. You will apply basic skills and may develop advanced skills appropriate for the position. Your duties and tasks are standardized. You will work under direct supervision and follow standard procedures to accomplish tasks.
You will also be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Responsibilities:

• Performs troubleshooting to determine problems and may be required to do corrective maintenance. Completes preventative maintenance task according to detailed procedures and schedules. May provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off-hours. Maintain accurate records of all activities.

• Provides technical set-up support for manufacturing areas.

• Performs equipment modifications, including installation, validation support and start-up, of new equipment as well as decommissioning activities.

Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 4 years related operations or manufacturing experience

• In-depth knowledge of company policies and procedures

• Basic computer skills

• Must be available to work Sunday -Thursday (10:30pm – 7:00am)

Preferred:

• Associates degree or equivalent military training

• Documented experience troubleshooting and repairing the following types of systems: electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Indianapolis, is 51,500.00 - 95,700.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, s

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Tipicamente responsabile per i conti medio-grandi o hanno un contingente medio-grande/territorio. Deve sviluppare le prospettive del cliente e creare e mantenere le relazioni con i decisori. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Description of the area
Senior Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) with a focus on Technical Extensibility and Automation. Responsible for the strategic design and operational excellence of the "Requirements to Deploy" process. This role bridges the gap between high-level ALM frameworks and the underlying technical architecture. You will lead the design of custom extensions, workflows, and integrations within the SAP ALM ecosystem (Solution Manager and Cloud ALM), ensuring that the toolset is not just "out-of-the-box" but optimized through advanced development patterns to meet complex enterprise needs. You will provide the technical vision for how ABAP-based ALM tools evolve to support modern DevOps and agile delivery.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
Assume full responsibility in managing Retail customers including field promotion and
business partnership to ensure sales and KPI achievement in Retail Chapter in a cost
effective manner. Develop and implement annual HCP plan and promotions to solidify CS-
NPC leading position in the target market.
負責零售通路客戶群、現場推廣及事業夥伴的全部責任，確保以有效成本達成銷售和KPI績效
。 制定並實施年度Retail Chapter計劃和推廣活動，以確保CS-NPC在目標市場領先地位

Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in
Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security,
Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of
compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.
在進行所有業務活動時，應完全遵守羅氏安全政策、羅氏商業行為準則、羅氏競爭法互動對
話準則以及羅氏安全、安保、健康和環境保護政策，同時展現對合規要求的深刻理解，並堅
持高標準的誠信。

主要工作職責 Main Tasks & Responsibilities :

• Contribute to the formulation of the Annual Sales Plan and develop specific account plans and profiles to maximize coverage, sales and distribution objectives
協助制定年度銷售計劃並製定特定的客戶計劃和資料，以最大程度地覆蓋範圍，銷售和銷售目標

• Develop and implement annual plan and contract for retail customers timely and with quality.
及時並高品質地制定和實施零售通路客戶群年度營銷計劃和合約

• Disease area-based position responsible for developing and enhancing professionalrelationships with healthcare professionals across various specialty networks including endocrinology and so on.
負責疾病領域相關工作，與包括內分泌學等在內的各個專科網絡的醫療保健專業人員建立和加強專業關係。

• Collaborate with the Key Account Team to identify and capitalize on new market opportunities, driving business growth.與關鍵客戶團隊合作，識別並掌握新的市場機遇，推動業務成長。

• Support Portfolio Management / Supports for assigned products
支援產品組合管理/為指定產品提供支援

• Manage retail customers and business partners sales and develop promotions to achieve sales target and KPIs.
管理零售通路客戶群和事業夥伴的銷售並開展促銷活動以實現銷售目標和KPI

• Develop new channels, innovate new sales models, and create cooperation between Roche and other external companies
開發新銷售通路，創新銷售模式，並與其他外部公司之間建立合作

• Visit channels at the required frequency and build strong engagement and partnership with them.
按要求的頻率訪問各通路，並與他們建立牢固的夥伴關係

• Track the results of promotion and effectiveness of field promotion regularly.
定期追蹤區域推廣銷售活動的成果與效能

• Accelerate product off-take in trade and optimize inventory level.
加快商品迴轉，優化庫存水平

• Provide Account sales forecast for order placement and sales tracking.
提供重要客戶銷售預測，以進行訂單投放和銷售追踪

• Well manage M&D budget on Account and business partners.
有效管理客戶和事業夥伴的 M&D預算

• Maintain awareness of market trends, understanding forthcoming customer initiatives and monitor what competitors are doing.
保持對市場趨勢的了解，了解即將到來的客戶計劃並監控競爭對手的行為

• Raise applications of FOC and demo goods from the team, and monitor if applications are written off monthly
提出FOC和展示商品申請，並監視是否每月核銷申請

• Conduct business in full compliance to Behavior in Business and Behavior in Competition.
完全遵守業務行為和競爭行為來開展業務

• Other tasks assigned by Head of CS-NPC
負責人分配的其他任務

Requirements:
Qualifications:

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

• Experience in retail/OTC business management/development is preferred

Education:
University graduate

Working Experience:
At least 3 years retail customers business management experience in medical related field
or consumer healthcare
Skills & Knowledge: Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high
standards

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Service Engineer PE
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Ingeniero de IT en Lima, te unirás a un Squad multidisciplinario para brindar soporte informático crítico y asegurar que nuestros clientes cuenten con las mejores soluciones de gestión de laboratorio . Esta posición te ofrece la oportunidad de impactar directamente en la eficiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología .

Oportunidad

• Liderar la implementación y el mantenimiento de soluciones informáticas para la gestión de laboratorios y conexiones de clientes .

• Brindar soporte técnico preventivo y correctivo, asegurando el cierre oportuno de actividades en el CRM según los estándares globales .

• Colaborar proactivamente con tu Squad para identificar necesidades de hardware, interfaces y viabilidad técnica de nuevas herramientas .

• Participar en la elaboración de proyectos informáticos y material de especificaciones técnicas para clientes y personal interno .

• Gestionar la instalación de servidores, redes, bases de datos y equipos periféricos (lectores, impresoras) en el entorno del cliente .

• Contribuir al cumplimiento de los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) del área de servicios.

• Realizar visitas de campo y demostraciones técnicas junto a los integrantes del equipo comercial cuando sea requerido .

• Atender el servicio de retén una vez finalizado el periodo de aprendizaje de 6 meses .

Quien eres

• Eres profesional titulado en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Informática o carreras afines, debidamente colegiado y con habilidad profesional vigente .

• Cuentas con al menos 2 años de experiencia comprobada en la gestión de proyectos de IT .

• Posees sólidos conocimientos técnicos en desarrollo de software, manejo de redes y gestión de bases de datos .

• Demuestras autonomía, liderazgo y capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente en entornos dinámicos .

• Te comunicas de manera efectiva en inglés a nivel intermedio .

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Site Manager External Manufacturing and Business Operations Lead

titleByLocale.it: Gestione del sito Produzione esterna e operazioni aziendali Lead
titleByLocale.en: Site Manager External Manufacturing and Business Operations Lead
titleByLocale.de: Site Manager Externer Fertigungs- und Betriebsleiter
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de site Fabrication externe et opérations commerciales Responsable

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Roche External Manufacturing group (Commercial Drug Substance) is Part of the Roche Drug Substance manufacturing unit, we Partner with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and ensure that relevant production/manufacturing targets are delivered to Roche on-time, to the highest quality and within-budget and that the CMOs operate in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements and Roche corporate standards.

The External Manufacturing and Business Operations Manager has two main responsibilities: She/he is the primary relationship manager for specified partner Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) or sites. And She/he also acts as Chief of Staff for the unit, ensures strategy deployment is well executed, and carries ownership of the Performance management process for the group.

The Opportunity:

You act as the primary lead and relationship manager for CMOs throughout the entire product Lifecycle, from initial selection and implementation to decommissioning. That means:

• Lead international governance teams across diverse functions such as Quality, MSAT, Supply chain, Legal, and Procurement to ensure organizational alignment during CMO manufacturing, due diligences or Tech Transfers

• Enforce strict adherence to GMP, Quality, and SHE standards while conducting regular risk reviews to proactively address potential supply issues at CMOs

• Serves as the Chief of Staff and advisor to the DS External Manufacturing Head and site leadership team, closely collaborating on efforts to advance the portfolio toward the Drug substance Network vision

• Lead the Performance Management reporting system, including goals/KPIs, PTN Alignment, and the effective execution of weekly, monthly, and Quarterly Business Reviews

• Works closely with Finance and other stakeholders to lead the business planning and track financial performance

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le groupe de fabrication externe de Roche (substances pharmaceutiques commerciales) fait partie de l'unité de fabrication de la substance médicamenteuse de Roche, nous collaborons avec des organismes de fabrication sous contrat (OCM) et nous veillons à ce que les objectifs pertinents de production et de fabrication soient livrés à Roche à temps, à la plus haute qualité et dans les limites du budget, et que les OCM fonctionnent conformément aux exigences actuelles des bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) et aux normes de Roche. Le gestionnaire externe de la fabrication et des opérations commerciales a deux responsabilités principales : il est le principal gestionnaire de relations pour les organismes ou les sites de fabrication à contrat de partenaires déterminés. Elle est également chef d'état-major de l'unité, elle veille à ce que le déploiement de la stratégie soit bien exécuté et elle est propriétaire du processus de gestion du rendement pour le groupe. La possibilité : Vous êtes le principal responsable et gestionnaire de relations pour les OCM tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, de la sélection et de la mise en œuvre initiales au déclassement. Cela signifie :
• Diriger les équipes de gouvernance internationale dans diverses fonctions telles que la qualité, le MSAT, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les services juridiques et les achats afin d'assurer l'alignement organisationnel pendant la fabrication des OCM, les diligences dues ou les transferts de technologie
• Appliquer le strict respect des BPF, de la qualité et des normes de la SHE tout en procédant régulièrement à des examens des risques afin de s'attaquer de façon proactive aux problèmes d'approvisionnement potentiels des OCM
• Chef de cabinet et conseiller auprès de l'équipe de direction de DS External Manufacturing Chef et chef de site, collaborant étroitement aux efforts visant à faire progresser le portefeuille vers la vision du Réseau des substances médicamenteuses
• Diriger le système d'établissement de rapports sur la gestion du rendement, y compris les objectifs/ICP, l'alignement des NPT et l'exécution efficace des examens hebdomadaires, mensuels et trimestriels des activités;
• Collabore étroitement avec les Finances et d'autres parties prenantes pour diriger la planification des activités et suivre la performance financière
• Élaborer une stratégie globale pour une communication efficace entre les équipes, diriger et assurer la gestion des risques dans l'ensemble de la fabrication externe DS, identifier et intégrer des plans d'atténuation dans le portefeuille prioritaire du site Qui vous êtes : Nous avons des attentes élevées concernant la pensée de bout en bout et la collaboration interfonctionnelle dans un réseau mondial en prenant en main et en déléguant les décisions au niveau approprié. Nous apprécions un état d'esprit d'entreprise avec la capacité de changer constamment ou de s'adapter dans un environnement dynamique. Nous espérons que vous vous concentrerez sur le travail le plus efficace et le plus intéressant en priorisant vos efforts en mettant clairement l'accent sur la création de valeur pour le patient. Vous serez prêt à explorer de nouvelles opportunités, être à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et prendre des risques intelligents, tout en respectant les dernières réglementations. En outre:
• Éducation et expérience de base: Baccalauréat en génie ou en sciences de la vie (diplôme avancé préféré) avec plus de 10 ans d'expérience de fabrication/opérations au sein de Pharma/Biotech ou des industries réglementées de la même manière
• Leadership et gestion de projets : 3 ans et plus de rapports directs ou d'équipes matricielles, associés à 5 ans et plus de projets interfonctionnels complexes à grande échelle (la certification de gestion de projets est un plus)
• Expertise technique et de qualité : Compétence approfondie dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF (spécialement une substance médicamenteuse biologique), avec un engagement ferme en matière de conformité, d'intégrité et de Lean Six Sigma/pratiques d'amélioration continue
• Achats et systèmes avancés : expérience démontrée en matière de stratégie d'approvisionnement, de gestion de catégorie et de PGI

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units to develop novel therapeutics that will have an impact on patient lives. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence, the Computational Biology and Medicine department focuses on furthering our understanding of disease pathogenesis, patient populations, and target biology by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across Roche, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated computational scientist to join our Neuroscience and Rare Diseases therapeutic area. In this role, you will be a key member of an interdisciplinary team dedicated to advancing our understanding of neurological diseases. As Roche continues to build and advance its capabilities in computational and data-driven R&D, this position offers an integral role in our strategy. You will identify novel therapeutic targets and biomarkers by analyzing high-dimensional data. You will collaborate closely with leading laboratory scientists and clinicians, contributing directly to a pipeline of innovative medicines for patients with neurodegenerative and neuroinflammation diseases. You will also be part of the wider Computational Biology and Medicine unit of the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence drawing on the shared experience and expertise of colleagues globally.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

• Lead the analysis of high-dimensional datasets such as single-cell, spatial, proteomics, metabolomics, and human genetics data to support therapeutic and biomarker development

• Collaborate closely with the AI/ML Foundation Model development teams and apply advanced quantitative methods, supporting drug discovery projects in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases.

• Deliver clear and objective data-driven insights to inform portfolio decision-making

Collaboration & Strategy

• Contribute to the data and analytics strategy for Neuroscience and Rare Diseases efforts in collaboration with partners in the therapeutic area

• Develop effective working relationships with key stakeholders in the disease therapeutic area, laboratory teams, and computational teams

Team & Culture

• Contribute to a collaborative workplace culture of scientific rigor, continuous improvement, and open feedback

• Support the scientific growth of team members by sharing knowledge and expertise

Who you are

You are a dedicated scientist with a strong background in applying computational methods to biological problems. You are motivated by scientific challenges and have a clear interest in translating data into meaningfu

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences informatiques est une organisation mondiale qui permet aux unités de recherche et de développement précoce de Roches de développer de nouvelles thérapies qui auront un impact sur la vie des patients. Au sein du Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles, le département de biologie et de médecine computationnelles s'efforce de mieux comprendre la pathogenèse des maladies, les populations de patients et la biologie cible en ayant accès aux plus grands ensembles de données sur la R-D pharmaceutique au monde. En partenariat avec nos scientifiques de Roche, nous créons de meilleurs médicaments en augmentant chaque partie de la R-D grâce à notre culture axée sur les données. La possibilité : Nous cherchons un scientifique computationnel très motivé pour rejoindre notre domaine thérapeutique Neuroscience et maladies rares. Dans ce rôle, vous serez un membre clé d'une équipe interdisciplinaire dédiée à faire progresser notre compréhension des maladies neurologiques. Au fur et à mesure que Roche continue de renforcer ses capacités en R-D informatique et axée sur les données, cette position joue un rôle essentiel dans notre stratégie. Vous identifierez de nouvelles cibles thérapeutiques et de nouveaux biomarqueurs en analysant les données à haute dimension. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec des scientifiques de laboratoire et des cliniciens de premier plan, contribuant directement à un pipeline de médicaments innovants pour les patients atteints de maladies neurodégénératives et neuroinflammatoires. Vous ferez également partie de l'unité de biologie et de médecine computationnelles du Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles, qui s'appuiera sur l'expérience et l'expertise partagées de collègues à l'échelle mondiale. Analyse des données et génération d'informations
• Diriger l'analyse d'ensembles de données à haute dimension tels que les données à cellules uniques, spatiales, protéomiques, métabolomiques et génétiques humaines afin de soutenir le développement de marqueurs thérapeutiques et biologiques
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de développement de modèles de l'IA/ML Foundation et appliquer des méthodes quantitatives avancées, en soutenant des projets de découverte de médicaments dans les neurosciences et les maladies rares.
• Fournir des données claires et objectives pour éclairer la prise de décisions concernant le portefeuille Collaboration et stratégie
• Contribuer à la stratégie de données et d'analyse pour les efforts de neurosciences et de maladies rares en collaboration avec des partenaires dans le domaine thérapeutique
• Établir des relations de travail efficaces avec les principales parties prenantes dans le domaine thérapeutique de la maladie, les équipes de laboratoire et les équipes de calcul Équipe & Culture
• Contribuer à une culture collaborative sur le lieu de travail de rigueur scientifique, d'amélioration continue et de rétroaction ouverte
• Soutenir la croissance scientifique des membres de l'équipe en partageant les connaissances et l'expertise Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un scientifique dévoué avec une solide expérience dans l'application des méthodes de calcul aux problèmes biologiques. Vous êtes motivé par des défis scientifiques et avez un intérêt clair à traduire les données en sensfu

jobs.title: China Technical Regulatory (CMC) Policy Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

• Provide Leadership, oversight and execution of technical regulatory policy activities for the Roche Pharma Group relevant to China including the development of Roche policy positions on key topics relevant to Pharma Technical, and effective advocacy of such positions externally.

• Collaborate closely with the regulatory colleagues in China and globally to develop and execute the China regulatory policy roadmap

• Ensure alignment and stakeholder engagement within Pharma Technical Operations, Product Development, Pharma International, governmental affairs as well as external interest groups

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

Identify and enable regulatory policy activities in China such that Roche is globally recognized as an industry leader with health authority agencies and industry peer groups and that significant value is realized in facilitating pipeline development, marketing authorizations and excellence in manufacturing

Build and maintain relationships based on trust and respect with key health authority professionals, relevant academic and opinion leaders and non-profit scientific associations

Establish a strong partnership and networks with internal (i.e. Regulatory, Technical, Quality, Medical,, Gov. Affairs ) and external stakeholders

Ensure the development, execution and communication of the China regulatory policy roadmap

Lead strong cross-functional teams and regional/global regulatory communities of practice to drive policy change in China

Represent Roche technical regulatory policy views in China (and beyond) during external stakeholder engagement

Take leadership in local, regional and/or global associations (e.g. RDPAC, BIO, IFPMA…) and/or governmental organizations (e.g. APEC, ICH) in line with the Roche positions .

Provide leadership and consultancy to Roche Pharma Division leaders on regulatory policy and strategy related topics affecting China

Act as subject matter expert for key technical regulatory policy and strategy areas as assigned, lead the development of specified Global Regulatory Policy positions in close collaboration with SMEs.

Build influencing and advocacy knowledge and capacity and empowers other colleagues to shape the regulatory environment

Core Competencies, Skills
Excellent collaboration skills

Recognized expert in relevant CMC technical/regulatory area with established external credibility as thought leader

Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with global health authorities

Strong team player and communicator

Creates an environment of strong team spirit, good communication, high motivation, inspire cross-functional project teams

Excellent advocacy, communication and presentation skills

Strategic thinking and analytical skills, ability to simplify complex topics and to pull it all together to strategic planning.

Challenges the status quo to drive innovation

Ability to operate successfully in a global matrix environment with shared accountability and responsibilities.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience

Degree in relevant technical area ( Analytical, Biochemistry, Biology, Pharmacy)

At least 10 years of work experience in relevant area or advanced degree (PhD) in relevant technical area combined with a minimum of 5 yrs work experience

Previous experience in Regulatory (Industry or Agency) is preferred

In depth Knowledge of China regulatory environment

Previous participation and proven effectiveness in international regulatory/industry forums is highly preferr

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Business Partner - SPG

titleByLocale.it: Partner di Business Amministrativo Senior - SPG

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Administrative Business Partner - SPG

As a Senior Administrative Business Partner, you will independently manage complex administrative functions, including high-level scheduling, project coordination, managing POs, accruals, and event planning. In this role, you will interact with key internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, to ensure smooth communication and efficient workflows.
By applying your advanced financial management knowledge and proficiency in organizational tools, you will play a significant role in team strategy, proactively streamline administrative processes, and handle a wide range of problems with autonomy to contribute to our operational goals.

Join us in our Warsaw or Poznań office 2 days per week - a hybrid approach designed to balance focused remote work with high-impact, in-person collaboration.

The Opportunity:

• Independently manage complex administrative functions, high-level scheduling, and project coordination.

• Demonstrate advanced knowledge of financial processes, managing POs, invoices, and accruals while providing input on workflow improvements.

• Solve problems independently and take full ownership of projects to optimize efficiency with minimal supervision.

• Interact with both internal and external stakeholders, including senior management and key clients to ensure seamless communication and professional relationship management.

• Support team strategy and operational goals by proactively identifying and streamlining administrative process improvements.

• Manage high-complexity tasks and intricate scheduling for large teams or multiple projects with sharp attention to detail.

• Utilize advanced proficiency in organizational systems, office tools, and project management software to drive procedures.

Who you are:

• Experience in high-level scheduling, project coordination, and large-scale event logistics.

• Proven ability to drive initiatives from initiation to completion with full autonomy.

• Skilled in stakeholder relationship management.

• Advanced skills in office management software and project management platforms to drive departmental efficiency.

• Experience managing financial workflows, specifically PO creation, invoice processing, and financial accruals.

• Strong command of organizational systems and procedures, with a focus on implementing best practices.

• Demonstrated success in identifying and refining operational workflows to significantly increase team efficiency.

• Proven ability to maintain high accuracy while effectively managing high-density workloads and rapidly shifting priorities.

• Flexible availability to align with various time zones and management needs.

• Full professional proficiency in English.

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę).

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter).

• Take Time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more!

INTERESTED? APPLY!
If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

The controller of your personal data is Roch

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Partner di Business Amministrativo Senior - SPG In qualità di Senior Administration Business Partner, gestirai in modo indipendente funzioni amministrative complesse, tra cui pianificazione di alto livello, coordinamento dei progetti, gestione dei PO, accruals e pianificazione degli eventi. In questo ruolo, si interagirà con i principali stakeholder interni ed esterni, tra cui la gestione senior, per garantire una comunicazione fluida e flussi di lavoro efficienti. Applicando la vostra conoscenza e la competenza della gestione finanziaria avanzata negli strumenti organizzativi, si svolgerà un ruolo significativo nella strategia del team, razionalizzare proattivamente i processi amministrativi e gestire una vasta gamma di problemi con autonomia per contribuire ai nostri obiettivi operativi. Unisciti a noi nel nostro ufficio di Varsavia o Poznań 2 giorni alla settimana - un approccio ibrido progettato per bilanciare il lavoro remoto focalizzato con la collaborazione di alto impatto in persona. L'opportunità:
• Gestione indipendente di funzioni amministrative complesse, pianificazione di alto livello e coordinamento del progetto.
• Dimostrare la conoscenza avanzata dei processi finanziari, la gestione dei PO, delle fatture e delle accruals, fornendo al contempo input sui miglioramenti del flusso di lavoro.
• Risolvere i problemi in modo indipendente e prendere la piena proprietà dei progetti per ottimizzare l'efficienza con una supervisione minima.
• Interagire con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, tra cui la gestione senior e i clienti chiave per garantire la comunicazione senza soluzione di continuità e la gestione dei rapporti professionali.
• Supporta la strategia del team e gli obiettivi operativi attraverso l'identificazione proattiva e la semplificazione dei miglioramenti dei processi amministrativi.
• Gestire attività ad alta complessità e pianificazione intricata per grandi team o progetti multipli con una forte attenzione ai dettagli.
• Utilizzare la competenza avanzata in sistemi organizzativi, strumenti per ufficio e software di gestione del progetto per guidare le procedure. Chi sei:
• Esperienza nella pianificazione di alto livello, coordinamento del progetto e logistica di eventi su larga scala.
• Prove capacità di guidare iniziative dall'avvio al completamento con piena autonomia.
• Abilitato nella gestione delle relazioni degli stakeholder.
• competenze avanzate nel software di gestione dell'ufficio e piattaforme di gestione del progetto per guidare l'efficienza del reparto.
• Esperienza di gestione dei flussi di lavoro finanziari, in particolare la creazione di PO, l'elaborazione delle fatture e l'accumulazione finanziaria.
• Forte comando di sistemi e procedure organizzative, con l'obiettivo di implementare le migliori pratiche.
• Successo dimostrato nell'identificazione e nella raffinazione dei flussi di lavoro operativi per aumentare significativamente l'efficienza del team.
• comprovata capacità di mantenere alta precisione, gestendo efficacemente i carichi di lavoro ad alta densità e spostando rapidamente le priorità.
• Disponibilità flessibile per allineare con vari fusi orari e esigenze di gestione.
• Completa competenza professionale in inglese. Che cosa si ottiene:
• Contratto di lavoro (Umowa o pracę).
• Pagamento bonus annuale basato sulle prestazioni.
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione sulla vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport.
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre).
• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).
• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).
• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).
• Aggiunti di acquisto azionario.
• Vendita annuale di attrezzature aziendali e molti altri! Interessato? APPLY! Se sentite questa offerta si adatta ad un tuo amico, sentitevi liberi di condividerla. Il titolare del trattamento dei dati personali è Roch

jobs.title: Country Medical Manager (Ophthalmology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Scopo primario di lavoro (Riepilogo del lavoro) Il Country Medical Manager (CMM) è un partner affidabile, esternamente focalizzato, scientificamente fondato all'interno del nostro modello di customer engagement. Con la costruzione e il mantenimento di connessioni profonde e affidabili con i clienti di alto livello chiave in un periodo di tempo significativo, il CMM genererà l'impatto anticipando e ottimizzando proattivamente la pratica medica, e assicurarsi che Roche è un partner preferito nelle nostre aree di malattia chiave. La funzione medica funge da motore critico di competitività per garantire che le nostre innovazioni raggiungano il loro pieno potenziale per i pazienti con una prospettiva finale. Il ruolo del CMM è progettato per massimizzare le attività mediche e scientifiche locali e di fondo per accelerare la consegna della nostra pipeline, differenziare il nostro portafoglio in base ai dati, guidare l'advocacy strategica, l'impegno della comunità, l'adozione della pratica medica, e l'accesso al nostro portafoglio mediante la capitalizzazione proattiva su "Momenti che Matter" attraverso il ciclo di vita degli asset. Principio ruoli e responsabilità / responsabilità 1. Contribuire con esperienza medica (core & common):
• Competenza medica: responsabile per contribuire attivamente a una forte competenza scientifica, medica e terapeutica nell'ambito delle pertinenti malattie che informano la differenziazione della nostra pipeline e del nostro portafoglio. Agire come esperto medico per la pipeline e il portafoglio durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Strategia di forma: Guidare la parte medica della strategia integrata, modellare una storia di valore, scientificamente sana e differenziata localmente e comunicare i contributi di Roche in aree chiave della malattia, riflettendo una prospettiva aziendale end-to-end che tira attraverso la strategia con impatto. 2. Engagement & Insights (core & common):
• Impegno medico mirato attivo: come funzione medica la nostra ambizione è quella di trascorrere la maggior parte del nostro tempo attivamente coinvolgendo con i clienti esterni come partner nella strategia di coinvolgimento del cliente integrata. Il CMM funge da esperto scientifico e medico, attivando proattivamente TAE di alto livello e altri principali stakeholder in pieno allineamento strategico e operativo con altri ruoli in campo. Nella fase pre-lancio è la priorità di guidare strategie E2E proattive che offrono un'esperienza superiore, anticipare il futuro e modellare la pratica medica di conseguenza. Nella fase post-launch l'impegno continua a garantire che i pazienti giusti siano trattati al momento giusto e la portata di fidanzamento si espande sulle popolazioni dei pazienti non servite. Il coinvolgimento in campo serve come componente fondamentale di questa strategia di overarching per il coinvolgimento scientifico mirato. Si capisce che in base alle esigenze aziendali il CMM può servire come punto di contatto primario per alcuni clienti con l'ambizione di guidare i cambiamenti del sistema sanitario richiesti e dove possibile prima e più ampia adozione del nostro portafoglio trasformativo.
• Partenariato medico & Istruzione: Stabilire e mantenere efficaci relazioni tra pari e genitori con gli stakeholder esterni e identificare/sviluppare collaborazioni scientifiche con iTAE. Fornire corrente, di alta qualità, piano di educazione medica integrata e differenziare le informazioni scientifiche ai clienti esterni, sostenere la formazione scientifica dei team interni e garantire la formazione continua sulle conoscenze mediche per i ruoli PPoC. Condurre scambi scientifici internazionali e nazionali di alta qualità, non promozionali per diffondere i dati pertinenti, promuovere la fiducia del medico e la base di approvazione clinica

Die Position Primary Purpose of Job (Job Zusammenfassung) Der Country Medical Manager (CMM) ist ein vertrauenswürdiger, extern fokussierter, wissenschaftlich fundierter Partner in unserem Kundenengagement-Modell. Durch den Aufbau und die Aufrechterhaltung von tiefen und vertrauenswürdigen Verbindungen mit den wichtigsten Top-Tier-Kunden über einen sinnvollen Zeitraum wird die CMM Auswirkungen durch die Antizipation und proaktiv Optimierung der medizinischen Praxis erzeugen und sicherstellen, dass Roche ein bevorzugter Partner in unseren Schlüsselerkrankungen ist. Die medizinische Funktion dient als kritischer Motor der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Innovationen ihr volles Potenzial für Patienten mit einem Ende der Perspektive erreichen. Die Rolle des CMM ist darauf ausgerichtet, lokale und länderübergreifende medizinische und wissenschaftliche Aktivitäten zu maximieren, um die Lieferung unserer Pipeline zu beschleunigen, unser Portfolio basierend auf Daten zu differenzieren, strategische Advocacy, Community Engagement, medizinische Praxis Adoption und Zugang zu unserem Portfolio durch proaktiven Kapitalisierung auf "Moments that Matter" über den gesamten Asset-Lifecycle. Grundsätze und Verantwortungen / Konten 1. Mit medizinischer Expertise (Core & Common):
• Medizinische Expertise: verantwortlich für proaktiven Beitrag zu einer starken wissenschaftlichen, medizinischen und therapeutischen Kompetenz in den relevanten Krankheiten, die die Differenzierung unserer Pipeline und unseres Portfolios informieren. Als medizinischer Experte für Pipeline und Portfolio während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.
• Shape Strategy: Führen Sie den medizinischen Teil der integrierten Strategie, formen Sie eine vorwärts denkende, wissenschaftlich fundierte und differenzierte Wertschöpfungsgeschichte vor Ort und kommunizieren Sie Roches Beiträge über wichtige Krankheitsfelder und reflektieren eine end-to-end-Geschäftsperspektive, die die Strategie mit Wirkung durchzieht. 2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (Core & Common):
• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: Als medizinische Funktion wollen wir den Großteil unserer Zeit proaktiv mit externen Kunden als Partner in der integrierten Customer Engagement-Strategie verbringen. Das CMM dient als wissenschaftlicher und medizinischer Experte, proaktiv engagierte Top-Tier-TAEs und andere wichtige Stakeholder in voller strategischer und operativer Ausrichtung mit anderen in-field Rollen. In der Vor-Lunch-Phase ist es die Priorität, proaktive E2E-Strategien zu fördern, die überlegene Erfahrungen liefern, die Zukunft vorwegnehmen und die medizinische Praxis entsprechend gestalten. In der post-launch-Phase sorgt das Engagement weiterhin dafür, dass die richtigen Patienten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt behandelt werden und der Eingriffsbereich auf unsere Patientenpopulationen erweitert wird. In-field Engagement dient als kritischer Bestandteil dieser übergeordneten Strategie für gezieltes wissenschaftliches Engagement. Es versteht sich, dass die CMM aufgrund der geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse als primärer Ansprechpartner für bestimmte Kunden dienen kann, mit dem Ziel, die erforderlichen Änderungen des Gesundheitssystems zu treiben und wenn möglich früher und breitere Annahme unseres transformativen Portfolios.
