La position But principal de l'emploi (résumé de l'emploi) Le Country Medical Manager (CMM) est un partenaire fiable, axé sur l'extérieur, scientifiquement basé dans notre modèle d'engagement client. En établissant et en maintenant des liens profonds et fiables avec des clients clés de premier plan sur une période de temps significative, le MMC générera de l'impact en anticipant et en optimisant de façon proactive la pratique médicale, et en veillant à ce que Roche soit un partenaire privilégié dans nos domaines de maladies clés. La fonction médicale est un moteur essentiel de la compétitivité pour assurer que nos innovations atteignent leur plein potentiel pour les patients dans une perspective de bout en bout. Le rôle du MMC est conçu pour maximiser les activités médicales et scientifiques locales et internationales afin d'accélérer la mise en oeuvre de notre pipeline, de différencier notre portefeuille en fonction des données, de stimuler la sensibilisation stratégique, l'engagement communautaire, l'adoption de pratiques médicales et l'accès à notre portefeuille en capitalisant proactivement sur les « Mouvements qui comptent » tout au long du cycle de vie des actifs. Rôles, responsabilités et responsabilités 1. Contribuer avec l'expertise médicale (de base et commune):
• Expertise médicale : responsable de la contribution proactive d'une expertise scientifique, médicale et thérapeutique solide au sein des maladies pertinentes, contribuant à la différenciation de notre pipeline et de notre portefeuille. Agir comme expert médical pour le pipeline et le portefeuille tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Stratégie de forme : Diriger la partie médicale de la stratégie intégrée, façonner localement une histoire de valeur prospective, scientifiquement solide et différenciée et communiquer les contributions de Roches dans les domaines clés de la maladie, reflétant une perspective commerciale de bout en bout qui tire à travers la stratégie avec impact. 2. Engagement et points de vue proactifs des clients (de base et communs):
• Engagement médical ciblé proactif: En tant que fonction médicale, notre ambition est de passer la majorité de notre temps à s'engager activement avec des clients externes en tant que partenaires dans la stratégie intégrée d'engagement des clients. Le CGM est l'expert scientifique et médical, en faisant participer de façon proactive les TAE de haut niveau et d'autres intervenants clés à l'harmonisation stratégique et opérationnelle complète avec d'autres rôles sur le terrain. Dans la phase de pré-lancement, il est prioritaire de conduire des stratégies proactives d'E2E qui fournissent une expérience supérieure, anticipent l'avenir et façonnent la pratique médicale en conséquence. Au cours de la phase postérieure au lancement, l'engagement continue de garantir que les bons patients sont traités au bon moment et que la portée de l'engagement s'étend aux populations de patients non desservis. L'engagement sur le terrain constitue une composante essentielle de cette stratégie globale d'engagement scientifique ciblé. Il est entendu qu'en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, le MMC peut servir de point de contact principal pour certains clients ayant l'ambition de provoquer les changements requis du système de santé et, si possible, d'adopter plus tôt et plus largement notre portefeuille de transformation.
• Partenariat médical et éducation : établir et maintenir des relations efficaces entre les pairs et les parties prenantes externes et identifier/développer des collaborations fondées sur la science avec les EAT. Fournir un plan d'éducation médicale intégré et de haute qualité et différencier l'information scientifique aux clients externes, appuyer la formation scientifique des équipes internes et assurer une formation continue sur les connaissances médicales pour les rôles du PPOC. Mener des échanges scientifiques internationaux/nationaux de haute qualité et non promotionnels afin de diffuser les données pertinentes, de favoriser la confiance des médecins et de favoriser l'approbation clinique

jobs.title: Regulatory Expert / Sr. Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
1.Filling the registration dossiers and get the approval according to the registration plan with compliance the regulations and SOP manner.
2.Make sure the accuracy and truthfulness of the registration dossiers. Maintain the registration and approved dossiers per company requirements.
3.Per company requirements, cross check for the registration dossier to make sure the accuracy and truthfulness of the registration dossiers.
4.Establish and maintain the good and closed relationship with NMPAtesting centers. And successfully gains product QC testing reports per registration forecast plan.
5.Close working together with COand CCOEteamsto provide the regulatory supports on time.
6.Provide the cross cooperation with other department.
7.Establish and maintain the good relationship with key contacts. Recommend valuable suggestion to company.

Main Tasks& 
• Responsibilities:
1.Prepare the registration dossier to submit to NMPA and obtain the approval to meet the registration plan.
2. Make sure the accuracy and truthfulness of the registration dossiers and maintain all the submission and approved dossiers in related IT systems, share points, V drive,and notify all the stakeholders per company SOP requirements.
3.Complete the related payment procedure in systems on time, place order for FOC for the QC testing.
4. Active join the discussion and verification of in the national standard or panel verification or national/industrial standard discussion and verification.Guide and influence the formulation of Standards
5. Working together with global team, to draft the PTR and complete the type testing on time if needed.
6. Active involve the regulation, guidance discussion, provide the feedback to authority aligned with Roche Regulatory Strategy.Guide and influence the formulation of guidelines.
7. As a member of RD, provide active and strong regulatory supports to internal dep. as needed.
8. Initiatively deal with daily works. Keep records. Have clear filing and maintain of all documents, update information on time based on relevant requirements.
9. Productively work-share in multi-functional teams with different perspectives and approaches. Proactively resolve issues; Build effective networks and maintain efficient cross-functional collaboration.
10. Proactively identify and assess regulations and relative changes, and contribute constructive ideas on key project registration strategies.
11. Handle risk assessment, risk levels and risk analysis; Proactively anticipate regulatory risks throughout the product line lifecycle, and figure out the mitigation plan in advance.
12. Figure out registration strategies, and propose innovative registration strategies with appropriately regulation and resources, to accelerate the product launch.
13. Manage stakeholder expectations from BAs' perspective; proactively and strategically facilitate project completion for cross-functional teams while ensuring time limit, budgets and compliance.
14. Other projects or tasks assigned by line manager.
15. Conduct business in full compliance including but not limited to Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, Roche Safety, Security Health and Environmental Protection.
16. Understand and fulfill the responsibility of line manager's SHE tasks and duties (as defined in SHE handbook).

Basic 
• Requirements of the Job
Education& 
• Qualifications:
1. Bachelor degree or above, relevant subject on medicine/bioengineering/clinical medicine/ biochemistry or

jobs.title: Patient Safety Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Job Purpose

The Patient Safety Partner (Lead) is accountable for the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the local PV system for the assigned affiliate(s)/country(ies) and sets the strategic direction for patient safety including risk management within the Affiliate, ensuring alignment with IPS priorities and local business needs.

Key Responsibilities

General

• Lead/facilitate APS strategy and planning to enable effective prioritisation for impact.

• Collaborate strategically with the Country Cluster Lead, Safety Net, Affiliate PV Net, Patient Safety Operations, and affiliate leadership by leveraging country safety insights to determine priorities, shape organisational strategies, and influence regional and global decisions.

PV System

• Act as the local single point of contact for safety-related aspects , internally and externally, including the local regulatory authority.
(In Case of a formal requirement for a local QPPV /Local PV Officer (depending on the wording of local legislation) replace with the following):
Local Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV): As the named and qualified point of contact, the Local Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV) holds responsibility for both establishing and maintaining the local PV system, and for guaranteeing adherence to local requirements mandated by the local Regulatory Authority.

• Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of local PV processes and PV oversight ensuring they are effective and efficient, while driving continuous improvement and alignment with evolving needs and requirements globally and locally. Ensure appropriate escalation and action taken in case of compliance gaps.

• Enable operational excellence and maintain oversight* of safety-related activities relevant to the PV system through collaboration with key stakeholders such as Patient Safety Operations and Affiliate PV Net, by ensuring that day-to-day operations are executed effectively and efficiently to maintain the monitoring of the safety profile of Roche medicinal products and medical devices and their safety risk management, meet regulatory requirements, and ensure license to operate.
Key areas of oversight/activities include the following in line with Roche standard operating procedures (where applicable):

• Individual Case Safety Reports (e.g. data collection and submissions to HA)

• Signal Detection & Signal Management for Local Products

• Aggregate safety reports (e.g. submission to HA)

• Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. PVA, Safety Data Exchange Agreement)

• Risk Management and Safety Communication (e.g., Direct Healthcare Professional Communication, Risk Minimization Measures, emerging safety issues)

• Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., ICT, NIS, PASS, PAES, MAP, PAA, CUP, PTAP, Dicela)

• Safety Labeling and PV Commitments

• (Local) Pharmacovigilance System Master File

*Oversight includes activities to ensure that the local PV system is in line with local regulatory requirements and internal procedures including the review of relevant compliance metrics.

• Lead in shaping country PV regulation and the broader country pharmacovigilance ecosystem according to APS grouping, in particular in order to promote regulatory reliance and international harmonization in partnership with, and not limited to, pharma trade associations, healthcare organizations, patient groups etc, where applicable.

• Ensure business continuity and coordinate APS

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you a visionary scientific leader with a passion for operational excellence? As the Principal Scientist – Lab Head in Basel, you will be the driving force behind our regional Biosample Lab Operations. You will have end-to-end accountability for laboratory activities, integrating innovative technologies with robust business processes to ensure our scientific experiments and sample quality meet the highest global standards.

In this role, you aren’t just managing a lab; you are shaping the future of Biosample strategy, identifying high-impact technologies, and leading a high-performing team to support life-changing clinical development.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Leadership: Contribute to the global Pharma Biosample Services (PBS) Biosample Lab scientific and operational strategies, identifying and implementing innovative technologies and process improvements

• Operational Excellence: Own the end-to-end accountability for lab activities, including sample receipt, tracking, accessioning, processing, destruction and data integrity ensuring all samples are of superior analyzable quality.

• People Development: Direct and mentor a team of Scientific Researchers, designing in collaboration with Ethic & Quality Manager appropriate training strategies, fostering a culture of continuous learning, high motivation, and strict adherence to GCP/Health & Safety standards.

• Scientific Oversight: Design and oversee scientific experiments and workflows, ensuring data integrity and technical precision.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with cross-functional internal/external stakeholders, researchers, study teams and vendors to decide on optimal sample processing pathways. Present solutions to appropriate stakeholder groups.

• Project & Resource Management: Manage cross-functional projects, and resource allocation and prioritization to meet service requests and organizational goals.

• Operational compliance management: In collaboration with PBS Ethic & Quality Manager, manage organization-specific and local EHS-specific policies and regulations implemented in the lab and workflows. Oversee Lab training compliance, SOP accuracy, Lab method, LIMS and other relevant system validations and equipment qualifications.

Who You Are

You are a decisive, service-oriented leader who thrives in regulated environments. You balance a "big picture" strategic mindset with the technical grit required to run a sophisticated laboratory.

• Education: MSc in Science, Healthcare, or an equivalent field.

• Leadership Experience: Minimum of 5 years in a supervisory or leadership role within an academic or industry lab setting (human sample management experience preferred).

• Technical Expertise: Significant experience with LIMS, instrument workflows, and molecular techniques (e.g., DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, RT-PCR, Picogreen/Ribogreen, microarray, protein analysis and other cutting edge technologies).

• Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of GCP/GCLP in the context of clinical development.

• Communication & Influence: Proven ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels and present complex information to diverse stakeholders and executive leadership.

• Strategic Mindset: Demonstrated experience in functional strategy, goal setting, and leading large-scale change initiatives.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to

In questo ruolo, non state solo gestendo un laboratorio; state plasmando il futuro della strategia di Biosample, identificando le tecnologie ad alto impatto e conducendo un team ad alto rendimento per sostenere lo sviluppo clinico che cambia la vita. • Leadership strategica: Contribuire ai Servizi globali di Biosample (PBS) Biosample Lab strategie scientifiche e operative, identificare e implementare tecnologie innovative e miglioramenti dei processi

• Conoscenza delle normative: comprensione profonda di GCP/GCLP nel contesto dello sviluppo clinico.

Sie sind ein entscheidender, serviceorientierter Führer, der in regulierten Umgebungen lebt. Sie balancieren ein "großes Bild" strategisches Denken mit dem technischen Glanz, der erforderlich ist, um ein anspruchsvolles Labor zu betreiben.

• Strategische Mindset: Demonstrierte Erfahrung in der funktionellen Strategie, der Zielsetzung und den führenden großen Änderungsinitiativen. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous un leader scientifique visionnaire avec une passion pour l'excellence opérationnelle? En tant que chercheur principal – Chef de laboratoire à Bâle, vous serez le moteur de nos opérations régionales de laboratoire Biosample. Vous aurez une responsabilité de bout en bout pour les activités de laboratoire, en intégrant des technologies innovantes avec des processus d'affaires robustes pour assurer que nos expériences scientifiques et la qualité des échantillons répondent aux normes mondiales les plus élevées. Dans ce rôle, vous n'êtes pas simplement la gestion d'un laboratoire; vous façonnez l'avenir de la stratégie Biosample, identifiant les technologies à impact élevé, et dirigeant une équipe à haut rendement pour soutenir le développement clinique qui change la vie. L'opportunité
• Leadership stratégique: contribuer aux stratégies scientifiques et opérationnelles du laboratoire Biosample Services (PBS) Pharma à l'échelle mondiale, identifier et mettre en œuvre des technologies innovantes et améliorer les processus
• Excellence opérationnelle : Posséder la responsabilité de bout en bout pour les activités de laboratoire, y compris la réception des échantillons, le suivi, l'adhésion, le traitement, la destruction et l'intégrité des données, garantissant que tous les échantillons sont de qualité analytique supérieure.
• Développement des personnes : Diriger et encadrer une équipe de chercheurs scientifiques, concevoir en collaboration avec Ethic & Quality Manager des stratégies de formation appropriées, favoriser une culture d'apprentissage continu, une motivation élevée et le strict respect des normes de GCP/Health & Safety.
• Surveillance scientifique: Concevoir et superviser des expériences scientifiques et des flux de travail, en assurant l'intégrité des données et la précision technique.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes/externes, les chercheurs, les équipes d'étude et les fournisseurs pour décider des voies optimales de traitement des échantillons. Présenter des solutions aux groupes d'intervenants appropriés.
• Gestion des projets et des ressources : gérer les projets interfonctionnels, l'affectation des ressources et l'établissement des priorités pour répondre aux demandes de services et aux objectifs organisationnels.
• Gestion de la conformité opérationnelle : En collaboration avec PBS Ethic & Quality Manager, gérer les politiques et les règlements spécifiques à l'organisation et à l'ESM mis en œuvre dans le laboratoire et les workflows. Surveiller la conformité de la formation en laboratoire, l'exactitude des PON, la méthode de laboratoire, le SGLI et d'autres validations de systèmes et qualifications d'équipement pertinentes. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader décisif et axé sur le service qui prospère dans les environnements réglementés. Vous équilibrez un état d'esprit stratégique "grand tableau" avec le grain technique nécessaire pour faire fonctionner un laboratoire sophistiqué.
• Éducation : maîtrise en sciences, santé ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience de leadership : minimum de 5 ans dans un poste de supervision ou de leadership dans un laboratoire universitaire ou industriel (expérience de gestion d'échantillons humains préférée).
• Expertise technique: Expérience significative avec LIMS, flux de travail des instruments et techniques moléculaires (par exemple, extraction d'ADN/ARN, PCR, RT-PCR, Picogreen/Ribogreen, microarray, analyse de protéines et autres technologies de pointe).
• Connaissance de la réglementation : compréhension approfondie du GCP/GCLP dans le contexte du développement clinique.
• Communication et influence: Capacité éprouvée d'établir des relations de collaboration à tous les niveaux et de présenter des informations complexes à divers acteurs et dirigeants.
• L'esprit stratégique: expérience démontrée dans la stratégie fonctionnelle, la définition d'objectifs et la conduite d'initiatives de changement à grande échelle. jobs.title: Medical Writer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub is a growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Medical Writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives.

In addition, you will work with Senior Medical Writers and stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs.

The Opportunity:

• Writing and editing medical content for different formats / digital channels and platforms, including: information for patients, educational materials for HCPs (slides, posters, speaker briefs and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports/study summaries, materials for use in public relations teams

• Researching, writing and editing pre-clinical and/or clinical reports, summarizing data from pre-clinical and/or clinical studies

• Assisting in the development of formats and guidelines for clinical documentation and may prepare scientific manuscripts, abstracts and posters while controlling quality and proofreading for scientific accuracy

• Managing multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines and ensuring that the content, format and structure comply with regulatory and other guidelines, as well as with Roche best practices

• Partnering with the Creative Artworker to develop content and partnering with other internal teams, clients, business partners, healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders to understand their business needs and how content creation will contribute to their success.

Who you are:

• You have a degree in Medical Sciences and 2-4 years experience in a similar role.

• You have a native-level written and spoken English , and additional languages (Spanish, Italian, German, French) are a big advantage.

• You have effective time management and excellent communication skills both written and verbal, so you can work effectively across our diverse resources and business stakeholders with a customer-service mentality.

• You have excellent attention to detail, consistency, clarity and scientific rigor, you are able to interpret data and you are accountable and focused.

• You have the ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and the ability to prioritize tasks.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free la

jobs.title: Produktionsmitarbeiter/Operator (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir sind Roche

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten.

Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care ! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen!

In deiner Funktion als Produktionsmitarbeiter/Operator im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du bedienst Bereichsübergreifend Abfüll-, Etikettier,- Fertigungs- und Verpackungsanlagen zur Produktion von diagnostischen Produkten

• Das prüfst die zur Produktion eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Reinigung der Produktionsanlagen und Betriebsmittel unter Berücksichtigung geltender Arbeitsanweisungen

• Gemäß geltender Regularien führst du Inprozesskontrollen durch und dokumentierst diese GMP-konform

• Durch Deine aktive Mitarbeit erkennst Du auftretende Qualitätsmängel, führst vorgeschriebene Stichprobenprüfungen, Musterziehungen und optische Kontrollen durch und arbeitest aktiv am kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess mit.

• Du behebst einfache technische Störungen und übernimmst einfache Umrüstungen

• Alle Aufgaben führst Du unter Beachtung der Arbeitsanweisungen, Hygienevorschriften, Arbeitsschutz-, GMP- und Umweltschutzregeln durch

• Das Arbeiten mit einer FFP3- Maske und einem Gebläse-Atemschutz stellt für Dich kein Problem dar.

• Ver- und Entsorgung der Produktionsbetriebe durch Materialanforderung/-transport, die sachgerechte Kennzeichnung sowie die Entsorgung des Materials liegen in deiner Verantwortung. Dabei nutzt Du manuelle und/oder angetriebene Transportmittel.

• Die Tätigkeit erfordert ständiges Stehen und das tägliche, regelmäßige Heben und Bewegen von schweren Lasten bis 15 kg (unter Umständen bis 28kg).

Das bringst Du mit:

• Eine Berufsausbildung hast Du erfolgreich abgeschlossen und besitzt mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem Produktions- oder Verpackungsbetrieb

• Mit Deinem technischen Geschick überzeugst Du ebenso wie mit Deinen detaillierten Kenntnissen über die zu bedienenden Produktionsanlagen.

• Du verfügst über gute GMP-Kenntnisse sowie über praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten in Bereichen mit besonderen Hygieneanforderungen (z. B. Produktion in einem Reinraum ISO 8 oder höher).

• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse über manuelle Arbeit mit Kleinteilen in der Musterfertigung mit und hast bereits Erfahrung mit Arbeit an Messmikroskop

• In den gängigen Google Suite und MS Office Programmen bist Du sicher. Auch der sichere Umgang mit SAP und MES ist für Dich kein Problem. Du hast ein Grundverständnis für elektronische Abbildungen in prozessgesteuerten Anlagen.

• Deine Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Produktionsteams sowie Dein Engagement zeichnet Dich aus.

• Du verfügst über Transportkenntnisse mit Flurförderfahrzeugen oder Gabelstapler.

• Du arbeitest gerne in wechselnden Arbeitszeiten (3-Schicht), um auf Produktionsänderungen entsprechend flexibel reagieren zu können. Auch die Bereitschaft zur Wochenendarbeit ist

• Mit Deinem technischen Geschick überzeugst Du ebenso wie mit Deinen detaillierten Kenntnissen über die zu bedienenden Produktionsanlagen.
• Du verfügst über gute GMP-Kenntnisse sowie über praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten in Bereichen mit besonderen Hygieneanforderungen (z. B. Produktion in einem Reinraum ISO 8 oder höher).
• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse über manuelle Arbeit mit Kleinteilen in der Musterfertigung mit und hast bereits Erfahrung mit Arbeit an Messmikroskop
• In den gängigen Google Suite und MS Office Programmen bist Du sicher. Auch der sichere Umgang mit SAP und MES ist für Dich kein Problem. Du hast ein Grundverständnis für elektronische Abbildungen in prozessgesteuerten Anlagen.
• Deine Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Produktionsteams sowie Dein Engagement zeichnet Dich aus.
• Du verfügst über Transportkenntnisse mit Flurförderfahrzeugen oder Gabelstapler.
• Du arbeitest gerne in wechselnden Arbeitszeiten (3-Schicht), um auf Produktionsänderungen entsprechend flexibel reagieren zu können. Auch die Bereitschaft zur Wochenendarbeit ist

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Engineering - AI Enablement group within DDC is accountable for… enabling AI! We do this across the board with our scientific and computational partners based on their goals. We help embed our AI strategy across our research organisations by providing employees with the tools and support needed to adopt AI into our daily work—helping us work smarter and enhancing our day-to-day work. We also build and deploy AI-based solutions that reshape and transform business processes to unlock value at scale and optimise workflows. We also work on scaling up model training and inference, evaluating the quality of AI/ML models and output, and building impactful applications which accelerate the scientists doing the critical work of drug discovery and development. Partnering with colleagues to build, deploy and evolve a modern tech stack and utilities to enable our AI/ML and agentic efforts will be a key foundation to our success. Our aim is for everyone who can benefit from AI/ML to be able to leverage that utility where and when they need it, from data analysis to literature search to documentation writing. We are aiming for AI/ML to be an everyday utility. The team is cross-functional, impact-driven, independent, and constantly evolving to meet the scientific needs.

The Opportunity

As a machine learning engineer in AI Enablement, you will be working closely with folks that span the gamut from Computational Scientists, Research Scientists, AI/ML experts, Product leaders, DevOps, and everyone in between. You'll build, own, and constantly improve scalable AI/ML-based systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients.

• Design, develop, and test robust, scalable, and maintainable AI/ML facing scientific web applications and backend systems.

• Build tools to evaluate AI/ML model performance and establish new ways to understand AI quality.

• Partner with product managers and scientists to understand user needs, shape requirements, and translate them into actionable technical specifications.

• Develop and maintain systems for collecting, structuring, and storing diverse scientific data that support advanced analytics, machine learning, and other data-driven initiatives.

• Implement, adopt, or evaluate new AI/ML algorithms and analytical techniques

• Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and the evolution of our development processes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) guida l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi di calcolo e dati e l'integrazione delle tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per consentire ai nostri stakeholder, la scienza basata sui dati di potenza e l'accelerazione del processo decisionale. Il gruppo Engineering - AI Enablement all'interno del DDC è responsabile per... abilitare AI! Lo facciamo attraverso il consiglio con i nostri partner scientifici e computazionali in base ai loro obiettivi. Aiutiamo a integrare la nostra strategia AI nelle nostre organizzazioni di ricerca fornendo ai dipendenti gli strumenti e il supporto necessari per adottare l'IA nel nostro lavoro quotidiano, aiutandoci a lavorare più intelligente e migliorare il nostro lavoro quotidiano. Inoltre costruiamo e distribuiamo soluzioni basate su AI che rimodellano e trasformano i processi aziendali per sbloccare il valore in scala e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro. Lavoriamo anche per scalare la formazione e l'inferenza del modello, valutando la qualità dei modelli e dell'output di AI/ML e costruendo applicazioni di impatto che accelerano gli scienziati facendo il lavoro critico della scoperta e dello sviluppo della droga. Collaborare con i colleghi per costruire, distribuire ed evolvere un moderno stack tecnologico e utilità per consentire ai nostri sforzi AI/ML e agentic sarà una base fondamentale per il nostro successo. Il nostro obiettivo è per tutti coloro che possono beneficiare di AI/ML di essere in grado di sfruttare tale utilità dove e quando ne hanno bisogno, dall'analisi dei dati alla ricerca della letteratura alla scrittura della documentazione. Stiamo puntando per AI/ML per essere un servizio di utilità quotidiana. Il team è interfunzionale, guidato da impatto, indipendente e in continua evoluzione per soddisfare le esigenze scientifiche. L'opportunità Come ingegnere di machine learning in AI Enablement, lavorerai a stretto contatto con le persone che abbracciano la gamma di scienziati computazionali, scienziati di ricerca, esperti AI/ML, leader dei prodotti, DevOps e tutti in mezzo. Costruirete, possedere e migliorare costantemente sistemi basati su AI/ML scalabili che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici, accelerando la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento di vita per i pazienti.
• Progettazione, sviluppo e test robusti, scalabili e manutenbili AI/ML affrontando applicazioni web scientifiche e sistemi di backend.
• Costruire strumenti per valutare le prestazioni del modello AI/ML e stabilire nuovi modi per capire la qualità dell'IA.
• Partner con product manager e scienziati per comprendere le esigenze degli utenti, modellare i requisiti e tradurli in specifiche tecniche attuabili.
• Sviluppare e mantenere sistemi per la raccolta, la strutturazione e la memorizzazione di diversi dati scientifici che supportano analisi avanzate, machine learning e altre iniziative basate sui dati.
• Implementare, adottare o valutare nuovi algoritmi AI/ML e tecniche analitiche
• Contribuire alle decisioni architettoniche, alle revisioni dei codici e all'evoluzione dei nostri processi di sviluppo.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerischen Wissenschaften verwandeln die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das neue Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, diese transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern in pRED und GRED zu helfen, innovativere und transformative Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Innerhalb der CoE-Organisation treibt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC)-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme und die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung an, um unseren Stakeholdern, der stromdatengetriebenen Wissenschaft und der Beschleunigung der Entscheidungsfindung zu ermöglichen. Die Gruppe Engineering - AI Enablement innerhalb des DDC ist verantwortlich für... die KI ermöglicht! Wir tun dies im gesamten Board mit unseren wissenschaftlichen und rechnerischen Partnern auf der Grundlage ihrer Ziele. Wir helfen bei der Einbindung unserer KI-Strategie in unsere Forschungsorganisationen, indem wir den Mitarbeitern die nötigen Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für die Übernahme von KI in unsere tägliche Arbeit bieten – und uns dabei helfen, intelligenter zu arbeiten und unsere tägliche Arbeit zu verbessern. Wir bauen und implementieren auch KI-basierte Lösungen, die Geschäftsprozesse neu gestalten und transformieren, um den Wert im Maßstab zu entsperren und Workflows zu optimieren. Wir arbeiten auch an der Skalierung von Modellausbildung und -inferenz, der Bewertung der Qualität von AI/ML-Modellen und -Ausgang und der Erstellung von schlaggebenden Anwendungen, die die Wissenschaftler beschleunigen, die die kritische Arbeit der Drogenentdeckung und -entwicklung leisten. Die Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen, um einen modernen Technologie-Stapel und -Dienstprogramme zu entwickeln, zu bauen, zu implementieren und zu entwickeln, um unsere AI/ML- und Agentenbemühungen zu ermöglichen, ist eine zentrale Grundlage für unseren Erfolg. Unser Ziel ist es, dass alle, die von AI/ML profitieren können, dieses Dienstprogramm nutzen können, wo und wenn sie es benötigen, von der Datenanalyse über die Literatursuche bis hin zum Dokumentationsschreiben. Wir wollen, dass AI/ML ein alltägliches Dienstprogramm ist. Das Team ist funktions-, schlagzäh, unabhängig und entwickelt sich ständig, um die wissenschaftlichen Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen. Die Chance Als Machine Learning Engineer in AI Enablement arbeiten Sie eng mit Leuten zusammen, die den Galmut von Computational Scientists, Research Scientists, AI/ML-Experten, Produktführern, DevOps und allen dazwischen. Sie werden skalierbare KI/ML-basierte Systeme aufbauen, besitzen und ständig verbessern, die das Potenzial unserer vielfältigen wissenschaftlichen Daten freischalten und die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von lebensverändernden Behandlungen für Patienten beschleunigen.
• Entwerfen, entwickeln und testen Sie robuste, skalierbare und pflegefähige AI/ML mit wissenschaftlichen Webanwendungen und Backend-Systemen.
• Erstellen Sie Tools, um die Leistung von AI/ML-Modellen zu bewerten und neue Wege zu schaffen, um die Qualität von AI zu verstehen.
• Partner mit Produktmanagern und Wissenschaftlern, um Benutzeranforderungen zu verstehen, Anforderungen zu formen und sie in handlungsfähige technische Spezifikationen umzusetzen.
• Entwicklung und Pflege von Systemen zum Sammeln, Strukturieren und Speichern verschiedener wissenschaftlicher Daten, die fortschrittliche Analysen, maschinelles Lernen und andere datengesteuerte Initiativen unterstützen.
• Neue AI/ML-Algorithmen und analytische Techniken implementieren, übernehmen oder bewerten
• Beitrag zu architektonischen Entscheidungen, Code-Reviews und der Entwicklung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Les progrès dans l'IA, les données et les sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organisations de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, en tirant parti des données et des nouveaux modèles de calcul pour stimuler l'impact. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le nouveau Centre d'Excellence des Sciences Computationnelles (CdE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est de tirer parti de cette puissance transformatrice de données et d'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques en pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et transformatifs pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduit à la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données et à l'intégration des technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce afin de permettre à nos parties prenantes, d'alimenter la science axée sur les données et d'accélérer le processus décisionnel. Le groupe Engineering - AI Enablement au sein de DDC est responsable de... permettre l'IA! Nous le faisons de façon générale avec nos partenaires scientifiques et informatiques en fonction de leurs objectifs. Nous aidons à intégrer notre stratégie d'IA dans nos organismes de recherche en fournissant aux employés les outils et le soutien nécessaires pour adopter l'IA dans notre travail quotidien, en nous aidant à travailler plus intelligemment et en améliorant notre travail quotidien. Nous construisons et déployons également des solutions basées sur l'IA qui remodelent et transforment les processus d'affaires pour débloquer la valeur à l'échelle et optimiser les flux de travail. Nous travaillons également à l'intensification de la formation et de l'inférence des modèles, à l'évaluation de la qualité des modèles et des résultats de l'IA/ML et à la construction d'applications efficaces qui accélèrent le travail critique des scientifiques en matière de découverte et de développement de médicaments. Le partenariat avec nos collègues pour construire, déployer et développer une pile technologique moderne et des services publics pour permettre nos efforts d'IA/ML et d'agent sera un fondement clé de notre succès. Notre objectif est que tous ceux qui peuvent bénéficier de l'IA/ML puissent tirer parti de cette utilité là et quand ils en ont besoin, de l'analyse des données à la recherche documentaire à la rédaction de documents. Nous visons à ce que l'IA/ML soit une utilité quotidienne. L'équipe est interfonctionnelle, axée sur l'impact, indépendante et en constante évolution pour répondre aux besoins scientifiques. L'opportunité En tant qu'ingénieur d'apprentissage automatique en Activation de l'IA, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les gens qui couvrent la gamme des scientifiques computationnels, chercheurs scientifiques, experts de l'IA/ML, chefs de produits, DevOps, et tout le monde entre. Vous créerez, posséderez et améliorerez constamment des systèmes évolutifs basés sur l'IA/ML qui libèrent le potentiel de nos diverses données scientifiques, accélérant la découverte et le développement de traitements qui changent la vie des patients.
• Concevoir, développer et tester des applications web scientifiques et des systèmes de backend robustes, évolutives et durables.
• Construisez des outils pour évaluer les performances du modèle AI/ML et établir de nouvelles façons de comprendre la qualité de l'IA.
• Collaborer avec les responsables de produits et les scientifiques pour comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, façonner les exigences et les traduire en spécifications techniques réalisables.
• Mettre au point et entretenir des systèmes de collecte, de structuration et de stockage de diverses données scientifiques qui appuient les analyses avancées, l'apprentissage automatique et d'autres initiatives axées sur les données.
• Mettre en œuvre, adopter ou évaluer de nouveaux algorithmes AI/ML et techniques d'analyse
• Contribuer aux décisions architecturales, aux révisions de codes et à l'évolution de nos processus de développement.

jobs.title: 大客户经理 - MCE
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 您的主要工作职责：
• 1. 执行经销商和药店等商业客户的管理要求。
• 2. 负责区域医院准入计划的制定与结果交付。
• 3. 制定区域项目相关策略及项目实施计划，实现项目助力业务目标达成。
• 4. 结合公司战略与内外部资源，拓展以患者诊疗需求为中心的服务创新模式。
• 5. 协助执行所属省/市招标和价格谈判工作。
• 6.日常工作管理。

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 具备外资医药相关工作经验5年及以上；
• 具备客户管理能力，能够分析区域信息，制定区域业务目标和工作计划能力
• 具备项目管理能力，具有多项目和复杂项目的管理知识，能够资源优化配置，有序推动项目计划
• 具备谈判和影响能力，具有熟练的沟通谈判技巧，能预判风险和制定预案，使价值最大化

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: フィールドカイエンティスト
titleByLocale.en: フィールドサイエンティスト（名古屋）
titleByLocale.de: フィールドサイエンティスト（名古屋）
titleByLocale.fr: フィールドサイエンティスト（名古屋）

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 業務内容
• ・検査機器の設置時のアプリケーションセットアップ業務
• ・検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得のためのサポート業務
• ・医師・コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた関係構築と当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動
• （病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の実施等を含む）
• ・機器 / 試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務
特定の施設への定期訪問というよりは、自身の専門領域＆担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼。及び電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼で、病院や検査センターに訪問となります。ルーチン的な業務に追われるのではなく、営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職よりも検査に関して高度な専門性を持つ役割として、高い責任感を持ち、検査室の検査の質や生産性向上に貢献いただく業務です。

応募条件
• 【必須（MUST）】
• ・普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有し、以下、1〜4いずれかのご経験者
• ・全国転勤可であること

• 1：臨床検査技師資格を有し、病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方
• ※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎
• 2：臨床検査分野の営業（DMR）や、製薬メーカーやCSO、CROでのMR、MSL、CRA等の経験があり、営業ではなく、サイエンティスト（学術）業務に興味がある方
• 3：製薬メーカーの学術部門の経験があり、近年、技術の向上がめざましく、病気の早期発見、治療方針決定、治療効果や予後のモニタリング等の幅が広い臨床検査学に関心をお持ちの方
• 4:　体外診断薬の研究、または製品開発の経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Computational Chemistry/Cheminfomatics Intern - AIDD

Qualifications & Required Skills:
• Education & Core Stack: Master or PhD candidate in Computational Chemistry, Cheminformatics, Molecular Modeling, Machine Learning, or a related discipline. Fluency in Python and proficiency with relevant toolkits.

• Specialized Expertise : Candidates should possess strong practical experience in AT LEAST ONE of the following two areas:
o Track A (Cheminformatics & Representation) : Proficiency in generating, manipulating, and applying chemical representations, such as SMILES, Reaction SMARTS, or equivalent formats. Experience developing Python-based tools and workflows for molecular fragmentation tasks. A solid foundational understanding of organic chemistry and the drug discovery pipeline.
o Track B (Conformational Sampling & Quantum Chemistry) : Experience with automated, high-throughput searches for low-energy conformers in conformational space. • Preferred Qualification (Highly Desired) : Experience or empirical knowledge in structure-based generative modeling, specifically fragment-based molecule generation within protein binding pockets.

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).
The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.
Position Summary

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of content creation priorities. As a Senior Medical writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners across various therapeutic areas and play a crucial role in business development and stakeholder engagement

As a Senior Medical Writer, you will be at the forefront of creating high-quality content for medical communications tailored solutions. The Senior Medical Writer is an experienced subject matter expert, advisor and leader within the chapter. Focussing on specific therapeutic areas in dedicated service teams, Senior Medical Writers are responsible for training and mentoring medical writers, copywriters and content editors within their assigned team - also driving cross-team upskilling and knowledge transfer to grow the capabilities of the chapter overall. This critical position has a global scope and a key component of the role involves acting as a trusted advisor and knowledgeable consultant to our business teams on the topic of medical writing and communications.

Key accountabilities:

• Apply your broad knowledge of medical writing for the pharmaceutical industry, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including medical, scientific, and commercial partners, to understand client needs and develop tailored and effective scientific content for digital implementation

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines

• Ensuring that the content, format and structure comply with regulatory and other guidelines, as well as with Roche best practices

• Monitor assigned tasks and manage own workload, taking ownership and anticipating capacity issues and potential solutions

• As a trained and experienced senior medical writer you will provide mentorship and technical coaching to other medical writers in the team, as well as new writers joining the team

• As a senior medical writer you will be a subject matter expert in pharmaceutical and medical communications as well as lead the team in assigned, specific therapeutic areas.

Key responsibilities:

• Your role will require taking responsibility and ownership for upholding the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines, local and international

• Exercise excellent interpersonal/communication skills for effective and professional liaison with the internal team, clients, healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders and to obtain comprehensive briefs and responses to queries

• Diligently keep u

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about people, communication, and making a real difference in a global organization? If you excel at coaching, building relationships, and solving complex problems, we want you! Join our People Support Solutions team as a Talent Acquisition Specialist and leverage your expertise in human interaction to launch a career in global talent acquisition.

The Opportunity:

• Launch your career in Talent Acquisition by learning to manage the full recruiting lifecycle within a supportive global team.

• Act as a key communication partner for hiring managers and senior leaders, applying your coaching and interpersonal skills to guide them through the hiring process.

• Learn to conduct in-depth candidate assessments, focusing on evaluating core competencies and fit.

• Manage and optimize the candidate experience, ensuring clear, consistent communication from application to offer.

• Utilize advanced HR technology (Workday) to streamline recruiting activities and support crucial data management.

• Collaborate closely on internal talent management efforts, including succession planning and internal mobility, applying a strategic lens to organizational needs.

• Contribute to process innovation, helping us challenge the status quo and continuously improve our talent search strategies.

Who You Are:

• Advanced language skills in German and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory.

• You bring 3+ years of senior experience in a people-focused field (e.g., teaching, therapy, counseling, psychology, advanced customer relationship management, or translation etc.) where strong communication and coaching were central

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science or equivalent work experience is required.

• You possess a strong customer-centric, growth, and agile mindset, thriving in ambiguous and multicultural environments.

• You demonstrate proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to manage expectations and build trust with diverse partners.

• You are capable of working independently, effectively managing multiple, competing priorities, and driving toward results with a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please note that the position official name is Talent Acquisition Partner.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
● This position is primarily responsible for advocating the value of diagnostic products, formulating and executing marketing strategies and tactics. This position will more focus on Liver disease& navify Algosuite portfolios

The area includes Liver diseases portfolio(IM Infectious Diseases, HBV, HCV,HDV, Other Virology and future related ) & navify Algosuite portfolio(GAAD, PROC3ADAPT, and other algorithms such as LGIFlag and Klinrisk in the pipeline)

Role Scope
Develop and execute Marketing plans, business strategies and marketing tactics across the Liver disease& navify Algosuite portfolios to maximize its commercial success

• Identify business opportunities and challenges in the market that addresses customer pain points

• Maintain market intelligence, monitor and analyze product and competitors; and pivot market strategies where necessary.

• Shape reimbursement policies and communicate the value of our product.

• Influence lab and clinician behavior to drive adoption

• Establish annual sales forecast and 3-year business planning for the products assigned in line with the developed strategies.

• Identify executable strategies and translate them into concrete next steps that can be trialed with CST (Sales)

• Explore and experiment with new innovative commercial business models to further support market development efforts

• Organize and carry out marketing events to engage users, clinicians and other healthcare professionals.

• Launch preparation fundamentals based on Launch Power House framework

• Lead cross-functional teams to develop, execute and monitor product launch plan and key milestones, to ensure a successful product commercialization.

• Ability to craft customer specific and compelling product messaging. Includes internal and external public communications on digital , in-person and paper channels

• Clear price and product positioning in identified customer segments, with an understanding of the market dynamics and competitor landscape.

• Ensure that all marketing materials (promotional content, product info, manuals, etc) are compliant with Roche and local regulatory requirements; and available for the CST (sales) team to promote the products effectively.

• Work and prioritize registration requirements with QRA to ensure that requirements are met in regards to local registration, performance and evaluation.

• Develop internal and external training plans and ensuring optimal training execution

• Create and align on the go-to-market strategy with the commercial and support teams, including key performance indicators, segmentation, and account/customer targets.

• Develop and engage Key Opinion Leaders (KOL) in relation to focus product portfolio and marketing initiatives, including healthcare professionals, professional societies, government officials, payers and patients.

• Plan and execute effective product life-cycle management

• Manage marketing and product notifications

• Cross functional collaboration (CST, CSS, SPB&CE, SCM, QRA) during product version changes or phase-out. Understanding regulation update impact with QRA, including product in catalog and pricing, ensuring sufficient inventory with SCM, understanding customer impact and managing this process with CST

• Product pricing management: List price and ASP management..

• Work closely with Customer Service & Support (CSS) and Medical teams to ensure product related technical and medical issues are well handled

• Enterprise thinking to work across pr

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
目标地点：邵阳地区

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责/责任
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a. 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b. 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c. 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点
3. 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育
4. 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
3. 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力与经验
1）岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力

jobs.title: IT Software Engineer - DIA R&D

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur logiciel de TI - R-D DIA

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT Software Engineer - DIA R&D

Who we are:
The CDMA Product Area delivers essential technology platforms that enable clinical trial operations and evidence generation across Diagnostics R&D. We manage the core clinical trial ecosystem (including CTMS and Veeva eTMF) and are responsible for converging these systems into an integrated, AI-ready platform. Our goal is to accelerate diagnostic approval timelines and support the CDMA 2030 vision of delivering trials 15% faster and cheaper.

The Opportunity:
We are looking for an IT Software Engineer who balances high-level architecture with hands-on execution. In this role, you will provide technical expertise for our clinical product portfolio, designing scalable solutions while maintaining a hands-on role in writing code and building complex integrations.

Technical Stewardship & Architecture

• Own the Technical Vision: Design and maintain the solution architecture for our clinical product portfolio, ensuring all systems are scalable, reliable, and secure.

• Platform Lifecycle Management: Assess and manage the technical lifecycle impact of SaaS vendors (e.g., Veeva eTMF, CTMS), including release management, technical debt reduction, and GIS/security compliance.

• Tech Stack Evolution: Evaluate and implement modern tooling, frameworks, and AI-assisted workflows to continuously improve development velocity and clinical operations.

• Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce best practices across the product lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, system monitoring, and rigorous code reviews.

Technical Execution & Delivery

• Hands-on Engineering: Act as a player-coach, spend a significant portion of your time hands-on, writing code, building complex API integrations, and solving the toughest technical hurdles in the trenches.

• Agile & Lean Delivery: Select and manage the right toolsets for the product team. Translate complex business requirements into actionable technical tasks applying Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Lean Programming (LEAP) methodologies to eliminate process waste and continuously optimize development velocity.

• Risk Management: Proactively identify and mitigate technical and architectural risks. Establish and track software quality metrics to ensure absolute data integrity and system performance across all clinical environments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Strategic Liaison: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for stakeholders across R&D and Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA).

• Bridging Tech and Science: Partner closely with the Head of Product to translate the "Digital Endgame" business strategy into executable technical roadmaps.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, solution architecture, and systems integration.

• Proven experience managing the technical lifecycle of enterprise SaaS platforms. Familiarity with clinical systems (e.g., CTMS, Veeva eTMF) is highly preferred.

Technical Skills

• Deep expertise in setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud infrastructure.

• Strong capability to design, craft, deploy, and sustain complex API integrations and data pipelines tailored to business requirements.

• Strong interest or demonstrated experience in integrating AI/ML capabilities or GenAI tools into enterprise workflows.

• Good understanding of cybersecurity and the implementation of secure software development practices.

• Ability

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione IT Software Engineer - DIA R&D Chi siamo: L'area del prodotto CDMA offre piattaforme tecnologiche essenziali che consentono operazioni di sperimentazione clinica e generazione di prove attraverso Diagnostics R&D. Gestiamo l'ecosistema di sperimentazione clinica di base (compresi CTMS e Veeva eTMF) e siamo responsabili della convergenza di questi sistemi in una piattaforma integrata, pronta per l'intelligenza artificiale. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di accelerare i tempi di approvazione diagnostica e sostenere la visione CDMA 2030 di fornire le prove 15% più veloce e più economico. L'opportunità: Stiamo cercando un IT Software Engineer che bilancia l'architettura di alto livello con esecuzione hands-on. In questo ruolo, fornirete competenze tecniche per il nostro portfolio di prodotti clinici, progettando soluzioni scalabili mantenendo un ruolo pratico nella scrittura di codice e costruzione di integrazioni complesse. Stewardship tecnica e architettura
• Proprio la Visione Tecnica: Progettare e mantenere l'architettura della soluzione per il nostro portafoglio di prodotti clinici, garantendo che tutti i sistemi siano scalabili, affidabili e sicuri.
• Gestione del ciclo di vita della piattaforma: Valutare e gestire l'impatto del ciclo di vita tecnico dei fornitori SaaS (ad esempio, Veeva eTMF, CTMS), compresa la gestione del rilascio, la riduzione del debito tecnico e la conformità GIS/security.
• Tech Stack Evolution: Valutare e implementare strumenti moderni, quadri e flussi di lavoro assistiti da AI per migliorare continuamente la velocità di sviluppo e le operazioni cliniche.
• Eccellenza di Ingegneria: Stabilire e far rispettare le migliori pratiche in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, tra cui pipeline CI/CD, test automatizzati, monitoraggio del sistema e rigorose revisioni del codice. Esecuzione tecnica e consegna
• Hands-on Engineering: agire come giocatore-coach, trascorrere una parte significativa del vostro tempo hands-on, codice di scrittura, la costruzione di integrazioni API complesse, e risolvere gli ostacoli tecnici più difficili nelle trincee.
• Agile & Lean Delivery: selezionare e gestire gli strumenti giusti per il team del prodotto. Traduci i complessi requisiti aziendali in attività tecniche attuabili che applicano le metodologie Agile (Scrum/Kanban) e Lean Programming (LEAP) per eliminare i rifiuti di processo e ottimizzare continuamente la velocità di sviluppo.
• Gestione del rischio: identificare e mitigare i rischi tecnici e architettonici. Stabilire e monitorare le metriche di qualità del software per garantire l'integrità assoluta dei dati e le prestazioni del sistema in tutti gli ambienti clinici. Collaborazione trasversale

• Forte interesse o esperienza dimostrata nell'integrazione delle capacità AI/ML o degli strumenti GenAI nei flussi di lavoro aziendali.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position IT Software Engineer - DIA R&D Who we are: The CDMA Product Area delivers essential technology platforms that enable clinical trial operations and evidence generation across Diagnostics R&D. We manage the core clinical trial ecosystem (including CTMS and Veeva eTMF) and are responsible for converging these systems into an integrated, AI-ready platform. Our goal is to accelerate diagnostic approval timelines and support the CDMA 2030 vision of delivering trials 15% faster and cheaper. The Opportunity: We are looking for an IT Software Engineer who balances high-level architecture with hands-on execution. In this role, you will provide technical expertise for our clinical product portfolio, designing scalable solutions while maintaining a hands-on role in writing code and building complex integrations. Technical Stewardship & Architecture
• Own the Technical Vision: Design and maintain the solution architecture for our clinical product portfolio, ensuring all systems are scalable, reliable, and secure.
• Platform Lifecycle Management: Assess and manage the technical lifecycle impact of SaaS vendors (e.g., Veeva eTMF, CTMS), including release management, technical debt reduction, and GIS/security compliance.
• Tech Stack Evolution: Evaluate and implement modern tooling, frameworks, and AI-assisted workflows to continuously improve development velocity and clinical operations.
• Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce best practices across the product lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, system monitoring, and rigorous code reviews. Technical Execution & Delivery
• Hands-on Engineering: Act as a player-coach, spend a significant portion of your time hands-on, writing code, building complex API integrations, and solving the toughest technical hurdles in the trenches.
• Agile & Lean Delivery: Select and manage the right toolsets for the product team. Translate complex business requirements into actionable technical tasks applying Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Lean Programming (LEAP) methodologies to eliminate process waste and continuously optimize development velocity.
• Risk Management: Proactively identify and mitigate technical and architectural risks. Establish and track software quality metrics to ensure absolute data integrity and system performance across all clinical environments. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Strategic Liaison: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for stakeholders across R&D and Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA).
• Bridging Tech and Science: Partner closely with the Head of Product to translate the "Digital Endgame" business strategy into executable technical roadmaps. Who you are: Education / Experience
• 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, solution architecture, and systems integration.
• Proven experience managing the technical lifecycle of enterprise SaaS platforms. Familiarity with clinical systems (e.g., CTMS, Veeva eTMF) is highly preferred. Technical Skills
• Deep expertise in setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud infrastructure.
• Strong capability to design, craft, deploy, and sustain complex API integrations and data pipelines tailored to business requirements.
• Strong interest or demonstrated experience in integrating AI/ML capabilities or GenAI tools into enterprise workflows.
• Good understanding of cybersecurity and the implementation of secure software development practices.
• Ability

• Livraison Agile & Lean: Sélectionnez et gérez les bons outils pour l'équipe produit. Traduire des exigences commerciales complexes en tâches techniques exploitables en appliquant les méthodologies Agile (Scrum/Kanban) et Lean Programming (LEAP) pour éliminer les déchets de processus et optimiser continuellement la vitesse de développement.
• Gestion des risques : identifier et atténuer les risques techniques et architecturaux. Établir et suivre des mesures de la qualité des logiciels pour assurer l'intégrité absolue des données et la performance du système dans tous les environnements cliniques. Collaboration interfonctionnelle
• Liaison stratégique : servir de principal point de contact technique pour les parties prenantes de la R-D et du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA).
• Bridging Tech and Science: partenaire en étroite collaboration avec le responsable du produit pour traduire la stratégie d'affaires "Digital Endgame" en feuilles de route techniques exécutables. Qui vous êtes : Éducation / Expérience
• 5+ ans d'expérience professionnelle en ingénierie logicielle, architecture de solutions et intégration de systèmes.
• Expérience éprouvée en gestion du cycle de vie technique des plateformes SaaS d'entreprise. La familiarité avec les systèmes cliniques (p. ex., le SMC, Veeva eTMF) est très privilégiée. Compétences techniques
• Une expertise approfondie dans la mise en place et la gestion de pipelines CI/CD, de tests automatisés et d'infrastructures en nuage.
• Forte capacité de concevoir, d'élaborer, de déployer et de soutenir des intégrations d'API complexes et des pipelines de données adaptés aux besoins opérationnels.
• Fort intérêt ou expérience démontrée pour l'intégration des capacités AI/ML ou des outils GenAI dans les workflows d'entreprise.
