jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Patient Journey Partner, Ophthalmology
Location: Preference for candidates based in the greater Montreal region.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Join Our Mission in Ophthalmology!

At Roche, we don’t just build networks; we build bridges to better patient outcomes. As a Patient Journey Partner, you will embody our core values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion to reshape the Ophthalmology landscape.

We are looking for a visionary who has the courage to challenge the status quo and the integrity to build deep, trust-based partnerships with our stakeholders. Your relentless passion for networking won't just open doors, it will fuel your curiosity to uncover the "why" behind customer needs. By fostering authentic connections, you will be the catalyst that unlocks innovative collaborations, ensuring that every partnership we forge translates into a meaningful impact on patients' lives.

The Opportunity :

• Acting as the key liaison between stakeholders and Roche, leveraging your influence to foster impactful relationships, trust, and collaboration within the Ophthalmology sector, thereby driving meaningful connections and mutual growth.

• Ensuring appropriate use of Roche's products, sharing benefits and risks with Health Care Practitioners in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Collaborating with cross-functional colleagues to prioritize and plan account activities based on team priorities.

• Partnering across functions to address stakeholder needs, prioritize solutions, and evaluate progress.

• Implementing an omnichannel approach to engage stakeholders with Roche's offerings.

• Participating in a peer-to-peer coaching and mentorship model within self-organizing teams.

• Embracing self-directed learning and experiential growth as part of the working culture.

Who you are:

• You hold an University degree in scientific, economic, or business field.

• You bring 7+ years' of experience in life sciences or healthcare sector.

• You have the ability to build strong relationships with external stakeholders and deliver tailored solutions.

• You demonstrate an understanding of fast-paced, competitive market dynamics and the Canadian healthcare system.

• You prove expertise in stakeholder engagement and partnering, including leading cross-functional teams and leveraging digital tools for improved stakeholder experience.

• You have the ability to travel depending on the business need.

Preferred:

• Advanced degree.

• You have 3+ years experience in pharmaceutical sales or key account management, Ophthalmology preferred.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Roche Institute of Human Biology (IHB) in Basel, Switzerland, is seeking a Postdoctoral Scientist focused on in vitro modeling of human adaptive immunity. The role aims to define adaptive immune cell states in human CNS disease and translate these insights into improved experimental models and future therapeutic strategies.
You will work closely with a computational postdoctoral scientist and collaborate with drug developers across pRED, forming an integrated experimental–computational and translational team. Together, you will combine human multi-omic data with targeted experimental systems to define and validate T- and B-cell states in neuroinflammation, with a central focus on developing in vitro models of meningeal inflammation relevant to diseases such as multiple sclerosis (MS) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD).
This position is particularly well suited for a scientist with strong expertise in human adaptive immunology who is excited to build experimental systems that directly interface with high-dimensional datasets.

The Opportunity
As a Postdoctoral Scientist, you will pursue your research within the IHB’s highly collaborative open-lab environment. You will lead experimental efforts to generate, validate, and functionally interrogate immune cell states to model human CNS and meningeal tissues, while working iteratively with computational colleagues. In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

Experimental Immunology & Model Systems:

• Design and execute experimental strategies to investigate adaptive immune responses in human neuroinflammation, with a focus on T-, B-, and stromal-cell biology within tissue-relevant contexts.

• Develop and implement in vitro model systems that recapitulate key features of CNS meningeal inflammation, including immune–stromal interactions and TLS-like organization, and model disease-relevant immune responses in contexts such as multiple sclerosis (MS) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD).

• Perform deep immune phenotyping and generate multi-omic datasets (e.g., flow cytometry, single-cell RNA-seq, V(D)J profiling) to characterize immune–stromal interactions, define adaptive immune cell states, and functionally validate and refine in vitro models aligned with human atlases and translational goals.

Scientific Growth & Translation:

• Partner closely with computational scientists to translate atlas-derived cell states into experimentally testable hypotheses and iteratively refine in vitro models based on human data.

• Engage with teams across IHB and pRED—including direct exposure to drug developers—to align experimental findings with translational questions in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases and contribute to long-term portfolio impact.

• Communicate findings through scientific manuscripts, presentations, and cross-functional discussions, clearly articulating experimental insights and their relevance to human biology and therapeutic strategy.

Who You Are
You are a hands-on experimental scientist with a strong foundation in immunology and a deep interest in human disease biology. You enjoy working collaboratively with computational scientists and are motivated by the opportunity to generate data that directly informs systems-level understanding.
You are excited not only by profiling human immune responses, but also by building experimental systems that capture key features of tissue-specific immunity, including meningeal inflammation and ectopic lymphoid structure-like biology. Furthermore, You bring:

• A Ph.D. in Immunol

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Istituto Roche di Biologia Umana (IHB) di Basilea, in Svizzera, sta cercando uno scienziato post-dottorato focalizzato sulla modellazione in vitro dell'immunità adattativa umana. Il ruolo mira a definire gli stati delle cellule immunitarie adattativi nella malattia del CNS umano e a tradurre queste intuizioni in modelli sperimentali migliorati e future strategie terapeutiche. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con uno scienziato computazionale post-dottorato e collaborare con gli sviluppatori di droga attraverso pRED, formando un team sperimentale-computazionale e traduttivo integrato. Insieme, si combinano dati umani multi-omici con sistemi sperimentali mirati per definire e convalidare gli stati T- e B-cell in neuroinflammazione, con un focus centrale sullo sviluppo di modelli in vitro di infiammazione meningeale rilevanti per le malattie come la sclerosi multipla (MS) e la malattia di Alzheimer (AD). Questa posizione è particolarmente adatta per uno scienziato con una forte esperienza nell'immunologia adattativa umana che è entusiasta di costruire sistemi sperimentali che si interfacciano direttamente con dataset ad alta dimensione. L'opportunità Come scienziato post-dottorato, si persegue la vostra ricerca all’interno dell’ambiente open-lab altamente collaborativo di IHB. Condurrai gli sforzi sperimentali per generare, convalidare e interrogare funzionale gli stati delle cellule immunitarie per modellare i tessuti CNS e meningeali umani, mentre lavori in modo iterativo con i colleghi computazionali. In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di: Immunologia sperimentale e sistemi di modello:
• Progettare ed eseguire strategie sperimentali per indagare le risposte immunitarie adattative nella neuroinfiammazione umana, con un focus sulla biologia T-, B- e stromal-cell all'interno di contesti di tessuto-relativi.
• Sviluppare e implementare sistemi di modello in vitro che ricapitolano le caratteristiche chiave dell'infiammazione meningeale CNS, comprese le interazioni immunitarie-stromiche e l'organizzazione TLS-like, e modellare le risposte immunitarie rilevanti della malattia in contesti come la sclerosi multipla (MS) e la malattia di Alzheimer (AD).
• Eseguire la fenotipazione immunitaria profonda e generare set di dati multi-omici (ad esempio, citometria di flusso, RNA-seq monocellulare, profilazione V(D)J) per caratterizzare le interazioni immuno-stromiche, definire stati di cellule immunitarie adattative, e validare e perfezionare in modelli vitro allineati con atlanti umani e obiettivi traduttivi. Crescita scientifica e traduzione:
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli scienziati computazionali per tradurre gli stati cellulari derivati da atlanti in ipotesi sperimentali e perfezionare in modo iterativo i modelli vitro basati sui dati umani.
• Coinvolgere con i team di IHB e PRED, compresa l'esposizione diretta agli sviluppatori di droga, per allineare i risultati sperimentali con domande traduttive in Neuroscience e Malattie Rare e contribuire all'impatto del portafoglio a lungo termine.
• Comunicare i risultati attraverso manoscritti scientifici, presentazioni e discussioni interfunzionali, chiaramente articolando intuizioni sperimentali e la loro rilevanza per la biologia umana e la strategia terapeutica. Chi sei Sei uno scienziato sperimentale pratico con una forte fondazione in immunologia e un profondo interesse per la biologia delle malattie umane. Ti piace lavorare in collaborazione con scienziati computazionali e sono motivati dall'opportunità di generare dati che informano direttamente la comprensione del livello di sistemi. Sei emozionato non solo profilando le risposte immunitarie umane, ma anche costruendo sistemi sperimentali che catturano le caratteristiche chiave dell'immunità specifica del tessuto, tra cui l'infiammazione meningeale e la biologia linfoide ectopica. Inoltre, Lei porta:
• Un dottorato in Immunol

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Das Roche Institute of Human Biology (IHB) in Basel, Schweiz, sucht einen Postdoktoranden, der sich auf die in vitro Modellierung menschlicher adaptiver Immunität konzentriert. Die Rolle zielt darauf ab, adaptive Immunzellenzustände in der menschlichen CNS-Krankheit zu definieren und diese Erkenntnisse in verbesserte experimentelle Modelle und zukünftige therapeutische Strategien umzusetzen. Sie arbeiten eng mit einem rechnerischen Postdoktoranden zusammen und kooperieren mit Medikamentenentwicklern über pRED und bilden ein integriertes experimentell-komputatives und translatorisches Team. Zusammen werden Sie humane multi-omische Daten mit gezielten experimentellen Systemen kombinieren, um T- und B-Zellzustände in der Neuroinflammation zu definieren und zu validieren, mit einem zentralen Schwerpunkt auf der Entwicklung von in vitro-Modellen von meningealen Entzündungen, die für Krankheiten wie Multiple Sklerose (MS) und Alzheimer-Krankheit (AD) relevant sind. Diese Position eignet sich besonders gut für einen Wissenschaftler mit hohem Know-how in der human adaptiven Immunologie, der erregt ist, experimentelle Systeme aufzubauen, die direkt mit hochdimensionalen Datensätzen verbunden sind. Die Chance Als Postdoctoral Scientist verfolgen Sie Ihre Forschung im hochkollaborativen Open-Lab-Umfeld der IHB. Sie führen experimentelle Anstrengungen, um Immunzellenzustände zu erzeugen, zu validieren und funktionell zu verhören, um menschliche CNS und Meningealgewebe zu modellieren, während Sie iterativ mit rechnerischen Kollegen arbeiten. In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit: Experimentelle Immunologie & Modellsysteme:
• Erarbeitung und Durchführung von experimentellen Strategien zur Untersuchung adaptiver Immunantworten bei der humanen Neuroentzündung, mit einem Fokus auf T-, B- und stromalzellige Biologie in geweberelevanten Kontexten.
• Entwickeln und implementieren in-vitro-Modellsysteme, die Schlüsselmerkmale der CNS-Meningealentzündung, einschließlich immun-stromale Wechselwirkungen und TLS-ähnliche Organisation, und Modell krankheitsrelevante Immunreaktionen in Kontexten wie Multiple Sklerose (MS) und Alzheimer-Krankheit (AD).
• Führen Sie tiefe Immun-Phänotypisierung durch und erzeugen Sie multi-omische Datensätze (z.B. Flusszytometrie, einzellige RNA-Seq, V(D)J-Profiling), um immun-stromale Wechselwirkungen zu charakterisieren, adaptive Immunzellenzustände zu definieren und in vitro-Modelle funktionell zu validieren und zu verfeinern, die mit menschlichen Atlasen und Translationszielen ausgerichtet sind. Wissenschaftliches Wachstum und Übersetzung:
• Partner eng mit rechnerischen Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um atlasabhängige Zellzustände in experimentell testbare Hypothesen zu übersetzen und in vitro-Modelle auf Basis menschlicher Daten iterativ zu verfeinern.
• Vernetzen Sie sich mit Teams über IHB und pRED – einschließlich direkter Exposition gegenüber Drogenentwicklern –, um experimentelle Erkenntnisse mit Translationsfragen in Neurowissenschaften und Seltenen Krankheiten auszurichten und zu langfristigen Portfolio-Wirkungen beizutragen.
• Befunde durch wissenschaftliche Handschriften, Präsentationen und funktionsübergreifende Diskussionen kommunizieren, experimentelle Erkenntnisse und ihre Relevanz für die menschliche Biologie und therapeutische Strategie klar artikulieren. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein Experimentalwissenschaftler mit einer starken Grundlage in der Immunologie und einem tiefen Interesse an der Biologie der menschlichen Krankheit. Sie genießen die Zusammenarbeit mit rechnerischen Wissenschaftlern und sind von der Möglichkeit motiviert, Daten zu generieren, die das System-Level-Verstehen direkt informieren. Sie sind begeistert nicht nur durch das Profilieren menschlicher Immunreaktionen, sondern auch durch den Aufbau von experimentellen Systemen, die wichtige Merkmale der gewebespezifischen Immunität erfassen, einschließlich Meningealentzündung und ektopischer lymphoider strukturähnlicher Biologie. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie:
• Ein Doktor in Immunol

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'Institut Roche de Biologie Humaine (IHB) de Bâle, en Suisse, cherche un scientifique postdoctoral axé sur la modélisation in vitro de l'immunité adaptative humaine. Le rôle vise à définir les états des cellules immunitaires adaptatives dans la maladie du SNC humaine et à traduire ces connaissances en modèles expérimentaux améliorés et en stratégies thérapeutiques futures. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec un chercheur postdoctoral computationnel et collaborerez avec des développeurs de médicaments à travers pRED, formant une équipe expérimentale-computationnelle et translationnelle intégrée. Ensemble, vous combinerez des données multi-omiques humaines avec des systèmes expérimentaux ciblés pour définir et valider les états des cellules T et B dans la neuroinflammation, en mettant l'accent sur le développement de modèles in vitro d'inflammation méningéale pertinents aux maladies telles que la sclérose en plaques (SM) et la maladie d'Alzheimer (AD). Cette position est particulièrement bien adaptée pour un scientifique ayant une solide expertise en immunologie adaptative humaine qui est excité de construire des systèmes expérimentaux qui s'interfacent directement avec des ensembles de données haute dimension. L'opportunité En tant que chercheur postdoctoral, vous poursuivrez vos recherches dans le cadre de l'environnement de laboratoire ouvert hautement collaboratif de l'IHB. Vous dirigerez des efforts expérimentaux pour générer, valider et interroger fonctionnellement les états de cellules immunitaires pour modéliser le SNC humain et les tissus méningés, tout en travaillant itérativement avec des collègues calculateurs. Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion : Immunologie expérimentale et systèmes modèles :
• Concevoir et exécuter des stratégies expérimentales pour étudier les réponses immunitaires adaptatives dans la neuroinflammation humaine, en mettant l'accent sur la biologie des cellules T, B et stromiques dans des contextes pertinents aux tissus.
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des systèmes modèles in vitro qui récapitulent les principales caractéristiques de l'inflammation méningéale du SNC, y compris les interactions immuno-stromiques et l'organisation similaire au SLT, ainsi que des réponses immunitaires modèles liées à la maladie dans des contextes tels que la sclérose en plaques (SM) et la maladie d'Alzheimer (AD).
• Effectuer des phénotypages immunitaires profonds et générer des ensembles de données multi-omiques (par exemple, cytométrie en flux, profilage RNA-seq monocellulaire, V(D)J) pour caractériser les interactions immuno-stromiques, définir les états immunitaires adaptatifs, valider et affiner fonctionnellement les modèles in vitro alignés sur les atlas humains et les objectifs translationnels. Croissance scientifique et traduction :
• S'associer étroitement avec les chercheurs en calcul pour traduire les états cellulaires dérivés de l'atlas en hypothèses testables expérimentalement et affiner les modèles in vitro à partir de données humaines.
• S'engager avec les équipes de l'IAB et du PRED – y compris l'exposition directe aux développeurs de médicaments – pour aligner les résultats expérimentaux sur les questions translationnelles dans les neurosciences et les maladies rares et contribuer à l'impact à long terme du portefeuille.
• Communiquer les résultats au moyen de manuscrits scientifiques, de présentations et de discussions interfonctionnelles, en articulant clairement les idées expérimentales et leur pertinence pour la biologie humaine et la stratégie thérapeutique. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un scientifique expérimental avec une base solide en immunologie et un profond intérêt pour la biologie des maladies humaines. Vous aimez travailler en collaboration avec des chercheurs en calcul et êtes motivé par l'occasion de générer des données qui informe directement la compréhension au niveau des systèmes. jobs.title: Post Doctoral Scientist (IHB) - Computational Immunology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Roche Institute of Human Biology (IHB) in Basel, Switzerland, is seeking a Postdoctoral Scientist in Computational Biology/Immunology to join a cross-functional research effort focused on building a human atlas of CNS meningeal inflammation. This work aims to generate a deeper understanding of immune cell states in human disease and translate those insights into improved experimental models and future therapeutic strategies.
The successful candidate will be housed within the IHB and work in close collaboration with colleagues across the Institute as well as with partners across pRED, including the Neuroscience and Rare Diseases Therapeutic Area and the Computational Center of Excellence. The role is designed to help bridge foundational human biology research at the IHB with translational questions relevant to the portfolio.
This position will particularly suit a scientist excited by the opportunity to combine computational analysis, immunology, and human multi-omic data to address important questions in neuroinflammation and immune-mediated diseases.

The Opportunity
As a Postdoctoral Scientist, you will pursue your research within the IHB’s highly collaborative open-lab environment. You will contribute to an interdisciplinary effort to define immune cell states, repertoires, and molecular programs across human neuroinflammatory settings, with a particular focus on deriving insights that can benchmark and refine future in vitro model systems developed by the team.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Scientific Leadership:
Lead computational research projects focused on immune cell state biology in human neuroinflammation, integrating multi-omic datasets to uncover mechanisms relevant to disease and therapeutic intervention.

• Atlas Building:
Contribute to the development of a comprehensive human atlas of neuroinflammation, identifying cellular states and molecular signatures associated with healthy and diseased donor or patient outcomes.

• Innovation:
Apply computational and biological insight to high-dimensional datasets, including single-cell, repertoire, and spatial profiling approaches, to generate hypotheses and guide future translational research.

• Immune Profiling:
Drive analyses of T- and B-cell repertoires and high-throughput single-cell B cell receptor (BCR) repertoire profiling, including AIRR-seq, Rep-seq, and scRNA-seq + VDJ datasets.

• Collaboration:
Partner closely with scientists across IHB and pRED, including colleagues in Neuroscience and Rare Disease, to help translate human biology findings into portfolio-relevant questions and experimental strategies.

• Communication:
Contribute to scientific manuscripts, internal presentations, and external conference presentations, clearly communicating computational and biological findings to diverse audiences.

• Mentorship and Team Science:
Support a collaborative and inclusive research culture by working across functions and

Who You Are
You thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment that gives you ownership of your scientific contributions while encouraging strong partnership across disciplines. You are proactive, curious, and solution-oriented, with the ability to work independently and engage productively with experimental and computational colleagues alike. You are motivated by the opportunity to generate insight from complex datasets and translate those findings into meaningful biological and therapeutic understanding.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Das Roche Institute of Human Biology (IHB) in Basel, Schweiz, sucht einen Postdoktoranden in der Computational Biology/Immunology, der sich mit einem funktionsübergreifenden Forschungsanstrengung befasst, um einen menschlichen Atlas der CNS Meningealentzündung aufzubauen. Diese Arbeit zielt darauf ab, ein tieferes Verständnis von Immunzellenzuständen in der menschlichen Krankheit zu erzeugen und diese Erkenntnisse in verbesserte experimentelle Modelle und zukünftige therapeutische Strategien umzusetzen. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird in der IHB untergebracht und arbeitet in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen am Institut sowie mit Partnern über pRED, einschließlich der Neurowissenschaften und Seltenen Krankheiten Therapeutic Area und dem Computational Center of Excellence. Die Rolle soll helfen, die Grundlagenforschung der Humanbiologie am IHB mit für das Portfolio relevanten Translationsfragen zu überbrücken. Diese Position wird besonders an einen Wissenschaftler herankommen, der von der Möglichkeit begeistert ist, rechnerische Analysen, Immunologie und humane multi-omische Daten zu kombinieren, um wichtige Fragen bei der Neuroentzündung und immunvermittelten Erkrankungen zu beantworten. Die Chance Als Postdoctoral Scientist verfolgen Sie Ihre Forschung im hochkollaborativen Open-Lab-Umfeld der IHB. Sie werden zu einem interdisziplinären Bemühen beitragen, Immunzellenzustände, Repertoires und molekulare Programme über menschliche neuroinflammatorische Einstellungen zu definieren, mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf der Ableitung von Erkenntnissen, die zukünftige in-vitro-Modellsysteme, die vom Team entwickelt werden, Benchmark und verfeinern können. In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit:
• Wissenschaftliche Führung: Führen Sie computergestützte Forschungsprojekte, die auf die Immunzellen-Zustandsbiologie in der humanen Neuroinflammation konzentriert sind und multi-omische Datensätze integrieren, um Mechanismen für Krankheit und therapeutische Intervention aufzudecken.
• Atlas-Gebäude: Beitrag zur Entwicklung eines umfassenden menschlichen Atlas der Neuroentzündung, zur Identifizierung von zellulären Zuständen und molekularen Signaturen, die mit gesunden und kranken Spender oder Patientenergebnissen verbunden sind.
• Innovation: Nutzen Sie rechnerische und biologische Erkenntnisse zu hochdimensionalen Datensätzen, einschließlich Einzell-, Repertoire- und Raumprofilierungsansätzen, um Hypothesen zu erzeugen und zukünftige Translationsforschung zu führen.
• Immune Profiling: Drive-Analysen von T- und B-Zell-Repertoiren und hochdurchsatz-Einzelzell-B-Zellrepertoire-Profiling, einschließlich AIRR-Seq, Rep-seq und scRNA-seq + VDJ-Datensätzen.
• Zusammenarbeit: eng mit Wissenschaftlern über IHB und pRED, darunter Kollegen in Neurowissenschaften und Seltenerkrankungen, zusammenarbeiten, um menschliche Biologie-Ergebnisse in portfoliorelevante Fragen und experimentelle Strategien zu übersetzen.
• Kommunikation: Beitrag zu wissenschaftlichen Manuskripten, internen Präsentationen und externen Konferenzvorträgen, übersichtlich rechnerische und biologische Erkenntnisse an unterschiedliche Publikum.
• Mentorship and Team Science: Unterstützen Sie eine kollaborative und integrative Forschungskultur, indem Sie über Funktionen arbeiten und wer Sie sind, in einem dynamischen, kollaborativen Umfeld, das Ihnen das Eigentum an Ihren wissenschaftlichen Beiträgen gibt, und fördern Sie eine starke Partnerschaft über Disziplinen hinweg. Sie sind proaktiv, neugierig und lösungsorientiert, mit der Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten und produktiv mit experimentellen und rechnerischen Kollegen gleichermaßen zu engagieren. Sie sind motiviert durch die Möglichkeit, Erkenntnisse aus komplexen Datensätzen zu generieren und diese Erkenntnisse in ein sinnvolles biologisches und therapeutisches Verständnis zu übersetzen. Sie arbeiten bequem an der Schnittstelle

jobs.title: Intern-Roche Data, Digital and Privacy
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location: Shanghai

Job Description：
Who We Are:
At Roche, we are dedicated to transforming healthcare and improving patient lives. Our Legal team plays a crucial role in ensuring that we comply with regulations and standards, while driving innovation in digital health and artificial intelligence (AI). As a member of our global Legal team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects and collaborate with diverse teams, driving our commitment to ethical and compliant AI and digital solutions.

The Position:

• We are seeking an intern with keen interest in privacy, digital and AI based in Shanghai to support our global legal team. This role supports our global legal counsels in managing the rapidly evolving digital, privacy, and security frameworks within the APAC region. The ideal candidate possesses a solid foundational understanding of technology law and a keen interest in the healthcare industry.

Key Responsibilities:

• Monitor digital, privacy and security-related legislative and regulatory developments across APAC.

• Assist supervising counsels in legal analysis on various AI, IT, digital and security matters, including data economy, data privacy, intellectual property, and compliance risks.

• Support privacy operations for the APAC region.

• Conduct other ad hoc research on personal data protection/privacy laws and AI governance laws.

Who You Are:

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in law plus Bar Exam, ideally with a focus on technology law, data privacy, or a related field.

• Available 3-4 days per week from mid-May 2026 to 30 November 2026

• Skills:

• Strong communication skills, fluent in both spoken and written English and Mandarin.

• Openness to work across geographical time-zones and cultures.

• Self-motivated with a strong sense of responsibility and ownership.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: (Senior) Analyst, Analytical Lab, Biologics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the physical and chemical testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Analytical Testing lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance. Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to, internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

• Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

• Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.

● By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies

• Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Analytical method transfer execution: Support and execute the analytical method transfer for the aseptic product.

• Analytical Method Validation and Qualification: Execute the methods comparison, qualification and validation activities.

• Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies
● 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
● Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.
● Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.
● Fluent communications skills in English
● Project management skills is preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Domain Architect - Dia R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Domain Architect - Diagnostics R&D

The Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D is a senior-level, key position within the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This position plays a critical role between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the Diagnostics R&D function. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Head of Dia RDT for DIA R&D, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of the Diagnostics R&D environment.
Crucially, in our federated Roche Digital Technology (RDT) model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Diagnostics R&D architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain and solution architects embedded directly within the Diagnostics R&D organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready roadmaps.

Description of the Area

The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural point of contact for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Diagnostics R&D domain, this involves deeply integrating with teams such as DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, and DIA Portfolio & Project Management to drive efficiency and innovation with end-to-end accountability. This role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and Diagnostics R&D’s operational execution is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

The Opportunity:

• You will act as the strategic liaison between SPG EA and Diagnostics R&D, partnering with leadership to align business priorities with multi-year roadmaps.

• You lead the Diagnostics R&D architecture network, shaping shared strategic priorities and enabling architects to execute while maintaining enterprise alignment.

• You provide leadership for architecture governance activities, overseeing deliverables and technology guardrails to ensure security and resilience.

• You drive the success of large, critical technology programs by translating strategy into actionable, transformative initiatives that deliver business value.

• You develop and maintain core architecture artifacts, including Capability Maps and Target-State Architectures, using the standard RDT toolchain.

• You partner with Portfolio Management to embed architectural insights into investment decisions, maximizing platform reuse and managing technical debt.

• You monitor emerging technology trends and evaluate vendors to ensure the Diagnostics R&D architecture remains innovative and future-ready.

• You influence a complex, federated RDT model, balancing enterprise coherence with the agility required for local operational execution.

Who you are:

• You hold a Master’s degree and bring 7+ years of experience in IT and enterprise architecture, specifically within complex, matrixed, or federated global organizations.

• You possess deep domain experience in Diagnostics R&D, with a comprehensive understanding of the scientific, clinical, and engineering processes—from computational science and instrumentation to dry & wet laboratory op

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Domain Architect - Diagnostics R&D The Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D è una posizione chiave nel team di Strategy, Portfolio & Governance Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions. Questa posizione svolge un ruolo critico tra l'organizzazione Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) e la funzione Diagnostics R&D. Segnalandosi direttamente al Capo delle Imprese Architettura Business Partnering Functions con una linea tratteggiata al Capo di Dia RDT per DIA R&D, sarete campioni delle nostre pratiche di architettura aziendale, pur comprendendo profondamente le complessità uniche dell'ambiente Diagnostics R&D. Crucialmente, nel nostro modello Roche Digital Technology (RDT) federato, si agirà come il principale orchestratore della rete di architettura Diagnostics R&D. Con la guida di questa rete, che include te stesso insieme a tutti gli architetti di dominio e soluzioni incorporati direttamente all'interno dell'organizzazione Diagnostics R&D, guiderai la governance dell'architettura e la formulazione di strategia, garantirai la coerenza delle imprese e tradurrai gli obiettivi aziendali in roadmap adattabili e future. Descrizione dell'Area L'area Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions funge da punto di contatto architettonico strategico per i leader del dominio aziendale, favorendo la collaborazione per allineare applicazioni, capacità aziendali e asset informativi con soluzioni tecnologiche. Per il dominio Diagnostics R&D, questo implica profondamente l'integrazione con team come DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, e DIA Portfolio & Project Management per guidare l'efficienza e l'innovazione con la responsabilità finale. Questo ruolo assicura che il ponte tra la visione aziendale di SPG e l'esecuzione operativa di Diagnostics R&D sia senza soluzione di continuità, collaborativo e altamente efficace. L'opportunità:
• Agirai come collegamento strategico tra SPG EA e Diagnostics R&D, collaborando con la leadership per allineare le priorità aziendali con roadmap pluriennali.
• Guidate la rete di architettura R&D Diagnostics, modellando le priorità strategiche condivise e consentendo agli architetti di eseguire mantenendo l'allineamento delle imprese.
• Fornire la leadership per le attività di governance dell'architettura, supervisionare i materiali di consegna e le protezioni tecnologiche per garantire la sicurezza e la resilienza.
• Si guida il successo di grandi e critici programmi di tecnologia, traducendo la strategia in iniziative attuabili e trasformative che forniscono valore aziendale.
• Sviluppi e mantieni manufatti di architettura di base, tra cui Capability Maps e Target-State Architectures, utilizzando la toolchain standard RDT.
• Collaborate con Portfolio Management per incorporare intuizioni architettoniche sulle decisioni di investimento, massimizzando il riutilizzo della piattaforma e la gestione del debito tecnico.
• Monitora le tendenze tecnologiche emergenti e valuta i fornitori per garantire che l'architettura R&D di Diagnostics rimanga innovativa e pronta per il futuro.
• Influenzi un modello RDT complesso e federato, bilanciando la coerenza aziendale con l'agilità necessaria per l'esecuzione operativa locale. Chi sei:
• Si possiede un Master e portare 7+ anni di esperienza nell'architettura IT e enterprise, specificamente all'interno di organizzazioni globali complesse, matrici o federazioni.
• Possiedi una profonda esperienza di dominio in Diagnostics R&D, con una comprensione completa dei processi scientifici, clinici e ingegneristici, dalla scienza computazionale e dalla strumentazione all'operazione di laboratorio a secco e umido

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Domain Architect - Diagnostics R&D Der Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D ist eine hochrangige, zentrale Position im Strategie-, Portfolio & Governance Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions Team. Diese Position spielt eine entscheidende Rolle zwischen der Strategie, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Organisation und der Diagnostics R&D Funktion. Wenn Sie direkt an den Leiter der Unternehmensarchitektur Business Partnering Functions mit einer gepunkteten Linie an den Leiter der Dia RDT für DIA R&D melden, werden Sie unsere Unternehmensarchitektur-Praktiken unter tiefem Verständnis der einzigartigen Komplexitäten der Diagnostics R&D-Umgebung. Crucially, in unserem federated Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Modell, werden Sie als Hauptorchester des Diagnostics R&D-Architekturnetzwerks fungieren. Durch das Führen dieses Netzwerks – das sich neben allen Domänen- und Lösungsarchitekten einschließt, die direkt in der Diagnostics R&D-Organisation eingebettet sind – werden Sie die Governance und Strategieformulierung der Architektur vorantreiben, die Unternehmenskohärenz sicherstellen und Geschäftsziele in anpassungsfähige, zukunftsfähige Roadmaps übersetzen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Der Bereich Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions dient als strategischer architektonischer Ansprechpartner für Business-Domain-Leiter und fördert die Zusammenarbeit, um Anwendungen, Business-Fähigkeiten und Informationsvermögen mit Technologielösungen auszurichten. Für die Diagnostics R&D-Domain beinhaltet dies eine tiefe Integration mit Teams wie DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs und DIA Portfolio & Project Management, um Effizienz und Innovation mit End-to-End-Rechenbarkeit zu steigern. Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass die Brücke zwischen der Unternehmensvision von SPG und der operativen Durchführung von Diagnostics R&D nahtlos, kollaborativ und hochwirksam ist. Die Gelegenheit:
• Sie werden als strategische Verbindung zwischen SPG EA und Diagnostics R&D fungieren und mit der Führung zusammenarbeiten, um Geschäftsprioritäten mit mehrjährigen Fahrplänen auszurichten.
• Sie leiten das R&D-Architekturnetzwerk Diagnostics, formen gemeinsame strategische Prioritäten und ermöglichen Architekten, gleichzeitig die Ausrichtung des Unternehmens durchzuführen.
• Sie bieten Führung für die Aktivitäten der Architekturverwaltung, die Überwachung von Liefer- und Technologieschutzläufen, um Sicherheit und Widerstand zu gewährleisten.
• Sie treiben den Erfolg großer, kritischer Technologieprogramme, indem Sie Strategie in handlungsfähige, transformative Initiativen übersetzen, die Unternehmenswert liefern.
• Sie entwickeln und pflegen Kernarchitektur-Artefakte, einschließlich Capability Maps und Target-State Architectures, mit der Standard RDT-Toolchain.
• Sie arbeiten mit Portfolio Management zusammen, um architektonische Einsichten in Investitionsentscheidungen einzubetten, die Plattform wiederverwenden und technische Schulden zu verwalten.
• Sie überwachen aufstrebende Technologietrends und bewerten die Anbieter, um sicherzustellen, dass die R&D-Architektur Diagnostics innovativ und zukunftsbereit bleibt.

• Sie halten einen Master-Abschluss und bringen 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der IT- und Unternehmensarchitektur, speziell in komplexen, Matrix- oder federführenden globalen Organisationen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Architecte de domaine - Recherche et développement diagnostiques L'Architecte de domaine – Diagnostic La R-D est un poste clé de niveau supérieur au sein de l'équipe des fonctions de partenariat d'affaires Stratégie, Portefeuille et Gouvernance. Ce poste joue un rôle crucial entre l'organisation de la Stratégie, du Portefeuille et de la gouvernance (SPG) et la fonction de R-D en matière de diagnostic. Sous l'autorité directe du responsable de l'architecture d'entreprise Business Partnering Functions, avec une ligne pointillée du chef de la DDT Dia pour la R-D DIA, vous allez défendre nos pratiques d'architecture d'entreprise tout en comprenant profondément les complexités uniques de l'environnement de R-D Diagnostics. Principalement, dans notre modèle fédéré Roche Digital Technology (RDT), vous agirez en tant que principal orchestre du réseau d'architecture de R-D Diagnostics. En dirigeant ce réseau, qui comprend tous les architectes de domaines et de solutions intégrés directement au sein de l'organisation de R-D Diagnostics, vous dirigerez la gouvernance de l'architecture et la formulation de stratégies, assurerez la cohérence de l'entreprise et traduireez les objectifs commerciaux en feuilles de route adaptables et prêtes à l'avenir. Description de la zone Le secteur des fonctions de partenariat d'affaires en architecture d'entreprise sert de point de contact stratégique pour les chefs de domaine d'affaires, favorisant la collaboration pour aligner les applications, les capacités d'affaires et les actifs d'information sur les solutions technologiques. Dans le domaine de la R-D en matière de diagnostic, il faut s'intégrer en profondeur avec des équipes telles que les laboratoires de R-D de l'IDA, les sciences et le génie de la R-D de l'IDA, l'instrumentation de R-D de l'IDA, le développement clinique de l'IDA et les affaires médicales, ainsi que le portefeuille de l'IDA et la gestion de projets pour stimuler l'efficacité et l'innovation grâce à la responsabilisation de bout en bout. Ce rôle assure que le pont entre la vision d'entreprise de SPG et l'exécution opérationnelle de la R-D diagnostique est transparent, collaboratif et très efficace. La possibilité :
• Vous jouerez le rôle de liaison stratégique entre SPG EA et Diagnostics R&D, en partenariat avec le leadership pour aligner les priorités opérationnelles sur les feuilles de route pluriannuelles.
• Vous dirigez le réseau d'architecture de R & D Diagnostics, façonnant des priorités stratégiques partagées et permettant aux architectes d'exécuter tout en maintenant l'alignement des entreprises.
• Vous dirigez les activités de gouvernance de l'architecture, supervisez les produits livrables et les garde-corps technologiques pour assurer la sécurité et la résilience.
• Vous dirigez le succès de grands programmes technologiques critiques en transformant la stratégie en initiatives concrètes et transformatrices qui apportent une valeur opérationnelle.
• Vous développez et maintenez des artefacts d'architecture de base, y compris des cartes de capacités et des architectures d'état cible, en utilisant la chaîne d'outils RDT standard.
• Vous vous associez à Portfolio Management pour intégrer des idées architecturales dans les décisions d'investissement, maximiser la réutilisation des plateformes et gérer la dette technique.
• Vous surveillez les nouvelles tendances technologiques et évaluez les fournisseurs pour vous assurer que l'architecture de R-D Diagnostics demeure novatrice et prête à l'avenir.
• Vous influencez un modèle RDT complexe et fédéré, en conciliant la cohérence de l'entreprise avec l'agilité requise pour l'exécution opérationnelle locale. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master et apportez 7 ans d'expérience dans l'architecture informatique et d'entreprise, en particulier au sein d'organisations mondiales complexes, matricielles ou fédérées.
• Vous possédez une expérience approfondie en R & D diagnostique, avec une compréhension complète des processus scientifiques, cliniques et d'ingénierie — de la science informatique et de l'instrumentation au laboratoire sec et humide

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• El Patient Journey Partner (PJP) es un rol híbrido cuyo objetivo es representar a
• Roche frente al cliente y ser la persona de referencia en la zona Norte en el área de
• oftalmología.
• Es el responsable de identificar y anticipar las necesidades de los clientes-pacientes para
• poder co-crear y desarrollar junto con los distintos stakeholders soluciones integrales
• alineadas con las prioridades y estrategia de Roche que beneficien al mayor número de
• pacientes lo antes posible.
• Reporta al Área Leader de la zona Norte y será responsable de centros de
• Asturias, Lugo y A Coruña en las áreas de Oftalmología

Principales Responsabilidades
• ● Conocimiento científico en las áreas de oftalmología y de la competencia.
• ● Persona de referencia de Roche con la comunidad médica y otros stakeholders
• aprovechando los canales disponibles, adaptando los medios virtuales que le
• proporciona la compañía y que utilizan sus clientes.
• ● Responsable de recoger los insights, tanto de la comunidad médica como de los
• distintos stakeholders, aportando y compartiendo posibles soluciones a sus
• necesidades.
• ● Proporcionar información, tanto dentro de su región como a los diferentes
• equipos, marketing, los equipos médicos y cross funcionales implicados en su
• patología.
• ● Análisis cuantitativos y cualitativos de los mercados terapéuticos.
• ● Trabajar, junto con los HealthCare System Partners de la zona y con los distintos
• stakeholders de acceso para asegurar y garantizar un acceso rápido a los
• pacientes.
• ● Establecer colaboraciones científicas con Sociedades y Asociaciones de
• Pacientes Regionales, actuando en continua colaboración con el Patient Access
• Partner.
• ● Rol activo en Simposios y Reuniones Científico-profesionales. Proporcionar
• briefing a los speakers de eventos científicos.
• ● Dar soporte a los profesionales sanitarios en las solicitudes de usos compasivos
• de su ecosistema, si fuera necesario.

Requisitos
• ● Licenciatura superior.
• ● Inglés Medio-Alto imprescindible (B2-C1)
• ● Residencia en Asturias
• ● Se valorará conocimiento en procesos y procedimientos de Ensayos Clínicos
• ● MD, PharmD o PhD relevante para el dominio terapéutico (valorable)
• ● MBA / Negocio relevante o acceso al mercado (valorable)
• ● Comprensión de la práctica clínica; conocimiento en la implementación y
• seguimiento de ensayos clínicos (valorable)
• ● Experiencia en gestión de TAEs y organizaciones externas (sociedades
• científicas, y organizaciones de pacientes (valorable)

Perfil competencial
• ● Habituado a trabajar en entornos matriciales y ágiles.
• ● Capacidad demostrada para trabajar en equipo y de forma cross funcional en
• entornos físicos y virtuales.
• ● Capacidad de priorización y de organización de recursos internos y externos
• ● Mentalidad emprendedora y capaz de actuar con rapidez mostrando autonomía y
• proactividad. Capacidad de detectar necesidades no cubiertas y transformarlas en
• propuestas reales.
• ● Capacidad didáctica y de interlocución a distintos niveles. Movilizador e
• influyente, puede construir y mantener una comunicación abierta y transparente
• con los diferentes interlocutores del ecosistema.
• ● Capaz de aprender rápidamente y crecer de forma autónoma para enfrentar
• nuevos desafíos.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using ou

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP) operations, including invoice processing (PO/non-PO), payments, reconciliations, and query resolution.

• Support month-end closing activities, including accrual analysis, balance sheet reconciliations, and preparation of financial and KPI reports.

• Ensure compliance and accuracy through duplicate checks, sanction screening, audit support, and maintenance of process documentation.

• Handle stakeholder communication by resolving internal and external queries and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

• Support operational excellence through system troubleshooting, process improvements, training, and participation in projects, system integration, and UAT.

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English language.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• SAP skill & AP related process knowledge is added advantage

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Referendariat - Juristische Wahlstation am Standort Penzberg (m/w/d)

Dein Team
Roche ist eines der weltweit führenden Biotechnologieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Medikamente, Diagnostika und digitale Lösungen, um die Gesundheitsversorgung nachhaltig zu verbessern. Gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft zu gestalten, heißt für uns, Stärken zu verbinden, Innovationen zu fördern und Verantwortung zu übernehmen - in einem Umfeld voller Vertrauen, Vielfalt und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Unser Team der Rechtsabteilung Deutschland berät die Geschäftsführungen der deutschen Landesgesellschaften sowie deren Geschäftsbereiche und Tochterunternehmen in allen Rechtsangelegenheiten. Zum umfassenden Aufgabengebiet, in das der Referendar (m/w/d) praxisnah und aktiv miteinbezogen wird, gehören die Prüfung von Rechtsfragen, die Erteilung von Rechtsrat sowie die Mitgestaltung von Vertragsverhältnissen mit Kunden und Kooperationspartnern. Wir bieten eigenständiges Arbeiten mit der Möglichkeit des direkten Mandantenkontaktes an.

Unser Team am Standort Penzberg besteht aus 4 Legal Counsel sowie 4 Paralegal, wobei wir standortübergreifend, Hand in Hand mit unseren Kollegen in Mannheim und der Schweiz, agieren.

Unser Arbeitsstil ist von Wertschätzung, Technologie-Offenheit, guter Teamarbeit, Kreativität sowie nicht zuletzt Spaß an den Aufgaben geprägt. Auf diese Weise erreichen wir nicht nur passende, sondern innovative Lösungen für unsere Geschäftsbereiche.

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Dein Referendariat
Im Rahmen deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, die Arbeitswelt eines Juristen in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben

• An der Seite unserer Legal Counsel bearbeitest du nationale und internationale Fragestellungen aus dem allgemeinen Wirtschaftsrecht und gewerblichen Rechtsschutz, Einblicke in weitere Rechtsgebiete möglich.

• Du wirkst bei Vertragsverhandlungen und der Vertragsgestaltung für den Abschluss künftiger Kooperationen – bspw. mit Universitäten oder Kliniken – mit.

• Das Erstellen von Gutachten unterschiedlichster Fragestellungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in deine Hände.

• Als Teil unseres kreativen Teams wirkst du zudem aktiv an nationalen und internationalen Projekten mit.

• Dein Examen hat Priorität, daher unterstützen wir deine ganzheitliche Ausbildung und stellen sicher, dass dir genügend Zeit für Arbeitsgemeinschaften und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung bleibt.

Deine Benefits
Eingebettet zwischen der Großstadt München und dem schönen Voralpenland liegt unser Standort Penzberg mit gut 7.700 Mitarbeitenden. Damit du neben dem Lerneffekt auch die Vorteile unseres Standortes nutzen kannst, bieten wir unseren Referendaren u. a. folgende Benefits:

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (in Präsenz vor Ort/Home-Office)

• Attraktive monatliche Vergütung

• Vielfältige Unterstützung bei Fragen rund um deine berufliche Karriere

• Sehr gute Anbindung an das ÖPNV-Netz im Penzberger

• Du wirkst bei Vertragsverhandlungen und der Vertragsgestaltung für den Abschluss künftiger Kooperationen – bspw. mit Universitäten oder Kliniken – mit.
• Das Erstellen von Gutachten unterschiedlichster Fragestellungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in deine Hände.
• Als Teil unseres kreativen Teams wirkst du zudem aktiv an nationalen und internationalen Projekten mit.
• Dein Examen hat Priorität, daher unterstützen wir deine ganzheitliche Ausbildung und stellen sicher, dass dir genügend Zeit für Arbeitsgemeinschaften und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung bleibt. Deine Benefits Eingebettet zwischen der Großstadt München und dem schönen Voralpenland liegt unser Standort Penzberg mit gut 7.700 Mitarbeitenden. Damit du neben dem Lerneffekt auch die Vorteile unseres Standortes nutzen kannst, bieten wir unseren Referendaren u. a. folgende Benefits:
• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (in Präsenz vor Ort/Home-Office)
• Attraktive monatliche Vergütung
• Vielfältige Unterstützung bei Fragen rund um deine berufliche Karriere
• Sehr gute Anbindung an das ÖPNV-Netz im Penzberger

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Accounts Payable Solution Architect
The Accounts Payables ERP Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within the Accounts Payables context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust ERP implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization.

Description of the area
Our landscape in the Accounts Payables area integrates SAP ECC and S/4HANA with diverse procurement platforms to support the Invoice-to-Pay lifecycle. We ensure seamless processing from invoice receipt and compliant financial approval workflows through to the successful delivery of payment instructions to the Treasury solution.
You will play a key role in navigating the transition from legacy environments to modern ERP standards, ensuring integration resilience and scalability as we re-engineer our global ERP landscape through the ASPIRE program.
You will serve as the critical interface for translating business requirements into technical/ IT language. Your primary mission is to deeply explore and define the functional "why" behind business requests, ensuring that every technological solution is built upon a foundation of clearly mapped processes and validated organizational needs.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs ERP solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within Accounts Payables solution context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fit requirements. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle, and aligns with the architecture community for proper governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned ERP solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and ontologies for the solution and the related interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, needed NFRs, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility for the solution, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap within the solution context. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific ERP technologies for product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Accounts Payable Solution Architetto Il Accounts Payables ERP Solution Architect si concentra sulla progettazione di soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready nel contesto Accounts Payables. In questo ruolo, si progettano soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali, mentre gestiscono i requisiti non funzionali e l'evoluzione dell'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Risolvendo complessi problemi tecnici, definendo architetture di riferimento, e allineando con la più ampia comunità di architettura per la governance, ti garantirai robuste implementazioni ERP che offrono un valore aggiunto all'organizzazione. Descrizione della zona Il nostro paesaggio nell'area Accounts Payables integra SAP ECC e S/4HANA con diverse piattaforme di approvvigionamento per supportare il ciclo di vita Invoice-to-Pay. Garantiamo l'elaborazione senza soluzione di continuità dalla ricevuta della fattura e i flussi di lavoro di approvazione finanziaria conformi alla consegna di successo delle istruzioni di pagamento alla soluzione del Tesoro. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella navigazione della transizione dagli ambienti legacy agli standard ERP moderni, garantendo l'integrazione resilienza e scalabilità come ri-ingegneria del nostro panorama ERP globale attraverso il programma ASPIRE. Potrai servire come interfaccia critica per tradurre i requisiti aziendali in linguaggio tecnico / IT. La vostra missione primaria è quella di approfondire e definire il "perché" funzionale dietro le richieste aziendali, assicurando che ogni soluzione tecnologica sia costruita su una base di processi chiaramente mappati e di esigenze organizzative convalidate. L'opportunità:
• Scope / (Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni ERP che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno del contesto di soluzioni Accounts Payables. Gestisce i requisiti non operativi (NFR) e i requisiti di vestibilità. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per una corretta governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Sostegni problemi complessi, prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti ed esercitando un giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per la soluzione ERP assegnata. Assesse e consultazioni su impatti e dipendenze di iniziative su capacità, rischi e il paesaggio delle applicazioni. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie e onlogie per la soluzione e le relative interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, necessari NFR, e assicura l'Architettura Decision Records (ADRs) sono registrati. Guida le tendenze della tecnologia esterna e valuta la fattibilità per la soluzione, comprese le valutazioni dei fornitori.
• Stakeholder Management: Spiega informazioni tecniche difficili o sensibili e lavora in collaborazione per costruire il consenso tra team di prodotti, stakeholder aziendali e colleghi tecnici.
• Impatto/Strategia: Sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto nel contesto della soluzione. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione su specifiche tecnologie ERP per i team di prodotto. Identificare le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali, migliorare le soluzioni esistenti, gestire il debito tecnico, e le ricerche, valuta, piloti e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona principalmente all'interno dell'ambito del prodotto Accounts Payable, gestendo le complessità architettoniche di specifiche applicazioni o componenti ERP. Inoltre fornisce
