Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Unter der Matrix-Führung des Safety Strategy Leader (SSL) und in Zusammenarbeit mit Portfolio Clinical Safety (PCS) Kollegen zu: ● Entwickeln und pflegen Sie ein Verständnis des Sicherheitsprofils ihrer zugewiesenen Produkte oder Therapiebereiche. Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung eines fachkundigen Verständnisses des Sicherheitsprofils des/der zugewiesenen Produkte sowie des Verständnisses des jeweiligen strategischen Kontexts (z.B. Krankheit im Studium, Sicherheitsprofil der Wettbewerber, Handlungsmechanismus) ● Verantwortlich für individuelle und aggregierte Fallberichte, einschließlich ICSR-Fallmanagement (medizinische Überprüfung) und Gesamtberichterstattung (d.h. DSUR, PBRER) ● Verantwortlich für die Signalerkennung und -verwaltung einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf STAR-Wartung, ISMP-Wartung. Beitrag zur Strategie und Überprüfung von Sicherheitsbewertungen und Drogensicherheitsberichten für Signale oder Probleme (Ink, Produktqualität) oder als Reaktion auf Anträge der Regulierungsbehörde ● Beitrag zur Entwicklung der Produktsicherheitsstrategie und Bereitstellung von Medikamentensicherheit in die klinische Entwicklungsstrategie ● Beteiligung an Risikomanagementtätigkeiten einschließlich Vorbereitung und Wartung von CCDS, Kennzeichnung von Dokumentenwartung (einschließlich der IB), Risikokommunikation, RMP, REMS ● Studienmanagement aus Sicherheitsperspektive durch SMT/PET-Aktivitäten und Dokumentenüberprüfung und -wartung im gesamten Entwicklungskontinuum (vorläufige Phase zu Post-Marketing-Studien), einschließlich PASS ● Beiträge der Regulierungsbehörde (Investigational New Drug/IND Applications, New Drug Applications/NDAs, Marketing Authorization Applications/MAAs, Variationen, Renewals, etc.) durch Überprüfung von Sicherheitsdaten und Vorbereitung relevanter Abschnitte der Einreichungs- und Einreichungspakete in Abstimmung mit SPL ● Verantwortlich für die Vorbereitung und Wartung von Sicherheitsteilen des Unternehmens Kerndatenblatts und/oder Referenzsicherheitsinformationen in der IB ● Beteiligen Sie sich an den Sitzungen für Drogenüberwachungsausschüsse (iDMC) oder interne Überwachungsausschüsse (IMC) und liefern Sie gegebenenfalls ● In Partnerschaft mit der SSL unterstützen Sie die Präsentation wichtiger Sicherheitsfragen an den Drogensicherheitsausschuss (DSC), den Entwicklungsüberprüfungsausschuss (DRC) und andere interne und externe Überprüfungs- und Governance-Komiteees, wie erforderlich. ● Autor oder Beitrag zu wissenschaftlichen Publikationen (Abzüge, Plakate, Papiere) für wissenschaftliche Treffen/Journalen ● Akten unabhängig, um Sicherheitsaufgaben auf Studienteams und in Aktivitäten zur Unterstützung der Sicherheitswissenschaft zu verwalten ● Verantwortung für spezielle Rollen mit PCS übernehmen. Diese können umfassen, aber nicht beschränkt auf; funktionaler Geschäftsprozessinhaber, Fachexperte. (

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Sous la direction matricielle du chef de la stratégie d'innocuité (CSS) et en collaboration avec des collègues du Portefeuille de l'innocuité clinique (SCP) pour : ● Élaborer et maintenir une compréhension du profil d'innocuité de leurs produits ou domaines thérapeutiques. Élaborer et maintenir une compréhension experte du profil d'innocuité du ou des produits assignés ainsi que de la situation stratégique pertinente (p. ex. maladie à l'étude, profil d'innocuité des concurrents, mécanisme d'action) ● Responsable des activités de déclaration de cas individuelles et globales, y compris la gestion de cas du CISR (examen médical) et la déclaration globale (c.-à-d. DSUR, PBRER) ● Responsable des activités de détection et de gestion des signaux, y compris, sans s'y limiter, l'entretien des ISMP par STAR. Contribuer à la stratégie et à l'examen des évaluations de l'innocuité et des rapports sur l'innocuité des médicaments en ce qui concerne les signaux ou les questions (y compris la qualité du produit) ou en réponse aux demandes de l'autorité réglementaire ● Contribuer à l'élaboration de la stratégie sur l'innocuité des produits et fournir des données sur l'innocuité des médicaments dans la stratégie de développement clinique ● Contribuer aux activités de gestion des risques, y compris la préparation et l'entretien du CCDS, la mise à jour des documents d'étiquetage (y compris l'IB), les communications sur les risques, le PGR, le SMRE ● Contribuer à la gestion des études du point de vue de l'innocuité par l'entremise des activités de TMS/ETP et l'examen et l'entretien des documents dans l'ensemble du continuum de développement (première phase des études postcommercialisation), y compris le PASS ● Contribuer aux présentations d'autorités réglementaires (demandes de nouveaux médicaments/IND, demandes de nouveaux médicaments/ADN, demandes d'autorisation de mise sur le marché/AAM, variantes, renouvellements, etc.) en examinant les données sur l'innocuité et en préparant les sections pertinentes des trousse En partenariat avec le SSL, appuyer la présentation d'importantes questions d'innocuité au Comité de l'innocuité des médicaments (CSD), au Comité d'examen du développement (CDR) et à d'autres comités d'examen et de gouvernance internes et externes au besoin. ∙ Auteur ou contribution à des publications scientifiques (abstractions, affiches, articles) pour des réunions/journals scientifiques ● Agit de manière indépendante pour gérer les responsabilités en matière de sécurité des équipes d'étude et des activités appuyant les sciences de la sécurité ● Prendre en charge les rôles spécialisés avec PCS. Il peut s'agir, sans s'y limiter, du propriétaire fonctionnel des processus opérationnels, expert en la matière. (
• Responsabilités liées aux qualifications médicales) Ils fourniront l'expertise médicale clinique et la prise de décisions, dans les domaines où cela est spécifiquement nécessaire pour soutenir les collègues du SCP. Les situations où l'on peut généralement demander une contribution médicale clinique qualifiée pourraient inclure, sans s'y limiter : ● L'interprétation de nouvelles données pertinentes en matière d'innocuité, dans le contexte de l'expérience acquise dans les domaines pertinents de la médecine clinique et des soins de santé. ∙ Définir les types de questions de sécurité ou de problèmes de sécurité, dans le contexte d'une molécule ou d'un programme, qui peuvent nécessiter des évaluations ou des décisions spécifiques de sécurité médicale clinique. ∙ Effectuer des évaluations de l'impact de la pratique médicale dans le contexte des questions d'innocuité de la qualité du produit (p. ex. dans le cadre d'activités définies décrites dans les processus gérés par le PT qui exigent une évaluation formelle par qualité médicale)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Referendariat - Juristische Wahlstation am Standort Mannheim (m/w/d)

Dein Team

Roche ist eines der weltweit führenden Biotechnologieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Medikamente, Diagnostika und digitale Lösungen, um die Gesundheitsversorgung nachhaltig zu verbessern. Gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft zu gestalten, heißt für uns, Stärken zu verbinden, Innovationen zu fördern und Verantwortung zu übernehmen - in einem Umfeld voller Vertrauen, Vielfalt und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Unser Team der Rechtsabteilung Deutschland berät die Geschäftsführungen der deutschen Landesgesellschaften sowie deren Geschäftsbereiche und Tochterunternehmen in allen Rechtsangelegenheiten. Zum umfassenden Aufgabengebiet, in das der Referendar (m/w/d) praxisnah und aktiv miteinbezogen wird, gehören die Prüfung von Rechtsfragen, die Erteilung von Rechtsrat sowie die Mitgestaltung von Vertragsverhältnissen mit Kunden und Kooperationspartnern. Wir bieten eigenständiges Arbeiten mit der Möglichkeit des direkten Mandantenkontaktes an.

Unser Team am Standort Mannheim besteht aus 6 Legal Counsel, 4 Paralegal sowie unserem Compliance Team. Wir arbeiten standortübergreifend Hand in Hand mit unseren Kollegen in Penzberg, Grenzach, der Schweiz und den Roche-Affiliates.

Unser Arbeitsstil ist von Wertschätzung, Technologie-Offenheit, guter Teamarbeit, Kreativität sowie nicht zuletzt Spaß an den Aufgaben geprägt. Auf diese Weise erreichen wir nicht nur passende, sondern innovative Lösungen für unsere Geschäftsbereiche.

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Dein Referendariat

Im Rahmen deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, die Arbeitswelt eines Juristen in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben

• An der Seite unserer Legal Counsel bearbeitest du nationale und internationale Fragestellungen aus dem allgemeinen Wirtschaftsrecht und gewerblichen Rechtsschutz, Einblicke in weitere Rechtsgebiete möglich.

• Du wirkst bei Vertragsverhandlungen und der Vertragsgestaltung für den Abschluss künftiger Kooperationen – bspw. mit Universitäten oder Kliniken – mit.

• Das Erstellen von Gutachten unterschiedlichster Fragestellungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in deine Hände.

• Als Teil unseres kreativen Teams wirkst du zudem aktiv an nationalen und internationalen Projekten mit.

• Dein Examen hat Priorität, daher unterstützen wir deine ganzheitliche Ausbildung und stellen sicher, dass dir genügend Zeit für Arbeitsgemeinschaften und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung bleibt.

Deine Benefits

Unser Standort Mannheim liegt mit knapp 8.700 Mitarbeitenden im Herzen der Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar. Wir sind drittgrößter Standort von Roche weltweit. Damit du neben dem Lerneffekt auch die Vorteile unseres Standortes nutzen kannst, bieten wir unseren Referendaren u. a. folgende Benefits:

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (in Präsenz vor Ort/Home-Office)

• Attraktive monatliche Vergütung

• Vielfältige Unterstützung bei Fragen rund um dein

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten.

Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen!
In deiner Funktion als Schichtleiter im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig.

Was Dich erwartet:

• Verantworte den reibungslosen Produktionsablauf unter Einhaltung von SOPs, GMP-Richtlinien und Reinraumregeln.

• Maximiere die Schichtleistung durch effiziente Personal- und Materialplanung sowie gezielte Kennzahlensteuerung.

• Führe und entwickle Dein Schichtteam gemäß der Roche-Führungsgrundsätze und fördere aktiv den „One-Team“-Gedanken.

• Manage das operative Personalgeschäft von Mitarbeitergesprächen und Zielvereinbarungen bis zur Zeitwirtschaft.

• Sichere die Qualität durch regelmäßige Teamschulungen, Shopfloor-Meetings und lückenlose Dokumentation.

• Treibe die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen und Anlagen in enger Abstimmung mit den Schnittstellen voran.

• Gewährleiste höchste Arbeitssicherheit durch proaktive Kontrollen, Sicherheits-Rundgänge und die Wartung der Anlagen.

Wer Du bist:

• Qualifikation & Erfahrung: Du hast eine technische Ausbildung abgeschlossen und bringst langjährige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder diagnostischen Produktion mit.

• Führungspersönlichkeit: Du besitzt nachweisbare (fachliche) Führungskompetenz, arbeitest strukturiert und förderst eine offene Kommunikation im Team.

• Fach-Know-how: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes GMP-Verständnis sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktions-IT (z. B. MES, SAP) und MS Office.

• Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Organisationsgeschick und Belastbarkeit im dynamischen Produktionsumfeld aus.

• Rahmenbedingungen: Du beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift und bist bereit zur Arbeit im Vollkonti-Schichtmodell (18/21 Schichten).

Deine Bewerbung:

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt und können bei Bedarf angefordert werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Statutory Accountant - Romania
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Statutory Accountant (12 month contractor)

Responsibilities:

• Preparation of analytical and synthetic accounting in accordance with Romanian accounting standards;

• Analytical development of the chart of accounts in accordance with the activities performed by the company, ensuring alignment between the corporate and the local accounts;

• Preparation of periodic non-tax related returns, as requested by the statutory legal framework and their submission within the legal deadline;

• Preparation of annual and semi-annual financial statements;

• Assistance in the preparation of primary documents, including the Journal Register;

• Assistance in preparation of the postings needed to capture the differences between IFRS and Local GAAP;

• Preparation of the statutory adjustments postings as needed for the financial statements;

• Proactively monitor and follow-up with the external auditors and internal stakeholders the progress of the work to complete the statutory financial statements

• Ensure compliance with any other non-tax local accounting legal provisions (such as, but not limited to, yearly inventory count), liaise with internal stakeholders to this end

• Assistance in the event of a tax inspection

Requirements:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role

• Knowledge of Romania accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools

• Meticulous, independent, proactive mindset and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines

• Proficiency in influencing skills

• Comfortably working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment

• Proficiency in English and Romanian

20 hours/week
1 day in the office

jobs.title: GxP Supplier Quality Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Job Responsibilities

• Oversee all required quality activities during the lifecycle of a GxP supplier (Source & Select, Implement, Manage and Decommission), including but not limited to: process or method validations, Roche audits, Health Authority inspections, complex investigations, product complaints, and regulatory submissions, as assigned.

• Develop, negotiate and maintain Quality Agreements and Product Specific Requirements (as appropriate) with GxP suppliers, as well as with Partners, Collaborators and External Sponsors as applicable, and ensure compliance with agreements.

• Collaborate with GxP suppliers to address any gaps in audit responsiveness, CAPA implementation, deviation reporting and management, complaint management, investigation closure, and change implementation with regards to quality and timeliness with the supplier; and escalate as appropriate.

• As applicable, manage all required quality activities to support Make Assess Release (MAR) of Roche products including approval of master process documentation, batch documentation review, resolution of investigations, assessment of changes, and monitor and report GxP Supplier quality performance.

• As applicable, release, reject or quarantine Roche products (drug substance or API, bulk drug product, and semi-finished and finished products) and medical devices produced within the area of responsibility per applicable Roche requirements, cGMP and the schedule. Support RP and QP Declaration and Certification requirements as applicable.

• As applicable, collaborate with GxP suppliers to maintain the manufacturing processes and the Specifications and Analytical Methods (SAM) in a validated state and compliant with the regulatory dossier, including stability testing programs. Also includes quality oversight for direct material changes, certifications, supplier specifications and internal release specifications, and other documentation.

• As applicable, develop and maintain quality risk management plans; utilize risk management tools to identify and mitigate supplier quality and compliance risks, ensuring suppliers are in a state of compliance.

• As applicable, manage or lead quality deliverables supporting technical transfers for manufacturing, testing, packaging and product launches at external sites

• As applicable, engage in supplier improvement initiatives to solve complex manufacturing or quality problems.
Functional Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate and manage relationships across internal and external partners to ensure quality expectations are aligned with Roche objectives.

• Notify Senior Management of potential quality or regulatory issues that may impact product quality or regulatory compliance.

• Troubleshoot and drive the resolution of quality issues, fostering effective interdepartmental and cross-functional partnerships.

• Approve documents as authorized and described by Roche policies, procedures and job descriptions.

• Be accountable for behaviors described in Roche Code of Conduct.

• Deliver business outcomes in support of departmental objectives.

• Maintain and communicate work priorities to meet goals and timelines.

• Ensure timely completion of all job-related training requirements prior to performing GMP-job functions and strive to continuously improve on knowledge and skills in quality, compliance and technology.

• Communicate new and updated regulatory requirements and applicable Roche expectations to GxP suppliers as applicable and evaluate systems

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Technical Job Responsibilities
• Oversee all required quality activities during the lifecycle of a GxP supplier (Source & Select, Implement, Manage and Decommission), including but not limited to: process or method validations, Roche audits, Health Authority inspections, complex investigations, product complaints, and regulatory submissions, as assigned.
• Develop, negotiate and maintain Quality Agreements and Product Specific Requirements (as appropriate) with GxP suppliers, as well as with Partners, Collaborators and External Sponsors as applicable, and ensure compliance with agreements.
• Collaborate with GxP suppliers to address any gaps in audit responsiveness, CAPA implementation, deviation reporting and management, complaint management, investigation closure, and change implementation with regards to quality and timeliness with the supplier; and escalate as appropriate.
• As applicable, manage all required quality activities to support Make Assess Release (MAR) of Roche products including approval of master process documentation, batch documentation review, resolution of investigations, assessment of changes, and monitor and report GxP Supplier quality performance.
• As applicable, release, reject or quarantine Roche products (drug substance or API, bulk drug product, and semi-finished and finished products) and medical devices produced within the area of responsibility per applicable Roche requirements, cGMP and the schedule. Support RP and QP Declaration and Certification requirements as applicable.
• As applicable, collaborate with GxP suppliers to maintain the manufacturing processes and the Specifications and Analytical Methods (SAM) in a validated state and compliant with the regulatory dossier, including stability testing programs. Also includes quality oversight for direct material changes, certifications, supplier specifications and internal release specifications, and other documentation.
• As applicable, develop and maintain quality risk management plans; utilize risk management tools to identify and mitigate supplier quality and compliance risks, ensuring suppliers are in a state of compliance.
• As applicable, manage or lead quality deliverables supporting technical transfers for manufacturing, testing, packaging and product launches at external sites
• As applicable, engage in supplier improvement initiatives to solve complex manufacturing or quality problems. Functional Job Responsibilities
• Collaborate and manage relationships across internal and external partners to ensure quality expectations are aligned with Roche objectives.
• Notify Senior Management of potential quality or regulatory issues that may impact product quality or regulatory compliance.
• Troubleshoot and drive the resolution of quality issues, fostering effective interdepartmental and cross-functional partnerships.
• Approve documents as authorized and described by Roche policies, procedures and job descriptions.
• Be accountable for behaviors described in Roche Code of Conduct.
• Deliver business outcomes in support of departmental objectives.
• Maintain and communicate work priorities to meet goals and timelines.
• Ensure timely completion of all job-related training requirements prior to performing GMP-job functions and strive to continuously improve on knowledge and skills in quality, compliance and technology.
• Communicate new and updated regulatory requirements and applicable Roche expectations to GxP suppliers as applicable and evaluate systems

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Solution Architect (Quality & Compliance)

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Join a team at the forefront of the "Quality Unites Us" program, where you will design the digital backbone of our global pharma quality and compliance systems. This role is a unique chance to lead the shift toward a paperless, predictive quality ecosystem, ensuring our life-saving medicines reach patients faster. You will work in a high-impact environment, balancing cutting-edge lab technologies with robust enterprise standards.

The opportunity:

• Scope/(Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Business /Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Solution Architect (Quality & Compliance) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Unisciti a un team all'avanguardia del programma "Quality Unites Us", dove potrai progettare la spina dorsale digitale dei nostri sistemi di qualità e conformità di farmaci globali. Questo ruolo è un'occasione unica per portare lo spostamento verso un ecosistema di qualità senza carta, predittivo, assicurando che i nostri farmaci salvavita raggiungano i pazienti più velocemente. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente ad alto impatto, bilanciando tecnologie di laboratorio all'avanguardia con standard aziendali robusti. L'opportunità:
• Scope/(Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti del prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali. Gestisce i requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance. Riguarda i quadri in una soluzione complessa o multipla o nel contesto del prodotto.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: porta altri a risolvere problemi complessi; utilizza un sofisticato pensiero analitico per esercitare giudizio e identificare soluzioni innovative. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per soluzioni multiple. Assesse e consultazioni sugli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, sui rischi e sul paesaggio delle applicazioni. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie, ontologie e percorsi di integrazione per il prodotto. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli, NFR e funzioni di fitness, assicurando che l'Architettura Decision Records (ADRs) siano registrate e pubblicate per più soluzioni o il prodotto. Guida le tendenze della tecnologia esterna e valuta la fattibilità, comprese le valutazioni dei fornitori.
• Gestione degli Stakeholder: Comunica chiaramente concetti difficili e negozia con altri per adottare un punto di vista diverso. Guida la condivisione delle informazioni attraverso il prodotto completo.
• Impatto/Strategia: sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per i team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico, e le ricerche, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identifica le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali all'interno di un Contesto Complesso o Soluzione Multiple o Prodotto.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): funziona all'interno di una soluzione complessa o multipla o Contesto del prodotto.
• Capacità aziendale /tecnica: si basa su una conoscenza approfondita ed esperta in più aree tecnologiche. Proattivamente contribuisce alle pratiche di architettura

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Senior Solution Architect (Qualität und Compliance) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation den Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Community von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die dazu beitragen, die digitale Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen zu gestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu treiben und das Potenzial künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren Tech-Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zweck und Leidenschaft, bauen wir eine Zukunft, in der digital eine Kernkraft für alle Roche ist, die intelligentere Möglichkeiten der Arbeit ermöglicht, das menschliche Potenzial zu entsperren und Durchbrüche zu treiben, die wirklich für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wichtig sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Wir verlangen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter in unseren Büros durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Bedarf variieren, z.B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathause, Teamtreffen und andere kollaborative Veranstaltungen. Nehmen Sie an der Spitze des Programms "Quality Unites Us" teil, wo Sie das digitale Rückgrat unserer globalen Pharma-Qualitäts- und Compliance-Systeme entwerfen werden. Diese Rolle ist eine einzigartige Chance, die Verschiebung zu einem papierlosen, prädiktiven Qualitäts-Ökosystem zu führen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere lebenssparenden Medikamente schneller Patienten erreichen. Sie werden in einer hocheffizienten Umgebung arbeiten und modernste Labortechnologien mit robusten Unternehmensstandards ausgleichen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Scope/(Content Leadership): Entwerfen Sie Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Unternehmensprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards erfüllen. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) und Fitness-Funktionen. Dokumente und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und richtet sich an die Architekturgemeinschaft für Governance. Gilt für Frameworks in einem komplexen oder mehreren Lösungs- oder Produktkontext.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Führen Sie andere, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen; nutzt ausgeklügelten analytischen Gedanken, um Urteil zu üben und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren. Bewahrt die Vision, Roadmap und aktuelle Landschaft für mehrere Lösungen. Unterstützung und Beratung zu den Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft. Erzeugt Konzept- & Logische Datenmodelle, Taxonomien, Ontologien und Integration Pfade für das Produkt. Definiert und treibt Referenzarchitekturen, Muster, NFRs und Fitness-Funktionen, die sicherstellen, dass Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) aufgezeichnet und für mehrere Lösungen oder das Produkt veröffentlicht werden. treibt Trends der externen Technologie voran und bewertet Machbarkeit, einschließlich Herstellerbewertungen.
• Stakeholder Management: Kommuniziert schwierige Konzepte klar und verhandelt mit anderen, um einen anderen Standpunkt zu vertreten. Fahren Sie den Informationsaustausch über das gesamte Produkt.
• Impact/Strategy: Entwickelt und pflegt die Technologiekarte des Produkts. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Beratung und Beratung zu spezifischen Technologien für Produktteams. Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden und forscht, bewertet, pilotiert und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien voran. Erkennt Möglichkeiten, Wert- und Geschäftsprozesse innerhalb eines komplexen oder mehrerer Lösungs- oder Produktkontexts zu verbessern.
• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Operate innerhalb einer komplexen oder mehreren Lösung oder Produkt Kontext.
• Business /Technische Fähigkeit: Gilt fundiertes und fachkundiges Wissen in mehreren Technologiebereichen. Proaktiv trägt zur Architekturpraxis bei
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Architecte principal des solutions (qualité et conformité) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. Rejoignez une équipe à l'avant-garde du programme « Qualité Unites Us », où vous concevrez l'épine dorsale numérique de nos systèmes mondiaux de qualité et de conformité des produits pharmaceutiques. Ce rôle est une chance unique de conduire le changement vers un écosystème de qualité sans papier et prédictive, assurant que nos médicaments qui sauvent la vie atteignent les patients plus rapidement. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement à impact élevé, en conciliant les technologies de laboratoire de pointe avec des normes d'entreprise robustes. L'occasion :
• Portée/(Le leadership du contenu): Concevoir des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise. Gérer les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de conditionnement physique. Documente et évolue l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit et s'harmonise avec la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance. Applique les cadres dans un contexte complexe ou multiple de solution ou de produit.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre des problèmes: mène les autres à résoudre des problèmes complexes; utilise la pensée analytique sophistiquée pour faire preuve de jugement et identifier des solutions innovantes. Maintenir la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel pour de multiples solutions. Évaluer et consulter les répercussions et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le contexte d'application. Crée des modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, des taxonomies, des ontologies et des voies d'intégration pour le produit. Définir et piloter les architectures de référence, les modèles, les NFR et les fonctions de fitness, en veillant à ce que les documents de décision d'architecture (ADR) soient enregistrés et publiés pour plusieurs solutions ou le produit. Incite les tendances technologiques externes et évalue la faisabilité, y compris les évaluations des fournisseurs.
• Gestion des parties prenantes: Communique clairement les concepts difficiles et négocie avec d'autres pour adopter un point de vue différent. Permet le partage de l'information dans le produit complet.
• Impact/Stratégie: développe et maintient la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies spécifiques aux équipes de produits. Améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies. Indique les possibilités d'améliorer la valeur et les processus opérationnels dans un contexte complexe ou de solutions multiples ou de produits.
• Complexité / (Taille du produit): fonctionne dans une solution complexe ou multiple ou dans un contexte de produit.

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Sequencing Solutions is expanding with a Principal Data Scientist to lead and help drive forward R&D activity by providing a deep level of insight into experimental data, its interpretation and implications for project development efforts. This role seeks a highly advanced and versatile individual who combines deep statistical expertise with proficiency in advanced data analysis tools and a focus on applying these skills to complex biological problems. (Applicants whose primary experience is narrowly defined within established bioinformatics analysis workflows might not align for the scope of this Principal Data Scientist role.)

Principal data scientists combine a number of skills from different domains to organize, process, and learn from data, often through the lens of domain-expert informed models that help to abstract concepts from the data, test their validity and make predictions.

The Opportunity:

• You will analyze large datasets, identify patterns, correlations, and anomalies that might be hidden within the data. Use statistical methods and machine learning algorithms to extract meaningful insights.

• You will have experience with DOE for biological and assay development experiments, where we need to draw meaningful conclusions on small sample sizes.

• You will provide statistical analysis of experimental results and communicate it to internal customers in a way that is both approachable and informative.

• You will work cross functionally using various pilot studies to then integrate the necessary analytical or inferential routines into a pipeline through a collaborative software engineering effort; the overall goal resulting in a validated internal software product that may be used regularly by experimentalists to track their research progress.

• You will utilize AI based tools for data analysis and create AI based support tools for internal customers.

• You have the ability to create clear and informative visualizations of the data and analysis results, making it easier for the technical (and non technical) team(s) to understand the situation and make informed decisions.

• You are able to identify technical challenges as they pertain to your team as well as collaborating teams, definite requirements and architecture for next-generation machine learning and statistical analysis products.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or other related areas of study and 5 years (or more) of experience handling various data sets/modules.

• You are able to define and lead analysis projects interfacing with multiple stakeholders.

• You have demonstrated experience handling large datasets, with demonstrated ability of transferring the data into meaningful and actionable reports.

• You have demonstrated experience in the application of statistical methods for process control and optimization (e.g., Statistical Process Control, A/B testing design/analysis, or advanced time series modeling) in a non-biological context.

• You have a demonstrated level of experience in a wide range of ML algorithms (traditional to advanced) and a strong understanding of the principles behind model training, validation and hyperparameter tuning.

• You have practical experience in designing and implementing automated workflows; the ability to troubleshoot/map out a solution.

jobs.title: People Support Specialist - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The Opportunity:
As a People Support Specialist​ - German speaking , you will be the first point of contact for our "People Portal," providing essential P&C services to employees, managers, and retirees. You will play a key role in ensuring a seamless employee experience by balancing customer inquiry resolution with technical lifecycle management.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for P&C inquiries via chat, ticketing, and phone, supporting the entire employee lifecycle from onboarding to retirement.

• Execute administrative activities and maintain system data for core business processes, including recruitment, compensation, and performance management.

• Deliver high-quality customer care by troubleshooting issues, managing service requests, and proactively anticipating stakeholder needs.

• Drive continuous improvement by analyzing service interactions and collaborating with P&C Chapters to identify process pain points and knowledge gaps.

• Ensure operational excellence by meeting defined KPIs and SLAs while strictly complying with data privacy rules and global SHE guidelines.

• Maintain internal knowledge bases by staying up-to-date on global processes and contributing to the evolution of SOPs and Work Instructions.

• Collaborate across the network with regional and global peers to ensure consistent service delivery and a unified "People Support Solutions" vision.

Who You Are
You are a solution-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced, multicultural environment. You possess a strong customer-centric mindset and the ability to navigate complex data structures while maintaining end-to-end accountability for your work.

• Educational Background: You hold a university degree and have 0-2 years of experience in Human Resources or a customer service environment.

• Service Expertise: You have experience in a Shared Service Center and feel comfortable handling multiple competing priorities in a matrix organization.

• Technical Proficiency: You are efficient in handling standard IT applications (preferably Google Suite) and possess knowledge of Workday HR processes.

• Problem-Solving Skills: You demonstrate critical thinking and active listening to resolve complex inquiries and improve existing workflows.

• Communication: Fluent in English and German (written and spoken)

• Growth Mindset: You are eager to learn, open to giving and receiving feedback, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a changing environment.

• Relationship Management: You have a proven ability to build strong stakeholder relationships and work independently while remaining a proactive team player.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibili

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Ti unirai al team Business Operations all'interno dell'organizzazione Pharma Technical Cell e Gene Therapy (PTC). I nostri partner di team attraverso i confini locali, regionali e globali, compresi gli stakeholder interni e i partner esterni, per stabilire capacità innovative per il nostro portafoglio di terapia cellulare e genica. Si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel promuovere il portafoglio di Roche gestendo progetti tecnici, principali iniziative interfunzionali, sostenendo la gestione del portafoglio e stabilendo standard di processo aziendale e di gestione del progetto all’interno di PTC. Sfruttando le tue competenze specialistiche nell'imaging, nell'editoria digitale e nel design delle presentazioni, tradurrai dati e informazioni complessi in messaggi semplici e risonanti che catturano l'attenzione dell'organizzazione più ampia e degli stakeholder più anziani. L'opportunità Nell'ambito del team Business Operations all'interno di PTC, gestirai progetti tecnici ad alto impatto e sforzi di comunicazione strategici per far progredire il nostro portafoglio di terapia cellulare e genica.
• Eccellenza di Project Management: Definire gli obiettivi e dirigere la portata, le linee temporali, i bilanci come applicabili e gestire i rischi e le prestazioni per progetti complessi locali e globali.
• Comunicazione strategica: tradurre informazioni complesse in messaggi risonanti e narrazioni ad alto impatto per l'organizzazione più ampia e gli stakeholder senior.
• Stakeholder Engagement: gestire il branding interno, portali digitali e eventi su larga scala come Town Halls.
• Eccellenza Operativa: Implementare metodologie snelle, best practice e strumenti avanzati per migliorare l'efficienza operativa, la standardizzazione e la reporting. Chi sei Sei un professionista orientato ai risultati che prospera in ambienti matrici e porta chiarezza a paesaggi tecnici complessi.
• Istruzione e esperienza: laurea in un campo tecnico con 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione del progetto nel settore farmaceutico/biotecnico. L'esperienza nelle terapie cellulari e geniche è un vantaggio. Profonda competenza in diverse metodologie di gestione del progetto con la capacità di adattare i quadri per soddisfare le esigenze di team e stakeholder in evoluzione, per creare risultati e per guidare l'efficienza.
• Esperto di comunicazione: competenze inglesi eccezionali con una comprovata capacità di influenzare e trasmettere informazioni alla leadership senior e ai diversi stakeholder.
• Multimedia Pro: Proficiente nella creazione di multimedia professionali, inclusi video, editing di immagini e presentazioni esecutive, e la gestione di piattaforme interne come SharePoint o Google Sites.
• Giocatore di squadra: Capacità di costruire relazioni costruttive tra le squadre globali e promuovere una cultura di inclusione senza autorità diretta.
• Proficienza tecnica: competenze in G-Suite, MS Office e strumenti di visualizzazione dati come Tableau o Spotfire e nella costruzione di soluzioni collaborative per esempio Airtable o Lunedi. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel axé sur les résultats qui prospère dans des environnements matriciaux et apporte la clarté à des paysages techniques complexes.

L'expérience des thérapies cellulaires et géniques est un plus. Connaissance approfondie des diverses méthodes de gestion de projet, avec la capacité d'adapter les cadres pour répondre aux besoins en évolution de l'équipe et des intervenants, pour obtenir des résultats et pour stimuler l'efficacité.
• Expert en communication: compétences anglaises exceptionnelles avec une capacité avérée d'influencer et de transmettre l'information aux dirigeants et aux diverses parties prenantes.

jobs.title: Head of Drug Regulatory Affairs (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Als Head of Drug Regulatory Affairs (d/f/m) gestaltest Du die Brücke zwischen pharmazeutischer Entwicklung und der sicheren Versorgung von Patient:innen, indem Du die Konformität unseres Portfolios in einem dynamischen regulatorischen Umfeld sicherstellst. In dieser Schlüsselposition verbindest Du strategisches Handeln mit wissenschaftlicher Präzision, damit unsere Medikamente unter Einhaltung höchster Standards die Menschen erreichen, die sie dringend benötigen und auch nachweislich davon profitieren. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team trägst Du so direkt dazu bei, die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens verantwortungsvoll und nachhaltig zu gestalten.

Dein neues Team:
Du leitest ein engagiertes Team von Expert:innen in der Abteilung Drug Regulatory Affairs (DRA), das durch Kooperation, fachlichen Austausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung geprägt ist. Mit ca. 20 regulatorischen Expert:innen mit den verschiedensten Schwerpunkten (Arzneimittel, Medizinprodukte, regulatorische Texte, Systeme etc.) und einem engagierten Führungsteam gelingt es Dir die DRA in der sich stark wandelnden europäischen regulatorischen Landschaft und mit dem breitgefächerten Roche Portfolio weiterhin zukunftsfähig aufzustellen, Chancen in der dazugehörigen digitalen regulatorischen Prozess- und Systemlandschaft zu erkennen, in Koordination mit relevanten Stakeholdern zu implementieren und Herausforderungen zu meistern. Mit Begeisterung für Möglichkeiten mit den etablierten KI-tools in der Regulatorik setzt Du Maßstäbe und förderst Innovation.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Durch intelligente Optimierung der Produktinformation und zugehöriger Prozess Excellence ermöglichst Du die bestmögliche Produkteinführung. Dafür unterstützt Du schon früh im Entwicklungs- Lifecycle, dass die regulatorischen Texte sowohl den Zugang für die Patienten als auch die Therapieentscheidung der Health-Care Professionals gewährleisten.

• Du stellst die korrekte und termingerechte Bearbeitung aller regulatorischen Agenden für das Grenzach-Portfolio gemäß europäischer und nationaler Gesetze sicher. Dabei berücksichtigst Du sowohl Arzneimittel- als auch Medizinprodukte und In vitro Diagnostic (MDR/IVDR).

• Du bist als Informationsbeauftragter gemäß § 74a AMG für die Zulassungskonformität der regulatorischen Texte aller in Deutschland vertriebenen Roche-Präparate verantwortlich.

• Du entwickelst Zulassungsstrategien für neue Produkte und arbeitest eng mit globalen Gremien, regulatorischen Kolleg:innen in europäischen Niederlassungen sowie crossfunktional über eine Vielzahl interner Funktionen am Standort in Grenzach..

• Du etablierst und pflegst den strategischen Dialog zu Zulassungsbehörden sowie Verbänden (z. B. VFA) und vertrittst die Interessen von Roche proaktiv. Damit gestaltest Du die regulatorische Landschaft mit dem Ziel durch Chancen in der General Pharma Legislation und anderen neuen nationalen und EU Gesetzgebungen ein global kompetitives Umfeld in Deutschland und Europa zu schaffen.

• Du treibst als Teil der lokalen Expertengruppe zur Evidenzgenerierung die Ambitionen voran und stellst sicher, dass das Team projektspezifisch den regulatorische Rahmen erkennt und somit innovativ Projekte effizient umsetzen kann.

• Du führst und coachst die Mitglieder des DRA-Teams und verantwortest die Ressourcenplanung sowie die fachliche Weiterentwicklung der Abteilung.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Pharmazie (Approbation bevorzugt) oder eine vergleichba

Dein neues Team: Du leitest ein engagiertes Team von Expert:innen in der Abteilung Drug Regulatory Affairs (DRA), das durch Kooperation, fachlichen Austausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung geprägt ist. Mit ca. 20 regulatorischen Expert:innen mit den verschiedensten Schwerpunkten (Arzneimittel, Medizinprodukte, regulatorische Texte, Systeme etc.) und einem engagierten Führungsteam gelingt es Dir die DRA in der sich stark wandelnden europäischen regulatorischen Landschaft und mit dem breitgefächerten Roche Portfolio weiterhin zukunftsfähig aufzustellen, Chancen in der dazugehörigen digitalen regulatorischen Prozess- und Systemlandschaft zu erkennen, in Koordination mit relevanten Stakeholdern zu implementieren und Herausforderungen zu meistern. Mit Begeisterung für Möglichkeiten mit den etablierten KI-tools in der Regulatorik setzt Du Maßstäbe und förderst Innovation. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
• Durch intelligente Optimierung der Produktinformation und zugehöriger Prozess Excellence ermöglichst Du die bestmögliche Produkteinführung. Dafür unterstützt Du schon früh im Entwicklungs- Lifecycle, dass die regulatorischen Texte sowohl den Zugang für die Patienten als auch die Therapieentscheidung der Health-Care Professionals gewährleisten.
• Du stellst die korrekte und termingerechte Bearbeitung aller regulatorischen Agenden für das Grenzach-Portfolio gemäß europäischer und nationaler Gesetze sicher. Dabei berücksichtigst Du sowohl Arzneimittel- als auch Medizinprodukte und In vitro Diagnostic (MDR/IVDR).
• Du bist als Informationsbeauftragter gemäß § 74a AMG für die Zulassungskonformität der regulatorischen Texte aller in Deutschland vertriebenen Roche-Präparate verantwortlich.
• Du entwickelst Zulassungsstrategien für neue Produkte und arbeitest eng mit globalen Gremien, regulatorischen Kolleg:innen in europäischen Niederlassungen sowie crossfunktional über eine Vielzahl interner Funktionen am Standort in Grenzach..
• Du etablierst und pflegst den strategischen Dialog zu Zulassungsbehörden sowie Verbänden (z. B. VFA) und vertrittst die Interessen von Roche proaktiv. Damit gestaltest Du die regulatorische Landschaft mit dem Ziel durch Chancen in der General Pharma Legislation und anderen neuen nationalen und EU Gesetzgebungen ein global kompetitives Umfeld in Deutschland und Europa zu schaffen.
• Du treibst als Teil der lokalen Expertengruppe zur Evidenzgenerierung die Ambitionen voran und stellst sicher, dass das Team projektspezifisch den regulatorische Rahmen erkennt und somit innovativ Projekte effizient umsetzen kann.
• Du führst und coachst die Mitglieder des DRA-Teams und verantwortest die Ressourcenplanung sowie die fachliche Weiterentwicklung der Abteilung. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Pharmazie (Approbation bevorzugt) oder eine vergleichba

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Medical Affairs Manager is a forward-looking health expert who drive diagnostics innovation and its implementation into diagnostics routine, areas: neurology / infectious diseases In this role you will provide state of the art medical insights into the therapeutic area to the local and international teams. You will create value by improving patient pathways.

The Opportunity:

• Enable medical standards of care applied by HCP correspond to the latest medical knowledge

• Develop and execute medical affairs strategy, initiates and executes medical initiatives for Poland and export countries

• Engage and partner with clinical stakeholders, develop a network of relevant KOLs and stakeholders

• Map patient journey and influence its transformation towards the innovative diagnostic solutions

• Shape the therapeutic areas focused non product related expertise and discussion (national consultants/KOL on national level).

• Continuously expand the medical and scientific knowledge as well as market knowledge

• Verify and approve scientific content for symposia / workshops/publications/promotional materials

• Approve medical educational grants

Who you are:

• You have a strong focus on Medical Affairs

• You are an expert that can translate the development in their domain(s) into strategy

• You have the ability to learn and transfer new scientific content quickly,

• You have the ability to search, critically analyze and present medical data

• You have a creative-mindset focused on continuous improvement

• You have excellent understanding of medical needs and system capabilities to properly identify unmet medical need

• You provide in-depth specialist knowledge and may coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills

• You are able to facilitate high level health stakeholders interactions

• You bring Agile mindset and ways of working

• You are solution- and customer-orientation

Expertise:

• Deep knowledge and insights of Evidence Based Medicine principles

• Therapeutic area knowledge

• 5 years of relevant experience

• Experience in a clinical / medical work environment

• Relevant medical university degree or deep scientific expertise, MD or PhD is an advantage

• Experience in managing relationships with high level KOL

• Network of KOL in the given therapeutic area

• Good analytical skills

• Proficient in Polish and English

INTERESTED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roche.com/global/en/careers/roche-careers.html

The controller of your personal data is Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o., ul. Domaniewska 28, 02-672 Warsaw. The data is processed for the purpose of recruitment. You have the right to access data, rectify it, delete it, limit processing, transfer it and - if processing is based on your consent - withdraw this consent at any time. Contact the Data Protection Officer at: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. More information on the principles of processing your personal data by Roche at the link: https://www.roche.pl/privacy-policy-recruitment-dia-en .

Roche Diagnostics sp. z o.o. operates in full compliance with the law and does not tolerate any violations. Roche Diagnostics sp. z o.o. has implemented a Procedure for Reporting Violations of Law. If you wish to report any irregularities related to our activities, all necessary information regarding the reporting process can be found on our web

jobs.title: (Sr.) Director Pharma Partnering Transactions (BD&L)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Corporate Business Development organization supports Roche and Genentech partnerships worldwide, encompassing R&D assets, technologies (both biotech and digital), and commercial deals. As a pioneer in healthcare, Roche is dedicated to driving groundbreaking science and technology that transforms patients' lives, and external innovation is a cornerstone of its R&D strategy, complementing its extensive internal pipeline.

The Partnering Transaction Group (PTG) is composed of highly experienced business development professionals in Basel and San Francisco with deep expertise in the execution of pharmaceutical licensing and collaboration deals. We are looking for an excellent candidate to join our group in Basel to ensure that negotiated outcomes of our deals clearly reflect desired partnership arrangements and align with our business objectives.

The Opportunity
As a member of the Partnering Transaction Group, you will be an integral part of deal teams to structure and negotiate high-impact deals, and shape the direction of our global partnerships through the following responsibilities:

• Act as a core member of the deal team to drive strategic partnerships and licensing projects across all therapeutic areas and drug development stages worldwide.

• Lead or co-lead the preparation of offers (NBOs, term sheets) and negotiations with biopharma executive teams and external advisors.

• Participate in briefings with senior management at key project junctures to drive business decisions.

• Focus on all elements of deal strategy and execution, including proposed deal structures and financials based on valuation, risks, and diligence assessments.

• Draft term sheets and deliver detailed comments on complex licensing agreements while driving the resolution of deal issues.

• Highlight deviations from standards on financial and key licensing clauses, identifying resulting risks and possible mitigation strategies.

• Expérience importante dans la négociation d'accords complexes de licence ou de fusion-acquisition, de préférence en tant que négociateur principal dans l'espace biopharmaceutique.
• Une compréhension approfondie des fonctions de l'entreprise, y compris la finance, la comptabilité, le droit et la propriété intellectuelle (PI).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Integrated Medical Engagement Catalyst team is at the heart of designing and delivering modernised medical communication and engagement models. As part of the Global Integrated Medical Engagement chapter in PDMA, we focus on the evolution of medical engagement and the tools, processes, and mindsets required for the future. We bridge the gap between today’s standards and a future defined by personalised, scientific exchange.

As a Change Management Lead, you will be a "Catalyst" for organisational transformation. You will ensure that our medical network successfully navigates shifts in how we communicate and engage with customers by addressing both systemic requirements and day-to-day implications for individuals. This is a highly collaborative role, working across PDMA, GIME, and our global affiliate medical network to make our new engagement frameworks a sustainable reality.

• Architect the Change Journey: Design and implement end-to-end transformation strategies that bridge the gap between initial design and sustainable business-as-usual adoption.

• Lead Change Interventions: Serve as the primary change lead for major work packages, integrating human-centric plans into the technical delivery of new frameworks.

• Drive a Future-Ready Culture: Foster a growth and experimental mindset across the medical network, empowering teams to move toward proactive, value-based relationships.

• Ensure Sustainable Adoption: Establish and nurture a network of change agents and champions to drive adoption and ensure new frameworks are successfully scaled globally.

• Design Learning Strategies: Execute learning strategies that upskill the workforce in digital fluency and insight-driven engagement for the future operating model.

• Influence Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Commercial, Digital, and Technology partners to ensure a "One Roche" approach to the customer experience.

• Uphold Ethical Standards: Ensure all activities follow legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice, including HCP engagement policies and Roche directives.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader who thrives in complex, fast-changing environments and has a passion for guiding people through transformational shifts. You look beyond current processes to solve customer pain points and are skilled at translating technical shifts into human-centric value propositions. You are a natural coach and facilitator, able to navigate ambiguity and build trust across a global matrix.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Expert Qualifications: An advanced life-science degree (PhD, PharmD, or MD) or equivalent experience in organisational development, alongside 5+ years of Medical Affairs knowledge.

• Change Mastery: Proven experience applying structured change management frameworks (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) to large-scale organisational shifts, preferably in an Agile environment.

• Strategic Storytelling: The ability to craft a compelling "Case for Change" that connects transformation to higher business impact and the "Triple Win."

• Matrix Fluency: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to speak the language of medical, digital, and commercial teams to drive a unified vision.

• Problem-Solving Agility: Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritise tasks, anticipate barriers, and focus on successful outcomes.

Relocation benefits are available for this position

A healthier future drive

• Assurer l'adoption durable : établir et entretenir un réseau d'agents et de champions du changement pour favoriser l'adoption et veiller à ce que de nouveaux cadres soient appliqués avec succès à l'échelle mondiale.
• Concevoir des stratégies d'apprentissage : Exécuter des stratégies d'apprentissage qui améliorent la compétence de la main-d'œuvre en matière de fluidité numérique et d'engagement axé sur les connaissances pour le futur modèle opérationnel.
• Influence sur l'alignement interfonctionnel : Collaborer avec les partenaires commerciaux, numériques et technologiques pour assurer une approche « One Roche » de l'expérience client.
• Normes éthiques : veiller à ce que toutes les activités respectent les codes de pratique juridiques, réglementaires et d'entreprise, y compris les politiques d'engagement du HCP et les directives Roche. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader visionnaire qui prospère dans des environnements complexes et en évolution rapide et qui a une passion pour guider les gens à travers des changements transformationnels. Vous regardez au-delà des processus actuels pour résoudre les points de douleur du client et sont qualifiés pour traduire les changements techniques en propositions de valeur centrées sur l'homme. Vous êtes un entraîneur et un facilitateur naturel, capable de naviguer l'ambiguïté et de bâtir la confiance à travers une matrice globale. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Qualifications d'expert : Diplôme de sciences de la vie (PhD, PharmD ou MD) ou expérience équivalente en développement organisationnel, parallèlement à 5 ans de connaissances en affaires médicales.
• Maîtrise du changement : expérience éprouvée en appliquant des cadres structurés de gestion du changement (par exemple, Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) à des changements organisationnels à grande échelle, de préférence dans un environnement agile.
• Histoire stratégique : la capacité d'élaborer un « cas pour le changement » convaincant qui relie la transformation à un impact commercial plus élevé et la « triple victoire ».
• Matrice Fluency: Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles avec la capacité de parler le langage des équipes médicales, numériques et commerciales pour conduire une vision unifiée.
• Agilité de résolution des problèmes : Des compétences solides en gestion de projet avec la capacité de prioriser les tâches, d'anticiper les obstacles et de se concentrer sur les résultats fructueux. Des prestations de réinstallation sont disponibles pour ce poste Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain

jobs.title: Pathology Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) is seeking a full-time Pathology Scientist (m/f/d) to join the Pathology team of the US-accredited Companion Diagnostics (CDx) laboratory located in Penzberg. If you have experience in Immunohistochemistry (IHC), in situ hybridization (ISH), or quantitative image analysis using artificial intelligence or machine learning, we want to hear from you!

At Roche PHCS, we value collaboration, innovation, and the drive to make significant contributions to healthcare. As part of our team, you'll work in a multidisciplinary environment, engaging with experts in bioinformatics, oncology, digital pathology, and biomarker development.

The Opportunity

Join a global team of over 20 pathologists located in both Germany and the United States who work together to drive innovation and bring new products to market. In this challenging role you will

• Provide medical oversight for pathology and slide reading for early phase clinical trials, assay development, CE-IVD and Pharma clients. Ensure quality and continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

• Support R&D activities for primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, special stains, and digital pathology, contributing to new product development and process improvements.

• Serve as the medical representative on project teams, addressing all pathology-related aspects and queries, and making strategic contributions through medical knowledge.

• Participate in Pharma client meetings to support biomarker hypothesis testing strategies, and drive activities for publication and/or patent potential.

• Coordinate the work of contracted pathologists, including training, assigning work and advising on day-to-day activities, as needed.

• Contribute to internal pathology education programs, perform training and scoring of slides, read clinical trial patient samples for the CDx laboratory (Penzberg), and stay up-to-date on pathology, oncology, and molecular biology literature.

• Serve as Principal Investigator with medical accountability across multiple European clinical trials within global CDx development programs, acting as the primary medical interface to Pharma partners.

• Provide medical oversight of laboratory processes, procedures, and quality management systems. Ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements as well as global Roche and international standards and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

Who you are

• We seek a Pathologist (m/f/d) with German board certification, a valid German medical license and at least one year of clinical or industry experience

• The ideal candidates will have proven expertise in immunohistochemistry

• You are experienced in interpretation and assessment of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, and molecular platforms

• You are proficient in providing pathology support to project teams and clinical trials

• Furthermore, you are skilled in leading people while communicating effectively, and working within multidisciplinary teams

Your Application
Please submit your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage.
Please note that no additional documents can be submitted
