The Position

Roche is seeking a Medical Affairs leader to shape the future of our Multiple Sclerosis (MS) therapy area. As the Group Leader Medical Affairs , you will lead an experienced team of Global Medical Science Leaders (MDs, PhDs, and PharmDs) who are collectively responsible for our MS medical affairs strategy. This team defines the integrated medical strategy—driving evidence generation, strategic engagement, and medical insights that directly influence how we bring innovative assets to patients worldwide. You will sit at the center of a cross-functional ecosystem, collaborating with specialists in Scientific Communications, Patient Partnership, and Real-World Data to ensure our science changes lives.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will:

• Architect Evidence Strategies: Lead the design and execution of global evidence generation plans, bridging medical and market access gaps through clinical studies and Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS).

• Forge Purposeful Networks: Build and lead scientific exchange with top-tier academic specialists, clinical influencers, and healthcare stakeholders globally to drive RWD initiatives and research collaborations.

• Translate Insights into Strategy: Synthesize complex medical insights to steer commercialization strategies at both the asset and Disease Area levels.

• Enable Market Access: Provide the medical "north star" for market access strategies, ensuring our innovations are positioned for maximum patient benefit and operational success.

• Champion Scientific Innovation: Secure the strategic input necessary to enable the introduction of next-generation therapies.

• Lead with Global Influence: Collaborate seamlessly across Roche’s Pharma and Diagnostics Divisions and our global affiliate network to ensure a unified medical voice.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader with deep scientific roots and a relentless passion for Neurology. You don’t just manage teams; you inspire experts to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
Your credentials include:

• Deep Expertise: An advanced life-science degree ( MD, PhD, or PharmD ) with a specialization in Neurology or equivalent high-level industry experience.

• Proven Leadership: A distinguished track record in Medical Affairs, with a demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing expert teams.

• Patient-Centric Ethics: Unwavering ethical standards and a mindset that places the patient at the center of clinical development and medical practice.

• Strategic Agility: The ability to navigate complex global environments, make informed decisions under pressure, and influence stakeholders through exceptional communication.

• Global Fluency: Mastery of written and verbal communication, capable of engaging and inspiring diverse audiences worldwide.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche sta cercando un leader di affari medici per modellare il futuro della nostra area di terapia per la sclerosi multipla (MS). Come Leader del Gruppo Medical Affairs , guiderai un team esperto di Global Medical Science Leaders (MD, PhD e PharmDs) che sono responsabili collettivamente della nostra strategia per gli affari medici di MS. Questo team definisce la strategia medica integrata: la generazione di prove, l'impegno strategico e le intuizioni mediche che influenzano direttamente il modo in cui portiamo beni innovativi a pazienti in tutto il mondo. Ti siederai al centro di un ecosistema interfunzionale, collaborando con specialisti in Comunicazione Scientifica, Partenariato Paziente e Dati Real-World per garantire la vita dei nostri cambiamenti scientifici. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, voi:
• Strategie di prova dell'architetto: guidare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di piani di generazione di prove globali, colmare lacune di accesso medico e di mercato attraverso studi clinici e studi avviati dell'investigatore (IIS).
• Forge Targetful Networks: Costruire e condurre lo scambio scientifico con specialisti accademici di alto livello, influencer clinici e stakeholder sanitari a livello globale per guidare iniziative di RWD e collaborazioni di ricerca.
• Tradurre Insights in Strategy: Sinthesize complesse intuizioni mediche per sostenere strategie di commercializzazione sia a livello di asset che di Area Malattia.
• Abilitare l'accesso al mercato: fornire la "nord star" medica per le strategie di accesso al mercato, assicurando le nostre innovazioni sono posizionate per il massimo beneficio del paziente e il successo operativo.
• Champion Scientific Innovation: assicura l'ingresso strategico necessario per consentire l'introduzione di terapie di nuova generazione.
• Guidare con l’influenza globale: collaborare senza soluzione di continuità attraverso le Divisioni Farmacie e Diagnostica di Roche e la nostra rete di affiliazione globale per garantire una voce medica unificata. • Profonda competenza: un grado avanzato di vita-scienza (MD, PhD, o PharmD) con una specializzazione in neurologia o equivalente esperienza di settore di alto livello.
• Prove Leadership: un disco distinto in Medical Affairs, con una capacità dimostrata di guidare, mentore e sviluppare team di esperti altamente performanti.

This team defines the integrated medical strategy—driving evidence generation, strategic engagement, and medical insights that directly influence how we bring innovative assets to patients worldwide. • Forge Purposeful Networks: Build and lead scientific exchange with top-tier academic specialists, clinical influencers, and healthcare stakeholders globally to drive RWD initiatives and research collaborations.
• Translate Insights into Strategy: Synthesize complex medical insights to steer commercialization strategies at both the asset and Disease Area levels.
• Enable Market Access: Provide the medical "north star" for market access strategies, ensuring our innovations are positioned for maximum patient benefit and operational success.
• Champion Scientific Innovation: Secure the strategic input necessary to enable the introduction of next-generation therapies.
• Lead with Global Influence: Collaborate seamlessly across Roche’s Pharma and Diagnostics Divisions and our global affiliate network to ensure a unified medical voice. En tant que chef de groupe des affaires médicales, vous dirigerez une équipe expérimentée de leaders mondiaux des sciences médicales (MD, doctorats et PharmDs) qui sont collectivement responsables de notre stratégie en matière de sciences médicales. Cette équipe définit la stratégie médicale intégrée – génération de preuves de conduite, engagement stratégique et perspectives médicales qui influencent directement la façon dont nous apportons des actifs innovants aux patients dans le monde entier. Vous siégerez au centre d'un écosystème interfonctionnel, en collaboration avec des spécialistes des communications scientifiques, du partenariat patient et des données du monde réel afin de s'assurer que notre science change les vies. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Stratégies en matière de preuves architecturales : Diriger la conception et l'exécution de plans mondiaux de production de preuves, combler les lacunes médicales et d'accès aux marchés grâce à des études cliniques et à des études menées par des chercheurs.
• Forge Des réseaux ciblés : Construisez et dirigez des échanges scientifiques avec des spécialistes universitaires de haut niveau, des influenceurs cliniques et des intervenants dans le domaine de la santé à l'échelle mondiale afin de stimuler les initiatives et les collaborations en matière de DDR.
• Translate Insights into Strategy: Synthétiser des informations médicales complexes pour orienter les stratégies de commercialisation tant au niveau des actifs qu'au niveau des maladies.
• Permettre l'accès au marché : fournir la « étoile nord » médicale pour les stratégies d'accès au marché, en veillant à ce que nos innovations soient positionnées pour un maximum d'avantages pour le patient et de succès opérationnel.
• Champion de l'innovation scientifique : Sécuriser l'apport stratégique nécessaire pour permettre l'introduction de thérapies de nouvelle génération.
• Diriger avec l'influence mondiale : Collaborer de manière transparente entre les divisions Pharma et Diagnostics de Roches et notre réseau mondial d'affiliation pour assurer une voix médicale unifiée. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader visionnaire aux racines scientifiques profondes et à la passion incessante pour la neurologie. Vous ne gérez pas simplement des équipes ; vous inspirez les experts à repousser les limites de ce qui est possible. Vos références comprennent :
• Deep Expertise : Diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie (M.D., Ph.D. ou PharmD) avec spécialisation en neurologie ou expérience professionnelle équivalente de haut niveau.
• Leadership prouvé : Un parcours remarquable en affaires médicales, avec une capacité démontrée de diriger, de guider et de développer des équipes d'experts hautement performantes.
• Éthique du patient : Des normes éthiques inébranlables et un état d'esprit qui place le patient au centre du développement clinique et de la pratique médicale.
• Agilité stratégique : Capacité de naviguer dans des environnements mondiaux complexes, de prendre des décisions éclairées sous pression et d'influencer les parties prenantes par une communication exceptionnelle.
• La fluidité globale : maîtrise de la communication écrite et verbale, capable d'engager et d'inspirer divers publics dans le monde entier. Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir comment votre leadership peut redéfinir le paysage MS à Roche! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Medical Manager is a key strategic leadership role requiring therapeutic area expertise and clear business understanding to identify and address the relevant medical needs of clinical practice, to successfully support the optimal use of Roche products.
They link affiliate to Global Medical Affairs objectives to deliver on data generation, knowledge exchange / data communications, and to lead Therapeutic Area Expert engagement in a scientific manner.
The MM acts as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics, and safety of Roche products, putting patients at the center of their actions.

The Opportunity:
Development and management of the medical plan

• Identify local data gaps, local studies protocol design, study planning (including budget), input to site selection and feasibility assessment, data dissemination strategy

• Align the local medical plan with the local marketing, CT/IMT/DST strategy and global medical plan, under supervision of Medical Director

• Congress overview and guidelines development

Medical expertise and customer insights to the brand team

• Offer experienced opinion aligned with LCT/IMT/DSC medical recommendations on scientific medical information to identify and develop effective peer-to-peer relationships to implement our product strategies, while holding high ethical standards, compliance to Roche SOP and local/international regulations

• Research, collate, present and offer data insights related to the dedicated disease area and product(s)

• Lead the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communicated both internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes.

• Handle Medical Information activities in accordance with regional/local model, referencing global standard responses

• Manage publication related activities according to Roche Policy and SOPs

• Develop a customer centricity culture, making sure promotional/medical/scientific communications address HCP needs and optimize patient benefit and safety while keeping a fair balance and compliance with regulations and SOPs

Contribution to local clinical operations activities

• Design, oversight of execution, and report of clinical trials according to ICH-GCP, Roche SOPs and local regulations

• Development of effective interactions with Clinical Operations (both PDG and PA/GPS), including but not limited to placing studies, provide input on feasibility, sites and investigators selection.

• Oversee the phase III-B/IV trial program by holding effective relationship with the Clinical Operations team

• Provide early insights on new products and indications in close collaboration with the PDG group

• Inform other Affiliate functions on Global planned studies

• Design and implementation of patient support programs

Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) engagement plan and execution

• Maintain regular contacts with investigators for key studies

• Identify and develop scientific relationship with external TAEs/ experts who are qualified sources of insight and advice

• Ensure that all activities towards external experts / TAEs are harmonized across the affiliate

• Share Best Practices across customers to facilitate improved patients outcome

• Planning and execution of relevant scientific advisory boards and expert meetings

Who you are:

• Medical Degree or related careers (Health)

• Oncology background is a must.

• Advanced Level of English

• Professional experience within the pharmaceutical industry desirable but not mandatory

• K

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Doing now what patients need next. Near Patient Care is committed to helping people with diabetes everywhere in the world think less about their daily diabetes routine, so they can get true relief, day and night. We offer a broad portfolio of solutions for both people with diabetes and their professionals - from blood glucose monitoring to information management to continuous glucose monitoring. Our aim is to offer innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis is a function within Roche Diagnostics - Near Patient Care Operations, responsible for the strip manufacturing of the majority of our blood glucose monitoring portfolio for the global demand of our patients. In the future, Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis will also be responsible for sensor manufacturing for our continuous glucose monitoring portfolio.

The Opportunity:

As a Sr Manufacturing Engineer - Controls, you will provide technical engineering support of automated and semi-automated manufacturing equipment as required by the production schedule. You will troubleshoot equipment and process issues, lead/contribute to process improvement/characterization projects, train maintenance and production personnel, conduct pilot and validation activities following Roche Diagnostics – Near Patient Care Operations policies and procedure. You will ensure the validated state of the production process/equipment is maintained.

Your Responsibilities;

• Leads the development, implementation and maintenance of manufacturing methods, procedures and processes in the manufacture of products, components, subassemblies and final assemblies.

• Develops and improves automation and electromechanical processes by studying requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators and maintenance technicians.

• Interfaces with design and process development engineering in coordinating the release of new products to the manufacturing process.

• Helps to estimate manufacturing cost and makes recommendations for tooling, controls system hardware and software, and process requirements of new or existing production lines.

• Manages multiple projects and time scopes for each project.

• Ensures process changes are characterized and implemented following validation policies and procedures.

• Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished -product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.

• Assists department leadership in setting strategic direction.

• Possess and apply a broad knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures of the field.

• Maintains product and company reputation by complying with government regulations.

• Provide guidance and advice to lower level staff.

• Participates in the on-call rotation to provide off shift / weekend support to production, as needed.

• Support key initiatives such as information management, cyber security, and life cycle management.

•

Knowledge/Skills/Attributes

• This role requires hands-on experience in troubleshooting manufacturing equipment controls systems. Key areas of focus include, but are not limited to:

• Electrical systems

• PLC ladder logic and structured text (preferably Allen Bradley PLCs using RSLogix/Studio 5000)

• Motion Controls (e.g. VFDs, servos, etc.)

• Human Machine Interface (HMI) (p

The Position
The Opportunity

As Global Business Process Manager (GBPM) for GBPM Intercompany Finance - Trade (Physical / Digital), you are part of the BPM Finance team in RSS. In this role you are reporting to the Global Business Process Owner Global Business Process Owner (GBPO) P2Dx & Capital Finance for GBPM Intercompany Finance - Trade (Physical / Digital)
In this role, you are responsible in the product area of R2R for the Definition and continuous global harmonization, the implementation and continuous improvement including automation and the governance of the process and system solutions.

• Accountable for generating ideas towards and driving the BPM strategic roadmap for For GBPM Intercompany Finance - Trade (Physical / Digital)

• Liaise with and influence (senior) stakeholders to guarantee business acceptance on a global level across divisions and functions.

• Ensure you establish metrics for your E2E process area.

• Accountable for prioritization, justification and realization of major change requests in line with the strategic roadmap for your process area

• Ensure documentation of process requirements, implementation through guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures

• Drive efficiencies and improvements (incl. automation) across E2E network, RSS Operations, affiliates and IT, by considering external market insights and best practices

• Contribution to partner projects, providing advice and guidance for your process area

• Provide guidance to the Global Business Process Specialists for your area

• Accountable for implementing and driving initiatives in line with the strategic roadmap for your process area

• Contribute to advance agile ways of working in teams and the organization

Who you are

• Expert Credentials: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance or Business with 5–7 years of experience in controlling and global process optimization.

• Transformation Leadership: Proven success supporting large-scale, cross-functional global projects and navigating complex international stakeholder networks.

• Strategic Problem Solving: Advanced analytical skills with a "Can Do" mindset and the ability to make decisive moves in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

• Operational Excellence: Proficient in Agile and Lean methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Scrum) to challenge the status quo and drive innovative change.

• Elite Communication: Exceptional organizational skills and fluency in English, with the ability to influence and present effectively at a corporate level.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

jobs.title: (Senior) Regulatory Group Director (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Position
In dieser Führungsposition innerhalb von Pharma Technical Regulatory (PTR) verfügst du über ein breites Verständnis der regulatorischen Landschaft und setzt dein Wissen gezielt ein, um Ergebnisse im Einklang mit unserer „North Star“-Vision zu erzielen. Als Führungskraft bist du dafür verantwortlich, Veränderungen in der gesamten Organisation voranzutreiben und unsere Mitarbeitenden in einem globalen Umfeld zu unterstützen. Du hast ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für Prioritäten und Bereiche mit hoher Hebelwirkung, vernetzt die richtigen Personen und Ressourcen mit den entsprechenden Aufgaben und hilfst der Organisation, sich an veränderte regulatorische Anforderungen anzupassen. Du inspirierst unsere Teams zu mutiger Innovation und Zusammenarbeit, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die für Patienten, Stakeholder und das Unternehmen von entscheidender Bedeutung sind.
In der Rolle des Regulatory Group Director verantwortest du sowohl das Portfolio-Management (mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich Biologics / ADCs) als auch die personelle Führung . Dabei unterstützt und befähigst du Teams und Einzelpersonen innerhalb dieses Betriebsmodells, die übergeordneten Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Deine Chancen

• Strategische Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Aufsicht und Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von End-to-End-Regulierungsstrategien und -initiativen auf Portfolio-Ebene.

• Portfolio-Steuerung: Du definierst Strategien für ein spezifisches Portfolio (z. B. Produktportfolio innerhalb einer Modalität, cross-funktionale Initiativen für Innovation, Operational Excellence oder Policy) und übersetzt diese in konkrete Ergebnisse. Dabei sicherst du die Transparenz über Squads und Teams hinweg, priorisierst Aufgaben und steuerst die Ressourcenplanung sowie das Budgeting.

• Globale Kollaboration: Du arbeitest auf globaler Ebene eng mit anderen Führungskräften zusammen, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die Organisationsziele durch punktuelle Unterstützung von Projekten und Initiativen zu fördern.

• Trend-Monitoring: Du hältst dich über interne und externe Entwicklungen sowie Trends auf dem Laufenden, um die Auswirkungen auf alle Programme bewerten zu können, und stärkst das Bewusstsein hierfür im Unternehmen.

• Behördenmanagement: Du leitest Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden (Health Authorities) sowie die Überprüfung von Einreichungen (Submissions) für zugewiesene Projekte mit erweitertem Umfang. Du vertrittst den Bereich Technical Regulatory in multidisziplinären Terminen mit Behörden. Zudem bist du zentraler Ansprechpartner für einen oder mehrere regulatorische Kompetenzbereiche (z. B. CTA, NDA, LCM, Datenmanagement, Systeme) und treibst dort Effizienz und Exzellenz voran.

• Kommunikation & Stakeholder-Management: Du fungierst als Sprachrohr der Organisation und stellst sicher, dass Herausforderungen, Chancen und Maßnahmen der Führungsebene den Mitarbeitenden strukturiert und transparent vermittelt werden. Du baust Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern auf und räumst organisatorische Hindernisse aus dem Weg.

• Modern Leadership: Als Führungskraft befähigst du selbstverwaltete Teams, indem du als Visionär, Architekt, Coach und Katalysator agierst. Du bist für das Performance-Management deiner Direct Reports verantwortlich, gibst zeitnahes Feedback und förderst die individuelle Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Gespräche und Check-ins.

Dein Profil
Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverha

jobs.title: Ad Operations Coordinator (Fixed-term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Ad Operations Coordinator plays a central role in ensuring high-quality campaign activation and reliable data foundations for reporting and performance measurement. This role requires a hands-on operator with strong technical expertise in ad serving platforms, combined with a structured, detail-oriented mindset and a focus on scalable and sustainable operations.

This is a fixed-term opportunity for 1,5 year.

The Opportunity:

• Manage and support the setup, configuration, and ongoing operation of Roche Pharma’s ad server environment, including the rollout and adoption of usage across teams in line with defined standards and best practices

• Execute and oversee campaign trafficking end-to-end, ensuring accurate setup, tagging, ad assignment, and launch readiness, while reviewing and correcting builds to maintain high execution quality

• Act as a subject matter expert for ad server governance, maintaining naming conventions, taxonomy, and trafficking standards, and ensuring consistency, auditability, and operational discipline

• Ensure data integrity across the ad server ecosystem by supporting tagging and tracking frameworks, validating reporting outputs, and collaborating with analytics teams to enable reliable dashboards and measurement

• Troubleshoot campaign and data issues, serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement of workflows, processes, and scalable ad operations practices

Who you are:

• You have 6+ years of experience in digital marketing, ad operations, campaign management, or a related field, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience in ad trafficking and ad server operations, ideally within a media agency or comparable in-house function

• You have strong hands-on experience with ad-serving platforms such as Campaign Manager 360 (CM360) or equivalent, and understand campaign setup, tagging workflows, placement structures, creatives, and tracking methodologies

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential and additional languages are a plus, based on region/customer requirements

• You are detail-oriented, well-organized, and efficient with time management

• You are able to work under pressure and work independently

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes, and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching/mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global, inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Main Responsibilities:
Manages market research needs for products or therapeutic areas within the organization.
Conducts and manages primary and secondary market research projects, including labeling and advertising.
Provides marketing insight and direction to optimize strategic products
Analyzes data and makes strategic recommendations.
Contributes to annual business plan and maximizes market potential. Interprets and translates scientific clinical data into commercial implications.
Directs the development of company marketing plan and supporting sales activities for specific products or product lines including assessment of potential markets.
Establishes pricing strategies, develops budgets and monitors expenditures.
May develop short and long-range strategies for product expansion. Interfaces with Product Development, Production and Manufacturing to develop new products or enhance existing products or product lines.
May act as a technical advisor for specific products.
Oversees market analysis, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs. Defines vision, strategies, and tactics.
Selects, develops and evaluates employees to ensure the efficient operation of the function.

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor above

• Medical, marketing, commerce preferred

• Adapt well to different cultures and business styles

• Collaborative and supportive approach to teamwork

• Good understanding and strong commitment

• Innovate and highly self-motivated to drive results

• Strong learning agility

Job Required Competencies

• MNC background

• 7-10 years’ experience in marketing and/sales

• 7 years Pharmaceutical or relevant marketing experience preferred

• Strong communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English (oral and writing)

• Strong execution capability, cross-functional communication

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English (oral and writing)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: PSS Transformation Solution Partner

titleByLocale.it: Partner della soluzione di trasformazione PSS

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Transformation and Solution Partner (TSP) , you will engage and partner primarily with People & Culture (P&C) colleagues across all Chapters and business stakeholders globally. Your mission is to govern M&A and transformation data management frameworks with right solution expertise while driving global P&C solution improvements. You will serve as a centre of excellence for transformation ideation, navigating complex business transformations to ensure a seamless partner experience in collaboration with Transformation and Solution Advisor (TSA). You help translate business goals into P&C priorities, leveraging holistic data and historical learning to iterate and improve the overall global transformation flow.

Your opportunity as Transformation & Solution Partner:

• M&A / Transformation Framework Governance: Lead the governance of transformation frameworks to ensure consistency and excellence across global initiatives.

• Transformation Solution & Framework Expertise: Provide expert guidance and implementation support for digital transformation tools. Serve as a Centre of Excellence for transformation improvement ideations, capturing historical learnings to further iterate and enhance existing transformation experience.

• Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Business Partners and business leaders of globally-scaled transformations to provide framework consultancy, from preliminary until embedment stages.

• Cross P&C Solution Improvement: Drive improvements for the overall global transformation flow, identifying gaps and implementing proactive solutions across the P&C network.Collaborates on complex P&C challenges and demands, connecting with the right P&C chapters to develop an end-to-end solution, determine ownership and drive effective change management.

• Continue Improvement : Proactively identifies customer needs or P&C solutions’ gaps, and translates these needs to change requests and builds cross-functional squads to implement continuous improvements within our P&C network.

• Collaboration & Innovation: Share best practices for emerging technologies, such as AI-driven org design and job design to build Transformation and solution advisory team knowledge and capability.

Who you are:
You bring the following skills and competencies:

• Passion for Change: Deep interest in project management, process improvement, and change management.

• Digital Proficiency: Strong expertise in digital solutions like Airtable and Workday, with the ability to lead the transition from manual spreadsheets to integrated technology platforms.

• Exceptional Stakeholder Management: Ability to represent the P&C/PSS vision and articulate the strategy and “the why” behind complex transformations.

• Agility: Ability to work independently and deliver results in a matrixed, fast-paced environment while balancing competing priorities.

• Influencing Skills: Exceptional communication, consulting, and negotiation skills, with the ability to coach colleagues and lead without direct authority.

Further requirements:

• Education: University degree or equivalent, HR preferred.

• Experience: Extensive experience (typically 7–8 years) with HR processes, HR shared services, or HR functional expertise, ideally in a global environment.

• Transformation Expertise: Proven track record in managing large-scale global transformations and M&A activities.

• Languages: Fluent in English required; additional languages are a plus.

• Certification: Project management and/or process

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Head of Digital Strategy, Excellence & Standards, Global Digital & Data Analytics

Why Roche
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Who We Are
The Global Data, Digital & AI (GDDA) organization plays a central role in Roche Pharma Commercial’s digital and AI ecosystem. GDDA sets the enterprise digital strategy, translates commercial objectives into a coordinated portfolio of investments, and defines the standards and operating model that enable scalable execution across programs and products. By connecting strategy, portfolio, standards, programs, and products, GDDA ensures that data, digital, and AI capabilities are delivered as scalable, enterprise solutions that drive adoption and improve outcomes for patients, healthcare providers, and the broader healthcare ecosystem.

The Opportunity
The Head of Digital Strategy, Excellence & Standards is responsible for shaping and driving the strategic agenda of the Global Data, Digital & AI organization within Pharma Commercial. This role leads development of the GDDA strategic plan, ensuring strategic coherence with GDDA’s core mandates while translating enterprise and Pharma Commercial priorities into clear GDDA objectives, outcomes, and prioritization principles that guide investment decisions. This role also drives the design of GDDA’s operating model and organizational approach including the definition of global vs. local standards and operating discipline for digital products, data, and technology— establishing the bar for quality and consistency across markets and local execution. This role also owns change enablement across the digital ecosystem — ensuring that new standards, processes, and capabilities are adopted effectively through structured communication, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness. Partnering closely with leaders across Roche Pharma, the Head of Strategy defines interfaces, aligns initiatives, and avoids duplication across the broader digital ecosystem. Acting as Chief of Staff to the GDDA Leader, this role represents GDDA perspectives in leadership forums, develops executive narratives, and ensures strong cross-functional alignment and a coherent path from strategy to impact. Over time, the role will build and lead a team responsible for delivering and scaling these mandates.

What you will be working on
Strategy & Standards
Lead development and evolution of the enterprise GDDA strategy, including mandate definition, ambition setting, and a multi-year capability vision and strategic direction ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and continuous evolution based on value realization and external signals.
• Define and evolve testable, repeatable, and scalable global standards across digital products, data, technology, and ways of working — enabling consistent adoption across markets.
• Engage in enterprise strategic conversations to ensure pharma commercial digital priorities are represented as enterprise strategies are shaped.
• Ensure ongoing strategic alignment of GDDA initiatives with broader Roche Pharma and enterprise priorities.
• Continuously refresh, connect,

jobs.title: Data and Analytics Governance (DAG) Lead

titleByLocale.it: Gestione dei dati e delle analisi (DAG)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Data and Analytics Governance (DAG) Lead is a key role responsible for establishing and maintaining effective data & analytics governance practices for Roche’s Digital Backbone (Enterprise Resource Planning environment) and the Finance, Procurement and Roche Solution and Services Domain, working closely with cross-functional teams in ASPIRE program (implementing and deploying the Digital Backbone to all Roche affiliates), Roche Data Office, Informatics and Enterprise Master Data Management (EMDM) to ensure the consistent application of Functional DAG policies, standards and controls derived out of the Global Guidelines from the Roche Data Office.

• Align, Develop and implement a comprehensive DAG Framework, including data policies, standards, and procedures in alignment with the Roche Data Council's policies, standards and procedures.

• Implement and further develop the Framework`s data and analytics -related roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities

• Develop and implement a comprehensive DAG Cookbook, including metadata management guidance

• Build and maintain up to date metadata repository, data lineage, monitor data quality, integrity, and security measures in collaboration with data stewards, data owners, and Informatics teams

• Facilitate DAG meetings, Stakeholder alignment meetings and closely collaborate with the Roche Data Council

• Manage Business Data Stewardship from a Product Owner perspective, including Strategy, Roadmap and Objectives for Data Analytics and Governance (DAG), aligned with Group Data Strategy

Who you are

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Management, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in data management, governance, or analytics roles

• Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts

• Familiarity with data governance frameworks and standards (e.g., DAMA)

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights

• Effective communication and facilitation skills to engage stakeholders at all levels

• Project management experience and the ability to juggle multiple priorities

• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging data and analytics governance frameworks to continuously improve DAG Roche’s Digital Backbone approach

• Excellent understanding of Data & Analytics, Pharmaceutical Business Processes, Data Governance Solutions (e.g. Collibra)

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive cult

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要工作目标
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责/责任
规范诊疗
1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
学科建设
1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范疾病全程管理
支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
•在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
• That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
Position summary

As a team member of RSS, you execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level requirements, in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process.
It is also key to follow the instructions of the Team Lead regarding the daily work coordination.
You are responsible for managing incoming and outgoing phone calls based on the predefined SLAs and processes and incoming Service Now tickets. With your dedicated work, you contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of Roche.

Responsibilities

● Service Delivery
o Your key responsibilities will be providing support on 1st level questions, system related questions, role management, consultancy services on existing procurement functionalities of the system/platform for end users
• o Providing support primarily by phone and ticketing tool for above mentioned system related queries coming from Indirect Procurement End Users
• o Creating/maintaining and following up cases/tickets in the adequate quality and in timely manner – within 24 hours if possible- in order to achieve the best response and end-to-end resolution time
• o Proceed with role ownership tickets in timely manner according to the guidelines
• o Responsible for first level issue resolution and being able to make decision on further actions for completing and resolving the upcoming requests and issues
• o Being a bridge between other resolver groups and the business, by reviewing feedback related incidents and sharing the knowledge and instructions with the Requestor on the adequate level
• o Work on scheduled and ad-hoc reporting activities, pro-actively practice the available and required tool sets
• o Work on the regular and ad-hoc monitoring activity and apply fixes as needed.
• o Being responsible and contribute to a proper availability planning within the Team by discussing planned holiday/training schedule in advance

● Cross-Functional Collaboration
o Contribute continuously to the implementation of new tasks and responsibilities coming to the RSS

● Outputs & Deliverables
o Maintaining SOPs, Annexes and training materials for 1st level support. Prepare and share knowledge base documents in timely manner or for the requested deadline

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

Who You Are
Your skills:

• ● You bring the following skills and competencies:
• o Experience in supplier relationship management
• o Basic understanding of procurement support
• o Familiar with ticketing tools
• o Good numerical and analytical skills
• o React to problems in an appropriate manner
• o Able to work in a fast paced environment
• o Good at time management
• o Open to working in afternoon schedule until 6:00 pm
• o Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills
• o Outstanding customer service and interpersonal skills
• o Highly accountable, agile, and results oriented.
• o Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and written
• o Excellent organizational skills and abi

jobs.title: Regional Center Partner (PV, Pharmacovigilance)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Regional Center Partner (PV, Pharmacovigilance) , you will be at the heart of our Pharmacovigilance (PV) operations, ensuring that safety information is collected, reported, and handled with the highest level of integrity. You will join a mission-driven team dedicated to delivering compliant, high-quality outcomes that directly impact patients' lives worldwide.
In this role, you will act as a guardian of our PV system, driving continuous improvement and simplification of processes. You will collaborate with a diverse network of global experts and external vendors, navigating a complex matrix environment to maintain an inspection-ready state. This is an opportunity to apply your "systems thinking" and entrepreneurial mindset to a function that is critical to Roche’s success and reputation.

• You will ensure the end-to-end collection and reporting of safety information in strict compliance with Roche and local regulatory requirements.

• You will maintain robust oversight of safety risk management activities, including those executed by our external partners and vendors.

• You will lead the preparation of safety-related documents, serving as Lead Author for Local Aggregate Reports (LAR) and Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRER).

• You will drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and effectiveness within the Patient Safety Operations.

• You will identify and escalate potential risks or deviations, ensuring appropriate follow-up actions are taken to maintain compliance.

• You will collaborate closely with Country Champions and Affiliate Patient Safety teams to ensure seamless execution of safety activities.

Who you are

You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong quality mindset and the ability to navigate complex regulatory landscapes with sound judgement. You thrive in collaborative environments and are passionate about continuous learning and process optimization. We offer a positive work environment where your contributions to patient safety are valued, and you are empowered to grow your expertise in a global pharmaceutical leader.

• You hold a Health Care Professional degree (e.g., Medicine, Pharmacy) or a Life Science degree (e.g., Biology, Neuroscience).

• You bring at least 2-3 years of experience in Drug Safety or Pharmacovigilance.

• You have a solid understanding of global Pharmacovigilance and Medical Device regulatory requirements.

• You possess a deep knowledge of end-to-end PV processes and Quality Management Systems (QMS).

• You have the ability to independently evaluate, analyze, and interpret complex data to draw meaningful conclusions.

• You are a proactive problem-solver with excellent communication skills in fluent English.

Location: This position is based in Budapest.

Relocation Assistance is not available

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Opportunity：

titleByLocale.en: Java Developer ( Agent - First Development Mindset )
titleByLocale.de: Java Entwickler ( Agent - First Development Mindset )

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Information Solutions (RIS), we now do what patients need next. We are transforming healthcare through digital innovation, building high-scale, cloud-native platforms that support clinicians and patients globally. We are seeking a high-seniority Java Developer for our Warsaw-based hub who can be co-located, and brings an AI-first mindset to the software development lifecycle.

The Opportunity

You will work on a cloud-native digital pathology platform that is transforming how pathology laboratories operate worldwide. The system enables pathologists, histotechnicians, and laboratory coordinators to digitize tissue slide specimens, manage clinical cases end-to-end, review high-resolution slide images remotely, run AI-powered algorithms for diagnostic decision support, and seamlessly exchange data with laboratory information systems (LIS) and PACS archives. The vision is to deliver advanced medical insights and drive personalized healthcare by replacing manual, microscope-bound workflows with a connected, software-defined laboratory experience.

As a Java Developer, you will build and evolve the microservices that power these clinical workflows — from image ingestion and case management to algorithm orchestration and third-party integrations — directly contributing to faster, more confident diagnoses for patients globally.

Who you are:

The "AI-First" Mindset

Beyond technical mastery, we value developers who treat AI agents as a core partner in their workflow:

• SDLC Optimization: Using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, or LLMs) to accelerate refactoring, boilerplate generation, and complex bug hunting.

• Agentic Awareness: Understanding how to leverage AI agents to automate routine tasks such as unit test generation, documentation, and PR descriptions.

• Efficiency: A proactive approach to using prompt engineering to drive speed and quality in production-ready code.

Technical Skills :

• Strong Knowledge of Java: Deep understanding of core Java (including Java 17+ features), JVM internals, memory management, and concurrency.

• Extensive Spring Experience: Proficient in Spring Boot, including modules like Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security.

• Microservices Architecture: Proven experience in designing, developing, and deploying microservices-based applications.

• Cloud Technologies: Hands-on experience with the AWS cloud platform.

• Databases: Proficiency in SQL databases, specifically PostgreSQL.

• Testing: Solid experience with unit testing (JUnit, Mockito), integration testing, and end-to-end testing.

• Version Control: Advanced proficiency with Git, including branching strategies and code review processes.

• APIs: Strong understanding of RESTful API design and development.

Skills & Experience:

• A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in Java software development.

• Code Quality: A strong advocate for high-quality code, best practices, and clean code principles (SOLID).

• Fluent English

• Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex, distributed issues.

• Project Ownership: Capable of taking full ownership of features and projects, from initial conception to deployment and maintenance.

• Independence and Autonomy: Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and be proactive in a fast-paced, remote environment.

• Strong Communication: Excellent skills in articulating technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Team C

titleByLocale.de: Global Leiter Pharma Technical Development Synthetic Molecules (PTDC)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are

Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to millions of patients worldwide. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine from the development process through clinical trials and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of the production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is an integral part of this mission. As an organization of over 2,500 people globally, PTD is responsible for developing the manufacturing processes, products, analytical methods, and Chemistry, Manufacturing & Controls (CMC) strategies to deliver all new products in Roche’s pipeline. This work encompasses the full range of development functions, including biologics, synthetic molecules, devices, clinical supply chain management, and project and portfolio management. PTD applies leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical-stage products globally, reliably delivering the pipeline and supporting commercial manufacturing operations. We excel through innovation, collaboration, dedication, and mutual respect, continuously improving what we do to ensure Roche’s supply of quality products to patients. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, technical excellence, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Position Purpose

As the Global Head of Pharma Technical Development Synthetic Molecules (PTDC), you are an enterprise leader responsible for the strategic direction, development, clinical manufacturing of Roche’s Synthetic Molecule portfolio. This is a triple-impact role: you lead the end-to-end technical development (CMC) for small molecules, oligonucleotides and peptides, while simultaneously serving as the PTD Basel Site Head .
You are also responsible for internal manufacturing of launch and commercial supply of drug substance for the synthetic molecules.

You are the primary accountable leader of the new Synthetic Molecule Facility (SMF), ensuring it is delivered on time and on budget to deliver Pharma Ambition. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) est l'organisation qui fabrique et livre des thérapies révolutionnaires à des millions de patients dans le monde entier. PT est impliqué dans la production de chaque médicament Roche depuis le processus de développement jusqu'aux essais cliniques et jusqu'à la maturité du produit. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) fait partie intégrante de cette mission. En tant qu'organisation de plus de 2 500 personnes à l'échelle mondiale, PTD est responsable du développement des procédés de fabrication, des produits, des méthodes d'analyse et des stratégies de chimie, de fabrication et de contrôle (CMC) pour livrer tous les nouveaux produits dans le pipeline de Roche. Ce travail englobe toute la gamme des fonctions de développement, y compris les produits biologiques, les molécules synthétiques, les dispositifs, la gestion clinique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la gestion de projets et de portefeuilles. La PTD applique une expertise technique de premier plan à la conception, au développement, à l'approvisionnement et à l'enregistrement des produits en phase clinique à l'échelle mondiale, à la livraison fiable du pipeline et au soutien des activités de fabrication commerciale. Nous excellons par l'innovation, la collaboration, le dévouement et le respect mutuel, en améliorant continuellement ce que nous faisons pour assurer la fourniture de produits de qualité aux patients. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'excellence technique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Fonction En tant que responsable mondial du développement technique des molécules synthétiques (PTDC), vous êtes un chef d'entreprise responsable de la direction stratégique, du développement, de la fabrication clinique du portefeuille des molécules synthétiques Roches. C'est un rôle à triple impact : vous dirigez le développement technique de bout en bout (CMC) pour les petites molécules, oligonucléotides et peptides, tout en servant simultanément comme tête de site de la PTD Basel. Vous êtes également responsable de la fabrication interne du lancement et de l'approvisionnement commercial de la substance médicamenteuse pour les molécules synthétiques. Vous êtes le chef de file principal responsable de la nouvelle installation de molécules synthétiques (MFS), vous assurant qu'elle est livrée à temps et dans le budget pour livrer Pharma Ambition. Vous servez de catalyseur pour le « leadership collectif » au sein de la DPT, comblant l'écart entre l'innovation en début de carrière et l'excellence du lancement commercial. Principales responsabilités 1. Portefeuille des molécules synthétiques et développement de bout en bout
• E2E Responsabilisation: Diriger la vision et l'exécution de la substance médicamenteuse à molécule synthétique, du soutien à la découverte et à la fabrication clinique au lancement commercial et à la gestion du cycle de vie.
• Lancer Excellence : assurer la livraison des trousses de CMC pour les EMN (nouvelle entité moléculaire) et les extensions de lignes, contribuant directement aux objectifs généraux de Roche et aux objectifs d'excellence en R-D.
• Innovation technique: Diriger les capacités synthétiques de nouvelle génération, y compris l'automatisation numérique, les modèles "Lab to Plant" et les processus durables "Green Chemistry". 2. Leadership du site de Bâle (chef du site du DPT)
• Gouvernance du site: Servir de point unique de responsabilité pour toutes les questions liées au site de la PTD à Bâle. Cela comprend la surveillance de la qualité, de la sécurité, de la durabilité et de l'infrastructure.
• Membre actif de l'équipe de gestion de Bâle/Kaiseraugst : représentant efficacement et faisant avancer les intérêts de la PTD et du site lors de la réunion de gestion de Bâle Kaiseraugst.
• Les gens et la culture : favoriser une organisation à haut rendement (HPO). Formation des employés principaux, initiatives de mobilisation

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. As an Accounts Receivable & Treasury Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for AR & Treasury matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

You will be :

• You are responsible in processing Account receivable, treasury and inter-company task as per Service level Agreement.

• You process all cash application and remittance reconciliation for assigned countries accurately and within specific timescales. Then, you also prepare regularly the details of unallocated and unidentified receipts for key individuals further actions.

• You perform and responsible for credit analysis on customer according to company credit policy and procedures. Also, reviewing credit risk for new and existing customers by carry out credit assessment and make credit limit recommendation.

• You ensure customers pay within agreed payment terms, contacting sales team and customer on collection activities if vital as per company’s debt collection procedure.

• You ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines. You also engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project.

Who you are

• You possess Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• You have minimum 3-5 years working experiences in Accounts Receivable and Treasury or other accounting functions

• Experience in using SAP or other ERP accounting systems will be added advantage.

• You possess good proficiency in English and Japanese language is required with good communication skill as the role will be supporting our counterpart in Japan.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:

The Position

Bei Roche leisten über 100.000 Menschen weltweit Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt.

Der Konzernhauptsitz in Basel & Kaiseraugst ist einer der grössten Roche-Standorte weltweit. Begünstigt durch die geografische Lage im Herzen Europas, ist Basel eine der dynamischsten Wirtschaftsregionen in der Schweiz mit interessanten Kultur- und Freizeitangeboten. Es gibt viel zu entdecken und Sie sollten dabei sein!

Innerhalb des Bereiches Safety, Health, Environment (SHE) ist die Arbeitssicherheit für die Unterstützung und Beratung aller Funktionen am Standort zuständig. Sie setzt sich für sichere und gesundheitsschonende Arbeitsplätze ein und setzt SGU-Standards gemäss den gesetzlichen Vorgaben und den Roche-internen Anforderungen fest.

Die kontinuierliche Überprüfung und Verbesserung der Sicherheitsbelange an dem Standort BS / KAU wird durch die Fachgruppe Arbeitssicherheit gesteuert. Als Spezialist:in ASGS übernehmen Sie an unserem Standort Basel / Kaiseraugst (Areal Kaiseraugst) folgende Hauptaufgaben:

Ihre Möglichkeit

Durchführen von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen zur Prävention von Unfällen in einem sehr abwechslungsreichen Umfeld (Forschung, Entwicklung, Produktion, Werkstatt, Büro, Baustelle).

• Beraten, klären und beantworten der Fragen von Sicherheitsbeauftragten und Mitarbeitenden aus allen Bereichen von Roche Basel/Kaiseraugst betreffend Arbeitssicherheit

• Entwickeln, organisieren und durchführen von Schulungen zum Thema “Arbeitssicherheit und Sicherheitskultur”

• Erstellen, anpassen und aktualisieren von internen Weisungen und Prozessen aufgrund von Neuerungen und Gesetzen

• Mitarbeit an einer gemeinsamen Standortstrategie für Arbeitssicherheit und Sicherheitskultur und Austausch mit Group SHE bzw. Mitarbeit in entsprechenden globalen Projekten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren internen Fachstellen, wie z.B. Arbeitshygiene, Biosicherheit, Brandschutz etc.

• Linienfunktionen bei der Abklärung von Berufsunfällen und der Erarbeitung von Massnahmen unterstützen / beraten.

• Management der Berufsunfalldaten und daraus abgeleiteten Massnahmen in STARI (System for Tracking And Reporting Incidents)

• Weiterentwickeln des Incident Managements am Standort Basel/ Kaiseraugst

Wer Sie sind

Sie sind offen für neue Ideen und hinterfragen konventionelle Denkmuster. Sie schätzen es, in einer agilen, zielorientierten Umgebung zu arbeiten, die von gegenseitigem Respekt, Diskussion und Zusammenarbeit getragen wird. Dann ist Roche für Sie der Ausgangspunkt für ein spannendes und internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungschancen.

Als erfolgreiche Kandidat:in für unsere Stelle als Spezialist:in der Arbeitssicherheit zeigen Sie eine hohe Affinität zu sicherheitsrelevanten Themen. Mit Ihrem dienstleistungsorientierten Charakter organisieren Sie sich als Ansprechpartner:in für Ihre Kundengruppen im Areal Basel/Kaiseraugst.

Weiterhin verfügen Sie über folgende Kompetenzen:

• Berufsabschluss (im Bereich der Chemie, Produktion, Forschung & Entwicklung, Werkstatt, Baustelle) oder Hochschul- oder Fachhochschulabschluss in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Chemie, Verfahrenstechnik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik), Erfahrung in den Bereichen Chemie und Verfahrenstechnik bevorzugt

• Zusatzausbildung als Spezialist:in der Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz oder höher.

• Berufserfahrung in den Bere

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation.

Innerhalb der Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” gestalten wir im Bereich “Business Solutions” gemeinsam mit unseren Anspruchsgruppen massgeschneiderte Lösungen.

Als Qualification Engineer bist du im Bereich “Business Solutions” und dort im Kreis “Pharma Engineering Drug Substance” dafür verantwortlich, die Qualifizierungsleitung-/durchführung in Projekten und Betriebsengineering zu übernehmen und entsprechende Qualifizierungsdokumentation unter Berücksichtigung aller internen und behördlichen Vorgaben zu erstellen, unsere etablierten Prozesse zu pflegen und bei Audits und Inspektionen zu präsentieren. Du bringst dich mit deinem persönlichen Erfahrungsschatz ein, technische GMP Themen nachhaltig zu klären und darzustellen. Zu deinen alltäglichen Aufgaben gehören zudem das interdisziplinäre Agieren mit unseren internen Business Partnern, als auch die Führung und Anleitung von externen Mitarbeitern.

Die Möglichkeit:

• Leitung, Durchführung und Support von Qualifizierungsaktivitäten in Investitionsprojekten.

• In den Projekten: Kostenverantwortung, Ressourcenverantwortung, GMP Prozesse und Engineering, Change Control

• Unterstützung interner Business Partner als anerkannter Berater in sämtlichen technischen GMP Fragestellungen, z.B. Umsetzung von Qualifizierungs-Anforderungen

• Partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen

• Du bewertest Changes/Deviations, erstellst Qualifizierungsdokumente und sicherst den "Qualified Status".

• Planung, Durchführung und Verfolgung von Review Aktivitäten

• Erstellung, Prüfung und Freigabe von GMP-relevanten Dokumenten

• Aktive Vorstellung der durchgeführten Arbeiten bei Inspektionen durch die Zulassungsbehörde, sowie bei internen Audits oder Kunden Inspektionen

Wer du bist
Du besitzt eine fundierte Grundausbildung mit abgeschlossenem Studium (FH/TU) in einer technischen Fachrichtung sowie mind. 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in Planung, Inbetriebnahme oder Betrieb von Produktionsanlagen im pharmazeutischen / chemischen / biotechnologischen Umfeld. Du bist vertraut mit Betriebsengineering und mit der Abwicklung von Investitionsprojekten und der Beschaffung von Package Units.

• hohe Sozialkompetenz, Teamfähigkeit und sehr gute Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten auch im Umgang mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen.

• Offenheit und Fähigkeit sich in einer flachen, agilen Organisation aktiv einzubringen

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von technischen GMP-Anforderungen der Zulassungsbehörden (Swissmedic, FDA, EMA) in Investitionsprojekten und Betriebsengineering

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement sowie in der Anwendung relevanter Richtlinien

• Fokus auf das Liefern von Ergebnissen, welche einen wertvollen Beitrag für das Business haben

• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie Fähigkeit komplexe Sachverhalte aufzuschlüsseln und in angepas

• Creation, testing and approval of GMP-relevant documents

• high social competence, team skills and very good communication and coordination skills also in dealing with stakeholders at all levels.

• Quick conception and ability to encrypt complex facts and to adapt them
