jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Summary
The Customer Planning and Reporting Specialist supports the Roche Diagnostics service field team with various activities including creating and monitoring of cases and reports, producing the Service dashboard containing main department KPI’s, and ensuring interface between call center, customers and Service field team. You prepare Service offers and maintenance plans, perform reconciliation between CRM and billing systems, and support Customer Experience initiatives on deployment and monitoring the customer surveys.

Good command of the German language , both spoken and in writing is a must as this team supports the Roche Diagnostics Service team of Germany.

The work time is from 7:50 AM to 6 PM (German time, equivalent to 8:50 Am to 7 PM Romanian time) and is organised in shifts. The shifts are distributed within the team, so you will be working some days from early morning to afternoon, in the majority of days from later morning to the evening. Work time also includes some local Romanian public holidays, when there is no public holiday in Germany.

Your Responsibilities
Planning and Reporting (≈ 75%)

• Dispatching / creating cases for proactive activities of the field team

• Monitoring spare parts orders

• Starts the replacement process for third parties accessories like UPS, water station, etc

• Monitor and adjust the Service spare parts stocks (trunk and warehouse)

• Support for / checking / correcting FSE Reports

• Train new colleagues on CRM system

• Offers support for requested documentation for Finance & Commercial departments

• Add customer offers for spare parts and service activities

• Maintain the relationship with third parties suppliers for dispatching cases and installation projects as well as invoice monitoring

• Deployment and monitoring the event-based surveys

• Extract recurrent reports and propose actions to drive KPI’s in defined targets.

• Define process for escalations received via surveys and follow up on actions taken

Purchasing/Procurement Coordination (≈ 25%)

• Manage outsourcing activities end-to-end, using existing procurement processes and systems

• Onboard and off board service providers including organizing and coordinating training, hardware, accesses, and guidelines.

• Plan and create orders, including obtaining and summarizing forecasts, offers, and service descriptions with German business teams.

• Monitor, report and understand KPIs, quality, and budget of service providers, including tracking performance, compliance, costs, and deviations. Monthly presentation of KPIs to our Service partners.

• Verify and approve invoices, including checking plausibility, order, service, and corrections. In Case of questions or incorrectness direct communication with External Business Partners

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct)

Who You Are

• You have work experience in a similar Customer Support role

• You have advanced interpersonal skills, you are able to work independently and in a team

• You are comfortable with Google suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, Excel etc

• Previous experience with Salesforce and SAP are preferred

• You are well organized, are able to prioritize work, and have advanced analytical skill

• You are a self-starter, with a positive and client-oriented attitude, able to cope with change and to prioritize multiple tasks to ensure timely and high-quality accomplishment

• You master Romanian and

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GPC Training and Service Quality Lead
Department: Global Patient Care (GPC)
Area: Global Customer Support (GCS)
Reports to: GPC Support Lead
Location: Sant Cugat, Spain

About the Role
The Training and Service Quality Lead for Global Patient Care (GPC) plays a pivotal role in shaping service excellence across Roche Diagnostics' customer support network. Leading a dedicated team of Training and Service Quality Specialists, this role ensures the development and implementation of robust training programs and quality assurance frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality, patient-centered care.

Collaborating closely with GPC leadership, you will drive strategies that enhance skill development, align with global service standards, and foster a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards. Through effective leadership and data-driven insights, you will strengthen the quality and efficiency of interactions with patients and customers, advancing Roche's mission to deliver transformative healthcare solutions.

Your Responsibilities
Strategic Program Development:

• Identify training and service quality improvement opportunities by collaborating with regional Customer Support hubs, Business Implementation Specialists, and other GPC functions to ensure services evolve with business needs

• Design, enhance, or discontinue training and quality programs to uphold service excellence while ensuring compliance with auditable training standards

• Lead projects related to improvements and changes within Global Patient Care to meet evolving business needs

Customer Experience & Operational Excellence:

• Establish and continuously improve a global training and service quality framework to deliver consistent, high-standard customer and patient experiences

• Define and implement operational standards to ensure excellence in Training and Service Quality across all regions

• Implement a robust quality monitoring framework for external Customer Support operations

• Utilize customer satisfaction metrics, feedback, and operational data to identify trends and improvement areas

Training Program Design and Delivery:

• Lead the development and execution of training programs tailored to enhance competencies of frontline teams and specialists

• Ensure training initiatives align with global service delivery objectives and support achievement of organizational KPIs

• Work with external partners to define and implement global training standards

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

• Implement a robust quality assurance framework to monitor and improve interactions with patients and customers

• Ensure compliance with global standards for CRM systems, contact center operations, and regulatory requirements

• Report directly to GPC Leadership to guarantee consistent, high-standard experiences while supporting delivery of Roche's innovative products and digital solutions

KPI Management & Analysis:

• Track, analyze, and report key performance indicators related to training effectiveness and service quality

• Provide actionable insights to leadership teams and regional operations to drive continuous improvement

Team Leadership & Development:

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance

• Lead by example as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader; set clear goals, provide continuous guidance, motivation, coaching, and feedback

• Cultivate an inspiring, in

jobs.title: Compliance Assurance Lead West
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission
As a Global Patient Care Compliance Assurance Lead (East/West), you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times.

You will lead and manage a team of PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs.
Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps.

You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be supporting the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented.

Key Accountabilities

• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.

• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.

• Support the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.

• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.

• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.

• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.

• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.

• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.

• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, or as an Auditor, preferably in a medical regulated environment.

• Profound knowledge of audit-re

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Mission As a Global Patient Care Compliance Assurance Lead (East/West), you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times. You will lead and manage a team of PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs. Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps. You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be supporting the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented. Key Accountabilities
• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.
• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.
• Support the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.
• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.
• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.
• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.
• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.
• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.
• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.
• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.
• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.
• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management. Key skills and Experience
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.
• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.
• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.
• Minimum 2 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, or as an Auditor, preferably in a medical regulated environment.
• Profound knowledge of audit-re

jobs.title: GPC Service Performance Lead

titleByLocale.it: Lead delle prestazioni del servizio GPC

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission
As the GPC Service Performance Lead, you will contribute that Global Patient Care (GPC) business objectives are achieved efficiently by leading a high-performing team of GPC Service Performance Specialists and managing the performance of GPC’s workforce. In this critical management role, you will design and implement staffing and performance models to meet operational demands while aligning performance management with strategic business objectives across an omnichannel environment.

This role involves overseeing detailed volume forecasting, performance planning, and monitoring trends to maximize efficiency and effectiveness across GPC’s global operations.

You will lead a team responsible for designing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) across all supported channels, validating performance data, and identifying early patterns. You will ensure the GPC Leadership Team is proactively informed when course correction is required, managing the balance between accurately forecast volumes and the desired service levels to ensure a consistent customer experience.

Key Accountabilities

• Develop and implement service performance strategies to meet global operational and efficiency goals.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of GPC Service Performance Specialists, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

• Oversee strategic forecasting processes, ensuring accurate volume and capacity planning across all channels.

• Design, maintain, and validate global KPI frameworks to drive improvement and ensure data-driven decision-making.

• Analyze service performance data to identify trends, proactively providing the GPC Leadership Team with insights for operational course correction.

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders to provide channel forecasts and validate partner outcomes align with Roche performance standards (KPIs).

• Strategic Reporting Liaison: Liaise with global reporting teams to drive close collaboration, ensuring that validated, high-quality data is consistently available for GPC Leaders.

• Data Integrity & Governance: Lead the review and validation of reporting outputs to guarantee the highest level of accuracy and integrity across all operational performance metrics.

• Monitor productivity metrics and global performance to identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization.

• Proactive participation in or management of projects to develop infrastructure and administration processes within the performance area.

• Cultivate an inspiring and inclusive team environment that promotes diversity, cross-functional collaboration, and overcomes the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on selecting and retaining top talent while maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance evaluations, compensation reviews, and succession planning.

• Ensure team adherence to all P&C and compliance policies, fostering a culture of integrity and accountability.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting and a multi-channel contact center.

• 3-5 years specialization and in-depth knowledge of Service Performance, Forecasting, and Operational Analytics.

• Methodological competence and strong analytical skills with an affinity for complex data an

jobs.title: Deja tu Huella - Communications Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Communications & Intern

What do we offer?
To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to get on the job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid , we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexbility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche's senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

What is the main purpose of this internship?
Ideation, development, and implementation of the positioning plan and corporate narrative of Roche Farma España, both nationally and across ecosystems, as well as planning and development of Corporate Social Responsibility actions in collaboration with Internal Communication.

What are the main responsibilities of the intern?

• Assist in the design and execution of communication plans for specific therapeutic areas (e.g., Neuroscience, Ophthalmology).

• Draft, edit, and adapt high-quality content (press releases, internal news, talking points) related to clinical milestones and product launches.

• Create engaging assets for social media and digital platforms, ensuring that scientific data is communicated clearly and creatively.

• Support the management of press conferences, scientific forums, and patient advocacy initiatives.

• Analyze the impact of our therapeutic area communications and stay ahead of healthcare trends in the Spanish market.

What are we looking for in this position?

• Graduate or currently finishing a degree in one of the branches of Information Sciences (communications, journalism, etc).

• Training and/or experience in health communication is desirable

• High capacity for communication and public relations

• Skill and speed in creating and composing texts, ability to obtain and edit videos and images, and deep knowledge of the main social networks.

• We want proactive and curious candidates that are willing to learn and grow by challenging the status quo.

• We are looking for flexible talents that adapt to changes and are willing to collaborate with teams in a network organization.

• Advanced level of communication in English and Spanish.

• Desirable to have international experience as a student or working abroad.

• Passion for improving the lives of patients and motivation to give the best of yourself in an innovative and challenging environment.

• Commitment to dedicate yourself full time to the program from September 2026 to August 2027.

For international students, have a valid NIE or work permit in Spain.

And remember, being part of this program offers you:

• Postgraduate University CEU-Roche: "Deja tu Huella" program with great

jobs.title: Pathologist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies. You have an opportunity to work with leading edge technologies, such as Immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, immunofluorescence, multiplex assays, digital pathology and more. This position is based onsite in Tucson, AZ

The Opportunity:

• You will provide crucial pathology and slide reading support for assay development, FDA submissions, clinical trials and collaborating with internal and external development teams.

• You will be at the forefront of research and development activities by supporting the development of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes and special stains.

• You will advise on future pathology and medical needs.

• You will be a medical representative on project core teams and contribute to pathology related aspects of specific development projects.

• You will drive continuous improvement in work processes, making a direct impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

• You will utilize your expertise to advise on future pathology and medical needs, ensuring that we stay ahead of the curve in our industry

Who you are:

• You have an M.D. or D.O. with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology and an active state medical license.

• You are Residency-trained in anatomic pathology with expertise in surgical pathology and a proven ability to assess histopathology, IHC, ISH, and multiplex assays.

• You are experienced in evaluating complex immunohistochemistry assays such as PD-L1, HER2, and Ki-67.

• You are a precision medicine innovator and are Passionate about companion diagnostics (CDx) and the "right drug, right patient, right time" philosophy.

• You are a tech-Forward collaborator: Comfortable utilizing digital pathology scanners, automated algorithms, and advanced staining platforms (VENTANA Benchmark).

• You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, working seamlessly with scientists, engineers, and other experts to drive FDA submissions and clinical trial success.

​ Preferred Qualifications:

• Fellowship trained with 1 year of experience in clinical practice or industry.

• Prior experience in immunohistochemistry, cytology, molecular and/or genetics

​
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ is 174,000-323,100. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Relocation benefits are available for this posting

jobs.title: Line Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Line Manager at Regional Customer Support Center in Sant Cugat

About the Role

The Sant Cugat Regional Customer Support Center is seeking an experienced, collaborative leader with a strong customer focus to join our Regional Customer Support team.

As a Line Manager, you will lead and empower a team of highly skilled remote specialists providing support across Spain and Portugal customers and to the EMEA-LATAM region. Your mission is to move beyond case resolution to provide proactive support and data-driven insights to improve decision making to attract and retain our customers. You will be a catalyst for a culture of high performance and digital transformation.

In this role, you will be responsible for achieving outstanding team performance and maximizing customer satisfaction, driving remote resolution, overseeing employee and customer training and facilitating local and regional knowledge sharing and escalation support.
You will do this by analyzing results, challenging how support is currently provided, and rapidly incorporating innovations, new digital tools and AI-driven solutions to continuously improve our service. A core priority will be the development of your team members, mentoring them to excel in their current roles while preparing them for the future challenges.

With your experience in Diagnostics or Healthcare, you will put the customer -and ultimately the patient- at the heart of everything we do.

You'll report directly to the Head of the Sant Cugat Regional Customer Support Center and join a team passionate about creating an environment where empowered individuals can flourish and fulfil their potential.

What You'll Own:

Leadership & Talent Development
Coach and empower your team to achieve high performance. You'll manage the full talent lifecycle—from recruiting top talent to performance management and building the capabilities needed for a digital-first organization.

Operational Excellence & Innovation
Lead service delivery by ensuring all processes meet quality and excellence standards sustainably. Leverage AI to shift toward proactive, data-driven support that maximizes system performance and customer value.

Stakeholder Management & Resolution
Connect our remote support team with customers, field and regional/global teams. Serve as the primary escalation point for complex issues, driving them to resolution and delivering first-class service experiences.

Strategic Collaboration
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Service to ensure the technical service offering aligns with broader business goals.

Customer Focus
Maximize customer satisfaction by analyzing feedback and customer relationship management data and turning insights into meaningful actions. Implement innovative approaches to improve service outcomes.

Cross-Regional Leadership
Drive collaboration across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America by leading regional initiatives. As a change agent, you'll shape network structures and implement global strategies with a focus on local impact and service excellence.

Knowledge Management & Learning
Build a strong knowledge-sharing culture, ensuring rapid, well-organized knowledge transfer to both staff and customers to accelerate competency development.

Agile Leadership
Thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment by managing shifting priorities and multiple deadlines effectively. Navigate ambiguity with creativity, keeping your team focused and high-performing.

Who You Are:

You're a resilient leader who excels

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), located in Basel, Switzerland, focuses on the discovery and early development of innovative treatments for specific diseases that affect the lives of millions. In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

We are currently hiring four experienced PhD-level Discovery Scientists to join our Cardiovascular & Metabolic Disease Research team :
These opportunities include two in vivo-focused and two in vitro-focused positions , offering the chance to contribute to innovative preclinical research in metabolic diseases. We are looking for candidates with strong expertise in in vitro and/or in vivo pharmacology, a solid industry background, and a proven track record in executing preclinical projects in metabolic diseases and immunology.

The opportunity
In this role, you will design and execute experiments and lead projects to evaluate the efficacy and safety of novel therapeutic candidates.

• Lead research projects in the area of metabolic diseases (insulin resistance, obesity) from target ideation to entry into clinical development for both small- and large-molecule modalities.

• Drive the positioning and prioritization of novel metabolic and immunological targets, integrating disease biology, translational biomarkers, and therapeutic modality selection to align with Roche’s CVM pipeline.

• Collaboratively design, execute, and interpret complex preclinical in vitro and in vivo experimental studies for the validation and characterization of targets or therapeutic agents

• Direct, execute, and benchmark novel experiments, work together hand in hand with associates, and transfer standardized assays to associates

• Act as a resource in project teams, and demonstrate clear and professional verbal and written communication

Who You Are
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you receive the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Working in a multicultural environment motivates you. As a fast learner, you actively drive the quality of the requirements.

• You possess a PhD degree in Life Sciences ; are specialized in Metabolic diseases (insulin resistance, obesity, muscle-/adipose-physiology)

• You have >5 years of research and project leadership experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• You have demonstrated ability to effectively present scientific data and concepts to colleagues, teams, and management is essential

• Skillfully able to interact effectively with people, both internally and externally

• Vigorous “can do” mentality to succeed in a dynamic and highly collaborative research team

• Depending on your background, this role is embedded in an in vivo–focused or in vitro-focused research team

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employee

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) , realizziamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), situato a Basilea, Svizzera, si concentra sulla scoperta e lo sviluppo precoce di trattamenti innovativi per malattie specifiche che influiscono sulla vita di milioni di persone. Nella zona cardiovascolare e metabolismo, stiamo sviluppando terapie all'avanguardia per il trattamento delle malattie metaboliche. Attualmente stiamo assumendo quattro esperti scienziati di ricerca di livello PhD per unirsi al nostro team di ricerca di malattie cardiovascolari e metaboliche: Queste opportunità includono due posizioni in vivo focalizzate e due in vitro-focused , offrendo la possibilità di contribuire a una ricerca preclinica innovativa nelle malattie metaboliche. Siamo alla ricerca di candidati con una forte esperienza nella farmacologia in vitro e/o in vivo, un solido background del settore, e una comprovata esperienza nell'esecuzione di progetti preclinici in malattie metaboliche e immunologia. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, progettare ed eseguire esperimenti e condurre progetti per valutare l'efficacia e la sicurezza dei nuovi candidati terapeutici.
• Progetti di ricerca di piombo nell'area delle malattie metaboliche (resistenza dell'insulina, obesità) dall'ideazione di destinazione all'ingresso nello sviluppo clinico per entrambe le modalità di piccole e grandi molecole.
• Guidare il posizionamento e la priorità di nuovi obiettivi metabolici e immunologici, integrando la biologia delle malattie, biomarcatori traduttivi e la selezione di modalità terapeutiche per allineare con la pipeline di Roche CVM.
• Progettazione, esecuzione e interpretazione di studi sperimentali complessi preclinici in vitro e in vivo per la validazione e caratterizzazione di obiettivi o agenti terapeutici
• Esperimenti di romanzi diretti, esecutivi e benchmark, lavorare insieme a mano in mano con gli associati e trasferire saggi standardizzati agli associati
• Agire come risorsa nei team di progetto e dimostrare una comunicazione verbale e scritta chiara e professionale Chi sei Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il tuo sviluppo. Stai cercando una società in cui ricevi l'opportunità di perseguire i tuoi interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie. Lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale vi motiva. Come un apprendimento veloce, si guida attivamente la qualità dei requisiti.
• Possiedi un dottorato in Scienze della Vita; sono specializzati in malattie metaboliche (resistenza dell'insulina, obesità, muscolo-/adipose-fisiologia)
• Hai > 5 anni di esperienza nella ricerca e nella leadership del progetto nell'industria farmaceutica.
• Hai dimostrato la capacità di presentare efficacemente dati e concetti scientifici a colleghi, team e gestione è essenziale
• Abilmente in grado di interagire efficacemente con le persone, sia internamente che esternamente
• La mentalità vigorosa “può fare” per avere successo in un team di ricerca dinamico e altamente collaborativo
• A seconda del tuo background, questo ruolo è incorporato in un team di ricerca in vivo o focalizzato in vitro Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED) de Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. pRED Cardiopathie & Métabolisme, Immunologie (CMI), située à Bâle, Suisse, se concentre sur la découverte et le développement précoce de traitements innovants pour des maladies spécifiques qui affectent la vie de millions de personnes. Dans le domaine cardiovasculaire et métabolique, nous développons des thérapies de pointe pour traiter les maladies métaboliques. Nous embauchons actuellement quatre chercheurs chevronnés au niveau du doctorat pour rejoindre notre équipe de recherche sur les maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques : Ces possibilités comprennent deux positions in vivo et deux positions in vitro, offrant la possibilité de contribuer à la recherche préclinique innovante sur les maladies métaboliques. Nous recherchons des candidats possédant une solide expertise en pharmacologie in vitro et/ou in vivo, une solide expérience de l'industrie et une expérience éprouvée dans l'exécution de projets précliniques en maladies métaboliques et en immunologie. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous concevez et exécutez des expériences et dirigez des projets pour évaluer l'efficacité et l'innocuité des nouveaux candidats thérapeutiques.
• Diriger les projets de recherche dans le domaine des maladies métaboliques (résistance à l'insuline, obésité) depuis l'idée cible jusqu'à l'entrée dans le développement clinique pour les modalités de petites et grandes molécules.
• Favoriser le positionnement et la hiérarchisation de nouvelles cibles métaboliques et immunologiques, intégrant la biologie des maladies, les biomarqueurs translationnels et la sélection des modalités thérapeutiques pour s'aligner sur le pipeline CVM de Roches.
• Concevoir, exécuter et interpréter en collaboration des études expérimentales précliniques in vitro et in vivo complexes pour la validation et la caractérisation de cibles ou d'agents thérapeutiques
• Expérimenter directement, exécuter et comparer de nouvelles expériences, travailler main dans la main avec les associés, et transférer des essais normalisés aux associés
• Agir en tant que ressource dans les équipes de projet et faire preuve de communication verbale et écrite claire et professionnelle Qui vous êtes Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut influencer votre propre développement. Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous aurez l'occasion de poursuivre vos intérêts à travers les fonctions et les géographies. Travailler dans un environnement multiculturel vous motive. En tant qu'apprenant rapide, vous conduisez activement la qualité des exigences.
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en sciences de la vie ; vous êtes spécialisé dans les maladies métaboliques (résistance à l'insuline, obésité, physiologie musculaire/adiposique)
• Vous avez plus de 5 ans d'expérience en recherche et en leadership de projet dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.
• Vous avez démontré la capacité de présenter efficacement les données et les concepts scientifiques aux collègues, aux équipes et à la gestion est essentielle
• Capacité à interagir efficacement avec les personnes, à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur
• Vigorous peut faire la mentalité de réussir dans une équipe de recherche dynamique et hautement collaborative
• Selon vos antécédents, ce rôle est intégré dans une équipe de recherche in vivo ou in vitro. Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. jobs.title: Director/Associate Director of Safety, Facilities, and Security

titleByLocale.it: Direttore/Associate Direttore of Safety, Facilities, and Security

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a strategic safety and facilities leader ready to make an impact in a fast-paced biotech environment? We're seeking an experienced Director/Associate Director to join our SBX Technology team as the cornerstone of our site's operational resilience and compliance excellence. In this high-visibility role, you'll lead proactive risk management, oversee critical infrastructure, and drive continuous improvement across safety, facilities, and security—all while maintaining inspection readiness around the clock. If you have 8+ years in large-scale industrial environments, proven management expertise, and the drive to anticipate facility demands, we'd like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

• Manages the SHE, Security, and Facilities maintenance to comply with applicable regulatory and company policies, utilizing industry best practices, and identifying and managing risk.

• Works with building management to maintain critical power systems and emergency generators. Serves as the primary internal lead for building power restoration and temporary generators, ensuring building management and external vendors to maintain 100% operational readiness during extended building outage.

• Works cross-functionally to develop and support facilities projects and implementing new technology processes including remodels, new equipment, and reagents, etc . Manages all moves, construction, upgrades, and maintenance for the site.

• Leads hazard identification - determining and implementing necessary risk assessment programs/processes – as well as related facilities changes.

• Responds to and investigates all SHE, Security and Facility issues. Supports post-incident analysis to determine mitigation strategies to reduce future incident frequency and impact.

• Leads, manages, and continuously improves all relevant safety processes in a large generator environment, including hazardous waste management, dangerous goods shipments, chemical safety assessments, spill safety, exposure monitoring, biosafety programs, etc. Identifies and manages risk and ensures compliance.

• Ensures the site complies with applicable regulatory and company policies and is always “inspection ready”. May lead government and company interactions related to SHE, Security, and Facilities requirements including reporting, notification, facilitating inspections, and ensuring closure of corrective actions.

• Establishes monitoring solutions for critical facilities and lab equipment to enable after-hours monitoring and meaningful alerts.

• Prepares clear response plan documents for safety and facilities scenarios that can be executed by on-site personnel outside of standard business hours. Provides transparent documentation of site fail point areas.

Who you are
Education

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in chemistry, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

Experience

• 8 years of progressive experience within a large scale industry such as technical manufacturing, diagnostics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas industry, or other relevant industries.

• 5+ years of management experience.

Core Competencies

• Emergency Response & On-Call Availability: Demonstrated capability to respond effectively to critical safety, facilities, or security incidents (chemical spills, power outages, facility emergencies) with flexibility for after-hours and weekend availability as needed; track record of minimizing business disruption during safety events

• Self-Direction & Organization: Highly sel

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a Subject Matter Expert in chemistry and biology . Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables.

The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, developing and executing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

• You will tackle efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems. You will successfully navigate the transition of assays from solution-phase to solid-phase environments and quantify reactions on surfaces.

• You will perform the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.

• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance and troubleshoot issues. You will apply your functional grasp of chemistry to navigate challenges related to chemical compatibility, surface tension, surface passivation, ionic strength, shear forces, and the influence of pH on surface interactions.

• You will conduct early-stage, deep-dive troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will seamlessly connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.

• You will serve as a subject matter expert in molecular biology, sample and library preparation, and sequencing chemistry. You will be a go-to person for explaining complex biological and chemical concepts to a team of talented engineers.

• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide critical, data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware, ensuring chemistry, molecular biology, and engineering are harmonized through iterative feedback cycles.

A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company.

This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are (Required):

• You have a PhD in Chemist

titleByLocale.it: Specialista per gli affari regolamentari - Gestione delle emissioni
titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des affaires réglementaires - Gestion des présentations

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Opportunity
Operational Excellence

• Ability to execute tasks like document formatting /quality checks /tracking/ publishing/ compiling with supervision while learning project planning and management basics.

• Demonstrates potential to build trustful relationships with colleagues and stakeholders to support submission processes through communication and basic coordination.

• Works effectively within a team by participating in collaborative efforts, contributing ideas, and asking for help as needed to achieve common goals.

• Strong commitment to learning and adapting with guidance, including acquiring familiarity with new systems, tools, and workflows to foster personal and professional growth.

Who You Are
eCTD Expertise

• Foundational understanding of eCTD submission format and regulatory requirements, with a focus on learning NMPA-specific guidelines and terminology in parallel to those of ICH, FDA, EMA, etc.

• Familiarity with documentation assembly and formatting, working under supervision to gain practical experience in eCTD compilation and validation.

• Essential knowledge to eCTD publishing processes, submission software, document management systems, and MS Office and Adobe Acrobat for document preparation; exposure to systems like RIM/Veeva Vault as part of training.

• A proactive, motivated learner eager to understand regulatory changes and contribute to process improvement under guidance.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La tua opportunità Eccellenza operativa
• Capacità di eseguire attività come la formattazione dei documenti / controlli di qualità /tracking / pubblicazione / compilazione con supervisione durante l'apprendimento della pianificazione del progetto e basi di gestione.
• Dimostra il potenziale di costruire relazioni fiduciose con colleghi e stakeholder per sostenere i processi di presentazione attraverso la comunicazione e il coordinamento di base.
• Funziona efficacemente all'interno di un team partecipando a sforzi collaborativi, contribuendo idee e chiedendo aiuto, se necessario, per raggiungere obiettivi comuni.
• Forte impegno nell'apprendimento e nell'adattamento con la guida, compreso l'acquisizione di familiarità con nuovi sistemi, strumenti e flussi di lavoro per favorire la crescita personale e professionale. Chi sei ECTD Expertise
• Comprensione fondamentale del formato di presentazione eCTD e dei requisiti normativi, con un focus sull'apprendimento delle linee guida e della terminologia specifiche NMPA in parallelo a quelle di ICH, FDA, EMA, ecc.
• Familiarità con l'assemblaggio e la formattazione della documentazione, lavorando sotto supervisione per acquisire esperienza pratica nella compilazione e nella validazione eCTD.
• Conoscenza essenziale ai processi di pubblicazione eCTD, software di presentazione, sistemi di gestione dei documenti e MS Office e Adobe Acrobat per la preparazione dei documenti; esposizione a sistemi come RIM/Veeva Vault come parte della formazione.
• Un apprendista proattivo e motivato desideroso di comprendere i cambiamenti normativi e contribuire al miglioramento del processo sotto la guida. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Your Opportunity Operational Excellence
• Ability to execute tasks like document formatting /quality checks /tracking/ publishing/ compiling with supervision while learning project planning and management basics.
• Demonstrates potential to build trustful relationships with colleagues and stakeholders to support submission processes through communication and basic coordination.
• Works effectively within a team by participating in collaborative efforts, contributing ideas, and asking for help as needed to achieve common goals.
• Strong commitment to learning and adapting with guidance, including acquiring familiarity with new systems, tools, and workflows to foster personal and professional growth. Who You Are eCTD Expertise
• Foundational understanding of eCTD submission format and regulatory requirements, with a focus on learning NMPA-specific guidelines and terminology in parallel to those of ICH, FDA, EMA, etc.
• Familiarity with documentation assembly and formatting, working under supervision to gain practical experience in eCTD compilation and validation.
• Essential knowledge to eCTD publishing processes, submission software, document management systems, and MS Office and Adobe Acrobat for document preparation; exposure to systems like RIM/Veeva Vault as part of training.
• A proactive, motivated learner eager to understand regulatory changes and contribute to process improvement under guidance. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Ihre Chance Operative Exzellenz
• Fähigkeit, Aufgaben wie Dokumentformatierung / Qualitätskontrollen / Tracking / Publishing / Kompilieren mit Aufsicht, während Lernen Projektplanung und Management Grundlagen.
• Demonstriert Potenzial, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen mit Kollegen und Stakeholdern aufzubauen, um Einreichungsprozesse durch Kommunikation und grundlegende Koordination zu unterstützen.
• Arbeitet effektiv innerhalb eines Teams, indem sie an kollaborativen Anstrengungen teilnimmt, Ideen beiträgt und nach Bedarf Hilfe für gemeinsame Ziele fordert.
• Starkes Engagement für das Lernen und die Anpassung an die Beratung, einschließlich des Wissens mit neuen Systemen, Werkzeugen und Workflows zur Förderung des persönlichen und beruflichen Wachstums. Wer bist du? eCTD Expertise
• Grundlegendes Verständnis von eCTD-Einreichungsformat und regulatorischen Anforderungen, mit dem Fokus auf das Lernen NMPA-spezifischer Richtlinien und Terminologie parallel zu denen von ICH, FDA, EMA usw.
• Vertrautheit mit Dokumentationsmontage und Formatierung, die unter Aufsicht arbeitet, um praktische Erfahrungen in der ECTD-Compilation und Validierung zu sammeln.
• Grundlegende Kenntnisse zu eCTD-Publishing-Prozessen, Einreichungssoftware, Dokumentenverwaltungssystemen und MS Office und Adobe Acrobat zur Dokumentenvorbereitung; Exposition gegenüber Systemen wie RIM/Veeva Vault im Rahmen der Schulung.
• Ein proaktiver, motivierter Lerner bemüht sich, regulatorische Veränderungen zu verstehen und zur Prozessverbesserung unter Anleitung beizutragen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Votre opportunité Excellence opérationnelle
• Capacité d'exécuter des tâches telles que le formatage des documents / contrôles de qualité / suivi / publication / compilation avec supervision tout en apprenant les bases de la planification et de la gestion des projets.
• Démontre la possibilité d'établir des relations de confiance avec les collègues et les parties prenantes pour appuyer les processus de soumission par la communication et la coordination de base.
• Travailler efficacement au sein d'une équipe en participant aux efforts de collaboration, en apportant des idées et en demandant l'aide nécessaire pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
• Un engagement ferme en faveur de l'apprentissage et de l'adaptation avec l'orientation, y compris l'acquisition de la connaissance des nouveaux systèmes, outils et flux de travail pour favoriser la croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Qui vous êtes Expertise eCTD
• Compréhension fondamentale du format de présentation eCTD et des exigences réglementaires, l'accent étant mis sur l'apprentissage des lignes directrices et de la terminologie propres à la NMPA, parallèlement à celles de l'ICH, de la FDA, de l'EMA, etc.
• Connaissance du montage et du formatage de la documentation, travail sous supervision pour acquérir une expérience pratique dans la compilation et la validation eCTD.
• Connaissances essentielles pour les processus de publication eCTD, les logiciels de soumission, les systèmes de gestion de documents, et MS Office et Adobe Acrobat pour la préparation de documents; exposition à des systèmes comme RIM/Veeva Vault dans le cadre de la formation.
• Un apprenant proactif et motivé désireux de comprendre les changements réglementaires et de contribuer à l'amélioration des processus sous la direction. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Team Lead (Fixed Asset)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Record to Report Department , often abbreviated as R2R department provides financial services for more than 130 affiliates in the EMEA region . Our main areas covered are: General Ledger Accounting, Management Accounting, Treasury and Accounts Receivable. The department is constantly expanding since our main goal is to perform end-to-end accounting activities in the near future.

As a Finance & Accounting Team Lead, focusing on Fixed Asset accounting you will coordinate complete, stringent, and timely finance and accounting tasks within the department's scope while proactively seeking opportunities to allow more effective cooperation between teams regardless of country or functional assignments.

In this role, you will focus on:

• Leading people management activities, including recruitment, goal setting, and performance evaluations to support both operational excellence and professional growth.

• Ensuring service quality and compliance by overseeing daily Capital and Lease Accounting operations in accordance with SOPs, ICFRs, and agreed service levels.

• Proactively and constructively managing change initiatives , continuous improvement & automation projects and best practice implementations to support business and operational transformation across the EMEA region.

• Fostering strong relationships with stakeholders in the respective business area to ensure a free flow of communication and alignment on regional requirements.

• Providing and organizing assistance to other teams or team members facing workload challenges or requiring specialized expertise.

• Coaching and mentoring team members by identifying knowledge gaps and ensuring the delivery of process training according to official learning paths.

• Maintaining high integrity and safety standards by ensuring full compliance with corporate guidelines, SHE requirements, and applicable laws.

Who you are:
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University degree , preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 6+ years of working experience in related field, around 4 years experience in people management , preferably leading team with a large span of control

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools

• Strong communication skills , expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner

• Ability to work comfortably in a dynamic, changing and growing environment

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average. We create the opportunity f

jobs.title: Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del prodotto HI Enterprise Cloud
titleByLocale.en: Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable du produit HI Enterprise Cloud

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.

Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Your main responsabilities:

• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.

• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.

• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.

• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.

• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.

• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.

• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicine

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) è responsabile per l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino al lancio, scaling e all'eventuale ritiro di un prodotto complesso. Questo ruolo è fondamentale per trasformare le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche tangibili e ad alto valore. Sarete responsabili di definire la visione del prodotto, la strategia e la roadmap, assicurando che si allinea con gli obiettivi di overarching della nostra organizzazione e, infine, accelera la consegna di diagnostica e medicine che cambiano la vita ai pazienti. Questo ruolo richiede una combinazione distintiva di inquisitività scientifica, competenza tecnica e business insight per navigare con successo nel paesaggio. Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di definire la direzione per i team di ingegneria e di servizio per costruire prodotti desiderabili, fattibili, fattibili e sostenibili che soddisfino le esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri utenti interni, pur mantenendo una stretta conformità con i relativi standard del settore. Le sue principali responsabilità:
• Guidare la Visione del Prodotto: Definire ed eseguire la strategia e la roadmap completa per il portafoglio Enterprise Cloud per accelerare la consegna della diagnostica in continuo cambiamento.
• Gestire il ciclo di vita completo: Prendere la responsabilità per l'intero viaggio del prodotto, dall'ideazione iniziale e dalla pianificazione strategica fino alla scalabilità e al pensionamento di soluzioni cloud complesse.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: la strategia "Cloud-First" di Orchestrate Roche ottimizza la velocità e la cadenza di rilascio per soddisfare le esigenze in evoluzione dei prodotti Enterprise e R&D.
• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigare un ampio ecosistema di team interni, fornitori esterni di SaaS e partner accademici per garantire l'integrazione della piattaforma senza soluzione di continuità e la gestione delle API.
• Assicurare Compliance ed Eccellenza: L'innovazione di equilibrio con una rigorosa adesione agli standard del settore, tra cui GxP, integrando al contempo le capacità AI per mantenere un vantaggio competitivo. Chi sei:
• Leader del prodotto esperto: porti 10+ anni nella gestione del prodotto o nell'analisi aziendale con una comprovata storia di lancio e gestione di prodotti tecnologici complessi.
• Esperto del settore: hai 2 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata.
• Proven People Manager: Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza leader, mentoring e sviluppo di team tecnici altamente performanti e multidisciplinari.
• Tecnicamente Proficiente: Lei possiede una laurea universitaria e ha una profonda conoscenza dell'architettura moderna del software, di Cloud Hyperscalers e di Container come Servizio (CaaS).
• Normativa e Data Savvy: Lei è ben diversificato nei principi di dati GxP, FAIR e nelle normative sulla privacy dei dati come GDPR per garantire fondazioni sicure e conformi. Pronto a portare le vostre qualità uniche a Roche e fare un impatto? Applicare ora e unirsi a noi nella nostra missione per plasmare il futuro della salute.
