At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape. Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards. Your main responsabilities:
• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.
• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.
• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.
• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.
• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage. Who you are:
• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.
• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.
• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.
• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Chef de produit expérimenté: Vous apportez 10 ans et plus en gestion de produits ou en analyse commerciale avec une histoire éprouvée de lancement et de gestion de produits technologiques complexes.
• Expert de l'industrie: Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans le secteur pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie ou des technologies de santé réglementées.
• Proven People Manager: Vous possédez plus de 2 ans d'expérience en leadership, en mentorat et en développement d'équipes techniques multidisciplinaires à haut rendement.
• Techniquement compétent: Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire et avez une connaissance approfondie de l'architecture logicielle moderne, Cloud Hyperscalers et Container as a Service (CaaS).
• Regulatory and Data Savvy: Vous êtes bien orienté dans GxP, principes de données FAIR, et les règles de confidentialité des données telles que le RGPD pour assurer des fondations sûres et conformes. Prêt à apporter vos qualités uniques à Roche et faire un impact? Postulez maintenant et rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de façonner l'avenir des soins de santé. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec notre médicament

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern- Product Owner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the role

Are you a natural communicator with an analytical mind? Do you want to understand how a complex medical product is defined before a single line of code is written? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Product Owner / Requirement Engineer Intern .
In this role, you will support our Product Owners in the vital task of defining "what" we build. You will act as a bridge between high-level business needs and the technical implementation teams, ensuring that every feature is clearly documented and understood. This is a unique opportunity to gain a holistic view of the healthcare business and the lifecycle of medical software.

Main responsibilities

• Requirement Definition: Support the creation and maintenance of Feature Files and Product Requirements that guide our software implementation partners.

• Product Risk Management: Identify product risks in defined features and define appropriate risk control measures to mitigate risks that could cause patient harm.

• Operational Agility: Assist Product Owners in the day-to-day operational tasks, ensuring that requirements are ready for development "sprints" and resolving functional doubts.

• Tool Management: Work directly with our official requirement management tool, Retina (Codebeamer) , to keep documentation organized and updated.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Help gather needs and feedback from different areas, including Business Leaders (IPM), Global Service (GCS), and other cross-functional departments.

• Quality Assurance: Ensure that the defined requirements meet the necessary quality attributes for a regulated medical environment.

• Process optimization: Actively participate in and contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements processes within a SAFe environment.

How would your day-to-day look like?

Your day will involve a lot of interaction within the internal team and stakeholders from other areas and projects. You will participate in meetings with senior Product Owners to understand the strategic roadmap, and then translate those ideas into detailed documentation. You will spend time in Retina , refining feature descriptions, product risks, product requirements and ensuring the "definition of ready" is met for the developers.
Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to balance the needs of different stakeholders while building a strong network across various business areas. It’s a role that combines deep "desk work" (analysis and writing) with constant collaboration and networking.

Who are you?

• Education: Recent graduate in Informatics, Telecommunications, or Biomedical Engineering . We value your understanding of the product domain and logic over coding skills.

• Analytical Skills: You have a knack for breaking down complex problems into clear, logical requirements.

• Communication: You are comfortable talking to people from different backgrounds (technical and non-technical) and have excellent writing skills.

• Organization: You are methodical and detail-oriented, especially when managing documentation and deadlines.

• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B2/C1 level) is essential, as you will interact with international stakeholders.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ABOUT THE ROLE

Are you fascinated by how software is deployed, scaled, and maintained in high-stakes environments? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Trainee to join our DevOps and Infrastructure operations.
In this role, you will be the backbone of our development process. You won't just be writing code; you will be ensuring that our software reaches its destination (testing and production environments) smoothly and reliably. This is a unique opportunity to enter the DevOps world, a discipline built on experience and collaboration rather than traditional textbooks.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

• Environment Maintenance: Support the daily operations of our testing environments, ensuring they are ready for the testing team’s deployments.

• Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with our implementation partners to maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, ensuring faster and safer software delivery.

• Infrastructure as Code: Assist in managing containerized environments using Docker, kubernetes and cloud resources within Azure and AWS .

• Daily Support: Provide support to the development squads in their day-to-day DevOps needs, troubleshooting deployment issues and monitoring system health.

• Continuous Improvement: Participate in initiatives to automate manual tasks and modernize our current infrastructure.

HOW WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE?

Your day will start with a sync meeting to identify any bottlenecks in our deployment pipelines or environments. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to manage the infrastructure and how to orchestrate services with Kubernetes .
You will work closely with both the testing team (to provide them with stable environments) and our external implementation partners (to learn and improve how we build software). It is a hands-on journey where you will see the immediate impact of your work on the speed and quality of the entire department.

WHO ARE YOU?

• Education: Recent graduate in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical field.

• DevOps Passion: You are naturally curious about cloud technologies, automation, and the "behind the scenes" of software development.

• Tech Interest: While you don't need to be an expert, you have a basic understanding or a strong desire to master Cloud services and Kubernetes .

• Mindset: You are a problem-solver who enjoys technical challenges and thrives in collaborative environments.

• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B1/B2 or higher).

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• A Real DevOps School: DevOps is learned by doing. We offer you the environment, the tools, and the team to transform your curiosity into a professional career.

• Mentorship: You will have a dedicated mentor to guide your learning path from day one.

• High-Tech Stack: Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Azure, Docker, CI/CD).

• Flexibility: A flexible working model in our Sant Cugat office with remote work options.

• Program: This position is part of our START TECH program for young digital talent.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role:

We are looking for a creative, innovative and open-minded intern to join the Global Regulatory Affairs team.
As an Intern in Regulatory Affairs, you have the opportunity to support regulatory and product care activities, and get insights into the IVD/MD industry and the applicable regulations and standards for IVD/MD products.
In Global Regulatory Affairs we work on specific challenges as a team within all areas of the diagnostic business around the globe, to grow together to bring the best products to patients while choosing a work environment that fits our life.
As AI plays an increasing role in our daily lives we are also looking for colleagues who are keen in taking part in high-impact projects that leverage machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) to optimize how we navigate the complex landscape of global health regulations.
In this intern role, you can clearly demonstrate your creativity and leave a footprint in our products’ lifecycle. You will directly contribute to Roche Diagnostics' vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare & changing lives.

Your key responsibilities:

After your onboarding program, you will be assigned to tasks or projects. You’ll be mostly spending your time in:

• Assisting in the worldwide registrations and activities for various IVD/MD products, at various stages of their development and lifecycle

• Supporting the preparation and maintenance of global documentation for our IVD/MD products

• Collaborating with other regulatory affairs teams, including local affiliates, for registrational activities

• Coordinating with global interdisciplinary project teams to provide regulatory input to development, submission planning, and documentation needed

• Supporting the global regulatory affairs team members in their non-registrational activities

• Assisting in the design, development, and testing of AI-powered tools and dashboards for regulatory tracking, document analysis, and automated reporting.

• Participating in the training and fine-tuning of ML and NLP models tailored for regulatory use cases, ensuring high accuracy and compliance with internal standards.

• Keep abreast of emerging AI technologies and changing regulatory guidelines regarding AI in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries.

Who you are:

• You have recently graduated (within the last 3 years) in the field of Biology, Life Sciences, Engineering, or Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics

• You possess facilitation and communications skills and the ability to deal with adversity in a multicultural and international environment

• You are a fast learner, have a proactive attitude to drive solutions, and have a high level of team orientation

• You are curious and attentive to detail with a strong problem-solving capability

• You are fluent in English (written and spoken)

• You have a strong proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).

• You have Experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face, spaCy).

• You have Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering.

• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, or Matplotlib/Seaborn).

What do we offer?

• Become a Regulatory Affairs professional for IVDs/MDs.

• Develop a Regulatory Mindset and understand the most important regulations and industry standards.

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagement of Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PD of Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality vailable information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the af

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role:

Your mission is to support the evolution of our operational landscape. You will focus on converting traditional routine processes into agile, AI-enhanced workflows. Additionally, you will provide essential support to our Document Management team, ensuring key project documents are managed and processed accurately within our Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), specifically DiaDoc and SAP.

Main responsibilities:

• Process Analysis: Critically evaluate established routine processes to identify specific opportunities for AI-driven optimization and efficiency gains.

• Implementation & Strategy: Support the deployment and maintenance of intelligent solutions while assisting with internal communication strategies to ensure smooth adoption.

• Operational Support: Assist in the daily management of project documentation, ensuring high standards of data integrity and accessibility.

How would your day to day look like?

• Immersive Learning: You will start by integrating into our daily routines, gaining a deep understanding of our workflows and the interdependencies that drive our business.

• Collaborative Problem-Solving : You will work closely with cross-functional team members to understand their pain points and translate their ideas into tangible efficiency gains.

• Technical Innovation: You will spend significant time developing and supporting intelligent, AI-based solutions tailored to our specific organizational needs.

• Hands-on Document Management : You will gain practical experience in an international regulatory environment by processing selected project documents within our professional EDMS.

Who are you?

• Education: You are a recent Bachelor’s or Master’s graduate looking to launch your career in a high-impact environment.

• Technical Agility: You possess a sophisticated understanding of the current AI landscape and have the technical aptitude to integrate smart solutions into a professional corporate infrastructure.

• Solution-Oriented Mindset: You are a motivated problem-solver who is eager to take digital infrastructure to the next level.

• Global Perspective: You are excited to collaborate with international teams and thrive in a fast-paced, world-class diagnostic organization.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

The Diagnostics Insights Solution Management Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising solutions with multiple components (digital, physical, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs.

As Business Solution Management Associate , you will support us in addressing the challenges in commercializing these integrated solutions. One of our key initiatives in commercializing integrated solutions with country organizations is the multi-year Stronger Solution Selling (S3) program . You will support the S3 core team in delivering strategic workshops with country organizations and optimizing essential solution-selling assets to help cross-functional affiliate teams better navigate Roche Diagnostic’s physical, digital, and service portfolios. This role offers a blend of project management and process refinement, providing a unique platform to shape how the organization delivers tailored value to its customers worldwide.

Main responsibilities

As a Business Solution Management Associate, you will help us in bridging the gap between strategic methodology and operational execution. Over the course of your one-year assignment, your core responsibilities will include:

• Project Management & Delivery : Take ownership of assigned tasks with a focus on structuring complexity and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.

• Affiliate Support & Collaboration : Directly assist the S3 Core Team in driving activities with country organizations and country clusters.

• Asset & Tool Optimization : Refine existing and develop new solution-selling tools to help teams better navigate Roche’s physical and digital offerings.

• Change Management : Support ongoing activities aimed at sustaining the organizational shift toward effective solution selling.

• Process Improvement : Potentially step up into a process improvement project to refine workflows, systems, or insights that improve the effectiveness of solution selling.

How would your day to day look like?

As Business Solution Management Associate , you'll work closely with team members in the S3 core team, as well as subregional and country teams. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders for driving improvements in solution commercialization.

Your day-to-day will be dynamic and diverse, and could begin by coordinating with the S3 Core Team to support global affiliates and manage project deliverables. You might spend the morning organizing workshops or refining assets that help teams navigate Roche's complex solution portfolio. This involves a high degree of ownership, as you structure complex information into clear, high-quality tools for country organizations.

In the afternoon, you shift focus toward process optimization and change management. jobs.title: Service Design Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will join the Customer Experience, Research & Strategy team at Roche Diagnostics in Sant Cugat. This team sits at the heart of how Roche understands and designs for the people who rely on diagnostic solutions — from lab professionals to clinicians and patients. The team combines rigorous research with strategic design to shape services and experiences across digital and physical touchpoints.

About the role

As a Service Design intern you will contribute to real research and design projects from day one. Working alongside senior designers and researchers, you will help map the end-to-end experiences of Roche's customers, conduct user research, and explore how conversational interfaces — chatbots, voice assistants, and AI-powered agents — can better serve the needs of healthcare professionals.
Over the course of a full year you will move through the entire design cycle — from discovery and research through to prototyping and delivery — building a rich, evidence-based portfolio in one of the most complex and meaningful design contexts there is.

What you'll do

Research support

• Assist in planning and facilitating user interviews, contextual enquiries, and usability sessions with healthcare professionals

• Help synthesise qualitative findings through affinity mapping and insight frameworks

• Contribute to personas, journey maps, and mental model documentation

• Support the team in maintaining research repositories and knowledge assets

Service design

• Contribute to service blueprints and experience maps that reveal systemic friction

• Participate in co-design workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders

• Help build and iterate on prototypes for concept testing

• Document design decisions and produce artefacts that communicate intent clearly

Conversational design

• Support the design of dialogue flows and conversation scripts for chat and voice interfaces

• Help define tone of voice guidelines for automated interactions in a healthcare context

• Assist in evaluating conversational prototypes with real users and documenting findings

• Research best practices in NLP, intent design, and accessible conversational UX

Collaboration

• Work in cross-functional squads alongside product managers, engineers, and clinical experts

• Present work-in-progress in team reviews and design critiques

• Contribute to team rituals: stand-ups, retrospectives, and design community sessions

• Bring fresh perspective and curiosity to a team that values diverse viewpoints

Who we're looking for

• Currently enrolled in a degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, HCI, UX, or a related field

• Genuine interest in human-centred research — you are curious about people and why they behave as they do

• Exposure to conversational design, dialogue writing, or NLP through coursework or personal projects

• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to ask good questions in complex environments

• Clear communication in English (working language of the team); Spanish is a plus

• A portfolio or project work demonstrating research and/or design thinking

Nice to have

• Familiarity with tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, or Dovetail

• Interest in healthcare, diagnostics, or life sciences

• Exposure to systems thinking, service blueprinting, or design research methods

• Any experience with chatbot platforms or voice assistant design

• Strong visual communication skills — the ability to make complexity legible

What we offer: The internship experience

• A full

jobs.title: Software Testing Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Purpose of the role

This position aims at offering the opportunity to develop competences in the area of testing, integration and validation of Software solutions in the field of Laboratory connectivity components in Roche Laboratories. Our team is responsible for developing connectivity solutions which are enabling interoperability of all components part of the Diagnostics of our clients (instruments, Network integrators, IT solutions, LIS…). The position will support this ambition by covering activities related to gain understanding of requirements at business and technical level so that they can support on the component, E2E and field validation of functionality, testing activities and integration with other solutions. The role will also provide technical requirements to development teams when appropriate.

How would your day to day look like?

You will be part of a development team based in Sant Cugat and as part of it, you will join their Agile ceremonies (SAFE Framework). You will work in some activities from your team backlog related to your role. You will be in the office an average of 1 to 2 days per week together with the rest of the team for specific testing needs. In addition, you will need to travel 3-4 times per year to Switzerland or other client locations.

Who are you?

You are a recent graduate (max 3 years after graduation) in the fields of Informatics, Telecommunications and Biotech.
You are a person with high curiosity and willingness to learn from other domains. You try to find autonomy in your work and are able to ask for help or advice in order to ensure you are doing valuable work. You are authentic, tell the truth and explain the why, strive for excellence and continuously improve and live our values of Integrity, Courage and Passion.

What do we offer?

We offer a learning environment and opportunities to develop quickly yourself both on our domains and on your personal growth and leadership. 
• We offer you a mature organization with Innovative and passionate people, very customer centric and open to change and continuously improving and delivering value fast. You also will be trained on the basic competencies you need to work with us and will feel safe for failing and learning as the essence to growing with us.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Simulation Specialist Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position

At the heart of this internship, you will collaborate with our Simulation Teams to architect the future of System & Solution Design. As a key contributor, you will help build and validate ‘Digital Twins’ for our next-generation core lab solutions. Your work won’t just be theoretical, it will directly shape the physical architecture and the logical “brain” of cutting-edge, end-to-end laboratory systems.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Model & Maintain: Create and maintain complex scenarios for software and hardware simulations.

• Execute & Analyze: Run simulations and perform deep-dive analyses of the results to identify system behaviors.

• Evolutionary Support: Provide status updates and issue notifications to support the continuous evolution of our simulators.

• Collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve departmental operations and project delivery.

What You Will Learn & Develop

• Advanced Simulation: Gain hands-on experience with Discrete Event Simulation (DES) using tools like Simio or AnyLogic.

• Systems Engineering: Understand the "big picture" of how hardware, software, and logistics integrate into massive diagnostic solutions.

• Algorithmic Thinking: Design and implement efficient heuristics for real-time decision-making in robotics.

• Data Science: Use Python to transform raw simulation outputs into powerful, data-driven visual stories.

• Software Development: Level up your OOP (C# or Java ) skills by extending simulation logic.

• Global Collaboration: Experience working across borders with engineers and product owners in an international environment.

Who You Are

You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.

• Education: Mechanical Engineering, SW Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Industrial Engineering.

• Programming: Solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (C# or Java).

• Data Tools: Knowledge of SQL, Python, and Pandas for data management.

• Simulation: Familiarity with Discrete Event Simulations and statistical modeling.

• Communication: Fluent in English; able to present complex data with clarity.

• Mindset: You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.A strong willingness to learn and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Clinical Quality Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Main tasks and duties:

• Support Roche clinical studies and play a role in the development of new diagnostic tests, helping to ensure the quality and safety of our products.

• Perform quality review of clinical study documents (study protocols, investigator brochures and

• reports) to ensure that clinical studies of IVDs are planned, conducted, and documented in

• compliance with regulations, internal procedures and product specification documents.

• Support GCP inspection readiness activities, including through study file reviews.

• Support team initiatives, including process improvement/harmonization.

• Support project teams with Good Clinical Practice expertise.

Additional tasks, duties and responsibilities:
● Additional tasks as required.

Requirements:

• Preferred Education: Recent graduates from University degree or Master in scientific or technological discipline, ideally in Biomedicine, Biotechnology field.

• No previous experience needed.

• Fluent command of English.

• Interest in clinical studies, medical devices, quality management systems and software development processes. Knowledge of quality and regulatory standards is a plus but not

• mandatory: Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ISO 13485, ISO 20916,

• FDA QSR, IVDR, GDPR

• This position is only available for candidates who have never worked in a company in Spain or used a "contrato de prácticas" before.

Who We Are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. At Roche, we believe diversity and inclusion are essential values for our success. We have a special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. If you have a disability, we see it as a plus and offer you special benefits.

Are you ready to apply?
We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now!

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

At Diagnostics Insights Software, we are collaborating in digitalizing diagnostics and revolutionizing how data is accessed and utilized in Laboratories and Point of Care settings.

Building software products is great, but working on software with a purpose is even better! As a Software Engineer in Test, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and UX experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software engineering practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users’ lives at risk!

Main responsibilities:

• Confirm the correctness of requirements-driven tests, utilizing diverse testing approaches such as exploratory, white box, and black box testing.

• Execute tests across multiple testing levels , including end-to-end, system, integration, and unit testing.

• Perform various testing types , such as functional, performance, resiliency, and scalability testing, to ensure robust product quality.

• Automate and execute front-end and back-end tests for platforms and web applications .

• Develop and automate deployment and testing pipelines, supporting multiple project branches and stages.

• Track and report quality metrics , contributing to the maintenance and improvement of quality dashboards .

• Conduct root cause analyses of defects and newly discovered issues to continuously improve testing practices.

• Design and implement automation frameworks and validate toolchains to support testing processes.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory standards for all quality engineering deliverables.

• Collaborate closely with Test Architects, Test Leads, Test Managers, as well as designers, architects, and developers.

• Share, coach, and train the built-in quality mindset throughout the organization.

How would your day to day look like?
You will work closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
You will deep dive on ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products by performing thorough testing activities throughout the development lifecycle. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to design reviews, thorough test coverage, focused quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you

Who are you?

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• You are familiar with integration of automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous testing.

• You are familiar with the testing processes: design, plan, execution and reporting.

• Great written and verbal communication in English.

• Technologies & Tools: Kubernetes-based applications, AWS, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Typescript, Javascript, Playwright, Cypress, Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link.

jobs.title: Penetration Tester Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Department Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated professional with experience in Security and Privacy to join our dynamic team. As a Junior Penetration Tester, your main responsibilities will include supporting and assisting in penetration testing activities to ensure the security of Roche products and solutions. This role involves collaborating with Product Teams, executing predefined test strategies, and documenting the results. You will play a crucial role in identifying vulnerabilities and aiding in the reporting process.

The Opportunity

• Work closely with Product Teams to understand and determine testing requirements and assist in the development, planning, scoping and execution of testing activities (both in physical and cloud products).

• Conduct cybersecurity penetration testing activities across various technology layers, assessing the criticality of vulnerabilities for adequate prioritization, and providing suitable remediation recommendations to product teams.

• Maintain and utilize the repository of penetration testing methods and tools to ensure consistency and standardization in testing practices.

• Create detailed reports and present findings, associated risks, and recommendations to product teams and management.

• Participate in planning and managing red team exercises to assess the cyber resilience of products and solutions.

• Support the Incident Response team during incidents.

• Contribute to initiatives aimed at integrating defense capabilities into products in collaboration with other PSPO colleagues.

• Develop, maintain, and continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools to enhance penetration testing efficiency and effectiveness.

Program Highlights

• Intensive 1 year intern graduate program (Contrato en prácticas).

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Location in Sant Cugat del Valles, On Site.

• Access to training and development opportunities.

• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.

Who You Are (Required)

• Must have graduated from a University degree program.

• Must have attained a Bachelor's degree.

• Experience or familiarity with cloud computing technologies, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing.

• Knowledge of automating security controls through scripting languages such as shell scripting and Python.

• Understanding of information security and privacy risks.

• Problem solving abilities, communication, teamwork, flexibility and adaptability.

• Team player, proactive, self-driven, solution-oriented, and hands-on.

Required Majors: Information Systems, Computer Science or a related relevant area of study.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Intern in the Global Digital Hub, you support the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Intern will collaborate closely with the Campaign Delivery Specialists to support affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

Responsibilities

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Incorporates feedback on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are
You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse teams and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations.

Further requirements

• Proficient in English and German language

• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college

• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week

• You are passionate about project management

• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully

• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills

• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind

• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment

In exchange we provide you with:

Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

A global community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

jobs.title: R&D Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation in diagnostics. As part of our Start Tech Program , we are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join our team in Sant Cugat and contribute to cutting-edge diagnostic development.
This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic laboratory environment while working alongside experienced professionals in the field.

Your Responsibilities

As a Start Tech Graduate Intern, you will support the development of diagnostic solutions and contribute to laboratory operations. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Participating in the development of diagnostic assays, including clotting, enzymatic, and immunological methods

• Independently supporting the execution of analytical experiments, including data analysis, interpretation, and presentation of results

• Assisting in the planning, implementation, evaluation, and documentation of development activities, including literature research

• Contributing to general laboratory tasks to ensure smooth day-to-day operations

• Taking responsibility for the proper use and maintenance of assigned laboratory equipment

What We Are Looking For

• Recent graduate in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field

• Strong interest in diagnostics and laboratory-based research

• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment

• Good communication skills and willingness to learn

What We Offer

• Hands-on experience in a leading global healthcare company

• Exposure to innovative diagnostic technologies and methodologies

• A collaborative and international work environment

• Opportunities for learning, growth, and future career development within Roche

If you are eager to start your career in diagnostics and want to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation in diagnostics. As part of our Start Tech Program , we are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join our team in Sant Cugat and contribute to cutting-edge diagnostic development. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic laboratory environment while working alongside experienced professionals in the field. Your Responsibilities As a Start Tech Graduate Intern, you will support the development of diagnostic solutions and contribute to laboratory operations. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Participating in the development of diagnostic assays, including clotting, enzymatic, and immunological methods
• Independently supporting the execution of analytical experiments, including data analysis, interpretation, and presentation of results
• Assisting in the planning, implementation, evaluation, and documentation of development activities, including literature research
• Contributing to general laboratory tasks to ensure smooth day-to-day operations
• Taking responsibility for the proper use and maintenance of assigned laboratory equipment What We Are Looking For
• Recent graduate in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field
• Strong interest in diagnostics and laboratory-based research
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
• Good communication skills and willingness to learn What We Offer
• Hands-on experience in a leading global healthcare company
• Exposure to innovative diagnostic technologies and methodologies
• A collaborative and international work environment
• Opportunities for learning, growth, and future career development within Roche If you are eager to start your career in diagnostics and want to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Process Technician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Responsibilities:
Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

Purpose - our focus in the

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità: Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di due tecnici di processo per aderire al nostro team di Process Engineering in un contratto di 12 mesi, con la possibilità di estensione. Entrambe le posizioni coinvolgeranno le stesse responsabilità quotidiane descritte di seguito; tuttavia, uno dei ruoli richiederà anche di lavorare nella nostra posizione Dumyat. In qualità di tecnico di processo lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team di produzione e confezionamento dei sensori e diventerai altamente qualificato e competente in tutti gli aspetti della produzione (ad esempio il funzionamento della linea e l'imballaggio, i processi e le procedure). Essere in grado di diagnosticare i problemi di prodotto e processo in modo rapido ed efficace utilizzando un approccio logico. Supporta e guida iniziative di miglioramento continuo garantendo al contempo i massimi livelli di qualità e produttività. Analizzare i dati di produzione e condurre i test di prodotto / processo per garantire CTQ sono soddisfatti. Documentazione di aggiornamento come procedure operative standard, istruzioni di lavoro e bollette di materiale. Questo è un ruolo in loco basato sulla nostra sede Athena Motherwell. Si prega di notare che trascorrerete circa il 70% del vostro tempo lavorando dal nostro sito Bathgate, tuttavia, uno dei ruoli richiederà anche di lavorare nella nostra posizione Dumyat. Responsabilità: Tecnica:
• Lavorare in stretta collaborazione con tecnici e ingegneri di produzione per diventare altamente competenti nel funzionamento, processi e procedure della linea di produzione dei sensori
• Monitoraggio del supporto dei dati dei prodotti e dei processi utilizzando tecniche di analisi statistica
• Diagnosi rapida ed efficace e risoluzione dei problemi utilizzando un approccio metodologico e riferire i progressi in modo strutturato
• Condurre test CTQ e tecniche di analisi dei materiali / prodotti
• Indagare e risolvere non conformità e contribuire a sviluppare misure di prevenzione e di OCAP robuste
• Sostenere i progetti NPD attraverso il trasferimento di lavori pilota alla fabbricazione di volumi elevati
• Supportare le attività di validazione e il completamento della documentazione di validazione in linea con le esigenze aziendali
• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso l'impegno del team di produzione a turni
• Garantisce elevati livelli di qualità e conformità sono mantenuti
• Aggiornamenti di controllo delle modifiche di piombo/supporto alla documentazione di produzione. Chi sei: Educazione Essenziale/ Qualifiche:
• Processo Eccellenza Giallo o Verde cintura ulteriore vantaggio.
• Preferibilmente Laurea esperienza qualificata o rilevante.
• Esperienza nella conversione rotante e/o bobina nella stampa a bobina (schermo rotatorio / flessografico ecc.) ulteriore vantaggio
• Conoscenza dei metodi / tecniche di analisi statistica Requisiti (incl. competenze chiave):
• Esperienza GMP
• Un tecnico di processo pratico con un buon livello di esperienza industriale rilevante (preferibilmente dispositivo medico correlato)
• Esperienza di ottimizzazione dei prodotti e dei processi
• Alti livelli di alfabetizzazione del computer
• Giocatore di squadra e tiene conto delle sfide di produzione
• Analizzare i dati di produzione e condurre l'analisi del processo / del prodotto per garantire il raggiungimento di CTQ
• Forte capacità di problem solving e senso di urgenza
• Dettagli orientati e assicura elevati livelli di qualità e produttività sono mantenuti ogni giorno Processo di assunzione Fase I:
• Presentazione di Cover Letter & CV: Valutazione delle competenze tecniche e della motivazione. Fase II:
• Intervista in persona a Athena Motherwell (sarà condivisa con i candidati più brevi in seguito) Scopo - la nostra attenzione

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La possibilité : Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche de deux techniciens de process pour rejoindre notre équipe de Process Engineering sur un contrat de 12 mois, avec la possibilité de prolongation. Les deux postes comprendront les mêmes responsabilités quotidiennes décrites ci-dessous; toutefois, l'un des rôles devra aussi travailler à notre emplacement de Dumyat. En tant que technicien en process, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de fabrication et d'emballage des capteurs et vous deviendrez hautement qualifié et compétent dans tous les aspects de la fabrication (p. ex. fonctionnement et emballage en ligne, processus et procédures). Être en mesure de diagnostiquer les problèmes de produit et de processus rapidement et efficacement en utilisant une approche logique. Appuyer et diriger les initiatives d'amélioration continue tout en assurant le maintien des plus hauts niveaux de qualité et de productivité. Analyser les données de fabrication et effectuer des essais de produits et de procédés pour s'assurer que les CTQ sont respectés. Mettre à jour les documents tels que les procédures opérationnelles normalisées, les instructions de travail et les factures de matériel. C'est un rôle sur place basé sur notre site Athena Motherwell. Veuillez noter que vous passerez environ 70 % de votre temps à partir de notre site de Bathgate, mais que l'un des rôles devra aussi être celui de notre site de Dumyat. Responsabilités : Technique:
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les techniciens de fabrication et les ingénieurs pour devenir très compétents dans le fonctionnement de la ligne de fabrication de capteurs, les processus et les procédures
• Soutenir la surveillance des données sur les produits et les procédés au moyen de techniques d'analyse statistique
• Diagnostic rapide et efficace et dépannage des problèmes en utilisant une approche méthodique et rapporter les progrès de manière structurée
• Effectuer des essais CTQ et des techniques d'analyse des matériaux/produits
• Étudier et résoudre les non-conformités et aider à développer des OCAP et des mesures préventives robustes
• Soutenir les projets de la NPD par le transfert des travaux pilotes à la fabrication à haut volume
• Soutenir les activités de validation et compléter la documentation de validation en fonction des besoins opérationnels
• Aider à mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue par l'engagement de l'équipe de production en équipe
• Assurer le maintien des niveaux de qualité et de conformité les plus élevés
• Mise à jour du contrôle du changement de plomb/support à la documentation de fabrication. Qui vous êtes : Études essentielles / Qualifications :
• Processus Excellence Ceinture jaune ou verte avantage supplémentaire.
• De préférence Expérience qualifiée ou pertinente.
• Expérience en conversion rotative et / ou bobine à l'impression de bobines (écran rotatif / flexographique etc.) avantage supplémentaire
• Connaissance des méthodes et techniques d'analyse statistique Exigences (y compris les compétences clés):
• Expérience BPF
• Un technicien pratique en procédés possédant un bon niveau d'expérience dans l'industrie (de préférence lié à un appareil médical)
• Expérience d'optimisation des produits et des procédés
• Niveau élevé de connaissances en informatique
• Joueur d'équipe et prend la responsabilité de tout défi de fabrication
• Analyser les données de production et effectuer l'analyse des procédés/produits pour s'assurer que les CTQ sont respectés
• Compétences fortes en résolution de problèmes et sentiment d'urgence
• Des détails orientés et assure le maintien quotidien des niveaux les plus élevés de qualité et de productivité Processus de recrutement Phase I :
• Présentation de la lettre de présentation et du CV : évaluation des compétences techniques et de la motivation. Phase II:
• Entretien en personne à Athena Motherwell (avec les candidats présélectionnés plus tard) Objectif - notre objectif

jobs.title: GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Globale per l'Assicurazione della Conformità GPC

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission

As a GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times.

You will lead and manage a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Compliance Assurance Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs.
Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps.

You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be accountable for the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented.

Key Accountabilities

• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.

• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.

• Accountable for the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.

• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.

• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.

• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.

• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.

• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.

• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Comp

• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.
• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.

• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.
• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.
• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.
• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.
• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.
• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.
• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.
• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.
• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management. Key skills and Experience
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.
• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.
• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Comp
