jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Scientist in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development.

The opportunity

• Leading development: Pharmaceutical development of parenteral formulations for clinical development and market (including line extensions). Understanding stability behavior (e.g. biophysics, chemical degradation)

• Management of Data: Ensure seamless integration of structured and unstructured data across the department.

• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to perform deep-dive Data Mining. Identify trends and correlations associated with scientific data.

• Functional expertise as project management: Representation of Pharmaceutical Development as pharmaceutical project leader in global CMC teams, functional representative in cross-functional teams and global committees within Roche.

• Regulatory submissions: Authoring drug product sections for clinical IND/IMPDs and MAAs.

Who you are
As the successful candidate you hold a Ph.D. degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields Or you hold a masters degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional (industry) experience in a pharmaceutical company.

• Proven experience of establishing and managing large data sets, including exposure to scripting associated with data analysis.

• Deep understanding of statistical modeling including linear/logistic regression, cluster analysis, time-series forecasting, longitudinal study data analysis, and multivariate testing.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical product development and associated requirements.

• Understanding of regulatory requirements for different clinical and commercial stages of development.

• Excellent communication skills and collaborative behaviors, with end-to-end and global thinking, as well as excellent stakeholder management skills

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Il dipartimento di sviluppo farmaceutico è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali ( molecole sintetiche e biologiche) dalla fase 1 al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per i prodotti farmaceutici parenterali per tutte le fasi cliniche e il lancio del mercato, il trasferimento del prodotto e del processo ai siti di produzione commerciale, il supporto commerciale del prodotto e lo sviluppo dell'estensione della linea. • Sviluppo leader: sviluppo farmaceutico delle formulazioni parenterali per lo sviluppo e il mercato clinico (comprese le estensioni di linea). Comprendere il comportamento della stabilità (ad esempio biofisica, degradazione chimica)
• Gestione dei dati: garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei dati strutturati e non strutturati in tutto il dipartimento.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilizzare tecniche di statistica e machine learning avanzate per eseguire l'estrazione di dati in profondità. Identificare le tendenze e le correlazioni associate ai dati scientifici.
• Competenze funzionali come project management: Rappresentanza dello Sviluppo Farmaceutico come responsabile del progetto farmaceutico nei team CMC globali, rappresentante funzionale in team interfunzionali e comitati globali all'interno di Roche.
• Inserimenti normativi: autorizzare sezioni di prodotti farmaceutici per IND/IMPDs clinici e MAAs. Chi sei Come candidato di successo si possiede un dottorato di ricerca in ingegneria chimica/processo/bioprocesso o campi correlati O si possiede un master in ingegneria chimica/processo/bioprocesso o campi correlati con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale (industria) in un'azienda farmaceutica.
• Provata esperienza di stabilire e gestire grandi set di dati, compresa l'esposizione a script associati all'analisi dei dati.
• Profonda comprensione della modellazione statistica, tra cui regressione lineare/logistica, analisi dei cluster, previsione delle serie temporali, analisi dei dati di studio longitudinale e test multivariato.
• Conoscenza dello sviluppo dei prodotti farmaceutici e dei requisiti associati.
• Comprensione dei requisiti normativi per diverse fasi cliniche e commerciali di sviluppo.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e comportamenti collaborativi, con il pensiero end-to-end e globale, nonché eccellenti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le lancement du marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciale, le soutien des produits commerciaux et le développement d'extensions de gamme. L'opportunité
• Développement avancé: Développement pharmaceutique de formulations parentérales pour le développement clinique et le marché (y compris les extensions de lignées). Comprendre le comportement de stabilité (par exemple biophysique, dégradation chimique)
• Gestion des données : assurer une intégration transparente des données structurées et non structurées dans l'ensemble du département.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilisez des techniques avancées de statistique et d'apprentissage automatique pour effectuer l'extraction de données en profondeur. Déterminer les tendances et les corrélations associées aux données scientifiques.
• Expertise fonctionnelle en tant que gestion de projet : Représentation du développement pharmaceutique en tant que chef de projet pharmaceutique dans les équipes mondiales du CMC, représentant fonctionnel dans les équipes interfonctionnelles et les comités mondiaux au sein de Roche.
• Présentations réglementaires : Autoriser les sections des produits pharmaceutiques pour les ID/IMPD cliniques et les AAM. • Expérience éprouvée de l'établissement et de la gestion de grands ensembles de données, y compris l'exposition à des scripts associés à l'analyse des données.
• Compréhension approfondie de la modélisation statistique, y compris la régression linéaire/logistique, l'analyse en grappes, la prévision de séries chronologiques, l'analyse longitudinale des données des études et les essais multivariés.
• Connaissance du développement des produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences connexes.
• Compréhension des exigences réglementaires pour les différents stades cliniques et commerciaux du développement.

jobs.title: Technical Solution Management Associate
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

The Diagnostics Insights Solutions Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising larger solutions with multiple components (digital products, physical products, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs.

As a Technical Solution Management Associate you will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation of our solutions portfolio. You will work hand in hand with our team and different Solution Teams in the organization to support them with the automation of processes, contributing to the alignment with organizational objectives. Your main area of responsibility will be the application of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence technologies to design and develop tailored tools to bring the end-to-end management of digital solutions to the next level.

Main responsibilities

As a Technical Solution Management Associate, your core responsibilities will include:

• Contribution to Ideation and Design: Actively participate in the ideation, analysis, and evaluation of solutions within the team's scope with the objective of optimizing processes and augmenting transparency and traceability with data.

• Process Optimization Tool Development: Identify opportunities for improvement and enhance solution management by leveraging data analytics and AI tools for diverse stakeholder groups (e.g., solution teams, affiliate members, or the broader organization). Additionally, identify inefficient processes and create tools to automate or streamline them.

• Team management (e.g. lean portfolio management, Aha! Automation, etc.)

• Technical solution management (e.g. requirements, version control,...)

• End-to-End solution management (e.g. coordination of solutions portfolio, traceability,...)

• Solution Lifecycle Management Support: Assisting with the administrative and documentation tasks related to the different stages of the lifecycle of complex software solutions.

• Reporting and Metrics Creation: Supporting the creation of data-driven tools to track the performance and adoption of key organizational solutions.

• Sustainable Development: Define the necessary maintenance and sustainability tasks to ensure the continued relevance and accuracy of the developed tools by e.g. enabling seamless retraining with new or updated training data.

How would your day to day look like?
As Technical Solution Management Associate in the Diagnostics Insights Solutions team, you'll work closely with our team members (Business Solution Managers and Technical Solution Managers) as well as cross-functional partners from across the organization. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including product managers, marketing leads, definition teams, engineering teams and subject matter experts.

The successful candidate will play a dual role, handling management and administrative support tasks related to organizational solutions, while also developing and implementing tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our internal processes. jobs.title: Application Specialist - Molecular Solutions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System.

This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.

• Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.

• Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.

• Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.

• Provide scientific documentation to customers.

• Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.

• Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.

• Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.

• Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.

• Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner.

Who you are:

• B.S. Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or work-related experience.

• Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions - an advantage.

• Fluent in English (oral and written).

• Technical vocabulary & terminology.

• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).

• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).

• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.

• Verbal and written communication skills.

• Planning, administration and decision making.

• Work well in a team environment.

• Service/Customer oriented.

• Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are driven by a shared ambition: to create a healthier future through continuous innovation, advancing science, and expanding access to healthcare for people worldwide. Our purpose is to help build a world where people can spend more time with those who matter most.

As healthcare continues to evolve, Global Procurement is transforming to deliver greater strategic value—enhancing supplier partnerships, driving innovation, and improving outcomes for patients and healthcare systems globally. By actively managing a complex supplier ecosystem, we ensure we meet today’s needs while anticipating those of tomorrow.

The Opportunity

As Analytics & Insights Business Partnering Lead , you will lead the strategic direction of Analytics within the Procurement Enablement chapter. This function is central to building a best-in-class Procurement organization through data-driven insights, governance, capability development, and digital innovation.

You will shape how data is leveraged across Global Procurement, unlocking its full potential to inform decision-making, drive performance, and create tangible business impact. Operating in a highly dynamic, global environment, you will guide teams to apply structured thinking, advanced Analytics, and actionable insights to complex business challenges.

Your Impact

In this leadership role, you will act as a strategic advisor and capability builder, working across Procurement, Finance, and cross-functional Analytics teams. You will lead, coach, and inspire others while delivering high-impact Analytics solutions and fostering a strong data-driven culture.

Key areas of accountability include:

• Setting the vision and strategy for Analytics and insights within business partnering, aligning with broader Global Procurement objectives

• Acting as a senior subject matter expert, guiding best practices in data strategy, Analytics, visualization, and insight generation

• Leading the development and continuous improvement of Analytics products, frameworks, and scalable solutions

• Influencing senior stakeholders to embed data-driven decision-making and improve data quality across the organization

• Building and developing high-performing teams, while contributing to cross-functional initiatives, squads, and enterprise-wide programs

• Championing innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies, methodologies, and ways of working

Who You Are

You are an experienced leader with a strong track record in Analytics, Procurement, and account management within complex, matrixed organizations. You bring both strategic vision and hands-on expertise, along with the ability to influence at the highest levels.

You will typically bring:

• A university degree (business, Analytics, or life sciences preferred)

• 10+ years of experience in Procurement, Analytics, business analysis, or management consulting

• Proven experience translating complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions

• Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to influence and drive adoption of new strategies and technologies

• Deep expertise in data, visualization, and insight generation, combined with experience leading teams and initiatives

• Category management experience is highly advantageous

• Previous account management experience also desirable

• Fluency in English

• Leadership Mindset

You embody an enterprise mindset, thinking beyond functional boundaries to create integrated, customer-centric solu

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, siamo guidati da un'ambizione condivisa: creare un futuro più sano attraverso l'innovazione continua, avanzando la scienza e espandendo l'accesso alla sanità per le persone in tutto il mondo. Il nostro scopo è quello di aiutare a costruire un mondo in cui le persone possono trascorrere più tempo con coloro che importano di più. Man mano che l'assistenza sanitaria continua a evolversi, Global Procurement si sta trasformando per offrire un maggior valore strategico: migliorare le partnership dei fornitori, guidare l'innovazione e migliorare i risultati per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari a livello globale. Gestire attivamente un ecosistema di fornitori complesso, ci assicuriamo di soddisfare le esigenze di oggi, anticipando quelle di domani. L'opportunità In qualità di Lead di partner commerciali di analisi e informazioni, guiderai la direzione strategica di Analytics all'interno del capitolo Procurement Enablement. Questa funzione è centrale per la costruzione di un'organizzazione di appalti di classe migliore attraverso intuizioni basate sui dati, governance, sviluppo delle capacità e innovazione digitale. Potrai modellare come i dati vengono sfruttati attraverso Global Procurement, sbloccando il suo pieno potenziale per informare il processo decisionale, le prestazioni di guida e creare impatto commerciale tangibile. Operando in un ambiente altamente dinamico e globale, guiderai i team ad applicare il pensiero strutturato, l'analisi avanzata e le intuizioni attuabili a complesse sfide aziendali. Il tuo impatto In questo ruolo di leadership, si agirà come consulente strategico e costruttore di capacità, lavorando tra i team di Procurement, Finance e Analytics cross-functional. Potrai guidare, allenare e ispirare gli altri offrendo soluzioni di analisi ad alto impatto e promuovere una forte cultura basata sui dati. Le principali aree di responsabilità includono:
• Impostare la visione e la strategia per l'analisi e le intuizioni all'interno del business partnering, allineando con gli obiettivi di Global Procurement più ampi
• Agire come esperto di materia senior, guidando le migliori pratiche nella strategia dei dati, analisi, visualizzazione e generazione di informazioni
• Condurre lo sviluppo e il miglioramento continuo dei prodotti, dei framework e delle soluzioni scalabili di Analytics
• influenzare gli stakeholder senior per incorporare il processo decisionale basato sui dati e migliorare la qualità dei dati in tutta l'organizzazione
• Costruire e sviluppare team altamente performanti, contribuendo a iniziative, team e programmi multifunzionali
• Campione dell'innovazione individuando opportunità di sfruttare nuove tecnologie, metodologie e modi di lavoro Chi sei Sei un leader esperto con un forte record di traccia in Analytics, Procurement e gestione account all'interno di organizzazioni complesse e matrici. Porti sia la visione strategica che l'esperienza pratica, insieme alla capacità di influenzare ai massimi livelli. tipicamente porterà:
• Preferito un diploma universitario (business, analisi o scienze della vita)
• 10+ anni di esperienza nella consulenza per appalti, analisi, analisi aziendale o gestione
• Esperienza comprovata che traduce complesse sfide aziendali in soluzioni analitiche scalabili
• Forte capacità di comunicazione esecutiva, con la capacità di influenzare e guidare l'adozione di nuove strategie e tecnologie
• Profonda esperienza nella generazione dei dati, della visualizzazione e dell'intuizione, unita a team e iniziative leader di esperienza
• L'esperienza di gestione della categoria è altamente vantaggiosa
• Esperienza di gestione account precedente anche auspicabile
• Fluenza in inglese
• Mindset Leadership Incorpori una mentalità aziendale, pensando oltre i confini funzionali per creare solu integrato, customer-centric

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche sind wir von einem gemeinsamen Ehrgeiz angetrieben: eine gesündere Zukunft durch kontinuierliche Innovation zu schaffen, Wissenschaft voranzutreiben und den Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung für Menschen weltweit zu erweitern. Unser Ziel ist es, eine Welt aufzubauen, in der Menschen mehr Zeit mit denen verbringen können, die am meisten wichtig sind. Da sich die Gesundheitsversorgung weiter entwickelt, verwandelt sich Global Procurement um einen größeren strategischen Wert – die Förderung von Lieferantenpartnerschaften, das Fahren von Innovation und die Verbesserung der Ergebnisse für Patienten und Gesundheitssysteme weltweit. Durch die aktive Verwaltung eines komplexen Lieferanten-Ökosystems stellen wir sicher, dass wir die heutigen Bedürfnisse erfüllen und die von morgen erwarten. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept, and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the CoE, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development — furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient response to treatment. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

As Digital Measures Lead , you will play a pivotal role in embedding sensor-based digital health technologies into the heart of our pRED and gRED drug development programs. In disease areas like Alzheimer’s disease and Multiple Sclerosis, you will be responsible for shaping and executing on strategies that allow us to increase R&D productivity using digital clinical outcome assessments, digital biomarkers and exploratory digital measures collected from wearables, smartphones and other sensor-based digital health technologies (DHTs). You will be part of a team of experts located in Basel and South San Francisco and report to the Sensor Data Insights group lead in the Computational Biology and Medicine department.

The Opportunity:

• Partner with drug development teams to shape high-impact opportunities that drive clinical trial productivity improvements with sensor-based DHTs; embed them into disease area, clinical development, and biomarker strategies.

• Develop comprehensive roadmaps to realize these opportunities, including assessing unmet measurement needs; evaluating, developing, validating sensor-based DHTs; driving towards community and regulatory acceptance

• Lead the delivery of these roadmaps. This includes securing governance endorsement and resourcing; leading CoE matrix team delivery; managing vendor/technology partnerships; ensuring seamless integration of sensor-based DHTs into clinical trials, including study designs, operations, data analyses; supporting results interpretation.

• Foster external partnerships with industry, technology providers, academic centers, regulators, and patients to strengthen and accelerate these efforts.

• Drive scientific communication and thought leadership both within and outside Roche through conferences and peer-reviewed publications, while upholding scientific rigor and patient-centricity in all activities.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Ph.D. or equivalent experience in Digital Health, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Neuroscience or a related discipline coupled with at least 5+ years of professional experience leveraging sensor-based DHTs to improve R&D productivity in Phase I-IV trials

• You possess deep expertise in neuroscience, including Alzheimer's disease and Multiple Sclerosis, and understand how sensor-based DHTs can be applied for clinical trial use cases in these areas (e.g. efficacy/safet

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED ) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un'organizzazione globale che consente alle unità di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche (pRED e gRED) di diventare più basate sui dati, più digitalmente adept, e meglio preparate per le sfide del futuro. All'interno del CoE, la Medicina Computazionale si concentra sullo sviluppo e l'applicazione di soluzioni di analisi dei dati innovative per supportare lo sviluppo clinico, migliorando la nostra comprensione della malattia, della progressione della malattia e della risposta individuale del paziente al trattamento. In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso pRED e gRED, creiamo farmaci migliori aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura data-driven. Come Digital Measures Lead , si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell'integrazione di tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori nel cuore dei nostri programmi di sviluppo di droga pRED e gRED. Nelle aree di malattia come il morbo di Alzheimer e la Sclerosi Multipla, sarete responsabili di modellare ed eseguire strategie che ci permettono di aumentare la produttività R&D utilizzando le valutazioni dei risultati clinici digitali, i biomarcatori digitali e le misure digitali esplorative raccolte da wearables, smartphone e altre tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori (DHT). Sarete parte di un team di esperti che si trova a Basilea e nel sud di San Francisco e riferirete al gruppo Sensor Data Insights leader nel reparto Biologia e Medicina Computazionale. L'opportunità:
• Collaborare con i team di sviluppo della droga per creare opportunità ad alto impatto che favoriscano i miglioramenti della produttività di trial clinici con DHT basati sui sensori; integrarli in aree di malattia, sviluppo clinico e strategie di biomarcatore.
• Sviluppare mappe stradali complete per realizzare queste opportunità, compresa la valutazione delle esigenze di misura non soddisfatte; valutare, sviluppare, convalidare i DHT basati sui sensori; guidare verso l'accettazione della comunità e della regolamentazione
• Guidare la consegna di queste roadmap. Ciò include la garanzia di approvazione e risourcing della governance; la consegna del team di matrice CoE leader; la gestione dei partenariati di fornitori/tecnologie; l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei DHT basati sui sensori in studi clinici, tra cui progetti di studio, operazioni, analisi dei dati; l'interpretazione dei risultati di supporto.
• Promuovere partnership esterne con industria, fornitori di tecnologia, centri accademici, regolatori e pazienti per rafforzare e accelerare questi sforzi.
• Guidare la comunicazione scientifica e la leadership di pensiero sia all'interno che all'esterno di Roche attraverso conferenze e pubblicazioni peer-reviewed, mentre sostenere il rigore scientifico e la concentrazione dei pazienti in tutte le attività. Chi sei?
• Ha un Ph.D. o un'esperienza equivalente in Digital Health, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Neuroscience o una disciplina correlata accoppiata con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale sfruttando DHT basati sui sensori per migliorare la produttività R&D nelle prove di Fase I-IV
• Possiedi una profonda esperienza in neuroscienze, tra cui la malattia di Alzheimer e la sclerosi multipla, e capire come i DHT basati sui sensori possono essere applicati per i casi di uso di prova clinica in queste aree (ad esempio l'efficacia/sicurezza

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED ) Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CdE) est une organisation mondiale qui permet aux unités de recherche et de développement précoce de Roches (PRED et GRED) de devenir plus axées sur les données, plus performantes sur le plan numérique et mieux préparées aux défis de l'avenir. Au sein du Conseil de l'Europe, la médecine computationnelle met l'accent sur l'élaboration et l'application de solutions innovantes d'analyse de données pour soutenir le développement clinique. Nous créons de meilleurs médicaments en partenariat avec nos scientifiques dans les domaines de la R-D et de la R-D, grâce à notre culture axée sur les données. En tant que chef de file en matière de mesures numériques, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'intégration des technologies de santé numériques basées sur des capteurs au cœur de nos programmes de développement de médicaments PRED et GRED. Dans des domaines comme la maladie d'Alzheimer et la sclérose en plaques, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de stratégies qui nous permettent d'accroître la productivité de la R-D à l'aide d'évaluations de résultats cliniques numériques, de biomarqueurs numériques et de mesures numériques exploratoires recueillies à partir de portables, de smartphones et d'autres technologies numériques de santé basées sur des capteurs. Vous ferez partie d'une équipe d'experts située à Bâle et à South San Francisco et relèverez du groupe Sensor Data Insights, responsable du département de biologie et de médecine computationnelles. La possibilité :
• S'associer à des équipes de développement de médicaments pour créer des possibilités à fort impact qui favorisent l'amélioration de la productivité des essais cliniques avec des DHT à base de capteurs; les intégrer dans les stratégies de lutte contre la maladie, de développement clinique et de biomarqueur.
• Élaborer des feuilles de route complètes pour exploiter ces possibilités, notamment en évaluant les besoins non satisfaits en matière de mesure; en évaluant, en développant et en validant les DHT basés sur des capteurs; en conduisant vers une acceptation communautaire et réglementaire;
• Diriger la livraison de ces feuilles de route. Il s'agit notamment d'obtenir l'approbation et le ressourcement en matière de gouvernance; de diriger la mise en oeuvre de la matrice du Conseil de l'Europe; de gérer les partenariats fournisseurs/technologies; d'assurer l'intégration harmonieuse des DHT fondés sur des capteurs dans les essais cliniques, y compris les conceptions d'études, les opérations, les analyses de données; d'appuyer l'interprétation des résultats.
• Favoriser des partenariats externes avec l'industrie, les fournisseurs de technologie, les centres universitaires, les régulateurs et les patients pour renforcer et accélérer ces efforts.

jobs.title: Technical Development Leader (TDL) Large Molecules
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally.

The Opportunity
As a TDL, you will lead Technical Development Teams (TDTs) to develop and drive Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Control (CMC) strategies for clinical drug candidates from early human trials through product launch ensuring technical integrity and proactive risk mitigation.

• Leadership: Lead technical teams throughout the product lifecycle, from preclinical development to product launch, ensuring the scientific integrity of the CMC strategy.

• Strategy & Execution: Designs and implements multifaceted technical strategies - encompassing manufacturing processes, drug product and device configurations, and global supply chains - to ensure seamless regulatory approval and commercial success.

• Enterprise Alignment & Governance: Provides enterprise-level perspectives to ensure deliverables remain patient- and customer-focused; serves as a primary liaison to asset teams, senior management and governance committees, delivering transparent updates that facilitate informed decision-making.

• Operational Excellence: Oversees end-to-end CMC development, including financial stewardship, resource forecasting, and milestone tracking to ensure flawless execution.

• Risk & Decision Management: Drives informed decision-making for CMC investments and risk mitigation, developing robust contingency plans and proactively communicating potential impacts to relevant leadership and governance bodies.

Who You Are

• You are a recognized thought leader in CMC/product development with a proven ability to lead complex, high-stakes pharmaceutical projects.

• Education: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Technical Expertise: Extensive pharmaceutical industry experience, including a strong background in biologics process development and CMC team leadership.

• Strategic and Critical Thinking: Advanced understanding of the full drug development process with a history of successful innovation. Business acumen is a plus

• Program Management: Demonstrated ability to handle complex cross-functional programs while thinking strategically and proactively.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional negotiation and verbal/written communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior management and third parties.

.
Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) è l'organizzazione che produce e fornisce le terapie innovative di Roche a 127 milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. PT è coinvolto nella produzione di ogni farmaco Roche – dal processo di sviluppo attraverso gli studi clinici – e continua a maturità del prodotto. La nostra organizzazione coordina tutti gli aspetti della produzione di farmaci Roche in tutte le aree di malattia e forme di dosaggio. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) è parte integrante della missione di Roche di sviluppare farmaci innovativi e trasformativi significativi per i pazienti applicando competenze tecniche di punta per progettare, sviluppare, fornire e registrare i prodotti di fase clinica a livello globale. L'opportunità Come TDL, guiderai i team di sviluppo tecnico (TDTs) per sviluppare e guidare strategie di chimica, manifatturiera e controllo (CMC) per i candidati alla droga clinica dai primi studi umani attraverso il lancio del prodotto garantendo l'integrità tecnica e la mitigazione del rischio proattivo.
• Leadership: Leader team tecnici in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dallo sviluppo preclinico al lancio del prodotto, garantendo l'integrità scientifica della strategia CMC.
• Strategia & Esecuzione: Progetta e implementa strategie tecniche sfaccettate, che comprendono processi produttivi, configurazioni di prodotti e dispositivi, e catene di approvvigionamento globali, per garantire una perfetta approvazione normativa e un successo commerciale.
• allineamento aziendale e governance: fornisce prospettive a livello aziendale per garantire che i responsabili rimangano pazienti e orientati al cliente; funge da collegamento primario ai team di asset, ai comitati di gestione e governance senior, fornendo aggiornamenti trasparenti che facilitano il processo decisionale informato.
• Eccellenza operativa: supervisiona lo sviluppo CMC end-to-end, tra cui la gestione finanziaria, la previsione delle risorse e il tracciamento delle pietre miliari per garantire l'esecuzione impeccabile.
• Gestione del rischio e delle decisioni: guida il processo decisionale informato per gli investimenti CMC e la mitigazione dei rischi, lo sviluppo di piani di contingenza robusti e la comunicazione proattiva dei potenziali impatti per gli organismi di leadership e di governance rilevanti. Chi sei
• Sei un leader di pensiero riconosciuto nello sviluppo CMC / prodotto con una comprovata capacità di condurre progetti farmaceutici complessi e ad alto consumo.
• Istruzione: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chimica, Farmacia, Ingegneria Chimica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Competenza Tecnica: Ampia esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, tra cui un forte background nello sviluppo dei processi biologici e nella leadership del team CMC.
• pensiero strategico e critico: comprensione avanzata del processo di sviluppo completo della droga con una storia di innovazione di successo. Business acumen è un plus
• Gestione del programma: capacità dimostrata di gestire programmi interfunzionali complessi mentre si pensa strategicamente e proattivamente.
• Comunicazione e influenza: negoziazione eccezionale e capacità comunicative verbali/scritte, con un track record di influenzare la gestione senior e terze parti. . Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) ist die Organisation, die Roches bahnbrechende Therapien auf 127 Millionen Patienten weltweit produziert und liefert. PT beteiligt sich an der Produktion jeder Roche-Medikament – vom Entwicklungsprozess über klinische Studien – und an der Produktreife. Unsere Organisation koordiniert alle Aspekte der Produktion von Roche-Medizinen in allen Krankheitsgebieten und Dosierungsformen. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) ist integraler Bestandteil der Mission von Roche, innovative und transformative sinnvolle Arzneimittel für Patienten zu entwickeln, indem sie führende technische Expertise für die Entwicklung, Entwicklung, Versorgung und Registrierung von klinischen Stage-Produkten weltweit anwenden. Die Chance Als TDL führen Sie technische Entwicklungsteams (TDTs) dazu, Chemie, Fertigung und Control (CMC) Strategien für klinische Arzneimittelkandidaten aus frühen humanen Studien zu entwickeln und zu treiben, indem Sie die technische Integrität und proaktive Risikominderung gewährleisten.
• Führung: Führen Sie technische Teams während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der präklinischen Entwicklung bis zum Produktstart, um die wissenschaftliche Integrität der CMC-Strategie zu gewährleisten.
• Strategy & Execution: Entwirft und implementiert vielseitige technische Strategien, die Fertigungsprozesse, Produkt- und Gerätekonfigurationen und globale Lieferketten umfassen, um eine nahtlose regulatorische Genehmigung und kommerziellen Erfolg zu gewährleisten.
• Enterprise Alignment & Governance: Bietet Unternehmensperspektiven, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lieferungen geduldig und kundenorientiert bleiben; dient als primäre Verbindung zu Asset-Teams, Senior Management- und Governance-Komitees und liefert transparente Updates, die die fundierte Entscheidungsfindung erleichtern.
• Operationelle Exzellenz: Übersieht die end-to-end CMC-Entwicklung, einschließlich finanzieller Stewardship, Ressourcenprognose und Meilensteinverfolgung, um eine einwandfreie Ausführung zu gewährleisten.
• Risiko- und Entscheidungsmanagement: treibt fundierte Entscheidungsfindung für CMC-Investitionen und Risikominderungen an, entwickelt robuste Notfallpläne und kommuniziert potenzielle Auswirkungen auf relevante Führungs- und Leitungsorgane proaktiv. Wer bist du?
• Sie sind ein anerkannter Denkführer in der CMC/Produktentwicklung mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, komplexe, hochverdiente pharmazeutische Projekte zu führen.
• Ausbildung: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chemie, Pharmazeutika, Chemische Technik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Technische Expertise: Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, einschließlich eines starken Hintergrunds in der Prozessentwicklung der Biologik und CMC-Team-Führung.
• Strategisches und kritisches Denken: Fortgeschrittenes Verständnis des gesamten Drogenentwicklungsprozesses mit einer Geschichte erfolgreicher Innovation. Business acumen ist ein Plus
• Program Management: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, komplexe funktionsübergreifende Programme zu handhaben, während strategisch und proaktiv denken.
• Kommunikation & Einfluss: Außergewöhnliche Verhandlungs- und mündliche/schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit einem Überblick über die Einflussnahme von Führungskräften und Dritten. . Sind Sie bereit, einen Unterschied für unsere Patienten zu machen? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung – jetzt beitreten und Teil unserer Reise werden! Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Basel. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam über 100’000 Mitarbeiter

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Position Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) est l'organisation qui fabrique et livre des thérapies révolutionnaires à 127 millions de patients dans le monde. PT participe à la production de tous les médicaments Roche – du processus de développement jusqu'aux essais cliniques – et continue à atteindre la maturité du produit. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) fait partie intégrante de la mission de Roches de développer des médicaments innovants et transformatifs significatifs pour les patients en appliquant une expertise technique de premier plan pour concevoir, développer, fournir et enregistrer des produits de stade clinique dans le monde entier. L'opportunité En tant que TDL, vous dirigerez des équipes de développement technique (TDT) afin d'élaborer et de piloter des stratégies de chimie, de fabrication et de contrôle (CMC) pour les candidats aux médicaments cliniques, depuis les premiers essais humains jusqu'au lancement du produit, en assurant l'intégrité technique et l'atténuation proactive des risques.
• Leadership : Diriger les équipes techniques tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, du développement préclinique au lancement du produit, en assurant l'intégrité scientifique de la stratégie CMC.
• Stratégie et exécution : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies techniques multiformes - englobant les procédés de fabrication, les configurations de produits et d'appareils pharmaceutiques et les chaînes d'approvisionnement mondiales - pour assurer une approbation réglementaire et un succès commercial sans faille.
• Alignement et gouvernance de l'entreprise : offre des perspectives à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour s'assurer que les produits livrables restent axés sur le patient et le client; assure la liaison principale avec les équipes d'actifs, les cadres supérieurs et les comités de gouvernance, en fournissant des mises à jour transparentes qui facilitent la prise de décisions éclairées.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Supervise le développement de bout en bout du MCC, y compris la gérance financière, la prévision des ressources et le suivi des étapes pour assurer une exécution parfaite.
• Gestion des risques et des décisions : favorise la prise de décisions éclairées pour les investissements du MCC et l'atténuation des risques, l'élaboration de plans d'urgence robustes et la communication proactive des impacts potentiels aux organismes de leadership et de gouvernance pertinents. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un chef de file reconnu dans le développement de CMC/produit avec une capacité éprouvée de diriger des projets pharmaceutiques complexes et à fort débit.
• Éducation: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. en chimie, pharmacie, génie chimique, ou un domaine technique connexe.
• Expertise technique : vaste expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris une solide expérience dans le développement de procédés biologiques et le leadership de l'équipe du CMC.
• Pensée stratégique et critique: compréhension avancée du processus de développement complet des médicaments avec une histoire d'innovation réussie. Le sens des affaires est un atout
• Gestion des programmes : Capacité démontrée de gérer des programmes interfonctionnels complexes tout en pensant de façon stratégique et proactive.
• Communication & influence: compétences exceptionnelles en négociation et en communication verbale/écrite, avec une expérience d'influence sur la haute direction et les tiers. . Êtes-vous prêt à faire une différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et devenez partie intégrante de notre voyage! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle pourrait être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents en matière de rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés

jobs.title: PRACTICANTE DE TALLER
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Practicante de taller , te unirás a nuestro equipo técnico para aprender sobre el mantenimiento de equipos de diagnóstico médico de vanguardia . Esta es una oportunidad única para desarrollar tus habilidades técnicas en un entorno ágil, colaborativo y con un impacto real en la salud de los pacientes .

Oportunidad

• Apoyas las actividades del taller, adquiriendo conocimientos profundos sobre equipos de diagnóstico médico y procesos de gestión .

• Realizas mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos bajo la supervisión del responsable del taller .

• Colaboras con los Ingenieros de Servicio de Campo (FSE) en la instalación y puesta a punto de analizadores Roche (Cobas y Sysmex) .

• Desarrollas aplicaciones para la mejora y automatización de proyectos y actividades internas del taller .

• Gestionas el soporte documentario para los procesos de importación de repuestos y materiales operativos .

• Aseguras el cumplimiento de procedimientos administrativos técnicos, incluyendo la preparación de reportes y manejo de software CRM .

• Participas activamente en los entrenamientos técnicos y sesiones de capacitación impartidas en el taller .

• Contribuyes a la organización de materiales, reactivos y periféricos necesarios para la continuidad del servicio al cliente .

Quien eres

• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Ingeniería Electrónica, Mecatrónica, Biomédica o afines .

• Cuentas con un nivel de inglés intermedio que te permite comprender manuales técnicos .

• Posees un manejo intermedio de MS Office, con énfasis en el uso de Excel para gestión de datos .

• Te caracterizas por tu proactividad, capacidad de aprendizaje rápido y orientación al detalle .

• Eres una persona con habilidades para el trabajo en equipo y una fuerte ética profesional .

• Experiencia previa o conocimientos en gestión de laboratorios clínicos sería preferible mas no requerido.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Quote Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity to drive Quote Management initiatives and Diagnostics commercial launches . You will act as a trusted advisor to leadership and Diagnostics affiliate commercial teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and translating requirements into strategic implementation plans . Join us to lead the design of effective solutions and shape best practices within our global digital landscape .

Description of the area
The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. We are responsible for developing, globally rolling out, and continuously evolving technology solutions that enhance the experience of healthcare providers and patients. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM.

The Opportunity:

• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .

• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .

• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .

• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .

• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .

• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .

• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .

• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards .

Who you are:

• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .

• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .

• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .

• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .

• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre

jobs.title: Record to Report CRM Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Process Account receivable, treasury and inter-company task as per Service level Agreement. Process all cash application and remittance reconciliation for assigned countries accurately and within specific timescales. Prepare and follow up unidentified open items in clearing account when execute daily/monthly bank reconciliation.

• Liaise with the stakeholder for preparation and transaction posting of Inter-company non trade related debit and credit notes. Preparation of monthly reconciliation, highlight and rectify anomalies encountered. Generate statement of accounts to the customers. Track and resolve disputes and route to local affiliates as and when required

• Attend to all matters requested for accounts receivable when required. Initiate the dunning process and generate reminders for overdue accounts. Prepare regularly the details of unallocated and unidentified receipts for stakeholder further actions. Execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities for countries assigned. Manage Cash pool account reconciliation

• Prepare preliminary and final Inter-company Account Receivable balances to reconcile against counterparty balances. Ensure timely and accurate deal settlement and posting of treasury related transactions including Inter-company foreign exchange, loan, accrual and actual interest, bank charges and etc.Creation and maintenance of the customer master data records in system. Credit management – Perform and responsible for credit analysis on customer according to company credit policy and procedures. Reviewing credit risk for new and existing customers by carry out credit worthless checks and make credit limit recommendation.

• Collection management – Ensure customers pay within agreed payment terms, contacting sales team and customer on collection activities if necessary as per company’s debt collection procedure.. Demonstrated good customer service skills while initiating outbound calls and received inbound calls with customer. Handling of AR bad debt allowance and write off management. First point of contact for operational support and issue solving Liaise with customer for balance confirmation and monitoring of daily sales order status.

Who you are

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines.

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required. Participate in internal and external compliance audit queries

• Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations : Work collaboratively with Country Chief Accountant and stakeholders. Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively to identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

​

Thank you for your application. Please take note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche können Sie so sein, wie Sie sind – mit all den einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Entfaltung, offene Dialoge und aufrichtige Beziehungen. Hier werden Sie für die Person, die Sie sind, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert, sodass Sie sich persönlich und beruflich entfalten können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Mensch heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werde Teil von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position:

• Die Abstimmung des Projektportfolios mit den Kapazitäten und Fähigkeiten von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ist die Kernaufgabe

• Als Projekt-Liaison sind Sie die primäre Kontaktperson für Projekte aus Forschung und Entwicklung (REDs), Einlizensierungen sowie für lokale und globale Planungsrollen und -gremien. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern wie Synthetic Molecule Technical Development, Galenik, Regulatory und Quality gewährleisten Sie, dass die jeweiligen Projektziele abgestimmt sind.

• Sie übernehmen die Leitung für strategische Projektplanung & Machbarkeit und führen somit die langfristige strategische Planung aus, insbesondere eine 5-Jahres-Ausblicks für Betriebsanlagen und Personal, sowie Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien sowie Kapazitätsbewertungen.

• In der Rolle des Ressourcenkoordinators stimmen Sie Ressourcen in Kollaboration mit den Sektionen innerhalb von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ab und überwachen die Planung innerhalb der Abteilung.

• Sie fungieren als Fachexperte und Berater für Herstellungsprozesse und/oder -anlagen und stellen Ihr Fachwissen zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme sowie strategischer Fragestellungen bereit. Sie leiten komplexe Untersuchungen, identifizieren Ursachen und implementieren wirksame Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen.

• Als Mentor und Coach unterstützen Sie unsere Mitarbeiter bei deren kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer beruflichen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse.

• Treten Sie als treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung auf , indem Sie innovative Lösungen zur Prozessoptimierung und Produktivitätssteigerung identifizieren, Lean-Prinzipien und digitale Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Abläufe nutzen und implementieren.

• Fungieren Sie als Matrix-Lead , welcher die strategische Planung und Zielsetzung der Abteilung gestaltet und der einen starken Teamgeist und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Dringlichkeit sowie der hohen Motivation fördert, um diese Ziele zu erreichen.

Wer Sie sind:

• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Chemie oder Chemieingenieurwesen und mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Prozesschemie für synthetische Moleküle.

• Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in der chemischen Synthese, chemischen Prozesstechnologien und der Produktion in einer cGMP-Umgebung.

• Als technischer Experte verstehen Sie es, Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu motivieren und einen starken Zusammenhalt zu schaffen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

• Ihre Stärken liegen in der Zusammenarbeit: Sie pflegen ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern und navigieren geschickt durch Verhandlungen und funktionsübergreifende Projekte.

• Sie sind ein aktiver Impulsgeber für den Wandel, der eine flexible und offene Kultur für neue Möglichkeiten schafft.

• Sie sind eine treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und packen neue Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft an.

• Sie kommunizieren fliessend in Deuts

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche potete essere come siete – con tutte le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura promuove lo sviluppo personale, i dialoghi aperti e le relazioni sincere. Qui siete apprezzati, accettati e rispettati per la persona che siete, in modo che si può sviluppare personalmente e professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che ogni persona ha accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. Partecipa a DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, dove ogni voce conta. Posizione:
• Il coordinamento del portafoglio di progetti con le capacità e le capacità di DS Clinical & Commercial Supply è il compito principale
• Come collegamento di progetto, sei la persona di contatto principale per progetti di ricerca e sviluppo (RED), inizializzazione e per ruoli e organismi di pianificazione locali e globali. In collaborazione con le parti interessate interne ed esterne, come lo sviluppo tecnico sintetico Molecule, Galenik, Regolazione e Qualità, si assicura che i rispettivi obiettivi di progetto siano coordinati.
• Assumono la gestione della pianificazione strategica del progetto e della fattibilità e svolgono quindi una pianificazione strategica a lungo termine, in particolare una prospettiva di 5 anni per gli impianti e il personale, nonché studi di fattibilità e valutazioni delle capacità.
• Nel ruolo del coordinatore delle risorse, sintonizzi le risorse in collaborazione con le sezioni di DS Clinical & Commercial Supply e monitori la pianificazione all'interno del dipartimento.
• Agiscono come specialista e consulente per processi produttivi e/o impianti e forniscono la vostra esperienza nella soluzione di problemi tecnici complessi e di questioni strategiche. Conducono indagini complesse, identificano le cause e attuano misure correttive e preventive efficaci.
• Come mentore e allenatore, i nostri dipendenti sostengono il loro continuo sviluppo delle loro competenze e conoscenze professionali.
• Essere una forza trainante per il miglioramento continuo individuando soluzioni innovative per l'ottimizzazione dei processi e il miglioramento della produttività, utilizzando principi magre e implementando soluzioni digitali per migliorare i processi.
• Diventa un leader di matrice che sviluppa la pianificazione strategica e l'obiettivo del dipartimento e promuove uno spirito di squadra forte e una cultura di cooperazione, urgenza e motivazione elevata per raggiungere questi obiettivi. Chi sei:
• Hanno una laurea in chimica o ingegneria chimica e almeno 10 anni di esperienza nella chimica di processo per molecole sintetiche.
• Hanno una profonda conoscenza della sintesi chimica, delle tecnologie di processo chimico e della produzione in un ambiente cGMP.
• Come esperto tecnico, si capisce motivare i team in un'organizzazione matrice e creare una forte coesione per avere successo insieme.
• I loro punti di forza sono in cooperazione: mantengono eccellenti relazioni con gli stakeholder e navigano abilmente attraverso negoziati e progetti interfunzionali.
• Sono un impulso attivo per il cambiamento, creando una cultura flessibile e aperta per nuove opportunità.
• Sono una forza trainante per un miglioramento continuo e incontrano nuove sfide con passione.
• Comunica senza intoppi in Deuts

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. Here you will be appreciated, accepted and respected for the person you are, so that you can develop yourself personally and professionally. So we want to prevent, stop and heal diseases and ensure that every person has access to health care today and for future generations. Be part of DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, where each voice counts. Position:
• The coordination of the project portfolio with the capacities and capabilities of DS Clinical & Commercial Supply is the core task
• As a project liaison, you are the primary contact person for projects from research and development (REDs), initializations as well as for local and global planning roles and bodies. • They take over the management of strategic project planning & feasibility and thus carry out long-term strategic planning, in particular a 5-year outlook for plant and personnel, as well as feasibility studies and capacity assessments.
• In the role of the resource coordinator, you tune resources in collaboration with the sections within DS Clinical & Commercial Supply and monitor the planning within the department.
• They act as a specialist and consultant for manufacturing processes and/or plants and provide your expertise in solving complex technical problems and strategic issues. They conduct complex investigations, identify causes and implement effective corrective and preventive measures.
• As a mentor and coach, our employees support their continuous development of their professional skills and knowledge.
• Be the driving force for continuous improvement by identifying innovative solutions for process optimization and productivity enhancement, using and implementing lean principles and digital solutions to improve processes.
• Become a matrix leader who develops the strategic planning and objective of the department and promotes a strong team spirit and a culture of cooperation, urgency and high motivation to achieve these goals. Who you are:
• They have a degree in chemistry or chemical engineering and at least 10 years of experience in process chemistry for synthetic molecules. They have profound knowledge of chemical synthesis, chemical process technologies and production in a cGMP environment.
• As a technical expert, you understand motivating teams in a matrix organization and creating strong cohesion to succeed together.
• Their strengths lie in cooperation: they maintain excellent relationships with stakeholders and navigate skillfully through negotiations and cross-functional projects. They are an active impetus for change, creating a flexible and open culture for new opportunities.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position At Roche you can be as you are – with all the unique qualities you bring. Our culture promotes personal development, open dialogues and sincere relations. Here you are valued, accepted and respected for the person you are, so that you can develop yourself personally and professionally. This is how we want to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure that every person has access to healthcare today and for future generations. Be part of DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, where each voice counts. Position:
• They are the link between our operational processes and the global corporate standards. Their focus is on guaranteeing compliance with cGMP regulations, SHE guidelines and Roche principles, while also making the processes robust and efficient.
• Expertise in practice: They are the main representative of DS Clinical & Commercial Supply in the feasibility assessment and development of global requirements. They lead and support the implementation of these standards in a dynamic production environment.
• Project responsibility as a user representative: As a primary representative of our teams, you are actively involved in designing and implementing complex projects. They ensure that the results meet the expectations and needs of the organisation.
• They act as a specialist and consultant for manufacturing processes and/or plants and provide your expertise in solving complex technical problems and strategic issues. They conduct complex investigations, identify causes and implement effective corrective and preventive measures.
• As a mentor and coach, our employees support you in their continuous development of their professional skills and knowledge.
• Be a driving force for continuous improvement by identifying innovative solutions for process optimization and productivity enhancement, using lean principles and implementing digital solutions to improve processes.

• They are a driving force for continuous improvement and meet new challenges with passion.
• They communicate smoothly in German and English and convince with their excellent communication skills. Are you ready for your unique qualities at DS Cl
