jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Global Business Process Specialist - Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division.

Disclosure Note: The position is open on a fixed-term basis until 31/12/2029.

The Opportunity

• Project Management and Contribution: Drive deployment of large scale SAP S4 project, responsible for areas in and around Asset Accounting, CAPEX & Lease Accounting

• Business Process Strategy: Actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, delivers solutions including processes, technology, and analytics, and supports global business acceptance for their dedicated area.

• Business Process Design: Responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design and redesign, ensuring processes are fit for purpose, lean, and standardized.

• Business Process Governance: Manages the prioritization and implementation of change requests, ensures robust process execution, documents process requirements, and drives automation and improvements.

• Strong Business and IT Knowledge: Requires strong knowledge in both business and IT to effectively discuss and justify business requirements and assess the feasibility of technical solutions.

• Strong Stakeholder Management Skills: Needs strong skills in communication, change management, and negotiation to discuss complex topics with various stakeholders across the organization.

• Overarching Impact: Has a significant global impact on both business and IT through the design, governance, and implementation of standardized processes.

• Agile Leadership and Coaching: Has a good understanding of SAFe principles, contributes to advancing agile ways of working, assumes agile roles (e.g., product owner, scrum master), and provides guidance and coaching to other specialists and colleagues.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable field is required, along with 5-7 years of professional experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or an equivalent function.

• Technical and Process Expertise: The role demands a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, deep process knowledge, and technical expertise in areas like IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, Procurement, and various laws and regulations. Past experience as functional consultant and/or end user in asset & lease accounting i

• Project Management and Contribution: Drive deployment of large scale SAP S4 project, responsible for areas in and around Asset Accounting, CAPEX & Lease Accounting
• Business Process Strategy: Actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, delivers solutions including processes, technology, and analytics, and supports global business acceptance for their dedicated area.
• Business Process Design: Responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design and redesign, ensuring processes are fit for purpose, lean, and standardized.
• Business Process Governance: Manages the prioritization and implementation of change requests, ensures robust process execution, documents process requirements, and drives automation and improvements.

• Strong Stakeholder Management Skills: Needs strong skills in communication, change management, and negotiation to discuss complex topics with various stakeholders across the organization.
• Overarching Impact: Has a significant global impact on both business and IT through the design, governance, and implementation of standardized processes.
• Agile Leadership and Coaching: Has a good understanding of SAFe principles, contributes to advancing agile ways of working, assumes agile roles (e.g., product owner, scrum master), and provides guidance and coaching to other specialists and colleagues. • Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable field is required, along with 5-7 years of professional experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or an equivalent function.

jobs.title: Intern Digital Customer Excellence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Praktikum (m/w/d) im Team Digital Customer Excellence
Roche Pharma AG

Wer wir sind
Bei Roche leisten über 101.000 Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt.

Das Kundenerlebnis in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen, Digital-First zu denken und Omnichannel-Marketing zu leben entspricht Deinem Mindset? Wir wollen jeden Touchpoint unserer Kunden mit Roche mit einer besonders positiven Customer Experience belegen. Passt das zu Dir? Dann bist Du bei Roche und in unserem Team genau richtig. Ein umfangreicher Einarbeitungsplan hilft Dir gemeinsam mit dem Team, alle Teilbereiche von Digital Customer Excellence kennen- und verstehen zu lernen. Und dann heißt es mit Unterstützung deines Buddys aus dem Team „Learning by doing“.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Superior Customer Experience mitgestalten

• Unterstützung und Auswertung digitaler Kampagnen und Omnichannel-Kommunikation für strategische, abteilungsübergreifende Produkte

• Wissenstransfer digitaler Konzepte in die Kundeninteraktion und standortweite Implementierung

• Omnichannel-Kommunikation (Fokus Digital) erlebbar machen

• Analyse & Bewertung nutzerfreundlicher digitaler Plattformen und Kanäle

• Erarbeitung und Mitwirkung bei digitalen Kampagnen und Konzepten

• Maßnahmen mitgestalten, die einen WOW-Effekt bei unseren Kunden erzeugen und ein nachhaltiges CX-Mindset fördern

• Recherche und interne Kommunikation von Best-Practice-Beispielen zu Customer Centricity

• Content-Erstellung für deutschsprachige Kanäle; Workshop-Moderation und Ergebnisdokumentation in deutscher Sprache

Wer Du bist:
Für Dein Praktikum im Team von Digital Customer Excellence (Bezeichnung der Abteilung) bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Generelle Voraussetzung zur Beschäftigung als Praktikant/in ist die ordentliche Immatrikulation während des gesamten Praktikums oder aber das Praktikum wird innerhalb eines Gap Years absolviert, also nach dem Bachelorabschluss in Vorbereitung auf ein Masterstudium oder auf die Promotion.

• Du bist Student (m/w/d) mit den Schwerpunkten Wirtschafts- oder Naturwissenschaften, Digitales Management und/oder Gesundheitsmanagement.

• Du bist ein "Early Adopter" von neuen, digitalen Tools/Plattformen und zeichnest Dich aus durch Deine Neugierde in Bezug auf die Entwicklung und Implementierung digitaler Kommunikationsformen.

• Du verfügst über eine gute digitale Affinität sowie eine analytische Herangehensweise.

• Interesse an Marketing in der Pharmabranche und allgemeinen Fragestellungen im gesundheitspolitischen Umfeld.

• Idealerweise praktische Erfahrungen im Vertrieb oder Gesundheitsmanagement.

• Interesse an CX/UX & Content Management wünschenswert.

• Du überzeugst durch Deine kommunikative Persönlichkeit und Dein Ideenreichtum.

• Deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Dein analytisches Denken hast Du in Projekten eingesetzt und diese selbstständig vorangetrieben.

• Du bist ein Teamplayer, gibst und erhältst gerne Feedback und agierst immer mit dem Ziel, das Portfolio des Teams zu verbessern.

• Sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden D

jobs.title: Digital Content Strategist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of priorities related to content. You are responsible for supporting Roche disease area teams in translating their brand strategy into content. In addition, you work with relevant stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that all content related activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. This position has a global scope.

Your Opportunity
In the position of Digital Content Strategist in the area of Immunology/CVRM you will be focusing on:

• Aligning content strategy across disease area teams to ensure business objectives flow seamlessly through the full content supply chain

• Developing customer engagement goals and driving customer-centric content planning that solves identified business problem

• Building integrated omnichannel plans by collaborating with strategy leads, insights teams, and data analytics experts to ensure content reaches customers effectively

• Auditing and optimizing content by identifying gaps, repurposing existing assets across new channels and formats, and maximizing content value

• Fostering cross-functional collaboration across commercial, medical, corporate communications, and global teams to co-create innovative content strategies

• Measuring content performance through KPIs and A/B testing, while building a repository of best practices tailored to customer segments

• Driving continuous improvement by establishing governance principles, encouraging experimentation, and recommending enhancements to service and responsiveness for business partners

Who you are
You are an upbeat, dynamic individual who is highly involved and passionate about planning, creating and executing content strategies. As a Digital Content Strategist you are an accomplished expert, with a deep knowledge of digital content and demonstrated success executing content strategies and providing high quality enablement of customer engagement. You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You are passionate about personal growth and learning, constantly focusing on improvement of our customer's experience. You have:

• Degree in Life sciences or healthcare experience (considered as a plus) with 3–5 years digital marketing experience

• Content Development experience: Create resonant digital content across multiple channels (email, paid media, congresses)

• Rapid Learning: Quickly master disease areas, competitive landscapes, and brand-specific marketing challenges

• Strong planning, influencing, and cross-functional facilitation skill

• Fluent English; excellent presentation, customer service, and team alignment abilities

• Detail-oriented, organized, independent problem-solver; adaptable to pressure and international schedules; tech-savvy quick learner

In exchange we provide you with

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

Your Opportunity
The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines. In the position you will be focusing on:

● Managing the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.
● Incorporating feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.
● Instructing stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area
● Supporting Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication
● Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are
You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with a keen understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-
quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse stakeholders and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations. You have:

● Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
● Min 1+ years of proven experience in project management, preferably in digital marketing or content creation.
● Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management.
● Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with a track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
● Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
● Experience in coordinating and collaborating with cross-functional teams, including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders, strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
● Openness to learn project management tools and software, experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additio

jobs.title: Design Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.

Your Opportunity:
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.
In this position you will be focusing on:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• Exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• Skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)

• A global diverse community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unser Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) bietet engagierten Talenten eine besondere Gelegenheit, praktische Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie zu sammeln und gleichzeitig einen positiven Beitrag für die Welt zu leisten.

Bist Du bereit, Teil eines globalen Netzwerks in mehr als 20 Ländern zu werden, in dem kluge Köpfe gemeinsam an realen Herausforderungen in Innovation & Sustainability arbeiten? Möchtest Du an wirkungsvollen Projekten mitarbeiten, die Zukunft mitgestalten und Veränderung von innen heraus vorantreiben?

In diesem Praktikum arbeitest Du an der datenbasierten Optimierung von HVACR-Systemen, um Energieverschwendung in Gebäudebetrieben sichtbar zu machen und gezielt zu reduzieren. Du analysierst bestehende Facility-Daten von mehr als 100 Assets, identifizierst ineffiziente Betriebsweisen wie gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen oder unnötige Laufzeiten und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate erstellst Du ein Mapping der zehn energieintensivsten Assets, entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung von Ineffizienzen und erarbeitest einen priorisierten Optimierungsplan für das lokale Facility Management. Damit trägst Du direkt zur Priorität Environment in Roche’s Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie bei, insbesondere zu Climate Change und Sustainable Operations. Die Rolle bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, mit Daten sofort messbare Umweltwirkung und Kosteneinsparungen in einer komplexen Infrastruktur zu erzielen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du analysierst historische Facility-Daten, um Muster von Energieverschwendung und ineffizientem Anlagenbetrieb zu identifizieren

• Du erstellst ein Mapping und Inventar der zehn energieintensivsten Assets auf Basis von Datenmustern

• Du entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung betrieblicher Ineffizienzen, zum Beispiel für HVACR-Unstimmigkeiten oder Abweichungen von Produktionsplänen

• Du bewertest bestehende Daten nach definierten Kriterien und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale ab

• Du schlägst Anpassungen von Produktionszeiten und HVACR-Betriebszeiten vor, um unnötigen Energieverbrauch zu vermeiden

• Du quantifizierst das Einsparpotenzial jeder Maßnahme in Bezug auf Energieverbrauch, Kosten und CO₂-Fußabdruck

• Du erarbeitest einen umsetzbaren Optimierungsplan mit einer priorisierten Liste technischer Anpassungen für das lokale Facility Management

• Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf und stimmst Dich mit relevanten Stakeholdern ab

Wer Du bist

Du bist aktuell an einer Universität in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen Energiemanagement, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt HLK/Gebäudetechnik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Umwelttechnik oder Facility Management, und möchtest Dein Wissen in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld im Rahmen eines mindestens 3-monatigen Praktikums einbringen.

Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:

• Du hast Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und kannst mit größeren Datensätzen sicher arbeiten

• Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis von HVACR-Systemen und deren Zusammenspiel in industriellen oder großtechnischen Gebäuden

• Du hast ein Basisverständnis von Gebäudeautomationssystemen und davon, wie Facility-Daten erfasst und gesteuert werden

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert

• Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und verfügst über gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse

Auch wenn Du nicht alle Qualifika

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Unser Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) bietet engagierten Talenten eine besondere Gelegenheit, praktische Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie zu sammeln und gleichzeitig einen positiven Beitrag für die Welt zu leisten. Bist Du bereit, Teil eines globalen Netzwerks in mehr als 20 Ländern zu werden, in dem kluge Köpfe gemeinsam an realen Herausforderungen in Innovation & Sustainability arbeiten? Möchtest Du an wirkungsvollen Projekten mitarbeiten, die Zukunft mitgestalten und Veränderung von innen heraus vorantreiben? In diesem Praktikum arbeitest Du an der datenbasierten Optimierung von HVACR-Systemen, um Energieverschwendung in Gebäudebetrieben sichtbar zu machen und gezielt zu reduzieren. Du analysierst bestehende Facility-Daten von mehr als 100 Assets, identifizierst ineffiziente Betriebsweisen wie gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen oder unnötige Laufzeiten und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate erstellst Du ein Mapping der zehn energieintensivsten Assets, entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung von Ineffizienzen und erarbeitest einen priorisierten Optimierungsplan für das lokale Facility Management. Damit trägst Du direkt zur Priorität Environment in Roche’s Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie bei, insbesondere zu Climate Change und Sustainable Operations. Die Rolle bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, mit Daten sofort messbare Umweltwirkung und Kosteneinsparungen in einer komplexen Infrastruktur zu erzielen. Deine Aufgaben
• Du analysierst historische Facility-Daten, um Muster von Energieverschwendung und ineffizientem Anlagenbetrieb zu identifizieren
• Du erstellst ein Mapping und Inventar der zehn energieintensivsten Assets auf Basis von Datenmustern
• Du entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung betrieblicher Ineffizienzen, zum Beispiel für HVACR-Unstimmigkeiten oder Abweichungen von Produktionsplänen
• Du bewertest bestehende Daten nach definierten Kriterien und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale ab
• Du schlägst Anpassungen von Produktionszeiten und HVACR-Betriebszeiten vor, um unnötigen Energieverbrauch zu vermeiden
• Du quantifizierst das Einsparpotenzial jeder Maßnahme in Bezug auf Energieverbrauch, Kosten und CO₂-Fußabdruck
• Du erarbeitest einen umsetzbaren Optimierungsplan mit einer priorisierten Liste technischer Anpassungen für das lokale Facility Management
• Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf und stimmst Dich mit relevanten Stakeholdern ab Wer Du bist Du bist aktuell an einer Universität in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen Energiemanagement, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt HLK/Gebäudetechnik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Umwelttechnik oder Facility Management, und möchtest Dein Wissen in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld im Rahmen eines mindestens 3-monatigen Praktikums einbringen. Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:
• Du hast Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und kannst mit größeren Datensätzen sicher arbeiten
• Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis von HVACR-Systemen und deren Zusammenspiel in industriellen oder großtechnischen Gebäuden
• Du hast ein Basisverständnis von Gebäudeautomationssystemen und davon, wie Facility-Daten erfasst und gesteuert werden
• Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert
• Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und verfügst über gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse Auch wenn Du nicht alle Qualifika

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Localisation idéale : Bretagne.

Missions
Vous serez en charge de la réalisation des installations (& désinstallation) , des maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives sur l’ensemble du portefeuille de nos systèmes analytiques et pré-post analytiques pour la filiale Roche Diagnostics France.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous validez les installations techniques simples et gérez les déménagements

• Vous gérer les pré-installations et installations techniques

• Vous assurez les maintenances préventives et curatives

• Vous effectuez les désinstallations

• Vous réalisez les rétrofits hardware/software des systèmes

• Vous assurez un reporting exact de votre activité, maitrisez les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent votre activité et êtes responsable de la mise à niveau de vos connaissances.

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation technique en électronique ou électricité et/ou licence biomédicale

• Bonne maitrise technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)

• Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic dans l'idéal, ou vous possédez une forte appétence pour ce domaine.

• Vous avez une bonne aisance relationnelle, une attitude positive, l’esprit d'équipe et un très bon sens du service client

• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de ponctualité

• Bon niveau d’anglais technique requis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Entwicklung

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, das Dir die Möglichkeit bietet, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich zu wachsen? Möchtest Du Deine theoretischen Kenntnisse in einem praxisorientierten Umfeld anwenden und in einem spannenden Bereich mit deutschlandweiter Bedeutung tätig werden? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und profitiere von individueller Betreuung und regelmäßigem Feedback, um Dein Potenzial voll auszuschöpfen. In deinem Praktikum wirst du direkt an den Head of Mobility Management berichten.

Über uns

Mobility - nachhaltig, rentabel und attraktiv. Als Mobility Management-Gruppe sind wir verantwortlich für die Mobilität unserer ca. 20.000 Roche Mitarbeiter. Digitale Mobilitätsplattformen, Flugreisen, Deutsche Bahn, ÖPNV, Fahrräder, Elektroautos und zukünftig auch Transporter fürs Beamen? Mit unseren drei Fachbereichen: Travel Management Roche Deutschland, Fleet Management für Mannheim, Penzberg und Ludwigsburg sowie Mobility Site Services in Mannheim und Penzberg gestalten wir die Zukunft der Mobilität. Wir suchen motivierte Talente wie dich, die mit uns auf diese aufregende Reise gehen.

Deine Aufgaben: Vielfältig und spannend!

• Du übernimmst die Durchführung von (Teil-)Projekten, darunter die Optimierung von Prozessen mit Tools wie bspw. Lucid Charts

• Du interviewst verschiedene Stakeholder um stets den Ist-Zustand des Prozesses adäquat darzustellen

• Du führst Prozessmappings in Tools wie bspw. Lucid Chart aus

• Du stellst Business Cases auf und bewertest verschiedene Optionen um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen

• Durch deine kreative Ader unterstützt du uns mit deinen Ideen für unsere Werbekanäle und bei der ansprechenden Gestaltung von Präsentationen

• Du unterstützt uns im Team dabei, effektiv zu arbeiten durch bspw. die Organisation in unserem G-Drive

Wer bist du?

• Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ähnliches oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium

• Du überzeugst mit einer analytischen Herangehensweise, hinterfragst konventionelle Denkmuster und verfügst über ein hohes Maß an Eigenständigkeit und Koordinationsfähigkeit

• Du hast dich bereits Prozessoptimierung auseinandergesetzt und ein Talent für das Strukturieren und Gestalten von Informationen

• Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Planungs- und Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige und eigeninitiative Arbeitsweise und deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hilft Dir dabei, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu verstehen und umzusetzen.

• Du hast Routine im Umgang mit dem MS / Google-Office-Paket: Unsere Arbeit basiert hauptsächlich auf Google-Tools wie G-Sheets und G-Slides. Vorkenntnisse sind daher ein Plus, aber mit Excel- oder PowerPoint-Erfahrung wirst Du Dich schnell einfinden.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- (C-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B-Niveau) runden Dein Profil ab.

Rahmendaten und Vorteile

• Dauer: 6 Monate Vollzeit (37,5h/Woche)

• 2268€ Vergütung im Monat

• Das Praktikum ist im Rahmen von “Mobile Work” auch zum Teil von zuhause möglich

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50,0 %) in unseren Mitarbeiterkantinen

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden sowohl in unserem Team als auch darüber hinaus!

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus: Mit dem Roche Aktiv-Center in Mannheim bietet Roche vielfältige Angebote zur Gesundheitsförderung

• Nut

jobs.title: Ingénieur Service et Maintenance - Touraine (d/f/m)

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di servizio e manutenzione - Touraine (d/f/m)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Localisation idéale : Touraine.

Missions
Vous serez en charge de la réalisation des installations (& désinstallation) , des maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives sur l’ensemble du portefeuille de nos systèmes analytiques et pré-post analytiques pour la filiale Roche Diagnostics France.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous validez les installations techniques simples et gérez les déménagements

• Vous gérer les pré-installations et installations techniques

• Vous assurez les maintenances préventives et curatives

• Vous effectuez les désinstallations

• Vous réalisez les rétrofits hardware/software des systèmes

• Vous assurez un reporting exact de votre activité, maitrisez les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent votre activité et êtes responsable de la mise à niveau de vos connaissances.

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation technique en électronique ou électricité et/ou licence biomédicale

• Bonne maitrise technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)

• Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic dans l'idéal, ou vous possédez une forte appétence pour ce domaine.

• Vous avez une bonne aisance relationnelle, une attitude positive, l’esprit d'équipe et un très bon sens du service client

• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de ponctualité

• Bon niveau d’anglais technique requis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Decision Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe that data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of innovation. As a Decision Analytics Consultant , you won’t just be analyzing requirements; you will be a trusted advisor and a strategic bridge between complex technical landscapes and business outcomes.
You will lead end-to-end business analysis workstreams, leveraging advanced analytics and statistical modeling to tackle ambiguity and transform complex clinical or operational data into actionable insights. Your mission is to ensure that every solution we build provides demonstrable value to our patients and our organization.

Your Impact & Responsibilities

• Strategic Advisory & Leadership: Independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams. You will act as a consultant to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and aligning project goals with long-term solution roadmaps.

• Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret complex datasets (quantitative and qualitative) to inform product and UX decisions; Experience translating user behavior, metrics, and feedback into actionable insight; Proficiency in tools such as SQL, Excel, or Tableau

• Solution Design & Product Development: Translate complex business requirements into strategic implementation plans. You will design data products (datasets, KPI frameworks) and evaluate vendor solutions to ensure they meet our technical and business standards.

• User Behavior & Experience Analysis: Strong capability to analyze user journeys, pain points, and interaction patterns; Experience with usability testing, A/B testing, and heuristic evaluations; Familiarity with UX research tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, or Mixpanel

• Requirements Elicitation & Problem Structuring: Expertise in breaking down ambiguous business problems into structured requirements and hypotheses; Ability to synthesize stakeholder needs, technical constraints, and user expectations into clear functional and non-functional requirements; Skilled in creating user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows

• Process Excellence & Mentorship: As a senior member of our Community of Practice, you will mentor junior and intermediate BAs, proactively shaping our methodologies and driving continuous improvement in our operational workflows.

• Technical Integrity: Drive the analysis and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability, maintaining a focus on data governance and change management.

Who You Are
You are someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves tackling "gray areas," and is passionate about the intersection of technology and human health. You bring structure to chaos and are a natural communicator.
Qualifications & Experience:

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Consultancy, with at least 3+ years within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in one of the following fields - Information Systems / Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration (with a focus on IT, Analytics, or Operations), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) or UX-related discipline, Data Analytics / Data Science. Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in - MBA (Information Systems or Product Management focus), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI),Data Analytics / Business Analytics is highly desirable.

• Analytical Mastery: SQL, BI tools (Tableau/Power BI), UX analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Mixpanel), and collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence). Familiarity

jobs.title: Facilities Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you organized, detail-oriented, and energized by keeping complex operations running smoothly? Roche is seeking a Facilities Specialist to serve as a key contributor to our facilities management team. You'll coordinate maintenance, manage SAP systems, supervise contractors, and be the trusted liaison between our internal customers and facilities services. If you have SAP Plant Maintenance expertise, strong customer service skills, and thrive in regulated environments, this role offers the perfect blend of technical and interpersonal challenge.

The Opportunity
Essential Job Functions & Major Contributions

• Coordinates facility repair and maintenance frequently involving the supervision of contractors. Inspects completed work for quality, compliance with local procedures and documentation for final approval. Primary liaison between internal customers and facilities management for unscheduled maintenance and projects, local personnel and equipment relocations, and small projects.

• Coordinates and supervises various contracted maintenance services that includes but is not limited to mechanical, plumbing and electrical equipment and systems. Assesses service provider performance at least annually.

• Primary or back-up SAP Plant Maintenance coordinator, adding equipment master records, functional locations, setting up maintenance plans and general equipment task lists, generating and tracking PM and maintenance orders, documenting order completion, and auditing of maintenance records and reports to ensure regulatory compliance of the maintenance program. Generates CMMS reports based on gathered metrics.

• Assist with delegating repair/service tickets to the Facilities Team

• Assists with handles invoices for review, approval, payment, and filing. Acts as the primary liaison GenMark Facilities group, service providers and Accounts Payable.

• Responsible for collection and prompt reporting of any customer service-related issues directly to the Facilities Manager or Director. Responsibilities may include preparing, tabulating, and analyzing customer satisfaction surveys related to any or all of the wide array of service provided by the group through ServiceNow.

• Support O&M technical leads, which may include periodically performing daily rounds and on-call services

• Maintains GMP SOPs and non-GMP Facilities documents

• Trained to input SOP Change Requests

• Other tasks delegated to by the Manager

Who You Are
Education & Experience

• Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, etc.

• Minimum 2 years working experience with SAP Plant Maintenance Module software and knowledge of Archibus

• Minimum 4 years’ experience working in a customer service intensive role and /or facilities maintenance planning

• Exceptional customer service skills

• Experience working in an ISO and FDA regulated environment.

• Advanced computer skills - e.g., MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Google Workspace

Preferred:

• Technical/trade school specializing in electrical, plumbing or mechanical systems.

• Thorough expertise using SAP Plant Maintenance Module software, Archibus, and ServiceNow

• 6 or more years’ experience working in a relevant Facilities Management and Planning position

• Experience working with Monday.com

This position is not eligible for relocation.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $66,900 - $124,200 USD Annual. Act

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor (Kottayam)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager (Individual Contributor) based in Kottayam , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Kottayam territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Kottayam territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.title: RWD Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Strategic planning
● Shape and influence strategy for complex evidence generation deliveries and cross-functional projects
● Lead and/or support evidence generation strategy/plan setting up as critical component of local integrated evidence plan for multiple portfolio and pipeline products across therapeutic areas
● Provide epidemiological inputs with solid understanding of strategic business context in the medical planning process across therapeutic areas
Implementation
● Lead the RWD project/studies design, analyses and interpretation.
● Map / license RWD sources and build research collaborations to increase the availability of fit - for - purpose RWD.
● Implement the RWE plan and execute RWE projects timely in close collaboration with cross - functional partners.
● Identify and implement scientifically innovative RWE programs that can support to address business needs and overcome key challenges in drug development using RWD or enable to provide meaningful RWE in support of regulatory decision making (e.g. label changes, new indications), payer decision making and clinical practice.
Communication
● Build strong partnerships and opportunities to collaborate and innovate with varying internal and external stakeholders in support of Roche products, programs, processes, systems, and/or compliance
● Communicate scientifically and develop/maintain KOL network in medical/clinical community to ensure appropriate academic consultation/support and address the varying evidence requirements of stakeholders
● Lead the development of new and innovative partnerships with external stakeholders across healthcare ecosystems to co - design and execute innovative study designs and implementation science that address pre identified evidence needs.
Development
● Act as a coach, mentor or consult to provide technical expertise on the RWE/epidemiology basics and internal/external trainings.
● Serve as franchise / division level RWE lead to ensure a broad understanding of the value of RWE to the product value demonstration both locally and globally.
● Maintain process standards across the therapeutic areas according to Roche SOPs, China CDE requirements and GPP guidelines with regard to pharmacoepidemiology

Qualification and Experience
● Education/Qualifications
- Master degree or above in the epidemiology, biostatistics, public health or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in designing, implementation and report of epidemiology/observational studies
- Working experiences as real world data scientist/epidemiologist in multinational pharmaceutical company or Clinical Research Organization, experience in oncology studies will be plus
● Leadership Competencies
Ability to work effectively in a matrix team
● Job Required Competencies
- Expert knowledge of epidemiology/observational methodologies and applications
- Previous experience as a key RWD scientist or lead epidemiologist
- Good knowledge of statistical programming skill (including SAS programming)
- Strong communication skills and ability to work both, independently and collaboratively, as required
- Demonstrated project management skills is strongly preferred
- Business acumen
- Be able to handle technical discussion in fluent English

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to health

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案

• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈

• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理

• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Praktikum im Project Portfolio Management mit Schwerpunkt IT-Architektur & KI-Anwendungen (m/w/d)

Möchten Sie die Zukunft des Project Portfolio Managements mitgestalten und innovative KI-Lösungen entwickeln? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!

Wer wir sind:
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg (DOZ) ist der zweitgrößte Produktionsstandort innerhalb Roche Global Operations und Rohstofflieferant für die gesamte Diagnostics Division. Als führender Hersteller für biologische und chemische Einsatzstoffe ist DOZ ein wichtiger Knotenpunkt im weltweiten Roche Netzwerk.

Wir suchen eine/n engagierte/n und motivierte/n Praktikanten/in, die/der unser Team im Bereich Project Portfolio Management (PPM) verstärkt. In dieser spannenden Rolle arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen IT-Architektur und der Implementierung von Künstlicher Intelligenz, um unsere Projektmanagementprozesse zu optimieren und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Wenn Sie begeistert vom Projektmanagement und der Steuerung eines großen Projektportfolios sind, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung einer zukunftsweisenden IT-Architektur für das Project Portfolio Management: Sie helfen uns dabei, eine skalierbare und effiziente Architektur zu konzipieren, die den Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Projektlandschaft gerecht wird.

• Identifizierung und Evaluierung von Potenzialen für den Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen im PPM: Sie recherchieren und bewerten innovative KI-Lösungen, die zur Verbesserung von Prognosen, Ressourcenplanung, Risikomanagement und Entscheidungsfindung im Projektportfolio eingesetzt werden können.

• Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) für ausgewählte KI-Anwendungen: Sie sind aktiv an der Umsetzung erster Prototypen beteiligt, um die Machbarkeit und den Mehrwert von KI-basierten Lösungen zu demonstrieren.

• Analyse von Projektmanagement-Daten zur Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen: Sie unterstützen uns bei der Datenanalyse, um Engpässe und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in unseren bestehenden PPM-Prozessen zu identifizieren.

• Dokumentation von Prozessen, Architekturen und Best Practices: Sie tragen zur Erstellung und Pflege relevanter Dokumentationen bei, um Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung des Teams im Tagesgeschäft des Project Portfolio Managements: Sie erhalten Einblicke in die täglichen Abläufe und unterstützen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Ihr Profil:

• Immatrikulierte/r Student/in der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.

• Hohe Motivation, Lernbereitschaft und Leidenschaft für Prozessoptimierung .

• Begeisterung für Projektmanagement oder erste Berührungspunkte mit Projekt- oder Portfoliomanagement.

• Interesse an IT-Architektur und Faszination für KI sowie Bereitschaft, sich in neue Technologien

• Analytische, problemlösungsorientierte Denkweise und der Wunsch, Herausforderungen aktiv anzunehmen .

• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, gute Kommunikation und Teamgeist.

• Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Einblicke in die spannende Welt des Project Portfolio Managements und der KI-Entwicklung in einem d

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：（高级）治疗领域专员

您是谁：
（高级）治疗领域专员是公司与相应疾病领域医生的主要接触点,发掘和管理内外部资源,通过各种学术活动、推广或非推广活动把罗氏的专业知识、科学和技术、产品关键信息带入生态系统,准确及时的传达给客户,并与客户和合作伙伴共同发现潜在的合作机会,以改善对患者旅程的影响,实现患者最终获益。

您的机会：
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士(HCP)观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

计划管理
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2.了解医生观念、需求、会议安排;制定会议及覆盖计划;执行会议计划;回访收集反馈

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变,实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作,关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
•3 年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Luxembourg
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Belgium & Luxembourg is seeking an individual to join the Customer Engagement Chapter as a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) for LUXEMBOURG (GDL) to drive value for patients, the ecosystem and Roche. In this role, you'll generate actionable customer insights and position Roche’s products to deliver better patient outcomes.

We are offering an incredible opportunity for an experienced, strategic and patient-centric professional to join our team as a Patient Journey Partner in Oncology. This is a field-based role where you will actively engage with stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to generate insights and position Roche’s products to drive value for patients, healthcare professionals and Roche.

If you are passionate about patient care, reaching ambitious goals and being at the heart of innovation in healthcare, join us to make a meaningful impact !

Your impact

As a PJP in Oncology for LUXEMBOURG, you will be the catalyst for change in the oncology patient journey, bridging the gap between Roche’s innovative treatments and the evolving needs of patients and healthcare professionals.

Your key responsibilities:

• Gather and share stakeholder insights and advocate the appropriate use of Roche’s products

• Influence strategy and tactical omnichannel engagement plans based on customer insights

• Ensure compliance with the Roche Code of Conduct and local regulations

Who you are
Mindset :

• Competitive mindset, embracing an entrepreneurial spirit, we seize opportunities, adapt swiftly and continuously improve to achieve commercial excellence with pride in who we are.

• Collaboration mindset, which shows valorisation of diverse perspectives and mutual respect while challenging each other and leveraging complementary skills with clear accountability.

• Customer-Centric mindset, putting customers and the patients at the heart of everything we do, and at the core of our strategic decision making.

• Curiosity mindset, being intentional learners fueled by curiosity to grow and adapt. We take purposeful actions to drive meaningful change aligned with Roche business outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills & Qualifications :

• Deep understanding of patient journeys and treatments in oncology

• Broad understanding of Roche's portfolio

• Strong communication and consultative persuasion skills

• Excellent stakeholder engagement and partnership abilities

• Fluent in French and proficient in English

• Connections and knowledge of the market in LUXEMBOURG

• Display integrity in everything they do

We expect you to live close to or in Luxembourg (GDL).

Why Roche ?

We are an open and inclusive organization undergoing continuous development. This creates an exciting dynamic full of opportunities. We invest in the growth and development of our colleagues, including you. We do not define your career path; instead, we recognize that it varies for each individual. We encourage you to actively shape your development, and we will support and guide you in this journey.

Discover more about Roche in Belgium and follow us on LinkedIn .

What we offer

• A dynamic and market-leading company with national and international opportunities

• A great place to work, have fun, and make a meaningful impact on patient lives

• A people-centered agile work environment where autonomy and decision-making are valued

• A culture of diversity and inclusion, where you can be your authentic self

• Opportunities for personal and professional development

Who we are
A healthier future drive

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: ERP ALM Solution Architect - Cloud ALM Transition & Custom Systems

titleByLocale.it: ERP ALM Solution Architetto - Cloud ALM Transition & Custom Systems
titleByLocale.en: ERP ALM Solution Architect - Cloud ALM Transition & Custom Systems
titleByLocale.de: ERP ALM Solution Architect - Cloud ALM Transition & Custom Systems
titleByLocale.fr: ERP ALM Solution Architect - Cloud ALM Transition & Custom Systems

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.

Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:

Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.

Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.

Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.

Qualifications

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.

• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.

• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings

• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.

• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.

• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders

• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ
