jobs.title: Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Analytics and Workflows group within the Center of Excellence (CoE) is dedicated to turning complex data into actionable insights that advance drug discovery and development. We leverage cutting-edge high-throughput technologies and foundational multimodal machine learning models to analyze large-scale chemical and biological data, enabling deeper understanding of molecular behavior and the identification of novel therapeutic opportunities. Despite advances in these fields, however, transforming raw data and computational models into meaningful insights remains a key challenge. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of data science, medicinal chemistry, and engineering to build innovative analytical tools that bridge the gap between data generation and interpretation, helping unlock new avenues for scientific discovery and impact.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) to design and build interactive tools for small-molecule drug discovery, with a particular focus on chemical data, molecular design workflows, and model interpretability. You will shape the technical and product direction of platforms that enable medicinal and computational chemists to explore data, test hypotheses, and design better drugs. This role is fullstack, with a strong emphasis on scientific data visualization, workflow design, and integration with computational pipelines. Success will be measured not only by technical delivery, but by the impact on how scientists design and evaluate small-molecule candidates. Your work will include:

• Partnering directly with medicinal chemists, cheminformaticians, and AI scientists to understand real-world molecular design and analysis workflows, including ambiguous or evolving needs.

• Designing and building end-to-end platforms—spanning front-end interfaces, backend services, and data integrations—that enable scientists to run analyses, explore data, and interpret model outputs.

• Leading the development of intuitive, extensible user experiences for complex scientific workflows, with a focus on interactive visualization, usability, and scientific fidelity.

• Architecting and implementing APIs, data models, and services that support scalable, data-intensive applications, including integration with computational pipelines and machine learning systems.

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies (including AI-assisted development tools) to accelerate iteration, while exploring new approaches to scient

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il gruppo di analisi e flussi di lavoro all'interno del Centro di eccellenza (CoE) è dedicato a trasformare i dati complessi in insight attuabili che anticipano la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Ci avvaliamo di tecnologie all'avanguardia ad alto rendimento e modelli di machine learning multimodali fondamentali per analizzare i dati chimici e biologici su larga scala, consentendo una comprensione più approfondita del comportamento molecolare e l'identificazione di nuove opportunità terapeutiche. Nonostante i progressi in questi campi, tuttavia, la trasformazione dei dati grezzi e dei modelli computazionali in insight significativi rimane una sfida chiave. In questo ruolo, lavorerai all'intersezione della scienza dei dati, della chimica medica e dell'ingegneria per costruire strumenti analitici innovativi che colmano il divario tra la generazione dei dati e l'interpretazione, aiutando a sbloccare nuovi viali per la scoperta scientifica e l'impatto. L'opportunità Stiamo cercando un Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) per progettare e costruire strumenti interattivi per la scoperta della droga di piccole molecole, con una particolare attenzione ai dati chimici, ai flussi di lavoro di progettazione molecolare e all'interpretazione del modello. Potrai modellare la direzione tecnica e del prodotto di piattaforme che permettono ai chimici medicinali e computazionali di esplorare i dati, le ipotesi di test e progettare farmaci migliori. Questo ruolo è fullstack, con una forte enfasi sulla visualizzazione dei dati scientifici, la progettazione del flusso di lavoro e l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali. Il successo sarà misurato non solo dalla consegna tecnica, ma dall'impatto su come gli scienziati progettano e valutano i candidati alla piccola molecola. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà:
• Collaborare direttamente con chimici medicinali, cheminformatici e scienziati dell'IA per comprendere i flussi di lavoro di progettazione e analisi molecolari del mondo reale, comprese le esigenze ambigue o in evoluzione.
• Progettazione e costruzione di piattaforme end-to-end: interfaccia front-end, servizi backend e integrazioni dei dati, che permettono agli scienziati di eseguire analisi, esplorare i dati e interpretare le uscite dei modelli.
• Conducendo lo sviluppo di esperienze utente intuitive ed estensibili per complessi flussi di lavoro scientifici, con un focus sulla visualizzazione interattiva, l'usabilità e la fedeltà scientifica.
• Architettare e implementare API, modelli di dati e servizi che supportano applicazioni scalabili, ad alta intensità di dati, tra cui l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali e sistemi di machine learning.
• Valutazione e applicazione delle tecnologie emergenti (inclusi gli strumenti di sviluppo assistiti dall'IA) per accelerare l'iterazione, esplorando nuovi approcci allo scient

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerischen Wissenschaften verwandeln die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das neue Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, diese transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern in pRED und GRED zu helfen, innovativere und transformative Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Die Gruppe Analytics und Workflows im Center of Excellence (CoE) widmet sich dem Umsetzen komplexer Daten in handlungsfähige Erkenntnisse, die die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Medikamenten vorantreiben. Wir nutzen modernste High-Throughput-Technologien und grundlegende multimodale maschinelle Lernmodelle, um groß angelegte chemische und biologische Daten zu analysieren, um ein tieferes Verständnis des molekularen Verhaltens und die Identifizierung neuer therapeutischer Möglichkeiten zu ermöglichen. Trotz Fortschritten in diesen Bereichen bleibt jedoch die Umwandlung von Rohdaten und Rechenmodellen in sinnvolle Erkenntnisse eine zentrale Herausforderung. In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Datenwissenschaft, medizinischer Chemie und Ingenieurwissenschaften, um innovative analytische Werkzeuge zu bauen, die die Lücke zwischen Datenerzeugung und Interpretation überbrücken und neue Wege für wissenschaftliche Entdeckung und Wirkung entsperren. Die Chance Wir suchen einen Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack), um interaktive Werkzeuge für die Entdeckung von Kleinmolekülen zu entwerfen und zu bauen, mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf chemischen Daten, molekularen Design-Workflows und Modellinterpretationsfähigkeit. Sie werden die technische und Produktrichtung von Plattformen prägen, die es medizinischen und rechnerischen Chemikern ermöglichen, Daten zu erforschen, Hypothesen zu testen und bessere Medikamente zu entwickeln. Diese Rolle steht in vollem Zusammenhang mit der wissenschaftlichen Datenvisualisierung, dem Workflow-Design und der Integration mit rechnerischen Pipelines. Der Erfolg wird nicht nur durch technische Lieferung gemessen, sondern durch die Auswirkungen auf die Gestaltung und Bewertung von Kleinmolekülkandidaten. Ihre Arbeit beinhaltet:
• direkt mit medizinischen Chemikern, Cheminformatikern und KI-Wissenschaftlern zusammenarbeiten, um reale molekulare Design- und Analyse-Workflows zu verstehen, einschließlich mehrdeutiger oder sich entwickelnder Bedürfnisse.
• Entwicklung und Aufbau von End-to-End-Plattformen – die sich über Frontend-Schnittstellen, Backend-Dienste und Datenintegrationen erstrecken – die es Wissenschaftlern ermöglichen, Analysen durchzuführen, Daten zu erforschen und Modellausgänge zu interpretieren.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung intuitiver, erweiterbarer Benutzererlebnisse für komplexe wissenschaftliche Workflows, mit Fokus auf interaktive Visualisierung, Usability und wissenschaftliche Treue.
• Erstellung und Implementierung von APIs, Datenmodellen und Dienstleistungen, die skalierbare, datenintensive Anwendungen unterstützen, einschließlich der Integration mit rechnerischen Pipelines und maschinellen Lernsystemen.
• Bewertung und Anwendung von aufstrebenden Technologien (einschließlich AI-gestützter Entwicklungstools) zur Beschleunigung der Iteration und Erkundung neuer Ansätze für Scient
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès dans l'IA, les données et les sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organisations de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, en tirant parti des données et des nouveaux modèles de calcul pour stimuler l'impact. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le nouveau Centre d'Excellence des Sciences Computationnelles (CdE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est de tirer parti de cette puissance transformatrice de données et d'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques en pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et transformatifs pour les patients du monde entier. Le groupe Analytics and Workflows au sein du Centre d'excellence (CdE) se consacre à transformer des données complexes en idées concrètes qui favorisent la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Nous mettons à profit des technologies de pointe à haut débit et des modèles d'apprentissage de machines multimodales fondamentales pour analyser les données chimiques et biologiques à grande échelle, permettant une meilleure compréhension du comportement moléculaire et l'identification de nouvelles opportunités thérapeutiques. Toutefois, malgré les progrès réalisés dans ces domaines, la transformation des données brutes et des modèles de calcul en données probantes demeure un défi majeur. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez à l'intersection de la science des données, de la chimie médicinale et de l'ingénierie pour construire des outils analytiques novateurs qui comblent l'écart entre la production de données et l'interprétation, aidant à débloquer de nouvelles pistes de découverte scientifique et d'impact. L'opportunité Nous cherchons un ingénieur scientifique principal (Fullstack) pour concevoir et construire des outils interactifs pour la découverte de médicaments à petites molécules, en mettant l'accent sur les données chimiques, les workflows de conception moléculaire et l'interprétation des modèles. Vous façonnerez la direction technique et produit des plates-formes qui permettent aux chimistes médicaux et calculateurs d'explorer les données, de tester les hypothèses et de concevoir de meilleurs médicaments. Ce rôle est complet, l'accent étant mis sur la visualisation des données scientifiques, la conception des flux de travail et l'intégration avec les pipelines informatiques. Le succès sera mesuré non seulement par l'exécution technique, mais aussi par l'impact sur la façon dont les scientifiques conçoivent et évaluent les candidats aux petites molécules. Votre travail comprendra :
• Établir des partenariats directs avec des chimistes, des chimistes et des scientifiques de l'IA pour comprendre les processus de conception moléculaire et d'analyse du monde réel, y compris les besoins ambigus ou en évolution.
• Concevoir et construire des plates-formes de bout en bout, des interfaces front-end, des services de backend et des intégrations de données, qui permettent aux scientifiques d'effectuer des analyses, d'explorer des données et d'interpréter les résultats des modèles.
• Diriger le développement d'expériences utilisateur intuitives et extensibles pour des workflows scientifiques complexes, en mettant l'accent sur la visualisation interactive, la convivialité et la fidélité scientifique.
• Architecte et mise en œuvre d'API, de modèles de données et de services qui prennent en charge des applications évolutives et à forte intensité de données, y compris l'intégration avec des pipelines de calcul et des systèmes d'apprentissage automatique.
• Évaluer et appliquer les nouvelles technologies (y compris les outils de développement assistés par l'IA) pour accélérer l'itération, tout en explorant de nouvelles approches de la science

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Data Center Network Engineer (d/f/m)
Introduction At Roche, we believe that every voice matters, and we invite you to bring your unique perspective to our team. As a Senior Data Center Network Engineer, you will join a culture of technical excellence, architecting resilient, high-performance infrastructures that empower our global mission. You will act as a technical expert, leveraging advanced automation to solve critical business challenges and drive our digital evolution.
The Opportunity:

• Architect Scalable Networks: Lead the end-to-end design and deployment of "first-time-right" network solutions, specifically focusing on Spine-Leaf topologies and L2/L3 fabrics.

• Drive Technical Leadership: Act as a Solution Architect for large initiatives, managing resource estimation, dependencies, and risk mitigation across technical teams.

• Implement Network as Code: Modernize operations by developing and maintaining Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, repeatable deployments.

• Master Complex Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose complex network incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

• Maximize System Reliability: Define and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) through advanced telemetry and streaming analytics to ensure "five-nines" availability.

• Influence Strategic Roadmaps: Translate technical roadmaps into business value for stakeholders and steer vendor product evaluations to align with long-term strategy.

• Lead Seamless Migrations: Oversee high-stakes brownfield-to-greenfield migrations with a focus on hitless cutovers and zero-downtime execution.

• Foster Innovation and Growth: Proactively refine fabric performance and mentor junior engineers, contributing to a workplace culture of continuous learning.

Who you are:

• Experienced Architect: You bring deep mastery of Arista EOS and EVPN-VXLAN architectures, with a proven track record of designing large-scale fabrics.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and bring years of relevant industry experience; CCIE-level expertise is highly desirable.

• Automation Expert: You are proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), specifically using Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines for network automation.

• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to translate complex system concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Resilient Problem Solver: You demonstrate expert-level troubleshooting skills and remain decisive in high-pressure, complex technical scenarios.

• Project Leader: You have significant experience leading technical teams through complex project dependencies and risk management.

• Visionary Engineer: You are a proactive learner who stays ahead of industry trends to maintain architectural excellence in modern fabric environments.

Call to Action: Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the role

Are you a tech enthusiast eager to bridge the gap between traditional Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join our development squads.
In this role, you will be part of the team designing cutting-edge solutions for the future Core Laboratory. Your mission will be to help the department explore and implement AI use cases, directly contributing to projects that impact patient lives while developing your skills in a professional, high-tech environment.

Main responsibilities

• AI Integration: Participate in initiatives to explore, prototype, and implement AI-driven features within our software ecosystem.

• Development: Support the squad in developing software components using C# and .NET , while leveraging Python for AI-specific implementations.

• Modern Tooling: Work with cutting-edge developer tools like GitHub Copilot and contribute to integrations with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers .

• Collaboration: Work within an Agile squad, participating in ceremonies (Daily, Sprint Planning) and contributing to the team's goals.

• Quality: Produce clean, maintainable code and participate in testing activities to ensure the reliability of our medical instrumentation software.

How would your day-to-day look like?

You will start your day synced with your squad, discussing progress and tackling challenges. Under the guidance of an assigned mentor , you will transition from your initial onboarding to making real contributions to our codebase. You will spend part of your time investigating how AI can optimize our projects and the other part implementing those solutions within our C#/.NET architecture. It is a balance of autonomous learning, creative exploration of AI, and structured teamwork.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link.

Who we are

jobs.title: Medical Director - CVM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

•
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ESPERIENZA E QUALIFICA:
• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• • M.D. richiesto
• Conoscenze terapeutiche all’interno del metabolismo, dell’obesità e del diabete con un’esperienza clinica, scientifica e clinica di sperimentazione/sviluppo necessaria
• Lo sfondo accademico/insegnante è un plus
• Esperienza di lavoro con i principi e le tecniche di analisi, interpretazione e rilevanza clinica
• Esperienza risultati editoriali di uno studio scientifico in una rivista peer-reviewed è preferito
• Normativa: La conoscenza degli aspetti medici di GCP (buona pratica clinica), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolamenti pertinenti è preferito
• Durata dell'esperienza: 2 o più anni di esperienza accademica o clinica post-laurea
• Fino al 30% di viaggio globale Abilità e comportamenti chiave
• Etica: ha un'etica impeccabile. Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche
• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
• Business Acumen: Ha la conoscenza del settore farmaceutico/biotecnico, le molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga. Regolarmente conduce lo sviluppo di strategie e piani di malattia
• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, sul bersaglio e nel budget
• Competenze interpersonali: buona comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenza: può influenzare senza autorità
• Scrittura: Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta
• Capacità di presentazione: Buone capacità di presentazione aziendale; è comodo ed efficace quando si presenta ad altri, internamente o esternamente. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo
• Competenze di negoziazione: Buone competenze di negoziazione: sa come completare i materiali di consegna lavorando efficacemente con altri internamente ed esternamente
• Decision Making: Sa come prendere decisioni di compromesso, bilanciando etica ed efficacia
• Lavoro di squadra: forte orientamento al lavoro di squadra DUTI SPECIFICHE E RESPONSABILITÀ: Strategia e pianificazione CDP
• Partecipa allo sviluppo del piano CD per molecola/indicazioni assegnate
• Raccoglie e analizza i dati e le informazioni necessarie per creare il piano CD
• Funziona con altri membri del CST e sub-team rilevanti per sviluppare componenti del piano CD (ad esempio, strategia di analisi/dati, sviluppo di KOL, strategia di pubblicazioni, ecc.)
• Funziona con CST e altri team rilevanti per sviluppare e fornire informazioni e input per i requisiti di budget/risorse necessari per implementare ed eseguire il piano CD
• Rimangono al di fuori degli sviluppi interni ed esterni, delle tendenze e di altre dinamiche pertinenti al lavoro del CD per mantenere, in ogni momento, una visione e una prospettiva completamente attuali di influenze interne/esterne e/o implicazioni per l'area terapeutica e malattia assegnata(i)
• Come opportuno, partecipa a attività e progetti di valutazione e/o di intelligence competitiva e/o di altri mercati/industria
• Mantiene i più elevati standard e livelli di conoscenza scientifica e clinica nella specifica area terapeutica e malattia di assegnazione
• Collabora con una varietà di partner e stakeholder interni ed esterni, come investigatori clinici, clinici, scienziati e leader di opinione chiave (KOL), nonché gruppi interni multidisciplinari, tra cui altri gruppi in PD, ricerca, sviluppo aziendale, commerciale

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position ERFAHREN UND QUALIFIKATIONEN:
• Akademiker/Wissenschaft/Klinik:
• • M.D. erforderlich
• Therapeutische Kenntnisse in Stoffwechsel, Fettleibigkeit und Diabetes mit relevanten klinischen, wissenschaftlichen und klinischen Studien/Entwicklungserfahrung erforderlich
• Akademischer/Lehrer Hintergrund ist ein Plus
• Erfahrungen mit den Prinzipien und Techniken der Datenanalyse, Interpretation und klinische Relevanz
• Erleben Sie die Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen einer wissenschaftlichen Studie in einem peer-reviewed Journal wird bevorzugt
• Regulierung: Kenntnis medizinischer Aspekte von GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (Internationale Konferenz zur Harmonisierung technischer Anforderungen für die Registrierung von Arzneimitteln für den menschlichen Gebrauch), FDA, EMA und andere relevante Richtlinien und Verordnungen werden bevorzugt
• Dauer der Erfahrung: 2 oder mehr Jahre postgraduale akademische oder klinische Erfahrung
• Bis zu 30% globale Reise Schlüsselfertigkeiten und Verhaltensweisen
• Ethik: Hat tadellose Ethik. Nachweise oder nachgewiesene Nachweisfähigkeit, Roche-Werte
• Liebe zum Detail: Liebe zum Detail
• Business Acumen: Hat Arbeitswissen über die Pharma/Biotech-Industrie, die vielfältigen Funktionen und Rollen, die am Drogenentwicklungsprozess beteiligt sind. Regelmäßig führt die Entwicklung von Krankheitsstrategien und -plänen
• Organisation: Kann mehrere Aufgaben und Ziele rechtzeitig, auf Ziel und innerhalb des Budgets priorisieren
• zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten: Gute zwischenmenschliche, verbale Kommunikation und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten: kann ohne Autorität beeinflussen
• Schreiben: Starke schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Präsentation Fähigkeiten: Gute Business-Präsentation Fähigkeiten; ist komfortabel und effektiv bei der Präsentation für andere, intern oder extern. Vertraut und kompetent bei der Interaktion mit anderen intern und extern: bleibt fokussiert und on-point, ist in der Lage, Probleme oder Herausforderungen produktiv und reif zu stellen
• Verhandlungskompetenzen: Gute Verhandlungskompetenzen: weiß, wie man die Lieferungen durch eine effektive Zusammenarbeit mit anderen intern und extern abschließt
• Entscheidungsfindung: Wissen, wie man Entscheidungen trifft, während man Ethik und Wirksamkeit ausgleicht
• Teamwork: Starke Orientierung an Teamwork TECHNISCHE DATEN UND RESPONSIBILITÄTEN: CDP Strategie und Planung
• Erwartet die Entwicklung des CD-Plans für zugewiesene Moleküle/Indikationen(e)
• Erhält und analysiert Daten und Informationen, die zur Erstellung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind
• Arbeiten mit anderen CST-Mitgliedern und relevanten Subteams zur Entwicklung von CD-Plan-Komponenten (z.B. Analytik/Datenstrategie, KOL-Entwicklung, Publikationsstrategie usw.)
• arbeitet mit CST und anderen relevanten Teams zusammen, um Informationen und Eingaben für Budget- und Ressourcenanforderungen zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen, die zur Umsetzung und Durchführung des CD-Plans erforderlich sind
• Verharrt auf internen und externen Entwicklungen, Trends und anderen Dynamiken, die für die Arbeit von CD relevant sind, um jederzeit eine voll aktuelle Sicht und Perspektive interner/externer Einflüsse und/oder Implikationen für den zugewiesenen therapeutischen und Krankheitsbereich(en) zu erhalten
• Beteiligungen an wettbewerbsfähigen Erkenntnissen und/oder anderen Markt-/Industriebewertungstätigkeiten und Projekten
• Bewahrt die höchsten Standards und Niveaus der wissenschaftlichen und klinischen Kenntnisse im spezifischen therapeutischen und Krankheitsbereich(en) der Aufgabe
• Zusammenarbeit mit einer Vielzahl von internen und externen Partnern und Interessenvertretern, wie klinischen Ermittlern, Klinikern, Wissenschaftlern und Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), sowie multidisziplinären internen Gruppen, einschließlich anderer Gruppen in PD, Forschung, Geschäftsentwicklung, Handel

jobs.title: Instandhaltungsplaner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Der Bereich “Pharma Site Services“ der Roche Pharma ist am Standort Basel/Kaiseraugst der zentraler Partner für die unterschiedlichsten Funktionen: von Group Functions über Forschung, Entwicklung bis zu Produktion und Versand. Wir erbringen Services die unseren Standort pulsierend und attraktiv machen, die zeigen, dass wir das inspirierendste Unternehmen in der Schweiz sind. Wir gestalten massgeschneiderte Lösungen und betreiben Gebäude, Infrastruktur, Anlagen und halten diese Instand.

Wir haben diese Services in Kreisen (Circles) organisiert. Der Circle «Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies » gestaltet am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst das Umfeld für eine maximale Wertschöpfung von Anlagen mit dem Ziel eine möglichst hohe „Anlagenrendite“ zu erwirtschaften.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit dem Betreiber und dem Projekt Engineering Instandhaltungsstrategien, -konzepte und bildest diese in unseren Systemen SAP S/4 Hana ab.

Du bist maßgeblich für die Standardisierung, Einhaltung von Methoden und die Pflege von Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrier-Stammdaten zuständig. Du sicherst und förderst eine hohe Datenqualität, behebst Probleme mit Daten und ihren Quellen.

Die Möglichkeit:

• Du agierst als Key User und Hauptverantwortlicher für die Stammdaten. Du pflegst und genehmigst Anlagenstammdaten im SAP S/4 Hana (inklusive Tasklisten und Prüfplänen) und prüfst als letzte Instanz die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Standards und Naming Conventions.

• Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrierprozesse und berätst mit Deiner Fachexpertise für Instandhaltung und Datenmanagement die unterschiedlichen Kundengruppen in Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst.

• Du prüfst die Qualität der Daten und behebst Datenintegritäts- oder -konsistenzprobleme gezielt in den Workflows.

• Du analysierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und leitest kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zur Datenqualität ab. So schaffst Du die Basis verlässlicher Daten, um lokale und globale Asset Lifecycle Management Initiativen voranzutreiben.

• Du entwickelst Instandhaltungsstrategien, legst diese fest und bildest sie in den Systemen ab.

• Du hinterfragst den Status Quo sachlich-kritisch und gehst neue Wege in der Instandhaltung.

Wer Du bist
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken Team-Fähigkeiten. In diesem Sinne bringst du eine offene und kollaborative Einstellung und Denkweise mit, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in deinem Team und bereichsübergreifend benötigt. Du vertraust dir und anderen, übernimmst Verantwortung und lebst eine offene Speak-Up- und Fehlerkultur. Deine lösungsorientierte Grundhaltung und Can-Do Einstellung bestimmt dein tägliches Handeln und stellt den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner und Experte für Stammdaten hast Du bereits fundierte Berufserfahrung mit der Instandhaltung von verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen und Packaged Units sammeln können, idealerweise in der pharmazeutischen (GxP-regulierten) oder einer ähnlich streng regulierten Industrie..

Du verstehst die Konzepte der Datenmodellierung, gehst sicher mit mit dem Data Warehouse um und hast gute technische Dokumentationsfähigkeiten. Die hohe Qualität von Daten ist das Fundament robuster Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrierprozesse. Du lebst kontinuierliche Verbesserung, Erfahrung mit SAP S/4 Hana runden Dein Profil ab.

Im Umgang mit globalen Schnittstellen

La posizione La divisione “Pharma Site Services” di Roche Pharma è il partner centrale del sito di Basilea/Kaiseraugst per una vasta gamma di funzioni: dalle Funzioni di Gruppo alla ricerca, sviluppo e produzione e spedizione. Forniamo servizi che rendono la nostra posizione pulsante e attraente, che mostrano che siamo la società più ispiratrice in Svizzera. Sviluppato come progettista di manutenzione Insieme all'operatore e al progetto di ingegneria, svilupperai strategie di manutenzione, concetti e mapparli nei nostri sistemi SAP S/4 Hana. Sei responsabile della standardizzazione, del rispetto dei metodi e della manutenzione dei dati dei master di manutenzione e calibrazione. Si assicura e promuove alta qualità dei dati, sollevare problemi con i dati e le loro fonti. La possibilità:
• Si agisce come utente chiave e gestore chiave per i dati master. Si pug e approva i file master di impianti nella SAP S/4 Hana (comprese le liste di attività e i piani di test) e verificare la conformità con gli standard concordati e le convenzioni di denominazione come l'ultima istanza.
• Sei la persona di contatto principale per i processi di manutenzione e calibrazione e, con il tuo specialista in manutenzione e gestione dei dati, consiglia i diversi gruppi di clienti in produzione, ricerca e infrastrutture presso il sito di Basilea e Kaiseraugst.
• Controllare la qualità dei dati e correggere l'integrità dei dati o problemi di consistenza nei flussi di lavoro.
• Analizza i dati da diverse fonti e guida misure di miglioramento continuo per la qualità dei dati. Così è possibile creare la base di dati affidabili per avanzare iniziative locali e globali di gestione del ciclo di vita.
• Sviluppi le strategie di manutenzione, le fissi e le immagini nei sistemi.

Chi sei Sei un pensiero positivo, integree e auto-riflettente personalità con forti abilità di squadra. In questo senso, si porta un atteggiamento aperto e collaborativo e il modo di pensare che ha bisogno di un lavoro di successo nel vostro team e in tutte le aree. Ti fidi di te e degli altri, prenditi la responsabilità e vivi una cultura aperta del discorso e degli errori. Il vostro atteggiamento di base orientato alla soluzione e l'atteggiamento di can-do determina la vostra azione quotidiana e si concentra sul cliente. Come pianificatore di manutenzione ed esperto per i dati master È possibile ottenere un'esperienza professionale ben fondata con la manutenzione di apparecchiature di processo e unità confezionate, idealmente nel settore farmaceutico (GxP-regolated) o un'industria strettamente regolamentata. Capisci i concetti di modellazione dei dati, vai in sicurezza con il Data Warehouse e hai buone capacità di documentazione tecnica. L'alta qualità dei dati è la base di robusti processi di manutenzione e calibrazione. Vivi continuo miglioramento, esperienza con SAP S/4 Hana completa il tuo profilo. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Logistics Engineer / Project Manager leads the technical evolution and modernization of our 10,000m2 self-operated distribution center. This role is the strategic architect responsible for transforming a complex, legacy-automated environment into a flexible, next-generation fulfillment hub using AMR and advanced robotics.
You will bridge the gap between physical hardware and digital systems, managing the transition from a legacy software stack (WMS/WCS/MFC) to a modern SAP eWM environment. Reporting directly to the Head of Supply Chain, you will own the technical roadmap, from ROI analysis and vendor selection participation to on-site project execution lead, ensuring our automation strategy aligns with future business scalability.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Creation of holistic view of warehouse operations in terms of automation technology, system landscape and warehouse operator needs. Full understanding & documentation of current bottlenecks in terms of throughput and storage capacity. Create suitable measurements (KPIs) where needed in order to translate requirements and current capacities.

• Automation Transformation & Strategy: Assess and lead the transition from rigid legacy automation to flexible technologies (AMRs, Humanoids, etc.) where required. Take full stock of existing hardware capabilities and map them against future business requirements and market-leading solutions.

• Systems Architecture & Integration: Fully master the current system landscape (WMS, WCS, MFC). Design the integration strategy to link the physical world with the digital world, acting as the lead for the upcoming SAP eWM implementation.

• Financial Stewardship & ROI: Drive rigorous ROI analysis for all automation projects collaborating with finance and site management. Have clear visibility for throughput, storage density, and FTE optimization.

• Material Flow & Process Optimization: Analyze and redesign internal material flows to eliminate bottlenecks. Use data-driven insights to optimize picking strategies, replenishment cycles, and packing efficiency. Processes are redesigned considering sustainability, quality and safety aspects.

• Project Governance: Act as the on-site Project Lead for major technical and system shifts. Manage the end-to-end lifecycle—from concept and vendor assessment to commissioning and structured handover—ensuring minimal disruption to active operations. Interact with global and local project teams.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Partner with site management to assess new vendors and technologies. Navigate the complex relationship between legacy hardware providers and modern robotics OEMs, ensuring system interoperability.

• Technical Communication: Adapt complex technical concepts for different audiences (“zoom in & out”). Clearly articulate the "why" behind automation shifts to senior leadership while providing granular technical direction to on-site maintenance and IT teams.

• Performance Tracking: Define and monitor KPIs for automated systems, including uptime, cycle times, and error rates. Lead corrective actions when performance gaps occur in the automated flow.

Who You Are

• An Analytical Problem Solver: You enjoy the challenge of making legacy systems perform in a modern context. You take ambiguity and uncertainty as an opportunity to bring up proposals.

• Material Flow & Process Optimization: Analyze and redesign internal material flows to eliminate bottlenecks. Use data-driven insights to optimize picking strategies, replenishment cycles, and packing efficiency. Processes are redesigned considering sustainability, quality and safety aspects.
• Project Governance: Act as the on-site Project Lead for major technical and system shifts. Manage the end-to-end lifecycle—from concept and vendor assessment to commissioning and structured handover—ensuring minimal disruption to active operations. Interact with global and local project teams.

• An Analytical Problem Solver: You enjoy the challenge of making legacy systems perform in a modern context. You take ambiguity and uncertainty as an opportunity to bring up proposals.
• A Strategic Executor: You can design a 3-year automation roadmap but are equally willing to be on the warehouse floor during a "Go-Live" to troubleshoot o

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor (Bangalore)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

titleByLocale.it: Pianificatore di manutenzione e Master Data Quality Steward (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Der Bereich “Pharma Site Services“ der Roche Pharma ist am Standort Basel/Kaiseraugst der zentraler Partner für die unterschiedlichsten Funktionen: von Group Functions über Forschung, Entwicklung bis zu Produktion und Versand. Wir erbringen Services die unseren Standort pulsierend und attraktiv machen, die zeigen, dass wir das inspirierendste Unternehmen in der Schweiz sind. Wir gestalten massgeschneiderte Lösungen und betreiben Gebäude, Infrastruktur, Anlagen und halten diese Instand.

Wir haben diese Services in Kreisen (Circles) organisiert. Der Circle «Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies » gestaltet am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst das Umfeld für eine maximale Wertschöpfung von Anlagen mit dem Ziel eine möglichst hohe „Anlagenrendite“ zu erwirtschaften.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit dem Betreiber und dem Projekt Engineering Instandhaltungsstrategien, -konzepte und bildest diese in unseren Systemen SAP S/4 Hana ab.

Als Master Data Quality Steward liegt Deine Hauptverantwortung im Bereich der Kalibrierung. Du bist maßgeblich für die Standardisierung, Einhaltung von Methoden und die prozessuale Qualitätssicherung der Kalibrierstammdaten zuständig. Du sicherst und förderst eine hohe Datenqualität, behebst Probleme mit Daten und ihren Quellen und gewährleistest effiziente, standardisierte sowie integrative Prozesse für kalibrierrelevante Stammdaten (Master Data Management).

Die Möglichkeit:

• Du agierst als Key User und Hauptverantwortlicher für die Kalibrierstammdaten. Du pflegst und genehmigst Anlagenstammdaten im SAP S/4 Hana (inklusive Kalibrier-Tasklisten und Prüfplänen) und prüfst als letzte Instanz die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Standards und Naming Conventions.

• Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Kalibrierprozesse und berätst mit Deiner Fachexpertise für Kalibrieren und Datenmanagement die unterschiedlichen Kundengruppen in Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst.

• Du stellst die systemtechnische Abgrenzung im Kalibrierbereich sicher, identifizierst Datenquellen, prüfst die Qualität der Daten und behebst Datenintegritäts- oder -konsistenzprobleme gezielt in den Kalibrier-Workflows.

• Du dokumentierst Datenquellen, verknüpfst Informationen, betreibst dediziertes Qualitätsreporting für den Kalibrierbereich und pflegst relevante KPIs.

• Du analysierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und leitest kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zur Datenqualität ab. So schaffst Du die Basis verlässlicher Daten, um lokale und globale Asset Lifecycle Management Initiativen voranzutreiben.

• Du entwickelst Kalibrierstrategien, legst diese fest und bildest sie in den Systemen ab.

• Du hinterfragst den Status Quo sachlich-kritisch und gehst neue Wege in der Kalibrierung.

Wer Du bist
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken Team-Fähigkeiten. In diesem Sinne bringst du eine offene und kollaborative Einstellung und Denkweise mit, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in deinem Team und bereichsübergreifend benötigt. Du vertraust dir und anderen, übernimmst Verantwortung und lebst eine offene Speak-Up- und Fehlerkultur. Deine lösungsorientierte Grundhaltung und Can-Do Einstellung bestimmt dein tägliches Handeln und stellt den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner und Experte für Stammdaten hast Du bereits fundierte Berufserfahrung mit der Instandhaltung und Kalibrierung von verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen und Packaged Uni

A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La divisione “Pharma Site Services” di Position Roche è il partner centrale del sito di Basilea/Kaiseraugst per una vasta gamma di funzioni: dalle funzioni di gruppo alla ricerca, allo sviluppo alla produzione e alla spedizione. Forniamo servizi che rendono la nostra posizione pulsante e attraente, che mostrano che siamo la società più ispiratrice in Svizzera. Progettiamo soluzioni su misura e operiamo edifici, infrastrutture, strutture e lo teniamo a mente. Abbiamo organizzato questi servizi in Circles. Il Circolo «Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies » al sito di Basilea e Kaiseraugst modella l'ambiente per la creazione di valore massimo di impianti con l'obiettivo di raggiungere il massimo rendimento possibile delle piante. Come pianificatore di manutenzione, si sviluppano strategie di manutenzione, concetti e svilupparli nei nostri sistemi SAP S/4 Hana insieme all'operatore e al progetto di ingegneria. Come Master Data Quality Steward, la vostra responsabilità principale è nel campo della calibrazione. Lei è responsabile della standardizzazione, del rispetto dei metodi e della garanzia di qualità del processo dei dati master di calibrazione. Garantire e promuovere un'alta qualità dei dati, risolvere i problemi con dati e fonti e garantire processi efficienti, standardizzati e inclusivi per la calibrazione della gestione dei dati master. Possibilità:
• Si agisce come utente chiave e controller principale per i dati master di calibrazione. Lei sta gestendo e autorizzando i dati master degli impianti nella SAP S/4 Hana (compreso la calibrazione delle liste delle attività e dei piani di prova) e come istanza finale, verifica il rispetto degli standard concordati e delle convenzioni di denominazione.
• Siete la persona di contatto principale per i processi di calibrazione e, con la vostra competenza per le tarature e la gestione dei dati, consiglia i diversi gruppi di clienti in produzione, ricerca e infrastrutture presso il sito di Basilea e Kaiseraugst.
• L'utente garantisce la limitazione tecnica del sistema nell'area di calibrazione, identifica le fonti di dati, controlla la qualità dei dati e corregge specificamente l'integrità dei dati o i problemi di consistenza nei flussi di calibrazione.
• Si documentano fonti di dati, informazioni di collegamento, eseguire report di qualità dedicati per l'intervallo di calibrazione e la cura dei KPI rilevanti.
• Analizzi i dati da diverse fonti e guida misure di miglioramento continuo per la qualità dei dati. Così si crea la base di dati affidabili per far avanzare iniziative locali e globali di gestione del ciclo di vita.
• Sviluppi le strategie di calibrazione, le fissi e le immagini nei sistemi.
• Stai mettendo in discussione lo status quo obiettivamente-critico e andrai in nuovi modi nella calibrazione. Chi sei tu sei un pensiero positivo, integree e auto-riflessione personalità con forti abilità di squadra. In questo senso, si porta un atteggiamento aperto e collaborativo e il modo di pensare che ha bisogno per il lavoro di successo nel vostro team e in tutte le aree. Ti fidi di te e degli altri, prenditi la responsabilità e vivi una cultura aperta Parla e errori. Il vostro atteggiamento di base orientato alla soluzione e l'atteggiamento di can-do determina la vostra azione quotidiana e si concentra sul cliente. Come pianificatore di manutenzione ed esperto per i dati master Hai già consolidato esperienza professionale con la manutenzione e la calibrazione delle attrezzature di processo e Packd Uni

jobs.title: (Lead/Senior) Medical Director - Neurodegeneration
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE:
Roche’s Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late development (Phase II – III) clinical strategies and plans that deliver medically-differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients.
The Lead Medical Director leads or makes major contributions to development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and is responsible for effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).
Lead Medical Directors are expected to perform their responsibilities with more independence by comparison to Medical Directors.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

• M.D. Required

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Significant experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Significant pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized expert in the field

• Significant experience designing and conducting clinical trials (i.e. one or more trials)

• Experience authoring a global development plan is preferred

• Understanding of Phase II – III drug development

• Knowledge and understanding of Phase I & IV drug development is a plus

• Understanding of product and safety profiles

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is required

• 4 or more years pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized local expert in the field (e.g Assistant Professor or equivalent)

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Is regarded as knowledgeable in his/her field, is respected by others, can effectively contribute to longer-range drug development, and can lead cross-functional teams to successful results

jobs.title: Head, PV Regional Center EMEA
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you a visionary leader passionate about shaping the future of Patient Safety? In this pivotal role, you will lead and manage the PV Regional Center, ensuring the delivery of high-quality pharmacovigilance (PV) and Device Vigilance activities across the Europe, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA) region. You will be at the forefront of driving operational excellence, upholding regulatory compliance, and integrating regional clinical safety activities in a complex, global environment.
Working in partnership with Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will contribute to the broader Patient Safety Operations (PSO) strategy. Your leadership will ensure that our safety processes are not only compliant but also innovative, leveraging data-driven insights and digital transformation to protect patients worldwide.

• Lead and inspire a multi-site regional team , acting as a catalyst for a quality- and customer-centric culture.

• Oversee the operationalization of safety processes to ensure full compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations.

• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by embedding technological advances like AI and digital analytics into safety operations.

• Ensure inspection and audit readiness for all regional activities, maintaining a robust business continuity plan.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate regionalized clinical safety activities and achieve shared global objectives.

• Foster a culture of growth and empowerment , adopting the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership style to develop future talent.

• Represent the PV function with external parties, including regulators, ensuring Roche’s reputation for excellence remains unmatched.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker and a servant leader who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape and are motivated by the opportunity to lead large-scale operational changes that have a real impact on patient lives.

• You hold a Health Care Professional Degree (Medical, Pharmacy, or equivalent professional experience).

• You bring 10+ years of pharmaceutical experience , with at least 5 years in significant PV leadership roles.

• You have a proven track record in managing multi-country or regional operations within a large, complex organization.

• You are a VACC leader , committed to inclusive behaviors and developing high-performing, diverse teams.

• You possess deep technical expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).

• You are an exceptional communicator , able to influence stakeholders and convey complex information clearly in English.

• You have a growth mindset , eager to experiment with new technologies and take smart risks to improve operational efficiency.

Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions
En tant qu' Ingénieur Réseau Terrain (Territoire Ouest), rattaché(e) à un Responsable Territorial des Equipes Services, vous serez amené(e) à collaborer avec les équipes supports et IT sur des missions liées à l'installation et à la maintenance des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d'analyses médicales (privés et hospitaliers).

Localisation idéale: Poitiers / La Rochelle / Bordeaux

Vos principales responsabilités :

• Concevoir les schémas réseau, les matrices de flux et assurer leur déploiement. Gestion de son parc informatique et mise à jour des documents clients (Document d’Architecture Technique, Document d’Exploitation)

• Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Spécialiste IT et Workflow.

• Garantir les plans d'actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. Agir rapidement lors d’élaboration de PRI (Plan de Réponse aux Incidents)

• Effectuer les rétrofits hardware / software IT réseau Roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions chez nos clients.

• Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche.

• Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting précis de vos interventions et des mises à niveau .

Votre profil :

• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou Master spécialisé en informatique et réseaux.

• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (réseaux, pare-feu, accès) des infrastructures informatiques clients.

• Aisance à l’oral, levée d’objection étant identifié comme Interlocuteur privilégié des Directions des Services Informatiques (DSI) pour expliquer les pré requis d’installation des solutions digitales Roche et échanger sur les besoins clients.

• Anglais professionnel

• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).

• Sens du résultat, goût du challenge et sens des responsabilités.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: R&D AI Transformation Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview

Are you interested in how software R&D organizations evolve to integrate AI and stay ahead in a changing technological landscape? We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented R&D AI Transformation Intern to join our strategy team.
You won't just be fetching coffee; you’ll be behind the scenes of major structural, cultural, and digital shifts as we embed AI into our engineering DNA, helping us bridge the gap between "traditional development" and "AI-augmented innovation."

Key Responsibilities

• Data Analysis & Insights: Gather and analyze R&D performance metrics and AI tool adoption rates to identify bottlenecks and track the progress of ongoing AI transformation initiatives.

• Stakeholder Communication: Assist in drafting internal memos, newsletters, and presentation decks that translate complex AI strategies and LLM implementations into "human" language for our developers and engineers.

• Project Management Support: Maintain project timelines (Gantt charts) and follow up on action items from cross-functional workshops focused on AI integration and automated workflows.

• Research: Conduct competitive benchmarking and research best practices in AI-assisted coding, machine learning operations (MLOps), and organizational design for AI-first R&D teams.

• Workshop Facilitation: Help organize and document brainstorming sessions aimed at improving software delivery pipelines through AI and boosting developer engagement with new intelligent tools.

What We’re Looking For

• Curiosity: A genuine interest in the intersection of software business strategy, AI ethics, and engineering culture.

• Communication: The ability to explain a complex technical AI concept or strategic shift simply and clearly.

• Agility: Comfort with ambiguity—navigating the rapid evolution of AI in R&D is rarely a straight line!

• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data visualization) and PowerPoint (storytelling), with an interest in exploring AI productivity tools.

• Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

Why Join Us?

This isn't your typical administrative internship. You will gain a "bird's-eye view" of how a software R&D organization operates at scale and learn the methodologies used to drive meaningful change in the age of AI.
If you're a problem-solver who loves to see the big picture in a high-tech environment, we’d love to have you on board.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea (한국로슈진단)
Division: Core Lab & POC (진단검사 사업부)
Location: 서울
Position: Sales Representative (영업)

Your key responsibilities
Job Summary
한국로슈진단은 고객 중심의 영업 활동 을 통해 진단 분야의 혁신적인 가치를 전달하며, 시장 리더십을 강화할 영업 전문가를 찾고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고객 관리

• 기존 고객사를 관리하고 유지하며 매출 증대

• 신규 고객사 발굴 및 개발

2. 대리점 관리

• 대리점과 협력하여 매출 목표 달성

• 대리점 재고 모니터링 및 관리

• 제품 교육 실시

• 대리점 영업 활동 지원

3. 마케팅 및 영업 활동

• 월별/분기별 및 연간 매출 목표 달성

• 신규 장비 설치

• 기존 장비에 신규 제품 추가

4. 기술 지원

• 장비 및 시약 관련 고객 문의 및 요청사항 응대

Who you are

• 학사 학위 이상 또는 이에 준하는 학력 (신입 ~ 경력 7년 이하 선호)

• 체외진단(IVD)에 대한 이해 및 지식 보유 선호

• 고객지향적 사고 및 커뮤니케이션 능력

• 비지니스 영어 구사 능력

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
