jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Mit dieser Vision im Blick leistet Roche Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Dabei gründet sich unser Erfolg auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt – und darauf, dass wir unsere Unterschiede als Vorteil betrachten, um das Gesundheitswesen durch Innovationen voranzutreiben. Auch im Bereich People Relations leben wir diese Kultur - um sie gemeinsam mit uns in den Arbeitsweisen der gesamten Organisation zu verankern, suchen wir Dich.

Dein neues Team
Als Teil des People & Culture Teams bei Roche, ist es unser Bestreben, das Potenzial unserer Mitarbeiter:innen zu entfalten. Als globale Funktion schaffen wir eine Kultur und ein Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung fördert und den Fokus auf das Wesentliche richtet. Dafür arbeiten wir auf lokaler und globaler Ebene eng mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, unseren Kunden aus der gesamten Roche Wertschöpfungskette sowie anderen internen und externen Partner:innen zusammen. Gemeinsam mit ihnen stellen wir sicher, dass sowohl Unternehmens- als auch Mitarbeitendeninteressen gleichermaßen gefördert werden. Mit unseren vielfältigen Themen und Projekten bieten wir ausgewogene Perspektiven und proaktive Lösungen in arbeitsrechtlichen Fragen, um Geschäfts- und Personalstrategien erfolgreich voranzubringen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In der dynamischen Rolle bei Roche begleitest und gestaltest Du Veränderungsprozesse. Du bringst Deine Expertise im Arbeitsrecht ein, agierst vermittelnd als (strategischer) Partner und treibst Projekte voran. Um maßgeblich zum Erfolg von Roche und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung beizutragen, übernimmst Du folgende Aufgaben:

• Du leitest komplexe P&C- relevante Projekte, einschließlich Restrukturierungen und Verhandlungen mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, unter Berücksichtigung globaler Rahmenbedingungen und lokaler arbeitsrechtlicher Anforderungen.

• Du pflegst vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu den Arbeitnehmervertretungen an all unseren deutschen Standorten und stellst mit lösungsorientierten Ansätzen den geschäftlichen Erfolg sicher.

• Du agierst als Expert:in und Berater:in für individuelle und kollektive Arbeitsrechtsthemen und unterstützt die Organisation in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, die den rechtlichen Standards und unseren Unternehmenswerten entsprechen.

• Du optimierst Prozesse und Lösungen in Deinem Fachbereich, um die organisatorische Effizienz zu steigern und die Einhaltung aktueller Regularien sicherzustellen.

• Du baust ein professionelles Netzwerk nach innen und außen auf und bist in der Lage, neue Trends zu bewerten und in die Prozessgestaltung einzubeziehen, um die Relevanz und Wirksamkeit von P&C-Initiativen zu erhöhen.

• Du berätst und unterstützt die Führungsebene mit fundierten Analysen und Handlungsempfehlungen zu kritischen P&C-Themen und trägst so zur strategischen Entscheidungsfindung bei.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Nach Abschluss Deines juristischen oder (personal)wirtschaftlichen Studiums und mindestens 5 Jahren einschlägiger Berufserfahrung bringst Du die nötige Seniorität und Empathie mit. Du besitzt umfassende Kompetenzen in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Projekten in Transformationsumgebungen.

• Du verfügst über Expertise in der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, wodurch Du versiert mit der Gestaltung und Pflege von Beziehungen umgehst.

• Deine vielseitigen Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht (sowohl individuell als auch kollektiv) und im Projektmanagement bilden das Fundament für die Beratung und Strategieentwi

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. Con questa visione, Roche sta fornendo un lavoro pionieristico nella sanità. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità – e guardiamo le nostre differenze come un vantaggio per far progredire la salute attraverso l'innovazione. Viviamo anche nella zona delle persone relazioni - per ancorarle insieme con noi nelle opere di tutta l'organizzazione, stiamo cercando voi. La tua nuova squadra Nell'ambito del team People & Culture di Roche, il nostro obiettivo è quello di sviluppare il potenziale dei nostri dipendenti. Come funzione globale, creiamo una cultura e un ambiente che promuove l'auto-responsabilità e si concentra sugli elementi essenziali. A questo scopo, lavoriamo a stretto contatto con i rappresentanti dei dipendenti, i nostri clienti dall'intera catena di valore Roche e altri partner interni ed esterni. Insieme a loro, ci assicuriamo che sia gli affari che i dipendenti siano sostenuti allo stesso modo. Con i nostri diversi argomenti e progetti, offriamo prospettive equilibrate e soluzioni proattive in materia di diritto del lavoro per migliorare con successo le strategie aziendali e del personale. responsabilità Ti aspetti Nel ruolo dinamico di Roche, accompagni e forma i processi di cambiamento. Porti la tua esperienza nel diritto del lavoro, mediando come partner (strategico) e promuovendo progetti. Per contribuire in modo significativo al successo di Roche e al miglioramento continuo, Hai i seguenti compiti:
• Conduci progetti P&C-relevant complessi, tra cui ristrutturazioni e negoziati con i rappresentanti dei dipendenti, tenendo conto delle condizioni quadro globali e dei requisiti di diritto del lavoro locale.
• Hai una buona idea di fidarti dei rapporti con i rappresentanti dei lavoratori in tutte le nostre sedi tedesche e garantire il successo aziendale con approcci orientati alla soluzione.
• Lei agisce come esperto:in e consulente: in caso di problemi individuali e collettivi di diritto del lavoro e sostiene l'organizzazione nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di strategie che soddisfano gli standard legali e i valori aziendali.
• Scegli processi e soluzioni nel tuo campo per aumentare l'efficienza organizzativa e garantire il rispetto delle normative vigenti.
• Costruisci una rete professionale all'interno e all'esterno e sei in grado di valutare nuove tendenze e incorporarle nella progettazione dei processi per aumentare la pertinenza e l'efficacia delle iniziative P&C.
• Si consiglia e supporta il livello di leadership con analisi sonore e raccomandazioni per l'azione su questioni critiche P&C e quindi contribuire al processo decisionale strategico. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta
• Dopo aver completato gli studi legali o (personali) economici e almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante Hai l'anzianità e l'empatia necessarie. Hai competenze complete nella riuscita realizzazione di progetti in ambienti di trasformazione.
• Hai esperienza nella collaborazione con le rappresentanze dei dipendenti, che ti guiderà con la progettazione e la cura delle relazioni.
• La vostra conoscenza versatile del diritto del lavoro (sia individualmente che collettivamente) e la gestione del progetto sono la base per la consulenza e lo sviluppo della strategia
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position A healthier future. With this vision, Roche is providing pioneering work in healthcare. Our success is based on innovation, curiosity and diversity – and we look at our differences as an advantage to advance healthcare through innovation. We also live in the area of people relations - in order to anchor them together with us in the workings of the entire organization, we are looking for you. Your new team As part of the People & Culture team at Roche, our aim is to develop the potential of our employees. As a global function, we create a culture and an environment that promotes self-responsibility and focuses on the essentials. For this purpose, we work closely with employee representatives, our customers from the entire Roche value chain and other internal and external partners. Together with them, we ensure that both business and employees are supported equally. With our diverse topics and projects, we offer balanced perspectives and proactive solutions in labour law issues to successfully advance business and personnel strategies. Responsibilities You're expecting In the dynamic role at Roche, you accompany and shape change processes. You bring your expertise in labour law, mediating as a (strategic) partner and driving projects forward. To contribute significantly to Roche's success and continuous improvement, You have the following tasks:
• You conduct complex P&C-relevant projects, including restructurings and negotiations with employee representatives, taking into account global framework conditions and local labour law requirements.
• You have a good idea of trusting relationships with workers' representatives at all our German locations and ensure business success with solution-oriented approaches.
• You act as an expert:in and consultant:in case of individual and collective labour law issues and support the organisation in the development and implementation of strategies that meet legal standards and corporate values.
• You opt for processes and solutions in your field to increase organizational efficiency and ensure compliance with current regulations.
• You build a professional network inside and outside and are able to evaluate new trends and incorporate them into process design to increase the relevance and effectiveness of P&C initiatives.
• You advise and support the leadership level with sound analyses and recommendations for action on critical P&C issues and thus contribute to strategic decision-making. Qualifications | That brings you
• After completing your legal or (personal) economic studies and at least 5 years of relevant professional experience You have the necessary seniority and empathy. You have comprehensive skills in the successful implementation of projects in transformation environments.
• You have expertise in collaborating with employee representations, which will guide you with the design and care of relationships.
• Your versatile knowledge of labour law (both individually and collectively) and project management are the foundation for consulting and strategy development

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner, Ophthalmology (East Java)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

Your Opportunity

• The PJP acts as a trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche involved in the patient journey. As the local face of Roche, PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• The PJP is responsible for creating exponential impacts for patients and the community and bringing us closer to our vision. Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem. Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Resource Planning, the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster. PJP is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally (affiliate) and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs, HSPs and enabling functions.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Owner of the customer engagement strategy based on the customer insights (planning until implementation) together with other PJPs.

Who you are

• You should hold a university degree (scientific, economic, or business degree) or an advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus with practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies as well as deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level.

• You should have broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions and robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research

• You should have an in-depth understanding of the Indonesia healthcare system and the role of multiple stakeholders within this. Also, In-depth knowledge of Indonesia Pharmaceutical Code of Conduct and other relevant standards and guidelines

• You should have excellent experience in customer and stakeholder engagement in healthcare system.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

For the Bratislava location the salary starts from 1 600 EUR gross / month. For the Prague location, the salary starts from 48 300 CZK / month. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo si basa nel Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale che si dedica a fornire eccellenza aiutando il personale di laboratorio a utilizzare i nostri prodotti. Operiamo con un approccio olistico, il che significa che ci occupiamo del nostro portafoglio prodotti dall'idea attraverso lo sviluppo e il lancio di mercato a phase-out. L'eccezionale varietà di tecnologie applicate in questo settore offre grandi opportunità di apprendimento. Specialista di supporto tecnico (lingua slovacca e ceca) Località: Varsavia, Praga o Bratislava (La tua scelta!) Sei pronto a passare dall'esperienza tecnica all'impatto che cambia la vita? Il nostro Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale (RCSC) è il motore intellettuale dietro l'eccellenza di laboratorio in Europa Centrale. Stiamo cercando un talento ceco e/o slovacco che ha fame di conoscenza, gode di problem solving, ed è pronto a padroneggiare le tecnologie diagnostiche più avanzate del mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità: Più di un semplice supporto Questo non è un tipico ruolo di helpdesk. Si tratta di una posizione di consulenza ingegneristica e applicativa in cui si diventa il "guardiano" dell'accuratezza diagnostica.
• Master the Complexity: lavorerai con sistemi IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) di fascia alta che combinano robotica, biochimica complessa e IT avanzato.
• Crescita continua: forniamo un programma intensivo di formazione di livello mondiale. Non ci aspettiamo che tu sappia tutto il primo giorno, ma ci aspettiamo che tu sia quello che non smette mai di chiedere "perché?".

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming facilities operations to support cutting-edge science and patient care? Join Roche Diagnostics as the Director of Facilities & Engineering for our Bay Area sites, where you'll take charge of shaping the strategic direction and operational excellence of our Pleasanton and Santa Clara campuses. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to oversee large-scale capital projects, optimize site master plans, and drive continuous improvements in reliability, safety, and efficiency. As a key member of the Site Leadership Team, you will inspire and develop a high-performing team, foster a culture of innovation, and ensure our facilities meet the highest standards of compliance and performance—empowering Roche’s mission to deliver extraordinary outcomes for patients around the world.

This role is responsible for the strategic leadership of all Facilities & Engineering initiatives across the Bay Area sites ( Pleasanton and Santa Clara ). This includes directing operations and maintenance, campus master planning, capital investment strategies and execution, asset lifecycle management, and reliability engineering. The Director is ultimately accountable for ensuring facilities operations are compliant, reliable, fiscally responsible and directly support the organization's overarching business objectives. This leader inspires and empowers a culture of operational excellence where every employee can achieve extraordinary outcomes for customers and patients every day.

The Opportunity
Responsibilities

• Oversees the curation and management of the Facilities CAPEX portfolio for Roche Diagnostics Sites in the Bay Area. Directs all facility related capital projects in support of the Facility Master Plan. Capital projects range from 100,000 USD to 100,000,000 USD with the following responsibilities: project scope, cost and schedule development, funding documentation development and presentation to senior management, construction, move coordination and project close-out. May direct capital project planning and execution for sites outside the Bay Area based on need and available resources.

• Develops and executes annual and long range strategic Facility Master Plans based on Site Business Plans. Plan development and execution requires interaction across all functional areas of the business and senior management, with strong negotiation skills to solve complex problems affecting nearly all employees at Roche sites.

• Direct facility operations and maintenance programs performance measurement, service provider management, and resource planning as well as developing, sharing and adopting technical innovations, life cycle costing models, best practices, KPIs and benchmarking information with the global Facilities community.

• Direct engineering services which include life cycle costing, energy conservation, asset management, reliability engineering, performance measurement and resource planning.

• Directs and leads efforts to ensure engineering-related policies, procedures, and practices are effective, efficient and consistent. Provides regular, consistent updates on facilities and engineering matters to support ongoing awareness and continuity of business operations.

• Interacts at a high level with internal and external resources to ensure the Company is in compliance with local, state, federal, and corporate regulations as well as internal Quality System and regulatory compliance programs.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei un leader visionario con la passione per la trasformazione delle operazioni di strutture per supportare la scienza all'avanguardia e la cura dei pazienti? Unisciti a Roche Diagnostics come Direttore di Strutture e Ingegneria per i nostri siti di Bay Area, dove ti occuperai di modellare la direzione strategica e l'eccellenza operativa dei nostri campus di Pleasanton e Santa Clara. Questo ruolo fondamentale offre l'opportunità di supervisionare progetti di capitale su larga scala, ottimizzare i piani di master del sito e migliorare continuamente l'affidabilità, la sicurezza e l'efficienza. In qualità di membro chiave del team di Leadership del sito, ispirerete e svilupperete un team di alto livello, promuovere una cultura dell’innovazione, e garantire che le nostre strutture soddisfino i più elevati standard di conformità e prestazioni, potenziando la missione di Roche per fornire risultati straordinari per i pazienti di tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo è responsabile della leadership strategica di tutte le iniziative di Strutture e Ingegneria nei siti Bay Area ( Pleasanton e Santa Clara). Ciò include la gestione di operazioni e manutenzione, la pianificazione master del campus, le strategie di investimento di capitale e l'esecuzione, la gestione del ciclo di vita degli asset e l'ingegneria di affidabilità. Il Direttore è in ultima analisi responsabile per garantire che le operazioni delle strutture siano conformi, affidabili, responsabile fiscale e sostengano direttamente gli obiettivi aziendali di supervisione dell'organizzazione. Questo leader ispira e potenzia una cultura di eccellenza operativa dove ogni dipendente può ottenere risultati straordinari per clienti e pazienti ogni giorno. L'opportunità responsabilità
• supervisiona la cura e la gestione del portafoglio Servizi CAPEX per i Siti diagnostici Roche nell'area della baia. Dirige tutti i progetti di capitale relativi alla struttura a sostegno del Facility Master Plan. I progetti di capitale variano da 100.000 USD a 100,000,000 USD con le seguenti responsabilità: portata di progetto, sviluppo dei costi e dei programmi, sviluppo della documentazione di finanziamento e presentazione alla gestione senior, costruzione, coordinamento del movimento e chiusura del progetto. Può la pianificazione e l'esecuzione del progetto di capitale diretto per i siti al di fuori della Bay Area in base alle necessità e alle risorse disponibili.
• Sviluppa ed esegue piani strategici di Facility Master annuali e a lungo raggio basati su Piani di business del sito. Lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione del piano richiedono l'interazione in tutte le aree funzionali del business e della gestione senior, con forti capacità di negoziazione per risolvere problemi complessi che interessano quasi tutti i dipendenti dei siti Roche.
• Misura diretta delle prestazioni delle operazioni di impianti e dei programmi di manutenzione, gestione dei fornitori di servizi e pianificazione delle risorse, nonché sviluppo, condivisione e adozione di innovazioni tecniche, modelli di costo del ciclo di vita, best practice, KPI e informazioni di benchmarking con la comunità globale delle strutture.
• Servizi di ingegneria diretta che includono il costo del ciclo di vita, la conservazione dell'energia, la gestione degli asset, l'ingegneria dell'affidabilità, la misurazione delle prestazioni e la pianificazione delle risorse.
• Diretti e conduce gli sforzi per garantire politiche, procedure e pratiche connesse all'ingegneria sono efficaci, efficienti e coerenti. Fornisce aggiornamenti regolari e coerenti su strutture e questioni ingegneristiche per supportare la consapevolezza e la continuità in corso delle operazioni aziendali.
• Interagisce ad alto livello con risorse interne ed esterne per garantire che la Società sia conforme alle normative locali, statali, federali e societarie, nonché al sistema di qualità interno e ai programmi di conformità alle normative.

• Direkte Anlagenbetriebe und Wartungsprogramme Leistungsmessung, Service-Provider-Management und Ressourcenplanung sowie Entwicklung, Austausch und Übernahme technischer Innovationen, Life Cycle Costing-Modelle, Best Practices, KPIs und Benchmarking-Informationen mit der globalen Einrichtungen-Community.
• Direkte Engineering-Dienste, die Lebenszyklus-Kosten, Energieeinsparung, Asset Management, Zuverlässigkeit Engineering, Leistungsmessung und Ressourcenplanung umfassen.
• Direkte und führende Anstrengungen zur Gewährleistung ingenieurtechnischer Strategien, Verfahren und Praktiken sind wirksam, effizient und konsistent. Bietet regelmäßige, konsequente Updates zu Einrichtungen und Ingenieursfragen, um das kontinuierliche Bewusstsein und die Kontinuität des Geschäftsbetriebs zu unterstützen.
• Interagiert auf hohem Niveau mit internen und externen Ressourcen, um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen in Übereinstimmung mit lokalen, staatlichen, Bundes- und Unternehmensvorschriften sowie internen Qualitätssystem und regulatorischen Compliance-Programmen ist.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous un leader visionnaire passionné par la transformation des installations pour appuyer les sciences de pointe et les soins aux patients? Rejoignez Roche Diagnostics en tant que directeur des installations et de l'ingénierie pour nos sites de Bay Area, où vous prendrez en charge l'orientation stratégique et l'excellence opérationnelle de nos campus Pleasanton et Santa Clara. Ce rôle central offre l'occasion de superviser les grands projets d'immobilisations, d'optimiser les plans directeurs du site et d'améliorer continuellement la fiabilité, la sécurité et l'efficacité. En tant que membre clé de l'équipe de leadership du site, vous inspirerez et développerez une équipe hautement performante, favoriserez une culture d'innovation et veillerez à ce que nos installations répondent aux normes de conformité et de performance les plus élevées. Ce rôle est responsable du leadership stratégique de toutes les initiatives en matière d'installations et d'ingénierie dans la région de Bay (Pleasanton et Santa Clara ). Il s'agit notamment de diriger les opérations et l'entretien, de planifier la maîtrise du campus, de stratégies d'investissement en immobilisations et d'exécution, de gérer le cycle de vie des biens et d'ingénierie de la fiabilité. Le directeur est ultimement responsable de s'assurer que les activités des installations sont conformes, fiables, responsables sur le plan financier et appuient directement les objectifs opérationnels généraux de l'organisation. Ce leader inspire et renforce une culture d'excellence opérationnelle où chaque employé peut atteindre des résultats extraordinaires pour les clients et les patients chaque jour. L'opportunité Responsabilités
• Supervise la curation et la gestion du portefeuille des installations CAPEX pour les sites de diagnostic de Roche dans la région de Bay. Dirige tous les projets d'immobilisations liés aux installations à l'appui du plan directeur des installations. Les projets d'immobilisations vont de 100 000 à 100 000 000 dollars, les responsabilités étant les suivantes : portée du projet, coûts et calendrier, élaboration et présentation de documents de financement à la haute direction, construction, coordination des déménagements et clôture du projet. Peut diriger la planification et l'exécution des projets d'immobilisations à l'extérieur de la baie en fonction des besoins et des ressources disponibles.
• Élaborer et exécuter des plans directeurs d'installations stratégiques annuels et à long terme fondés sur les plans d'activités du site. L'élaboration et l'exécution du plan exigent une interaction dans tous les domaines fonctionnels de l'entreprise et de la haute direction, avec de solides compétences en négociation pour résoudre des problèmes complexes touchant presque tous les employés des sites de Roche.
• Mesure du rendement des programmes d'exploitation et d'entretien des installations, gestion des fournisseurs de services et planification des ressources, mise au point, partage et adoption d'innovations techniques, de modèles d'établissement des coûts du cycle de vie, de pratiques exemplaires, d'IPK et d'informations comparatives avec la communauté mondiale des installations.
• Services d'ingénierie directe comprenant l'établissement des coûts du cycle de vie, la conservation de l'énergie, la gestion des actifs, l'ingénierie de la fiabilité, la mesure des performances et la planification des ressources.
• Dirige et dirige les efforts visant à assurer l'efficacité, l'efficience et la cohérence des politiques, procédures et pratiques liées à l'ingénierie. Fournit des mises à jour régulières et uniformes sur les installations et les questions d'ingénierie pour appuyer la sensibilisation continue et la continuité des opérations.
• Interagit à un niveau élevé avec les ressources internes et externes pour s'assurer que la Société est en conformité avec les règlements locaux, des États, fédéraux et ministériels ainsi que le système de qualité interne et les programmes de conformité réglementaires.

jobs.title: 实习医药信息顾问
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

职位职责：
• （1）协助在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2）协助进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3）协助开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4）协助及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （1）在校大学生
• （2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner (Contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

The Mission

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche Hong Kong and Macau. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• The PJP will deliver better outcomes for patients, better community value and better commercial results, the latter being the consequence of the first two. Committing to improving better care outcomes for patients is good business.

• This role is locally embedded in the Hong Kong ecosystem, it is an integrated role, primary point of contact, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example, in the network way of working. This is where solutions are sourced from the internal and external network first, to avoid duplications, and to achieve better patient outcomes faster.

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example in accelerating the digital maturity of Roche internally and in the external healthcare environment, aligned with the long term Roche vision of Personalized Health Care.

Major Accountabilities

• All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

• This position profile serves only to give a broad outline of the duties required and will be renewed and amended at periodic intervals in the consultation with the incumbent.

• The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• With regards to the ecosystems of Hong Kong and Macau, the PJP will continue to evolve the collaboration within the ecosystem of HA clusters, public and private partnerships and the smooth rolling out of healthcare system changes in which the HSPs will be shaping.

Details:

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with both Hong Kong and Macau partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient

• The PJP will deliver better outcomes for patients, better community value and better commercial results, the latter being the consequence of the first two. Committing to improving better care outcomes for patients is good business.

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives
• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example, in the network way of working. This is where solutions are sourced from the internal and external network first, to avoid duplications, and to achieve better patient outcomes faster.
• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example in accelerating the digital maturity of Roche internally and in the external healthcare environment, aligned with the long term Roche vision of Personalized Health Care. Major Accountabilities
• All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.
• This position profile serves only to give a broad outline of the duties required and will be renewed and amended at periodic intervals in the consultation with the incumbent.

jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English, Arabic is advantage

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
工作职责

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域相关科学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案。

• 运用专业知识，传递诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升。

• 拜访临床及病理医生，维护客户关系，按时按质的完成相关客户洞见，尤其重点专家对于疾病领域洞见的收集并进行总结/分析/反馈。

• 组织/协调/整合各类疾病领域学术会议，推动建立疾病领域治疗规范。

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力要求

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力和业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• ​3年以上医药行业工作经验，医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking an experienced SAP EWM Specialist who independently leads EWM solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to the architecture for the global Roche ASPIRE EWM System.

In this role, you will guide product developments, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. By bringing advanced EWM knowledge, expertise within GxP environments, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and the evolution of our warehouse processes across Roche.

Description of the area:
Job Responsibilities

• Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.

• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to the EWM system and its interfaces. Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• A minimum of five years of experience is required in independently leading and delivering complex solution designs and products within the Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) domain.

• Background in logistics or supply chain.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation.

Technical Skills

• SAP EWM certifications.

• Advanced knowledge o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer with MFS experience to join our team and take ownership of a highly complex, validated warehouse management solution. This warehouse is one of the biggest ones of the Roche Pharma division with a high degree of automation. You guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level.

The Opportunity

• Design & Implementation : Develop and implement complex enhancements to our SAP EWM solution, including MFS and WebDynpro user interfaces

• Independent Problem-Solving : Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions; troubleshoot issues at the code level without requiring constant guidance

• Technical Deep-Dive : Investigate complex technical challenges, debug code, and optimize system performance

• Stakeholder Collaboration : Work closely with business teams to understand requirements, manage expectations, and communicate technical constraints and timelines

• Validated Environment Management : Execute changes in compliance with our regulated environment, including documentation, test cases, and validation requirements

• Knowledge Transfer : Document solutions and share expertise with team members to build organizational capability

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

Required Qualifications

• Extensive SAP EWM Experience : Minimum 5+ years working with SAP EWM in production environments, including complex configurations and customizations

• MFS Expertise : Proven hands-on experience implementing and maintaining SAP MFS

• ABAP Development Skills : Solid programming background with ability to debug, and optimize ABAP code

• Validated Environment Experience : Demonstrated familiarity with regulated environments, change management processes, and compliance documentation

• SAFe Framework Knowledge : Working understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices

• Fluent English : Strong verbal and written communication skills (essential)

• German Language (Preferred) : Fluency in German is a significant plus

Who you are:

• Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 15%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM Stiamo cercando un esperto senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer con esperienza MFS per unire il nostro team e prendere la proprietà di una soluzione di gestione del magazzino altamente complessa e validata. Questo magazzino è uno dei più grandi della divisione Roche Pharma con un alto grado di automazione. Guida team di prodotti, responsabilità dei campioni e comunica efficacemente con tutti gli stakeholder. Si risolverà problemi complessi, prendere decisioni indipendenti a livello di prodotto, fornire la supervisione tecnica, e rapporto a livello di prodotto. L'opportunità
• Progettazione e attuazione: sviluppare e implementare miglioramenti complessi alla nostra soluzione SAP EWM, comprese le interfacce utente MFS e WebDynpro
• Indipendente Problem-Solving: analizzare i requisiti aziendali e tradurli in soluzioni tecniche; risolvere i problemi a livello di codice senza richiedere una guida costante
• Deep-Dive tecnico: individuare complesse sfide tecniche, debug code e ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali per comprendere i requisiti, gestire le aspettative e comunicare vincoli tecnici e tempistiche
• Gestione dell'ambiente convalidata: Eseguire le modifiche nel rispetto del nostro ambiente regolamentato, inclusi i requisiti di documentazione, casi di test e convalida
• Knowledge Transfer: soluzioni di documenti e competenze con i membri del team per costruire capacità organizzative
• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, workshop e impegno dei clienti Qualificazioni richieste
• Ampia esperienza SAP EWM: minimo 5+ anni di lavoro con SAP EWM in ambienti produttivi, comprese configurazioni complesse e personalizzazioni
• Competenza MFS: comprovata esperienza di attuazione e mantenimento di SAP MFS
• ABAP Development Skills: Solid background di programmazione con capacità di debug e ottimizzare il codice ABAP
• Esperienza ambientale convalidata: familiarità dimostrata con ambienti regolamentati, processi di gestione dei cambiamenti e documentazione di conformità
• Conoscenza quadro SAFe: comprensione di lavoro dei principi e delle pratiche di Agile Framework (SAFe)
• Inglese fluente: Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta (essenziale)
• Lingua tedesca (preferita) : La fluenza in tedesco è un vantaggio significativo Chi sei:
• Campo d'insalatura 14.175 - 26.325 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.
• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 15%).
• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).
• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).
• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.
• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).
• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport.
• Aggiunti di acquisto azionario.
• Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e automobili e molti altri! descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer mit MFS-Erfahrung, um unserem Team beizutreten und sich an eine hochkomplexe, validierte Lagerverwaltungslösung zu beteiligen. Dieses Lager ist eines der größten der Division Roche Pharma mit einem hohen Automatisierungsgrad. Sie führen Produktteams, Champion-Rechenbarkeit und kommunizieren effektiv mit allen Stakeholdern. Sie werden komplexe Probleme lösen, unabhängige Entscheidungen auf Produktebene treffen, technische Aufsicht und auf Produktebene berichten. Die Chance
• Design & Implementierung: Entwickeln und implementieren Sie komplexe Erweiterungen unserer SAP EWM-Lösung, einschließlich MFS und WebDynpro-Benutzeroberflächen
• Unabhängiges Problem-Solving : Analysieren Sie die Geschäftsanforderungen und übersetzen Sie sie in technische Lösungen; Fehlerbehebung Probleme auf Code-Ebene ohne ständige Anleitung
• Technischer Deep-Dive : Untersuchung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen, Debug-Code und Optimierung der Systemleistung
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Geschäftsteams zusammen, um Anforderungen zu verstehen, Erwartungen zu verwalten und technische Zwänge und Fristen zu kommunizieren
• Validiertes Umweltmanagement: Erarbeitung von Änderungen in Übereinstimmung mit unserer geregelten Umgebung, einschließlich Dokumentation, Testfälle und Validierungsanforderungen
• Wissenstransfer : Dokumentenlösungen und Erfahrungsaustausch mit Teammitgliedern, um organisatorische Fähigkeiten aufzubauen
• Reisen in die Schweiz nach Bedarf für Unterstützung vor Ort, Workshops und Kundenbindung Erforderliche Qualifikationen
• Umfangreiche SAP EWM Erfahrung: Mindestens 5+ Jahre mit SAP EWM in Produktionsumgebungen, einschließlich komplexer Konfigurationen und Anpassungen
• MFS-Expertise : Bewährte Erfahrungen bei der Implementierung und Aufrechterhaltung von SAP MFS
• ABAP Development Skills : Solide Programmierung Hintergrund mit der Fähigkeit, zu debug, und optimieren ABAP-Code
• Validierte Umwelterfahrung: Demonstrierte Vertrautheit mit geregelten Umgebungen, Änderungsmanagementverfahren und Compliance-Dokumentation
• SAFe-Framework-Wissen: Arbeitsverstehen von Skalierten Agile-Framework (SAFe) Prinzipien und Praktiken
• fließendes Englisch: Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (wesentliche)
• Deutsche Sprache (vorgezogen) : Fluency in German ist ein signifikantes Plus Wer du bist:
• Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN brutto auf der Grundlage des Arbeitsvertrags.
• Jährliche Bonuszahlung auf Basis Ihrer Leistung (Ziel 15%).

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Near Patient Care , we create the tools that help people with diabetes think less about their daily routine and more about their lives. Our Indianapolis site is a global hub for blood glucose strip manufacturing and the future home of our next-generation continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors.

The Opportunity
As a Controls Engineer , you are the technical backbone of our automated production lines. You won’t just be sitting at a desk; you’ll be hands-on with high-speed equipment, ensuring our manufacturing processes are stable, validated, and constantly improving.

What You’ll Do

• Optimize & Innovate: Lead the evolution of our automation and electromechanical processes. You’ll use data and operator feedback to make our lines faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Launch New Tech: Partner with R&D and Process Development to bridge the gap between design and high-volume manufacturing for new product launches.

• Own the Controls: Program, modify, and troubleshoot the "brains" of our machines, ensuring every sensor, motor, and PLC is performing at peak efficiency.

• Manage Quality & Validation: Lead equipment qualifications (IQ/OQ/PQ) and ensure all process changes meet strict regulatory standards without sacrificing production speed.

• Strategic Leadership: Manage multiple project lifecycles, mentor junior staff, and provide expert on-call support to keep our 24/7 operations running smoothly.

• On-Site: Engineers are dedicated to the Indianapolis site. Travel typically < 10%.

What You’ll Bring

• PLC & HMI Proficiency: Deep experience with Allen Bradley (RSLogix/Studio 5000) and FactoryTalk View. You are comfortable modifying code to drive continuous improvement.

• The "Troubleshooter" Mindset: Strong knowledge of electromechanical systems, motion controls (Servos/VFDs), Distributed I/O, sensors, and Cognex/Keyence Vision Systems.

• Validation Expertise: Proven ability to develop and execute equipment qualification protocols and write clear, technical documentation.

• Vendor Management: Experience collaborating with external partners to source specialized solutions or navigate component obsolescence.

• Analytical Drive: A highly logical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to run simulations and use test data to make informed decisions.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or closely related discipline with a minimum of 2 years of related experience; advanced degree may substitute for previous experience or equivalent experience

• Related experience must include troubleshooting, modifying, and/or developing industrial equipment controls systems (PLCs, HMIs, Motion Control, etc.)

Preferred:

• Familiar with GMP in a regulated environment (Medical Device or Pharmaceutical).

• Strong electro-mechanical skills that can look at the machine from all engineering aspects: mechanical, electrical, and controls.

• Previous experience troubleshooting controls systems of high volume/speed manufacturing equipment.

• Previous training or experience in Process Improvement Methodologies (e.g. LSS, PDCA, etc.).

• Demonstrates excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.

• Strong ability to teach and educate key stakeholders and other colleagues.

• Deep commitment to cross-functional collaboration and breaking down silos to achieve the best results for the organization.

This is an onsite role in Indianapolis. Relocation benefits are not available.

The expected salary range for the Manufacturing

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

Our Verification and Validation team, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is responsible for ensuring a software product meets its specified requirements and performs as intended by rigorously testing and analyzing the software throughout its development lifecycle.

As a Principal Software Developer in Test, you will be responsible for test design, development, automation, deployment, execution, and reporting. Specifically, you will develop an integrated hardware-software framework for end-to-end test automation that leverages a third-party Hardware-in-the-Loop solution. In this role, you will represent quality engineering and verification on behalf of your team in all events and activities related to this effort, working closely with software and hardware engineers across multiple global locations.

The Opportunity

• You develop solutions for Hardware-in-the-Loop testing for end-to-end testing of embedded instrument software

• You author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including:

• Testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.)

• Testing level (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.)

• Testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.)

• You automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering for:

• Instrument software

• Web applications

• You automate deployment and testing pipelines across branches and stages

• You report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards

• You perform root cause analysis of defects and discoveries

• You develop automation frameworks and validate automation toolchains

• You ensure regulatory compliance of quality engineering deliverables

• You partner with Test Architects, Test Leads, and Verification & Validation Leads on practices

• You collaborate with designers, architects, developers, system engineers and testers on product development

• You participate in all development events, and activities and guide junior testing team members as needed

• Technologies which may be utilized : C++, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Gherkin, Playwright, Windows, Cypress/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG, Typescript/Javascript, Angular, Docker, Jenkins, Groovy, Bash, Jira, Github, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux, MS SQL, Vector HIL Solutions

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related. Advanced degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered, with three years of experience for each year of missing education

• You have 10+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience with Jav

jobs.title: Enterprise Identity Management Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a Enterprise Identity Management Engineer to serve as a senior primary architect of our Enterprise Identity Management (IGA) future. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will design, build, and deliver next-generation identity solutions operating at global scale. Positioned at the intersection of security engineering and business enablement, you'll create resilient frameworks that protect critical systems while enabling seamless, automated access. As a technical visionary, you'll tackle the most complex identity challenges within our large-scale enterprise ecosystem.

The Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you will act as a primary architect driving the evolution of our Enterprise Identity Management strategy. You'll own the complete technical lifecycle, from designing scalable solutions to delivering resilient implementations across our global infrastructure.

Main Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end technical design of EIM solutions aligned with enterprise standards and security policies

• Define and standardize architecture patterns, best practices, and reusable frameworks

• Conduct design reviews and provide technical governance for scalable, high-quality implementations

• Translate security and business requirements into actionable technical solutions

• Architect, build, test, and deploy SailPoint-based IAM solutions from the ground up

• Deliver resilient identity solutions across complex, distributed environments

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation and production rollout

• Own delivery lifecycle end-to-end, including planning, estimation, timelines, and risk management

• Act as Tier 3 escalation point, leading root cause analysis and long-term fixes

• Drive innovation through PoCs and adoption of modern EIM Integrations (APIs, cloud integrations)

Who You Are
Core Expertise & Experience

• Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in Identity Management within large-scale, global environments.

• 3+ years experience working in a multinational work environment (Healthcare Industry experience a plus) as an Engineer/Technical team member

• Strong customer engagement and presentation skills with the ability to communicate across all levels (senior and/or small audiences)

• Deep technical expertise in SailPoint, specifically in design, custom development, troubleshooting, and architecture.

• Ability to work effectively with team members and virtual teams from different locations and different cultural background

• Ability to function independently with little supervision

• Advanced programming proficiency in Java for developing custom connectors, rules, and complex workflows.

• Proven experience implementing Integration solutions with Active Directory and cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and modern architecture (APIs, microservices, cloud)

• Strong understanding of RBAC, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and access governance frameworks.

Education

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.

• Professional Information Security certifications (e.g., CISSP) is a plus.

If you're an experienced identity architect with deep SailPoint expertise, a passion for solving complex security challenges, and the drive to own end-to-end technical delivery in a multinational environment, we want to hear from you.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posti

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1. 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2. 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1. 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户 ( 尤其重点专家 ) 对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2. 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识； 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )
• ● 既往有销售 / 市场 / 医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过 RDPAC 考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
