jobs.title: Filling Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: GPC Compliance Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission

As a GPC Compliance Assurance Specialist, you will be responsible for safeguarding the Global Patient Care (GPC) Organization by ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and safety protocols. Your mission is to move beyond service quality to a rigorous model of Compliance Monitoring across all customer channels.
You will act as a primary point of contact of GPC’s "Inspection Ready" status. By managing audit schedules, maintaining critical documentation, and liaising with Global Post Market Quality and Local Safety Officers, you will ensure that customer interactions and processes meet the highest legal and medical regulatory standards. You will identify systemic risks and implement corrective actions to maintain the integrity of our patient care operations.

Key Accountabilities

• Compliance Monitoring: Conduct regular, systematic compliance audits across all supported channels to ensure adherence to safety reporting and regulatory guidelines.

• Documentation Management: Author, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and relevant compliance documentation to reflect current global and local requirements.

• Audit Management: Lead the preparation and management of the GPC audit schedule; coordinate all "pre-work" to ensure the organization is prepared for internal and external inspections.

• Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the key point of contact for affiliate Local Safety Officers (LSOs) and Global Post Market Quality teams to align on safety reporting and quality standards.

• Audit Participation: Actively participate in GPC-relevant audits, providing evidence, responding to inquiries, and managing the documentation trail.

• Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA): Identify compliance gaps and collaborate with leadership to design and implement corrective measures and process improvements.

• Risk Mitigation: Communicate significant regulatory risks or compliance deviations to local and global management in a timely and transparent manner.

• Regulatory Alignment: Ensure that all GPC activities remain in full alignment with medical device regulations, pharmacovigilance standards, and data privacy laws.

Key Skills and Experience

• Language: A fluent command of English is required; additional languages are a distinct advantage.

• Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality Management, Regulatory Compliance, or Auditing, preferably within a medical device, pharmaceutical, or highly regulated environment.

• Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of Post Market Surveillance, Pharmacovigilance reporting, and relevant ISO standards.

• Attention to Detail: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to spot minute deviations in documentation or agent workflows.

• Communication: Ability to communicate complex regulatory requirements to non-compliance stakeholders clearly and persuasively.

• Organizing skills: Proven ability to manage audit schedules, meet strict deadlines, and coordinate multi-departmental preparation efforts.

• Systems Literacy: Proficient in IT navigation and Quality Management Systems (QMS); ability to quickly learn new compliance tracking technologies.

• Mindset: Highly ethical, detail-oriented, and resilient. You must be comfortable working with autonomy while maintaining a collaborative approach with global safety teams.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

The Position
Die Customer Area Near Patient Care (NPC) vereint die Portfolios Point of Care und Diabetes Care von Roche. Mit unserer Leidenschaft bringen wir Tests näher an Patienten und befähigen Menschen, ihre eigene Gesundheit besser zu überwachen. Innerhalb von NPC Operations sind wir global für die End-to-End-Produktion von Lösungen für die kontinuierliche Glukose-Überwachung (CGM), die Blutzuckermessung (BGM) und Insulin Delivery (IDS) sowie für Point-of-Care (POC)-Produkte verantwortlich. Unsere wichtigsten internen Produktionsstätten sind Mannheim in Deutschland und Indianapolis in den USA.

Das Umfeld
Als CxM Finished Goods sind wir mit rund 25 Kolleg:innen in Mannheim und Rotkreuz Teil von Manufacturing Science and Technology im Bereich NPC Operations. Für unser CGM Accu-Check SmartGuide verantworten wir den globalen Auf- und Ausbau sowie das Betreiben der externen Fertigungsstufe. Zusammen mit unseren strategischen Equipment- und Produktionspartnern entwickeln wir robuste Prozesse und Anlagen. Durch eine hohe Standardisierung sichern wir wettbewerbsfähige Herstellungskosten und eine zuverlässige Produktion. Wir stellen damit die Versorgung mit konformen Produkten in Qualität, Zeit und Kosten für die aktuellen und zukünftigen Produktgenerationen sicher und pflegen das Produkt über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.

Die Position
Als Head of CxM Finished Goods - Projects leiten Sie ein globales Team von technischen Projektleiter:innen. Ihr Team verantwortet die Industrialisierung von R&D-Konzepten in standardisierte und robust skalierbare Anlagendesigns, die für die globale Massenproduktion geeignet sind und gewährleisten herstellbares Produktdesign (Design for Manufacturability). Dabei agieren Sie an den Schnittstelle zwischen Equipmentherstellern, externen Betreiber (Contract Manufacturer) und internen Fachbereichen (z.B. R&D, Einkauf, Quality, interne Produktion) und verantworten Kapazitätserweiterungsprojekte speziell für Spritzgussteile und die finale Assemblierung unserer CGM-Produkte. Sie sind massgeblich am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung des Lieferantenökosystems beteiligt, pflegen aktiv ein externes Netzwerk aus Technologiepartnern und sind mit den relevanten industriellen Standards und Trends bestens vertraut. Zudem setzt Ihr Team Product Care Projekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktteam zur Proudukt-, Prozess und Kostenoptimierungen. Sie definieren effiziente Ablaufprozesse und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter, um zuverlässig und effizient Projektinhalte abzuliefern und die Fähigkeiten der Zulieferindustrie optimal zu nutzen.

Deine Aufgabe

• Teamführung und lokale Ansprechperson: Du leitest das Teams „CxM Finished Goods - Projects“ diziplinarisch und fachlich. Durch eine vorausschauende Bedarfsplanung formst du eine leistungsstarke Einheit, identifizierst und förderst Talente gezielt und stellst durch eine kontinuierliche Qualifizierung der Mitarbeitenden sicher, dass die Kompetenzen im Team stetig mit den technologischen Anforderungen wachsen. Als lokale Ansprechperson in Mannheim schaffst du ein vertrauensvolles und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld und pflegst ein Netzwerk mit den lokalen Schnittstellen.

Dabei stellst du eine transparente Planung und zuverlässige Einhaltung der Qualität der Inhalte und Timelines sicher. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Die Customer Area Near Patient Care (NPC) vereint die Portfolios Point of Care und Diabetes Care von Roche. Mit unserer Leidenschaft bringen wir Tests näher an Patienten und befähigen Menschen, ihre eigene Gesundheit besser zu überwachen. Innerhalb von NPC Operations sind wir global für die End-to-End-Produktion von Lösungen für die kontinuierliche Glukose-Überwachung (CGM), die Blutzuckermessung (BGM) und Insulin Delivery (IDS) sowie für Point-of-Care (POC)-Produkte verantwortlich. Unsere wichtigsten internen Produktionsstätten sind Mannheim in Deutschland und Indianapolis in den USA. Das Umfeld Als CxM Finished Goods sind wir mit rund 25 Kolleg:innen in Mannheim und Rotkreuz Teil von Manufacturing Science and Technology im Bereich NPC Operations. Für unser CGM Accu-Check SmartGuide verantworten wir den globalen Auf- und Ausbau sowie das Betreiben der externen Fertigungsstufe. Zusammen mit unseren strategischen Equipment- und Produktionspartnern entwickeln wir robuste Prozesse und Anlagen. Durch eine hohe Standardisierung sichern wir wettbewerbsfähige Herstellungskosten und eine zuverlässige Produktion. Wir stellen damit die Versorgung mit konformen Produkten in Qualität, Zeit und Kosten für die aktuellen und zukünftigen Produktgenerationen sicher und pflegen das Produkt über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Die Position Als Head of CxM Finished Goods - Projects leiten Sie ein globales Team von technischen Projektleiter:innen. Ihr Team verantwortet die Industrialisierung von R&D-Konzepten in standardisierte und robust skalierbare Anlagendesigns, die für die globale Massenproduktion geeignet sind und gewährleisten herstellbares Produktdesign (Design for Manufacturability). Dabei agieren Sie an den Schnittstelle zwischen Equipmentherstellern, externen Betreiber (Contract Manufacturer) und internen Fachbereichen (z.B. R&D, Einkauf, Quality, interne Produktion) und verantworten Kapazitätserweiterungsprojekte speziell für Spritzgussteile und die finale Assemblierung unserer CGM-Produkte. Sie sind massgeblich am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung des Lieferantenökosystems beteiligt, pflegen aktiv ein externes Netzwerk aus Technologiepartnern und sind mit den relevanten industriellen Standards und Trends bestens vertraut. Zudem setzt Ihr Team Product Care Projekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktteam zur Proudukt-, Prozess und Kostenoptimierungen. Sie definieren effiziente Ablaufprozesse und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter, um zuverlässig und effizient Projektinhalte abzuliefern und die Fähigkeiten der Zulieferindustrie optimal zu nutzen. Deine Aufgabe
• Teamführung und lokale Ansprechperson: Du leitest das Teams „CxM Finished Goods - Projects“ diziplinarisch und fachlich. Durch eine vorausschauende Bedarfsplanung formst du eine leistungsstarke Einheit, identifizierst und förderst Talente gezielt und stellst durch eine kontinuierliche Qualifizierung der Mitarbeitenden sicher, dass die Kompetenzen im Team stetig mit den technologischen Anforderungen wachsen. Als lokale Ansprechperson in Mannheim schaffst du ein vertrauensvolles und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld und pflegst ein Netzwerk mit den lokalen Schnittstellen.
• Exzellenz in der Projektabwicklung: Du verantwortest die professionelle Steuerung des gesamten Projektportfolios von CxM Finished Goods. Dabei stellst du eine transparente Planung und zuverlässige Einhaltung der Qualität der Inhalte und Timelines sicher. Durch effizientes Risiko- und Ressourcenmanagement stellst du die Kosteneffizienz üb

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is initially for a fixed-term contract 12 months. The employment contract will be concluded by our vendor/third party for outsourcing services.

We have a fantastic and challenging opportunity to fully combine your recruiting and consulting skills to seek, attract, and bring in the very best talent into Roche. This is with a focus on supporting the demand for talent within our Roche EMEA region.

As a Talent Acquisition Partner you will play a pivotal role in ensuring we are hiring the best talent to meet our business ambitions. Make Your Mark. Improve Lives.
You will be part of the Roche EMEA Recruiting team, a group of highly skilled professionals in our Integrated Workforce Strategies organization.

The geographic focus will be Extended Eastern Europe (EEE) & CIS countries, however you will also be collaborating closely within the Region EMEA where we swarm our capacities to achieve our region’s goals as one team, and also within our global network.
This position reports to the Recruiting Lead EEE & CIS countries.

Your Impact

• Be a professional and consultative partner for our business leaders regarding all talent acquisition aspects

• Expertly drive end-to-end recruiting processes and provide customized talent acquisition strategies and solutions, including active candidate sourcing & pipelining, talent marketing, talent selection, candidate experience, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

• Manage the offer process with all necessary stakeholders (create an offer proposal following our Roche compensation and benefits framework and pay equity considerations, obtain approvals, extend offers, and negotiate with the candidate if required)

• Closely collaborate with the other People and Culture colleagues in-country, particularly the Business Partners to have insight about the coming business priorities, and the People Relations Partners to ensure a high confidentiality of recruitment-related topics

• May lead recruitment transformation projects across functions/countries

Who You Are

• University degree in Human Resources Management, Business Management, Economics, Marketing, Finance is preferred

• You are fluent in English but also having additional language skills are an advantage

• You are preferably working in the Life Science/Tech industry and have a high passion for People and Culture, particularly for Talent Acquisition with proven success as a recruiter or head-hunter

• You are well-versed in talent attraction, sourcing, and assessing across multiple geographies and varied levels of complexity and expert in applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, LinkedIn

• You excel at building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders across all levels, both within our business and the People and Culture team, leveraging excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills to collaborate, negotiate, and innovate effectively

• You have excellent coaching and advising skills, and thus are a trusted partner to your business clients and enable them in their hiring decisions

• You can work in a multinational matrix organization with the dexterity to participate in or lead recruiting squads across regions or globally
Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/month. Final salary will depend on the level of experience and skills.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare toda

The Position This role is initially for a fixed-term contract 12 months. The employment contract will be concluded by our vendor/third party for outsourcing services. We have a fantastic and challenging opportunity to fully combine your recruiting and consulting skills to seek, attract, and bring in the very best talent into Roche. This is with a focus on supporting the demand for talent within our Roche EMEA region. As a Talent Acquisition Partner you will play a pivotal role in ensuring we are hiring the best talent to meet our business ambitions. Make Your Mark. Improve Lives. You will be part of the Roche EMEA Recruiting team, a group of highly skilled professionals in our Integrated Workforce Strategies organization. The geographic focus will be Extended Eastern Europe (EEE) & CIS countries, however you will also be collaborating closely within the Region EMEA where we swarm our capacities to achieve our region’s goals as one team, and also within our global network. This position reports to the Recruiting Lead EEE & CIS countries. Your Impact
• Be a professional and consultative partner for our business leaders regarding all talent acquisition aspects
• Expertly drive end-to-end recruiting processes and provide customized talent acquisition strategies and solutions, including active candidate sourcing & pipelining, talent marketing, talent selection, candidate experience, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
• Manage the offer process with all necessary stakeholders (create an offer proposal following our Roche compensation and benefits framework and pay equity considerations, obtain approvals, extend offers, and negotiate with the candidate if required)
• Closely collaborate with the other People and Culture colleagues in-country, particularly the Business Partners to have insight about the coming business priorities, and the People Relations Partners to ensure a high confidentiality of recruitment-related topics
• May lead recruitment transformation projects across functions/countries Who You Are
• University degree in Human Resources Management, Business Management, Economics, Marketing, Finance is preferred
• You are fluent in English but also having additional language skills are an advantage
• You are preferably working in the Life Science/Tech industry and have a high passion for People and Culture, particularly for Talent Acquisition with proven success as a recruiter or head-hunter
• You are well-versed in talent attraction, sourcing, and assessing across multiple geographies and varied levels of complexity and expert in applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, LinkedIn
• You excel at building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders across all levels, both within our business and the People and Culture team, leveraging excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills to collaborate, negotiate, and innovate effectively
• You have excellent coaching and advising skills, and thus are a trusted partner to your business clients and enable them in their hiring decisions
• You can work in a multinational matrix organization with the dexterity to participate in or lead recruiting squads across regions or globally Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/month. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Reportando al líder de Bids & Contracts en el Área Comercial, tu misión es colaborar de forma decisiva en el proceso integral de participación en licitaciones públicas para operaciones comerciales clave. Como experto de la filial en ofertas complejas, con un profundo conocimiento técnico y alto enfoque comercial , tu función se centra principalmente en asegurar la excelencia técnica y económica en la confección, revisión y presentación de ofertas.

Responsabilidades

• Acompañamiento a ventas : Especialmente en estadios comerciales preliminares visitando Clientes clave para afianzar la relación y garantizar el éxito de las operaciones.

• Asesoramiento experto en operaciones estratégicas: De la mano de ventas complementa las capacidades comerciales para asegurar que se define e implementa una estrategia ganadora que maximice oportunidades y minimice riesgos.

• Revisión exhaustiva de nuestras ofertas para las licitaciones estratégicas seleccionadas, asegurando la competitividad, la sostenibilidad y perfecta redacción.

• Seguimiento exhaustivo de operaciones clave : Monitorizando el proceso integral especialmente desde la fase previa a la publicación hasta la firma del contrato para operaciones complejas (incluyendo aclaraciones, subsanaciones o teniendo un rol clave en la construcción y revisión de los argumentos técnicos para alegaciones o recursos especiales en materia de contratación.

• Análisis holístico de todo el proceso integral de oferta y adjudicación para garantizar el cumplimiento de la estrategia y las simulaciones, lo que le permitirá mantenerse al día con los cambios en el mercado y la competencia. Comparte estos aprendizajes con el resto de la organización para futuras estrategias de licitación.

• Divulgación de los aprendizajes : Ser un referente formativo en ofertas, informando de forma continua de los principales aprendizajes / tendencias / noticias relevantes para otras operaciones. Capacitar al equipo completo de Bids, a la Red Comercial y al resto de la organización sobre la estrategia de ofertas con especial foco a la estrategia técnico-económica.

Requisitos y Habilidades

● Capacidad Analítica para interpretar datos de mercado, pliegos, revisar documentación técnica/económica compleja tanto propia como de la competencia y trabajar bajo presión cumpliendo plazos estrictos.
● Visión Estratégica y organizativa
● Alto nivel de conocimiento técnico y competitivo del mercado IVD y en contratación pública, unidos a una amplia visión comercial y económica
● Pensamiento crítico: Evaluar objetivamente la información, cuestionar suposiciones y tomar decisiones basadas en un análisis riguroso.
● Capacidad para analizar múltiples perspectivas y evidencias, evitando sesgos y prejuicios. Capacidad para resolver problemas y tomar decisiones efectivas en situaciones complejas y con poco tiempo.
● Se requieren excelentes habilidades de redacción y edición, con atención al detalle y capacidad para comunicar ideas complejas de forma clara y concisa.
● Capacidad divulgativa
● Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia en el sector de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) o biotecnología.
● Conocimiento de la legislación española sobre contratación pública.
● Sin ser un requisito, se tendrá en cuenta si el candidato/a tiene experiencia en impugnaciones.

Tu Perfil:
● Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Salud, Biotecnología o similar.
● Experiencia en equipos de ventas o licitaciones en filiales comerciales, preferiblemente en el sector de diagnóstico in vitro, salud o b

titleByLocale.en: Manager/Senior Manager - Central Market Access Strategy, ON
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire/Gestionnaire principal - Stratégie d'accès au marché central, ON

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Manager/Senior Manager - Central Market Access Strategy, I2

您将有机会：
疾病领域产品准入策略

• 产品准入策略及规划： 根据公司整体品牌策略，制定并整合疾病领域新产品及在研产品的整体准入策略，包含医保报销（Reimbursement）、商保创新目录准入（C-list）及基药目录准入等的策略开发。

• 价值建议开发： 与医学、市场部协作，开发具有竞争力的产品价值建议（Value Proposition）及定制化的准入沟通材料及资料（如 DA、Value Deck等） 。

疾病领域产品准入落地执行

• 准入全流程管理： 负责统筹该 TA 在中央层面准入、地方准入互动及动态调整机制下的医保和卫生准入及具体落地工作，协助处理相关异议并确保准入结果交付 。

• 重点项目运营： 策划并执行部门疾病领域重点策略项目，确保项目目标与产品准入需求高度切合 。

• 工具与培训： 支持中央及地方团队的客户沟通，提供沟通工具包使用培训及政策异议处理支持 。

• 区域协同： 与区域准入团队配合，推动落地及本地政策项目的执行 。

疾病领域政策倡导

• 政策洞察与框架构建： 研究并监测国家及地方医药政策趋势（如 DRG/DIP、动态准入等），构建并优化疾病领域的准入政策影响框架 。

• 准入环境塑造： 统筹该疾病领域的政策倡导规划，通过与高层利益相关者（政府机构、智库、学术团体）的合作，推动有利于创新药准入的政策环境和疾病规范化管理 。

疾病领域准入 BP

• 业务战略协同： 作为 NMA 部门与业务部门（CE）、及其他准入团队沟通的桥梁，参与核心讨论及准入建议，确保准入视角融入产品全生命周期策略 。

• 跨团队资源整合： 协调跨部门资源（医学、市场、VEP等），支持疾病领域关键产品在国家/地方准入一体化策略中的执行，提升组织效能 。

• 客户需求洞察： 动态维护内疾病领域内核心政策及影响客户图谱，基于区域需求进行客户的协同拜访等，并针对疾病领域提供差异化的解决方案，提升准入工作的客户导向。

我们期待您：

• 需具备 5 年以上（经理）或8 年以上（高级经理）医疗行业工作经验，其中至少包含 3 年或5年以上市场准入相关经验；

• 教育背景：拥有相关领域的学位（医学、卫生政策、经济学、管理学等），硕士学位优先。

• 专业技能：具备项目管理与执行方面的专业知识者优先。

• 语言能力：具备优秀的英语口语及书面表达能力。

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagementof Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PDof Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the aff

jobs.title: (Senior) Medical Science Manager (Immunology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagementof Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PDof Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the aff

jobs.title: Cybersecurity and Digital Solutions Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is part of the Legal and Compliance department in Diagnostics Division with matrix reporting lines. Your direct report is to Head of Legal and Compliance with dotted line managers Head of Marketing and Head of Professional Services also with direct access to executive directors (as legally required).

The Cybersecurity and Digital Solutions Lead is responsible for developing and implementing cybersecurity policies and protocols to protect Roche's products, information systems and technologies and managing the roadmap, governance, and value realization of key digital initiatives across the Czech Affiliate and its Diagnostics and Pharma businesses. Using your expertise in Roche's products and environment, you will ensure systems comply with all security and regulatory standards. You will also apply your technical skills to manage and mitigate cyber threats.

The Opportunity

• Develop and oversee cybersecurity framework, strategy, policies and procedures (eg. ISO 27001 implementation, NIS2 local implementation) to safeguard digital systems and sensitive information.

• Manage the cybersecurity responsibilities across different teams in Roche Diagnostics and Pharma divisions and ensure cooperation throughout the organization and overall alignment with Roche's security objectives.

• Ensure Regulatory Compliance with cybersecurity and data protection requirements.

• Manage the Risk Framework and monitor risk management activities.

• Perform risk assessments to identify potential cyber threats and establish and coordinate a risk management plan in the context of the organisation as well as individual installation cases.

• Assess system vulnerabilities and implement security measures.

• Monitor network and information security systems for potential breaches and intrusions.

• Coordinate potential cyber security incidents.

• Cooperate and coordinate the process of cybersecurity asset management.

• Conduct regular security audits and compliance checks across all systems and applications and elaborate regular reports on cybersecurity risks and mitigation steps.

• Liaise and communicate directly with the regulatory Authorities and relevant Bodies on topics of cybersecurity.

• Communicate directly and regularly with the management on the topics of cybersecurity, support Executive Management in cybersecurity-related decisions

• Prepare Security Assessments and Reports for Leadership.

• Maintain updated knowledge of cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and technologies.

• Collaborate with external IT and external business units (e.g. hospitals and laboratories, etc.) to ensure effective cybersecurity strategies are integrated into business processes.

• Provide training and awareness programs on cybersecurity best practices for all staff.

• Manage cybersecurity training and awareness programs across business functions.

• Oversee third-party risk management and vendor cybersecurity compliance.

• Define and maintain the digital portfolio roadmap for diagnostics, including connected devices, remote monitoring tools, and AI-driven decision support systems.

• Work cross-functionally with Product Management, IT, and Legal, Compliance and Regulatory teams to ensure timely and compliant delivery.

• Collaborate with all stakeholders (internal/ external) on development and implementation of Digital Products and Solutions strategy.

Who You Are

• Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

• Certifications su

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you someone who finds satisfaction in the details? Do you enjoy the process of systematically checking software to ensure it works perfectly with physical hardware?

In our cross functional and cross Site team, we are looking for a Test Technician with a strong interest in Instrument testing focusing on Software Testing to join our team in Sant Cugat. While you will be working with physical medical instruments, your primary focus will be on the software that drives them—executing test cases, documenting defects, and ensuring the system is reliable for patient use.

Your Role
In this position, you aren't just "clicking buttons"—you are the guardian of software quality. You will be responsible for the consistent execution of test protocols that bridge the gap between digital code and mechanical movement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Software-Centric medical device testing:
• Execute manual test cases focusing on software functionality, with a customer mindset on a medical device.

• Lifecycle Maintenance:
• Create, refine, and update software test cases over the entire life cycle of the medical device.

• Methodical Execution:
• Perform repetitive test cycles with high consistency to ensure software stability across different versions.

• Technical Documentation:
• Document every step of your process. You will record defects and test results with high precision to meet medical regulatory standards.

Your Profile
We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for technology. If you love troubleshooting, have a high affinity for software, and prefer hands-on execution over theoretical concepts, this is the role for you. Formación Profesional (Grado Medio/Superior), no university degree is required—we value your practical skills, technical curiosity, and drive to learn

Background:
Completed apprenticeship or solid job experience in a technical environment, laboratory, or IT-support setting. E.g. Técnico/a de Pruebas, Tester de Software y Hardware, Técnico de Verificación y Validación (V&V), Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataforma, Grado en Ingeniería Informática or similar

The "Tester" Mindset:
You are naturally conscientious and thorough. You enjoy a routine-oriented environment and take pride in performing repetitive tasks with 100% accuracy every time.

Software Affinity:
You have a keen interest in how software operates and a desire to build a career in instrument/system testing (no programming skills needed).

Quality First:
You understand that documenting a test is just as important as performing it.

Soft skills:
Ability to actively contribute to team collaboration, inclusion, sharing ideas and good team spirit, as well as mutual trust and respect (project team and sub chapter level)

Languages skills:
Expert Spanish (C1 or better) and expert English (C1 or better) language skills. The project language is English. Local team language is Spanish

Bonus skills:

• Basic understanding of customer workflows in the area of diagnostic instruments (e.g. in coagulation or serum work area)

• Basic skills with testing tools e.g. Retina

• Initial experience with software testing on instrument level

What you can expect from us:

Teamwork with ambitious and passionate people building high-quality products meeting customer’s needs
An agile working environment allowing for collaboration and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
Fostered collaboration within the project and chapter to build and maintain a tr

descriptionByLocale.it:
# Mansioni

IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

# Descrizione

At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

# Modalità di Lavoro

Roche offre un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in presenza. Al momento, richiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici in ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni di squadra e altri eventi collaborativi.

# Responsabilità

## Mansioni

- Gestisce in modo indipendente i flussi di lavoro dell'analisi aziendale dall'inizio alla fine, affrontando problemi con ambiguità emergente.
- Adatta con disinvoltura una serie di framework standard, mentor analisti junior e intermedi e plasma in modo proattivo i modi di lavorare della squadra e le migliori pratiche.

## Responsabilità/Problem Solving

- Guida l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, esegue ricerche approfondite nel dominio e guida l'analisi delle cause fondamentali.
- È responsabile della consegna di requisiti completi, contribuisce significativamente alla selezione della soluzione e identifica proattivamente le discrepanze tra esigenze e soluzioni per proporre miglioramenti creativi.

## Gestione dei Stakeholder

- Identifica una vasta gamma di stakeholder cross-functionali e costruisce la fiducia attraverso una profonda comprensione del business per agire come un consulente affidabile.
- Organizza workshop, risolve conflitti e plasma proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder per gestire strategicamente le aspettative e allinearle con gli obiettivi del progetto.

## Impatto/Strategia

- Fornisce un impatto su un prodotto, un'iniziativa o un cluster specifico, contribuendo agli obiettivi del dominio garantendo che le soluzioni forniscono valore.

# Opportunità

All'interno dell'Organizzazione Farmaceutica, la Medical Affairs fa da ponte tra lo sviluppo clinico e la commercializzazione dei medicinali. Il dominio si concentra sempre di più sull'impegno con gli stakeholder esterni, con l'obiettivo di derivare approfondite informazioni sulle esigenze mediche non soddisfatte, sulle barriere terapeutiche e sulle percezioni dei pazienti sui dati. Sintetizzando queste informazioni, la Medical Affairs plasma la direzione strategica dell'organizzazione. In qualità di IT Business Analyst in questo spazio, supporterai la trasformazione digitale di come le prove scientifiche vengono generate, gestite e comunicate alla comunità medica globale.

# Requisiti

## Esperienza

- Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione di progetti complessi e nella collaborazione con team cross-functionali.
- Esperienza nella gestione di progetti IT e nella definizione di requisiti.
- Esperienza nella gestione di progetti di trasformazione digitale.

## Conoscenze

- Conoscenza approfondita delle best practice nell'analisi aziendale e nella gestione dei progetti.
- Conoscenza delle tecnologie IT e delle loro interrelazioni.
- Conoscenza del dominio farmaceutico e della ricerca medica.

## Competenze

- Capacità di analisi e risoluzione dei problemi.
- Capacità di gestione dei progetti e dei team.
- Capacità di comunicazione efficace e di gestione degli stakeholder.
- Capacità di adattamento e di apprendimento rapido.

# Cosa Offriamo

## Benefit

- Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e rispettoso.
- L'opportunità di lavorare su progetti che hanno un impatto significativo sulla salute delle persone in tutto il mondo.
- Un pacchetto di benefit competitivo, tra cui una retribuzione equa e vantaggiosa, programmi di formazione e sviluppo professionale, e un'ampia gamma di benefit per la salute e il benessere.

# Contatto

Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro team delle Risorse Umane.

Shipments

IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

Description

At Roche, you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to quote, stop, and care diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Working methods

Roche offers a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with collaboration in the presence. At the moment, we ask our employees to be in our offices on average two days a week. Specific days in the office may vary according to business needs, such as workshops, conferences, team meetings and other collaborative events.

Liability

Shipments

- It independently manages the workflows of corporate analysis from start to finish, addressing problems with emerging ambiguities.
- Fits with ease a set of standard frameworks, junior and intermediate analyst mentor and proactively shapes the ways of teamwork and best practices.

Responsibility/Problem Solving

- Drive the analysis of business problems, perform in-depth research in the domain and guide the analysis of fundamental causes.
- He is responsible for delivering complete requirements, significantly contributes to the selection of the solution and proactively identifies the discrepancies between needs and solutions to propose creative improvements.

Stakeholder Management

- Identifies a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds trust through a deep understanding of business to act as a reliable consultant.
- Organize workshops, resolve conflicts and proactively shape stakeholders' perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project objectives.

Impact/Strategy

- Provides an impact on a specific product, initiative or cluster, contributing to domain objectives ensuring that solutions provide value.

Opportunities

Within the Pharmaceutical Organization, Medical Affairs is a bridge between clinical development and medicinal marketing. The domain is increasingly focused on the commitment with external stakeholders, with the aim of developing in-depth information on unsatisfied medical needs, therapeutic barriers and patient perceptions on data. Synthesizing this information, Medical Affairs shapes the strategic direction of the organization. As an IT Business Analyst in this space, you will support the digital transformation of how scientific evidence is generated, managed and communicated to the global medical community.

Requirements

Experience

- Experience demonstrated in the management of complex projects and in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
- Experience in managing IT projects and defining requirements.
- Experience in managing digital transformation projects.

Knowledge

- In-depth knowledge of best practices in business analysis and project management.
- Knowledge of IT technologies and their interactions.
- Knowledge of pharmaceutical domain and medical research.

Skills

- Ability to analyze and resolve problems.
- Project and team management skills.
- Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to adapt and learn quickly.

What we offer

Benefit

- An inclusive and respectful working environment.
- The opportunity to work on projects that have a significant impact on people's health around the world.
- A competitive benefit package, including fair and advantageous pay, training and professional development programs, and a wide range of health and wellness benefits.

Contact

For more information or to apply, visit our website or contact our Human Resources team.
descriptionByLocale.de: Business Analyst - Pharma R&D Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten zitieren, stoppen und pflegen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Arbeitsmethoden Roche bietet ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit Kollaboration in der Präsenz verbindet. Im Moment bitten wir unsere Mitarbeiter, durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros zu sein. Bestimmte Tage im Büro können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Verantwortung Mansions - Es verwaltet unabhängig die Workflows der Geschäftsanalyse von Anfang bis Ende und steht vor Problemen mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten. - Passt mit Leichtigkeit zu einer Reihe von Standard-Frameworks, Junior- und Intermediate-Analysten-Mentoren und gestaltet proaktiv die Wege der Teamarbeit und Best Practices. Verantwortung / Problemlösung - Leitet die Analyse von Geschäftsproblemen, führt eingehende Recherchen im Bereich durch und leitet die Analyse grundlegender Ursachen. - Es ist für die Bereitstellung vollständiger Anforderungen verantwortlich, trägt wesentlich zur Auswahl der Lösung bei und identifiziert proaktiv die Diskrepanzen zwischen Bedürfnissen und Lösungen, um kreative Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen. Management von Stakeholdern - Identifiziert eine breite Palette von funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern und schafft Vertrauen durch ein tiefes Verständnis des Geschäfts, um als zuverlässiger Berater zu agieren. - Organisieren Sie Workshops, lösen Sie Konflikte und plasma proaktiv die Perspektiven der Stakeholder, um die Erwartungen strategisch zu managen und sie an den Zielen des Projekts auszurichten. Auswirkung/Strategie - Bietet Auswirkungen auf ein bestimmtes Produkt, eine bestimmte Initiative oder ein bestimmtes Cluster und trägt zu Domänenzielen bei, um sicherzustellen, dass Lösungen einen Mehrwert bieten. Innerhalb der Pharma-Organisation ist Medical Affairs eine Brücke zwischen klinischer Entwicklung und medizinischem Marketing. Die Domäne konzentriert sich zunehmend auf die Interaktion mit externen Stakeholdern, mit dem Ziel, detaillierte Informationen über unzufriedene medizinische Bedürfnisse, therapeutische Barrieren und die Wahrnehmung von Daten durch Patienten zu entwickeln. Durch die Synthese dieser Informationen prägt Medical Affairs die strategische Ausrichtung der Organisation. Als IT Business Analyst in diesem Bereich unterstützen Sie die digitale Transformation der Art und Weise, wie wissenschaftliche Beweise generiert, verwaltet und an die globale medizinische Gemeinschaft kommuniziert werden. Erfahrungsanforderungen - Erfahrung im Management komplexer Projekte und in Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. - Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von IT-Projekten und der Definition von Anforderungen. - Erfahrung im Management digitaler Transformationsprojekte. Wissen - Tiefes Wissen über Best Practices in der Geschäftsanalyse und im Projektmanagement. - Kenntnis der IT-Technologien und ihrer Zusammenhänge. - Kenntnisse des pharmazeutischen Bereichs und der medizinischen Forschung. Fähigkeiten - Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. - Projekt- und Teammanagementfähigkeiten. - Effektive Kommunikation und Stakeholder Management Fähigkeiten. - Fähigkeit, sich anzupassen und schnell zu lernen. Was wir bieten Benefit - Ein inklusives und respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld. - Die Möglichkeit, an Projekten zu arbeiten, die erhebliche Auswirkungen auf die Gesundheit der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt haben. - Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket, einschließlich einer fairen und vorteilhaften Bezahlung, Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsprogrammen sowie einer breiten Palette von Gesundheits- und Wellnessvorteilen. Für weitere Informationen oder um sich zu bewerben, besuchen Sie unsere Website oder kontaktieren Sie unser HR-Team.

Expéditions

Analyste des affaires en TI - R-D en pharmacie

Désignation des marchandises

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous avons l'intention de citer, d'arrêter et de soigner les maladies et de veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Méthodes de travail

Roche offre un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en présence. Pour le moment, nous demandons à nos employés d'être dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les journées spécifiques au bureau peuvent varier en fonction des besoins opérationnels, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

Responsabilité

Expéditions

- Il gère indépendamment les flux de travail de l'analyse d'entreprise du début à la fin, s'attaquant aux problèmes avec les ambiguïtés émergentes.
- S'adapte avec facilité à un ensemble de cadres standard, un mentor analyste junior et intermédiaire et façonne de façon proactive les façons de travailler en équipe et les meilleures pratiques.

Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes

- Diriger l'analyse des problèmes commerciaux, effectuer des recherches approfondies dans le domaine et guider l'analyse des causes fondamentales.
- Il est responsable de fournir des exigences complètes, contribue de manière significative à la sélection de la solution et identifie de manière proactive les écarts entre les besoins et les solutions pour proposer des améliorations créatives.

Gestion des parties prenantes

- Identification d'un large éventail d'intervenants interfonctionnels et renforcement de la confiance grâce à une compréhension approfondie des affaires pour agir en tant que consultant fiable.
- Organiser des ateliers, résoudre les conflits et façonner proactivement les perspectives des intervenants pour gérer stratégiquement les attentes et les aligner sur les objectifs du projet.

Impact/stratégie

- Fournit un impact sur un produit, une initiative ou une grappe spécifique, contribuant aux objectifs du domaine, garantissant que les solutions apportent de la valeur.

Possibilités

Au sein de l'Organisation pharmaceutique, les affaires médicales sont un pont entre le développement clinique et la commercialisation des médicaments. Le domaine est de plus en plus axé sur l'engagement avec les parties prenantes externes, dans le but de développer des informations approfondies sur les besoins médicaux non satisfaits, les barrières thérapeutiques et les perceptions des patients sur les données. Synthèse de cette information, Affaires médicales façonne l'orientation stratégique de l'organisation. En tant qu'analyste IT Business dans cet espace, vous soutiendrez la transformation numérique de la façon dont les preuves scientifiques sont générées, gérées et communiquées à la communauté médicale mondiale.

Exigences

Expérience

- Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de projets complexes et en collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles.
- Expérience dans la gestion des projets informatiques et la définition des exigences.
- Expérience dans la gestion de projets de transformation numérique.

Connaissance

- Connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques en matière d'analyse des affaires et de gestion de projets.
- Connaissance des technologies de l'information et de leurs interactions.
- Connaissance du domaine pharmaceutique et de la recherche médicale.

Compétences

- Capacité d'analyser et de résoudre les problèmes.
- Compétences en gestion de projet et d'équipe.
- Capacités de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes.
- Capacité d'adaptation et d'apprentissage rapide.

Ce que nous offrons

Prestations

- Un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux.
- L'occasion de travailler sur des projets qui ont un impact significatif sur la santé des gens partout dans le monde.
- Un ensemble d'avantages concurrentiels, y compris une rémunération équitable et avantageuse, des programmes de formation et de perfectionnement professionnel, et un large éventail d'avantages pour la santé et le bien-être.

Personne à contacter

Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez notre site Web ou contactez notre équipe de ressources humaines.

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor (Coimbatore)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager based in Coimbatore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Coimbatore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each othe

jobs.title: Business Developer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Business Developer , serás responsable de desarrollar e implementar nuevos negocios, mercados y estrategias comerciales en colaboración con el Infectious Diseases Disease Management Squad para Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia . En este rol, actuarás como el nexo clave con el mercado, capturando oportunidades estratégicas con agilidad para aportar valor a los clientes, impulsar el portafolio de Roche y elevar el estándar de cuidado de los pacientes .

The Opportunity

• Diseñar e implementar los planes y estrategias de desarrollo de negocios en total alineación con la estrategia del Disease Management Squad .

• Liderar de punta a punta la ejecución de proyectos de desarrollo de negocios, brindando soporte científico y técnico integral a los clientes .

• Relevar de forma proactiva insights del mercado y de los clientes para compartirlos con el squad , moldeando la estrategia según las necesidades del entorno .

• Co-crear y ejecutar los planes de cuentas clave en colaboración estrecha con los Key Account Managers (KAMs) y los clientes .

• Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas y efectivas con clientes y stakeholders clave del sector científico y técnico para influir en la estrategia de negocio .

• Colaborar con el Healthcare Manager y el equipo multidisciplinar para integrar los aportes del mercado en la estrategia general de la enfermedad .

• Actuar como el punto de contacto principal y referente experto para los clientes dentro de tu área de especialidad .

Who you are

• Profesional graduado en Ciencias Naturales, Bioquímica o carreras afines.

• Experiencia comercial dentro de la industria de diagnóstico o farmacéutica es deseable.

• Conocimientos técnicos críticos y trayectoria demostrable en biología molecular.

• Dominio del idioma inglés para interactuar fluidamente en un entorno global y corporativo .

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación, manejo de objeciones y una fuerte capacidad para influir en múltiples stakeholders .

• Mentalidad orientada al pensamiento sistémico, con alta capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas de negocio .

• Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para viajar de forma frecuente a través de la red de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia .

Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Learning Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity
As a Learning Specialist you are part of a global, international team and contribute to customer experience directly. Your key responsibilities are performing complete, stringent and timely Training & Learning related administrative and organizational tasks in area and understanding its linkage to Personnel Administration and Organizational Management.

• Providing insight, Tier 2 support and explanation on Learning system (Cornerstone), administering and updating Learning Catalog

• Managing course enrollments for learners, managing invitations, registrations, reminders and follow-up on courses and attendance

• Preparing and providing various Training-related reports and status updates for HR professionals and Training Owners

• Functionality testing of new learning management system and a dvising and supporting business with system / testing / Learning processes

• Providing customer service on Training related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way and building relationships with other colleagues within the GLS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

What can you bring to our team:

• Ideally 1-3 years of experience in the fields of HR personnel administrative or service delivery or customer service with a college/university degree

• Accuracy in record keeping, focus and accountability

• The capability to multitask and handle complex cases

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and fluent in written and spoken English .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice, and its conditions can be tailored for employees according to needs (2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share y

jobs.title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Analyst
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As an Senior Analyst, you will collaborate closely with the Strategic Analytics & Insights team based in the US, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads, and the broader GATE team. Your primary responsibility will be to deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights that support strategic priorities, ultimately aiming for the greatest impact with customers and patients.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex projects and initiatives in pharma commercial operations, focusing on Brand Performance tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patient Journeys (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Forecasting, Product launch support and assessment, Patient adherence, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact and ROIs

• Collaborate with Therapy area managers, Ecosystem insights leads and other business stakeholders to understand market dynamics and customer behaviors, leveraging this knowledge to support data-driven strategies

• Comprehend stakeholder requirements, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage day-to-day responsibilities, including liaising and coordinating with the GATE internal team for delivery

• Lead the team and stakeholder discussions, act as thought partner and provide them with high quality analytics solutions and recommendations

• Create impactful presentations to convey crucial insights and recommendations to stakeholders effectively

• Attend meetings with teams across different time zones to ensure smooth delivery of analytical & operations related requests for the business partners

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization, focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value

• Be flexible to attend meeting during IST/PST overlapping working hours

• Provide mentorship and training to junior team members and interns on analytics principles and the Pharma domain, fostering the development of skill sets and capabilities

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor degree in Technology or a relevant discipline, with a preference for Computer Science, Software, Statistics, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and related fields and 4-8 years of analytics / consulting experience, with 2-5 years specifically in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics projects. Preferably, Master’s Degree or any certifications on analytics or data science would be an added advantage.

• Must demonstrate expertise in US Pharma Commercial Operations and possess a strong background in Sales analytics, Claims analytics, Product analysis, Patients analytics, forecasting and ROI analysis

• Experience with a range of secondary data sets, including IQVIA Sales data, 867 data, LAAD Claims, affiliations, field interactions, Veeva, medical data, and more, is a significant advantage

• Exposure to therapeutic areas like oncology, neurology, immunology, etc., along with a working knowledge of Salesforce or Veeva, is a valuable additional qualification

• Str

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Analizzatore senior Roche India – Servizi e Soluzioni Roche Chennai o Hyderabad Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche ha stabilito Global Analytics e Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) per guidare le soluzioni analitiche e tecnologiche, collaborando con gli affiliati Roche in tutto il mondo. In qualità di Senior Analyst, collaborerai a stretto contatto con il team Strategic Analytics & Insights con sede negli Stati Uniti, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads e il team GATE più ampio. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di fornire analisi avanzate e approfondimenti attuabili che supportano le priorità strategiche, in ultima analisi, mirando al massimo impatto con clienti e pazienti. La tua opportunità
• Progetti complessi di piombo e iniziative nelle operazioni commerciali di farmaci, concentrandosi sul monitoraggio delle prestazioni di marca, Panoramica del mercato delle malattie, Viaggi dei pazienti (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Previsione, Supporto e valutazione del lancio del prodotto, Aderenza paziente, Targeting del medico / Account, Payer Mix, Impatto di marketing e ROIs
• Collaborare con Therapy area manager, Ecosystem insights conduce e altri stakeholder aziendali per comprendere dinamiche di mercato e comportamenti dei clienti, sfruttando questa conoscenza per supportare le strategie basate sui dati
• Comprehend requisiti delle parti interessate, priorità dei compiti e gestire efficacemente le responsabilità quotidiane, tra cui liaising e il coordinamento con il team interno GATE per la consegna
• Guidare le discussioni di team e stakeholder, agire come partner di pensiero e fornire loro soluzioni e raccomandazioni di analisi di alta qualità
• Creare presentazioni efficaci per trasmettere informazioni e raccomandazioni cruciali agli stakeholder in modo efficace
• Partecipare alle riunioni con i team in diversi fusi orari per garantire una consegna regolare delle richieste analitiche e operative relative ai partner commerciali
• Prendere una mentalità aziendale, collegare le responsabilità individuali con un'organizzazione più ampia, concentrarsi sui risultati che forniscono la maggior parte del valore aziendale e paziente
• Sii flessibile per partecipare all'incontro durante le ore di lavoro sovrapposte IST/PST
• Fornire mentorship e formazione ai membri del team junior e agli stagisti sui principi di analisi e sul dominio Pharma, promuovendo lo sviluppo di set di competenze e capacità Chi sei

Position title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst (Medical Analytics)
Roche India - Roche Services and Solutions
