descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Ärztin. Wir verwandeln die medizinische Praxis zusammen. Wir sind verantwortlich für die medizinische Außenanschauung bei Roche und dafür, dass die Wissenschaft hinter unseren Produkten weltweit unter relevanten HCPs kommuniziert und verstanden wird, für die wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner sind. Wir arbeiten zusammen und streben in einem integrierten Arbeitsumfeld mit den Affiliate, der globalen Entwicklung und der globalen Strategie an. Wir helfen bei der Entwicklung, Einführung, Aufnahme und informierten Nutzung unserer innovativen Medikamente und Dienstleistungen in der klinischen Praxis und Patientenversorgung weltweit. Wir schaffen und entwickeln Kompetenzen, Fähigkeiten und Chancen für unser globales Medical Network. Wir denken voraus und nutzen digital, wann immer möglich. Die Chance
• Sie bieten medizinisches Know-how für Brustkrebs und tragen als Teil einer integrierten Strategie zu Komponenten der medizinischen Strategie wie Beweiserzeugung, Verbreitung und medizinische Erkenntnisse bei.
• Sie leisten einen Beitrag zur Planung und Durchführung von im Bereich Brustkrebs relevanten Strategien der Beweiserzeugung, die auf medizinischen und Marktzugangslücken basieren, einschließlich klinischer Studien, Untersuchungs-Initiierten Studien (IIS), Daten der realen Welt und wissenschaftliche Forschungskooperationen, indem Sie gezielte Netzwerke mit Interessengruppen im Gesundheitswesen in verschiedenen Kulturen und Ländern aufbauen.
• Sie generieren integrierte medizinische Erkenntnisse, um Strategien und Pläne zu informieren und bieten medizinische und funktionale Expertise für Marktzugangsstrategien und damit verbundene Betriebspläne.
• Sie führen die Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen akademischen und klinischen Spezialisten weltweit, um wissenschaftliche und strategische Inputs für unsere klinischen Entwicklungsprogramme zu sichern und mit ihnen über die Interpretation unserer klinischen Studienergebnisse zu spären, so dass diese potenziell einen Mehrwert für HCPs schaffen und Patienten profitieren können. Wer bist du? Sie halten einen MD-Abschluss, der ein sehr bevorzugtes oder fortgeschrittenes Life-Science-Abschluss ist (z.B. PhD oder PharmD). Ein Spezialisierungsgrad oder Branchenerfahrung in Brustkrebs ist ein Muss. Darüber hinaus verfügen Sie über eine robuste medizinische und/oder pharmazeutische Medizin. Weiter bringt ihr:
• Hohe Ethische Standards: Sie zeigen Integrität und Compliance in allen professionellen Aktivitäten.
• Strategische Agilität: Sie haben die Fähigkeit, fundierte, strategische Entscheidungen effektiv zu treffen.
• Patient-Centric Approach: Sie priorisieren Patienten in der klinischen Entwicklung und in der medizinischen Praxis.
• Launch Experience: Ihre Erfahrung mit der Einführung von Medizinprodukten oder Indikationen wird die erfolgreiche Produkteinführung vorantreiben. Ihr Know-how im Brustkrebs kann sich ändern. Nehmen Sie den nächsten Schritt und helfen Sie uns, innovative Medikamente an Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Bewerben Sie sich. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes des affaires médicales. Nous transformons la pratique médicale ensemble. Nous sommes responsables de la perspective médicale externe à Roche et de veiller à ce que la science derrière nos produits soit communiquée et comprise parmi les HCP pertinents à l'échelle mondiale, pour lesquels nous sommes un partenaire de confiance. Nous collaborons dans un environnement de travail intégré avec les affiliés, le développement mondial et la stratégie mondiale. Nous contribuons au développement, à l'introduction, à l'adoption et à l'utilisation éclairée de nos médicaments et services innovants dans la pratique clinique et les soins aux patients dans le monde entier. Nous créons et développons des compétences, des capacités et des opportunités pour notre réseau médical mondial. Nous pensons à l'avenir et puisons dans le numérique chaque fois que possible. L'opportunité
• Vous fournissez une expertise médicale au cancer du sein et contribuez à des composantes de la stratégie médicale telles que la production de preuves, la diffusion et les connaissances médicales dans le cadre d'une stratégie intégrée.
• Vous contribuez ou dirigez la planification et l'exécution de stratégies de production de données pertinentes dans le domaine du cancer du sein, basées sur des lacunes médicales et d'accès au marché, y compris des études cliniques, des études entreprises par des chercheurs (SII), des données réelles et des collaborations de recherche scientifique en créant des réseaux ciblés avec les intervenants des soins de santé dans plusieurs cultures et pays.
• Vous produisez des informations médicales intégrées pour éclairer les stratégies et les plans et vous fournissez une expertise médicale et fonctionnelle aux stratégies d'accès au marché et aux plans opérationnels connexes.
• Vous dirigez la collaboration avec des spécialistes universitaires et cliniques clés du monde entier afin d'obtenir une contribution scientifique et stratégique à nos programmes de développement clinique et de les analyser avec eux sur l'interprétation de nos résultats d'essais cliniques afin que ceux-ci puissent potentiellement créer de la valeur pour les HCP et bénéficier aux patients. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme MD qui est un diplôme hautement préféré ou avancé en sciences de la vie (p. ex. doctorat ou pharmD). Un diplôme de spécialisation ou une expérience de l'industrie dans le cancer du sein est un must. De plus, vous avez une solide expérience médicale et/ou pharmaceutique. En outre, vous apportez:
• Hautes normes éthiques: Vous démontrez l'intégrité et la conformité dans toutes les activités professionnelles.
• Agilité stratégique : Vous avez la capacité de prendre des décisions stratégiques éclairées et efficaces.
• Approche patient-chercheur : Vous priorisez les patients dans les activités de développement clinique et de pratique médicale.
• Expérience de lancement: Votre expérience avec le lancement de produits médicaux ou d'indications conduira à une introduction réussie du produit. Votre expertise en cancer du sein peut conduire au changement. Prenez la prochaine étape et aidez-nous à fournir des médicaments innovants aux patients du monde entier. Demande maintenant. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Technical Services and Operations (TSO) group within DDC is accountable for providing application support (Level 1-3) for hundreds of software solutions. In addition, TSO is responsible for DevOps and Operations for the DDC’ application landscape, both Cloud and On Premise. Finally, TSO provides technical support for systems that offer tools to train large language models (LLMs) and create autonomous agents, as well as ensuring users are effectively enabled to leverage these advanced systems, from LLM training platforms to autonomous agent building tools.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will join the TSO Leadership team and will work closely with DDC colleagues as well as directly with our key stakeholders including Computational Scientists, ML Scientists and Research Scientists. You will also work closely with vendors who provide managed services which form the core of many of the TSO activities.

You are an experienced and hands-on technical expert with the proven ability to lead and deliver enterprise scale technical operations. You will be managing operations for Applications and Software and also contributing as an SRE supporting our Infrastructure. Together with the Technical Operations leadership team, you will integrate expertise across on-premises operations, cloud services, and advanced AI/ML technologies. Your strategic focus will be on ensuring high performance, user enablement, and efficient service delivery while effectively managing relationships with external vendors. This comprehensive approach will drive operational excellence and support the evolving technical needs of our organization.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il gruppo Servizi Tecnici e Operazioni (TSO) all'interno di DDC è responsabile per fornire supporto alle applicazioni (Level 1-3) per centinaia di soluzioni software. Inoltre, TSO è responsabile per DevOps e Operazioni per il paesaggio delle applicazioni DDC, sia Cloud che On Premise. Infine, TSO fornisce supporto tecnico per sistemi che offrono strumenti per la formazione di modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni (LLM) e per la creazione di agenti autonomi, oltre a garantire che gli utenti siano effettivamente abilitati a sfruttare questi sistemi avanzati, dalle piattaforme di formazione LLM agli strumenti di costruzione di agenti autonomi. Come Ingegnere Principale Software, si unirà al team di Leadership TSO e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i colleghi DDC e direttamente con i nostri principali stakeholder, tra cui scienziati computazionali, scienziati ML e scienziati di ricerca. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i fornitori che forniscono servizi gestiti che formano il nucleo di molte delle attività TSO. Sei un esperto e pratico esperto tecnico con la comprovata capacità di guidare e fornire operazioni tecniche su scala aziendale. Potrai gestire le operazioni per applicazioni e software e contribuire anche come SRE supportando la nostra infrastruttura. Insieme al team di leadership Technical Operations, integrerai le competenze nelle operazioni on-premise, nei servizi cloud e nelle tecnologie AI/ML avanzate. Il vostro obiettivo strategico sarà quello di garantire prestazioni elevate, l'attivazione degli utenti e la consegna efficiente dei servizi, mentre la gestione efficace dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Questo approccio completo guiderà l'eccellenza operativa e sosterrà le esigenze tecniche in evoluzione della nostra organizzazione. L'opportunità
• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Sviluppare e implementare piani strategici allineati a obiettivi organizzativi, integrando servizi gestiti, operazioni on-premise e iniziative cloud, sfruttando l'IA come acceleratore chiave.
• L'impegno del venditore & Stakeholder – le relazioni del venditore, negoziare i contratti e garantire l'adesione a SLAs.
• Eccellenza operativa & Change Management – Applicare i principi di ingegneria del software alle operazioni per scalare e mantenere sistemi di produzione altamente affidabili, bilanciando il rapido rilascio di nuove funzionalità

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerische Wissenschaften transformieren die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, die transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern sowohl pRED als auch gRED zu helfen, innovativere und lebensverändernde Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Innerhalb der CS CoE-Organisation führt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC)-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme durch die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung, um Stakeholder zu stärken, datenorientierte Wissenschaft zu fördern und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen. Die Gruppe Technical Services and Operations (TSO) innerhalb des DDC ist für die Bereitstellung von Anwendungsunterstützung (Level 1-3) für Hunderte von Softwarelösungen verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus ist die TSO für DevOps und Operations für die Anwendungslandschaft des DDC verantwortlich, sowohl Cloud als auch On Premise. Schließlich bietet die TSO technische Unterstützung für Systeme, die Werkzeuge bieten, um große Sprachmodelle (LLMs) zu trainieren und autonome Agenten zu schaffen, sowie sicherzustellen, dass die Nutzer effektiv in der Lage sind, diese fortschrittlichen Systeme zu nutzen, von LLM Trainingsplattformen bis zu autonomen Agent Building Tools. Als Principal Software Engineer werden Sie dem TSO Leadership Team beitreten und eng mit DDC-Kollegen sowie direkt mit unseren wichtigsten Interessenvertretern wie Computational Scientists, ML Scientists und Research Scientists zusammenarbeiten. Sie arbeiten auch eng mit Anbietern zusammen, die Managed Services anbieten, die den Kern vieler TSO-Aktivitäten bilden. Sie sind ein erfahrener und praktischer technischer Experte mit der bewährten Fähigkeit, technische Operationen im Unternehmensmaßstab zu führen und zu liefern. Sie leiten den Betrieb für Anwendungen und Software und tragen auch als SRE zur Unterstützung unserer Infrastruktur bei. Gemeinsam mit dem Team der Technischen Operations werden Sie Know-how in On-Premises-Betriebe, Cloud-Services und fortschrittliche AI/ML-Technologien integrieren. Ihr strategischer Fokus liegt auf der Sicherstellung von hoher Leistung, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und effizienten Service-Lieferung, während die Beziehungen mit externen Anbietern effektiv verwalten. Dieser umfassende Ansatz wird operative Exzellenz fördern und die sich entwickelnden technischen Bedürfnisse unserer Organisation unterstützen. Die Chance
• Strategische Planung & Service-Integration – Entwickeln und implementieren strategische Pläne, die mit organisatorischen Zielen ausgerichtet sind, die Integration von Managed Services, On-Premises-Operationen und Cloud-Initiativen und die Nutzung von AI als Schlüsselbeschleuniger.

Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'area Site and Investigator Engagement offre l'ecosistema digitale completo e piattaforme integrate necessarie per gestire il ciclo di vita end-to-end delle interazioni dei siti clinici, coprendo una pianificazione efficiente dello studio, la selezione del paese e del sito, l'attivazione del sito e la previsione dell'iscrizione dei pazienti. Inoltre, gestisce le tecnologie principali per gestire compiti amministrativi complessi, tra cui budgeting e negoziazione, contratti clinici, pagamenti e scambio di informazioni cliniche. Il team funge da collegamento strategico con Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Country Operations, CRO strategici e Siti Clinici. Attraverso questo allineamento, l'area architetti portafogli di tecnologia che favoriscono forti relazioni esterne e guidano un ecosistema clinico unificato e partner-centrico. In qualità di Partner Informatico a questo livello, si conducono sforzi strategici e complessi tra paesi o domini, allineando le iniziative con priorità a livello nazionale e risultati aziendali. Attesi e risolvi problemi complessi, a livello di sistemi, aziona l'innovazione e modella la visione del dominio mentre gestisci più flussi di lavoro con alta responsabilità. L'opportunità:
• Scope/Content Leadership: conduce iniziative in più team e forma attivamente i risultati aziendali. Agisce come esperto di materia tematica, influenzando strategie nazionali o interfunzionali e promuovendo collaborazioni con gli stakeholder a livello organizzativo. Responsabile per l'allineamento degli obiettivi di squadra o di dominio con obiettivi a livello nazionale, concentrandosi su progetti strategici che portano un impatto sostanziale. Spesso gestisce flussi di lavoro complessi e interfunzionali.
• Responsabilità/Problem Solving: conduce la risoluzione dei problemi a livello nazionale o interfunzionale, tenendo conto della responsabilità di più flussi di lavoro o dei risultati che influenzano gli obiettivi strategici. Anticipa e mitiga i potenziali problemi prima che si presentano, utilizzando analisi avanzate per affrontare problemi complessi. Semplifica un approccio orientato ai sistemi per proporre soluzioni che si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali e globali, dimostrando un'alta responsabilitÃ nella guida di miglioramenti e efficienza sostenuti in tutti i team. Navigate richieste altamente complesse e concorrenti tra team globali e locali. Employs framework data-driven a priorità aziendali soggettive di transizione in roadmap obiettive, scalabili e risoluzioni operative robuste.
• Gestione degli stakeholder: gestisce le relazioni tra le operazioni cliniche di farmaci globali, Co
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Investigator Relations Technology Informatics Partner Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world. At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events. The Site and Investigator Engagement area delivers the comprehensive digital ecosystem and integrated platforms required to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of clinical site interactions, covering efficient study planning, country and site selection, site activation, and patient enrollment forecasting. Additionally, it manages the core technologies to handle complex administrative tasks, including budgeting and negotiation, clinical contracts, payments, and clinical information exchange. The team acts as a strategic liaison connecting Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Country Operations, strategic CROs, and Clinical Sites. Through this alignment, the area architects technology portfolios that foster strong external relationships and drive a unified, partner-centric clinical ecosystem. ​ As an Informatics Partner at this level, you lead strategic and complex cross-functional efforts across countries or domains, aligning initiatives with country-wide priorities and business outcomes. You anticipate and solve complex, systems-level problems, drive innovation, and shape domain vision while managing multiple workstreams with high accountability. The opportunity:
• Scope/Content Leadership: Leads initiatives across multiple teams, and actively shapes business outcomes. Acts as a subject matter expert, influencing country-wide or cross-functional strategies, and fostering collaborations with stakeholders across organizational levels. Responsible for aligning team or domain objectives with country-wide goals, focusing on strategic projects that drive substantial impact. Frequently manages complex, cross-functional work streams.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads problem-solving at the country-wide or cross-functional level, taking accountability for multiple workstreams or outcomes that influence strategic objectives. Anticipates and mitigates potential issues before they arise, using advanced analysis to address complex problems. Employs a systems-thinking approach to propose solutions that align with business and global goals, demonstrating high accountability in driving sustained improvements and efficiencies across teams. Navigates highly complex, competing demands between global and local teams. Employs data-driven frameworks to transition subjective business priorities into objective, scalable technology roadmaps and robust operational resolutions.
• Stakeholder Management: Manages relationships across Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Co

Grâce à cet alignement, les portefeuilles technologiques d'architectes régionaux qui favorisent de solides relations externes et stimulent un écosystème clinique unifié et axé sur les partenaires. En tant que partenaire informatique à ce niveau, vous dirigez des efforts interfonctionnels stratégiques et complexes dans tous les pays ou domaines, en alignant les initiatives sur les priorités nationales et les résultats opérationnels. Vous anticipez et résolvez des problèmes complexes au niveau des systèmes, stimulez l'innovation et façonnez la vision du domaine tout en gérant plusieurs flux de travail avec une haute responsabilité. L'occasion :
• Portée et contenu Leadership : Dirige les initiatives de plusieurs équipes et oriente activement les résultats opérationnels. Agir à titre d'expert en la matière, influencer les stratégies nationales ou interfonctionnelles et favoriser la collaboration avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux organisationnels. Responsable de l ' harmonisation des objectifs de l ' équipe ou du domaine avec les objectifs nationaux, en mettant l ' accent sur les projets stratégiques qui ont un impact considérable. Il gère fréquemment des flux de travail complexes et interfonctionnels.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : dirige la résolution des problèmes à l'échelle du pays ou au niveau interfonctionnel, en prenant en compte la responsabilité de multiples secteurs de travail ou résultats qui influent sur les objectifs stratégiques. Anticiper et atténuer les problèmes potentiels avant qu'ils ne surviennent, en utilisant une analyse avancée pour résoudre les problèmes complexes. Utilise une approche de conception de systèmes pour proposer des solutions qui s'harmonisent avec les objectifs commerciaux et mondiaux, démontrant une haute responsabilité dans la conduite d'améliorations et d'efficacités durables entre les équipes. Navigue sur des demandes très complexes et concurrentes entre équipes mondiales et locales. Utiliser des cadres fondés sur les données pour transformer les priorités subjectives des entreprises en feuilles de route technologiques objectives, évolutives et des résolutions opérationnelles robustes.
• Gestion des parties prenantes: gère les relations dans le cadre des opérations cliniques mondiales Pharma, Co

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Estamos comprometidos no sólo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.
En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

What is your Mission?
You will be the key operational engine within Roche Diagnostics Spain (RDE), reporting directly to the leadership team. Your main mission is to ensure business agility and efficiency, freeing up high-value time for our strategic and customer-facing teams.

You will combine excellence in administrative management with innovation, optimizing processes through the implementation of Artificial Intelligence and ensuring regulatory compliance at a national level. If you are passionate about efficiency, technology, and strategic impact, this is your place.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Executive Management and Agile Coordination: Administer and coordinate complex agendas, plan travel, and organize key events for leadership and commercial teams, always prioritizing direct business impact.

• Strategic External and Internal Articulation: Facilitate and coordinate the leaders' interaction with strategic external and internal partners to drive commercial success, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional projects in our commercial headquarters.

• Commercial Strategic Support: Provide direct support to key account teams, including preparing client briefings, managing data in the CRM system, and administrative follow-up on executive actions.

• Pioneer in AI and Automation: Proactively identify repetitive tasks in various areas and design and implement automation solutions, using AI agents (such as generative models).

• Compliance Assurance: Act as a liaison to ensure that all administrative processes strictly comply with internal policies for Finance, Human Resources, and Business Integrity.

• Cross-functional Collaboration and Support: Participate in coordinating mutual support among assistants, ensuring service continuity and a balanced workload across the organization.

What We Look for in You:

• Education: Professional degree or equivalent. Training in project management will be especially valued.

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of demonstrable experience in executive support roles, team coordination, or administrative management in large-scale corporate environments (ideally in matrix or network structures).

• Languages: Fluent command (oral and written) of English and Spanish (essential).

• Digital and Technological Experience and Mindset: Advanced user of cloud ecosystems (Microsoft 365/Google Workspace) and a proactive, demonstrable curiosity for the application of Generative Artificial Intelligence.

Competency:
1. Business and Operation Skills:

• Process Architecture: Ability to analyze a complex activity and break it down into logical, efficient, and automatable flows.

• Prompt Engineering: Practical ability to interact with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) for content generation, summarization,

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key activities & Deliverables

• Co-ordinate and execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with work instructions and month end close checklist

• Perform and analyse booking accounting transactions, working and calculations are executed on timely and accurately

• Clearing of open items in accounts

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, cost center checks and transaction posting checks

• Ensure accruals are properly justified and correctly posted

• To ensure all journals are performed accurately and timely

• Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliation, highlight and rectify any anomalies encountered

• Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reporting packages accurately and within specified timescale

Documentation & Controlling

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required

• Participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries

Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations

• Initiate and execute the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Work collaboratively with customers and stakeholders

• Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

Coaching/Sharing

• Support the review entries posted by the team to ensure accuracy

• Extends coaching and guidance to juniors in daily operation

• Support the when there are any ad hoc activities or projects

• Contribute inputs/findings to establish a knowledge database of issue encountered, proposed resolution steps to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge and lesson learnt across the teams

Qualifications & Experience Required

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English.

• Minimum 5 years working experiences in the related field, preferable in the area of General Accounting and Management Accounting

• SAP knowledge or other ERP accounting systems and MS Office tools

• Proficiency in English and Japanese language are mandatory with good communication skill (writing and speaking).

Desirable qualifications

• External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing engagement will be preferable

• Prior leadership or project management type supervisory role may be an advantage.

Who we are

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

• Project Undertaking and Delivery: Assist and take ownership of key projects from various teams (MWA/OMSS/CB); responsible for decomposing strategic objectives into specific action plans. Lead project progress control, resource coordination, and cross-functional communication to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery.

• Project Implementation: Collaborate with Product Managers to develop effective promotion tools; ensure product strategies and marketing activities are efficiently executed and implemented at the sales terminal.

• AI Technology Empowerment: Act as the department's AI application expert; guide and assist product groups in building AI-based product management tools and intelligent workflows to drive digital transformation. Precisely identify business pain points within the ML department; develop and promote AI solutions to enhance the quality and efficiency of content generation.

• Team Productivity Enhancement: Leverage AI technology to deeply optimize internal approval processes, online operating systems, and user-facing business material preparation, significantly reducing the time investment of Product Managers in repetitive and administrative tasks.

• Large-scale Event Management: Oversee the planning and execution of major internal and external conferences (both online and offline) and brand promotion activities; responsible for vendor management and on-site operations.

• Omni-channel Media Operations: Optimize and maintain departmental marketing communication channels (e.g., WeChat, webinar platforms, and 3rd party professional media); ensure published content is highly aligned with corporate branding and compliance requirements.

• Vendor and Budget Management: Manage vendors to ensure projects meet departmental KPIs and compliance policies; monitor project implementation and strictly control budgets following the ROI principle.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Biological Engineering, Marketing, Business Management, or a related discipline.

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English

• Deep expertise in AI application tools (e.g., LLMs, Workflow Automation) and digital marketing; ability to translate business needs into technical AI solutions.

• Expertise in MS Office Suite and project management software (e.g., MS Project, Trello, or Jira). PMP or equivalent certification is a significant plus.

• At least 5 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer | Laboratory Diagnostics

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere del campo | Diagnostica del laboratorio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

• Global reputable company | Career growth opportunities

• Full time permanent position | Annual Bonus and Car Allowance

• Base salary between $100,000-$120,000

• Supportive and dynamic team | Agile ways of working

Roche Diagnostics New Zealand (RDNZ) has just opened an exciting opportunity for the position of Field Service Engineer to be based in Wellington. The key purpose of this position is to carry out the engineering service function for the assigned Squad, but the responsibilities may flex across the other squads as per business requirements. There is a requirement of training and continuing education on the portfolio, instrument and product troubleshooting, instrument installation and commissioning, instrument maintenance procedures and all manufacturer modifications, and other issues of instrument aftersales services to the satisfaction of the RDNZ customer base and in line with our organisational SOPs and policies.

Leveraging your Laboratory Diagnostics engineering experience, responsibilities of this role include but are not limited to;

• Ensure existing and new customer base are supported with quality after-sales service.

• Participate in an on-call roster to ensure customers are supported 24 hours 7 days.

• Instrument trouble-shooting service is provided, is efficient and fulfils the needs of our customers.

• Ensure RD maintains Service Level Agreements (SLA) conditions with regards response times for phone support and onsite customer visits.

• Chapter Lead Service, relevant Marketing Managers and Strategic Key Account Managers are kept aware of all product issues.

• Participate in Account Management Strategies.

• Spare parts stock are organized and maintained to avoid excess stock accumulation in consignment and are returned to 3PL warehouse.

• To complete all documentation required within the required timeline requested.

• Business opportunities are identified and implemented in accordance with internal and external stakeholders.

• To keep CRM (Rexis/\NFSS) customer records up to date, relevant and accurate.

• Ensure Service Contract information is followed for all service activities / work orders.

• Provide cover and travel as required for territories where engineering resources are required to meet business demands and customer needs.

• Complete timely pre-installation inspections and installation of new and refurbished RD and other analytical systems within areas of responsibility.

• Displays an understanding of, and adhere to, all SHE policies and principles to ensure the health and safety of all at the workplace.

Who You Are:

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies and where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

To be successful in this position, you will be an experienced engineer, and will be able to demonstrate the following:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role with tertiary qualification in Engineering (Electrical / Mechanical) or Science is desired

• Understanding of Diagnostic & Research Laboratories environment

• Appropriate work-r

Lo scopo principale di questa posizione è quello di svolgere la funzione di servizio di ingegneria per la squadra assegnata, ma le responsabilità possono flettersi tra le altre squadre secondo i requisiti aziendali. C'è un requisito di formazione e formazione continua sul portafoglio, strumento e risoluzione dei problemi di prodotto, installazione degli strumenti e messa in servizio, procedure di manutenzione degli strumenti e tutte le modifiche del produttore, e altre questioni dei servizi di postvendita dello strumento per la soddisfazione della base clienti RDNZ e in linea con i nostri SOP organizzativi e politiche. Sfruttando la vostra esperienza di ingegneria diagnostica del laboratorio, le responsabilità di questo ruolo includono ma non sono limitate a;
• Assicurarsi che la base clienti esistente e nuova sia supportata da un servizio post-vendita di qualità.
• Partecipare a un roster on-call per garantire che i clienti siano supportati 24 ore 7 giorni.
• Il servizio di risoluzione dei problemi degli strumenti è fornito, è efficiente e soddisfa le esigenze dei nostri clienti.
• Assicurare RD mantiene le condizioni di Service Level Agreements (SLA) per quanto riguarda i tempi di risposta per il supporto telefonico e le visite dei clienti in loco.
• Il servizio capofila, i responsabili di marketing rilevanti e i responsabili strategici del conto chiave sono tenuti a conoscenza di tutti i problemi del prodotto.
• Partecipare alle strategie di gestione degli account.
• Le scorte di ricambi sono organizzate e mantenute per evitare l'accumulo di scorte in eccesso nella spedizione e vengono restituite al magazzino 3PL.
• Per completare tutta la documentazione richiesta entro la cronologia richiesta.
• Le opportunità di business sono identificate e implementate in conformità con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Per mantenere aggiornati i record dei clienti CRM (Rexis/\NFSS), pertinenti e precisi.
• Assicurarsi che le informazioni del contratto di servizio siano seguite per tutte le attività di servizio / ordini di lavoro.
• Fornire copertura e viaggio come richiesto per i territori in cui le risorse ingegneristiche sono necessarie per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali e dei clienti.
• Completare ispezioni tempestive di preinstallazione e l'installazione di nuovi e rinnovati sistemi RD e altri sistemi analitici all'interno di aree di responsabilità.
• Visualizza una comprensione di, e aderire a, tutte le politiche e i principi SHE per garantire la salute e la sicurezza di tutti sul posto di lavoro. Chi sei? Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il tuo sviluppo. Per avere successo in questa posizione, sarete un ingegnere esperto e sarete in grado di dimostrare quanto segue:
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile con qualifica terziaria in Ingegneria (elettrica / meccanica) o Scienza è desiderato
• Comprensione dell'ambiente dei laboratori diagnostici e di ricerca
• Lavoro appropriato

• Equipe supportive et dynamique Roche Diagnostics New Zealand (RDNZ) vient d'ouvrir une opportunité passionnante pour le poste d'ingénieur du Service mobile à Wellington. Le but principal de ce poste est d'exercer la fonction de service d'ingénierie pour l'escouade assignée, mais les responsabilités peuvent varier entre les autres escouades selon les exigences opérationnelles. Une formation et une formation continue sont nécessaires en ce qui concerne le portefeuille, le dépannage des instruments et des produits, l'installation et la mise en service des instruments, les procédures de maintenance des instruments et toutes les modifications des fabricants, ainsi que d'autres questions relatives aux services après-vente des instruments, à la satisfaction de la clientèle de RDNZ et conformément à nos SOP et politiques organisationnelles. Tirer parti de votre expérience en génie diagnostique de laboratoire, les responsabilités de ce rôle comprennent mais ne se limitent pas à;
• Veiller à ce que la clientèle existante et nouvelle bénéficie d'un service après-vente de qualité.
• Participer à un fichier d'appels pour s'assurer que les clients sont pris en charge 24 heures 7 jours.
• Service de dépannage d'instruments est fourni, est efficace et répond aux besoins de nos clients.
• Veiller à ce que RD maintienne les conditions des accords de niveau de service (ALS) en ce qui concerne les délais de réponse pour le soutien téléphonique et les visites des clients sur place.
• Le chapitre Service principal, les gestionnaires de marketing et les gestionnaires de comptes stratégiques clés sont tenus au courant de tous les problèmes liés aux produits.
• Participer aux stratégies de gestion des comptes.
• Les stocks de pièces de rechange sont organisés et entretenus afin d'éviter l'accumulation excessive de stocks dans l'expédition et sont retournés à l'entrepôt 3PL.
• Remplir toute la documentation requise dans le délai requis.
• Les opportunités d'affaires sont identifiées et mises en œuvre en accord avec les acteurs internes et externes.
• Tenir à jour les dossiers clients du CRM (Rexis/\NFSS), pertinents et précis.
• S'assurer que l'information sur le contrat de service est respectée pour toutes les activités de service / commandes de travail.
• Assurer la couverture et les déplacements nécessaires pour les territoires où des ressources techniques sont nécessaires pour répondre aux besoins des entreprises et des clients.
• Effectuer en temps voulu des inspections préalables à l'installation et l'installation de nouveaux systèmes de RD et d'autres systèmes d'analyse rénovés dans les zones de responsabilité.
• Présente une compréhension et un respect de toutes les politiques et principes de la SHE pour assurer la santé et la sécurité de tous sur le lieu de travail. Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut influencer votre propre développement. Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous avez la possibilité de poursuivre vos intérêts à travers les fonctions et les géographies et où un titre d'emploi n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui vous êtes, mais comme le point de départ. Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous serez un ingénieur expérimenté et pourrez démontrer ce qui suit :
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire avec une qualification tertiaire en ingénierie (électronique / mécanique) ou la science est souhaitée
• Comprendre l'environnement des laboratoires de diagnostic et de recherche
• Travailleur approprié

jobs.title: Commercial Finance Partner(Demand Management)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value.

Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management

• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.

• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.

• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.

• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows.

2. Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.

• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L.

3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs

• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.

• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.

• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness.

4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration

• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.

• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices.

5. Compliance & Risk Management

• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations.

Key Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).

• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.

• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicin

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant - Talent Pool
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Affairs International (EAi), part of the Roche Pharma CEO Office, ensures the company can shape the policies, funding decisions, and market conditions that determine how healthcare innovation is valued and rewarded. We influence globally where strategic priorities are defined and enable locally where business impact is delivered. Through focused advocacy and a connected global network, EAi builds trusted relationships with governments, multilateral institutions, and global partners, develops third-party advocates, and forges alliances that protect and grow Roche’s business while improving patient access to innovation.

The Opportunity
The Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy is a high-impact strategic expert responsible for designing and driving Roche’s policy strategies across priority Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Reporting to the Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, you serve as the definitive policy expert, ensuring that the external policy environment and healthcare systems deliver rapid and sustainable access to innovation. This role requires a unique blend of technical policy mastery, commercial acumen and strategic diplomacy to navigate complex supra-national environments, influence senior stakeholders, and orchestrate global-to-local disease area policy alignment without the need for direct hierarchical authority.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the development and implementation of the global policy strategy portfolio and performance metrics across priority TAs, ensuring full alignment with global, regional, and affiliate functions.

• Define the long-term global disease area policy vision, strategy, objectives and crafting sophisticated policy projects, evidence, tools and positioning that addresses the needs of patients, medical professionals, and the business.

• Act as a primary catalyst for shaping policy environments by architecting external engagement and advocacy frameworks for a broad cross-section of disease area policy and health system stakeholders, while identifying and mitigating barriers to access among governments and NGOs.

• Serve as the primary global point-of-contact for disease area policy, providing timely and expert direction to the business

• Partner strategically across Roche regions and affiliates to ensure consistent application of health policy expertise, enabling local implementation of disease area policy strategies, and to drive the External Affairs mission through the organization.

• Lead the development of portfolio-wide content, analytical tools, and disease area policy strategies that translate complex external policy and healthcare challenges into actionable business insights and tactics.

• Manage high-impact global strategic policy initiatives and project workstreams, ensuring resource transparency and evidence-based recommendations to enable high-level business decision-making.

• Support organizational growth by sharing global health policy expertise and educating cross-functional peers to foster a culture of functional excellence and innovation.

Who You Are

• You hold a Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent in Political Science, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in health policy or public affairs within the life sciences sector or government,with a deep mastery and knowledge of disease area policy, health system and access environments.

• A recognized leader with a demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and policymakers

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esterni International (EAi), parte dell'Ufficio CEO di Roche Pharma, assicura che l'azienda possa modellare le politiche, le decisioni di finanziamento e le condizioni di mercato che determinano come l'innovazione sanitaria sia valutata e premiata. Influenziamo a livello globale dove vengono definite le priorità strategiche e consentiamo a livello locale dove l'impatto aziendale viene consegnato. Attraverso l’advocacy focalizzata e una rete globale collegata, EAi costruisce relazioni di fiducia con governi, istituzioni multilaterali e partner globali, sviluppa sostenitori di terze parti, e forgia alleanze che proteggono e crescono gli affari di Roche, migliorando l’accesso dei pazienti all’innovazione. L'opportunità La politica globale Lead, Malattia Area Policy è un esperto strategico ad alto impatto responsabile della progettazione e della guida delle strategie politiche di Roche attraverso aree terapeutiche prioritarie (TA). Segnalando al Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, sei l'esperto di politica definitiva, assicurando che l'ambiente di politica esterna e i sistemi sanitari garantiscano un accesso rapido e sostenibile all'innovazione. Questo ruolo richiede una miscela unica di padronanza della politica tecnica, acume commerciale e diplomazia strategica per navigare ambienti sovranazionali complessi, influenzare gli stakeholder senior e orchestrare l'allineamento della politica globale-locale delle malattie senza la necessità di autorità gerarchiche dirette. Principali responsabilità
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'attuazione del portafoglio di strategia di politica globale e metriche di performance attraverso TA prioritari, garantendo il pieno allineamento con le funzioni globali, regionali e affiliate.
• Definire la visione, la strategia, gli obiettivi e la realizzazione di progetti politici sofisticati, prove, strumenti e posizionamento a lungo termine che rispondono alle esigenze dei pazienti, dei medici e del business.
• Agire come catalizzatore primario per la modellazione degli ambienti politici attraverso l'archiviazione di schemi di impegno e di advocacy esterni per una vasta sezione trasversale delle parti interessate della politica della malattia e del sistema sanitario, identificando e mitigando le barriere all'accesso tra governi e ONG.
• Servire come punto di contatto principale globale per la politica dell'area delle malattie, fornendo una direzione tempestiva ed esperta al business
• Partner strategicamente nelle regioni e nelle affiliate di Roche per garantire un'applicazione coerente delle competenze in materia di politica sanitaria, consentendo l'implementazione locale delle strategie di politica delle malattie e di guidare la missione Affari Esteri attraverso l'organizzazione.
• Condurre lo sviluppo di contenuti a livello di portafoglio, strumenti analitici e strategie politiche di area malattia che traducono complesse sfide di politica esterna e di assistenza sanitaria in insight aziendali e tattiche attuabili.
• Gestire iniziative di politica strategica globale ad alto impatto e flussi di lavoro di progetto, garantendo trasparenza delle risorse e raccomandazioni basate su prove per consentire un processo decisionale di alto livello.
• Sostenere la crescita organizzativa condividendo le competenze della politica sanitaria globale e istruire i coetanei interfunzionali per promuovere una cultura di eccellenza funzionale e innovazione. Chi sei
• Hai un master, MBA, o equivalente in Scienze Politiche, Politica Pubblica, Salute Pubblica, Gestione della Sanità, o un campo relativo.
• 8+ anni di esperienza nella politica sanitaria o negli affari pubblici nel settore delle scienze della vita o del governo, con una profonda padronanza e conoscenza della politica della zona delle malattie, del sistema sanitario e degli ambienti di accesso.
• Un leader riconosciuto con una capacità dimostrata di influenzare dirigenti e politici senior

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position External Affairs International (EAi), Teil des Roche Pharma-CEO-Büros, sorgt dafür, dass das Unternehmen die Politiken, Förderentscheidungen und Marktbedingungen prägen kann, die bestimmen, wie Innovationen im Gesundheitswesen geschätzt und belohnt werden. Wir beeinflussen global, wo strategische Prioritäten definiert sind und lokal in die Lage versetzt werden, wo Geschäftsauswirkungen erzielt werden. Durch fokussierte Advocacy und ein vernetztes globales Netzwerk baut EAi vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Regierungen, multilateralen Institutionen und globalen Partnern auf, entwickelt Drittanbieter-Befürworter und forge Allianzen, die das Unternehmen von Roche schützen und wachsen und gleichzeitig den Zugang zu Innovationen verbessern. Die Chance Die Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy ist ein hochprägsamer strategischer Experte, der die politischen Strategien von Roche in vorrangigen Therapeutischen Bereichen (TAs) entwickelt und vorantreibt. Als definitiver politischer Experte, der sicherstellt, dass das außenpolitische Umfeld und die Gesundheitssysteme einen schnellen und nachhaltigen Zugang zu Innovation bieten. Diese Rolle erfordert eine einzigartige Mischung aus technischer Politik-Meisterschaft, kommerzieller acumen und strategischer Diplomatie, um komplexe supranationale Umgebungen zu navigieren, Senior Stakeholder zu beeinflussen und global-to-local Disease Area politische Ausrichtung ohne direkte hierarchische Autorität. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung des globalen Strategieportfolios und der Performance Metriken über prioritäre TAs aus, um eine vollständige Ausrichtung auf globale, regionale und Affiliate-Funktionen zu gewährleisten.
• Definieren Sie die langfristige globale Strategie, Strategie, Ziele und die Gestaltung von anspruchsvollen politischen Projekten, Beweisen, Werkzeugen und Positionierungen, die sich auf die Bedürfnisse von Patienten, medizinischen Fachleuten und das Geschäft beziehen.
• Aktivieren Sie als primärer Katalysator für die Gestaltung von politischen Umgebungen, indem Sie externes Engagement und Advocacy-Framework für einen breiten Querschnitt von Interessenvertretern im Bereich der Krankheits- und Gesundheitspolitik unter gleichzeitiger Identifizierung und Minderung von Barrieren für den Zugang zwischen Regierungen und NRO darstellen.
• Als primärer globaler Ansprechpartner für die Politik des Krankheitsbereichs dienen und dem Unternehmen zeitnah und kompetente Orientierung geben
• Partner strategisch über Roche-Regionen und Affiliates, um eine konsequente Anwendung der Gesundheitswesen-Expertise zu gewährleisten, die lokale Umsetzung von Krankheitsgebiet-Politikstrategien zu ermöglichen und die Mission für Auswärtige Angelegenheiten durch die Organisation zu fördern.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung von portfolioweiten Content-, analytischen Tools- und Krankheitsfeldstrategien, die komplexe externe Politik- und Gesundheitsprobleme in handlungsfähige Unternehmens- und Taktiken übersetzen.
• Verwalten hocheffizienter globaler strategischer Initiativen und Projektarbeit, um Ressourcentransparenz und evidenzbasierte Empfehlungen zu gewährleisten, um eine hochrangige Unternehmensentscheidung zu ermöglichen.
• Unterstützung des organisatorischen Wachstums durch den Austausch globaler gesundheitspolitischer Expertise und Ausbildung von funktionsübergreifenden Peers, um eine Kultur funktionaler Exzellenz und Innovation zu fördern. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Master-Abschluss, MBA oder gleichwertig in Politikwissenschaft, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Gesundheitspolitik oder öffentlichen Angelegenheiten im Bereich der Lebenswissenschaften oder der Regierung, mit einer tiefen Beherrschung und Kenntnisse der Krankheitsgebietspolitik, des Gesundheitssystems und der Zugangsumgebungen.
• Ein anerkannter Führer mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte und Politiker zu beeinflussen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position External Affairs International (EAi), qui fait partie du bureau du PDG de Roche Pharma, veille à ce que l'entreprise puisse façonner les politiques, les décisions de financement et les conditions du marché qui déterminent la valeur et la récompense de l'innovation en matière de soins de santé. Nous influons à l'échelle mondiale là où les priorités stratégiques sont définies et nous permettons à l'échelle locale d'avoir un impact sur les entreprises. Grâce à un plaidoyer ciblé et à un réseau mondial connecté, EAi établit des relations de confiance avec les gouvernements, les institutions multilatérales et les partenaires mondiaux, développe des défenseurs tiers et forge des alliances qui protègent et développent les affaires de Roches tout en améliorant l'accès des patients à l'innovation. L'opportunité Le responsable de la politique mondiale, Politique sur les zones de maladies, est un expert stratégique à fort impact chargé de concevoir et d'orienter les stratégies stratégiques de Roche dans les zones thérapeutiques prioritaires. Rendre compte au responsable de l'équipe de la politique mondiale sur les maladies, vous êtes l'expert en politiques définitives, vous assurant que l'environnement politique externe et les systèmes de soins de santé offrent un accès rapide et durable à l'innovation. Ce rôle exige un mélange unique de maîtrise des politiques techniques, de sens commercial et de diplomatie stratégique afin de naviguer dans des environnements supranationaux complexes, d'influencer les principaux intervenants et d'orchestrer l'alignement des politiques mondiales sur les zones de maladies locales sans avoir besoin d'une autorité hiérarchique directe. Principales responsabilités
• Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre du portefeuille de stratégies politiques mondiales et des indicateurs de performance dans les AT prioritaires, en assurant une alignement complet avec les fonctions mondiales, régionales et affiliées.
• Définir la vision politique, la stratégie, les objectifs et l'élaboration de projets politiques sophistiqués, de données probantes, d'outils et de positionnement qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des entreprises.
• Agir en tant que principal catalyseur de la mise en place d'un environnement politique en élaborant des cadres d'engagement et de plaidoyer extérieurs pour un large éventail d'acteurs de la politique et du système de santé, tout en identifiant et en atténuant les obstacles à l'accès entre les gouvernements et les ONG.
• Servir de principal point de contact mondial pour la politique en matière de maladies, fournissant une orientation opportune et experte aux entreprises
• Établir des partenariats stratégiques dans les régions de Roche et les filiales afin d'assurer une application cohérente de l'expertise en matière de politique de santé, de permettre la mise en œuvre locale des stratégies de lutte contre la maladie et de conduire la mission Affaires extérieures à travers l'organisation.
• Diriger l'élaboration de contenus à l'échelle du portefeuille, d'outils d'analyse et de stratégies politiques dans le domaine des maladies qui traduisent des politiques extérieures complexes et des défis en matière de soins de santé en idées et tactiques opérationnelles réalisables.
• Gérer les initiatives stratégiques mondiales à haut impact et les axes de travail des projets, en assurant la transparence des ressources et en formulant des recommandations fondées sur des données factuelles pour permettre une prise de décisions de haut niveau.
• Soutenir la croissance organisationnelle en partageant l'expertise mondiale en matière de politique de santé et en éduquant les pairs interfonctionnels pour favoriser une culture d'excellence fonctionnelle et d'innovation. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master, d'un MBA ou d'un équivalent en sciences politiques, politiques publiques, santé publique, gestion des soins de santé ou un domaine connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en matière de politique de santé ou d'affaires publiques dans le secteur des sciences de la vie ou au sein du gouvernement, avec une maîtrise et une connaissance approfondies de la politique en matière de maladies, du système de santé et des environnements d'accès.
• Un dirigeant reconnu ayant une capacité démontrée d'influencer les cadres supérieurs et les décideurs
