jobs.title: Learning Intern - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community.

Your Key Responsibilities

• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.

• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.

• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.

• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.

• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations.

Who You Are
We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:

• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).

• Able to work 25-30 hrs/week .

• Languages: Fluent English (C1) is required. German (B2-C1) also required.

• System & IT Skills : Experience with standard IT applications (Google Suite or Microsoft) and an eagerness to learn cloud-based learning management software (like Cornerstone).

• Growth Mindset : An agile learner who is open to seeking and giving feedback, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and capable of navigating complex data.

• Customer Centricity : Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on delivering reliable support and managing customer expectations.

• Collaboration : A supportive team player who enjoys working in a multicultural, cross-border matrix environment.

What We Offer

• Hands-on experience operating Cornerstone and various other tools.

• Deep exposure to a global Shared Service Center environment.

• Competitive salary.

• A collaborative and supportive team environment that values your development and continuous learning.

• Flexible working hours according to your studies.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changi

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications .
Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public.

Role scope:

Key responsibilities

• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies

• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas

• Plan and handle medical budgets

• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions

• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness

• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues

• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Additional task, duties and responsibilities:

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)

• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups

Requirements:
Education and experience

• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).

• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .

• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Required skills and qualifications

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity

• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri

jobs.title: Medical Communication Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
This role serves as a hybrid strategic leader, combining the leadership of a composite team (comprising Medical Information & Medical Review and AI Product) with the development of a data- and AI-driven medical communication strategy.
The mandate is anchored in establishing a "data-driven medical communication flywheel": leveraging AI to proactively capture customer perception insights, building personalized content generation platforms, and developing localized digital education platforms to empower strategic business decisions. Furthermore, the role drives the transformation of traditional MI and MR business models through the introduction of Agent technologies, forging a new paradigm of human-machine collaboration in medical inquiries and automated pre-approvals to accelerate internal process efficiencies and support high-quality business growth under strict compliance standards.

Principal Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. AI-Driven Strategy & Flywheel Construction Development and execution of a long-term, data-centric medical communication strategy, ensuring strict alignment with overarching business goals.

• Proactive Insight Generation: Leadership in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Social Listening) to proactively capture and analyze customer behaviors and perceptions, identifying market trends and opportunities to provide data-backed support for business decisions.

• Content Generation Platform & Impact: Establishment of a robust content generation platform to significantly accelerate the production speed of high-quality medical education materials. Leadership in the rapid construction of core scientific messaging and educational content derived from AI-driven insights to effectively influence and transform customer perceptions and clinical behaviors.

• Personalized Platform Development: Oversight of the construction of personalized content generation platforms and localized digital education platforms to ensure the medical value proposition is delivered precisely and efficiently based on targeted user personas.

2. Digital Product & Solution Leadership Lead the development, evolution, and ecosystem cooperation for strategic digital assets, ensuring they deliver measurable value to patients and the healthcare system.

• Portfolio Lifecycle Management: Oversee the roadmap and execution of key AI solutions, specifically, Social Listening, Content Generation, Digital Communication, MI Agent, and MR Agent.

• Agile Iteration: Driving the continuous iteration of cutting-edge technologies, such as Large Language Models (LLMs), within medical communication scenarios to optimize product performance in an evolving market landscape.

3. AI Agent Innovation & Human-Machine Collaboration

• Traditional Business Transformation: Leading the introduction and deployment of MI Agents and MR Agents to fundamentally revolutionize traditional medical information inquiries and compliance review workflows.

• Model Innovation: Establishment of a human-machine collaboration model for medical Q&A (MI Agent) and automated pre-approvals (MR Agent) to achieve a quantum leap in business responsiveness while ensuring 100% adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements.

4. Team Leadership & Capability Development Management and mentorship of a hybrid team of MI/MR and AI Product.

• Team Synergy: Elimination of functional barrier between traditional medical communication operations and technical product management

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche's Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing late-stage development (Phase II–III) clinical strategies that deliver medically differentiated therapies for patients. We are seeking a highly motivated Medical Director (grading commensurate with experience) to join our Neuroimmunology team, specifically focusing on Multiple Sclerosis (MS).

The Opportunity

As a Medical Director, you will participate in or lead the development of Clinical Development (CD) plans, ensuring the effective execution of strategies for assigned molecules and indications. This is a junior to mid-level individual contributor position without people management responsibilities. The Opportunity
To help us deliver life-changing therapies to patients, you will take on a vital role in our Neuroimmunology team and drive the following key responsibilities:

• CDP Strategy and Planning: Lead or contribute to the creation of the Clinical Development Plan (CDP), gathering data to ensure strategic alignment with long-term lifecycle plans.

• Study Design and Execution: Lead the design and execution of Phase II and III clinical studies, collaborating with cross-functional teams on study analytics, data management, and safety profiles.

• Scientific Leadership: Maintain the highest levels of scientific and clinical knowledge within the MS and Neuroimmunology therapeutic areas.

• Regulatory Engagement: Take an active role in Health Authority (HA) interactions and provide clinical expertise for regulatory filings, briefing packages, and labeling.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Build and cultivate relationships with clinical investigators, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and internal partners across research, commercial operations, and legal.

• Medical Monitoring: Act as a medical monitor for assigned studies, ensuring the correct interpretation of medical and scientific data.

Who You Are

We are looking for a resilient, scientifically driven expert who brings a blend of advanced clinical knowledge and collaborative leadership to our team:

• Academic & Clinical Expertise: M.D. required with relevant clinical experience as a Neurologist, including specialized training or a significant background working with Multiple Sclerosis patients.

• Scientific & Industry Experience: Strong scientific background (publishing in peer-reviewed journals, academic, or teaching background is a plus) alongside preferred prior industry experience in MS clinical development (>2 years) or recognition as an MS field expert (e.g., Assistant Professor).

• Clinical Trials & Regulatory Knowledge: Significant experience designing/conducting clinical trials, a strong understanding of Phase II–III drug development, and required knowledge of GCP, ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines (preferred for entry-level candidates).

• Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to present complex data, paired with the ability to build relationships and influence without authority in a complex, cross-functional environment.

• Strategic Leadership & Mobility: Sound judgment for ethical and business decision-making, strong cross-functional leadership acumen, and the ability to travel globally up to 30%.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

Who we are

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'organisme de développement clinique de Roche est structuré par domaine thérapeutique et est responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de stratégies cliniques de développement en phase terminale (phase II–III) qui offrent des traitements différenciés sur le plan médical aux patients. Nous cherchons un directeur médical très motivé (en fonction de l'expérience) pour nous joindre à notre équipe de neuroimmunologie, en mettant l'accent sur la sclérose en plaques (SM). L'opportunité En tant que directeur médical, vous participerez ou dirigerez l'élaboration de plans de développement clinique (DC), assurant ainsi l'exécution efficace des stratégies pour les molécules et indications attribuées. Il s'agit d'un poste de cotisant individuel de niveau intermédiaire sans responsabilités de gestion des personnes. L'opportunité Pour nous aider à offrir des thérapies qui changent la vie aux patients, vous assumerez un rôle vital au sein de notre équipe de neuroimmunologie et assumerez les responsabilités clés suivantes :
• Stratégie et planification du PDC : Diriger ou contribuer à la création du Plan de développement clinique (PDC), recueillir des données pour assurer l'alignement stratégique sur les plans du cycle de vie à long terme.
• Conception et exécution de l'étude: Diriger la conception et l'exécution des études cliniques de phase II et III, en collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles sur l'analyse des études, la gestion des données et les profils de sécurité.
• Leadership scientifique : maintenir les niveaux les plus élevés de connaissances scientifiques et cliniques dans les domaines thérapeutiques de la sclérose en plaques et de la neuroimmunologie.
• Engagement en matière de réglementation : jouer un rôle actif dans les interactions entre les autorités sanitaires et fournir une expertise clinique pour les dossiers réglementaires, les trousses d'information et l'étiquetage.
• Collaboration avec les intervenants : établir et cultiver des relations avec les chercheurs cliniques, les leaders d'opinion clés (KOL) et les partenaires internes dans les domaines de la recherche, des opérations commerciales et du droit.
• Surveillance médicale: agir en tant que surveillance médicale pour les études attribuées, en assurant une interprétation correcte des données médicales et scientifiques. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons un expert résilient et scientifique qui apporte un mélange de connaissances cliniques avancées et de leadership collaboratif à notre équipe :
• Expertise académique et clinique: M.D. nécessaire avec une expérience clinique pertinente en tant que neurologue, y compris une formation spécialisée ou une expérience importante de travail avec des patients atteints de sclérose en plaques.
• Expérience scientifique et industrielle : Une solide expérience scientifique (publication dans des revues, des études ou des cours évalués par des pairs) est en plus de l'expérience privilégiée de l'industrie dans le domaine du développement clinique de la SEP (>2 ans) ou de la reconnaissance en tant qu'expert de la SEP (p. ex. professeur adjoint).
• Essais cliniques et connaissances en matière de réglementation : expérience importante en matière de conception et de réalisation d'essais cliniques, bonne compréhension de la phase II–III du développement des médicaments et connaissance requise des lignes directrices du GCP, de l'ICH, de la FDA et de l'EMA (préférés pour les candidats de premier niveau).
• Compétences en communication et interpersonnelles : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite et verbale pour présenter des données complexes, jumelées à la capacité d'établir des relations et une influence sans autorité dans un environnement complexe et interfonctionnel.
• Leadership stratégique et mobilité : un bon jugement pour la prise de décisions éthiques et commerciales, un leadership interfonctionnel fort et la capacité de voyager à l'échelle mondiale jusqu'à 30 %. Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. jobs.title: P&C Business Partner (Advisory) - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas.

The Opportunity:
As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization.
Your day to day responsibilities are:

• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.

• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.

• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.

• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application.

​
Who You Are:

• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.

• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.

• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.

• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.

• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.

• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.

• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities

jobs.title: Field Service Representative (Hampshire/Dorset area)

titleByLocale.it: Rappresentante del servizio di campo (zona Hampshire/Dorset)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you seeking an exciting challenge in a critical support role that directly contributes to the vital NHS Pathology services, where your work truly matters and makes a meaningful impact?

Does the prospect of a rewarding career with a progressive, high-tech organisation inspire you?

Key Information

• Supporting Southern Counties Pathology Network (South 6)

• Ideal for experienced field engineers, with strong diagnostic service/support background

• Primary focus support for electro-mechanical hardware, including routine proactive and reactive maintenance.

• Additional responsibilities in applications support, IT support, and customer training

• Must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Hampshire/Dorset area

About the Role

Roche Diagnostics is seeking an experienced Electro-Mechanical Engineer to join our team as a Field Service Representative in the South region (Hampshire/Dorset area) directly supporting customers in NHS pathology laboratories.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide frontline support across various Roche product portfolio at customer sites.

• Troubleshoot and taking ownership of technical faults

• Minimise unplanned downtime of laboratory equipment

• Use of digital tools for proactive preventative measures

• Conduct training for laboratory staff

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Ideally, degree-educated in Life Sciences OR qualified to HNC/HND level in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or with equivalent demonstrable experience - you will bring a current and comprehensive understanding of the IVD industry, paired with strong experience in delivering world-class support

• E xcellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Strong communication and teamwork abilities

• Resilient and tenacious, able to thrive under pressure

• Growth mindset

For this position, the location is in the Hampshire/Dorset area.

You will be expected to collaborate with the wider team and all other areas of Roche to provide best-in-class service to our customers. Amongst other duties, this will involve attending customer review meetings to outline key achievements and objectives attained.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant - Bulgarian speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English and Bulgarian

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support fle

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards.
You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards

• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns

• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance)

Data & Integration

• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data
Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation

• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance

Platform (Adobe Stack)

• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA

• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation

• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems

Real-time & Orchestration

• Design event-driven and streaming architectures

• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)

• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks

Strategy & Delivery

• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases

• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities

• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment

Qualifications

Experience

• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems

• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)

• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams

• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP)

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of:

• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation

• Event-driven / streaming architectures

• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems

• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR)

What Success Looks Like

• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards

• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

• Real-time orchestration and activation across channels

• Measurable business impact through improved customer engagement

• Strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication and effective translation of complex concepts into business value

• Ability to influence and drive adoption of architectural decisions across cross-functional teams

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so w

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).

What your key responsibilities will be:

• Vendor creation/maintenance in SAP

• Bank maintenance in SAP

• Vendor Request validation and approval

• Participation in data cleansing activities

• Replication monitoring

What you should bring to our company:

• Ongoing Hungarian University studies

• Able to work at least 30 hours per week

• Fluent English

• Knowledge of MS Office

• SAP knowledge is a plus

Why you should join us:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Free language courses

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• The Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing is a pivotal executive role within the Roche Turkey Leadership Team, entrusted with holistically architecting, leading, and executing the commercial vision and go-to-market strategies for the company's entire pharmaceutical portfolio.

This role functions as the "Chief Commercial Conductor," orchestrating and unifying both the strategic business units (Disease Area Teams) and the central marketing capabilities that serve them (Marketing Leads / Marketing Chapter) under a single, cohesive vision.

This leader directly manages and develops two distinct leadership groups: the Disease Area (DA) Leads and the Marketing Leads. Through the DA Leads, they hold ultimate accountability for the therapeutic area strategies and full P&L outcomes. Concurrently, through the Marketing Leads, they are responsible for embedding marketing excellence, fostering state-of-the-art capabilities, and ensuring the agile, strategic allocation of marketing resources across the entire Organization.

The fundamental purpose of this role is to build a seamless bridge between high-level strategy and flawless execution. By leveraging a deep strategic partnership with the Medical, Access, Regulatory & Government affairs, as well as the Business Excellence Division, this leader will ensure Roche achieves its ambitious market leadership and patient impact goals.

Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities

1. Integrated Commercial, Access, Medical, and Government Affairs strategy & execution:

• Architect and drive the overarching commercial strategy for all Disease Areas, ensuring the creation of integrated, omnichannel marketing and sales plans that are executed with excellence in the field.

• Lead portfolio-level strategic planning, including lifecycle management, competitive readiness, and new asset launch sequencing to maximize the long-term commercial value and patient impact of Roche’s portfolio.

• Assume ultimate ownership of commercial forecasting in partnership with finance, resource allocation, and budget management to ensure financial targets are met, and investments yield maximum ROI.

•
2. Disease Area (DA) P&L and Performance Leadership:

• Provide strategic direction, coaching, and empowerment to the DA Leads, holding full P&L accountability for the entire commercial organization. Drive the achievement of ambitious revenue growth, market share, and profitability targets.

• Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and urgency within the DA teams, ensuring they remain laser-focused on overcoming obstacles and achieving their strategic objectives.

• Ensure DA teams have the necessary resources, capabilities, and cross-functional support to win in their respective markets.

•
3. Marketing Capability & Excellence (Marketing Lead) Leadership:

• Lead and cultivate the central Marketing Leads (Marketing Chapter) team, acting as the chief steward of marketing talent and capability within the organization.

• Take direct responsibility for the professional development, career progression, performance management, and succession planning for the marketing talent pool.

• Implement a dynamic resource allocation model, ensuring marketing expertise is deployed fluidly and effectively to the highest-priority strategic initiatives within the DA teams.

• Champion and embed a culture of marketing excellence across the organization, setting the gold standard for brand planning, digital marketing, data analytics, customer journey mapping,

jobs.title: Patient Solution Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：患者解决方案经理

您是谁：
患者解决方案经理是相应疾病领域 HCP(医疗专业人士)的主要接触点,负责制定患者整体解决方案相关的策略和相关项目的支持和执行工作,包含但不限于患者全程管理、创新支付解决方案、疾病认知(患者教育)、准入及安全运营以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建等,从而提升标准化诊疗水平,提高患者知晓率和可及性,从而实现患者获益。

您的机会：
患者全程管理
1.在生态圈内绘制患者就医流转图,从而更好的推动全程管理在医院内/间的落地。
2.协助生态圈内医院及相关科室推进和打造会诊通道,协助上下层医院间衔接流转,助力绿色转诊通道的建立,最终实现患者获益。
3.管理生态圈内患者全程管理项目的各项落地实施,并确保其合规性。

支付方案
与准入团队合作,协助整合罗氏相关支付方案,传递完整支付解决方案信息。

疾病认知(患者教育)
与第三方机构协作,针对相关疾病领域区域现状及整体策略,协助开展患者教育,提升疾病认知,促进患者获益。

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 成长性思维和快速学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 优秀的沟和资源整合能力
• 5年以上医药行业工作经验,有管理经验者优先
• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: (Senior) Biostatistician for Clinical Algorithms
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Department
We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights.

Your Team
Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development.

Your Main Objectives and Tasks

• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.

• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.

• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.

• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.

• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams.

Who You Are

• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.

• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.

• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.

• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.

• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
The Opportunity
In this role, you join the global Talent Marketing team which aims to position Roche as the employer of choice for key candidates with targeted and innovative approaches to meet & address hiring and market needs.

• Shape our global brand by creating engaging video, social media, and visual content that showcases Roche as an employer of choice to talent worldwide.

• Gain experience through the support of high-impact content campaigns across LinkedIn, Instagram, and our global careers webpage.

• Master content management at scale by gaining hands-on experience with our global platforms, ensuring brand quality stays consistent across all channels.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Recruiting, Communications, and creative teams to bring authentic employer storytelling to life.

• D rive engagement by producing content that authentically represents Roche culture, helping to inspire and increase candidate applications.

• Innovate with new formats by experimenting with emerging digital trends and tools to keep our visual language at the cutting edge.

• Experience a culture of trust where your creative ideas are valued and you are empowered to take ownership of your projects.

Who you are
We are looking for a creative storyteller who is passionate about digital media and global collaboration.

• Visual Storyteller: You have demonstrable experience with video filming and editing , whether through academic projects, a personal portfolio, or professional work. Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) or similar platforms is an advantage.

• Brand-Aware: You understand how consistent visual language strengthens a message and enjoy working within brand guidelines to ensure quality.

• Curious and Self-Driven: You take initiative, enjoy experimenting with new content formats, and thrive in an environment that encourages continuous growth.

• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in English and feel comfortable collaborating with diverse, international teams across different time zones.

• Educational Background: You are a student or recent graduate in Communications, Marketing, Media, or a related creative field. Please note that your graduation date must not be more than 12 months prior to your start date.

Application process:
Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

# Roche - Global Talent Marketing Internship ## Mansioni In questo ruolo, ti unirai al team globale di Marketing del Talento, con l'obiettivo di posizionare Roche come il datore di lavoro preferito per i candidati chiave attraverso approcci mirati e innovativi per soddisfare e affrontare le esigenze di assunzione e del mercato. - Crea contenuti video, sui social media e visivi coinvolgenti che mostrano Roche come il datore di lavoro preferito per i talenti in tutto il mondo. - Acquisisci esperienza attraverso il supporto di campagne di contenuti ad alto impatto su LinkedIn, Instagram e sulla pagina delle carriere globale di Roche. - Gestisci i contenuti a livello globale, acquisendo esperienza pratica con le piattaforme globali di Roche, garantendo la qualità del marchio in tutti i canali. - Collabora con le funzioni di recruiting, comunicazione e creative per portare alla vita storie autentiche del datore di lavoro. - Produci contenuti che rappresentano autenticamente la cultura di Roche, aiutando a ispirare e aumentare le candidature dei candidati. - Innovare con nuovi formati sperimentando con le tendenze e gli strumenti digitali emergenti per mantenere il nostro linguaggio visivo all'avanguardia. - Esperienza una cultura di fiducia in cui le tue idee creative sono apprezzate e sei autorizzato a prendere il controllo dei tuoi progetti. ## Chi sei
• Stiamo cercando un narratore creativo appassionato di media digitali e collaborazione globale. - Narratore Visivo: Hai esperienza dimostrabile nella ripresa e nel montaggio video, indipendentemente dal fatto che sia attraverso progetti accademici, un portfolio personale o lavoro professionale. La familiarità con gli strumenti come Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) o piattaforme simili è un vantaggio. - Consapevole del Marchio: Capisci come il linguaggio visivo coerente rafforza un messaggio e ti piace lavorare all'interno delle linee guida del marchio per garantire la qualità. - Curioso e Autodriven: Prendi l'iniziativa, ti piace sperimentare con nuovi formati di contenuti e prosperi in un ambiente che incoraggia la crescita continua. - Comunicatore Forte: Sei fluente in inglese e ti senti a tuo agio nel collaborare con team internazionali diversi in diversi fusi orari. - Background Educativo: Sei uno studente o un neolaureato in Comunicazione, Marketing, Media o un campo creativo correlato. Si prega di notare che la data di laurea non deve superare i 12 mesi dalla data di inizio. ## Processo di applicazione Carica un CV aggiornato e una Lettera di Motivazione, in cui si indica la data preferita per l'inizio del tirocinio. ## Informazioni aggiuntive Si prega di notare che, a causa dei regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EEA devono fornire un certificato dall'università che attesti che un tirocinio è obbligatorio come parte dei documenti di applicazione e devono essere costantemente iscritti all'università per tutta la durata di questo tirocinio. Se sei entusiasta di contribuire e senti di avere la dedizione al lavoro di squadra e all'innovazione che cerchiamo, allora Roche è l'organizzazione per te. Ogni ruolo in Roche gioca un ruolo nel fare la differenza per le vite dei pazienti. Se vuoi lavorare in un team appassionato, lasciare il tuo segno e migliorare le vite, applica ora! ## Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge all'innovazione. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati ad avanzare la scienza, garantendo che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri medicinali e più di 30 miliardi di test effettuati utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. • Shape our global brand by creating engaging video, social media, and visual content that showcases Roche as an employer of choice to talent worldwide.

• Master content management at scale by gaining hands-on experience with our global platforms, ensuring brand quality stays consistent across all channels.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Recruiting, Communications, and creative teams to bring authentic employer storytelling to life.
• D rive engagement by producing content that authentically represents Roche culture, helping to inspire and increase candidate applications.
• Innovate with new formats by experimenting with emerging digital trends and tools to keep our visual language at the cutting edge.

• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in English and feel comfortable collaborating with diverse, international teams across different time zones.
• Educational Background: You are a student or recent graduate in Communications, Marketing, Media, or a related creative field. Please note that your graduation date must not be more than 12 months prior to your start date. Application process: Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship. If you are eager to contribute and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. descriptionByLocale.de: Roche - Global Talent Marketing Praktikanten In dieser Rolle werden Sie dem globalen Talent Marketing Team beitreten, mit dem Ziel, Roche als bevorzugten Arbeitgeber für Schlüsselanwärter durch gezielte und innovative Ansätze zu positionieren, um die Bedürfnisse von Aufnahme und Markt zu erfüllen. - Erstellen Sie Videoinhalte, auf Social Media und immersive Visuals, die Roche als bevorzugten Arbeitgeber für Talente auf der ganzen Welt zeigen. - Erkundigen Sie sich durch die Unterstützung von hochwirksamen Content-Kampagnen auf LinkedIn, Instagram und Roches globaler Karriereseite. - Content global verwalten, praktische Erfahrungen mit Roches globalen Plattformen sammeln und Markenqualität auf allen Kanälen gewährleisten. - Zusammenarbeit mit Rekrutierung, Kommunikation und kreativen Funktionen, um authentische Arbeitgebergeschichten zu leben. - Produzieren Sie Inhalte, die die Kultur von Roche authentisch repräsentieren und helfen, die Bewerbungen zu inspirieren und zu erhöhen. - Innovieren Sie mit neuen Formaten, indem Sie mit neuen digitalen Trends und Tools experimentieren, um unsere visuelle Sprache avantgarde zu halten. - Erleben Sie eine Vertrauenskultur, in der Ihre kreativen Ideen geschätzt werden und Sie sind berechtigt, die Kontrolle über Ihre Projekte zu übernehmen. Wer sind Sie auf der Suche nach einem kreativen Erzähler leidenschaftlich über digitale Medien und globale Zusammenarbeit. - Visive Narrator: Sie haben Erfahrung in Videoaufnahmen und -bearbeitung, unabhängig davon, ob es sich um akademische Projekte, ein persönliches Portfolio oder eine professionelle Arbeit handelt. Die Vertrautheit mit Tools wie Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) oder ähnlichen Plattformen ist ein Vorteil. - Achtung der Marke: Verstehen Sie, wie konsistente visuelle Sprache eine Nachricht stärkt und Sie gerne in den Richtlinien der Marke arbeiten, um Qualität zu gewährleisten. - Kurios und Autodriven: Nehmen Sie die Initiative, Sie möchten mit neuen Inhaltsformaten und -reifen in einer Umgebung experimentieren, die ein kontinuierliches Wachstum fördert. - Pressemitteilung: Sie sind fließend in Englisch und fühlen sich wohl, mit verschiedenen internationalen Teams in verschiedenen Zeitzonen zu arbeiten. - Bildungshintergrund: Sie sind Student oder Absolventen in Kommunikation, Marketing, Medien oder einem verwandten kreativen Bereich. Bitte beachten Sie, dass das Abschlussdatum 12 Monate ab dem Startdatum nicht überschreiten sollte. Bewerbungsprozess Hochladen eines aktualisierten Lebenslaufs und eines Motivationsschreibens, in dem Sie das bevorzugte Datum für den Beginn des Praktikums angeben. Zusätzliche Informationen Bitte beachten Sie, dass Nicht-EU/EWR-Bürger aufgrund der Verordnungen ein Zertifikat der Universität zur Verfügung stellen müssen, dass ein Praktikum im Rahmen der Bewerbungsunterlagen obligatorisch ist und für die Dauer dieses Praktikums an der Universität ständig eingeschrieben werden muss. Wenn Sie sich freuen, einen Beitrag zu leisten und das Gefühl haben Sie Engagement für Teamwork und Innovation, die wir suchen, dann ist Roche die Organisation für Sie. Jede Rolle in Roche spielt eine Rolle bei der Differenzierung des Patientenlebens. Wenn Sie in einem leidenschaftlichen Team arbeiten wollen, verlassen Sie Ihre Marke und verbessern Sie das Leben, bewerben Sie sich jetzt! Wer wir eine gesündere Zukunft sind, führt uns zu Innovation. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass alle heute und für zukünftige Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren diagnostischen Produkten durchgeführt werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - Stage en marketing de talents mondiaux Expéditions Dans ce rôle, vous rejoindrez l'équipe mondiale Talent Marketing, dans le but de positionner Roche comme employeur privilégié pour les candidats clés grâce à des approches ciblées et innovantes pour répondre aux besoins de l'accueil et du marché. - Créer du contenu vidéo, sur les médias sociaux immersifs et les visuels qui montrent Roche comme l'employeur préféré pour les talents partout dans le monde. - Acquérir de l'expérience grâce au soutien de campagnes de contenu à fort impact sur LinkedIn, Instagram et la page de carrière mondiale de Roche. - Gérer le contenu à l'échelle mondiale, acquérir une expérience pratique avec les plateformes mondiales de Roche, assurant la qualité de la marque sur tous les canaux. - Collaborer avec le recrutement, la communication et les fonctions créatives pour donner vie à des histoires d'employeurs authentiques. - Produire du contenu qui représente authentiquement la culture de Roche, aidant à inspirer et à augmenter les candidatures. - Innovez avec de nouveaux formats en expérimentant les nouvelles tendances et outils numériques pour garder notre langage visuel avant-gardiste. - Vivez une culture de confiance dans laquelle vos idées créatives sont appréciées et vous êtes autorisé à prendre le contrôle de vos projets. Qui êtes-vous ? Nous recherchons un narrateur créatif passionné par les médias numériques et la collaboration mondiale. - Visive Narrator: Vous avez prouvé votre expérience dans le tournage et l'édition vidéo, que ce soit par des projets académiques, un portfolio personnel ou un travail professionnel. La familiarité avec des outils comme Adobe Creative Suite (Premier Pro, After Effects) ou des plateformes similaires est un avantage. - Connaissance de la marque: Comprenez comment un langage visuel cohérent renforce un message et vous aimez travailler dans les lignes directrices de la marque pour assurer la qualité. - Curious et Autodrived: Prenez l'initiative, vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux formats de contenu et prospérer dans un environnement qui encourage la croissance continue. - Communiqué de presse: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais et vous sentez à l'aise de travailler avec différentes équipes internationales dans différents fuseaux horaires. - Contexte éducatif: Vous êtes étudiant ou diplômé en communication, marketing, médias ou un domaine de création connexe. Veuillez noter que la date du diplôme ne doit pas dépasser 12 mois à compter de la date de début. Processus de demande Télécharger un CV mis à jour et une lettre de motivation, en indiquant la date préférée pour le début du stage. Informations complémentaires Veuillez noter que, en raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non européens/EEE doivent fournir un certificat de l'université qui certifie qu'un stage est obligatoire dans le cadre des documents de candidature et doit être constamment inscrit à l'université pour la durée de ce stage. Si vous êtes heureux de contribuer et de vous sentir dévoué au travail d'équipe et à l'innovation que nous recherchons, Roche est l'organisation pour vous. Chaque rôle de Roche joue un rôle dans la vie des patients. Si vous voulez travailler dans une équipe passionnée, laissez votre marque et améliorez vos vies, appliquez maintenant! Qui sommes-nous ? Un avenir plus sain nous conduit à l'innovation. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés du monde entier se consacrent à faire progresser la science, en veillant à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Nos efforts mènent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests effectués avec nos produits de diagnostic.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.

• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.

• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 10.06.2026
(Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugniss

jobs.title: Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte de données/d'information - Plateformes de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

The first key priority of this architectural roadmap will focus on the modernization of Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organisation (HCO) master data programs , with a broader scaling strategy across alternative master data domains in future waves. A defining focus of your architectural design will be bridging the gap between traditional MDM platforms and advanced enterprise semantic layers, seamlessly transitioning master datasets into unified knowledge graphs that fuel cutting-edge Generative AI applications.

The Data Management and Data Quality Platforms area serves as the foundational intelligence engine of our global digital enterprise. Our mission is to scale a harmonized, FAIR-compliant master data framework that integrates heavily with an automated, AI-enabled Semantic Layer . By injecting contextual meaning, ontology standards, and relationship graphs into raw master data, we provide the enterprise with a single, high-trust, and discoverable view of our network. Joining this area means taking a leading role in ensuring that healthcare-specific data models remain contextually accurate, highly secure, compliant with global regulatory standards, and completely optimized for state-of-the-art machine learning deployment.

The opportunity:

• AI-Enabled MDM Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the technical execution of modernizing enterprise Master Data Management systems by integrating AI/ML capabilities for data matching, entity resolution, and data enrichment.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Act as the primary technical architect for the foundational Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO), and Business Partner/Vendor master data initiatives, ensuring high-fidelity modeling and scalability for subsequent domains.

• Semantic Layer Integration: Define the blueprints and mapping rules required to connect transactional master data with unified semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise knowledge graphs.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Ensure that master data models are fully machine-readable and explicitly struct

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme di dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come squadra globale al centro di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi imprenditoriali impegnati a plasmare il futuro digitale della sanità. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso le tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidati dalla scopo e dalla passione, stanno preparando un futuro in cui il digitale è un punto di forza capace di crescere in tutta Roche, volendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, radicando il potenziale umano e guidando i progressi che contano veramente per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offrendo un modello di lavoro ibrido che abbina flessibilità con la collaborazione in presenza. Per ora, richiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici in ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni di squadra e altri eventi collaborativi.
• Stiamo cercando un architetto di dati/informazione visionario all'interno della funzione RDT Data Platforms per guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione strategica delle nostre soluzioni di gestione dei dati master (MDM) guidate dall'AI. In questo ruolo, sarai l'architetto centrale che abilita l'intelligenza artificiale nell'ecosistema MDM, progetta i registri master relazionali legacy in asset dati intelligenti, contestualmenteassunzione e pronta per l'AI. La prima priorità chiave di questa roadmap architettonica si concentrerà sulla modernizzazione dei programmi di gestione dei dati dei professionisti sanitari (HCP) e delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO), con una strategia di scalabilità più ampia per i domini dei dati master alternativi nelle future ondate. Un focus definito della tua progettazione architettonica sarà colmare il potenziale tra le piattaforme MDM e gli strati semantici aziendali avanzati, passando senza soluzione di continuità i dataset master in grafica della conoscenza unificati che alimentano le applicazioni di generazione dell'AI all'avanguardia. L'area di gestione dei dati e delle piattaforme di qualità dei dati servono come motore di intelligenza fondazionale della nostra impresa digitale globale. La nostra missione è scalare un framework di dati master armonizzato, conformi alle specifiche FAIR, che si integra pesantemente con uno strato semantico automatizzato, AI-abilitato. Inserendo il significato contestuale, gli standard ontologici e i grafici delle relazioni nei dati master grezzi, per all'impresa una visuale unica, ad alta fiducia e scopribile della nostra rete. Unendoti a questa area, assumonorai un ruolo di primo piano nell'assicurarti che i modelli dei dati specifici del settore sanitario paganono accurati contestualmente, altamente sicuri, conformi agli standardtivi globali e completamente ottimizzati per il deployment del machine learning all'avanguardia. Opportunità - Architettura MDM abilitata all'AI: Architettare, progettare e guidare l'esecuzione tecnica della modernizzazione dei dati master dell'impresa integrando le capacità AI/ML per la corrispondenza dei dati, la risoluzione delle elezioni e l'arricchimento dei dati. - Leadership del programma HCP & HCO: Fare da architetto principale tecnico per le iniziative di gestione dei dati dei professionisti sanitari (HCP), delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO) e dei partner commerciali/venditori, assicurando la modellazione ad alta fedeltà e la scalabilità per i domini successivi. - Integrazione dello strato semantico: Definire i progetti e le regole di mappatura obbligatoria per connettere i dati master transazionali con gli strati semantici un, le onlogie e i grafici della conoscenza aziendale. - Ingegneria dei dati pronta per l'AI: Assicurarsi che i modelli dei dati master siano completamente leggibili dalle macchine e strutturati esplicitamente.

jobs.title: China Biomarker Studies Asset Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
YOUR TEAM
You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams.
ROLE PURPOSE
As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).

• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China

• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.

• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.

• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)

• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS

• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.

• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.

• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.
