jobs.title: Process Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Process Manager within our Design Control Excellence (DCE) team in Sant Cugat, you will be responsible for the essential development processes that ensure our life-saving diagnostic products are safe, effective, and compliant. You will play a key role in the execution of Requirement Management, Product Risk Management, Configuration Management, Defect Management and Verification & Validation within development projects. Joining a growing innovation hub, you will work in a cross-functional environment to secure compliant execution while continuously optimizing process efficiency to meet evolving organizational needs.

Key Responsabilities

• Process Support: Provide process guidance and support for system, software, and assay projects with low complexity across Risk, Requirements, Configuration, Verification & Validation and Defect Management.

• Product Requirements: Support the creation and maintenance of product requirements by using the respective IT tool. Ensure that the appropriate documentation is created and are responsible for obtaining approval from the stakeholders.Facilitate and maintain the requirements traceability throughout the development of the product

• R isk Assessment: Support execution of product risk assessments. Create and maintain respective risk documentation.

• Configuration Management : Establish and maintain Configuration Management for projects, maintaining a clear overview of past, present, and future product configurations.

• Defect Management: Support with defect management by creating the defect management plan and managing defects.

• Verification & Validation: Provide support to ensure that V&V activities are planned, executed and documented according to our internal procedures.

• Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process optimization and "radical simplification" to improve time-to-market without compromising quality

Who You Are

You are a proactive and service-oriented professional who excels at analytical thinking, problem-solving, and precise communication. You possess a collaborative mindset and are excited to grow your skills in a dynamic environment where we experiment and learn together.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Educational Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Natural Sciences, or a related field.

• Regulated Industry Expertise: A minimum of three years of professional experience in a regulated product development environment (or a Master's degree), with preferred exposure to the Medical Device or Diagnostics industry.

• Technical Process Mastery: A understanding of Design Control processes and relevant global standards, such as ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

• Digital Fluency: Familiarity with ALM tracking systems (such as Jira, Azure DevOps, RETINA, or HP ALM) is considered a plus.

• Exceptional Communication: Clear, precise, and efficient communication skills in English; knowledge of Spanish is a valuable asset.

There are 2 positions of this role.

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together.

jobs.title: Clinical Site Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Clinical Site Manager for the Study Delivery Near Patient Care CVMD team, you are designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies at the clinical study sites. You are delivering other data generation methodologies, working independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocol, standard operating procedures, good clinical practices, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

The Opportunity

Acting as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, coordinating training, certification, and providing technical assistance to ensure successful study execution.

• Performing site assessments and qualification visits to support the site selection decision process and site activation activities, including contracting and obtaining IRB/EC/Health Authority approvals in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Developing and managing key study site documentation, such as Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, source documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to review study protocols, data management plans, reports, and manuscripts.

• Overseeing CROs for the delivery of site management activities, including training CRO CRAs, escalating issues, and collaborating with international investigators and key customers while mentoring and supporting colleagues to enhance their skills and expertise.

• Executing site management activities for sponsored studies in assigned focus areas across all phases of study (start-up, conduct, and close-out) for both registrational and non-registrational purposes.

• Validating product performance claims, supplying data for critical regulatory submissions, defining the functional and clinical utility of products, and gathering feedback and opinions from laboratories or customers regarding the products.

• Working in local and global study teams, including virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve business goals and ensure operational excellence.

Who You Are

• You bring a Bachelor's degree in Science Degree preferably in Health Sciences like Clinical Diagnostics or engineering (or equivalent combination of education and work experience)

• You have 3 years of working experience in either the Medical Device or Diagnostics industry, and 2 years of working experience in clinical study of IVD/Medical Device/Drug.

• You have experience particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication and Near Patient Care or Point of Care. Experience with studies in an emergency department setting is a plus.

• Excellent understanding of ICH GCP guidelines in the execution of clinical trials

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Exhibits the ability to make sound decisions and to analyze and solve problems; makes independent choices and takes responsibility

• ​ Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability to perform in a fast-paced, matrixed environment where fluid, cross-team collaboration is crucial.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be

Mansioni Responsabile del sito clinico per la consegna dello studio presso il team CVMD della cura dei pazienti Descrizione Come Clinical Site Manager per il team Study Delivery Near Patient Care CVMD, sei responsabile della progettazione, pianificazione, coordinamento e conduzione di tutte le attività necessarie nell'avvio, nel monitoraggio e nel monitoraggio degli studi di ricerca clinica nei siti di studio clinico. anche altre metodologie di generazione dei dati, lavorando in modo indipendente per garantire che gli studi ricevonoti, registrati e segnalati in conformità al protocollo, alle procedure operative standard, alle buone pratiche cliniche e ad altre normative applicabili. Opportunità - Agire come il principale punto di contatto e esperto di studio clinico per il personale del sito assegnato, coordinatere la formazione, la certificazione e fornire assistenza tecnica per garantire l'esecuzione dello studio. - E diretto del sito e visite di qualificazione per supportare il processo di selezione del sito e le attività di attivazione del sito, comprese le attività di contrattazione e l'ottenimento dei consensi IRB/EC/Autorità sanitaria in conformità alle normative applicabili. - Piattaforma e gestire la documentazione chiave del sito di studio, come i piani di monitoraggio dello studio, i documenti di consenso informato, i documenti di origine, le guide per l'istruzione del paziente e i moduli di raccolta dei dati, con conseguente con la tua esperienza tecnica alla revisione dei protocolli di studio, dei piani di gestione dei dati, dei rapporti e dei manoscritti. - Sorvegliare i CRO per la consegna delle attività di gestione del sito, inclusa la formazione dei CRO CRAs, la risoluzione dei problemi e la collaborazione con gli investigatori internazionali e i principali clienti, mentendo e supportando i comandi per migliorare le loro competenze e conoscenze. - Eseguire le attività di gestione del sito per gli studi sponsorizzati nelle aree interessanti di assegnate in tutte le fasi dello studio (avvio, condotta e chiusura) per scopi registrativi e non registrativi. - Validare le competenze di prestazione del prodotto, fornire dati per le presentazioni normative critiche, definire l'utilità e clinica dei prodotti e raccogliere i feedback e le opinioni dai laboratori o dai clienti sui prodotti. -re in team di studio locali e globali, compresi i team virtuali Lavorai, dimostrando diversità, consapevolezza culturale e favorindo relazioni collaborative forti con i membri del team multifunzionale, gli stakeholder interni ed i partner esterni per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali e garantire l'eccellenza operativa.
• Requisiti - Diploma di laurea in Scienze, preferibilmente in Scienze della Salute come Diagnostica Clinica o Ingegneria (o combinazione equivalente di istruzione e esperienza lavorativa) - 3 anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore dei Dispositivi Medici o Diagnostici e 2 anni di esperienza matura negli studi clinici di IVD/Dispositivo Medico/Farmaco. - Esperienza particolare nell'indicazione cardiovascolare/metabolica e Near Patient Care o Point of Care. L'esperienza con gli studi in un setting di pronto soccorso è un plus. - Ottima conoscenza delle linee guida ICH GCP nell'esecuzione degli studi clinici. Comportamenti, competenze e qualità del candidato ideale - Dimostra la capacità di prendere decisioni ponderate e di analizzare e risolvere i problemi; prende decisioni indipendenti e si assume la responsabilità delle proprie azioni. - Dimostra flessibilità e adattabilità per operare in un ambiente veloce e strutturato in matrice, dove la collaborazione incrociata tra i team è fondamentale. jobs.title: Clinical Contract Administrator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Clinical Contract Administrator, you will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth financial and operational execution of our clinical studies. You will act as a key collaborator between Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Procurement, Legal, and Finance to manage the lifecycle of supplier contracts and payments. This is an opportunity to join a high-performing team where your attention to detail directly supports the delivery of innovative healthcare solutions.

The key accountabilities for this position include but are not limited to

• Drive Financial Accuracy: Create and track purchase orders (POs), invoices, and accruals using our financial systems to ensure all supplier payments are precise and timely.

• Optimize Data Integrity: Maintain and update contract information within our tracking tools to ensure completeness and accuracy at all times.

• Master Contract Lifecycle Management: Take end-to-end responsibility for the contract signature process, from initial request through to service termination and final reconciliation. Track, maintain, and update assigned contract information within the CDMA tracking tools to ensure completeness and accuracy, as applicable.

• Champion Compliance Reporting: Prepare and submit reports regarding transfers of value to healthcare providers, ensuring full adherence to industry transparency standards like the Sunshine Act.

• Build Strategic Partnerships: Cultivate strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional leaders and external suppliers to meet ambitious business goals.

• Help drive the site budget negotiations in alignment with Fair Market Value.

• Other tasks may be assigned from time to time to support the overall CDMA function.

Who You Are
You are an organized and detail-oriented professional who thrives in fast-paced, matrixed environments. You are a natural collaborator who enjoys solving complex financial administrative challenges while working alongside diverse global teams.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Educational Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field (or equivalent relevant expertise in the healthcare industry).

• Sector Experience: 3-5+ years of professional experience, with specific expertise in purchase order (PO) creation and invoice management. Experience with negotiating budgets with clinical sites is a plus.

• Technical Proficiency: Proven experience tracking financial data such as accruals and payments within complex business environments.

• Collaborative Mindset: The ability to work independently while effectively partnering across functions like Legal, Procurement, and Clinical Operations.

• Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to perform in a fast-paced, matrixed environment where fluid, cross-team collaboration is crucial.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English).

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

L'esperienza nella definizione dei budget con i siti clinici è un plus. - Competenze Tecniche: Prova esperienza nel tracciamento dei dati finanziari come accantonamenti e pagamenti all'interno di ambienti aziendali complessi. - Mentalità Collaborativa: La capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mentre si collabora con le funzioni come Legal, Procurement e Clinical Operations. - Flessibilità e Adattabilità: Dimostra flessibilità e adattabilità per operare in un ambiente veloce e matricizzato in cui la collaborazione cross-team fluida è fondamentale. - Eccellenti Abilità di Comunicazione Verbale e Scritta** (Inglese). jobs.title: Senior Clinical Data Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe care should start before disease takes hold. As a Senior Clinical Data Specialist within our Clinical Operations team, you will perform expert-level data management activities that directly enable innovation, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement across our clinical and development projects. In this pivotal role, you will ensure the delivery of complete, accurate data ready for analysis and regulatory submission, helping us deliver life-changing healthcare solutions faster and more efficiently.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead Complex Projects : Function as the Lead Data Manager (LDM) and primary point of contact for clinical data management issues, guiding data management teams on large-scale programs and managing timelines and resource planning.

• Define Data Architecture : Use your professional expertise to define study-specific data workflows, clinical database requirements, and create comprehensive data management documentation (including CRFs, DMPs, database specifications, and data transfer specifications).

• Ensure Data Excellence : Oversee data quality by defining performance metrics, analysing trends, and performing expert data reviews to identify and resolve incomplete or discrepant data.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally : Represent Data Management in cross-functional study team meetings, providing technical clarification and fostering strong partnerships across departments.

• Mentor and Coach : Drive departmental excellence by mentoring team members, sharing best practices, and supporting the implementation of new technologies.

Who You Are

You are a collaborative, analytical problem-solver who thrives in a dynamic environment and excels at translating complex technical data concepts for non-technical colleagues. You bring strong professional judgment, a dedication to data quality, and a passion for mentoring others to reach their full potential. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Educational Background : A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a scientific discipline.

• Clinical Data Expertise : Extensive, progressive experience in clinical data management with a comprehensive understanding of the clinical study process.

descriptionByLocale.de: Sendungen Bei Roche zählt jede Stimme. Hier können Sie sich selbst sein, für Ihre Einzigartigkeit geschätzt und ermutigt, sich persönlich auszudrücken, offen Dialog und echte Verbindungen zu schaffen. Unsere Kulturwerte, akzeptiert und respektiert jedes Individuum und ermöglicht es Ihnen, sowohl auf persönlicher als auch auf professioneller Ebene zu leben. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen, den Zugang zur Pflege heute und für zukünftige Generationen gewährleisten. Begleiten Sie Roche und helfen, einen Unterschied zu machen. Die Lage Bei Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) ist unsere Mission klar: zuerst diagnostizieren, schneller entwickeln und die Behandlung anpassen, weil jeder Patient einzigartig ist. Unser Team von Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) leitet Innovationen, um die Gesundheitsergebnisse weltweit zu verbessern. Wir betrachten uns als ein Team, das sein volles Potenzial nur durch die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden erreichen kann. Wenn wir Patienten und Ärzte aufmerksam zuhören und die Digitalisierung und neue Technologien nutzen, nähern wir uns ihren wirklichen Bedürfnissen. Dieser kollaborative Geist schafft eine Umgebung, in der Ideen wachsen können, und Sie können neue Wege versuchen, Dinge zu tun - mit dem Ergebnis von wettbewerbsfähigen Produkten, die zu Patienten schneller kommen. Unsere Arbeit deckt den gesamten Lebenszyklus des Produktes ab, von der Entdeckung bis zum Post-Lunch. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams, externen Partnern und Patienten bietet das CDMA-Kapitel wertvolle medizinische Informationen, Designs und führt klinische Studien durch und bietet Marktunterstützung. Schließlich generieren wir komplette klinische Studien, die die Sicherheit, Wirksamkeit und wissenschaftliche Gültigkeit des Produktes demonstrieren - die Registrierung, Annahme und Erstattung von Produkten weltweit, um Leben zu retten und die Qualität des Patientenlebens zu verbessern. Die Chance In Roche glauben wir, dass die Behandlung beginnen sollte, bevor sich die Krankheit manifestiert. Als Senior Clinical Data Specialist in unserem Klinischen Operations-Team werden Sie kompetente Datenmanagement-Aktivitäten durchführen, die Innovationen, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in unseren klinischen und Entwicklungsprojekten direkt ermöglichen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle stellen Sie sicher, dass vollständige und genaue Daten für die regulatorische Analyse und Präsentation bereit sind und helfen uns, Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern, die das Leben schneller und effizienter verändern. Schlüsselverantwortung - Guide Complex Projects: Es arbeitet als Lead Data Manager (LDM) und Hauptkontaktpunkt für klinische Datenmanagement-Probleme, führt Datenmanagement-Teams zu großen Programmen und verwaltet Zeit- und Ressourcenplanung. - Definition von Data Architecture: Benutzen Sie Ihre Berufserfahrung, um studienspezifische Daten-Workflows, klinische Datenbankanforderungen zu definieren und eine vollständige Datenverwaltungsdokumentation zu erstellen (einschließlich CRF-Module, Datenmanagementpläne, Datenbankspezifikationen und Datentransferspezifikationen). - Datenschutz-Exzellenz: Es überwacht die Qualität der Daten durch Definition von Leistungsmetriken, Analyse von Trends und Durchführung von Expertendaten-Revisionen, um unvollständige oder diskrete Daten zu identifizieren und zu lösen. - Cross-Function-Kollaboration: Es stellt das Data Management in den Sitzungen des funktionsübergreifenden Studienteams dar und bietet technische Klärung und Förderung starker Partnerschaften zwischen den Abteilungen. - Mentoring and Coaching: Fördern Sie die Exzellenz der Abteilung durch lügende Teammitglieder, teilen Sie die besten Praktiken und unterstützen Sie die Umsetzung neuer Technologien. Wer sind Sie? Sie sind ein analytischer Mitarbeiter, der Probleme und Drives in einem dynamischen Umfeld löst und sich in der Übersetzung komplexer technischer Datenkonzepte für nichttechnische Kollegen auszeichnet. Bringen Sie ein starkes professionelles Urteil, Engagement für die Datenqualität und eine Leidenschaft für Mentoring andere, um ihr volles Potenzial zu erreichen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: - Akademische Ausbildung: Master-Abschluss oder Abschluss in einer wissenschaftlichen Disziplin. - Erfahrung im klinischen Datenmanagement: Umfangreiche und fortschrittliche Erfahrung im klinischen Datenmanagement mit einem vollständigen Verständnis der klinischen Studie. - Regelmäßiges Wissen: Ein fundiertes Wissen über internationale Vorschriften und Richtlinien für die Verwaltung von klinischen Daten. Kontakt Für weitere Informationen oder um sich zu bewerben, besuchen Sie unsere Website oder kontaktieren Sie unser Personalteam.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche, chaque voix compte. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, en assurant l'accès aux soins aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Rejoignez Roche et aidez à faire la différence. Position Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer d'abord, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe Développement clinique et affaires médicales (CDMA) guide l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous considérons comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel qu'en travaillant avec nos clients. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins et en profitant de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous abordons leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent grandir et vous pouvez essayer de nouvelles façons de faire - avec le résultat de produits compétitifs qui arrivent aux patients plus rapidement. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaboration avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales précieuses, conçoit et réalise des études cliniques et offre un soutien commercial. Enfin, nous produisons des essais cliniques complets qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique du produit - facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits dans le monde entier pour sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. Possibilités À Roche, nous pensons que les soins devraient commencer avant que la maladie ne se manifeste. En tant que spécialiste principal des données cliniques au sein de notre équipe des opérations cliniques, vous effectuerez des activités de gestion des données d'experts qui permettent directement l'innovation, les idées fondées sur les données et l'amélioration continue de nos projets cliniques et de développement. Dans ce rôle clé, vous veillerez à ce que des données complètes et précises soient prêtes pour l'analyse et la présentation réglementaires, nous aidant à fournir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie plus rapidement et efficacement. Key Responsibility - Guida Progetti Complessi: Il fonctionne comme gestionnaire de données principal (DND) et principal point de contact pour les questions de gestion des données cliniques, guide les équipes de gestion des données sur les grands programmes et gère la planification du temps et des ressources. - Définition de l'architecture des données : Utilisez votre expérience professionnelle pour définir les flux de données spécifiques à l'étude, les besoins des bases de données cliniques et créer une documentation complète de gestion des données (y compris les modules CRF, les plans de gestion des données, les spécifications des bases de données et les spécifications de transfert de données). - Assurer l'excellence des données : Il supervise la qualité des données en définissant des paramètres de rendement, en analysant les tendances et en effectuant des révisions de données d'experts pour identifier et résoudre des données incomplètes ou discordantes. - Collaboration interfonctions : Représente la gestion des données aux réunions de l'équipe d'étude interfonctionnelle, fournissant des éclaircissements techniques et favorisant des partenariats solides entre les ministères. - Mentorat et coaching : Promouvoir l'excellence du département en faisant partie de l'équipe, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en appuyant la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies. Qui êtes-vous un collaborateur analytique qui résout les problèmes et prospère dans un environnement dynamique, excellent dans la traduction de concepts de données techniques complexes pour les collègues non techniques. Apportez un jugement professionnel fort, un dévouement à la qualité des données et une passion pour le mentorat afin d'atteindre leur plein potentiel. Pour y arriver, vous devrez : - Formation académique : Maîtrise ou diplôme dans une discipline scientifique. - Expérience en gestion des données cliniques: Expérience étendue et progressive en gestion des données cliniques avec une compréhension complète de l'essai clinique. - Connaissances régulières : Une connaissance solide des règlements et lignes directrices internationaux pour la gestion des données cliniques. Contact Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez notre site Web ou contactez notre équipe de ressources humaines.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies. If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic area, specifically in Near Patient Care , we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.

• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Biostatistics, Data Management, Medical Affairs and CDMA Project Teams.

• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.

• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.

• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).

• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.

• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.

• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including cross-functional teams, CROs, opinion leaders, investigators, and key customers.

Your Profile:

• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication and Near Patient Care or Point of Care. Experience with studies in an emergency department setting is a plus.

• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related field. A backgro

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

As a Global Study Lead, you will take full accountability for the design, planning, and execution of global sponsored clinical trials from protocol development through to close-out. Joining a dynamic, matrixed team within our Clinical Development and Medical Affairs communities, you will oversee diverse study portfolios, including companion diagnostics, early adopter programs, and research collaborations, ensuring operational excellence, budget control, and absolute inspection readiness.

• Drive Study Excellence : Lead the global cross-functional study team with full accountability for high-quality study designs, clinical deliverables, budgets, and timelines.

• Shape Evidence Strategies : Partner with Program Leadership to map out innovative scenarios for global evidence generation, collaborating across Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and medical project teams.

• Author Core Study Documentation : Develop critical, high-impact clinical documents including study protocols, Design Validation Plans, study forms, and comprehensive study reports.

• Champion Strategic Partnerships : Oversee external service providers and Contract Research Organisations (CROs), driving vendor performance, selection, and relationship management at the study level.

• Advance Diagnostics Innovation : Direct the operational aspects of companion diagnostics studies sponsored by external partners alongside early access and research collaboration portfolios.

• Cultivate Expert Networks : Collaborate closely with international medical opinion leaders, investigators, and key external stakeholders to bring advanced external insights in-house.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, analytical clinical operations professional who thrives in fast-paced, global environments. You bring a collaborative mindset, excellent communication skills, and a passion for delivering life-changing clinical insights.

• A degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related scientific field (an advanced degree is a plus).

• Strong, progressive experience in clinical trial management or study-level execution within the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology sectors. Preferably experience study managing Molecular IVD clinical trials.

• Solid working knowledge of clinical research standards and gl

Unendo un team dinamico e matriceto all'interno delle nostre comunità di sviluppo clinico e affari medici, supervisionerete diversi portafogli di studio, tra cui la diagnostica dei compagni, i programmi di adozione precoce e le collaborazioni di ricerca, assicurando l'eccellenza operativa, il controllo del bilancio e la disponibilità assoluta di ispezione.
• Eccellenza di studio di guida: guidare il team di studio multifunzionale globale con piena responsabilità per progetti di studio di alta qualità, materiali clinici, budget e tempi.
• Strategie di prova di forma: Partner con Leadership del programma per mappare scenari innovativi per la generazione di prove globali, collaborando tra i team di regolamentazione, R&D e progetti medici.
• Documentazione di studio dell'autore: Sviluppare documenti clinici critici e ad alto impatto, compresi i protocolli di studio, piani di convalida della progettazione, moduli di studio e rapporti di studio completi.
• Partenariati strategici del campione: supervisionare i fornitori di servizi esterni e le organizzazioni di ricerca dei contratti (CRO), guidare le prestazioni del fornitore, la selezione e la gestione dei rapporti a livello di studio.
• Advance Diagnostics Innovation: Dirigere gli aspetti operativi degli studi di diagnostica dei compagni sponsorizzati da partner esterni insieme ai portafogli di collaborazione di accesso anticipato e di ricerca.
• Coltivare le reti di esperti: collaborare a stretto contatto con i leader internazionali di opinione medica, i ricercatori e le principali parti interessate esterne per portare in-house approfondimenti esterni avanzati. Chi sei Sei un professionista proattivo e analitico delle operazioni cliniche che prospera in ambienti veloci e globali. Porti una mentalità collaborativa, eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, e una passione per la fornitura di intuizioni cliniche che cambiano la vita.
• Una laurea in Scienze della Vita, Sanità, o un campo scientifico correlato (una laurea avanzata è un plus).
• Esperienza forte e progressiva nella gestione di studi clinici o nell'esecuzione a livello di studio all'interno del settore sanitario, farmaceutico o biotecnologico. Preferibilmente sperimentare la gestione di studi clinici Molecular IVD.
• Solida conoscenza del lavoro degli standard di ricerca clinica e gl

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer plus tôt, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous voyons nous-mêmes et nos clients comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel ensemble. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins, en tirant parti de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous nous rapprochons de leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent croître et de nouvelles façons de faire peuvent être essayées - ce qui donne lieu à des produits compétitifs qui parviennent plus rapidement aux patients. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaborant avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales cruciales, conçoit et exécute des études cliniques et offre un soutien sur le marché. En fin de compte, nous produisons les preuves cliniques complètes qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique des produits - en facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits à l'échelle mondiale afin que nous puissions sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. L'opportunité En tant que responsable de l'étude mondiale, vous serez pleinement responsable de la conception, de la planification et de l'exécution d'essais cliniques parrainés à l'échelle mondiale, depuis l'élaboration de protocoles jusqu'à la clôture. En vous joignant à une équipe dynamique et matricielle au sein de nos communautés de développement clinique et d'affaires médicales, vous superviserez divers portefeuilles d'études, y compris des diagnostics complémentaires, des programmes d'adoption précoce et des collaborations de recherche, assurant l'excellence opérationnelle, le contrôle budgétaire et la préparation absolue à l'inspection.
• L'excellence de l'étude : Dirigez l'équipe mondiale d'étude interfonctionnelle avec une responsabilité totale pour les études de haute qualité, les résultats cliniques, les budgets et les délais.
• Stratégies de mise en forme des données probantes : partenariat avec le leadership du programme pour définir des scénarios novateurs pour la production de données probantes à l'échelle mondiale, la collaboration entre les équipes des Affaires réglementaires, de la R-D et des projets médicaux.
• Author Core Study Documentation : Élaborer des documents cliniques critiques à impact élevé incluant des protocoles d'étude, des plans de validation de conception, des formulaires d'étude et des rapports d'étude approfondie.
• Champion Partenariats stratégiques : Superviser les fournisseurs de services externes et les organismes de recherche sous contrat (ORC), qui conduisent les performances des fournisseurs, la sélection et la gestion des relations au niveau de l'étude.
• Advance Diagnostics Innovation : Diriger les aspects opérationnels des études de diagnostics complémentaires parrainées par des partenaires externes, ainsi que les portefeuilles de collaborations d'accès et de recherche précoces.
• Cultiver les réseaux d'experts : Collaborer étroitement avec les leaders internationaux de l'opinion médicale, les chercheurs et les principales parties prenantes externes afin d'apporter des informations externes avancées à l'interne. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et analytique des opérations cliniques qui prospère dans des environnements rapides et mondiaux. Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif, d'excellentes compétences en communication et une passion pour fournir des perspectives cliniques changeantes.
• Un diplôme en sciences de la vie, santé, ou un domaine scientifique connexe (un diplôme avancé est un plus).
• Expérience solide et progressive de la gestion des essais cliniques ou de l'exécution au niveau de l'étude dans les secteurs des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques ou des biotechnologies. De préférence, l'expérience d'une étude portant sur la gestion des essais cliniques de DIV moléculaires.
• Bonne connaissance pratique des normes de recherche clinique

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies. If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic disease area (CVMD), specifically in Core Lab SWA (Serum Work Area) Systems and Automation, we would love to hear from you! • Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.
• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D,Biostatistics, Data Management and CDMA Project Teams.
• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.
• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.
• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.
• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).
• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.
• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.
• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication. Experience with IVD clinical and analytical system studies in the Core Lab Serum Work Area setting is a plus.
• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthc

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

As a Clinical Site Manager specialising in IVDR and Study Start-Up, you will be responsible for designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies at assigned sites. You will work independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocols, standard operating procedures, and global regulatory guidelines.
In this role, you will:

• Lead end-to-end study start-up activities , driving site selection, activation, and qualification assessments to ensure clinical trials launch efficiently and are compliance-ready.

• Manage Ethics Committee (EC) and Competent Authority (CA) submissions , ensuring all trial documentation is available, local contracts, Ethics Committee and Competent Authority approvals meet stringent regulatory requirements.

• Provide robust CRO oversight , monitoring external partner deliverables, tracking milestones, and escalation of any issues..

• Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, for execution of the study - including training and coordinating certification of study site personnel, and provide technical assistance, as necessary.

• Develop critical study documentation , including informed consent documents, patient instruction guides, and key documents for EC/CA submissions

• Collaborate cross-functionally with global, local, and virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve business goals and ensure operational excellence.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, collaborative, and highly organised clinical research professional who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess strong problem-solving skills, make sound independent decisions, and excel at managing external vendor relationships.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Education & Experience : A degree in a scientific discipline or related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience) combined with a proven track record in clinical operations or clinical trial coordination.

• Study Start-Up & Sub

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Annexe Responsabilité - Diriger les activités de démarrage de l'étude de bout en bout, la sélection du site de conduite, l'activation et les évaluations des qualifications pour assurer le lancement efficace des essais cliniques et être prêt à se conformer. - Gérer les soumissions des comités d'éthique (CE) et de l'autorité compétente (AC), en s'assurant que toute la documentation d'essai est disponible, les contrats locaux, les approbations des comités d'éthique et de l'autorité compétente satisfont aux exigences réglementaires rigoureuses. - Assurer une surveillance robuste du BRC, surveiller les résultats attendus des partenaires externes, suivre les étapes et augmenter les enjeux. - Agir en tant que premier contact et expert en essais cliniques pour le personnel affecté au site d'étude, pour l'exécution de l'étude - y compris la formation et la coordination de la certification du personnel du site d'étude, et fournir une assistance technique, au besoin. - Élaborer des documents d'étude critique, y compris des documents de consentement éclairé, des guides d'instruction des patients et des documents clés pour les présentations EC/CA - Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle avec des équipes mondiales, locales et virtuelles, démontrer la diversité, la sensibilisation culturelle et favoriser des relations solides et collaboratives avec des membres de l'équipe interfonctionnelles, des intervenants internes et des partenaires externes afin d'atteindre les objectifs opérationnels et d'assurer l'excellence opérationnelle. Chi Sei
• Requisiti - Éducation et expérience : Diplôme dans une discipline scientifique ou un domaine connexe (ou combinaison équivalente d'éducation et d'expérience) combiné à un dossier éprouvé en opérations cliniques ou en coordination d'essais cliniques. Abilità - Mise en route de l'étude et présentations : Expérience éprouvée dans les processus de mise en route et de présentation de l'étude, avec une bonne compréhension des exigences réglementaires. - Gestion de projet : Capacité démontrée de gérer plusieurs projets, de prioriser les tâches et de respecter les délais. - Gestion des intervenants : Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité d'établir et de maintenir des relations solides avec les intervenants internes et externes. - Résolution des problèmes : compétences solides en résolution des problèmes et capacité à prendre des décisions indépendantes solides. - Sensibilisation culturelle : Sensibilisation culturelle démontrée et capacité de travailler efficacement dans un environnement global et matriciel. Contatto Per candidarsi, inviare il proprio curriculum vitae all'indirizzo [adresse email] o visitare il nostro sito web per ulteriori informazioni sulla posizione e sul processo di candidatura.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

As a Clinical Site Manager for the Study Delivery Near Patient Care CVMD team, you are designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies at the clinical study sites. You are delivering other data generation methodologies, working independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocol, standard operating procedures, good clinical practices, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

The Opportunity

• Acting as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, coordinating training, certification, and providing technical assistance to ensure successful study execution.

• Performing site assessments and qualification visits to support the site selection decision process and site activation activities, including contracting and obtaining IRB/EC/Health Authority approvals in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Developing and managing key study site documentation, such as Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, source documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to review study protocols, data management plans, reports, and manuscripts.

• Overseeing CROs for the delivery of site management activities, including training CRO CRAs, escalating issues, and collaborating with international investigators and key customers while mentoring and supporting colleagues to enhance their skills and expertise.

• Executing site management activities for sponsored studies in assigned focus areas across all phases of study (start-up, conduct, and close-out) for both registrational and non-registrational purposes.

• Validating product performance claims, supplying data for critical regulatory submissions, defining the functional and clinical utility of products, and gathering feedback and opinions from laboratories or customers regarding the products.

• Working in local and global study teams, including virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve business goals and ensure operat

Roche - Responsabile del sito clinico - Studio Consegna vicino alla cura dei pazienti CVMD Mansioni - Agire come punto di contatto principale e esperto di studi clinici per il personale del sito assegnato, coordinatere la formazione, la certificazione e fornire assistenza tecnica per garantire l'esecuzione dello studio. - E diretta del sito e visite di qualificazione per supportare il processo di selezione del sito e le attività di attivazione del sito, inclusi contratti e approvazioni IRB/EC/autorità competente in conformità ai requisiti normativi. - Piattaforma e gestire la documentazione chiave del sito dello studio, come ad esempio i piani di monitoraggio dello studio, i documenti accettabili informati, i documenti sorgente, le guide per l'istruzione del paziente e i moduli CRF, mentre si verifica con l'esperienza tecnica alla revisione dei piani di gestione dei dati, dei rapporti e dei manoscritti. - Sorvegliare i CRO per la consegna delle attività di gestione del sito, inclusa la formazione dei CRA dei CRO, la risoluzione dei problemi e la collaborazione con gli investigatori internazionali e i clienti chiave, mentre si mentora e si supportano i comandi per migliorare le loro competenze e l'esperienza. - Eseguire le attività di gestione del sito per gli studi sponsorizzati nelle aree interessanti di assegnate in tutte le fasi dello studio (avvio, conduzione e chiusura) per scopi registrativi e non registrativi. - Validare le competenze di prestazione del prodotto, fornire dati per le presentazioni normative critiche, definire l'utilità e clinica dei prodotti e feedback e opinioni dai laboratori o dai clienti rispetto ai prodotti. -re in team di studio locali e globali, inclusi team virtuali Lavora, dimostrando diversità, consapevolezza culturale e favorindo relazioni collaborative forti con i membri del team cross-funzionale, gli stakeholder interni e i partner esterni per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali e garantire il funzionamento operativo.
• Requisiti - Esperienza nella gestione dei siti clinici e nella conduzione di studi clinici. - Conoscenza delle normative internazionali in materia di studi clinici. - Capacità di gestione dei progetti e delle attività. - Buone capacità comunicative e di collaborazione. - Esperienza nella gestione di team e nella formazione dei benefici. - Conoscenza della lingua inglese. Cosa? - Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e rispettoso, dove ogni voce conta. - L'opportunità di contribuire alla prevenzione, alla cura e alla diagnosi delle malattie, considerando la qualità della vita dei pazienti a livello globale. - Un team collaborativo e orientaleto all'innovazione, che lavora insieme per raggiungere obiettivi comuni. - L'opportunità di lavorare in un'azienda leader nel settore della salute, che investe in tecnologie all'avanguardia e in nuove soluzioni terapeutiche. This role offers an exciting opportunity to validate product performance claims, supply crucial data for regulatory submissions, and directly help deliver innovative diagnostic solutions to patients worldwide.

• Lead Site Execution : Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, delivering technical assistance and coordinating necessary training.

• Conduct Site Assessments : Perform comprehensive site assessments and qualification visits to drive informed site selection decisions.

• Manage Site Activation : Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure investigational sites properly obtain and maintain institutional approvals and meet all regulatory compliance needs before trial initiation.

• Develop Essential Documentation : Author and review key study site documents, including Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent forms, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to study protocols.

• Deliver End-to-End Monitoring : Execute all data generation, data validation, and comprehensive site visits across all study phases, from start-up through to close-out.

• Partner Cross-Functionally : Work dynamically within local, global, and virtual study teams, collaborating with R&D, Field Service, Study Management, and Biometrics to deliver top-tier solutions.

• Support Process Optimisation : Contribute to continuous improvement and change management activities to bring fresh perspectives to existing diagnostic testing solutions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni Clinical Site Manager - Molecular Lab Portfolio Descrizione A Roche, puoi essere te stesso e prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente in una cultura che valorizza e rispetta l'individualità. La nostra missione è di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a noi e fai la differenza. Opportunità Come responsabile del sito clinico specializzato nel nostro portafoglio di laboratorio molecolare, Lei: - Esecuzione del sito di piombo: agire come il contatto primario e esperto di prova clinica per il personale del sito di studio assegnato, fornire assistenza tecnica e coordinare la formazione necessaria. - Condurre le valutazioni del sito: Eseguire valutazioni complete del sito e visite di qualificazione per guidare le decisioni di selezione del sito informate. - Gestire l'Attivazione del Sito: collaborare in modo trasversale per garantire che i siti investigativi ottengano correttamente e mantengano le approvazioni istituzionali e soddisfino tutte le esigenze di conformità regolamentare prima dell'avvio del processo. - Sviluppa Documentazione Essenziale: Autore e rivedere i documenti chiave del sito di studio, compresi i piani di monitoraggio degli studi, i moduli di consenso informati e i moduli di relazione dei casi, contribuendo al contempo a competenze tecniche per studiare i protocolli. - Consegnere il monitoraggio end-to-End: Eseguire tutta la generazione di dati, la convalida dei dati e le visite complete del sito in tutte le fasi di studio, dall'avvio alla chiusura. - Partner Cross-Functionally: Lavorare dinamicamente all'interno di team di studio locali, globali e virtuali, collaborando con R&D, Field Service, Study Management e Biometrics per fornire soluzioni di livello superiore. - Ottimizzazione del processo di supporto: Contribuire a attività di miglioramento continuo e di gestione dei cambiamenti per portare nuove prospettive alle soluzioni di test diagnostici esistenti. Chi sei?
• Requisiti - Istruzione & Lab Familiarity: Laurea in una disciplina scientifica o in un campo correlato (o una combinazione equivalente di istruzione ed esperienza). - Proattività & Adaptability: Un professionista proattivo e adattabile che prospera in un ambiente a matrice veloce. - Analitica & Problem-Solving Competenze: Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving, con la capacità di fare scelte sonore indipendenti. - Consensus Building: una naturale capacità di costruire il consenso tra diverse squadre. Cosa? Vantaggi A Roche, offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivi che include: - Servizi sanitari: copertura sanitaria completa per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. - Risparmio di pensione: piani di risparmio di pensione competitivi con contributi aziendali. - Equilibrio vita-lavoro: accordi di lavoro flessibili e politiche time-off per sostenere un sano equilibrio di vita-lavoro. - Sviluppo professionale: Opportunità per la crescita e lo sviluppo professionale attraverso la formazione, il mentoring e l'avanzamento della carriera. Contatto Per candidarsi a questa posizione, si prega di inviare il proprio curriculum vitae e una lettera di motivazione all'indirizzo [email] o visitare il nostro sito web per ulteriori informazioni sulla nostra azienda e sulle opportunità di carriera disponibili.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

As a Clinical Site Manager for the Study Delivery CVMD Core Lab SWA Systems & Automation team, you are designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies in the clinical study sites. You are delivering other data generation methodologies, working independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocol, standard operating procedures, good clinical practices, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

The Opportunity

• Acting as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, coordinating training, certification, and providing technical assistance to ensure successful study execution.

• Performing site assessments and qualification visits to support the site selection decision process and site activation activities, including contracting and obtaining IRB/EC/Health Authority approvals in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Developing and managing key study site documentation, such as Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, source documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to review study protocols, data management plans, reports, and manuscripts.

• Participating in and overseeing CRO delivery of site management activities, including training CRO CRAs, escalating issues, and collaborating with international investigators and key customers while mentoring and supporting colleagues to enhance their skills and expertise.

• Validating product performance claims, supplying data for critical regulatory submissions, defining the functional and clinical utility of products, and gathering feedback and opinions from laboratories or customers regarding the products.

• Executing site management activities for sponsored studies in assigned focus areas across all phases of study (start-up, conduct, and close-out) for both registrational and non-registrational purposes.

• Working in local and global study teams, including virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve busi

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare by leading the clinical development strategy for next-generation diagnostic solutions? As a Clinical Development Lead, Neuroscience within our Clinical and Medical Affairs organisation in Diagnostics, you will play a pivotal role in planning and implementing clinical development activities that bring medically-differentiated solutions to patients globally. In this role, you will act as a senior strategic voice and trusted advisor, fostering an environment where science and collaboration thrive.

Key Responsibilities :

• Drive Clinical Strategy : Lead the clinical development strategy for clinical diagnostic studies and complex programs, in the Neuroscience area, defining clinical utility, intended use, and claim extensions across our portfolio.

• Lead Health Authority Interactions : Work closely with Global Regulatory Affairs in the completion and submission of global regulatory filings, authoring critical sections of meeting packages and reviewing clinical documents for international regulatory submissions.

• Forge Stakeholder Partnerships : Act as the clinical lead in external interactions with health authorities, build strategic relationships with international Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and drive development partnerships across industry and academia.

• Foster Communication Excellence : Oversee the implementation of communication strategies for clinical studies, representing the organisation at major medical congresses, advisory boards, and in key publications.

• Champion Innovation & Excellence : Act as a key driver for competitive differentiation, innovation, and early pipeline activities while developing intellectual property strategies and optimising clinical processes.

• Coach and Mentor : Act as a dedicated coach for team members, nurturing confidence and helping colleagues develop their skills and expertise.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You are passionate about customer and patient-centricity, and you excel at integrating multiple cross-functional perspectives into a unified clinical strategy.

• Education : Medical degree (MD) or an advanced degree (PhD) in Neuroscience or related fields.
