jobs.title: Head of Healthcare Transformation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

• Team Leadership & VACC Culture: Lead, coach, and inspire a cross-functional Medical, Market Access, Policy and Business Development team to unl

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose

By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.
• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.
• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.
• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.
• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.
• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next." Key Responsibilities:
• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.
• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Manufacturing Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Security Engineer plays a vital role in protecting Roche Manufacturing systems and networks against cybersecurity threats. This role is responsible for local architecture and engineering support, helping system owners and administrators in keeping their manufacturing environment up to date with the latest Roche Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards, baselines and industry best practices. Some of this role’s responsibilities are:

• Taking part in technical design reviews, integration, testing, and documentation activities concerning new OT systems and/or changes to existing manufacturing system or infrastructure

• Supporting development of Manufacturing Cybersecurity standards and baselines OT Cybersecurity Advisor during OT System planning phase and OT System Risk Assessment process

• Advising System Owners in selecting appropriate security measures to mitigate risk

• Coordinating of OT services and activities delivered by Vendors

• Reviewing local technical designs as part of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Requests (in ServiceNow)

• Designing and sustaining OT Security Monitoring (IIDS) at the Manufacturing Site

• Providing technical support during Incident Response process including steps to minimize the impact, conducting a technical and forensic investigation into how the breach happened and the extent of the damage

• Working closely with System Owners, Cybersecurity Site Representative and is a catalyst for cross-site collaboration on topics related to Manufacturing Cybersecurity

The Senior Security Engineer is a member of the Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering team led by the Head of Manufacturing Cybersecurity Engineering and part of the Security Platforms subfunction in the Information Security function at Roche.

Job Responsibilities

• Independently manages end-to-end security analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to more complex problems

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

• Stakeholder Management

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

• Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team processes Complexity

• Manages business analysis activities on more complex projects or across multiple products within a domain

• Capable of handling ambiguous requirements, navigating intricate stakeholder environments, and evaluating solution impacts considering both immediate and longer-term implications within the domain

• Business/Technical ability

• Demonstrates a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies

• Can independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis, effectively managing interconnections to improve overall efficiency and effectiveness

jobs.title: Account Value Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position: Account Value Partner
Report to: Account Value Lead
Area : Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Account Value Partner, you are at the forefront of our mission, driving the sales of Roche's innovative diagnostic products within your assigned territory in Thailand. You will be a trusted partner to healthcare professionals, providing them with the solutions and expertise they need to improve patient outcomes. This is a dynamic field-based role where you will build strong relationships, exceed sales targets, and be a key contributor to our success.

Role-Specific Accountabilities

• Define and own the medical education event and KOL engagement strategy.

• Gather and analyze insights to co-create solutions with hospital management, KOLs, and key customers.

• Take accountability for achieving budgeted sales while keeping costs under control.

• Seek out opportunities in key accounts and lead/organize promotional activities or product/solution presentations to achieve sales growth.

• Develop and implement territory and key account plans that align with the marketing plan, demonstrating effective time management and prioritization.

• Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction post-sale, including coordinating technical support or addressing initial product inquiries to maintain long-term partnerships.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiation, closing deals, and contract implementation.

QUALIFICATIONS
Experience and Competencies:

• Deep understanding of business drivers, products, the local market, and competition.

• Ability to influence at all levels, position/sell ideas to client groups, and manage expectations in line with the agreed portfolio.

• Builds trustful and effective relationships.

• Capable of finding creative solutions to complex problems, taking responsibility, driving results, and achieving expected outcomes.

Industry Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Medical Technology.

• 3+ years of work experience in a related sales or clinical field.

• Flexibility to be based in various locations across Thailand, including Bangkok, upcountry provinces, or in a hybrid model, depending on the assigned territory.

• Preferred area Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

• Proficient language skills in Thai and a good command of spoken and written English.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel frequently are required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Praktikum im Marketing & Produktmanagement Labordiagnostik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Abteilung

Im Produktmanagement & Marketing des Bereichs Labordiagnostik der Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH betreuen und vertreiben wir Lösungen für diagnostische Labore im deutschen Markt. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst Analysensysteme und Assays für die Klinische Chemie, Immunologie, Gerinnungs- und Urindiagnostik. Ganzheitliche Konzepte für Labore aller Größenordnungen werden durch innovative Hardware und Software Lösungen zur automatisierten Prä- und Postanalytik, zur Steuerung des Proben- und Datenflusses sowie zur Unterstützung der operativen und medizinischen Entscheidungsfindung realisiert. Im Marketing- und Produktmanagement stellen wir eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Verkauf, Service und Produktentwicklung dar.

Die Position

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, in dem Du Dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst? In diesem Praktikum bieten wir Bachelor- und Masterstudierenden die Möglichkeit, die Arbeit im Marketing und Produktmanagement kennenzulernen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Hier werden naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen mit betriebswirtschaftlichen und technologischen Themen vereint. Mögliche Aufgabenfelder beinhalten:

• Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Multi-Channel Marketingkampagnen, Schulungen und Events

• Mitarbeit bei der Einführung von neuen Produkten

• Konzeption von Marketingmaterialien (z.B. Online- und Social Media Marketing, Präsentationen und Broschüren)

• Identifikation, Analyse und Zusammenfassung von wissenschaftlicher Literatur und Studienergebnissen

• Markt- und Potentialanalysen

Qualifikationen

Für Dein Praktikum im Produktmanagement und Marketing bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Du bist immatrikulierte/r, fortgeschrittene/r Bachelor- oder Masterstudierende/r der Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Medizin, des Ingenieurwesens, der Informationstechnologie oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs

• Du bist es gewohnt, selbständig und mit hohem Engagement zu arbeiten und verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe

• Komplexe Fragestellungen aus dem Gesundheitswesen motivieren Dich und Herausforderungen treiben Dich an

• Du hast Spaß, im Team zu arbeiten und gemeinsam Erfolge zu erzielen

• Du bist sicher in der Anwendung der gängigen MS Office und Google-Programme

• Deutsch ist Deine Muttersprache oder Du hast C2 Niveau

• Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Einsatzbereitschaft runden Dein Profil ab

Die Benefits

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 4 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Die Bewerbung

Bitte bewirb Dich ausschließlich online und füge Deiner Bewerbung Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Zeugniskopien sowie eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung in einem Dokument bei.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : für 6 Monat

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead

As the Enterprise Architect - Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead, you will be the principal orchestrator of our global Architecture Community. You will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and practical execution, ensuring our architectural practices are co-created with the very teams that bring them to life. Join us in transforming architecture into a dynamic catalyst for global delivery and innovation.

Description of the area
The Enterprise Architecture Foundations team acts as the backbone of the architecture function, focusing on Community, Ways of Working, and Enablement. We define Enterprise and Solution Architecture practices, oversee our integrated toolchain (including ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS, and our AI Architecture Co-Pilot), and build organizational capability through learning curriculums and the Tech University. Our goal is to connect architects across a federated organization, empowering them to design sustainable technology solutions through shared principles and active community engagement.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the continuous maturation of Solution Architecture practices to adapt to evolving business needs and agile delivery models.

• Drive the transition from static documentation to dynamic solution modeling by leveraging our ArchiMEDES platform.

• Design and host global engagement forums, workshops, and community events to foster knowledge sharing and collaboration.

• Serve as the principal facilitator for the Architecture Community, inspiring a shared sense of identity across our global network.

• Partner with federated delivery teams to co-create standards that reduce friction and accelerate high-quality product delivery.

• Collaborate with Tech University to develop learning curriculums and upskill the community on modern solution design.

• Own and evolve the Solution Architect Onboarding Kit to ensure a seamless entry for new joiners into our culture and tools.

• Champion a data-driven approach to architecture, promoting the use of integrated toolchains to support transparent decision-making.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with professional background in solution or enterprise architecture within complex organizations.

• You possess applied experience as a Solution Architect, demonstrating a deep understanding of the practical realities of technology delivery.

• You offer comprehensive expertise in solution architecture methodologies and modern digital platforms like Cloud, Data, and AI.

• You are proficient with architecture modeling platforms (e.g., SAP LeanIX) and can translate enterprise principles into actionable designs.

• You have a proven track record in cultivating, motivating, and facilitating vibrant and active communities of practice.

• You demonstrate a co-creation mindset, viewing practice development as a shared journey rather than a top-down mandate.

• You are a master of influencing and storytelling, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders through empathy and clear communication.

What you get:

• Salary range 23 300 - 43 300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subs

Opportunità - Guidare la maturazione continua delle pratiche di Solution Architecture per adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione e ai modelli di consegna agile. - Guidare la transizione dalla documentazione statica al modello di soluzione provvisoria utilizzando la nostra piattaforma ArchiMEDES. - Progettare e ospitare forum di impegno globale, workshop e eventi organizzati per favorire la condivisione delle conoscenze e la collaborazione. - Fare da facilitatore principale per la comunità di architettura, ispirando un senso di identità condiviso nella nostra rete globale. - Collaborare con i team di consegna federati per co-creare gli standard che servono gli attriti e accelerano la consegna dei prodotti di alta qualità. - Collaborare con la Tech University per sviluppare i curricula di apprendimento e aggiornare la comunità sulle moderne progettazioni di soluzione. - Possedere e evolvere il Kit di Onboarding del Solution Architect per garantire un ingresso fluido per i nuovi arrivati nella nostra cultura e negli strumenti. - Promuovere un approccio basato sui dati all'architettura, promuovendo l'uso delle catene di strumenti si integrano per supportare le decisioni trasparenti. Chi sei? - Hai un Bachelor's o Master's Degree con un'esperienza professionale in soluzione o enterprise architecture all'interno di organizzazioni complesse. - Offri un'esperienza applicata come Solution Architect, dimostrando una profonda comprensione delle realtà pratiche della consegna tecnologica. - Offri un'esperienza completa nelle metodologie di soluzione architecture e nelle piattaforme digitali moderne come Cloud, Data e AI. - Sei esperto nelle piattaforme di modellazione dell'architettura (ad esempio SAP LeanIX) e puoi tradurre i principi aziendali in pianificazione azionabili. - Hai un'esperienza comprovata nella coltivazione, motivazione e facilitazione di comunità di pratica attive e vivaci. - Dimostri un mindset di co-creazione, vedendo lo sviluppo delle pratiche come un viaggio condiviso piuttosto che un mandato dall'alto. - Sei un maestro dell'influenza e della narrazione, con la capacità di discernere i senior stakeholder attraverso l'empatia e la comunicazione chiara. Cosa? - Gamma salariale 23 300 - 43 300 PLN lordi basati sul contratto di lavoro. - Bonus annuale basato sulla tua performance. - Budget di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati, ecc.). - Venerdì di ricarica (2 venerdì liberi per trimestre disponibili). - Programma di congedo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Congedo vacanza

• Cosa offriamo - Gamma salariale 23 300 - 43 300 PLN Lordi basata sul contratto di lavoro. - Bonus jährlich basato sulla tua performance. - Budget di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati, ecc.). - Venerdì di ricarica (2 venerdì liberi per trimestre disponibili). - Programma di congedo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Congedo vacanza

jobs.title: Pharmazeutischer Assistent (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​

Was Dich erwartet:
Als Pharmazeutischer Assistent (m/w/d) unterstützt Du die Leitung der Herstellung im Produktionsbetrieb im Rahmen der folgenden Aufgaben:

• Du stellst sicher, dass die GMP-konforme Herstellpraxis und die GMP-gerechte Dokumentation im Produktionsbetrieb eingehalten werden. Für den Chargenreview sowie konzeptionelle Erstellung der GMP-Dokumente in deutscher und englischer Sprache bist Du verantwortlich

• Du bearbeitest die Chargendokumentation (Batch Record Review) vor der Freigabe durch den Leiter der Herstellung.

• Du erstellst und bearbeitest Abweichungen, Reklamationen und Changes.

• Du erstellst und aktualisierst Arbeitsanweisungen und Vorschriften eigenständig.

• Du wirkst bei behördlichen Inspektionen mit und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen.

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Master), idealerweise mit Approbation als Apotheker.

• Du bringst erste Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie mit, zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Verpackung, aseptische Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle oder Qualitätssicherung.

• Du überzeugst mit deinen Sprachkenntnissen und deinem Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift)

• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbereitschaft

• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab

Diese Stelle ist befristet auf 24 Monate.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus:
https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.
Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, fos

The Position
Du möchtest in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten und aktiv dazu beitragen, unsere Servicequalität auf das nächste Level zu heben? Als Customer Operations Agent bei Roche Diagnostics übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle, um einen reibungslosen End-2-End Prozess in der Auftragsabwicklung zu gewährleisten.

Die Position ist vorerst auf 2 Jahre befristet und wird über ein Partnerunternehmen abgewickelt.

Was dich erwartet:

• Operative Auftragsabwicklung in SAP sowie Bearbeitung telefonischer und schriftlicher Kund:innenanfragen

• Selbstständige Betreuung eines zugewiesenen Kund:innenbereichs sowie Bearbeitung von Retouren, Gutschriften und Reklamationen

• Bearbeitung von Abrechnungsrückmeldungen der österreichischen Gesundheitskassen sowie Befundabrechnung im Labor- und Krankenhaussegment

• Engpassmanagement zur Sicherstellung und Optimierung der Liefertreue und enge Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Logistikteams, dem Außendienst sowie dem lokalen Material- und Produktmanagement und externen Logistikpartner:innen

• Exception Handling: Monitoring und Bearbeitung von Systemfehlern in internen und externen Anwendungen sowie Abstimmung mit relevanten Schnittstellen und Fachbereichen

• Anlage, Pflege und Aktualisierung von Kund:innenstammdaten im Patient:innenmanagement

• Unterstützung bei der Einführung, Automatisierung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Bestellmöglichkeiten in der Auftragsabwicklung

• Prozessverantwortung für definierte End-to-End-Prozesse (E2E)

Wer Du bist:

• Kaufmännische Ausbildung, FH-/Universitätsabschluss oder relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Auftragsabwicklung und Kund:innenbetreuung

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen sowie externen Kund:innen und Logistikpartner:innen (Deutsch C1, Englisch B2)

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen (idealerweise SAP) sowie Kenntnisse in Google Workspace, Office 365 und Salesforce von Vorteil

• Strukturierte, effiziente und selbstständige Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Organisationstalent und hoher Detailgenauigkeit

• Hohe Kundenorientierung sowie eine zuverlässige und kommunikative Teamplayer-Persönlichkeit

• Analytisches Denkvermögen, Belastbarkeit und eine ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeit mit lösungsorientierter und eigenverantwortlicher Arbeitsweise

Es erwartet dich ein Jahresgehalt ab € 48.000,00 brutto Vollzeit, sowie ein leistungsorientierter Bonus und attraktive Benefits. Pensionskasse, Betriebsrestaurant, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung und vielfältige Sportangebote, sind nur einige davon. Abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung besteht die Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Intern - KI in der Qualifizierung
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation. Klassische Vorgesetzte suchst du bei uns vergebens.
Innerhalb der Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” gestalten wir im Cluster “Business Solutions” gemeinsam mit unseren Anspruchsgruppen massgeschneiderte Lösungen.

Innerhalb der Abteilung Pharma Engineering – Qualifizierung Drug Substance (DS) am Standort Kaiseraugst betreuen wir die Erstqualifizierung von Produktionsanlagen und Systemen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld bieten wir dir die Gelegenheit, als Praktikant:in oder im Rahmen einer Bachelorarbeit aktiv an der digitalen Transformation unserer Abteilung mitzuwirken. Der Fokus liegt dabei auf der Steigerung der Effizienz und Qualität durch den Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) sowie der Standardisierung unserer Dokumentationsprozesse.

Die Möglichkeit
KI-gestützte Prozessoptimierung und Standardisierung

• KI-Integration: Du arbeitest aktiv bei der Optimierung von Qualifizierungsabläufen mit, indem Du KI Applikationen evaluierst und implementierst, um die operative Effizienz zu steigern.

• Standardisierung: Du unterstützt uns bei der Erarbeitung von Konzepten zur Vereinheitlichung von Qualifizierungstätigkeiten durch technologische Hilfsmittel.

• Innovations-Management: Du wirkst bei der Identifikation von Potenzialen mit, um manuelle Prozesse in digitale, KI-gestützte Workflows zu überführen.

Dokumentenwesen und Template-Optimierung

• Smart Documentation: Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Lösungen, um Qualifizierungsdokumente automatisiert mittels KI erstellen zu lassen.

• Lifecycle-Management: Du analysierst und optimierst bestehende Templates sowie Standarddokumente hinsichtlich Nutzerfreundlichkeit und Automatisierbarkeit.

Compliance und GxP-Standards

• Richtlinien-Einhaltung: Du hilfst dabei, die Einhaltung und Dokumentation von GxP-Richtlinien sowie internen Standards bei der Einführung neuer KI-Tools sicherzustellen. Du unterstützt uns bei der Erstellung einer lückenlosen Lifecycle-Dokumentation für die qualifizierten Systeme.

Anforderungen / Kenntnisse

• Grundverständnis für den Bereich Qualifizierung / Validierung sowie Interesse an GxP-Richtlinien.

• Affinität zu KI-Technologien und modernen Software-Tools und deren Anwendung

• Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für den Austausch in einem interdisziplinären Team.

Wer Du bist

• Du bist aktuell immatrikulierte/r Student:in (Bachelor/Master) oder hast dein Studium in den Bereichen Life Sciences, Pharmazie, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Zusätzliche Information

• Startdatum: Nach Vereinbarung (ideal Q3 2026)

• Dauer: 6 Monate

• Im Rahmen des P

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, parte della funzione “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, fornisce l’infrastruttura e i servizi per l’intero sito e li sviluppa continuamente e in modo innovativo. Lavoriamo con tutti gli stakeholder lungo tutta la catena del valore, dalla ricerca precoce alla cura dei pazienti. Con noi si può aspettare un modello organizzativo moderno, in cui è possibile contribuire i vostri talenti nel lavoro sensuale. Garantiamo la libertà di progettazione e di decisione nella nostra organizzazione. Stai cercando dei superiori classici. All’interno dell’organizzazione “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst” creiamo soluzioni su misura nel cluster “Business Solutions” insieme ai nostri stakeholder. All'interno del Dipartimento di Ingegneria Farmacia – Qualificazione Drug Substance (DS) presso il sito Kaiseraugst, sosteniamo la qualificazione iniziale di impianti e sistemi di produzione. In un ambiente dinamico, vi offriamo l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente alla trasformazione digitale del nostro dipartimento come stagista: in o come parte di una tesi di laurea. L'obiettivo è aumentare l'efficienza e la qualità attraverso l'uso dell'intelligenza artificiale (AI) e standardizzare i nostri processi di documentazione. La possibilità Ottimizzazione e standardizzazione dei processi basati su AI
• Integrazione dell'intelligenza artificiale: si sta lavorando attivamente per ottimizzare i processi di formazione, valutando e implementando applicazioni AI per aumentare l'efficienza operativa.
• Standardizzazione: Lei ci sostiene nello sviluppo di concetti per la standardizzazione della formazione mediante strumenti tecnologici.
• Gestione dell'innovazione: è possibile identificare i potenziali per trasferire i processi manuali ai flussi di lavoro basati su AI digitali. Documentazione e ottimizzazione dei modelli
• Smart Documentation: Supporti la concezione e l'implementazione di soluzioni per creare automaticamente documenti di qualificazione utilizzando AI.
• Gestione del ciclo di vita: analizza e ottimizza i modelli esistenti, nonché i documenti standard relativi alla facilità d'uso e all'automazione. Standard di conformità e GxP
• Conformità delle policy: l'utente aiuta a garantire la conformità e la documentazione delle politiche GxP e degli standard interni durante l'introduzione di nuovi strumenti AI. Ci supporta nella creazione di una documentazione completa del ciclo di vita per sistemi qualificati. Requisiti / conoscenza
• Comprensione di base per la qualificazione / validazione e l'interesse per le linee guida GxP.
• Affinità per tecnologie AI e strumenti software moderni e la loro applicazione
• Un modo di lavoro strutturato e indipendente
• Buone capacità di comunicazione per lo scambio in un team interdisciplinare. Chi sei
• Sei attualmente uno studente immatricato: in (Bachelor/Master) o hai completato con successo i tuoi studi nei campi delle scienze della vita, della farmacia, delle scienze ingegneristiche o di un soggetto paragonabile negli ultimi 12 mesi.
• Le competenze linguistiche tedesche nella parola e nella scrittura sono assolutamente necessarie; le buone abilità inglesi sono di vantaggio. Ulteriori informazioni
• Data di inizio: Con accordo (ideale Q3 2026)
• Durata: 6 mesi
• Sotto la P

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'organisation « Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst », qui fait partie de la fonction de groupe globale « Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites », fournit l'infrastructure et les services pour l'ensemble du site et les développe continuellement et de manière innovante. Nous travaillons avec tous les intervenants tout au long de la chaîne de valeur, de la recherche précoce aux soins aux patients. Avec nous vous pouvez vous attendre à un modèle organisationnel moderne, dans lequel vous pouvez contribuer vos talents dans le travail sensuel. Nous garantissons la liberté de conception et de prise de décision dans notre organisation. Vous cherchez des supérieurs classiques. Au sein de l'organisation, le réseau du site Basel/Kaiseraugst, nous créons des solutions sur mesure dans le cluster Solutions d'affaires avec nos partenaires. Au sein du ministère de l'Ingénierie Pharmae – Substance médicamenteuse qualifiée (DS) au site de Kaiseraugst, nous soutenons la qualification initiale des installations et des systèmes de production. Dans un environnement dynamique, nous vous offrons la possibilité de participer activement à la transformation numérique de notre département en tant que stagiaire:dans ou dans le cadre d'une thèse de baccalauréat. L'accent est mis sur l'amélioration de l'efficacité et de la qualité par l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) et la normalisation de nos processus de documentation. La possibilité Optimisation et normalisation des processus basés sur l'IA
• Intégration de l'IA : vous travaillez activement à optimiser les processus de formation en évaluant et en mettant en œuvre des applications d'IA pour accroître l'efficacité opérationnelle.
• Normalisation : vous nous aidez à développer des concepts de standardisation de la formation au moyen d'outils technologiques.
• Gestion de l'innovation : Vous pouvez identifier les possibilités de transférer des processus manuels vers des workflows numériques basés sur l'IA. Documentation et optimisation des modèles
• Smart Documentation: Vous supportez la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions pour créer automatiquement des documents de qualification en utilisant l'IA.
• Gestion du cycle de vie: Vous analysez et optimisez les modèles existants ainsi que les documents standard concernant la convivialité et l'automatisation. Conformité et normes GxP
• Conformité à la politique : vous aidez à assurer la conformité et la documentation des politiques de GxP ainsi que des normes internes lors de l'introduction de nouveaux outils d'IA. Vous nous aidez à créer une documentation complète sur le cycle de vie des systèmes qualifiés. Exigences / connaissances
• Compréhension de base pour la qualification / validation ainsi que l'intérêt pour les lignes directrices GxP.
• Affinité pour les technologies d'IA et les outils logiciels modernes et leur application
• Une manière de travailler structurée et indépendante
• Bonnes compétences en communication pour l'échange dans une équipe interdisciplinaire. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes actuellement un étudiant immatriculé:en (Bachelor/Master) ou avez terminé avec succès vos études dans les domaines des sciences de la vie, pharmacie, sciences de l'ingénierie ou un sujet comparable au cours des 12 derniers mois.
• Les compétences linguistiques en allemand dans la parole et l'écriture sont absolument nécessaires; de bonnes compétences en anglais sont avantageuses. Informations complémentaires

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que spécialiste commercial d’une/plusieurs gammes de produit (Core Lab), vous êtes responsable du développement et de l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et de part de marché de vos gamme de produits en coopération avec les Key Account Managers (KAM) / Customer Success Managers (CSM)
Vous interagissez en tant qu'expert(e) auprès des KAM / CSM en définissant et en présentant au client les solutions techniques envisagées.

Lieu d’habitation : Région de Paris

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous développez et maintenez une connaissance très forte de la gamme de produits/solutions dont vous avez la charge, grâce à une forte interaction avec le marketing et les experts produits du groupe; est en mesure de répondre à toutes les questions des clients sur ces produites, en autonomie et sait promouvoir la Valeur ajoutée différenciante de l’offre Roche vs les compétiteurs.

• Vous partagez les informations et tendance concurrence /marché que vous identifiez aux équipes marketing Roche. A ce titre, vous pouvez Identifier et informer le marketing des solutions de

• Vous soutenez les KAM et CSM d'un point de vue technique, médical ou scientifique sur le sujet dont vous êtes l'expert dans une perspective de développement du compte concerné

• Vous collaborez avec les CSM et le KAM à la construction de la stratégie commerciale des comptes sur ces gammes en identifiant les opportunités de croissance.

• Vous portez avec votre équipe la responsabilité de l’atteinte des objectifs de CA et de profitabilité associés à la/les gammes dont vous avez la charge - channel filling inclus.

• Vous construisez des offres spécifiques basées sur la compréhension des besoins clients en incluant les tierces parties nécessaires et en vous assurant notamment de la bonne adéquation entre l'offre commerciale et l'environnement opérationnel du client (CQ, repasse, volume, interface avec les autres chapters). Pour les dossiers AO publics - vous collaborez à la réponse financière et au pricing de la solution.

• Vous contribuez au sein de son équipe à l’amélioration de la performance de la/les gammes dont vous avez la responsabilité.

• Vous garantissez le respect de la compliance dans les relations avec le client

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation scientifique ou technique, vous maîtrisez l'environnement de la santé et les enjeux de l'industrie du Diagnostic In Vitro (DIV).

• Reconnu pour votre intelligence situationnelle et votre aisance relationnelle, vous maîtrisez l'art de la négociation et de la contractualisation de haut niveau.

• Doté d'une écoute active, vous savez traduire les demandes clients en solutions concrètes, conseiller avec valeur ajoutée et aligner vos interlocuteurs autour d'une vision stratégique commune.

• Vous possédez une forte capacité à inspirer, engager et influencer positivement. Vous excellez dans la collaboration transversale et la coopération hors lien hiérarchique.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Qualification Engineer/Qualifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele Menschen große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​

Was Dich erwartet:

Als Qualification Engineer/Qualifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d) bist Du Teil des Teams MSAT und sorgst gemeinsam mit den Kollegen*innen dafür, dass unsere pharmazeutischen Anlagen reibungslos laufen und alle gesetzlichen und GMP -Vorgaben eingehalten werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur die Einhaltung höchster Standards sicherstellt, sondern auch aktiv eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, des Lean Managements und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung
(#WIRGEMEINSAM) vorlebt.

Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du erstellst selbstständig und verantwortest Qualifizierungs- und
Requalifizierungsdokumente wie Pläne, Berichte und Risikoanalysen für Produktionsanlagen und Equipment anhand der geltenden Anforderungen, regulatorischen Vorgaben und Validierung skonzepten.

• Du vertrittst deine Arbeit souverän bei internen und externen Inspektionen und Audits gegenüber Behörden wie der EMA und FDA.

• Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Qualifizierungskonzepten hin zu einer kontinuierlichen, datenbasierten Qualifizierung, um die Effizienz zu steigern.

• Du steuerst, beauftragst und kontrollierst externe Dienstleister und interne Schnittstellenabteilungen effizient.

• Du tauschst dich proaktiv mit anderen Standorten aus, um das Fachgebiet weiterzuentwickeln und Best Practices zu etablieren.

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Bachelor, Master) in Pharmatechnik, Biotechnologie , Verfahrenstechnik oder eine einschlägige Berufsausbildung mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, insbesondere im Bereich der Sterilproduktion und Qualifizierung.

• Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse der pharmazeutischen Herstellungsverfahren und Technologien sowie der GMP , EU und FDA Richtlinien und relevanten Arzneibüchern.

• Du überzeugst mit deinen fließenden Sprachkenntnissen und deinem Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift).

• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbereitschaft.

• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus:
https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend

jobs.title: PostDoc Position in Bioorganic Chemistry (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you interested in developing novel reagents and workflows for next generation sequencing?
We are looking for a highly talented and motivated postdoctoral fellow (m/f/d) to join our team on
this mission.

The Chemistry Technologies department provides the full spectrum of chemical diagnostic
reagents, ranging from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers. Leveraging modern
synthetic and analytical methods we design and develop tailor-made molecules to find the right
solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We work as a team, are driven by passion for
science and commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of research.

Our culture is defined by trust, transparency, and a strong collaborative spirit. We are looking for
a proactive colleague who balances independent critical thinking with team spirit and the
flexibility to collaborate across diverse departments and interdisciplinary teams.

Your tasks

• Design and synthesize complex oligonucleotide-conjugates by contemporary bioconjugation techniques and small molecular entities by chemical synthesis

• Establish DNA templated proximity reactions for initial testing of your new reagent classes

• Collaborate proactively with project partners from biology, analytics and the sequencing test development teams to gain a deep insight into the relationship of structural design and assay performance

• Independently plan, execute and analyze experiments to effectively advance the projects

• Present scientific progress through internal meetings and visit scientific conferences to ensure the state-of-the-art knowledge in the field of bioorganic synthesis, chemical biology and surface chemistry

• Be part of a highly motivated and cross-functional team

Your profile

• You hold a PhD in the field of (bio)organic chemistry, chemical biology or life science.

• You possess profound knowledge in the synthesis of oligonucleotide-conjugates, preferably in context of biomolecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids)

• You are well experienced in organic synthesis

• Hands-on experience in the field of DNA-templated reactions, proximity reactions and nucleic acid detection completes your profile.

• Your qualification should be clearly demonstrated by at least one first author paper published or accepted in a high impact journal.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are your strength. You are sensitive to intercultural and interdisciplinary matters - working in a team comes natural to you.

• You are a proactive individual with passion and commitment to innovate healthcare through our Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.

• Excellent English skills are required, German is not mandatory.

When does it start?
This position will be filled with effect Septmber 2026 and is limited to 2 years.

Have we aroused your interest?
# If we are convinced, a virtual interview will take place
# If you also manage to convince us here, the last step is an interview and presentation in the
Penzberg area

Your application
Please submit your application by sending an updated CV (including publication list and
references) together with your latest certificates. Before sending your application, please note
that no further documents can be added subsequently.

We are looking forward to your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives u

The Position Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. We work as a team, are driven by passion for science and commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of research. • Design and synthesize complex oligonucleotide-conjugates by contemporary bioconjugation techniques and small molecular entities by chemical synthesis
• Establish DNA templated proximity reactions for initial testing of your new reagent classes
• Collaborate proactively with project partners from biology, analytics and the sequencing test development teams to gain a deep insight into the relationship of structural design and assay performance
• Independently plan, execute and analyze experiments to effectively advance the projects
• Present scientific progress through internal meetings and visit scientific conferences to ensure the state-of-the-art knowledge in the field of bioorganic synthesis, chemical biology and surface chemistry
• Be part of a highly motivated and cross-functional team Your profile
• You hold a PhD in the field of (bio)organic chemistry, chemical biology or life science.
• You possess profound knowledge in the synthesis of oligonucleotide-conjugates, preferably in context of biomolecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids)
• You are well experienced in organic synthesis
• Hands-on experience in the field of DNA-templated reactions, proximity reactions and nucleic acid detection completes your profile.
• Your qualification should be clearly demonstrated by at least one first author paper published or accepted in a high impact journal.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are your strength. You are sensitive to intercultural and interdisciplinary matters - working in a team comes natural to you.
• You are a proactive individual with passion and commitment to innovate healthcare through our Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.
• Excellent English skills are required, German is not mandatory. When does it start? This position will be filled with effect Septmber 2026 and is limited to 2 years. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global MSAT & Engineering function is undergoing a strategic modernization initiative to introduce innovative, efficient, and sustainable manufacturing technologies across our global device manufacturing footprint. As the Group Lead for Device Process Engineering, you will be the architect of our technical talent and process excellence. This is a dual-impact leadership role: you will serve as a senior technical authority for our most complex device programs and lead a world-class chapter of Process Engineers, ensuring they have the skills, tools, and standardized methodologies to deliver next-generation medical devices and drug-device combination products to patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of process engineers, setting clear expectations for technical excellence and functional capability.

• Define and drive the global process-engineering strategy for device and combination product assembly, packaging, and sterilization across the entire product lifecycle.

• Act as the senior technical authority for complex engineering decisions, balancing quality, compliance, supply, and speed-to-market.

• Drive structured process characterization using DOE and statistical tools to define operating windows and ensure process understanding.

• Establish methodologies for identifying critical process parameters (CPPs) and material attributes to ensure robust control strategies.

• Own design transfer activities, translating design outputs into production specifications, equipment requirements, and manufacturing work instructions.

• Define and govern risk-based validation strategies for manufacturing processes, equipment qualification, and sterilization.

• Manage the process-engineering framework for continued process verification, investigation support, and lifecycle optimization.

• Ensure all engineering practices comply with global regulatory requirements, including FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, and EU MDR.

Who you are
You are a strategic and technically credible leader who moves fluently between executive decision-making and deep engineering problem-solving. You have the ability to explain complex validation decisions to diverse audiences, translating technical risks into clear business impacts. You are a dedicated coach and talent developer who sets high standards for technical rigor while empowering your team to act. As an effective communicator and resilient collaborator, you build trust across matrixed organizations and remain focused on shared objectives even during periods of ambiguity or change.

Further you have the following qualifications and experiences:

• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 12-15+ years of experience in process engineering or technical operations within regulated medical device or pharma environments.

• Proven track record in formal people leadership and influencing across a matrixed global organization.

• Deep expertise in device assembly, packaging, sterilization, and automated manufacturing from development to commercial scale.

• Strong knowledge of design controls, risk management (ISO 14971), DfM, and technical transfer processes.

• Experience working with global external manufacturing partners and supplier networks.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives u

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Opportunità di lavoro Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La funzione Global MSAT & Engineering sta subendo un'iniziativa di modernizzazione strategica per introdurre tecnologie di produzione innovative, efficienti e sostenibili attraverso la nostra impronta globale di produzione di dispositivi. In qualità di Gruppo Lead for Device Process Engineering, sarai l'architetto del nostro talento tecnico e dell'eccellenza del processo. Questo è un ruolo di leadership dual-impact: servirai come autorità tecnica senior per i nostri programmi di dispositivo più complessi e condurre un capitolo di livello mondiale di ingegneri di processo, assicurando loro di avere le competenze, gli strumenti e metodologie standardizzate per fornire dispositivi medici di prossima generazione e prodotti combinati droga-dispositivi a pazienti in tutto il mondo. Opportunità - Lead, coach e sviluppare un team di ingegneri di processo altamente performanti, ponendo chiare aspettative per l'eccellenza tecnica e la funzionalità. - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di ingegneria del processo per l'assemblaggio, l'imballaggio e la sterilizzazione del prodotto di dispositivo e combinazione in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Agire come autorità tecnica senior per decisioni di ingegneria complesse, bilanciare la qualità, la conformità, la fornitura e la velocità di mercato. - Guidare la caratterizzazione del processo strutturato utilizzando DOE e strumenti statistici per definire le finestre operative e garantire la comprensione del processo. - Stabilire metodologie per identificare i parametri di processo critici (CPP) e gli attributi materiali per garantire strategie di controllo robuste. - Attività di trasferimento di progettazione proprie, traducendo uscite di progettazione in specifiche di produzione, requisiti di attrezzature e istruzioni di lavoro di fabbricazione. - Definire e governare strategie di validazione basate sui rischi per processi di produzione, qualificazione delle attrezzature e sterilizzazione. - Gestire il quadro di ingegneria del processo per la verifica continua del processo, il supporto di indagine e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita. - Assicurarsi che tutte le pratiche ingegneristiche siano conformi ai requisiti normativi globali, tra cui FDA QMSR, ISO 13485 e EU MDR. Chi sei? Sei un leader strategico e tecnicamente credibile che si muove fluentemente tra il processo decisionale esecutivo e la risoluzione dei problemi di ingegneria profonda. Hai la capacità di spiegare complesse decisioni di validazione a diversi pubblico, traducendo i rischi tecnici in chiari impatti aziendali. Sei un allenatore dedicato e sviluppatore di talenti che stabilisce standard elevati per il rigore tecnico, consentendo al tuo team di agire. Come un efficace comunicatore e collaboratore resiliente, si costruisce fiducia tra le organizzazioni matrici e si concentrano su obiettivi condivisi anche durante i periodi di ambiguità o cambiamento. Inoltre, hai le seguenti qualifiche ed esperienze: - Laurea (B.S., M.S. o Ph.D.) in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Farmaceutica, o un campo tecnico correlato. - 12-15 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria dei processi o nelle operazioni tecniche all'interno di dispositivi medici regolamentati o in ambienti farmaci. - Provato record di traccia nella leadership delle persone formali e influenzando attraverso un'organizzazione globale matrice. - Profonda competenza nel montaggio, imballaggio, sterilizzazione e produzione automatizzata da sviluppo a scala commerciale. - Forte conoscenza dei controlli di progettazione, gestione dei rischi (ISO 14971), DfM e processi di trasferimento tecnico. - Esperienza di lavoro con partner di produzione esterni globali e reti di fornitori. Contatto Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci guida.

Les Vous êtes un leader stratégique et techniquement crédible qui se déplace couramment entre la prise de décision exécutive et la résolution de problèmes en ingénierie profonde. Vous avez la capacité d'expliquer des décisions de validation complexes à divers publics, transformant les risques techniques en impacts commerciaux clairs. Vous êtes un entraîneur et développeur de talents dédié qui fixe des normes élevées pour la rigueur technique tout en donnant à votre équipe les moyens d'agir. En tant que communicateur efficace et collaborateur résilient, vous renforcez la confiance entre les organisations matricielles et demeurez concentré sur des objectifs communs, même en période d'ambiguïté ou de changement. jobs.title: Public Key Infrastructure - Junior Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At the heart of our digital security is the trust we build through encrypted communication. As a PKI Engineer, you will join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team to help manage the core certificate infrastructure. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that our digital certificates are issued, tracked, and renewed without a hitch. This is a growth-oriented role where you will learn to navigate complex security infrastructures while contributing to the automation of high-volume security tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Scope

• Support the day-to-day administration of Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), including basic template management and standard troubleshooting.

• Use Keyfactor Command to monitor certificate health, identify expiring assets, and assist in bringing untracked certificates into compliance.

• Support the deployment of ACME clients (like Certbot) for automated certificate issuance across web server environments.

• Participate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using Version Control systems and scripting as required (PowerShell or Python).

• Collaborate with senior engineers to orchestrate certificate distribution to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers.

Impact/Strategy

• Collaborate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using basic scripting (PowerShell or Python) and maintain scripts using version control systems.

• Assist in maintaining team internal wikis, standard operating procedures, and runbooks for certificate lifecycle management.

• Collaborate with senior engineers to route, distribute, and install certificates to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers .

​
Complexity

• Focuses primarily on executing defined procedures, troubleshooting routine issues, and escalating complex anomalies to senior team members.

• Contributes to team agility by identifying operational inefficiencies and proposing minor process improvements within immediate daily tasks.

• Demonstrates growing autonomy within the specific domain by translating daily requirements into structured tasks under direct supervision.

​
Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

​
Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, or junior Security Operations (SOC) role. An internship focused on infrastructure or security is highly valued.

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or equivalent practical experience.

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle defined tasks and contribute to various stages of the security and business analysis lifecycle

​
Technical Skills

• Understanding of Zero Trust principles, authentication factors and cryptography.

• A solid understanding of cryptography basics (Symmetric vs. Asymmetric, Hashing, Digital Signatures).

• Experience with Windows Server and Active Directory. Exposure to web servers like IIS, Apache, or Nginx. Comfortable using Git for basic file management and collaboration.

• Knowledge of the ACME protocol or experience using tools like Certbot.

• Familiarity with PowerShell o

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Network Security
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Network Security, you will lead the Design, Build, and Improvement of critical security infrastructures, specifically focusing on Cisco ISE, Wired Access Control (WAC), and Palo Alto Networks. This is a dual-impact role: you are the technical authority for the secure access layer, while simultaneously leading the engineering of a custom observability framework. You will develop the front-end, back-end, and integration logic required to provide deep visibility into the security product health and asset inventory.

Job Responsibilities

1. SME:
Secure Access (ISE, WAC, Palo Alto)

• Design & Architecture: Lead the high-level and low-level design (HLD/LLD) for global Cisco ISE deployments and Wired Access Control (WAC) strategies to ensure seamless, identity-based security.

• Palo Alto SME: Serve as the primary engineer for Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including advanced threat prevention, decryption, and secure egress/ingress traffic management.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the current security posture and implement technical enhancements to NAC policies, SGT (TrustSec) propagation, and firewall rule-sets.

• Build & Implementation: Act as the lead "implementer" for complex global migrations and new feature rollouts across the network security stack.

​
2. Observability Framework Engineering

• Full-Stack Development: Architect and develop a custom framework (front-end and back-end) to provide a "single pane of glass" for infrastructure health.

• Inventory & Integration: Build automated integrations with external data sources (CMDB, IPAM, etc.) to maintain a real-time, dynamic inventory of all network assets and security nodes.

• Telemetry Logic: Design custom logic to ingest and visualize telemetry from ISE, WAC, and Palo Alto using APIs, SNMP, and Syslog.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, providing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term, automated architectural fixes.

• Security Observability: Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into the "connected landscape," identifying insecure nodes or unauthorized devices before they can affect the network.

• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest
