descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Pharmaceutique Chez Roche, nous sommes animés par un engagement urgent à fournir des solutions médicales aujourd'hui tout en innovant pour demain. Notre nouveau modèle d'exploitation A2 audacieux met à profit les capacités collectives de l'entreprise pour créer des solutions rapides et efficaces pour les patients à l'échelle mondiale. Nous croyons en des soins de santé personnalisés et durables et sommes particulièrement bien placés pour intégrer les produits pharmaceutiques, les diagnostics, la santé numérique et les mégadonnées. Nous cherchons un activateur médical passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique APAC maladies rares. Ce rôle permanent à temps plein est un poste de ressource commun au-dessus du pays, exigeant un engagement de 80 à 100% ETP au-dessus du pays au sein de notre réseau. Idéalement, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui possède une vaste expérience des systèmes de soins de santé en Asie et qui sera situé à Hong Kong ou à Taïwan, mais ce rôle offre une occasion passionnante de se concentrer sur les paquets de travail transfrontaliers et de permettre, en collaborant à travers divers réseaux régionaux et mondiaux pour conduire un changement significatif. Vous allez travailler sur : En tant que catalyseur médical des maladies rares (PACA), vous :
• Apporter une contribution stratégique et un soutien opérationnel aux thérapies de développement et de lancement précoce des maladies rares.
• Agir en tant qu'expert scientifique pour nos médicaments et solutions tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Travailler dans des équipes virtuelles, transfrontalières et transfonctionnelles afin de réaliser et d'élargir les résultats nationaux, régionaux et mondiaux.
• Favoriser des collaborations scientifiques significatives et des partenariats fondés sur la valeur avec des experts des domaines thérapeutiques, des professionnels de la santé, des organisations de patients dans plusieurs systèmes de santé.
• Contribuer à la compréhension des lacunes dans les données et appuyer les plans de production de données (par exemple, études de phase IV, registres).
• Élaborer des programmes de formation médicale continue de grande valeur à l'intention des intervenants externes.
• Fournir un examen médical stratégique et l'approbation des documents et des communications.
• Assurer une liaison étroite avec les équipes et collègues médicaux mondiaux pour assurer la coordination et la cohérence de notre diffusion des données Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un professionnel passionné des affaires médicales prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur la santé des maladies rares en Asie. En tant qu'expert en matière de leadership potentiel, vous avez un esprit d'entreprise, identifiez les possibilités, êtes à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et contestez le statu quo. Vous avez :
• Expérience pertinente dans le domaine des affaires médicales dans le domaine des produits pharmaceutiques, des diagnostics, des sciences de la santé, de la biotechnologie ou dans des domaines connexes.
• L'expérience du travail dans les maladies rares serait très souhaitable.
• Une bonne compréhension des données, une évaluation critique, une synthèse et des compétences d'exécution.
• Un état d'esprit "System Thinker", capable de construire de solides collaborations internes/externes pour stimuler le changement.
• Approche client-centre, co-créant des solutions pour répondre aux besoins et transformer la pratique clinique.
• Une culture de l'humanité, de la curiosité et de la responsabilité, prospère dans un environnement de travail dynamique, dynamique et agile.
• Expérience éprouvée de la construction, de la direction et de la contribution à des équipes de haute performance, diversifiées, agiles et matricielles.
• Diplôme MD; doctorat ou baccalauréat en sciences, biologie, immunologie, neurosciences ou équivalent préféré. L'expérience clinique dans les maladies rares est un plus. C'est une occasion incroyable de développer votre expertise scientifique, de collaborer avec des collègues et des clients du monde entier et de contribuer à l'innovation qui touchera les familles vivant avec des maladies rares en Asie et au-delà. Où

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

• You create, process, maintain, modify and close Purchase Orders

• You review and approve shopping carts for Policy compliance

• You support purchase invoice reconciliation and liaise with the accounts payable department in connection with invoicing procedures

• You make reports on the given activities

• You assist with processing of returns for the Procurement Department as needed

• You are responsible for Order Acknowledgement handling and contact the suppliers in case of need

Who you are:

• You have college or university degree in finance or a related economics subject

• You have a general understanding of finance processes and standards. Experience in procurement processes and using SAP is an advantage

• You have strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• You have end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• You have proficiency in English and French

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:

1. Support the daily work of the registration operations team
- Assist in the preparation (translation/proofreading) and archiving of registration operations materials

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Sostenere il lavoro quotidiano del team di operazioni di registrazione - Assistere nella preparazione (traduzione/protezione) e l'archiviazione dei materiali di registrazione - Assistere in istruzioni per la correzione di farmaci o documenti correlati - Assist nel completamento dell'inserimento e della verifica dei dati 2. Assist nella gestione e ottimizzazione di sistemi operativi, piattaforme e strumenti informativi - Assistere a progetti di ottimizzazione del sistema di lavoro - Assistere nella realizzazione di report export e produzione - Assist nell'analisi dei dati - Assistere nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di nuove piattaforme o strumenti di lavoro 3. Assistere nel completamento del lavoro logistico per il reparto di registrazione - Coordinare e organizzare riunioni, prenotare sale riunioni, mailing e stampa, ecc. descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position 1. Appuyer le travail quotidien de l ' équipe chargée des opérations d ' enregistrement - Aider à la préparation (traduction/lecture à l'épreuve) et à l'archivage des documents d'inscription - Aider à corriger les instructions ou les documents connexes - Aider à compléter la saisie et la vérification des données 2. Aider à gérer et optimiser les systèmes opérationnels, les plates-formes d'information et les outils - Aider aux projets d'optimisation des systèmes de travail - Aider à remplir le rapport d ' exportation et de production - Aider à l ' analyse des données - Aider à la conception et au développement de nouvelles plates-formes ou outils de travail 3. Aider à mener à bien le travail logistique du département des opérations d ' enregistrement - Coordonner et organiser des réunions, réserver des salles de réunion, envoyer et imprimer, etc. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position 1. Unterstützung der täglichen Arbeit des Registrierungs-Teams - Assist bei der Vorbereitung (Translation/proofreading) und Archivierung von Registrierungsmaterialien - Assist bei der Korrekturlesen von Drogenanweisungen oder verwandten Dokumenten - Assist bei der Dateneingabe und -überprüfung 2. Assist bei der Verwaltung und Optimierung von Betriebssystemen, Informationsplattformen und Werkzeugen - Assist bei Arbeitssystemoptimierungsprojekten - Assist bei der Erstellung von Berichten Export und Produktion - Unterstützung bei der Datenanalyse - Assist bei der Gestaltung und Entwicklung neuer Arbeitsplattformen oder Werkzeuge 3. Bei der Durchführung der logistischen Arbeit für die Registrierungsabteilung - Koordinaten und arrangieren Treffen, Buch-Meeting-Räume, Mailing und Druck, etc. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position 1. Appuyer le travail quotidien de l ' équipe chargée des opérations d ' enregistrement - Aider à la préparation (traduction/lecture à l'épreuve) et à l'archivage des documents d'inscription - Aider à corriger les instructions ou les documents connexes - Aider à compléter la saisie et la vérification des données 2. Aider à gérer et optimiser les systèmes opérationnels, les plates-formes d'information et les outils - Aider aux projets d'optimisation des systèmes de travail - Aider à remplir le rapport d ' exportation et de production - Aider à l ' analyse des données - Aider à la conception et au développement de nouvelles plates-formes ou outils de travail 3. Aider à mener à bien le travail logistique du département des opérations d ' enregistrement - Coordonner et organiser des réunions, réserver des salles de réunion, envoyer et imprimer, etc. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Internship AI-ML Engineering / GenAI & LLM Applications (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.it: Internship AI-ML Engineering / GenAI & LLM Applicazioni (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.en: Internship AI-ML Engineering / GenAI & LLM Applications (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.de: Internship AI-ML Engineering / GenAI & LLM Applications (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Internship AI-ML Engineering / GenAI & LLM Applications (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your department

Your internship will take place in the Biostatistics & Data Science Core Lab & Near Patient Care department, which is part of our organization R&D Roche Diagnostic.
This development unit focuses on Biostatistics & Data Science. During your internship, you will work in the CC HET Biostatistics & Biophysics group.

Your tasks

• Develop machine learning models for anomaly detection in time-series data to identify infrastructure issues proactively

• Design and develop multi-agent systems for automated infrastructure monitoring and troubleshooting

• Build agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen

• Build conversational interfaces for AI-powered troubleshooting and root cause analysis

• Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated log analysis and summarization

• Build knowledge retrieval systems using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques

• Design and develop user interfaces for AI-powered troubleshooting tools

• Experiment with different ML algorithms and GenAI approaches to optimize performance

• Present your results and findings to stakeholders and the broader team

Your profile

• You are currently pursuing a Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field

• You have strong programming skills in Python and experience with modern development practices

• You have hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and understand prompt engineering concepts

• You have practical experience building applications with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar

• You understand agentic design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflection, Multi-Agent Collaboration, Tool Use)

• You have experience building multi-agent systems or orchestrating multiple AI agents to solve complex tasks

• You are familiar with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques and vector databases

• You have experience with API integration and working with external tools and services

• You are familiar with natural language processing techniques and text analysis

• You possess excellent communication skills, with required proficiency in both written and spoken German and English

Our offer

• Hands-On Experience: Gain practical experience in ML/AI and GenAI while working on production systems that have a real impact on clinical trial workflows and ultimately the lives of patients

• Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with state-of-the-art AI technologies including Large Language Models, RAG systems, and production-scale ML infrastructure

• Mentorship: Work closely with experienced professionals from Biostatistics & Data Science receiving guidance and mentorship throughout your internship

• Real-World Impact: See your work deployed in production, serving 120+ users in pharmaceutical research and development

• Career Development: Gain valuable experience in pharmaceutical AI/ML that will enhance your resume and prepare you for future career opportunities. Potential for full-time conversion based on performance

• Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values different perspectives and ideas

Your benefits

• Flexible working hours (37.5 hours/week)

• Attractive recognition grant (2,268 Euro per month for a full-time internship > 3 months)

• Discounted meal prices (- 50%) in our staff canteen

• Fitness studio on campus

• Online/Offline student networking events

• T

jobs.title: Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs)

titleByLocale.it: Gestione dei programmi strategici (Programmi di potenziamento degli appalti)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Strategic Programs Execution team in the Strategy and Solutions Chapter. Our purpose is to guide strategic priorities, advance value delivery through solutions and digital excellence, govern compliance and drive sustainability to deliver continuous improvement and strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the wider Roche organization. The Strategic Programs Execution team is dedicated to driving complex procurement-led programs that deliver high impact benefits for Roche and result in a step change in how we work with suppliers, use technology, partner with the business or collaborate with each other in Procurement.

As a Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs), you will work in partnership with teams from Global Procurement and other Roche functions to accelerate and enhance the delivery of GP led strategic programs. You will have a strong focus on Procurement Enhancement Programs, with the aim to enhance the overall level of effectiveness, efficiency and customer experience of Global Procurement.

• You utilise your expertise and in-depth knowledge in project management methodologies to lead and facilitate the execution of strategic procurement-led programs, focusing on transformative initiatives such as Operating Model Design and Implementation, Technology Deployment and Adoption, and Procurement Strategy Realization.

• You work closely with procurement, business stakeholders, and other relevant colleagues in a matrix setup either as a peer, coach, project / workstream lead, or subject matter lead, to align on needs, create the business case for change, prioritize, execute, and realize project goals.

• You develop change management strategies and integrate change management activities in project execution to drive transformational changes in the organisation. You manage the people-side of the change to drive behavioral changes and adoption.

• You contribute to the further development of project management and change management capabilities in the team, advocate and accelerate the advancement of best practices methodologies.

• You act as a practitioner and catalyst, applying GP’s core procurement capabilities and approaches in the programs you work on, and contribute to continuous enhancement of procurement excellence.

• You act as a role model, demonstrating curiosity, passion, an entrepreneurial spirit, enterprise thinking, inclusive collaboration, and desire for continuous learning.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business, engineering or technology.

• You have 5+ years procurement, project management, or management consulting experience, ideally within a matrix o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior Procurement Manager - IT Services

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Senior Procurement Manager in IT Services, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in a specific category or spend areas and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category strategy owner in charge of driving, coordinating and signing the category strategy.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as Customer Excellence, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive category sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives.

You will work closely with other team members, as a peer coach, project, or workstream lead to identify opportunities to aggregate customer demand, drive buying channel automation, deliver on day-to day activities, and provide capacity, expertise, and oversight to productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

As a Senior Procurement Manager in IT Services, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter expert in IT Services conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements and maximize the value for Roche.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and project management skills, and/or supporting team members by coaching them and enhancing their skills and knowledge.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Procurement Manager - Servizi IT Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'assistenza sanitaria si sta evolvendo e Global Procurement risponde continuando ad impegnarsi per le più alte prestazioni possibili, adottando approcci innovativi e strategici per le partnership tra imprese e fornitori. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità: Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del gruppo Indirect Procurement Delivery, che copre le attività principali di approvvigionamento da gestione di categoria, approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, gestione dei fornitori, contratto, definizione di strategia di contenuto e l'esecuzione. Il gruppo Indirect Procurement Delivery comprende molte comunità che raggruppano le categorie della stessa catena del valore o che hanno una comunitÃ, tra cui ricerca e sviluppo, servizi commerciali e aziendali, tecnologia digitale e servizi. Le comunità sono i principali abilitatori di una forte competenza di categoria, consentendo la flessibilità nella risposta di consegna degli appalti alle esigenze in evoluzione dei nostri clienti. In qualità di Senior Procurement Manager nei servizi IT, si porterà il pensiero analitico, la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la messa a fuoco per l'area di approvvigionamento sourcing e capacità di consegna. Utilizzando le vostre conoscenze specialistiche e competenze approfondite in una specifica categoria o aree di spesa e approvvigionamento generale, si proattivamente identificare e guidare le strategie e gli approcci per la gestione e l'assistenza dei requisiti di spesa di terze parti. È inoltre possibile svolgere il ruolo del proprietario di strategia di categoria incaricato di guidare, coordinare e firmare la strategia di categoria. Collaborerai con gli appalti interni (come l'Eccellenza del Cliente, l'Insights, l'Analisi, il Contraente, ecc.) e gli stakeholder aziendali per costruire e implementare strategie di gestione di categoria complete che siano allineate alle esigenze aziendali e agli obiettivi funzionali. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con altri membri del team, come peer coach, project, o workstream portare a identificare le opportunità di aggregare la domanda del cliente, guidare l'automazione dei canali di acquisto, fornire attività quotidiane, e fornire capacità, competenze e supervisione alla produttività e altri progetti / soluzioni orientate al cliente. Come Senior Procurement Manager in Servizi IT, si giocherà una varietà di ruoli secondo la vostra esperienza, conoscenza e requisiti aziendali generali, tra cui ma non limitati a:
• Lei è un esperto di materia tematica di categoria e sourcing in Servizi IT che conduce il mercato e l'analisi interna per sviluppare strategie, best practice e la guida su piani tattici per come Roche dovrebbe fonte e negoziare per beni e servizi di terze parti al fine di soddisfare i requisiti degli stakeholder e massimizzare il valore per Roche.
• Sei un professionista della consegna degli appalti che offre ed esegue strategie di approvvigionamento e iniziative importanti sfruttando spendere, know-how di categoria, sourcing robusto, negoziazione, contrazione, metodologie di gestione dei fornitori e competenze di gestione del progetto, e / o sostenere i membri del team allenandoli e migliorando le loro competenze e conoscenze.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Gestionnaire principal des achats - Services de TI Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les soins de santé évoluent, et Global Approvisionnement répond en s'efforçant constamment d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en adoptant des approches novatrices et stratégiques pour les partenariats avec les entreprises et les fournisseurs. Global Approvisionnement gère de manière proactive l'ensemble de l'écosystème fournisseur, contribuant de façon essentielle à améliorer les résultats en matière de santé, réduisant les coûts pour les patients et les systèmes de santé mondiaux, et faisant en sorte que Roche continue de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. La possibilité : Ce rôle fait partie du groupe chargé de la prestation des achats indirects, qui couvre les principales activités d'approvisionnement liées à la gestion des catégories, à l'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel, à la gestion des fournisseurs, à la passation de marchés, à la définition de la stratégie de contenu et à l'exécution. Le groupe de la prestation d'approvisionnements indirects comprend de nombreuses collectivités regroupant des catégories de la même chaîne de valeur ou ayant des points communs, y compris la recherche et le développement, les services commerciaux et ministériels, le numérique et la technologie et les installations. Les collectivités sont des catalyseurs clés d'une solide expertise de catégorie tout en permettant de répondre avec souplesse aux besoins changeants de nos clients. En tant que gestionnaire principal des approvisionnements dans les services de TI, vous ferez appel à la réflexion analytique, à la planification, à l'exécution et à la concentration dans le domaine des capacités d'approvisionnement et de prestation. À l'aide de vos connaissances spécialisées et de votre expertise approfondie dans une catégorie particulière ou dans des domaines de dépense et d'approvisionnement en général, vous définirez et dirigerez de façon proactive des stratégies et des approches pour gérer et acheminer les dépenses de tiers. Vous pouvez également jouer le rôle de propriétaire de la stratégie de catégorie en charge de la conduite, la coordination et la signature de la stratégie de catégorie. Vous collaborerez avec l'approvisionnement interne (telle que l'excellence client, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) et les intervenants commerciaux afin d'élaborer et de mettre en oeuvre des stratégies complètes de gestion de l'approvisionnement et des dépenses de catégorie qui correspondent aux besoins opérationnels et aux objectifs fonctionnels. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres membres de l'équipe, en tant qu'entraîneur par les pairs, qu'un projet ou qu'un volet de travail mène pour cerner les possibilités d'agréger la demande des clients, de stimuler l'automatisation des canaux d'achat, de mener des activités quotidiennes et de fournir une capacité, une expertise et une surveillance à la productivité et à d'autres projets/solutions axés sur les clients. En tant que gestionnaire principal des approvisionnements dans les services de TI, vous jouerez divers rôles en fonction de votre expérience, de vos connaissances et de vos besoins opérationnels généraux, notamment :
• Vous êtes un expert en matière de catégorie et d'approvisionnement dans les services informatiques qui mène des analyses de marché et internes pour élaborer des stratégies, des pratiques exemplaires et des conseils sur les plans tactiques pour la façon dont Roche devrait trouver et négocier des biens et services tiers afin de satisfaire les exigences des parties prenantes et maximiser la valeur pour Roche.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a team member of Roche Services (Europe) Ltd. Site Services Department, the Procurement & Car Fleet Management Intern is responsible for:

• Supporting the work of the Strategic Procurement Partner and the Office Executives in administration regarding Procurement tasks and Car Fleet Management.

Responsibilities
Car fleet:

• Managing administrative duties including: monitoring car fleet contract start/end dates, highway tickets, penalties etc.

• Keeping contact with the Leasing companies and following up the incoming messages.

• Informing the employees about the car policy and assisting them with any car fleet related questions.

• Managing and updating the database containing comprehensive car fleet details.

• Supporting the car handover process and performing regular car condition checks.

• Assisting with the request, distribution, and record-keeping of fuel cards and motorway vignettes.

• Supporting the team with ad-hoc projects and tasks as needed.

• Supporting system related activities in MyBuy, eg.: PO creation, reports.

Procurement:

• Supporting the Strategic Procurement Partner providing administrative assistance during the bidding process and organizing tender documentation.

• Analyzing supplier offers and maintaining data accuracy to support decision-making.

• Creating Purchase Orders (POs) and ensuring all transaction details are correct.

• Following up on orders and deliveries with vendors.

• Partnering with various departments to ensure their procurement needs are met efficiently and Ensuring all activities and documentation align with the official Procurement Policy.

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

What you can bring to our team

• Fluency in English & Hungarian

• You are currently studying in Hungarian University/College on a day-time schedule

• You are available to work 20-30 hours on a weekly basis

• B category driving license with active driving experience

• Stakeholder management skills, ability to multi-task

• Strong service orientation and communication skills

• Precise, focused, accountable way of working, high level of organizational and problem solving skills

• Proactive mindset

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Team player attitude, accuracy, ability to meet deadlines and set the right priorities

• Ability to adapt changes quickly

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Graphic Design Intern assists in creating visually compelling designs while gaining hands-on experience in a professional design environment. Working closely with senior designers and team members, they contribute to various creative projects across print, digital, and social media platforms.

In this role, the intern supports the team to design scalable Showpad pages, build automated template workflows, explore new Ai key features, and enforce governance across global Roche design assets. This role ensures 100% compatibility with Figma/Illustrator. They have the opportunity to enhance their creative skills, and learn how to create lovable marketing assets for customers using ABX approach.
This internship is ideal for students or recent graduates looking to build their portfolio, work on real-world projects, and collaborate within a dynamic design team.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

• Vector-First Production: Design, build, and migrate Showpad pages and UI assets strictly within Figma and Illustrator, ensuring all global assets are lightweight, editable, and scalable.

• Template Engineering: Turn standard layouts into robust, modular Figma components and design systems so that "simple design tasks" can be executed instantly or self-sourced by affiliates.

• Asset Optimization: Ensure all imagery and graphics comply with Roche UI guidelines

• Assist in designing marketing materials such as brochures, social media graphics, presentations, banners, and other visual assets.

• Support the team in maintaining brand consistency across all design outputs.

• Work closely with senior designers and other team members to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions.

• Edit and refine design elements based on feedback and brand guidelines.

• Explore AI page creation and section templates in Showpad to scale approach

• Develop a strong understanding of the organization's brand identity and apply it consistently across all design projects.

• Actively participate in design critiques, team meetings, and professional development opportunities to continuously improve skills and knowledge.

• Adapt to changing priorities and work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Who you are

You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You love to stay abreast of the latest digital updates in order to provide partners with cutting-edge design capabilities, being fully aware of the most current design trends.

Further requirements

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field at a Hungarian University.

• You are available to work 30 hours on a weekly basis

• Proficient in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).

• Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and layout design.

• A keen eye for detail and a passion for creative storytelling through design.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Strong communication skills and openness to receiving feedback.

• Basic knowledge of digital design principles for web and social media is a plus.

titleByLocale.it: Persone Piombo (m/w/d) in der Pharma Produktion
titleByLocale.en: People Lead (m/w/d) in der Pharma Produktion
titleByLocale.de: People Lead (m/w/d) in der Pharma Produktion
titleByLocale.fr: People Lead (m/w/d) in der Pharma Produktion

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Mission

Als Produktionsteam an unserem Standort Penzberg verfolgen wir ein gemeinsames Ziel: Menschen weltweit zuverlässig mit lebenswichtigen Medikamenten zu versorgen – sicher, effizient und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, treiben neue Ideen voran und entwickeln uns stetig weiter – für unsere Patient:innen weltweit.

Deine Rolle als People Lead

Wir suchen People Leader (m/w/d) mit Macher-Qualitäten, die die Prozesse hinterfragen, Dinge proaktiv anpacken und als Servant Leader Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen in unserer Organisation aktiv fördern. Vor allem kommt es uns darauf an, dass diese Position von jemandem mit einer positiv denkenden, lösungsorientierten, integren und selbstreflektierten Persönlichkeit ausgefüllt wird.

Was Dich erwartet

In dieser Position geht es nicht einfach nur darum, eine Führungskraft zu sein. Es geht vielmehr darum, als positives Beispiel voranzugehen und die neue Führungskultur erlebbar zu machen. Mitarbeitende werden von Dir disziplinarisch geführt und gefördert, um Fachexpertisen aufrechtzuerhalten und vor allem um der Organisation dabei zu helfen, heute zu leisten, was unsere Patienten morgen brauchen!

• Die konzeptionelle Ausrichtung sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung der Leistung des Teams, die Begleitung des Teams bei Veränderungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in Deine Hände.

• Du wendest LPS-Methoden (z.B. Gemba-Walks o.ä.) an, überträgst Verantwortungen im Sinne eines proaktiven “empowern” und richtest die Teamziele strategisch aus, um somit das Servant-Leadership-Konzept erlebbar zu machen.

• Coaching, Check-Ins, Weiterentwicklung, Fördern und Fordern sowie Motivieren sind Bestandteil Deiner täglichen Arbeit.

• Du sorgst für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld und gehst im Bereich SHE als gutes Beispiel voran.

• Als Change Agent gestaltest Du aktiv unsere Zukunft mit und begleitest Mitarbeitende bei Veränderungen.

• Die Motivation des Teams und eines jeden Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein besonderes Anliegen, daher ist es ebenso wichtig, dass das Team-Zusammenspiel von Dir empathisch begleitet und permanent entwickelt wird. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Tech Supervisors wird auch die Fachexpertise des Teams ausgerichtet und weiterentwickelt.

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Ressourcen- und die Kapazitätsplanung Deines Bereichs.

Wer Du bist

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship in protein chemistry: Novel antibody-based formats for in-vitro diagnostics (m/f/d)

Suchst Du ein Praktikum, in dem Du dich sowohl beruflich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen jemanden, der uns bei unseren vielfältigen Aufgaben unterstützt. Dies gibt Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die verschiedenen Einheiten innerhalb unserer Abteilung kennenzulernen und einen Überblick über die unterschiedlichen Aktivitäten zu gewinnen.

Die Abteilung

Sie werden in der Abteilung „Proteinchemie“ arbeiten, die zur Einheit „Reagent Research and Design“ von Roche Centralized and Point of Care Solutions gehört und sich auf die Entwicklung von protein basierten Reagenzien für immunologische Diagnostik Tests konzentriert.
Hier entwickeln, realisieren und bewerten wir innovative Lösungen für Diagnostik Systemkonzepte basierend auf dem Roche Cobas e-Analyzer zur zielgerichteten und hochsensitiven Quantifizierung von menschlichen Körperflüssigkeiten.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie werden aktiv an Forschungsprojekten teilnehmen, um die Entwicklung von Antikörper basierten Reagenzien für aktuelle und zukünftige Technologien zu optimieren.

• Sie werden verschiedene Techniken zur Antikörperreinigung durchführen.

• Sie werden Antikörper mit sowohl ortsspezifischen als auch unspezifischen Markierungsstrategien konjugieren und anschließend reinigen.

• Sie werden die Leistungsfähigkeit dieser Reagenzien auf Cobas e-Analyzer evaluieren.

• Sie werden wissenschaftliche Literatur überprüfen und bewerten und Ihre Ergebnisse präsentieren.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit mehreren Teams zusammen, die über verschiedene Abteilungen verteilt sind (Chemie, Proteinchemie, Antikörperentwicklung und Enzymtechnologie).

Ihr Profil

Sie sind eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) in Chemie, Biochemie, Chemischer Biologie oder einem
verwandten Bereich oder in einem vergleichbaren Masterstudiengang oder befinden sich in einem Gap
Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Ihre Stärken

• Sie haben Kenntnisse in organischer Chemie und Proteinbiochemie, erste Erfahrungen sind

• von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in instrumenteller Analytik (z.B. UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Grundkenntnisse in Immunologie sind von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen und gemeinsam im Team Konzepte zu entwickeln.

• Sie sind kreativ und setzen Ihre Ideen gerne in die Praxis um.

• Sie können sich selbstständig organisieren und Ihren Arbeitsalltag strukturieren.

• Sie besitzen gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (37.5 Std./Woche)

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

Ihre Bewerbung

Bitte laden Sie nur Ihren Lebenslauf online hoch.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) richtet, die derzeit
eingeschrieben sind oder sich in einem Gap Year befinden (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Zeitraum: Ab Oktober 2026 oder früher für einen Zeitraum von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Bitte beachten, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

--

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer within the AI Innovation workstream, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for the hands-on execution of our AI/ML security strategy. Working as part of a specialized team, you will assist in developing and implementing AI capabilities to optimize service delivery across the Design, Build, and Operations phases of our network security solutions. Your role is to help bridge the gap between network security engineering and data science, contributing to the development of intelligent automation that reduces manual intervention and shifts our infrastructure toward a proactive, self-healing model. You will apply your technical expertise to ensure these technologies integrate seamlessly with our core stack, including Cisco ISE, 802.1x, and Palo Alto Networks.

Job Responsibilities

1. AI Strategy & Roadmap Execution

• Strategy Definition: Partner with product owners to define the vision for AI adoption within Network Security (e.g., predictive threat detection, automated policy optimization).

• Hands-on Implementation: Lead the technical execution of AI workstreams, moving from Proof of Concept (POC) to production-ready security enhancements.

• SME for AI Security: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for how AI can be leveraged to improve the efficacy and performance of Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, and 802.1x infrastructures. ​

2. AI-Driven Observability & Inventory

• Intelligent Monitoring: Develop AI/ML models to identify anomalies in network traffic and security appliance telemetry that traditional threshold-based monitoring misses.

• Automated Classification: Enhance asset inventory and device profiling (NAC) by applying machine learning to identify complex IoT and medical device patterns.

• Framework Integration: Integrate AI insights into the existing observability front-end and backend frameworks to provide actionable intelligence to operations teams.

​
3. Proactive Defense & Automation

• Predictive Analytics: Implement tools to predict potential security bottlenecks or infrastructure failures before they impact the global network.

• Policy Optimization: Use AI to analyze firewall and NAC policy usage, recommending automated cleanup or hardening of security rules.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead the "Design, Build, and Improve" cycle for AI-driven security controls, ensuring they evolve alongside the threat landscape.

​

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Educational Bac

Als Teil des Schullaborteams wirst du an verschiedenen Aktivitäten und Projekten beteiligt sein, um den Schüler:innen sowie den Lehrpersonen vielfältige Angebote zu ermöglichen.

Die Möglichkeit

• Kreative Workshops gestalten: Du wirst aktiv an der Vor- und Nachbereitung von vielfältigen Workshops im MINT-Bereich (Mathematik, Informatik, Naturwissenschaften und Technik) mitwirken und deine eigenen Ideen einbringen.

• Eigene Projekte leiten: Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Teilbereiche oder sogar ganze Workshops selbstständig zu konzipieren und durchzuführen und dabei deine Fähigkeiten unter Beweis zu stellen.

• Innovation vorantreiben: Werde Teil des Schullaborteams und unterstütze uns bei der Entwicklung neuer, innovativer Angebote, um noch mehr junge Menschen für MINT-Themen zu begeistern.

• Für eine reibungslose Umgebung sorgen: Du hilfst dabei, die Infrastruktur und das Inventar im Labor und der Werkstatt in Schuss zu halten, damit alle optimal arbeiten können.

• Besucher willkommen heissen: Unterstütze bei der Betreuung verschiedener Besuchergruppen und präsentiere die spannende Welt von EXPERIO Roche.

• Netzwerken und lernen: Arbeite in abteilungs- und berufsgruppenübergreifenden Projekten der Berufsbildung mit und erweitere dein Netzwerk.

• Roche repräsentieren: Vertrete die Berufsbildungsabteilung auf verschiedenen Berufsmessen und inspiriere junge Talente für eine Karriere bei Roche.

Wer du bist

Deine Leidenschaft für MINT trifft auf unsere Begeisterung für Bildung. W enn du dich in folgender Beschreibung wiederfindest, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig:

• Studierende mit Begeisterung: Du bist derzeit an einer Fachhochschule oder Universität in einem Bachelor-Studiengang eingeschrieben oder nutzt ein Zwischenjahr, um dich beruflich zu orientieren und wertvolle Erfahrungen zu sammeln.

• MINT-Enthusiastin oder angehende Pädagogin : Du studierst in einem MINT-Bereich oder Pädagogik/Lehramt und möchtest dein Wissen an junge Talente weitergeben.

• Kreativer Kopf : Du möchtest deine eigenen Ideen einbringen und dich aktiv weiterentwickeln.

• Teamplayer/in mit sozialem Engagement: Du arbeitest gerne mit jungen Menschen in einem multikulturellen Umfeld zusammen

• Freude an praktischer Arbeit

• Erfahrungen in MINT-Bereichen und mit der Zielgruppe sind von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

• Kreativität, Selbständigkeit und Teamfähigkeit

Das Startdatum ist Anfang August 2026 (100% Pensum) und ist für 12 Monate bevorzugt.
Damit deine Bewerbung berücksichtigt wird, muss mindestens ein aktueller Lebenslauf sowie ein Motivationsschreiben eingereicht werden.

• Creare workshop creativi: parteciperai attivamente alla preparazione e al follow-up di diversi workshop nell'area STEM (matematica, informatica, scienze naturali e tecnologia) e porterà le tue idee.

• Promuovere l'innovazione: Diventa parte del team di laboratorio scolastico e supportaci nello sviluppo di nuove offerte innovative per ispirare ancora più giovani per gli argomenti STEM.
• Assicurare un ambiente liscio: aiuta a mantenere l'infrastruttura e l'inventario in laboratorio e il workshop in contatto in modo che tutti possano lavorare in modo ottimale.

• Networking e apprendimento: lavorare in progetti multidisciplinari e multiprofessionali di formazione professionale e ampliare la rete.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As our Business Support Specialist, you will act as an architect and orchestrator of our Deal Calculation processes. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the end-to-end offer, deal, and price calculation lifecycle, ensuring that complex laboratory solutions are translated into competitive, profitable, and compliant commercial proposals. By facilitating cross-functional collaboration and leveraging your mastery of global systems, you will directly contribute to the success of Roche Diagnostics’ tenders and quotes across different disease portfolios and product areas.

Please note that this is a CONTRACTOR/CONTINGENT POSITION. You will be employed by our 3rd party service provider.

You will work independently within broad guidelines, receiving minimal guidance while managing non-recurring, complex tender requests. By participating in high-level strategy sessions, you will bring your unique practice and knowledge to the table, directly affecting the quality and success rate of our critical affiliate tender activities.

• Lead End-to-End Deal Orchestration: Drive the entire deal calculation process for high-complexity offers and tenders, ensuring all stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, Finance, Supply Chain) are aligned and deadlines are met.

• Generate Complex Financial Modeling: Independently create and evaluate sophisticated financial calculations for large-scale tenders to ensure optimal profitability and competitive market positioning.

• Act as a Consultative Partner: Advisor to Sales and Marketing during the pre-tender phase, providing strategic insights on offer structures and pricing dynamics.

• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the local Key User and "Knowledge Anchor" for global, regional, and local deal calculation platforms, participating in international projects to shape Roche’s future commercial tools.

• Ensure Quality and Compliance: Analyze multiple sources of information to ensure every commercial proposal is flawlessly accurate and adheres to the highest ethical and compliance standards.

• Facilitate Consensus: Use tact and diplomacy to exchange sensitive information and build consensus among diverse cross-functional stakeholders during quote and tender preparations.

Who you are

• Educational Background: Hold a BSc/MSc degree in Life Sciences, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.

• Laboratory Expertise: Mandatory experience working in a central hospital/clinical laboratory, or a solid background in molecular biology, medical microbiology, pathology, or alternative relevant laboratory fields.

• Commercial Mastery & Systems Literacy: A proven track record in managing complex commercial processes alongside expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel and advanced analytical tools.

• Analytical Problem Solving: Ability to solve complex problems, interpret large datasets, and bring a fresh perspective to existing commercial solutions.

• Communication & Influence: Excellent negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information effectively to internal and external partners.

• Language Skills: Fluency in English and the local language is essential.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been newly established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As the Social Media Specialist (Community Management) , you would supports the Digital Communities team within Group Communications, you'll play a crucial role in orchestrating digital engagement and shaping the presence of Roche across various social media platforms. You will be working very closely with Digital Communications Engagement Managers and their stakeholders to support and enhance global social media channels and external audience interactions. You will be responsible for managing and growing our online presence across various platforms, the caretaker of our brand’s online presence, fostering a vibrant community, driving engagement through innovative and effective social media strategies, and ensuring positive and productive community interactions.

The Opportunity:

• Monitoring and replying to customer queries received via inbox and/or global social media channels.

• Cultivate and manage online communities by responding to comments, moderating interactions, and fostering meaningful engagement aligned with Roche’s brand voice.

• Building relationships with the Roche executive community, influencers, brand advocates, and partners to amplify brand messaging, and proactively manage potential social media issues by implementing crisis communication plans with the Global Insights/Crisis team.

• Proactively recommending improvements to strengthen digital presence, and identifying process enhancements to ensure innovative approaches across community, channel, and creative aspects while coaching junior colleagues as well.

• Business Process Management: as a center of excellence, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation within the scope of responsibility.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor's degree and 3 to 5 years of experience in global social media management, proficient in channel management, audience-centric strategies, social media tools, and managing agencies (experience in managing executive profiles is a big plus).

• You have experience with advertisement platforms and are strong in social metrics, content strategies for major platforms, and project management.

• You have excellent German and English communication skills; creative thinking for innovative content.

• You have strong interpersonal skills for teamwork and are skilled in conflict resolution, community moderation, and handling complex issues independently.

• You are a quick learner with a passion for technology, flexible with tools, and adept at adopting new technologies.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2

jobs.title: Global Program Manager ( 12 months FTC )
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Program Manager (GPM) at Roche/Genentech is a core member of molecule/disease area teams, driving drug or disease area development programs to maximize efficiency, portfolio value, and patient benefit. This role contributes to the company's bold ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines by 2030 by co-creating and delivering the portfolio effectively and efficiently.

The Opportunity

• Be a core member of one or more molecule/disease area teams and drive drug or disease area development programs as well as established (foundational) product teams to maximize efficiency, portfolio value and patient benefit.

• Provide strategic program management to project teams, framing and assessing options, and identifying inflection points and critical factors for project delivery, decision-making and governance.

• Guide molecule teams, in close collaboration with the respective team leader.

• Build and maintain highly functioning project teams by observing team dynamics, building trust, addressing issues and encouraging open dialogues.

• Keep teams on track to deliver short-, mid-and long-term activities to achieve team objectives and drive key program/project meetings & workshops, team communication and documentation.

• Lead and contribute to functional or company-wide initiative workstreams (may).

• Contribute to portfolio management by reporting and proactively maintaining key project information to support portfolio overview and decisions.

• Maintain program and project management guidelines, standards, and tools as required.

• Drive implementation and execution of program strategy identification and mitigation of program risks.

• Leverage molecule development and market expertise to accelerate high quality decisions, lead effective ways of working, and catalyze change.

• Foster a teaching, coaching, and learning culture and embody OneRoche leadership principles such as VACC - Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach within the MPM community, the PSD chapter and teams.

Addendum for the Evidence GPM Role

• Support Integrated Evidence Planning: This involves a global strategic planning process for evidence generation across functions to ensure broad and sustainable patient access to medicines by defining all necessary evidence for regulatory, access, and clinical practice throughout a product's lifecycle.

Scope of Authority

• The role is accountable for Program Oversight and Planning, Team Management, Communication, Portfolio Context, and Strategic Thought Partnership. It involves influencing R&D across many therapeutic areas and requires interactions with partners across the organization, including Clinical Development, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, and Commercial organizations. The GPM guides molecule teams and contributes to portfolio management and functional or company-wide initiative workstreams, demonstrating influence without explicit authority at various organizational levels.

Who you are

• Talented and passionate, inspired by the shared purpose of being key partners in translating Roche strategies into PD priorities and beyond and delivering the portfolio with excellence.

• Experienced in using different Project Management, Change Management, Business Management or related tools, methodologies & approaches to drive the team’s development of a strategy and achieve the desired outcomes for a program/project/function, effectively and efficiently.

• Solid drug development and potentially commercial experience, and a proven track record

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As Team Lead Engineering Commercial Pharma International Engagement Lead (CRM, Field, VOC, Events) (Senior Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

This role serves as the engagement lead for end-to-end customer engagement within the Pharma International region, encompassing the strategic oversight of CRM, Voice of Customer (VoC), and field integration. As a specialized ecosystem, the CRM space is designed to streamline relationships with healthcare professionals and patients while ensuring strict regulatory compliance across global markets. The system centralizes stakeholder data to enable personalized, omnichannel engagement across digital and in-person channels, supported by automated processes such as strategic account planning and sample management. By integrating VoC insights directly into these workflows, the platform ensures that field teams can refine their account strategies based on real-time customer feedback and preferences. Beyond execution, the CRM acts as a strategic hub for data-based insights, utilizing dashboards to monitor how effectively the organization is delivering on its customer-centricity goals while maintaining audit-ready documentation for legal requirements. Ultimately, this environment breaks down departmental silos to foster seamless collaboration between sales, marketing, and medical teams through a unified source of truth.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Proactively identifies and develops future-focused engineering team capabilities, aligning with long-term strategic goals.

• Mentors team members on long-term career paths, creating new opportunities and roles within the organization to support their growth.

• Addresses and helps resolve complex, systemic roadblocks that impact multiple development teams, and coaches other managers on effective performance management.

• Oversees the technical and soft skill development, ensuring a balanced and high-performing talent portfolio.

​

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Establishes and monitors metrics for team health and sustainability across several development teams, implementing strategies to ensure long-term balance.

• Designs and implements initiatives to improve collaboration and psychological safety across multiple related development teams or a whole product area.

• Proactively identifies and resolves systemic impediments that affect multiple development teams, improving the overall work environment.

• Manages the talent composition for own and related teams, planning for future needs and ensuring a healthy pipeline of skills.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the long-term technical vision and strategy for a product portfolio, partnering with Product Managers and Leaders who are overall responsible for the roadmaps.

• Accountable for

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.

Du wirst im Raum Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen ) .

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September (28.09. – 02.10.2026) ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik
