descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Was Dich erwartet: Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen. Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten. Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen. Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt. Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet. Du wirst im Raum Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen ) . Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:
• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September (28.09. – 02.10.2026) ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).
• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.
• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.
• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.
• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.
• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).
• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.
• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.
• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Estagiário(a) de Estratégia e Soluções Integradas, você terá a oportunidade de entender a jornada do paciente e envolver-se na cocriação e implementação de projetos e soluções. Esta vaga oferece uma trilha de desenvolvimento clara, onde você expandirá o seu impacto e responsabilidades ao longo do programa de estágio.

A Oportunidade
No seu dia a dia, você participa em melhorias de processos internos com foco na agilidade para o cliente e auxilia na implementação de eventos, campanhas e materiais. A sua jornada será estruturada da seguinte forma:

No 1º ano de estágio:

• Você realiza a imersão nas políticas internas e implementa processos end-to-end, como gestão de contratos, cadastro de speakers (PF e PJ) e parceiros de negócios, atuando como ponto focal de pagamentos.

• Você gerencia a abertura de eventos no SalesForce, realiza o upload de materiais no PromoMats para aprovação (de acordo com RDC 96 e PAMDE) e faz o preenchimento do GSD.

• Você colabora com a organização de repositórios nos iHubs, faz a interface direta com fornecedores e instituições patrocinadas, e modera as cerimónias do chapter de ESI.

No 2º ano de estágio:

• Você implementa, de ponta a ponta, projetos e eventos de média complexidade e participa, junto ao analista e coordenador, no desenvolvimento de projetos de alta complexidade.

• Você modera as syncs dos iHubs, atua na governança do guia de processos ESI e faz a interface com estratégias omnichannel.

• Você cria materiais e briefings para parceiros de negócios e realiza a revisão de materiais segundo as normas (RDC 96 e PAMDE).

Quem é você

• Você cursa graduação em áreas relacionadas a Marketing, Administração, Comunicação, Engenharia de Bioprocessos ou na área da Saúde (Farmácia, Enfermagem, Biomedicina, etc.).

• Você tem disponibilidade para cumprir um contrato de estágio de, no mínimo, 1 ano e meio (formatura a partir de Dez de 2027).

• Você possui um nível intermediário do idioma Inglês.

• Você tem conhecimentos básicos nas ferramentas Excel e PowerPoint.

Diferenciais

• Você possui noções e interesse em gestão de projetos.

• Você tem conhecimento de metodologias ágeis.

*Benefícios de relocalização não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questa posizione offre una traccia di sviluppo chiara, dove potrete ammirare l'impatto e le responsabilità lungo il programma di stage. L'Oportunità Nel quotidiano, parteciperete a finali di processi interni con focus sull'agilità per il cliente e aiutaete nell'implementazione di eventi, campagne e materiali. La tua storia sarà strutturata in questo modo: Anno 1 di Stage - Realizzerete l'immersione nelle politiche interne e implementerete processi end-to-end, come gestione di contratti, cattura di speaker (PF e PJ) e partner di business, agendo come punto focale di pagamenti. - Gestionerete l'apertura di eventi nel SalesForce, realizza l'upload di materiali nel PromoMats per approvazione (in base a RDC 96 e PAMDE) e tariffe il preenchimento del GSD. - Collaborerete con l'organizzazione di repositori nei iHubs, farete l'interfaccia diretta con fornitori e istituzioni patrocinate, e modorerete le cerimonie del capitolo di ESI. Anno 2 di Stage - Implementerete, da ponta a ponta, e eventi di media complessità e parteciperete, insieme all'analista e al coordinatore, nel sviluppo di progetti di complessità alta. - Modorerete le sync dei iHubs, agire nella governanza del guida di processi ESI e farete l'interfaccia con strategie omnichannel. - Creerete materiali e briefings per partner di business e realizza la revisione di materiali secondo le norme (RDC 96 e PAMDE). Chi è la persona giusta - Cursate la laurea in aree correlate a Marketing, Amministrazione, Comunicazione, Ingegneria di Bioprocessi o nell'area della Salute (Farmacia, Ingegneria, Biomedicina, ecc.). - adempiere a un contratto di stage di, almeno, 1 anno e mezzo (formatura a partire da Dicembre 2027). - Possedete un livello intermedio del linguaggio inglese. - conoscenze basilari nelle ferramenta Excel e PowerPoint. Differenziali - Possedete nozioni e interessanti in gestione di progetti. - Avete conoscenza di metodi agili. *Benefici di relocalizzazione non sono disponibili per questa posizione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a avanzare la scienza, assicurando a tutti l'accesso ai servizi sanitari oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri medicinali e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Abbiamo il potere di decidere a esplorare nuove possibilità, di favorire la creatività e di mantenere le nostre ambizioni alte, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni di saluto che hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un Datore di Lavoro Uguale Opportunità.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats.

As a CyberSecurity Analyst -Monitoring & Incident Response , you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

Note: As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was macht unseren Bereich aus
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist als Teil der Diagnostics Global Operations der wichtigste Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen bis hin zu speziellen Kits für die Diagnostik-Division von Roche. Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige, interessante und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe im Bereich Manufacturing. Hier werden biochemische und chemische Reagenzien und Einsatzstoffe für alle Geschäftsbereiche und vor allem die In-vitro-Diagnostik mehrerer Roche Geschäftseinheiten hergestellt.

Das Team
Unser Team im Themencluster Festphasenchemie produziert modifizierte Oligonucleotide, Peptide und Konjugate im kleinen Maßstab unter GMP-Bedingungen. Diese Produkte unterstützen zahlreiche diagnostische Assays wie PCR, Immundiagnostik und Sequencing. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Herstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Produkte, der Einführung innovativer Artikel und der kontinuierlichen Optimierung unserer Produktionsprozesse in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Experte in der organischen Chemie/Festphasenchemie stellst du hochwertige Produkte für die In-vitro-Diagnostik her. Deine Tätigkeiten finden in einem GMP-regulierten Bereich statt.
Neben der Abarbeitung von Produktionsaufträgen unterstützt du unser Team aktiv bei folgenden Themen:

• Übernahme neuer Verfahren und Implementierung neuer Produkte.

• Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, CAPAs, OOS-Fällen und Troubleshootings.

• Prozessverbesserungen, Scale-ups und Changes.

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von HVs und SOPs.

• Unterstützung bei Validierungen und Qualifizierungen sowie bei technischen Themen.

• Mitarbeit bei der Produktionsplanung und Unterstützung bei Arbeitssicherheitsthemen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast dein Studium der Chemie (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der organischen Chemie mit. Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung im Bereich der Festphasenchemie.

• Du besitzt theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der analytischen und präparativen Chromatographie.

• Berufserfahrung in einem Produktionsumfeld sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit sind ein Plus.

• Auf deine sehr guten Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr guten Kenntnisse gängiger EDV-Anwendungen können wir uns jederzeit verlassen.

Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The territory is within the San Diego area. Ideal candidate must reside in the territory.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $71,000 and $132,000 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits
*LI-MG1

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint. PTE is the organization that catalyzes global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients. We aim to activate data citizenship and digital mindset, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem and systems landscape, re-design excellent processes, and generate transformative insights.

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for driving the digital technology strategy through the delivery of key digital initiatives and use cases in the Quality domain and you take the role of an Agile Product Owner (PO) to partner with customers across PT functions to architect the planning (e.g. diagnose), execution (e.g. design & build), and sustainment of digital solutions to achieve the PT Digital Aspirations.

• Strategic Digital Transformation: Architecting key initiatives and acting as a digital translator between business needs and technical roles by navigating across both domains seamlessly.

• Impact: Defining impact aspirations (e.g. product vision, roadmap, value assessments, business cases) as well as leading deployment of a global solution in a function or site. Enable significant improvements in quality management processes through innovative digital solutions, confirmed through the measurement of key business metrics.

• Requirements Analysis: Utilize your broad Quality end to end Business understanding to perform detailed requirement analyses with the team, with a strong focus on balancing process requirements, stakeholder requirements with digital product simplicity, network scalability and sustainability.

• Prioritization and Team Setup: Conducting use case prioritization and assuming the product owner role to catalyze the implementation of key digital use cases. Coach teams that are developing and deploying digital use cases, e.g. share best practices, agile ways of working, backlog management, sprint planning and ensure full impact capture & coordination between different initiatives. Lead cross-functional project teams with digital experts and SMEs across multiple sites and time zones.

• Compliance and Solution Shaping: Facilitating compliant solutions for data and digital products in the GxP environment.

• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify potential risks associated with digital quality initiatives and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.

• Innovation and Improvement: Continuously explore and assess emerging digital technologies and industry trends. Drive innovation and process improvements within the Quality domain to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Who you are

You bring several years of experience in architecting and implementing digital

The Position
The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role. The territory is within the San Francisco peninsula, East Bay & South Bay areas, or within the Vacaville/Fairfield area. Ideal candidate must reside in the territory.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $81,700 and $151,700 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Proattivamente crei strategie di regolazione uniche/innovative e influenza gli approcci per evitare ostacoli normativi e accelerare le approvazioni mondiali. - Lei collabora efficacemente con gli stakeholder di influenza finale per capire e fornire le migliori soluzioni. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Cash Applications & Accounts Receivable Accountant based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be a key driver of financial accuracy within the Roche Services Americas team. This center provides critical Finance and Procurement services to various countries across the Americas region. Your primary mission is to ensure that all incoming payments are identified, matched, and applied to customer accounts with precision, effectively "closing the loop" on the Invoice-to-Cash cycle.

Key Responsibilities:

• Cash Application: Execute daily posting of incoming payments (Wire, ACH, Checks) and accurately match remittances to customer invoices.

• Reconciliation: Manage bank account reconciliations and clear AR/bank suspense accounts to ensure zero unexplained variances.

• Operational AR: Handle manual invoicing, corrections, and customer credit analysis to support regional financial health.

• Dispute Management: Identify and code payment discrepancies (short-pays/over-payments) and resolve inquiries from affiliates and customers.

• Process Improvement: Propose automation and system enhancements (SAP/BlackLine) to improve "auto-match" rates and SSC efficiency.

Who You Are:
You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong understanding of accounting flows and a commitment to high-integrity financial reporting.

Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or related field .

• Experience: 3+ years in Finance/Accounting; Shared Services experience is a plus.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP, BlackLine , or similar ERPs, and advanced Excel/G-Suite skills.

• Languages: Intermediate Portuguese is required for the role. Intermediate English is required for the role.

• Competencies: Strong ability to prioritize under tight deadlines and a focus on proactive problem-solving.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Inclusion & Belonging (I&B) Country Partner-China
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Inclusion & Belonging (I&B) Country Partner, you will be a strategic leader responsible for the localized execution and measurable impact of our I&B Strategy. You will partner with senior leaders to translate enterprise standards into meaningful local initiatives, ensuring an inclusive culture is deeply woven into our daily business outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to champion a culture of belonging while holding local leadership accountable for sustainable, inclusive progress.

The Opportunity

• Lead the implementation of the I&B and divisional strategies within your designated country.

• Partner with local senior leaders to strengthen I&B within business units, linking it directly to specific strategic priorities.

• Equip leaders with practical tools and resources to achieve measurable outcomes through tailored KPIs and metrics.

• Provide thought leadership and expertise, ensuring I&B is linked to the local business strategy in areas of greatest impact.

• Diagnose evolving local needs by listening to the organization and developing proactive, localized interventions.

• Serve as an executive coach to senior leaders, building I&B capability and mentoring colleagues across the country.

• Manage resource allocation and prioritization, making strategic trade-offs regarding budget and capacity.

• Embed I&B behaviors into the local organizational culture so they become part of both strategic and daily employee experiences.

Who You Are
You are a visionary leader who understands that inclusion is a driver of culture change and employee engagement. You thrive in international environments and possess the cultural intelligence needed to translate global strategy into local reality.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Influence Strategically: Partner directly with senior division leaders to actively shape their people agenda.

• Mobilize Communities: Activate the organization and drive matrixed resources without needing direct authority.

• Deliver Tangible Impact: Move past the "theory" of I&B and deliver concrete, measurable results that empower the business.

• Extensive Leadership Experience: Over 10 years of experience in I&B or a related field, with a significant focus on leading the agenda at a country level.

• Strategic & Data-Driven Mindset: A proven ability to demonstrate ROI by linking data to business outcomes and using insights to drive recommendations.

• Executive Influence: Outstanding skills in collaborating with and influencing management at all levels, including securing commitment for major initiatives.

• International Acumen: Deep understanding of the cultural, social, and economic dynamics within international markets.

• Change Management Expertise: Experience transforming how an organization relates to I&B and integrating these practices into people processes.

• Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Chinese and English (written and spoken) is required to effectively partner with local and global stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Country Partner di Inclusion & Belonging (I&B) sarai un leader strategico responsabile dell'esecuzione localizzata e dell'impatto misurabile della nostra strategia I&B. Potrai collaborare con i leader senior per tradurre gli standard aziendali in iniziative locali significative, assicurando una cultura inclusiva è profondamente intrecciata nei nostri risultati aziendali giornalieri. Questa è un'occasione unica per sostenere una cultura di appartenenza, mantenendo la leadership locale responsabile per il progresso sostenibile e inclusivo. L'opportunità Mansioni - Guidare l'implementazione delle strategie I&B e divisionali all'interno del vostro paese designato. - Partner con i leader locali senior per rafforzare I&B all'interno di business unit, collegandolo direttamente a specifiche priorità strategiche. - Equip leader con strumenti pratici e risorse per ottenere risultati misurabili attraverso KPI e metriche su misura. - Fornire leadership e competenze di pensiero, assicurando che I&B sia collegato alla strategia aziendale locale in settori di maggior impatto. - Diagnosi delle esigenze locali in evoluzione ascoltando l'organizzazione e sviluppando interventi proattivi e localizzati. - Servire come allenatore esecutivo per i leader senior, la costruzione di capacità I&B e i colleghi di mentoring in tutto il paese. - Gestire l'allocazione delle risorse e la priorità, fare trade-off strategici per quanto riguarda il bilancio e la capacità. - incorporare i comportamenti I&B nella cultura organizzativa locale in modo che diventino parte delle esperienze strategiche e quotidiane dei dipendenti.
• Requisiti - Influenza Strategicamente: Partner direttamente con i leader delle divisioni senior per plasmare attivamente l'agenda del loro popolo. - Mobilitare le Comunità: attivare l'organizzazione e guidare risorse matrici senza bisogno di autorità diretta. - Consegnare l'impatto tangibile: passare oltre la "teoria" di I&B e fornire risultati concreti e misurabili che potenziano il business. - Esperienza di leadership estesa: oltre 10 anni di esperienza in I&B o in un campo correlato, con un focus significativo sul leader dell'agenda a livello di paese. - Strategic & Data-Driven Mindset: una comprovata capacità di dimostrare ROI collegando i dati ai risultati aziendali e utilizzando intuizioni per guidare raccomandazioni. - Influenza esecutiva: competenze straordinarie nella collaborazione e nell'influenza della gestione a tutti i livelli, tra cui garantire l'impegno per importanti iniziative. - Acuma internazionale: profonda comprensione delle dinamiche culturali, sociali ed economiche all'interno dei mercati internazionali. - Change Management Expertise: Esperienza trasformando come un'organizzazione si riferisce a I&B e integrando queste pratiche nei processi delle persone. - Competenze linguistiche: La piena competenza professionale sia in cinese che in inglese (scritta e parlata) è tenuta a collaborare efficacemente con gli stakeholder locali e globali. Chi sei Sei un leader visionario che capisce che l'inclusione è un driver di cambiamento culturale e coinvolgimento dei dipendenti. Tu prosperi in ambienti internazionali e possiedi l'intelligenza culturale necessaria per tradurre la strategia globale nella realtà locale. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter dare vita

descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als Inclusion & Belonging (I&B) Country Partner werden Sie ein strategischer Führer für die ortsansässige Durchführung und messbare Auswirkungen unserer I&B-Strategie sein. Sie werden mit führenden Führungskräften zusammenarbeiten, um Unternehmensstandards in aussagekräftige lokale Initiativen zu übersetzen und sicherzustellen, dass eine inklusive Kultur zutiefst in unsere täglichen Geschäftsergebnisse eingeflossen ist. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, eine Kultur der Zugehörigkeit zu gewinnen, während lokale Führung verantwortlich für nachhaltige, inklusive Fortschritte. Die Chance Mansion - Führen Sie die Umsetzung der I&B- und Teilstrategien in Ihrem bestimmten Land. - Mit lokalen Führungskräften zusammenarbeiten, um die I&B innerhalb von Geschäftsbereichen zu stärken und sie direkt an bestimmte strategische Prioritäten zu knüpfen. - Equip-Führer mit praktischen Werkzeugen und Ressourcen, um messbare Ergebnisse durch maßgeschneiderte Kennzahlen und Kennzahlen zu erzielen. - Bereitstellung von Gedankenführung und Know-how, um sicherzustellen, dass I&B mit der lokalen Geschäftsstrategie in den Bereichen der größten Auswirkungen verknüpft ist. - Die lokalen Bedürfnisse zu diagnostizieren, indem sie der Organisation zuhören und proaktive, lokalisierte Interventionen entwickeln. - Als Executive Coach für leitende Führungskräfte, Aufbau von I&B-Fähigkeit und Mentoring Kollegen im ganzen Land. - Ressourcenzuweisung und Priorisierung verwalten, strategische Abschlüsse in Bezug auf Budget und Kapazität machen. - Embed I&B Verhaltensweisen in die lokale Organisationskultur, so dass sie Teil der strategischen und täglichen Erfahrungen der Mitarbeiter werden. Voraussetzungen - Einfluss Strategisch: Partner direkt mit führenden Divisionsleitern, um die Agenda ihrer Menschen aktiv zu gestalten. - Mobilisieren Sie Gemeinschaften: Aktivieren Sie die Organisation und treiben Sie Matrixressourcen ohne direkte Autorität. - Deliver Tangible Impact: Verlassen Sie die "Theorie" der I&B und liefern konkrete, messbare Ergebnisse, die das Unternehmen befähigen. - Umfangreiche Leadership-Erfahrung: Über 10 Jahre Erfahrung in I&B oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit einem erheblichen Schwerpunkt auf der Führung der Agenda auf Länderebene. - Strategic & Data-Driven Mindset: Eine bewährte Fähigkeit, ROI zu demonstrieren, indem Daten zu Geschäftsergebnissen verknüpft werden und Erkenntnisse verwendet werden, um Empfehlungen zu steuern. - Executive Influence: Herausragende Fähigkeiten bei der Zusammenarbeit mit und Einflussnahme von Management auf allen Ebenen, einschließlich der Sicherung von Engagement für große Initiativen. - International Acumen: Ein tiefes Verständnis der kulturellen, sozialen und wirtschaftlichen Dynamik in internationalen Märkten. - Change Management Expertise: Erfahren Sie, wie sich eine Organisation auf I&B bezieht und diese Praktiken in Menschenprozesse integriert. - Sprachkompetenzen: Vollständige berufliche Kompetenz in Chinesisch und Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) ist erforderlich, um effektiv mit lokalen und globalen Interessenvertretern zusammenzuarbeiten. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein visionärer Führer, der versteht, dass die Einbeziehung ein Treiber des Kulturwandels und der Mitarbeiterbindung ist. Sie leben in internationalen Umgebungen und besitzen die kulturelle Intelligenz, die benötigt wird, um die globale Strategie in die lokale Realität umzusetzen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir das Leben retten können
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que partenaire de pays d'inclusion et d'appartenance, vous serez un chef de file stratégique responsable de l'exécution localisée et de l'impact mesurable de notre stratégie d'intégration et d'appartenance. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des cadres supérieurs pour traduire les normes d'entreprise en initiatives locales significatives, en veillant à ce qu'une culture inclusive soit profondément ancrée dans nos résultats opérationnels quotidiens. C'est une occasion unique de défendre une culture d'appartenance tout en tenant les dirigeants locaux responsables des progrès durables et inclusifs. L'opportunité Mansioni - Diriger la mise en oeuvre des stratégies d'EI et de division dans votre pays désigné. - Établir des partenariats avec les cadres supérieurs locaux afin de renforcer les I&B au sein des unités opérationnelles, en les reliant directement à des priorités stratégiques précises. - Équiper les dirigeants d'outils et de ressources pratiques pour obtenir des résultats mesurables au moyen d'ICP et de mesures adaptées. - Assurer le leadership et l'expertise de la pensée, en veillant à ce que la D&E soit liée à la stratégie d'affaires locale dans les domaines les plus importants. - Diagnostiquer l'évolution des besoins locaux en écoutant l'organisation et en développant des interventions proactives et localisées. - Servir d'entraîneur pour les cadres supérieurs, renforcer les capacités en matière d'I et B et de mentorat de collègues partout au pays. - Gérer l'allocation des ressources et la hiérarchisation des priorités, en faisant des compromis stratégiques concernant le budget et la capacité. - Intégrer les comportements d'I & B dans la culture organisationnelle locale afin qu'ils fassent partie des expériences stratégiques et quotidiennes des employés.
• Requisiti - Influence Stratégique : S'associer directement avec les chefs de division pour façonner activement leur programme de travail. - Mobiliser les communautés : activer l'organisation et générer des ressources matricielles sans avoir besoin d'autorité directe. - Produire un impact tangible : dépasser la « théorie » d'I&B et produire des résultats concrets et mesurables qui responsabilisent l'entreprise. - Expérience de leadership étendue : Plus de 10 ans d'expérience en I&B ou dans un domaine connexe, l'accent étant mis sur la direction du programme au niveau national. - Strategic & Data-Driven Mindset: Une capacité éprouvée de démontrer le ROI en reliant les données aux résultats opérationnels et en utilisant des idées pour formuler des recommandations. - Influence de la direction : Compétences exceptionnelles dans la collaboration et l'influence de la direction à tous les niveaux, y compris l'engagement pour les grandes initiatives. - L'Acumen international : Compréhension approfondie de la dynamique culturelle, sociale et économique sur les marchés internationaux. - Expertise en gestion du changement : Expérience de la transformation de la relation d'une organisation avec les E et B et de l'intégration de ces pratiques dans les processus des personnes. - Compétences linguistiques : Une compétence professionnelle complète en chinois et en anglais (écrit et parlé) est nécessaire pour établir un partenariat efficace avec les parties prenantes locales et mondiales. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader visionnaire qui comprend que l'inclusion est un moteur du changement culturel et de l'engagement des employés. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements internationaux et possédez l'intelligence culturelle nécessaire pour traduire la stratégie mondiale en réalité locale. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin de pouvoir vivre

The Position
Dein neues Team
Du verstärkst unseren Bereich Vertrieb Service in der Region Augsburg/Landsberg a. Lech. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg:innen aus dem Verkauf und anderen Vertriebseinheiten verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine langfristige Kundenbindung sicherzustellen und den Verkauf unserer Roche-Systeme aktiv zu unterstützen. Dabei verantworten wir den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice unter anderem für Analysensysteme und Reagenzien der Molekularen/Gewebediagnostik und IT-Lösungen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Junior Systembetreuer (m/w/d) bist du das Gesicht von Roche vor Ort. Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit unserer Roche-Standardgeräte sicher und trägst so maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben erledigst du sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team:

• Du führst fachgerechte technische Fehlerdiagnosen durch und reparierst Roche-Standardgeräte – meist vor Ort beim Kunden, teilweise auch per Remote-Support. Dabei übernimmst du auch die sorgfältige Dokumentation im CRM-System, um nachhaltige Problemlösungen sicherzustellen und die Fakturierung.

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Installation neuer Systeme, führst Testläufe durch und übergibst die Geräte betriebsbereit an den Kunden.

• Du erledigst Wartungen und Modifikationen termingerecht und unter Berücksichtigung wirtschaftlicher Aspekte, basierend auf Serviceverträgen oder Einzelaufträgen.

• Als technischer Ansprechpartner vor Ort erkennst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden frühzeitig. Du weist Kunden technisch ein, berätst zu Serviceverträgen oder präventiven Maßnahmen und arbeitest eng mit dem Vertrieb zusammen, um Verkaufschancen für Systemgeschäfte oder Dienstleistungen zu identifizieren.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT GRC Expert - RDT Quality, Risk & Compliance

As an IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Quality, Risk & Compliance you design and implement comprehensive IT resilience, risk management, and compliance strategies aligned with business objectives. You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions.

The Opportunity:

• You will develop and refine enterprise-wide risk management, compliance, and continuity strategies to enhance our global recovery plans.

• Lead the response to critical IT risk, audit, and continuity events while establishing global best practices for handling disruptions.

• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.

• Manage high-level stakeholder relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to align risk policies with evolving business needs.

• Provide strategic insights based on industry best practices to ensure our compliance frameworks remain world-class.

• Oversee the scalability of IT resilience solutions, integrating complex policies with existing enterprise systems.

• Evaluate and select advanced tools for enterprise management to future-proof our technical resilience landscape.

• Facilitate advanced training sessions for cross-functional teams on BCM best practices and advanced problem-solving techniques.

Who you are:

• You possess extensive experience in architecting enterprise-wide IT resilience and risk management strategies at a strategic level.

• Expert in Life Sciences regulations, including GxP, SOX, and HIPAA, with a deep understanding of computer systems validation (CSV).

• Highly knowledgeable in IT General Controls (ITGC) and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, and DORA.

• Technically proficient in AWS and Azure environments, specifically regarding shared responsibility models and cloud-native DR orchestration.

• Proven ability to establish governance guardrails for emerging technologies like Generative AI, RPA, and SaaS.

• Skilled in secure SDLC and DevOps stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) with the ability to implement Compliance-as-Code.

• Holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or Cybersecurity, and at least one active credential: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 22301.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Posizione IT GRC Expert - Qualità RDT, Rischio e conformità In qualità di IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Qualità, Risk & Compliance progetta e implementa una resilienza IT completa, gestione del rischio e strategie di conformità allineate agli obiettivi aziendali. Conduci valutazioni di rischio complesse, sviluppi programmi di audit e continuità raffinati, e stabilisci le migliori pratiche per gestire le interruzioni critiche e la conformità alle normative. Facendo da consulente esperto per gli stakeholder di alto livello, si guidano le risposte agli incidenti critici e assicurano la scalabilità e la protezione futura delle soluzioni di rischio e continuità a livello aziendale. Opportunità - svilupperai e raffinerai strategie di gestione, conformità e continuità a livello aziendale per migliorare i nostri piani di recupero globale. - Guidare la risposta agli eventi critici relativi al rischio IT, all'audit e alla continuità, stabilendo le migliori pratiche globali per la gestione delle interruzioni. - Condurre revisioni post-incidenti e "deep-dives" per identificare guasti sistemici e implementare quadri di miglioramento continuo. - Gestire relazioni di stakeholder di alto livello, agendo come consulente strategico per allineare le politiche di rischio con le esigenze aziendali in evoluzione. - Fornire informazioni strategiche basate sulle best practice del settore per garantire che i nostri quadri di conformità rimangano di livello mondiale. - supervisionare la scalabilità delle soluzioni di resilienza IT, integrando politiche complesse con sistemi enterprise esistenti. - Valutare e selezionare strumenti avanzati per la gestione aziendale a prova di futuro il nostro paesaggio di resilienza tecnica. - Facilitare sessioni di formazione avanzate per team interfunzionali sulle best practice BCM e tecniche avanzate di problem solving. Chi sei? - Possiedi un'ampia esperienza nell'archiviare le strategie di resilienza IT a livello aziendale e di gestione dei rischi a livello strategico. - Esperto nelle normative Life Sciences, tra cui GxP, SOX e HIPAA, con una profonda comprensione della convalida dei sistemi informatici (CSV). - Altamente conoscibile in IT General Controls (ITGC) e strutture come SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, e DORA. - Tecnicamente competente in ambienti AWS e Azure, in particolare per quanto riguarda i modelli di responsabilità condivisa e l'orchestrazione DR nativo cloud. - Prove capacità di stabilire guardrails di governance per le tecnologie emergenti come AI Generativo, RPA e SaaS. - Compliance-as-Code. - Titolare di un Bachelor o Master in IT o Cybersecurity, e almeno una credenziale attiva: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, o ISO 22301. Cosa? - Campo d'insalatura 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale basato sulle tue prestazioni. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo). - Prendere Tempo per la Carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta). - Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport. - Aggiunti di acquisto azionario. - Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e automobili e molti altri! The Position IT GRC Expert - RDT Quality, Risk & Compliance As an IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Quality, Risk & Compliance you design and implement comprehensive IT resilience, risk management, and compliance strategies aligned with business objectives. You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions. The Opportunity:
• You will develop and refine enterprise-wide risk management, compliance, and continuity strategies to enhance our global recovery plans.
• Lead the response to critical IT risk, audit, and continuity events while establishing global best practices for handling disruptions.
• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.
• Manage high-level stakeholder relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to align risk policies with evolving business needs.
• Provide strategic insights based on industry best practices to ensure our compliance frameworks remain world-class.
• Oversee the scalability of IT resilience solutions, integrating complex policies with existing enterprise systems.
• Evaluate and select advanced tools for enterprise management to future-proof our technical resilience landscape.
• Facilitate advanced training sessions for cross-functional teams on BCM best practices and advanced problem-solving techniques. Who you are:
• You possess extensive experience in architecting enterprise-wide IT resilience and risk management strategies at a strategic level.
• Expert in Life Sciences regulations, including GxP, SOX, and HIPAA, with a deep understanding of computer systems validation (CSV).
• Highly knowledgeable in IT General Controls (ITGC) and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, and DORA.
• Technically proficient in AWS and Azure environments, specifically regarding shared responsibility models and cloud-native DR orchestration.
• Proven ability to establish governance guardrails for emerging technologies like Generative AI, RPA, and SaaS.
• Skilled in secure SDLC and DevOps stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) with the ability to implement Compliance-as-Code.
• Holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or Cybersecurity, and at least one active credential: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 22301. What you get:
• Salary range 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross based on the employment contract.
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.
• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).
• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).
• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).
• Vacation subsidy available.
• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).
• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).
• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.
• Stock share purchase additions.
• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more! Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare. If you feel this off

Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Posizione Expert en TI GRC - RDT Qualité, risque et conformité En tant qu'expert en TI GRC (Gouvernance, Risque et Conformité) - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Qualité, Risque et Conformité, vous concevez et implémentez des stratégies complètes de résilience, de gestion des risques et de conformité conformes aux objectifs opérationnels. Vous dirigez des évaluations des risques complexes, élaborez des programmes de vérification et de continuité améliorés et établissez des pratiques exemplaires pour gérer les perturbations critiques et la conformité réglementaire. En tant que conseiller expert auprès des intervenants de haut niveau, vous dirigez les interventions en cas d'incident critique et vous assurez l'évolutivité et la protection future des solutions de risque et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Annexe - Vous développerez et affinerez des stratégies de gestion des risques, de conformité et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise afin d'améliorer nos plans de redressement mondiaux. - Diriger la réponse aux risques critiques liés aux TI, à la vérification et à la continuité tout en établissant les meilleures pratiques mondiales pour gérer les perturbations. - Procéder à des examens post-incident et à des « directives profondes » pour déceler les défaillances systémiques et mettre en place des cadres d'amélioration continue. - Gérer les relations de haut niveau avec les intervenants, agir à titre de conseiller stratégique pour harmoniser les politiques sur les risques avec l'évolution des besoins opérationnels. - Fournir des renseignements stratégiques fondés sur les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie pour s'assurer que nos cadres de conformité demeurent de calibre mondial. - Surveiller l'évolutivité des solutions de résilience informatique, en intégrant des politiques complexes aux systèmes d'entreprise existants. - Évaluer et sélectionner des outils avancés pour la gestion d'entreprise pour mettre à l'épreuve notre paysage de résilience technique. - Faciliter les séances de formation avancée à l'intention des équipes interfonctionnelles sur les meilleures pratiques de la BCM et les techniques avancées de résolution de problèmes. Les - Vous possédez une vaste expérience dans l'architecture de stratégies de résilience informatique et de gestion des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise au niveau stratégique. - Expert en sciences de la vie, y compris GxP, SOX et HIPAA, avec une compréhension approfondie de la validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV). - Haute connaissance des contrôles généraux des TI (ITGC) et des cadres tels que SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2 et DORA. - Techniquement compétent dans les environnements AWS et Azure, en particulier en ce qui concerne les modèles de responsabilité partagée et l'orchestration de RD native en nuage. - Capacité éprouvée d'établir des garde-corps de gouvernance pour les technologies émergentes telles que Generative AI, RPA et SaaS. - Compétence dans les piles SDLC et DevOps sécurisées (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) avec la capacité de mettre en œuvre la conformité comme code. - Titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique ou cybersécurité, et au moins un titre actif : CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP ou ISO 22301.
• Cosa offriamo - Barème des salaires 19 000 - 35 400 PLN g ross sur la base du contrat de travail. - Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance. - Budget dédié à la formation (formation, certifications, conférences, parcours professionnels diversifiés, etc.). - Recharger les vendredis (2 vendredis par trimestre disponible). - Prendre du temps Programme (jusqu'à 3 mois de congé à utiliser à n'importe quelle fin). - Allocation de vacances disponible. - Flex Location (possibilité d'effectuer notre travail à partir de différents endroits du monde pour une certaine période de temps). - Prenez du temps pour l'organisme de bienfaisance (un congé payé supplémentaire de 2 semaines maximum pour participer à l'action de bienfaisance de votre choix). - Soins de santé privés (paquets LuxMed), assurance-vie collective (UNUM) et multisports. - Ajouts d'actions. - Ventes annuelles d'ordinateurs portables et de voitures d'entreprise et beaucoup plus! Contatto Appliquer directement et nous rejoindre pour façonner l'avenir des soins de santé. Si vous sentez ça

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

你需要具备哪些条件才能加大申请这个岗位的竞争力呢？
岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Data & Insights Enablement - Lead Analyst (UI/UX)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data & Insights Enablement - Lead Analyst (UI/UX)
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai / Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in India to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

As a Data & Insights Enablement - Lead Analyst (UI/UX), you will work closely with product teams and other stakeholders to design and improve dashboards and digital experiences. Your role will focus on understanding user needs, shaping features, and testing designs to ensure they are intuitive, useful, and deliver a smooth user experience.

Your Opportunity

• Identify and frame user-centered problems effectively

• Create wireframes and mock-ups to visualize concepts and facilitate usability testing with end users

• Collaborate with product, analytics, and technology teams throughout planning, design, and development to ensure design intent is met

• Work closely within the stakeholder teams to uphold quality standards for UI/UX design

• Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders, gather feedback, and incorporate it into iterations

• Conduct 'Data Discovery' sessions to understand what questions users are trying to answer before beginning the design phase. Define and maintain a 'Dashboard Design System' (components, color tokens, typography) to ensure a consistent look and feel across all analytics products

Behaviours & Abilities Required

• Design simple, effective, and elegant interactions between users and products

• Create strong problem statements and metrics to ensure design solutions are achieving the right business and user outcomes

• Forge strong relationships and work collaboratively with a multi-disciplinary team

Nice To Have

• Provide sound rationale for recommendations to gain support and commitment

• Manage ambiguity, change and uncertainty effectively, making timely decisions to keep work moving forward

• Adapt to dynamic business needs with flexibility and willingness to contribute across tasks

• Prior exposure to healthcare, clinical terminologies, therapeutic areas.

Who are you

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field with 7 plus years of experience in UI and UX design with a strong focus on dashboards and data products

• Candidates from Computer Science or Engineering backgrounds with strong UX design experience are also welcome

• Strong portfolio demonstrating UX thinking and problem solving is required

• Experience designing internal tools and external web applications for data driven use cases

• Strong ability to simplify complex data into clear and intuitive user experiences

• Hands on experience with Tableau and a strong understanding of data visualization best practices

• Experience working closely with product, analytics, and engineering teams to define requirements and design solutions

• Ability to design for different user groups such as analysts

Il tuo ruolo si concentrerà sulla comprensione delle esigenze degli utenti, la modellazione delle funzionalità e i progetti di test per garantire che siano intuitivi, utili e forniscono un'esperienza utente fluida. Mansioni - Identificare e inquadrare i problemi incentrati sull'utente in modo efficace - Creare wireframe e mock-up per visualizzare i concetti e facilitare il test di usabilità con gli utenti finali - Collaborare con i team di prodotti, analisi e tecnologia durante la pianificazione, progettazione e sviluppo per garantire l'intento di progettazione - Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team delle parti interessate per rispettare gli standard di qualità per il design UI/UX - Concetti di design attuali e razionalità per gli stakeholder, raccogliere feedback e incorporarlo in iterazioni - Condurre sessioni 'Data Discovery' per capire quali domande gli utenti stanno cercando di rispondere prima di iniziare la fase di progettazione. Definire e mantenere un 'Dashboard Design System' (componenti, token di colore, tipografia) per garantire un look coerente e sentire in tutti i prodotti di analisi Comportamenti e abilità necessarie - Progettare interazioni semplici, efficaci ed eleganti tra utenti e prodotti - Creare forti dichiarazioni di problemi e metriche per garantire soluzioni di progettazione stanno raggiungendo i giusti risultati aziendali e degli utenti - Forge relazioni forti e lavorare in collaborazione con un team multidisciplinare Bello da avere - Fornire una solida motivazione per le raccomandazioni per ottenere sostegno e impegno - Gestire efficacemente l'ambiguità, il cambiamento e l'incertezza, prendere decisioni tempestive per continuare a lavorare - Adapt alle esigenze aziendali dinamiche con flessibilità e disponibilità a contribuire attraverso i compiti - Prima esposizione alla salute, terminologie cliniche, aree terapeutiche. Chi sei - Hai una laurea in Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Comunicazione visiva, o un campo correlato con 7 anni di esperienza nel design UI e UX con una forte attenzione su dashboard e prodotti di dati - I candidati da Computer Science o Ingegneria sfondi con forte esperienza di progettazione UX sono anche benvenuti - È richiesto un portafoglio forte che dimostra il pensiero UX e la risoluzione dei problemi - Esperienza nella progettazione di strumenti interni e applicazioni web esterne per i casi di utilizzo - Forte capacità di semplificare i dati complessi in esperienze utente chiare e intuitive - Mani sull'esperienza con Tableau e una forte comprensione delle best practice di visualizzazione dei dati - Esperienza di lavoro a stretto contatto con i team di prodotti, analisi e ingegneria per definire i requisiti e le soluzioni di progettazione - Capacità di progettare per diversi gruppi di utenti come analisti

Tous les employés de Roche doivent contribuer efficacement à la collaboration et à la coordination interfonctionnelles et se conformer à toutes les lois, règlements, politiques et procédures qui régissent notre entreprise. En tant qu'analyste principal (UI/UX), vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de produits et d'autres intervenants pour concevoir et améliorer les tableaux de bord et les expériences numériques. Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, de façonner les fonctionnalités et de tester les conceptions pour s'assurer qu'elles sont intuitives, utiles et qu'elles offrent une expérience utilisateur harmonieuse. Qui êtes-vous ? - Vous avez un baccalauréat en design, interaction informatique humaine, conception d'interaction, communication visuelle, ou un domaine connexe avec 7 ans d'expérience en UI et UX design avec un accent fort sur les tableaux de bord et les produits de données - Les candidats issus de l'informatique ou de l'ingénierie avec une solide expérience de conception UX sont également les bienvenus - Un portefeuille solide démontrant la pensée UX et la résolution de problèmes est nécessaire - Expérience de la conception d'outils internes et d'applications Web externes pour les cas d'utilisation axés sur les données - Forte capacité à simplifier les données complexes en des expériences utilisateur claires et intuitives - Mise en pratique de l'expérience de Tableau et compréhension des meilleures pratiques de visualisation des données - Expérience en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de produits, d'analyse et d'ingénierie pour définir les exigences et les solutions de conception - Capacité de concevoir pour différents groupes d'utilisateurs comme les analystes
