jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein neues Team
Als Mitglied des PDG Country Study Start-Up Teams liegt dein Hauptaugenmerk darauf, einen reibungslosen und hocheffizienten Studienstart sicherzustellen, um so die Bereitstellung klinischer Studien für Patient:innen zu unterstützen. Du bringst klinische Studien innovativ auf den Weg: Du deckst den spezifischen Bedarf in der Start-up-Phase über verschiedene Therapiegebiete hinweg und garantierst einen reibungslosen Ablauf für Patient:innen und Prüfzentren. In dieser Schlüsselrolle vernetzt du dich intensiv mit lokalen und globalen Teams sowie unseren CRO Partnern (Auftragsforschungsinstituten).

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle konzentrierst du dich auf die effiziente und rechtskonforme Initiierung von Roche-gesponserten klinischen Studien. Du entwickelst effektive Start-up-Strategien, steuerst die operativen Abläufe und treibst Prozessverbesserungen auf Länder- und Zentren-Ebene voran – immer unter Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben.Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

• Strategische Leitung: Du leitest Teams bei der strategischen Planung der operativen Durchführung des Studienstarts, wobei Du die Verantwortung für Risikomanagement, regulatorische Compliance sowie die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit externen Stakeholdern trägst.

• Operative Exzellenz: Du managst die Start-up-Aktivitäten und stellst eine termingerechte Aktivierung der Prüfzentren sowie die regulatorische Compliance sicher. Du verantwortest und steuerst den gesamten Budget- und Vertragsprozess – von der Erstellung der Budgets über die Vertragsverhandlung und Versicherungsdokumente bis hin zur systemseitigen Datenpflege, um die finanzielle und rechtliche Konformität sowie eine präzise Planung zu gewährleisten.

• Globale Ausrichtung: Du arbeitest mit dem globalen Studienteam zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Zeitpläne eingehalten werden und managst Amendments über den gesamten Studienzyklus hinweg.

• Innovation & Standardisierung: Du identifizierst Chancen zur Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung und arbeitest mit regionalen sowie globalen Partnern zusammen, um Systeme zu harmonisieren und Zeitpläne zu optimieren.

• Behördenkommunikation: Du stehst im Austausch mit Behörden und Institutionen (z. B. Ethikkommissionen und Gesundheitsbehörden), um Richtlinien und Praktiken bei klinischen Studien aufeinander abzustimmen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Für die Rolle als Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) (m/w/d) bringst du ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (MD, PhD, Master oder Bachelor) in den Life Sciences oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Ein weiterführender Hochschulabschluss (Postgraduate/Master) ist dabei sehr wünschenswert. Folgende Punkte runden dein Profil ab:

• Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung im Start-up von klinischen Studien, in regulatorischen Einreichungsprozessen sowie in der cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit.

• Fachwissen: Du besitzt ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis der ICH-GCP-Leitlinien, der EU-CTR sowie der lokalen regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen und hast bereits Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Dienstleistern und CROs gesammelt.

• Methoden & IT: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit klinischen Systemen (z. B. Veeva Vault, CTIS, RIM) und zeichnest dich durch starke organisatorische, analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten aus.

• Mindset: Du bringst eine kollaborative und adaptive Denkweise mit. Es gelingt dir, auch in komplexen, matrixorganisierten und globalen Teams den Überblick zu be

jobs.title: Project Manager - Strategic Operations
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, we believe that project management is about being the operational backbone of innovation. As a Global Project Manager (GPM), you will be a catalyst for redefining how we deliver impactful diagnostic solutions. We are evolving this role into a strategic orchestration function, where the focus is on enabling value, ensuring end-to-end traceability, and driving operational excellence at a systemic level.
We are looking for operational architects who can challenge the status quo. By taking ownership of the links between strategy and execution, connecting cross-functional teams, and building a "single source of truth," you will help elevate the GPM role into a servant-leader position that ensures teams have the space and focus required to innovate.

Your Challenges
Your mission is to move beyond traditional task-tracking and actively shape the operational health of our global portfolios. Key challenges include:

• Operational Orchestration: Act as a strategic partner ensuring vertical traceability—ensuring that high-level goals are clearly connected to execution units to enable autonomous, high-quality decisions.

• Systemic Flow & Friction Reduction: Proactively identify and resolve structural bottlenecks. You will act as a servant-leader, absorbing operational overhead and administrative friction to protect the core delivery teams.

• Single Source of Truth: Guarantee reliable, consolidated data for tracking investments, capacity, and risks. You will move the organization toward predictive steering rather than reactive reporting.

• Integrated Operating Excellence: Drive the organic adoption of standardized frameworks (Quality, Regulatory, and Methodology) into daily workflows, ensuring compliance is "built-in" rather than an after-the-fact exercise.

• Cross-Domain Connectivity: Facilitate high-level Risk and Opportunity management (ROMA) and coordinate critical integration points between different lifecycles to ensure organizational coherence.

​ Who You Are
We need systems-thinkers who are obsessed with efficiency and data integrity.

• Experience: 3+ years leading complex operational frameworks or portfolios in Biotech/Tech. You are comfortable navigating highly regulated environments.

• Expertise: Mastery of the "Ops Stack" (JIRA, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Aha!) and modern frameworks (SAFe, Lean, or Systems Thinking).

• Strategic Impact: Proven ability to translate complex strategy into clear operational execution plans.

• Mindset: A fierce advocate for team autonomy who views "operations" as a product that needs to be optimized for the user.

Are you a Project Manager who is tired of chasing status updates? Do you believe that the best leaders don't just "check boxes"—they build the systems that make work flow?

At Roche Diagnostics, we are transforming the Global Project Manager role. We are moving away from administrative reporting and toward Operational Intelligence. We are looking for the "Engineers of Value"—people who can connect the dots between high-level strategy and the technical teams delivering life-saving solutions.
In this role, you will be the "Operational Pilot" for our most critical Lifecycles:

• You will build the Single Source of Truth: No more fragmented data. You will ensure that strategy and execution are perfectly aligned in our tools and our minds.

• You will kill friction: Your job is to shield teams from bureaucracy. If there is a bottleneck in the

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns bewegt, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft ständig voran und sorgen dafür, dass alle Menschen heute und in Zukunft Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben, die sie brauchen. Eine Welt zu schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das ist es, was uns zu Roche macht.

In der R&D-Abteilung Process Technologies and Material Science (Teil von Roche Diagnostics Solutions) entwickeln wir chemische Einsatzstoffe für das gesamte diagnostische Produktportfolio. Das Team Bioorganic Development & Transfer besteht aus 8 Mitarbeitenden mit wissenschaftlichem und technischem Hintergrund. Wir arbeiten an organisch-chemischen Synthesen und Up-scale Projekten und gehen dabei flexibel und zielorientiert vor, um maßgeschneiderte Moleküle für unsere Projektpartner zu entwickeln. Dabei legen wir Wert auf eine hohe Qualität und den Spaß an der gemeinsamen Arbeit.

Deine zentralen Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle bringst Du Deine fundierte Labor-Expertise direkt in die Entwicklung innovativer Diagnostika ein:

• Synthese & Herstellung: Du planst und führst eigenständig organisch-präparative Synthesen im Bereich niedermolekularer Verbindungen und deren funktionellen Bausteinen durch

• Up-Scale Arbeiten: Darüber hinaus bist Du für die Maßstabsvergrößerung chemischer Reaktionen vom Milligramm- bis in den Multigramm-Bereich verantwortlich

• Chromatographie & Downstream Prozesse: Du bringst Deine Expertise in die Aufreinigung komplexer Reaktionsmischungen ein (z. B. Flash-Chromatographie, HPLC) und optimierst Downstream-Prozesse

• Charakterisierung : Du isolierst die Zielverbindungen und nutzt moderne analytische Methoden (z. B. NMR, MS, HPLC/UV) zur Strukturaufklärung und In-Prozess-Kontrolle

• Prozessoptimierung & Transfer: Du optimierst etablierte Syntheseprozesse, um einen reibungslosen Transfer in die Produktion vorzubereiten und erstellst die entsprechenden Verfahrensanweisungen

• Dokumentation & Innovation: Du dokumentierst Deine Ergebnisse präzise, präsentierst diese im Team und setzt Dein Spezialwissen ein, um Projekte innerhalb von Roche Diagnostics voranzutreiben

Dein Profil

• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Chemie (Bachelor) mit Schwerpunkt Organische Chemie oder eine Ausbildung zum Chemielaborant mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Darüber hinaus bringst Du tiefgreifende Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung in der klassischen präparativen organischen Synthese mit

• Auf Dein fundiertes Know-how in der präparativen Chromatographie sowie auf Deine Erfahrung beim Up-scale von chemischen Prozessen können wir uns voll und ganz verlassen

• Ein sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Charakterisierungsmethoden (NMR, MS, HPLC) zeichnet Dich aus

• Du hast Freude an der Lösung komplexer chemischer Fragestellungen und am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Team

• Zuverlässigkeit, Gewissenhaftigkeit und eine strukturierte Vorgehensweise sind für Dich selbstverständlich

• Außerdem bist Du ein Teamplayer mit sicherem Kommunikationsstil in Deutsch und Englisch

Diese Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir machen es Dir leicht: Bitte lade lediglich Deinen aktuellen, aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf sowie das Zeugnis Deines höchsten Abschlusses hoch.
Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Experience Operations is focused on delivering professional IT support for our Roche affiliates in the EMEA region and globally as well in cooperation with our service centers in Costa Rica and Malaysia. Our teams consist of English, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish and French speaking Service Desk Specialists from beginners to highly skilled professionals.

Disclosure Note: The final job title is Employee Experience Operations IT Specialist.

The Opportunity

• Provide first-level support for software and hardware incidents and service requests across Mac, Windows, Microsoft Office, and Google environments.

• Engage with users across multiple channels, including phone, chat, and self-service portal.

• Thrive as a key member of a truly AI-powered IT support operations team.

• Champion the end-users' needs, escalating critical situations as required to ensure swift resolution.

• Keep users updated on their request status, guiding them toward the best solutions for their productivity and satisfaction.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University education in IT or related discipline is preferred

• 1.5 - 2 years of experience in call center, service desk, or IT desk-side support

• Experience with Apple and Microsoft operating systems, Google suite, Microsoft Office products, SAP, corporate networks, and video conferencing systems

• Strong troubleshooting, task prioritization, and problem-solving skills

• Fluency in German and English

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

​ Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que Key Account Manager Comptes Publics et rattaché(e) au SubChapter Lead Key Account Manager, vous intégrez une équipe dynamique et êtes Expert(e) des comptes stratégiques.

Vous êtes la voix des clients et représentez Roche auprès de ces derniers. A ce titre, vous avez une compréhension parfaite de la cartographie des interlocuteurs et de la matrice décisionnelle des comptes, de l'environnement, des enjeux et visions stratégiques des clients. Vous avez également une vue précise du positionnement compétitif de Roche vis à vis de ces enjeux, ce qui vous permet de définir et porter la responsabilité de la stratégie commerciale et financière des comptes - existant(s) ou futur(s). Enfin, vous définissez la stratégie de négociation et la mettez en œuvre

Localisation idéale : région Parisienne

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous déterminez la stratégie Roche Diagnostics France à déployer pour les grands comptes publics sous votre responsabilité, en identifiant les leviers soutenant le développement d’un partenariat solide et capable de générer de la valeur pour toutes les parties.

• A toutes les étapes de la relation commerciale, vous identifiez et saisissez les différentes opportunités au sein des comptes pour contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs stratégiques de Roche; en collaboration avec les experts internes, notamment les équipes commerciales, vous co-designez et proposez les solutions Roche adaptées aux besoins des clients et différenciantes. Vous êtes responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs business, de l'évolution du chiffre d'affaires et de la profitabilité des comptes.

• En étroite collaboration avec le chef de projet Appels d'Offres, vous coordonnez l’équipe projet engagée autour de la construction de la réponse et vous vous assurez que celle ci permettra l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et financier attendus; Vous vous assurez également de la bonne contractualisation en adéquation avec les règles du groupe et de la filiale.

• Responsable de la bonne exécution des marchés notifiés et de la satisfaction du client, vous mettez en place et suivez les indicateurs de performance pertinents pour les comptes sous votre responsabilité et engagez les équipes sur l’amélioration continue des actions; Vous êtes garant(e) de la pertinence et de l'efficacité du schéma de communication au sein des comptes.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Assistant (1 year contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
To provide essential administrative and operational support to the supply chain and logistics team. This role focuses on executing day-to-day routine tasks, including sales order data entry, basic inventory monitoring, and assisting with shipment follow-ups, to ensure the overall supply chain workflow operates smoothly.

Responsibility & Accountability

• Responsible for sales order intake and planning of delivery schedules to ensure timely delivery and commitment to customers' requests.

• Perform accurate data entry for customer orders into the SAP system.

• Maintain good after-sales service and customer engagement.

• Coordinate with 3PL to ensure that inbound shipments are received and stored on time and achieve the KPI target.

• Follow up and communicate with the global headquarters on shipment and delivery statuses.

• Handle export China shipments under the guidance of senior team members.

• Assist in the inventory movement and monitoring process.

• Assist the team in preparing timely reports on all aspects of the Supply Chain.

• Assist in manipulating SAP data for analysis purposes.

• Assist the team to streamline process flows or practices to improve efficiency by learning and exploring new technology.

• Collaborate with different internal and external stakeholders in various projects.

Requirements:
Education:

• HKDSE (Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education), Form 5/Form 7 graduate, or a Diploma/Certificate in Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:
0–2 years of working experience in customer service, data entry, or clerical support.

• Fresh graduates with a positive learning attitude are highly welcome.

• Previous experience with SAP or similar ERP systems is an advantage but not strictly required.

Competency:

• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on data entry accuracy.

• Proficient in MS Office applications (Word, Excel) and Chinese word processing.

• Good basic command of written and spoken English and Mandarin.

• Patient, responsible, and a strong team player able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Proficient in MS Office applications (Word, Excel) and Chinese word processing.
• Good basic command of written and spoken English and Mandarin.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Global Alliance Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Corporate Business Development (CBD) is dedicated to sourcing innovation outside of the Company by identifying compounds that fit into our pipeline, looking for technologies that can be integrated into our drug discovery process and diagnostics, establishing connections with academic institutions and other life sciences companies and entering into and managing collaborations. Together with R&D this is a key pillar of the Pharma business and our aim is to transform promising innovation into healthcare solutions of the future. Our approach to partnering is open and flexible. We aim to accelerate innovation in China by helping our partners expand their impact on patient health through joint development and delivery of novel therapies; the Global Alliance Management function within Roche is leading all strategic partnerships across the globe and we are proud to be recognized amongst the best in the industry.
We are looking for a Global Alliance Director (GAD) to join our Global Alliance Management team in Shanghai. You shall have the responsibility of managing a portfolio of China based alliances while closely interfacing with Alliance Directors in Basel and San Francisco. You will interact with senior leadership of partner companies and actively liaise with Asia Partnering as well as other Roche functions including PD, GPS, pRED, gRED, CiCor and Dia Partnering. The incumbent for the role shall be strongly connected to the China ecosystem including biotech companies and VCs and act as a facilitator and catalyst for our efforts and partnerships in China. This role will report to Beth Odeh-Frikert and is based in Shanghai.

Your responsibilities shall include:

• Successfully lead and manage a portfolio of China-based alliances.

• Establish and nurture strong, trust-based relationships with Chinese partners to align expectations, anticipate challenges, and effectively resolve operational issues as they arise. Drive alliance governance and operational processes, proactively identify and address key risks and issues, and lead by influence across cross-functional teams. Ensure adherence to contractual obligations and proactively manage conflicts and escalations in the best interest of the alliance.

• Partner closely with Basel and SSF based Global Alliance Directors (GADs) to support their alliance portfolios with Chinese partners. Act as an internal advisor and facilitator for Basel/SSF-led alliances and provide local context to help the global GADs navigate language, cultural nuances and business etiquette.

• Act as a center of expertise for China partnerships and systematically share local market insights, regulatory knowledge and relationship best practices to empower and upskill global GADs in Basel and SSF.

• Actively build and sustain high-value relationships within the Chinese biotech and VC ecosystems to drive collaborative initiatives and identify scalable partnership opportunities

• Identify, lead negotiations and implement necessary contractual amendments, and/or subsequent agreements in coordination with BD, Finance, Legal and all relevant internal stakeholders

• Brief Roche senior management on the strategy and status of assigned China alliances as needed

• Represent Corporate Business Development in public forums (conferences, congresses, other presentation opportunities) in China

In order to be successful in this role, you have:

• Advanced degree (i.e. Master, Diploma, MD, PhD, PharmD) in business, finance or science related field

• Significant

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for an enthusiastic and agile successor for our People Support Solutions Team Lead position within the People Support Solutions German Network . In this role, you will lead a team of HR generalists providing first-line support to our German-based employees, managing a diverse and high-impact portfolio.

The Opportunity

• Lead and inspire a team of HR specialists providing first-line support across the entire German network.

• Manage a diverse portfolio encompassing Employee Lifecycle Management, Compensation, Payroll, Time & Benefits, and Compliance.

• Navigate an extensive stakeholder network , partnering closely with Business & Talent Acquisition Partners and various Project Teams.

• Drive operational excellence by supporting your team in solving complex cases and engaging in demanding professional conversations.

• Benefit from a broad professional scope , moving beyond a single vertical to master a diversified P&C service landscape.

• Empower your team to take E2E accountability, fostering an environment where self-management and initiative are the norms.

• Act as a catalyst for growth , helping team members navigate transformations and reorganizations with confidence.

Who You Are

• A seasoned People Leader with at least 1 year of direct Line Management experience and a passion for developing others.

• Fluent in German (near-native/C1-C2) with the ability to communicate with sophistication and nuance in a regulated business environment.

• Highly proficient in English , enabling you to collaborate effectively within our global corporate structure.

• An empathetic leader who prioritizes empowerment, coaching, and a people-first mindset in your daily leadership practice.

• A strategic navigator comfortable managing complex stakeholder networks and diagnosing organizational needs.

• A disciplined professional with a university degree (HR or Business preferred) and a strong grasp of logical reasoning.

• An agile specialist who may come from a Second Level background but is ready to master the diverse, fast-paced world of Front Line HR.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we commit ourselves to achieving access to medical and diagnostics innovations for all. Together with our regional and country organizations, we are building health systems ready to provide the future of care and make access a reality, thus, enabling people and patients around the world to live their best lives.

This global leadership position is responsible for bringing our diagnostics solutions to the forefront of care and growing access, reimbursement and funding effectively for our established portfolio as well as our ground breaking innovations.
The incumbent will closely collaborate with the global functions in Medical, Commercial, Market Access and Health System Policy enabling our affiliates to effectively co-design and apply the global tools, setting specific access targets in their respective environments and pulling through effective plans for their realization in mutual accountability.
As you are versatile in many environments and wish to impact external access delivery, you will closely accompany affiliates in their efforts to build the health system of tomorrow. Through this lived proximity to market realities, you will enable better global tools and deliverables, always pushing for the next level in furthering our affiliate support.

The Opportunity

Your responsibilities include:

• Market Analysis and Opportunity Identification : Research and analyze access coverage, reimbursement levels, health and payer policies, competitive access landscapes to identify business opportunities enabled through access and assess the probability and impact of affecting positive change.

• Access Insight and Strategy Development : Apply expertise in consolidating and providing relevant access insights and supporting the development and execution of global access strategies and impactful access tools including the Access Reimbursement Toolkit.

• Strategic Access Engagement Leadership : Act as a catalyst and coach for regional and affiliate implementation of global access strategies, identifying gaps, tailoring approaches, and accelerating time to reimbursement and the effective funding for your prioritized products.

• Global-Regional-Affiliate Interface : Create frameworks for efficient transfer of global strategies and catalyze learning, sharing, and collaboration across organizations and territories by leading the Access Nexus pilot of your area - our key interface to the Regions and Countries driving your work in achieving reimbursement and funding.

• Affiliate Support : Support regions and affiliates in executing payer-relevant access approaches, addressing access, reimbursement and funding barriers holistically, and leading projects to enhance local access capabilities with delivering tangible business growth through the realization of access opportunities.

• Shaping Sustainable Healthcare Systems : Support regions and affiliates in building plans and networks that aim for the creation of sustainable Health Care Systems in affecting the regulatory frameworks of payers, Health Technology Assessment bodies and their advising network.

• Requires travel of up to 20%

Who you are

• Master’s degree in business economics, life sciences, public health, marketing, or a related discipline; additional educational programs in market access preferred

• 5+ years of commercial and/or access experience in the diagnostic/pharmaceutical or related industry. Additional experience in related functions such as Strategy, Marketing, or Health Policy preferred.

jobs.title: Workforce Strategy & Planning Expert

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di strategia e pianificazione della forza lavoro

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the Workforce Strategy & Planning Lead, you will be the strategic intelligence behind how Roche's Digital & Technology (RDT) organization anticipates, plans, and shapes its future workforce. This is a senior global individual contributor role responsible for translating RDT's business strategy into actionable workforce implications – providing scenario insight and planning coherence to make informed decisions about talent supply and demand across the organization.
You will lead by influence and connecting long-term business ambition to workforce reality – maintaining the workforce dashboard logic that enables RDT-level visibility. By anchoring every workforce decision in data-driven foresight, you will be shaping how a global digital organization plans, adapts, and builds for the future.

Job Responsibilities

• RDT Workforce Dashboard & Intelligence: Define, build, and maintain the logic behind the workforce dashboard, ensuring it delivers accurate, timely, and strategically relevant insight to RDT leadership. Ensures dashboard outputs are integrated with capability data and reflect a holistic view of RDT's talent landscape.

• Strategic workforce planning coherence: Act as the steward of planning coherence across the RDT organization, ensuring that workforce planning assumptions, methodologies, and outputs are consistent across functions, sites, and geographies. Translate complex planning outputs into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholder consumption.

• Federated planning enablement: Equip HR partners, site leads, and functions with the frameworks, tools, and guidance needed to execute workforce planning consistently across the federated RDT model, enabling local teams to contribute meaningfully to the global workforce picture. Leverage the RDT site network to ensure planning insights reflect both global strategy and local talent realities.

• Workforce Intelligence: Responsible for designing and deploying a Skills Intelligence Platform (SIP) that serves as a centralized 'Digital Twin' of the RDT workforce. Integrates data from multiple HR, learning, finance, and workforce systems to build a holistic and dynamic picture of RDT's talent landscape. Develop scenario models and predictive analytics that generate forward-looking insight to support strategic workforce and capability decisions.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies and engages key stakeholders, including management, across organizational boundaries. Shapes strategy as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and empowers teams in stakeholder management.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.

• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.

• Proven track record of recommending optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation and working on unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions.

• Ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic and enterprise-wide consulting advice.

• Exceptional stakeholder management skills, acting as a role model in teamwork, and driving good collaboration across Informatics and business structures.

• Strong dedication to actively contributing to organizational development.

Deine Chance | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Position bist du maßgeblich daran beteiligt, die Qualität unserer Computersysteme sicherzustellen. Wir vertrauen dir wichtige Aufgaben an, die den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Systeme betreffen. Deine Tätigkeit hat einen direkten Einfluss auf die Qualität der Roche-Produkte, die das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern.

• Qualitätssicherung : Du erstellst, bearbeitest und schließt Änderungen, Abweichungen, Korrekturen und Vorbeugemaßnahmen ab. Du führst Qualitätssicherungsaufgaben für Labor-, IT- und Automatisierungssysteme durch und stellst die Datenintegrität sicher.

• Risiko - und Dokumentenmanagement : Du erstellst Risikoanalysen im Quality Risk Management Umfeld und stellst sicher, dass alle GMP-relevanten Dokumentationen den Vorschriften entsprechen.

• Wissenstransfer : Du bleibst durch interne und externe Weiterbildungen auf dem neuesten Stand und teilst dein Wissen aktiv mit deinen Kolleg:innen.

Das bist Du
Du bist ein:e proaktive:r Teamplayer:in, der/die sich mit hohem Engagement für Compliance im Produktions- und Laborumfeld einsetzt. Du behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick, verfügst über Durchsetzungsvermögen und hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Ausbildung : Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Naturwissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Bioinformatik, Informatik oder ein Technikerabschluss mit relevanter Berufserfahrung sind die Grundlage für diese Position.

• Fachwissen : Du besitzt tiefgreifendes konzeptionelles und praktisches Wissen in der Qualitätssicherung von Computersystemen und bringst Grundwissen in Bereichen wie Automatisierungstechnik oder komplexen IT-Systemen mit.

• Kommunikation & Stakeholdermanagement : Du kommunizierst ausgezeichnet auf Deutsch und Englisch, über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg. Stakeholdermanagement ist für dich selbstverständlich - so stellst du z.B. sicher, dass alle relevanten Parteien eingebunden sind.

titleByLocale.de: Auszubildender Site Management (m/w/d) Master-Entwicklungsprogramm / StartUp Your Career
titleByLocale.fr: Trainee Site Management (m/w/d) Master-Entwicklungsprogramm / StartUp Your Career

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics Site Management | Wer wir sind
Das „Biep“ beim Öffnen des Drehtores. Stimmengewirr auf der Baustelle. Das Klirren von Metall auf der Werkbank. Das Glänzen der Photovoltaik auf dem Dach. Der Duft von frischen Bohnen in der Kaffeebar.
Im Site Management sind wir weit mehr als ein operativer Dienstleister: Wir verstehen uns als aktive Gestalter und Befähiger an unserem Standort. Für alle Mitarbeitenden am Standort, bspw. als Teil unserer Produktions- und Forschungseinheiten – also für unsere Business Units – schaffen wir ein integriertes Ökosystem, das nahtloses Arbeiten ermöglicht, Innovationen fördert und die Produktivität stärkt. Dabei verbinden wir tagtägliche Betriebssicherheit zuverlässig mit zukunftsweisenden Themen wie Digitalisierung, Nachhaltigkeit und modernen Arbeitsumgebungen. So leisten wir einen strategischen Beitrag zu qualitativ hochwertigen Diagnostika und pharmazeutischen Produkten zum Wohle unserer Patient:innen weltweit.

StartUp your Career - bist Du ready? | Das erwartet Dich
Mit unserem StartUp Trainee Programm bieten wir Dir spannende standortübergreifende Projekte und Perspektiven innerhalb der Standortfunktionen wie beispielsweise Facility Management, Instandhaltung, Automation, Risk Management, Safety, Health & Environment Compliance und Engineering. Vom ersten Tag an gestaltest Du Dein 24-monatiges Programm aktiv mit. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung übernehmen: Du arbeitest selbstständig sowie im Team in bis zu sechs verschiedenen Bereichen unserer Standorte und übernimmst von Beginn an eigene Aufgabenpakete.

• Projekte steuern: Du wählst Deine Projektschwerpunkte proaktiv, planst diese selbstorganisiert und führst sie zielgerichtet zum Erfolg.

• Netzwerk aufbauen: Du wirst Teil einer lebendigen Trainee-Community und knüpfst auch darüber hinaus wertvolle Kontakte zu Kolleg:innen über Funktionsgrenzen hinweg.

• Perspektiven erweitern: Du nutzt die Möglichkeit, Deine Fähigkeiten an einem unserer internationalen Roche-Standorte einzubringen und dort ein eigenständiges Projekt zu begleiten.

• Entwicklung gestalten: Du steuerst Deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung eigenverantwortlich, unterstützt durch ein personalisiertes Entwicklungsportfolio sowie ein Mentoring aus dem Senior Management.

• Zukunft sichern: Du profitierst von einer langfristigen Förderung – unser StartUp Trainee Programm startet direkt mit einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
So vielfältig wie unsere Services, so vielfältig sind auch unsere Mitarbeitenden. Für unsere Trainees ist ein Master-Abschluss die Grundvoraussetzung - Du musst diesen zum Start abgeschlossen haben, kannst Dich aber noch während des Studiums bewerben. Darüber hinaus suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit mit einem inneren Antrieb und dem Potenzial, Großes zu bewirken. Daher suchen wir Dich:

• Du hast ein Masterstudium im (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, in den Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder der Wirtschaftsinformatik erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit einem Schwerpunkt in den Bereichen Facility Management, Data Analytics, Energie-/Ressourcenmanagement oder Automation.

• Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen durch relevante Praktika im In- oder Ausland mit, vorzugsweise gesammelt in Ingenieurbüros, Industrie- oder Dienstleistungsunternehmen.

• Du hast Freude daran, innovative Lösungen in einem komplexen Umfeld zu entdecken, denkst unternehmerisch und begreifst Veränderungen als Entwicklungschan

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Diagnostics Site Management | Chi siamo The “Biep” quando si apre il cancello rotante. Votando sul cantiere. Il taglio di metallo sul banco di lavoro. La lucentezza del fotovoltaico sul tetto. Il profumo di fagioli freschi nel bar del caffè. In Site Management, siamo molto più di un fornitore di servizi operativi: ci comprendiamo come progettista attivo e persona capace al nostro sito. Per tutti i dipendenti del sito, ad esempio nell'ambito delle nostre unità di produzione e di ricerca – cioè per le nostre unità aziendali – creiamo un ecosistema integrato che permette un lavoro senza soluzione di continuità, promuove l'innovazione e rafforza la produttività. Uniamo in modo affidabile l'affidabilità operativa quotidiana con argomenti previsionali come la digitalizzazione, la sostenibilità e gli ambienti di lavoro moderni. Così, forniamo un contributo strategico alla diagnostica di alta qualità e prodotti farmaceutici a beneficio dei nostri pazienti: sia in tutto il mondo. StartUp your Career - sei pronto? | Con il nostro programma StartUp Trainee, vi offriamo interessanti progetti e prospettive multi-sito all'interno delle funzioni di localizzazione come la gestione delle strutture, manutenzione, automazione, gestione dei rischi, sicurezza, salute e conformità dell'ambiente e ingegneria. Dal primo giorno in poi, si forma attivamente il vostro programma di 24 mesi. Prendere le seguenti attività eccitanti:
• Assumere la responsabilità: Si lavora in modo indipendente e nel team in fino a sei aree diverse delle nostre posizioni e prendere le proprie attività fin dall'inizio.

• Hai completato con successo un master in ingegneria (economica), economia o informatica aziendale, incentrati idealmente sulla gestione delle strutture, analisi dei dati, gestione energetica/risorsa o automazione.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen.

Wir suchen dich als studentische Aushilfe zur Unterstützung bei der Dokumentenmigration! Im Rahmen der Migration bestehender, technischer Dokumente von einem bisherigen in ein neues Dokumentenmanagementsystem wirst du Teil eines Teams von 2-3 Personen sein.

Die Möglichkeit
Es erwarten dich folgende spannenden Tätigkeiten bei uns:

• Extraktion der bestehenden, technischen Dokumente aus dem bisherigen Dokumentenmanagementsystem

• Anpassung der Dokumente an neue technische Anforderungen

• Vorbereitung der Dokumente zur Besprechung in einem Fachgremium

• Besprechung der entworfenen Dokumente mit Fachexpert:innen

• Übertragung der Dokumente in das neue Dokumentenmanagementsystem

• Gemeinsam mit Fachexpert:innen wirst du diese neuen Anforderungen umsetzen und wertvolle Erfahrungen sammeln.

Wer Du Bist
Du bist immatrikuliert an einer Hochschule oder Universität, weiterhin hast du:

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Deutsch, und sprichst gut Englisch

• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe für technische Zusammenhänge und im Umgang mit spezifischen IT-Systemen im Bereich Dokumentenmanagement. ​

Zusätzliche Informationen
Der Standort ist Basel. Die Stelle basiertauf einem 50%-Vertrag. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit darf während dem Semester 15 Stunden nicht überschreiten. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit kann in den Semesterferien auf bis zu 40 Stunden erhöht werden.
Die Bewerbungsvoraussetzung von nicht-EU/EFTA-Bürger*innen ist, dass das Studium an einer Schweizer Bildungseinrichtung erfolgt.
Frühestes Startdatum: 1 August 2026

Bewirb dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Portfolio and Customer Engagement Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the Portfolio and Customer Engagement Lead, you will hold ultimate accountability for shaping and executing the commercial strategy within your assigned portfolio. You will champion a deep understanding of business drivers, the local market landscape and competitive dynamics to optimize customer experiences and drive long-term strategic success.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will:

• Set the strategic vision, high ambitions and clear outcomes for your teams by leveraging insights from internal and external stakeholders across the wider enterprise.

• Manage full P&L accountability and take ownership of the financial ambitions and investment health of your designated portfolio.

• Deliver exceptional impact and steer the outcomes of cross-functional engagement teams with an enterprise-wide mindset.

• Build, coach and inspire a high-performing community, providing visionary leadership that fosters an environment where cross-functional collaboration thrives.

• Optimize fluid, impact-driven resource allocation and prioritization, carefully balancing customer engagement models with broader portfolio priorities.

• Champion an enterprise growth mindset and show resilience, turning every stone to uncover innovative possibilities for patients, customers and healthcare systems.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader and a strategic thinker who thrives on turning bold ambitions into reality. You are deeply passionate about customer centricity, healthcare innovation and possess the business acumen required to lead complex, cross-functional ecosystems.

To excel in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Academic Foundation: A Master’s degree in Business, Science, or a related field.

• Strategic & Commercial Expertise: Solid experience (minimum of 10 years) in creating product and portfolio strategies, with a proven track record in the development, launch, or management of products within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Proven Leadership: Demonstrated ability to build trust as a leader and inspire seamless teamwork and collaboration across diverse networks.

• Market & Customer Insights: Extensive experience in strategic planning, product management, or market research—ideally combining local market knowledge with global perspective, supported by a strong background in customer-facing roles.

• Communication & Collaboration Skills: Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Finnish, enabling you to connect authentically with local and international stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is a pivotal leadership role within our UK Pharma Commercial team. You join at a moment of radical healthcare transformation — where market access, government affairs, and health economics converge to determine whether life-changing therapies reach the patients who need them. You lead a multidisciplinary function that shapes the UK's position as a priority destination for global pharmaceutical investment.

The Opportunity:

• Shape the future of UK pricing and reimbursement by leading the organisation's strategy across NICE, SMC, and AWMSG — ensuring our portfolio remains commercially viable and accessible to patients

• Lead high-stakes negotiations for Commercial Access Agreements that protect and grow a billion-pound revenue stream through sustainable, innovative funding models

• Influence government policy at the highest levels maintaining strategic relationships across the Department of Health and Social Care, HM Treasury, and the broader political landscape

• Build a world-class Access engine that serves as the gold standard for our global headquarters — proving that the UK is a priority launch market

• Drive health equity and system transformation by leading initiatives that improve patient outcomes, enhance population health, and reduce per-capita costs in partnership with the NHS

• Pioneer innovative access models including outcome-based agreements, value-based pricing, and real-world evidence frameworks that can be exported globally

Who you are:

• You bring extensive senior leadership in market access, health economics, or government affairs within the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector

• You have deep expertise in UK HTA processes and the commercial mechanics of industry-government pricing frameworks

• You are a proven political advocate, comfortable engaging at ministerial and senior civil servant level to shape policy outcomes

• You are an enterprise thinker who balances access decisions against commercial, medical, and supply chain considerations across a complex portfolio

• You lead with purpose — translating strategic patience into tactical urgency to deliver patient access today while building frameworks for tomorrow

Preferred:

• Experience navigating the post-Brexit regulatory and trade landscape as it impacts pharmaceutical operations

• Background in Real-World Evidence generation and its application to HTA submissions and lifecycle management

• International or global headquarters experience demonstrating cross-market strategic influence

If you're ready to shape the future of patient access in the UK, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche:
We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.
We are Roche.

About the Role:

Roche Products (Ireland) Limited is the sales & marketing arm in Ireland of the pharmaceutical division of Roche. We market and sell prescription medicines across a range of therapeutic areas including oncology, neurology, ophthalmology, rheumatology and spinal muscular atrophy. We are an agile organisation that brings together great people who are passionate about innovation, and who thrive in dynamic, cross-functional, and purposeful teams. These teams work together to deliver outstanding value to our business, patients, and customers.

This role is working within the Finance & Business Operations team which includes Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement, Business Support and Administration. The team provides support across the business and you will be working with multiple stakeholders. This 8 month contract role arises as the incumbent has been seconded to another role within the organisation.

Comfortable working both as a part of a team as well as on your own initiative, you will have proven organisational capability & high levels of personal effectiveness. jobs.title: Access Partner - Specified Purpose (Approx. 18 Months)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

The Access Partner is an enthusiastic advocate of his/her area of expertise. His/Her mission is to get our medicines to patients as fast as possible for as long as possible. He/she will work as part of the cross-functional team to drive our North Star and lead the Access agenda within the cross functional team (CFT).

In this role you will:

• Lead the development and execution of high-quality P&R strategies and HTA submissions to deliver on the CFTs mission

• Lead CFT engagement with national Access stakeholders i.e. NCPE, NCCP and support the wider squad in value messaging at a regional level

• Build fast and maintain market access for Roche’s specialist products through targeted communication with various stakeholders in the Irish health system: regional and national

• Identifying new ways of working together with our key stakeholders and identification of new projects that support Patient Access to Roche medicines

• Aligns Access strategies with commercial and medical strategies and pricing guidance from HQ

• Development of new strategic initiatives securing Roche’s long term commitment to secure all eligible patients access to Roche products

• Represent Market Access in Squads according to the Agile Operational model acting as the point of contact driving the Market Access agenda

• Work with CFT members to develop and deliver value messaging and engagement plans for all stakeholders throughout the Access journey

• Shape the payer environment and share relevant information to inform and shape opinion regarding the value of our products

• Responsible for own Market Access projects as agreed with The Head of Access

As a member of Roche Products Ireland Limited:
You will contribute to a combination of communities and teams that comprise of the larger Roche Products (Ireland) Limited and/or the wider Roche community. You will also participate in or lead local and/or global work package teams with a focus on delivering value for patients, external stakeholders and Roche via:

• Contributing and enabling the delivery of programmes across the business by providing operational and/or strategic input to the teams as well as helping to architect our ten year ambition that enables a better future for patients.

• Cultivate meaningful peer-to-peer collaborations to drive a deeper understanding of patient and employee needs across RPIL and beyond. In doing so, nurture a culture of curiosity to enable faster, simpler, and more patient-centric ways of working to deliver on high impact work.

• You may serve as a partner to local internal and external stakeholders inside and outside of Ireland and help support local business needs so that Roche operates as one larger community.

• Inspire and empower talent by working with colleagues across RPIL and the Roche family to promote communication, community and networking in a global environment.

• Optimising growth opportunities and capabilities to successfully contribute and operate in a diverse and global environment. Drive new thinking by identifying new opportunities and options to embrace value creation.

Who you are:

• Degree in Economics or Science, Pharmacist or equivalent professional background

• Patient focus

• Ability to apply the key concepts of economic evaluation including economic modeling

• Interest in and knowledge about the Irish health care system

• Ability to work in an agile environment

• Demonstrates Roche Core Values

• Strong strategic thinker

• Good sense of numb

The Position
International Product Manager – Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS)
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

Who We Are:
Advancing precision medicine through diagnostics for over 25 years.
In collaboration with leading pharmaceutical companies, Roche Personalised Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) identify and develop innovative precision diagnostics to help radically improve the lives of patients.
As the global diagnostic partner of choice, we deliver diagnostic confidence through a broad menu of high medical value assays across Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ hybridization (ISH), PCR and NGS. We are a global partner of choice in Oncology, including tissue diagnostics, as well as Neurology & Cardiology. jobs.title: Director, Customer Support Center
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Director, Customer Support Center

The Opportunity:
As the Director of Customer Support Center for Roche Diagnostics USA, you will lead the evolution of our support ecosystem into a next-generation diagnostic hub. Your primary goal is to minimize instrument downtime by championing Remote-First resolution. By integrating AI-assisted troubleshooting tools with our core platforms, you will empower our frontline experts to solve complex clinical and technical issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy. You will serve as a strategic leader who bridges the gap between high-level business objectives and world-class service delivery.

We are seeking a transformational leader who thrives on variety. You don’t just manage a department; you look for ways to help the entire company win. You are as comfortable leading a cross-functional project as you are implementing a new AI-guided troubleshooting tool, all while ensuring your team feels secure, valued, and empowered in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

Job Facts:

1. Strategic Leadership & Remote Excellence

• Expedited Fix Strategy: Define the roadmap for a proactive support model, utilizing assistive technologies within ServiceMax and Salesforce to increase first-contact resolution and maximize laboratory uptime.

• Operational & Financial Oversight: Direct accountability for expense budgets (P&L), resource planning, and performance data to ensure a cost-effective, high-output operation.

• Omnichannel Innovation: Oversee the optimization of CCaaS platforms (e.g., Genesys) to ensure seamless, data-driven interactions across all customer touchpoints.

2. People-Centric Innovation

• Augmented Support: Oversee the implementation of 'co-pilot' technologies—like predictive error mapping and automated case surfacing—that simplify complex workflows and protect agents from burnout.

• Change Management: Lead with transparency to ensure the team views new digital tools as career-enhancing assets rather than replacements.

• Talent Development: Direct all HR activities, including recruitment, training, and career planning, to build a resilient pipeline of leadership talent.

3. Strategic Business Partnership & Enterprise Impact

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as a high-level consultant to internal partners (Sales, Marketing, R&D, and Field Service), aligning support strategies to directly bolster sales objectives and product reliability.

• Commercial Alignment: Partner with Sales leadership to ensure that our service excellence becomes a competitive differentiator and a primary driver of contract renewals.

• Silo-Breaking Leadership: Navigate our matrixed organization to build consensus and lead initiatives that require cooperation across multiple departments to solve systemic customer pain points.

• Dynamic Flexibility: Proactively take on additional responsibilities and pivot resources to support other departments during periods of high demand or special product launches.

4. Compliance & Technical Quality

• Regulatory Stewardship: Ensure every remote-fix protocol and service action strictly adheres to Roche’s quality system and FDA/global regulatory requirements.

• Service Integrity: Maintain a work culture 100% committed to accuracy, ensuring that remote interventions provide the same level of reliability as an on-site visit.

Who You Are (Required Qualifications & Experience):

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Chemistry, Biology, Clinical Laboratory, Business or rel

Principal DevOps Engineer (DevOps Lead)

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Description
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity
The Principal DevOps​ ​Engineer​ (DevOps Lead) ​is a key member in engineering and DevOps groups and will apply knowledge of design principles, practices in the implementation of complex, enterprise-scale software systems. The Principal engineer is a hands-on leader of the DevOps function. General responsibilities include design concept generation, participating in reviews for components or features, development, and testing of the core software stack, and reliability testing.

Key Responsibilities:

• Software​ ​Development​: This is a software development position to write high quality software that will perform at scale, be supportable, and be extensible

• Process​ ​&​ ​Operations: Ensure the software stack integrates with our existing CI pipeline and contribute to continuous improvement; independently design, plan and deliver high-quality software

• Leadership​: Ensure a culture that values technical excellence together with support and compassion for individuals

• Evangelism: As a key evangelist, you will work to evangelize a healthy DevSecOps software development practice within the Roche Engineering Community

Who You Are:

• BS in Computer Science, or Computer Engineering, or related field.

• 10+ years of hands-on experience in public cloud AWS, Google, or Azure (AWS Preferred) of which at the minimum 5 years of experience in the software industry.

• Scripting experience is required and highly desirable, using shell, python, ruby, or similar languages.

• Experience leading DevOps teams and in building and maturing CI/CD pipelines

• Expertise in overall areas in DevSecOps including CI/CD with build & release, Internal tooling, and production operations.

• Build and operation tools that monitor backend production, Make sure backend services scale economically, Develop tooling framework, Help the dev team resolve production issues

• Hands-on System Administration experience with Unix based systems including experience with system configuration and networking (DNS, DHCP, rout tables and routing).

• Experience automating using infrastructure as code: AWS Cloudformation, Terraform, etc.

• Hands-on automation development using chef or ansible desired

• Experience deploying or managing large scale distributed Unix environments Partake in an on-call rotation alongside the engineers who build our production backends, Comfortable with large scale production systems and technologies, including load balancing, monitoring, distributed systems, and/or configuration management.

• Experience in contemporary platforms extended from cloud such as docker containers, Mesos, and/or Ku

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu. Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Du rotierst durch kaufmännische und technische Bereiche wie IT, Logistik oder Finance und baust dir ein starkes Netzwerk auf.

• Du bildest die direkte Brücke zwischen den Fachbereichen und der IT und koordinierst spannende gemeinsame Projekte.

• Du entwickelst smarte IT-Lösungen von der ersten Idee über die Programmierung bis zur Einführung mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum.

• Du optimierst aktiv betriebswirtschaftliche Prozesse und steuerst Abläufe – sei es in der Logistik, der Produktion oder im Controlling.

Deine praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Diagnostics in Mannheim statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Mannheim abgehalten.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.
Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

Wie lange dauert Dein Duales Studium?
3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung. Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
