jobs.title: Data Management & Governance Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Data Management & Governance Specialist is a data-minded professional preferable with IT business operations and IT strategy & portfolio experience..
In this role, you're excited about using data governance and quality foundations to unlock the next generation of IT maturity: agentic AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven IT decision-making.
The position involves actively managing data assets, ensuring data quality, lineage, and metadata accuracy, and supporting data stewardship programs. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to define data definitions, resolve data issues, and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations, contributing significantly to a trusted and well-managed data environment.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership):

• Leads, develops, and enforces data governance policies aligned with IT4IT value streams. Works independently on specific governance projects to ensure organizational alignment and data integrity.

• Accountability/Problem Solving:

• Develop Data Standards and data models for critical IT data entities across the IT4IT value streams.

• Diagnose root cause of poor data quality in IT operations.

• Implement proactive data quality frameworks following Enterprise Data Strategy guidelines.

• Stakeholder Management:

• Collaborates extensively with various departments to ensure compliance. Communicates effectively and clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to build trust and alignment.

• Impact/Strategy:

• Handles big-sized data governance projects. Develops and executes strategies that significantly improve data quality and overall organizational compliance.

• Align data governance with agentic AI readiness: Define data quality, trust, and compliance standards.

• Complexity / (Product Size):

• Oversees more complex data governance systems. Ensures critical data integrity and security across multiple business units.

• Create data lineage and ownership maps for IT operations data across the IT4IT system landscape, establishing clear accountability for data quality and currency.

• Manage data governance across complex IT operations ecosystems including ServiceNow, Data Warehouses, monitoring platforms, asset management tools, and emerging automation/AI systems

• Business / Technical ability:

• Applies high proficiency in data management tools and practices. Demonstrates and leverages a strong, comprehensive knowledge of data privacy laws and regulations to safeguard data assets.

• Apply knowledge of IT service management frameworks (e.g. IT4IT) to contextualize governance within ITSM processes.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Data-first mindset

• Demonstrated experience handling big-sized data governance projects and overseeing complex data governance systems.

• Proven track record of independently leading, developing, and enforcing data governance policies and standards across multiple business units.

• Experience actively managing data assets, ensuring data quality, lineage, and metadata accuracy.

• Familiarity with IT4IT framework and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) - strongly preferred

Technical / Business Skills

• Proficiency in utilizing data management tools and implementing data stewardship practices.

• Strong, in-depth knowledge of data privacy laws, regulatory requirements, and compliance standards.

• Understanding of IT service management frameworks: ITIL, IT4IT, or equivalent; ability to map gover

jobs.title: Business Strategy Praktikantenstelle (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unser Team

Unser Team ist ein integraler Teil der globalen Sites Networks von Roche und betreut die großen Produktionsstandorte Mannheim und Penzberg (München). Wir gestalten die strategische Ausrichtung und organisatorische Entwicklung dieser Standorte. Mit einer umfangreichen strategischen Agenda treiben wir zahlreiche Initiativen und Projekte im Site Management voran, immer mit dem Ziel, messbaren Fortschritt und Verbesserung zu erreichen. In unserem aufgeschlossenen und ambitionierten Team wirst du in Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen, globalen und Konzernfunktionen standortübergreifend innovative Ideen und Lösungen entwickeln sowie umsetzen.
Deine Rolle
In dieser Schlüsselfunktion bringst du deine eigenen Ideen direkt ein. Durch die enge 1:1 Zusammenarbeit mit dem/der Chief of Staff nimmst du eine aktive Sparringspartner-Rolle ein, um zentrale Managementthemen des Sites Networks erfolgreich mitzugestalten. Als Teil des Stabs der Geschäftsführung unterstützen wir zudem bei allen relevanten Gremien (u.a. Betriebsrat, Wirtschaftsausschuss) und Terminen von Roche Diagnostics.
Deine Aufgaben in unserem Team setzen sich wie folgt zusammen:

• Konzeption und Umsetzung eines Dashboards von Business-relevanten KPIs zur Performancesteuerung im Site Management. Dabei gehört die kontinuierliche Reflektion von Optimierungspotenzialen zu deinen Aufgaben

• Durchführung von verschiedenen Analysen und Auswertungen laufender Initiativen im Site Management, wie beispielsweise Marktanalysen und Stakeholderanalysen

• Analyse der Voraussetzungen und Ausarbeitung eines ganzheitlichen und zielgerichteten Ansatzes für ein unternehmerisches Ökosystem in der Pharmabranche in Deutschland. Hierbei arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen

• Eigenständige, konzeptionelle Vor- und Nachbereitung von Workshops, Meetings, Reportings und Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management und Gremiensitzungen

• Mitwirkung bei der Koordination, Konzeption und Umsetzung von strategischen Projekten in direkter Abstimmung mit dem/der Chief of Staff

• Aktive Unterstützung des Managements bei der Weiterentwicklung von Business, Strategie und Innovation

Dein Profil

• Ein Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

• Relevante praktische Erfahrung durch mindestens zwei Praktika in der Unternehmensberatung, in strategischen Konzernrollen, einem Start-up oder ähnlichen Bereichen, in denen analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein ausgeprägtes Organisationsgeschick erfolgreich unter Beweis gestellt wurden

• Zusätzliche Auslandserfahrung ist von Vorteil

jobs.title: Utilities Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Im Bereich Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing Large Molecules stellen wir mit modernsten Anlagen verschiedene therapeutische Wirkstoffe her.

In der Funktion als Utilities Manager unterstützen Sie den Chapter Utilities der Unit Facility Management (FM) & Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) und seine Kunden bei der Bearbeitung von Abweichungen und Änderungen, um nahtlosen Support für die kommerzielle & klinische Wirkstoffherstellung in den Bauten 91 (ADC/SUT) und 95 (MAB) bereitzustellen.

Die Möglichkeit

• Auslösen und Bearbeiten von Änderungen und Abweichungen als Owner auf lokaler Ebene (Drug Substance)

• Lösungsfindung im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und darüber hinaus,sowie Mitarbeit bei der Ursachenanalyse

• Bearbeitung / Überprüfung von technischen GMP Dokumente (Vorschriften)

• User Vertretung bei Investitions- und Quality Projekten, sowie Beratung (inkl. Review) für die Unit, sowie Mitarbeit in Fragen der Dokumentation

• Sicherstellen des unterbruchsfreien Betrieb unserer Anlagen und Einhaltung unserer Qualitäts- und SHE Standards

• Aktive Zusammenarbeit mit den FM&SHE Teams (Operators, Kalibrierer, Facility & Monitoring Managers, SHE Beauftragter) und LT, Manufacturing Units (interne Kunden), QA Partnern, andere Support Organization (Pharma Engineering, Technical Compliance) & DS Site Stakeholders

Wer du bist

• Abgeschlossenes Studium an einer Hochschule oder Fachhochschule, idealerweise im Bereich Verfahrens- und Umwelttechnik oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Bearbeitung von GMP-Dokumenten sowie fundiertes cGMP-Verständnis

• Technisches Know-how in Betrieb, Wartung und Qualifizierung hochautomatisierter Pharma-Anlagen sowie Erfahrung mit Clean & Black Utilities

• Kenntnisse in Clean & Black Utilities zugehörigen Prozesse (Biotech), Reinstmedien-Monitoring, LEAN, Data Integrity und von KPIs von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse im technischen Schreiben sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Nel campo di Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing Large Molecules produciamo vari principi attivi terapeutici con sistemi all'avanguardia. Nella funzione Utilities Manager, supporterai il Capitolo Utilities of Unit Facility Management (FM) & Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) e i suoi clienti nel trattamento delle deviazioni e delle modifiche per fornire un supporto senza soluzione di continuità per la produzione di sostanze attive commerciali e cliniche negli edifici 91 (ADC/SUT) e 95 (MAB). Mansioni - attivare e modificare le modifiche e le deviazioni come Proprietario a livello locale (Drug Substance) - trovare soluzioni nelle proprie aree di responsabilità e oltre, nonché cooperazione nell'analisi delle cause - Trattamento / revisione dei documenti tecnici GMP - Rappresentanza degli utenti per progetti di investimento e qualità, nonché consulenza (inclusa la revisione) per l'unità, nonché cooperazione sulla documentazione - Assicurare il funzionamento senza interruzioni dei nostri sistemi e il rispetto della nostra qualità e degli standard SHE - Collaborazione attiva con i team FM&SHE (operatori, calibratori, responsabili delle strutture e dei controlli, funzionari SHE) e LT, Unità di produzione (clienti interni), partner QA, altre organizzazioni di supporto (Pharma Engineering, Technical Compliance) & DS Site Stakeholders
• Requisiti - Studi completi presso un'università o un college, idealmente nel campo della tecnologia di processo e ambientale o in un corso di studio comparabile - Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella creazione e nella modifica dei documenti GMP e della confessione CGMP - know-how tecnico nel funzionamento, manutenzione e qualificazione di impianti farmaceutici altamente automatizzati e di esperienza con Clean & Black Utilities - Conoscenza dei processi correlati di Clean & Black Utilities (biotech), monitoraggio dei media di pulizia, LEAN, Integrità dei dati e KPI - Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco in scrittura tecnica e inglese in parola e scrittura Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.title: UX / Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented UX / Frontend Engineer to help build the next generation of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this role, you will work closely with our Lead UX Designer / Frontend Engineer to implement complex user interfaces and dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

You will focus on writing clean, scalable frontend code, translating complex bioinformatics workflows into intuitive web applications, and contributing to a seamless user experience. If you are passionate about Vue.js, clean UI design, and want to help visualize critical scientific data, this is the perfect opportunity to grow your skills in a highly specialized environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop, test, and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS frameworks.

• Collaborate directly with senior designers and engineers to translate complex workflows and wireframes into highly functional, user-centric code.

• Develop and optimize interactive data visualizations using D3.js to represent large-scale datasets across complex dashboards.

• Contribute to our internal component design system, ensuring reusable, accessible, and visually consistent UI elements across our platforms.

• Integrate frontend applications seamlessly with backend services via RESTful and GraphQL APIs in a cloud environment.

• Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, working cross-functionally with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to deliver features iteratively.

Who You Are
You are a talented, detail-oriented frontend professional who is passionate about clean UI design, modern web technologies, and data visualization. You excel at bridging the gap between design concepts and technical execution, and you thrive in collaborative environments where your work makes critical scientific data accessible.

Qualifications & Skills:

• 2–4 years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript frameworks, with a strong, demonstrable focus on Vue.js.

• Solid proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, SASS, and modern utility-first styling frameworks like Tailwind CSS.

The Nice-to-Haves:

• A background, previous experience, or strong interest in the life sciences domain (e.g., Sequencing, PCR, Bioinformatics, or digital healthcare).

• Experience using design hand-off tools (like Figma or Sketch) and contributing to component librari

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with a strong technical background rooted in fundamental computer science and database management. The position requires a team player who strives for engineering and technical excellence, and is passionate about leveraging technology to change the face of medicine.

In this role, you will act as a technical lead, driving the long-term planning, architecture, and design of initiatives such as our core ML and Data Platform. You will handle complex data projects alongside cross-functional teams, providing the robust infrastructure and tooling necessary for our Data Scientists to accomplish their research and production goals efficiently.

Key Responsibilities:

• Act as the central technical liaison between project stakeholders and the Data Science team, taking full ownership of integrating and deploying algorithms and machine learning models into production workflows.

• Design, build, and scale cloud-native and hybrid data and machine learning platforms (MLOps) tailored to the complex, evolving needs of our established Data Science team.

• Plan, architect, and develop long-term enterprise tooling and infrastructure for internal use to accelerate and streamline ML model research, training, and evaluation.

• Take responsibility for the end-to-end software and data architecture within Data Science initiatives, independently driving the specification, implementation, and testing of complex technical assignments.

• Serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert, gathering requirements from data-focused profiles to continuously improve the ML platform while mentoring peers to foster a culture of engineering excellence.

Who You Are
You are a collaborative technical leader who strives for engineering excellence and is passionate about leveraging technology to change the face of medicine. You excel at navigating ambiguity, enjoy handling complex data projects, and love mentoring others to grow technically.

Qualifications & Skills:

The Must-Haves

• A Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering with Python, including a deep understanding of Application Architecture and Design Patterns.

• Strict adherence to coding best practices (e.g., TDD, ATDD), rigorous testing strategies, and proper version control.

• A very good understanding of complete ML workflows and hands-o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung
In unserem Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) unterstützen wir Kunden aus Diagnostiklaboren und Krankenhäusern in mehreren europäischen Ländern bei technischen, applikativen und IT-nahen Fragestellungen rund um Roche Systeme der in-vitro Diagnostik. In dieser Rolle liegt dein Fokus auf der Schnittstelle von Molekulardiagnostik, Laborprozessen und IT-Systemen. Dabei unterstützt du insbesondere bei Themen wie LIS-Anbindung, Connectivity, Middleware und digitalen Labor-Workflows.

Für unser internationales RCSC suchen wir einen Junior Application Specialist (m/w/d) in Mannheim (DE), Almere (NL) oder Vilvoorde (BE).

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Bearbeitung von applikativen und systembezogenen Kundenanfragen

• Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Problemstellungen im Zusammenspiel von diagnostischen Systemen, Labor-IT und Kundenprozessen

• Mitarbeit an Lösungen zu Connectivity- und Schnittstellenthemen, z. B. im Umfeld von LIS, Middleware und Remote Connectivity

• sorgfältige Dokumentation von Fällen und Lösungen im CRM-System

• Durchführung von Kunden- und Mitarbeiterschulungen

• Aufbereitung und Weitergabe von produkt- und systemrelevanten Informationen

• gelegentliche Unterstützung von Außendienstkollegen:innen bei Einsätzen im Kundenlabor

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Niederländisch- und Englisch. Deutsch, Türkisch oder Griechisch sind ein Plus.

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise in Molekularbiologie, Biochemie, Medizininformatik, Biomedizintechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Alternativ verfügst du über eine naturwissenschaftliche oder medizinisch-technische Ausbildung und möchtest dich in einem applikativen und IT-nahen Umfeld weiterentwickeln.

• Du bringst erste Kenntnisse oder ein starkes Interesse im Bereich Molekulardiagnostik mit.

• Du hast Freude an technischen Zusammenhängen und eine ausgeprägte IT-Affinität.

• Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit LIS, Labor-IT, Middleware, Connectivity oder Systemintegrationen gesammelt.

• Du arbeitest gerne mit komplexen Systemen und gehst Fragestellungen strukturiert und lösungsorientiert an.

• Kundenorientierung, Kommunikationsstärke und Teamgeist zeichnen dich aus.

• Du wohnst in der Nähe von Mannheim, Almere oder Vilvoorde und bist bereit, regelmäßig nach Mannheim zu reisen.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Dort, wo Entgelttransparenz vorgeschrieben ist, geben wir die Informationen basierend auf dem Hauptstandort der Stelle an. Für diese Position ist der Hauptstandort Mannheim. Falls Du dich für einen anderen Standort interessierst, an denen die Stelle möglicherweise ebenfalls verfügbar ist, geben wir Dir die entsprechenden Entgeltinformationen im weiteren Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses.

Descrizione Da Roche puoi mostrarti come te stesso, accolto per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei valorizzato, accettato e rispettato per ciò che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Nel nostro Centro Regionale di Assistenza Clienti (RCSC), supportiamo clienti provenienti da laboratori diagnostici e ospedali in diversi paesi europei con questioni tecniche, applicative e IT relative ai sistemi diagnostici in vitro di Roche. In questo ruolo, il tuo focus sarà sull'interfaccia tra diagnostica molecolare, processi di laboratorio e sistemi IT. In particolare, fornirai supporto in argomenti come la connessione LIS, la connettività, il middleware e i flussi di lavoro di laboratorio digitale. Per il nostro RCSC internazionale cerchiamo un Junior Application Specialist (m/f/d) a Mannheim (DE), Almere (NL) o Vilvoorde (BE). Mansioni - Elaborazione delle richieste di clienti relative ad applicazioni e sistemi - Supporto nell'analisi di problemi nell'interazione tra sistemi diagnostici, IT di laboratorio e processi clienti - Collaborazione su soluzioni per problemi di connettività e interfaccia, ad esempio nell'ambiente di LIS, middleware e connettività remota - Documentazione attenta di casi e soluzioni nel sistema CRM - Implementazione di formazione per clienti e dipendenti - Preparazione e trasferimento di prodotto e comunicazione Informazioni rilevanti per il sistema - Supporto occasionale dei colleghi del servizio sul campo durante incarichi nel laboratorio del cliente
• Requisiti - Parli e scrivi fluentemente in olandese e inglese. Tedesco, turco o greco sono un vantaggio. - Hai una laurea, idealmente in biologia molecolare, biochimica, informatica medica, ingegneria biomedica o una disciplina comparabile. In alternativa, hai una formazione scientifica o medico-tecnica e vorresti svilupparti ulteriormente in un ambiente applicativo e informatico. - Hai conoscenze iniziali o un forte interesse nel campo della diagnostica molecolare. - Ti piacciono i contesti tecnici e hai una forte affinità per l'IT. - Idealmente, hai già ottenuto il primo contatto con LIS, IT di laboratorio, middleware, connettività o integrazioni di sistema. - Ti piace lavorare con sistemi complessi e affrontare le questioni in modo strutturato e orientato alla soluzione. - Sei caratterizzato da orientamento al cliente, forti capacità comunicative e spirito di squadra. - Vivi vicino a Mannheim, Almere o Vilvoorde e sei disposto a viaggiare regolarmente a Mannheim. Candidatura - Vi chiediamo i seguenti documenti: CV attuale. Al momento non sono assolutamente necessari ulteriori documenti. - Prima di inviare la domanda, si prega di notare che non possono essere aggiunti ulteriori documenti successivamente. Informazioni aggiuntive Quando è richiesta trasparenza salariale, forniamo le informazioni in base alla posizione principale del lavoro. La sede principale di questa posizione è Mannheim. Se sei interessato a un'altra sede dove la posizione potrebbe essere disponibile, ti forniremo le informazioni salariali rilevanti nel corso successivo del processo di candidatura. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a far avanzare la scienza, garantendo a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a oltre 26 milioni di persone curate ogni anno. Contatta: il tuo contatto con noi! Con le persone. Per le persone. - Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Consulta le FAQ su https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTDE) bringt innovative Therapien von der klinischen Phase bis zur Markteinführung. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Arzneimittel mithilfe modernster Technologien in Herstellung, klinischer Versorgung, Formulierung, Verpackung und Analytik.
Das Drug Product Clinical Supply Center (PTDE-C) in Basel produziert und füllt sterile Darreichungsformen für klinische Studien (Phase I–III) in hochmodernen Anlagen.
Als Praktikant*in unterstützt du das Chapter Manufacturing Compounding & Visual Inspection bei der Herstellung von Lösungen vor der Abfüllung sowie bei der visuellen Kontrolle von Vials und Spritzen. Zudem erhältst du Einblicke in angrenzende Bereiche wie Filling, E2E Manufacturing Support, Science & Technology und Qualitätssicherung.

Die Möglichkeit

• Unterstützung der Kollegen bei der Lösungsherstellung und visuellen Kontrolle

• Identifizierung, Evaluierung und Vorantreiben von Verbesserungen im Rahmen von Operational Excellence (Lean & Six Sigma), cGMP (Planned Events / Changes)

• Technische Bewertung und Implementierung von neuem Equipment

• Unterstützung der Teamkultur (New Ways of Working)

• Erstellen und Optimierung von cGMP Dokumenten, z.B. Arbeits und Bedienungsanweisungen im anwendbaren Quality System (Veeva)

• Sicherstellung der Qualitätsanforderungen nach cGMP

• Erstellen von Prozess- / Durchsatz- / Produkttracking, um Daten-basierter Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen

• Unterstützung bei Selbstinspektionen, Audits, Gemba Walks

Wer Du bist

• Immatrikulation an einer Universität oder Fach-/Hochschule oder abgeschlossenes Studium, dass nicht länger als 12 Monate zurückliegt, vorzugsweise in einem Life Sciences-, Pharmazie-, oder Engineering-Bereich und bringst folgende Fähigkeiten mit

• Erste Erfahrung in der technischen Entwicklung / Herstellung und / oder Kontrolle von parenteralen Arzneiformen

• Erfahrung in der Pharma Industrie (cGMP) oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTDE) porta terapie innovative dalla fase clinica al lancio del mercato. Il nostro obiettivo è lo sviluppo di farmaci sicuri ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia nella produzione, nella cura clinica, nella formulazione, nell'imballaggio e nell'analisi. Il Drug Product Clinical Supply Center (PTDE-C) di Basilea produce e riempie forme di dosaggio sterile per gli studi clinici (Phase I-III) in strutture all'avanguardia. In qualità di tirocinante, supporta il Capitolo Manufacturing Compounding & Visual Inspection nella produzione di soluzioni prima di riempire e controllare visiva di flaconi e siringhe. Potrai anche ottenere informazioni in aree adiacenti come Filling, E2E Manufacturing Support, Scienza & Tecnologia e Garanzia di Qualità. Mansioni - Supporto di colleghi nella produzione di soluzioni e controllo visivo - Identificazione, valutazione e avanzamento dei miglioramenti nell'eccellenza operativa (Lean & Six Sigma), cGMP (Planned Events / Changes) - Valutazione tecnica e realizzazione di nuove attrezzature - Supporto per la cultura del team (New Ways of Working) - Creazione e ottimizzazione di documenti cGMP, ad esempio istruzioni di lavoro e utente nel Sistema Qualità applicabile (Veeva) - Garantire requisiti di qualità secondo cGMP - Creare un processo/attraverso il tracciamento del prodotto/per consentire le decisioni basate sui dati - Supporto auto-ispezione, Audit, Passeggiate Gemba
• Requisiti - Immatrikulation in un'università o college o studio completato che non è più di 12 mesi indietro, preferibilmente in un campo di scienze della vita, farmacia o ingegneria e porta le seguenti competenze con - Prima esperienza nello sviluppo tecnico / preparazione e/o controllo delle forme medicinali parenterali - Esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica (cGMP) o in un altro ambiente regolamentato - Alta capacità di squadra con ottime capacità di comunicazione in parola e scrittura in tedesco / inglese e apertura per avvicinarsi attivamente ai colleghi - Molto buone capacità di documentazione - Gestione Routinizzata dei sistemi IT (ad esempio Google Workspace, gSheet, MS Office, Smartsheet, Tableau, Minitab ecc.) - Impegno, motivazione e alta disponibilità a lavorare in modo indipendente Informazioni - Lo stage inizia il prima possibile. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTDE) apporte des thérapies innovantes de la phase clinique au lancement du marché. Nous nous concentrons sur le développement de médicaments sûrs et efficaces utilisant des technologies de pointe dans la fabrication, les soins cliniques, la formulation, l'emballage et l'analyse. Le Drug Product Clinical Supply Center (PTDE-C) de Bâle produit et remplit des formes posologiques stériles pour les essais cliniques (phase I-III) dans des installations de pointe. En tant qu'interne, vous soutenez le Chapitre Fabrication Composé & Inspection visuelle dans la production de solutions avant le remplissage et le contrôle visuel des flacons et des seringues. Vous obtiendrez également des informations sur des domaines adjacents tels que le remplissage, le soutien à la fabrication E2E, la science et la technologie et l'assurance de la qualité. Mansioni - Accompagner les collègues dans la production de solutions et le contrôle visuel - Identification, évaluation et avancement des améliorations de l'excellence opérationnelle (Lean et Six Sigma), cGMP (Événements prévus / Changements) - Évaluation technique et mise en œuvre de nouveaux équipements - Soutien à la culture d'équipe (nouveaux modes de travail) - Création et optimisation de documents cGMP, p.ex. instructions de travail et d'utilisation dans le système qualité applicable (Veeva) - Assurer les exigences de qualité selon le GMPc - Créer le suivi des processus/processus/produits pour permettre la prise de décisions fondées sur des données - Soutien à l'auto-inspection, audits, marches de Gemba
• Requisiti - Immatrikulation dans une université ou un collège ou études terminées qui n'a pas plus de 12 mois de retard, de préférence dans un domaine des sciences de la vie, de la pharmacie ou de l'ingénierie et apporte les compétences suivantes - Première expérience dans le développement technique / préparation et/ou contrôle des formes parentérales - Expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique (BPFc) ou dans un autre environnement réglementé - Haute capacité d'équipe avec de très bonnes compétences en communication verbale et écrite en allemand / anglais et ouverture d'approche active des collègues - Très bonnes compétences en documentation - Gestion routinière des systèmes informatiques (par exemple Google Workspace, gSheet, MS Office, Smartsheet, Tableau, Minitab, etc.) - Engagement, motivation et grande volonté de travailler indépendamment Informations complémentaires - Le stage commence dès que possible. La durée du stage est de 9-12 mois. - Pour la demande, nous avons besoin d'une confirmation d'inscription valide, d'une lettre de motivation et d'un CV. - Les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE doivent fournir une confirmation de l'université qu'un stage obligatoire fait partie de la formation aux documents de candidature. Veuillez indiquer la date de début et la durée souhaitées dans votre lettre de motivation. Chi siamo Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir notre ambition élevée, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Stell Dir vor, Du bist der entscheidende Kompass, der uns hilft, die Talente von morgen heute schon zu finden. Bei Roche geht es nicht nur darum, Positionen zu besetzen – es geht darum, die Talente aus unterschiedlichen Professionen für unsere Vision zu gewinnen: Das Leben von Patient:innen weltweit nachhaltig zu verbessern. Als Talent Acquisition Partner:in (“TAP”) bist Du kein Recruiter im klassischen Sinne; Du bist strategische:r Berater:in, Data-Enthusiast:in und Botschafter:in in einem. Du gestaltest die Transformation unserer Arbeitswelt aktiv mit und stellst sicher, dass wir genau die Future Skills an Bord holen, die wir für die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft benötigen.

Dein neues Team:
Wir verstehen uns als Sparringpartner auf Augenhöhe für das Business und agieren als eingespieltes Team, das Wissen teilt und gemeinsam wächst. Bei uns triffst Du auf Expert:innen, die moderne Recruiting-Ansätze leben und Raum für neue Ideen bieten.
Du wirst Teil des oneREC Germany Teams bestehend aus mehr als 40 TAPs aufgeteilt auf unsere deutschen Standorte in Mannheim, Grenzach und Penzberg, sowie unsere Kolleg:innen in Budapest und berichtest an unsere REC Lead für R&D, Commercial, Group Functions & New Business.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Deine strategische Rolle

• Strategic Partner & Marktexpertise: Du bist der vertrauensvolle Strategic Partner des Business und verantwortest die Talentstrategie Deiner Fachbereiche von der Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Vertragsverhandlung.

• Gestalter der Transformation: Du begleitest die Transformation der Organisation, indem Du Führungskräfte proaktiv zu Future Skills und Mindset-Themen berätst und die "Must-haves" kritisch hinterfragst.

• Datenbasierte Talentakquise: Als Data-Enthusiast:in identifizierst Du Top-Talente proaktiv durch den Einsatz modernster Sourcing-Tools und KI-gestützter Ansätze, um unsere Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen.

• Excellence in Candidate Experience: Du sorgst für Candidate Experience Excellence und begleitest Bewerber:innen wertschätzend bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss, wobei Du stets faire und attraktive Angebote aushandelst.

• Innovationsmotor & Agile Workflows: Du treibst innovative Projekte voran. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Reduktion von Komplexität und der Gestaltung agiler, schlanker Workflows durch die Implementierung neuester Recruiting-Trends.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du bist eine:r passionierte:r TAP — für Dich ist diese Rolle eine Berufung, nicht nur der nächste Karriereschritt. Du bringst Erfahrung aus einer modernen, agilen TA-Organisation mit. Dein Talent und Dein Mindset sind uns dabei wichtiger als jahrelange Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast bereits aktiv in den strategischen Säulen der Talentakquise gearbeitet: Alignment, proaktives Sourcing und Data-Driven Decisions.

• Du bist versiert im Umgang mit modernen Technologien (z. B. Workday, Phenom People, AI-Chatbots) und nutzt Künstliche Intelligenz als strategischen Hebel.

• Du verbindest Daten und Empathie meisterhaft: Du triffst Entscheidungen fundiert, verlierst dabei aber nie den Menschen aus dem Blick.

• Du verfügst über, idealerweise profunde, Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht und hast Berührungspunkte mit organisationalen Veränderungsprozessen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen.

• Durch regelmäßige Anwesenheit vor Ort in Penzberg arbeitest Du eng mit Kolleg:innen und Stakeholdern zusammen und positionierst Dich so als strategischer Partner

• Du kommunizierst stark und klar auf Deutsch und

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Polish

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

In der Abteilung Manufacturing, Science & Technology (MSAT) stellen wir die technische und strategische Kompetenz für die Bereitstellung der klinischen Pipeline, die Einführung und die Unterstützung der kommerziellen Produktion sicher. Unser technischer Support, Engineering, Systeme, Daten und Dokumente sind essentiell für die Herstellung, Bewertung und Freigabe hochwertiger Produkte. MSAT Process Science ist u.a. am Troubleshooting von pharmazeutischen Proteinwirkstoffen, bei der Bewertung von Einsatzstoffen sowie an lokalen und globalen Gremien beteiligt.

Dein Team

Wir sind ein souveränes Team aus Biotechnologie-Ingenieuren, Labortechnikern, Labormitarbeitern und Managern im Bereich Aufreinigung (Downstream-Processing). Modernes Aufreinigungsequipment, innovative Analysemethoden und diverse Dokumentations- und Auswerte-Tools stehen uns zur Verfügung. Selbständiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten sind für unsere Aufgaben essentiell, doch der Teamzusammenhalt und der Spaß an der Arbeit sind für uns genauso wichtig. Ein offener und ehrlicher Umgang miteinander, geprägt durch Respekt und Wertschätzung, ist uns besonders wichtig.

Deine Aufgaben

Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich:

• Fehlersuche, -analyse und -behebung im Umfeld des Downstream Processings

• Planung, Bearbeitung und Auswertung von Laborversuchen zur Optimierung, Skalierung und Validierung von Aufreinigungsverfahren (Downstream Processing)

• Anwendung diverser chromatographischer (ÄKTA, HPLC) und spektroskopischer Verfahren sowie Filtration im Labormaßstab

Dein Profil

• Du aktuell für ein naturwissenschaftliches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium immatrikuliert bist

• Du das Thema Proteinaufreinigung nicht nur aus der Theorie kennst

• Dir auch die analytischen Anwendungen der Chromatographie und Spektroskopie vertraut sind

• Du sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift hast

• Selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Planen und Arbeiten für dich selbstverständlich sind

• Du ein wahrer Teamplayer bist, ein hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen besitzt und auch in Belastungssituationen immer den Überblick behältst und den Spaß an der Arbeit nicht vergisst

• Erfahrung mit statistischen Methoden (z.B. DoE, multivariate Datenauswertung) und dem systematischen Umgang mit großen Datenmengen ist von Vorteil

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

Deine Bewerbung

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Quality Control (QC) Basel/Kaiseraugst consists of approximately 350 employees, organized into 7 departments with subordinate structures. It serves as a central key point for producing high-quality medicines. BS/KAU is responsible for the analytical quality testing of an extensive product portfolio, ranging from drug substances and drug products to medical devices, bulk, finished goods, direct materials, and packaging materials.
As a specialized section within this structure, Analytical Science and Technology (ASAT) is responsible for the strategic implementation of modern testing methods and innovative technologies at the Quality Control (QC) Basel/Kaiseraugst site. We act as a central hub of expertise, not only establishing methods locally but also actively transferring them to other sites. By managing the entire product lifecycle on an end-to-end (E2E) basis, we provide global standardization and technical steering. This ensures our 'Right to Operate', consistent compliance, and the highest quality standards throughout the entire Roche network.
As a specialized section within this structure, Analytical Science and Technology (ASAT) is responsible for the strategic implementation of modern testing methods and innovative technologies at the Quality Control (QC) Basel/Kaiseraugst site. We act as a central hub of expertise, not only establishing methods locally but also actively transferring them to other sites. By managing the entire product lifecycle on an end-to-end (E2E) basis, we provide global standardization and technical steering. This ensures our 'Right to Operate', consistent compliance, and the highest quality standards throughout the entire Roche network.

The Opportunity
As you step into this role, you will lead critical initiatives that harmonize our global analytical operations and drive technical excellence.

• Lead and coordinate projects in close collaboration with cross-functional interfaces like Pharmaceutical Development, Manufacturing Operations, and Commercial QC.

• Drive network agility by actively participating in global project teams to promote standardization across the Roche network.

• Spearhead technology implementation, serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external partners regarding new analytical technologies.

• Provide strategic support for ASAT objectives while managing specific technical assignments and ensuring seamless method transfers.

• Author GMP documentation, including transfer/validation plans, reports, risk assessments, and SOPs, while managing Change Controls and Deviations as an SME.

• Support audit readiness by preparing for and executing health authority inspections to maintain the site’s Right to Operate.

• Manage lifecycle robustly, ensuring consistent analytical standards and technical steering throughout the product lifecycle.

Who You Are
You are a positive, self-reflective professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and values an open speak-up culture.

• Educated and experienced: You hold a degree in Life Sciences (Chemistry, Pharmacy, Biotech) or a technical field, paired with several years of experience in a quality/GMP environment.

• Technically proficient: You possess a fundamental understanding of safety and quality systems, backed by a strong analytical background for solving complex issues.

• Proactive and organized: You demonstrate a high degree of self-initiative, quick comprehension, and a solution-oriented, self-reliant way of working.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Il Contesto Controllo qualità (QC) Basilea/Kaiseraugst consisteva in circa 350 dipendenti, organizzati in 7 dipartimenti con strutture subordinati. Rappresenta un punto chiave centrale per la produzione di medicinali di alta qualità. BS/KAU è responsabile dei test di qualità analitica di un ampio portafoglio di prodotti, che spazia da sostanze farmaceutiche e prodotti finiti a dispositivi medici, materiali sfusi, beni finitoti, materiali diretti e materiali di confezionamento. Scienza e tecnologia analitica (ASAT), come sezione specializzata all'interno di questa struttura, è responsabile dell'implementazione strategica di metodi di test moderni e tecnologie innovative nel sito Quality Control (QC) di Basel/Kaiseraugst. Agiamo come un hub centrale di competenza, non solondo metodi a livello locale ma trasferendoli attivamente anche ad altri siti. Gestendo l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto su base end-to-end (E2E), forniamo standardizzazione globale e guida tecnica. Questo garantisce il nostro "Right to Operate", la conformità costante e i più alti standard di qualità in tutta la rete Roche. L’Opportunità Mansioni - Guidare e coordinare progetti in stretta collaborazione con finali multifunzionali come Sviluppo Farmaceutico, Operazioni di Produzione e QC Commerciale - Promuovere l’agilità della rete partecipando attivamente a team di progetto globali per favorire la standardizzazione in tutta la rete Roche - Guidare l’implementazione di tecnologie, fungendo da punto di contatto principale per partner interni ed esterni riguardo a nuove tecnologie analitiche - Fornire supporto strategico agli obiettivi ASAT gestendo specifici incarichi tecnici e garanzie dirette di metodi senza preavviso - Redigere documentazione GMP, inclusi piani/rapporti di trasferimento/convalida, obiettivi del rischio e SOPs, gestendo al contempo Change Controls e Deviations come PMI - Supportare la preparazione agli audit Corsisi ed eseguendo ispezioni delle autorità sanitarie per mantenere il "Right to Operate" del sito - Gestire robustamente il ciclo di vita, garantendo standard analitici coerenti e guida tecnica durante l’intero ciclo di vita del prodotto
• Requisiti - Sei un professionista positivo e autorevole che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo e apprezza una cultura di dialogo aperto - In possesso di una laurea in Scienze della Vita (Chimica, Farmacia, Biotecnologie) o in un campo tecnico, abbinata a diversi anni di esperienza in un ambiente di qualità/GMP - Con una solida comprensione dei sistemi di sicurezza e qualità, supportata da un forte background analitico per problemi complessi - Proattivo e organizzato, con un alto grado di iniziativa personale, comprensione rapida e un approccio orientato alle soluzioni e autonomi - Collaborativo e un eccellente comunicatore, in grado di lavorare temporaneo in team interfunzionali e di costruire relazioni solide con stakeholder interni ed esterni - Con una mentalità globale e la capacità di navigare in ambienti complessi, bilanciando priorità multiple con facilità - Fluente in inglese (lingua aziendale); la conoscenza del tedesco è un vantaggio

Schließe dich Roche an, wo jede Stimme zählt. Il contesto Quality Control (QC) Basel/Kaiseraugst consiste in circa 350 dipendenti, organizzati in 7 dipartimenti con strutture subordinate. Rappresenta un punto chiave centrale per la produzione di medicinali di alta qualità. BS/KAU è responsabile dei test di qualità analitica di un ampio portafoglio di prodotti, che spazia da sostanze farmaceutiche e prodotti finiti a dispositivi medici, materiali sfusi, beni finiti, materiali diretti e materiali di confezionamento. Analytical Science and Technology (ASAT), come sezione specializzata all'interno di questa struttura, è responsabile dell'implementazione strategica di metodi di test moderni e tecnologie innovative nel sito Quality Control (QC) di Basel/Kaiseraugst. Agiamo come un hub centrale di competenza, non solo stabilendo metodi a livello locale ma trasferendoli attivamente anche ad altri siti. Gestendo l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto su base end-to-end (E2E), forniamo standardizzazione globale e guida tecnica. Questo garantisce il nostro "Right to Operate", la conformità costante e i più alti standard di qualità in tutta la rete Roche. L'Opportunità Mansioni - Guidare e coordinare progetti in stretta collaborazione con interfacce multifunzionali come Sviluppo Farmaceutico, Operazioni di Produzione e QC Commerciale - Promuovere l'agilità della rete partecipando attivamente a team di progetto globali per favorire la standardizzazione in tutta la rete Roche - Guidare l'implementazione di tecnologie, fungendo da punto di contatto principale per partner interni ed esterni riguardo a nuove tecnologie analitiche - Fornire supporto strategico agli obiettivi ASAT gestendo specifici incarichi tecnici e garantendo trasferimenti di metodi senza interruzioni - Redigere documentazione GMP, inclusi piani/rapporti di trasferimento/convalida, valutazioni del rischio e SOPs, gestendo al contempo Change Controls e Deviations come SME - Supportare la preparazione agli audit preparandosi ed eseguendo ispezioni delle autorità sanitarie per mantenere il "Right to Operate" del sito - Gestire robustamente il ciclo di vita, garantendo standard analitici coerenti e guida tecnica durante l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto
• Requisiti - Sei un professionista positivo e autorevole che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo e apprezza una cultura di dialogo aperto - In possesso di una laurea in Scienze della Vita (Chimica, Farmacia, Biotecnologie) o in un campo tecnico, abbinata a diversi anni di esperienza in un ambiente di qualità/GMP - Con una solida comprensione dei sistemi di sicurezza e qualità, supportata da un forte background analitico per risolvere problemi complessi - Proattivo e organizzato, con un alto grado di iniziativa personale, rapida comprensione e un approccio orientato alle soluzioni e autonomo - Collaborativo e un eccellente comunicatore, in grado di lavorare efficacemente in team interfunzionali e di costruire relazioni solide con stakeholder interni ed esterni - Con una mentalità globale e la capacità di navigare in ambienti complessi, Bilanciando priorità multiple con facilità - Fluente in inglese (lingua aziendale); La conoscenza del tedesco è un vantaggio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Clinical Educator brings clinical expertise to their field team. This is a promotional role, working as an integral member of a field based team and will not have direct contact with patients.

Key Responsibilities:

• To assist specialist customers in a secondary care environment, to increase their knowledge, clinical understanding and advocacy of the assigned brands in the relevant therapeutic area/disease state and approved indications (multiple sclerosis)

• To provide education to health care professionals and their staff on the proper administration of designated treatments for assigned disease area

• To support healthcare professionals to provide patients with appropriate information and support informed decision making along the patient journey.

Who you are:

• Nursing background or similar experience required

• Good understanding and working knowledge of the Pharma Market and the local Health Service environment

• Good technical knowledge of Multiple Sclerosis experience strongly preferred

• Effective verbal and written communication skills

• High level of business planning, organisational & problem solving skills

• Ability to conduct face-to-face presentations to customers

• Highly motivated with drive & determination to succeed & willingness to adapt to change

• Dynamic, self-starter with strong influential skills, as well as entrepreneurial spirit

• Ability to develop and maintain strong, professional relationships

• Commercial, Regulatory and technical awareness

• The ability to navigate a large multi-disciplinary geography (which may require travel 50 – 60% of working time)

• Valid driving licence

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Ltd. At Roche Products we believe diversity drives innovation and we are committed to building a diverse and flexible working environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion or belief, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, disability or age. We recognise the importance of flexible working and will review all applicants’ requests with care. At Roche difference is valued and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Technical Development brings game-changing therapies from clinical phase I into the market to serve every patient, every day. Our core business is to develop safe, innovative and effective drugs using cutting edge technologies for manufacturing process (Drug Substance and Drug Product), clinical supply, formulation, device, packaging, and analytical development. Our daily work also includes compiling of regulatory documents and the transfer of development projects to commercial manufacturing.

The Opportunity:

• Routine analysis of release and stability samples across several projects as well as extended functional characterization.

• Following a GMP compliant workflow in our analytical landscape within technical development (CMC).

• Development, improvement and validation of analytical methods for the quality assessment of active substances

• Supporting the interfaces to early research and development as well as to marketed QC organization.

Who You Are:

• Lab technician with Apprenticeship (please note: this role is tailored for vocational qualifications; Master’s or PhD degrees are outside the scope of this position) with at least 5 years of experience in an industrial setting working on bioassays, ideally in a QC organization and working according to GMP.

• Hands-on experience in relevant immunological methodologies like ELISA, reporter gene assays, proliferation assays, cell killing assays and cell culture.

• Self-organizing way of working and the ability to interact and cooperate across matrix organizations and departments/functions.

• Good written and spoken English and German language skills.

This position is fixed term for 2 years.

Excited to shape the future with us? We look forward to receiving your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Lo sviluppo tecnico di Pharma porta terapie che cambiano il gioco dalla fase clinica I al mercato per servire ogni paziente, ogni giorno. Il nostro core business è quello di sviluppare farmaci sicuri, innovativi ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia per il processo di produzione (Drug Substance and Drug Product), fornitura clinica, formulazione, dispositivo, imballaggio e sviluppo analitico. Il nostro lavoro quotidiano comprende anche la compilazione di documenti normativi e il trasferimento di progetti di sviluppo alla produzione commerciale. Mansioni - Analisi di routine dei campioni di rilascio e stabilità in diversi progetti e caratterizzazione funzionale estesa. - A seguito di un flusso di lavoro conforme a GMP nel nostro paesaggio analitico all'interno dello sviluppo tecnico (CMC). - Sviluppo, miglioramento e convalida dei metodi analitici per la valutazione della qualità delle sostanze attive - Supportare le interfacce per la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce e per l'organizzazione QC commercializzata.
• Requisiti - Tecnico di laboratorio con Apprenticeship (si prega di notare: questo ruolo è su misura per le qualifiche professionali; Master o PhD gradi sono al di fuori della portata di questa posizione) con almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ambiente industriale che lavora su bioassay, idealmente in un'organizzazione QC e lavorare secondo GMP. - Esperienza pratica nelle metodologie immunologiche rilevanti come ELISA, saggi di gene reporter, saggi di proliferazione, saggi di uccisione cellulare e cultura cellulare. - Auto-organizzante modo di lavorare e la capacità di interagire e cooperare tra organizzazioni di matrice e dipartimenti/funzioni. - Buone competenze in lingua inglese e tedesca. Durata e nota Questa posizione è fissa per 2 anni. Cosa? Eccitato a plasmare il futuro con noi? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Contatto Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Pharma Technical Development bringt spielerische Therapien aus der klinischen Phase I in den Markt, um jeden Patienten jeden Tag zu bedienen. Unser Kerngeschäft ist die Entwicklung sicherer, innovativer und effektiver Medikamente mit modernsten Technologien zur Herstellung von Prozessen (Drug Substance and Drug Product), klinischer Versorgung, Formulierung, Gerät, Verpackung und analytischer Entwicklung. Unsere tägliche Arbeit umfasst auch die Erstellung von regulatorischen Dokumenten und die Übertragung von Entwicklungsprojekten auf die gewerbliche Fertigung. Mansion - Routineanalyse von Release- und Stabilitätsproben über mehrere Projekte sowie erweiterte Funktionscharakterisierung. - Nach einem GMP-konformen Workflow in unserer analytischen Landschaft in der technischen Entwicklung (CMC). - Entwicklung, Verbesserung und Validierung analytischer Methoden zur Qualitätsbewertung von Wirkstoffen - Unterstützung der Schnittstellen zur frühen Forschung und Entwicklung sowie zur vermarkteten QC-Organisation. Voraussetzungen - Labtechniker mit Lehramt (bitte beachten: diese Rolle ist auf berufliche Qualifikationen zugeschnitten; Master- oder PhD-Abschlüsse sind außerhalb des Rahmens dieser Position) mit mindestens 5 Jahren Erfahrung in einem industriellen Umfeld, das an Bioassays arbeitet, ideal in einer QC-Organisation und arbeiten nach GMP. - Hands-on Erfahrung in relevanten immunologischen Methoden wie ELISA, Reporter-Gen-Assays, Proliferations-Assays, Zell-Tötungs-Assays und Zellkultur. - Selbstorganisierende Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, über Matrixorganisationen und Abteilungen/Funktionen zu interagieren und zu kooperieren. - Gut geschrieben und gesprochen Englisch und Deutsch Sprachkenntnisse. Durata e Note Diese Position ist für 2 Jahre befristet.

Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Contattoo Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Sales Account Manager you will be responsible for achieving regional sales targets for our Near Patient Care (NPC) Roche Diagnostics portfolio. You will manage the full customer lifecycle, from prospecting new clients to maintaining relationships with existing ones through proactive communication.
Key responsibilities include providing demand-driven sales and after-sales support, conducting customer training, and installing NPC products, all while ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. You will also monitor market trends and competitor activity.
Our NPC covers healthcare customers such as physicians (General practitioners, ambulatory specialists - diabetologists, internal medicine doctors, cardiologists, pneumologists) and hospitals. The NPC portfolio consists of various POCT devices, professional/hospital and patient blood glucose meters and CGM.

Preferred location: Southern Moravia, e.g. Brno / Olomouc
Readiness to active business trips is required
Employment contract: initially fixed-term 2 years with a possibility to extend, contract with a vendor of service of Roche

The Opportunity

Customer Relationship & Sales Management:

• Proactively engage customers to identify needs, suggest solutions, and resolve issues, ensuring high satisfaction through exceptional after-sales support

• Drive sales growth by negotiating new business, promoting and installing products (instruments, reagents), and expanding the customer portfolio

• Manage the full sales process, including preparing, presenting, and negotiating quotations using designated tools and processes.

Portfolio Promotion & Training:

• Promote NPC portfolio by conducting customer training seminars and representing the company at key conferences

Market Intelligence & Personal Development:

• Monitor and report on regional competitor behavior and market trends

• Proactively engage in continuous self-learning to maintain expert knowledge of relevant publications and industry information

Compliance & Collaboration:

• Ensure strict compliance with all Complaint Management procedures, including accurate and timely reporting in our CRM and other global systems

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues within the NPC team and other departments to achieve shared goals

Who You Are

• Secondary education as a minimum, Natural or Health Sciences field preferred

• Proven customer-facing within commercial functional area experience (1+ years of experience as a minimum)

• Sales experience in the healthcare field of medical devices or In-vitro diagnostics is desired

• Czech language fluent and English at intermediate level

• Demonstrated communication skills to be able to present complex topics in concise and clear manner

• Negotiation and influencing skills with solution-orientated mindset

• Able to handle conflicting priorities with value-generating outlook

• PC Skills (experience working in Google Workplace, MS Office)

• Team player mindset to challenge colleagues but also support them grow in line with achieving common goals

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high
