descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Roche, verpflichtet, die Wissenschaft voranzubringen, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Unser Team von Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) ist das Herzstück von Pharma, das den Rhythmus für Pharma festlegt – die strategische Ausrichtung von Roche zu prägen und sicherzustellen, dass unser Portfolio weltweit sinnvolle Innovationen für Patienten liefert. Durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen, kommerziellen und Markteinblicken treibt GPS unternehmensweite Strategie, Portfoliopriorisierung und Unternehmensmodellinnovation an, um Roches Führung in der sich entwickelnden Gesundheitslandschaft voranzubringen. Im Rahmen des Portfolio-, Strategie- und Insights (PSI)-Teams im GPS-Bereich werden Sie als strategischer Denkpartner und vertrauenswürdiger Berater tätig sein, der das Produkt, den Krankheitsbereich, die Pharma- und die Unternehmensstrategie von Roche leitet. Das PSI-Team, bestehend aus Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads und Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, bietet konsistente, gezielte und technologiefähige Erkenntnisse, die die Qualitätsentscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen vorantreiben und unvoreingenommene, fachkundig kuratierte Intelligenz bereitstellen, um Lifecycle Management, Commercialization Excellence und Portfoliostrategien zu informieren. Das Global Ecosystem Insights (EI)-Team sucht einen Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Portfolio Insights Leader, der uns bei der Gestaltung der Pharmastrategie von Roche durch Markt-, Portfolio- und kundenzentrierte Erkenntnisse beitritt. Diese Rolle fungiert als interner Berater und Stratege und arbeitet mit kommerziellen und funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften zusammen, um Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die sich auf Therapeutische Bereiche erstrecken und Cross-Portfolio-Entscheidungen formen. Die Chance Der Beyond TA Portfolio Insights Leader ist für die Analyse des Global Pharma Portfolios verantwortlich, um kommerzielle Attribute zu bewerten, Risiken/ Chancen zu identifizieren, Auswirkungen von Landschaftsverschiebungen zu antizipieren und strategische Entscheidungen zu formen. Sie werden in EI und anderen PSI-Teams umfassend zusammenarbeiten, um Erkenntnisse zu entwickeln und den vollen Wert der generierten Empfehlungen zu realisieren. Sie navigieren eine komplexe globale Matrix, um funktionsübergreifende Partner rund um wirkungsstarke, einsichtsorientierte Lieferungen auszurichten. Sie werden dem EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader melden. Schwerpunkte und Zuständigkeiten
• Strategische Modellierung & Analytik: Entwickeln Sie ausgeklügelte analytische Rahmenbedingungen und Modelle, mit denen das globale Portfolio bewertet und die langfristige Planung informiert wird. Sie werden eine quantitative kommerzielle Grundlage für die Kommerzialisierung und strategische Entscheidungen der F & E bieten, um sicherzustellen, dass Empfehlungen in robusten Daten verwurzelt und für Geschäftsauswirkungen kontextualisiert werden
• Markttrend-Synthese: Bewerten Sie verschiedene Datenquellen, um aufkommende Trends und Verschiebungen in der Gesundheitslandschaft zu erkennen. Sie werden die Entwicklung von kohäsiven "outside-in" Perspektiven führen, die informieren, wie wir ein sich entwickelndes Wettbewerbsumfeld navigieren
• Leistungsbeurteilung und Risikominderung: Erfolgt das Cross-Portfolio, um potenzielle Wachstumstreiber und kritische Trade-offs zu identifizieren. Sie werden potenzielle Lücken in der kollektiven Strategie hervorheben und Interventionen empfehlen, um unsere Portfolioposition zu stärken
• Entscheidungsunterstützung: Handeln Sie als spezialisierter Berater für Strategieprojekte und übersetzen komplexe Portfolioanalysen in präzise, wirkungsstarke Empfehlungen. Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für leitende Führung dienen und technische Komplexität in klare, handlungsfähige Geschäftsstrategien verwandeln
• Einheitliche Portfolio-Erzählung: Integrieren Sie individuelle Therapeutische Area-Einsichten in eine einzelne, zusammenhängende "Beyond TA"
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes Roche, engagés à faire avancer la science afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, fixant le rythme de Pharma — façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roche, assurant notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Portefeuille, Stratégie et Perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance, guidant Roches produit, domaine de la maladie, pharmaceutique et stratégie d'entreprise. L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file du portefeuille « Beyond Therapeutical Area » (TA) pour se joindre à nous pour façonner la stratégie Pharma de Roche au moyen de perspectives axées sur le marché, le portefeuille et la clientèle. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Le chef de file du portefeuille Au-delà de l'AT est chargé d'analyser le portefeuille Global Pharma afin d'évaluer les caractéristiques commerciales, de cerner les risques et les possibilités, d'anticiper l'impact des changements de paysage et de façonner les décisions stratégiques. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec d'autres équipes de l'IE et d'autres ISP afin d'élaborer des idées et de réaliser toute la valeur des recommandations générées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Domaines d ' intervention et responsabilités
• Modélisation et analyse stratégiques: Développer des cadres et modèles analytiques sophistiqués utilisés pour évaluer le portefeuille mondial et éclairer la planification à long terme. Vous fournirez une base commerciale quantitative pour la commercialisation et les décisions stratégiques de R-D, en veillant à ce que les recommandations soient fondées sur des données solides et contextualisées en fonction de l'impact de l'entreprise.
• Synthèse des tendances du marché : Évaluer diverses sources de données pour identifier les tendances émergentes et les changements dans le paysage des soins de santé. Vous dirigerez l'élaboration de perspectives cohésives « externes » qui guideront la façon dont nous naviguons dans un environnement concurrentiel en évolution
• Évaluation des performances et atténuation des risques: évaluer les performances inter-portfolio pour identifier les facteurs de croissance à fort potentiel et les compromis critiques. Vous soulignerez les lacunes potentielles de la stratégie collective et recommanderez des interventions pour renforcer notre position de portefeuille
• Appui à la décision : agir en tant que consultant spécialisé pour les projets stratégiques, traduire l'analyse complexe du portefeuille en recommandations concises et à impact élevé. Vous serez un conseiller de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs, transformant la complexité technique en stratégies opérationnelles claires et réalisables
• Narratif unifié du portefeuille : Intégrer les points de vue individuels de la zone thérapeutique dans un « Au-delà de l'AT » unique et cohérent

jobs.title: Solution Architect - RDT Pharma R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Solution Architect - Pharma R&D
Preferred Location: Pune

The Opportunity

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Who you are

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

Technical Skills

• General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions and interfaces.

• Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions.

• Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for the solution, including conducting vendor assessments.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information and successfully build consensus.

• Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improve existing solutions, a

jobs.title: Software Senior Technical Lead Rust (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In a global, cross-functional environment, the PCR Software Development chapter develops, delivers and maintains integrated, unified and reliable software solutions for Molecular Diagnostics Systems by leveraging our advanced capabilities, in-depth knowledge and strong internal & external partnerships driving the accuracy, efficiency and agility in innovating the Molecular Lab experience for our customers and patients throughout their journey.

The Opportunity

As a Software TechLead, you will be part of a cross-functional team playing a pivotal role in facilitating agile processes and ensuring effective collaboration in developing software solutions. You will enable our Molecular Lab network to deliver accurate and timely diagnostic solutions and your contributions will support the Diagnostics 10-year ambition.

• You work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders (Product Owner, System Architect, Solution Architect, System Engineers, etc.) to understand and translate complex business and customer needs into effective technical solutions and communicate these to the team and the stakeholders.

• You design and develop innovative software solutions that meet regulatory requirements as well as fulfill system quality attributes like scalability, performance, reliability, maintainability, interoperability, extensibility, etc.

• You guide the team to adhere to best practices in software development, including code reviews, testing, and continuous integration, to deliver high-quality solutions and foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.

• You act as a mentor and role model, guiding and empowering team members in technical development, promoting a collaborative working environment and contributing effectively to the team's success.

Who you are

You as a candidate for our dynamic team will have the following skills and experience:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in the specialized field of Software Development / Engineering and experience in IVD software development is a plus for succeeding in the role.

• Several years of proven experience in software development, with a demonstrated passion and hands-on professional experience working with Rust for at least two years incl. a solid understanding of Rust's core concepts (ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes), experience with asynchronous programming in Rust (e.g., using async/await) and familiarity with common Rust libraries and frameworks (e.g., tokio, actix-web, rocket, serde, sqlx).

• Experience with modern system architectures like event-driven architecture and DDD, quality-driven practices such as TDD and BDD, or containerization technologies like Kubernetes is a plus.

• Demonstrated experience in transforming customer value into implementable solutions.

• Capable of solving complex issues creatively and effectively, using a multi-faceted approach based on thorough analysis to resolve complex project challenges.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to foster an inclusive and diverse environment as well as collaborate effectively within and across teams.

• Leads by example to foster cross-functional value delivery and to establish a psychologically safe working environment and empowers its own team and holds people accountable by creating conditions for ownership.

• Motivation to make an impact to your fellow team members, our company, our customers and our patients.

• Certified ISAQB or equivalent is a plus.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In a global, cross-functional environment, the PCR Software Development chapter develops, delivers and maintains integrated, unified and reliable software solutions for Molecular Diagnostics Systems by leveraging our advanced capabilities, in-depth knowledge and strong internal & external partnerships driving the accuracy, efficiency and agility in innovating the Molecular Lab experience for our customers and patients throughout their journey. The Opportunity As a Software TechLead, you will be part of a cross-functional team playing a pivotal role in facilitating agile processes and ensuring effective collaboration in developing software solutions. You will enable our Molecular Lab network to deliver accurate and timely diagnostic solutions and your contributions will support the Diagnostics 10-year ambition.
• You work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders (Product Owner, System Architect, Solution Architect, System Engineers, etc.) to understand and translate complex business and customer needs into effective technical solutions and communicate these to the team and the stakeholders.
• You design and develop innovative software solutions that meet regulatory requirements as well as fulfill system quality attributes like scalability, performance, reliability, maintainability, interoperability, extensibility, etc.
• You guide the team to adhere to best practices in software development, including code reviews, testing, and continuous integration, to deliver high-quality solutions and foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
• You act as a mentor and role model, guiding and empowering team members in technical development, promoting a collaborative working environment and contributing effectively to the team's success. Who you are You as a candidate for our dynamic team will have the following skills and experience:
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in the specialized field of Software Development / Engineering and experience in IVD software development is a plus for succeeding in the role.
• Several years of proven experience in software development, with a demonstrated passion and hands-on professional experience working with Rust for at least two years incl. a solid understanding of Rust's core concepts (ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes), experience with asynchronous programming in Rust (e.g., using async/await) and familiarity with common Rust libraries and frameworks (e.g., tokio, actix-web, rocket, serde, sqlx).
• Experience with modern system architectures like event-driven architecture and DDD, quality-driven practices such as TDD and BDD, or containerization technologies like Kubernetes is a plus.
• Demonstrated experience in transforming customer value into implementable solutions.
• Capable of solving complex issues creatively and effectively, using a multi-faceted approach based on thorough analysis to resolve complex project challenges.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to foster an inclusive and diverse environment as well as collaborate effectively within and across teams.
• Leads by example to foster cross-functional value delivery and to establish a psychologically safe working environment and empowers its own team and holds people accountable by creating conditions for ownership.
• Motivation to make an impact to your fellow team members, our company, our customers and our patients.
• Certified ISAQB or equivalent is a plus. Every role at Roche plays a

jobs.title: Domain Architect - Site & Services
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Domain Architect – Sites & Services

The Domain Architect – Sites & Services is a senior, pivotal role within the SPG (Strategy, Portfolio & Governance) Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This role serves as the critical connector between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the global Sites, SHE & Sustainability function with a focus on the Sites. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Sites leadership team, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of Roche’s global site footprint, corporate real estate, and facility management operations.
Crucially, in our federated Roche Digital Technology (RDT) model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Sites architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain and solution architects embedded directly within the Sites organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready technology roadmaps.

Description of the Area
The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural interface for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Sites domain, this involves deeply integrating with product and engineering teams across the core Sites function, Data, Analytics & AI, and the Regional Business Partnering teams (e.g., Switzerland, Germany, US West Coast, US Mid-West and East Coast). This architectural role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and the local operational execution for Roche's physical footprint and smart building initiatives is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

The Opportunity:

• Drive strategic business partnering by acting as the primary architectural liaison between SPG and the Sites function to align real estate priorities with multi-year technology roadmaps.

• Orchestrate the global architecture network across regional sites, empowering embedded domain and solution architects to execute efficiently while adhering to shared enterprise principles.

• Lead architecture governance by defining technology guardrails and non-functional requirements, including IoT network security, physical access control resilience, and operational data privacy.

• Steer critical program delivery for high-impact initiatives such as smart building deployments, connected workplace technologies, and global real estate portfolio rationalization.

• Develop core domain architecture deliverables, including Facility Management capability maps, target-state architectures, and reference blueprints utilizing the ArchiMEDES toolchain.

• Align portfolio investments by embedding architectural insights into funding decisions, maximizing platform reuse, and actively minimizing technical debt across global sites.

• Evaluate emerging technology innovations and vendor solutions (such as digital twins for buildings and advanced IoT facility ecosystems) to ensure alignment with operational needs.

• Foster a collaborative workplace culture that balances enterprise coherence with local agility, transforming complex architectural visions into scalable, real-world value.

Who you are:

• Educated with a Bachelor’s or Master’

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Accountant - Polish speaking (Fixed-term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term role for 1 year.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Polish

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Business & Program Management (BPM) Leader

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de la gestion des activités et des programmes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position Context & Scope

This position is designed for an energetic professional with a strong foundational track record in project execution who is looking to take a meaningful next step in their career. We are seeking candidates who excel at independently managing projects where the path to success is largely defined, yet requires skilled execution, active coordination, adaptability, adoption and value sustainment.
In this role, your primary impact will be ensuring seamless project delivery and driving user adoption, ensuring that timelines are met and immediate outcomes are successfully embedded into business workflows. While familiarity with structural frameworks is important, your day-to-day focus will lean heavily toward rigorous, practical execution and managing the "mechanics" of delivery.
This role offers a robust runway for long-term professional development; as you master these core outcomes, you will have a clear pathway to expand your scope, navigate increasingly ambiguous environments, and grow into broader strategic and enterprise-level responsibilities.
We welcome applications from accomplished project and change management professionals across all leadership profiles. Recognizing our need to scale capabilities in an increasingly data-driven environment, for one of our available positions we are specifically interested in candidates who can bridge the gap between technical teams—including software engineers and data scientists—and business execution. Experience or a strong understanding of Data Science and Analytics projects, coupled with demonstrated digital curiosity and broad knowledge in areas like Generative AI and Large Language Models, will be highly valued as a critical asset for success in this role.

As Business & Program Management Leader you will

• Partner with the business accountable and team to drive development of a vision and strategy for the molecule-enabling work.

• Scope, plan and execute the program/project roadmap to ensure solutions are adopted and intended value is realized within the agreed timeframe and in an iterative manner.

• Maintain accurate plans and documentation, ensuring that risks and issues are promptly captured, tracked, and communicated.

• Prepare clear data and status updates to support decision-makers, ensuring that governance meetings are productive and based on factual progress.

• Focus on consistent application of PPD delivery standards to keep a project running smoothly.

• Contribute to and manage team processes for development of critical deliverables.

• Enable informed decision making within the team, including facilitating decision points with governance bodies.

• Measure project specific outcomes in collaboration with Project Lead & Sponsor.

• Optimize team performance by enabling team norms, effective decision making, driving progress, meeting design/facilitation, simplifying processes/work

• Ensure the wider business is aware of the strategy/project and its impact, identifying risks and opportunities early.

• Ensure that impact assessments are accurate and stakeholders are kept informed.

• Support adoption by preparing leaders and teams through clear messaging about what's changing, why and what it means for them.

• Proactively flag potential adoption risks, ensuring the 'voice of the end-user' is represented in project decision-making. Identifies resistance at the end-user level and addresses it through clear communication.

Who You Are

• You are a talented and passionate

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Contesto di posizione & Scope Questa posizione è progettata per un professionista energico con un forte record di traccia fondamentale nell'esecuzione del progetto che sta cercando di fare un passo successivo significativo nella loro carriera. Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che eccellono a progetti di gestione indipendente in cui il percorso di successo è ampiamente definito, ma richiede esecuzione qualificata, coordinamento attivo, adattabilità, adozione e sostegno del valore. In questo ruolo, il vostro impatto primario sarà garantire la consegna senza soluzione di continuità del progetto e l'adozione dell'utente, assicurando che le linee temporali sono soddisfatte e i risultati immediati sono incorporati con successo in flussi di lavoro aziendali. Mentre la familiarità con i quadri strutturali è importante, la vostra attenzione quotidiana si appoggia pesantemente verso l'esecuzione rigorosa, pratica e la gestione della "meccanica" di consegna. Questo ruolo offre una robusta pista per lo sviluppo professionale a lungo termine; mentre si padroneggia questi risultati fondamentali, si avrà un percorso chiaro per espandere la vostra portata, navigare ambienti sempre più ambigui, e crescere in più ampie responsabilità strategiche e di livello aziendale. Accogliamo le applicazioni da professionisti del progetto e del cambiamento di gestione in tutti i profili di leadership. Riconoscendo la nostra necessità di scalare le capacità in un ambiente sempre più orientato ai dati, per una delle nostre posizioni disponibili siamo specificamente interessati ai candidati che possono colmare il divario tra team tecnici, inclusi ingegneri software e scienziati di dati, e l'esecuzione aziendale. L'esperienza o una forte comprensione dei progetti di Data Science e Analytics, insieme a una curiosità digitale dimostrata e ad una vasta conoscenza in settori come l'intelligenza artificiale genetica e i modelli di lingua di grandi dimensioni, saranno molto apprezzati come un bene critico per il successo in questo ruolo. Come Leader di Business & Program Management
• Collaborare con il business responsabile e il team per guidare lo sviluppo di una visione e una strategia per il lavoro di attivazione delle molecole.
• Scopo, pianificare ed eseguire la roadmap del programma/progetto per garantire che le soluzioni siano adottate e il valore previsto sia realizzato entro il timeframe concordato e in modo iterativo.
• Mantenere piani e documenti accurati, assicurando che i rischi e le questioni vengano rapidamente catturati, monitorati e comunicati.
• Preparare i dati chiari e gli aggiornamenti di stato per supportare i decisori, assicurando che le riunioni di governance siano produttive e basate su progressi fattivi.
• Focus sull'applicazione coerente degli standard di consegna PPD per mantenere un progetto in esecuzione senza intoppi.
• Contribuire e gestire i processi di team per lo sviluppo di materiali critici.
• Abilitare il processo decisionale informato all'interno del team, tra cui facilitare i punti decisionali con gli organi di governance.
• Misurare i risultati specifici del progetto in collaborazione con Project Lead & Sponsor.
• Ottimizzare le prestazioni del team abilitando le norme del team, il processo decisionale efficace, il progresso della guida, la progettazione/facilitazione delle riunioni, la semplificazione dei processi/lavoro
• Assicurarsi che il business più ampio sia consapevole della strategia/progetto e del suo impatto, identificare i rischi e le opportunità in anticipo.
• Assicurarsi che le valutazioni di impatto siano accurate e che gli stakeholder siano tenuti informati.
• Sostenere l'adozione preparando leader e team attraverso una chiara messaggistica su cosa sta cambiando, perché e cosa significa per loro.
• Proattivamente contrassegnare i potenziali rischi di adozione, assicurando che la voce dell'utente finale sia rappresentata nel processo decisionale del progetto. Identifica la resistenza a livello dell'utente finale e lo indirizza attraverso una comunicazione chiara. Chi sei
• Sei un talentuoso e appassionato

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Kontext und Geltungsbereich Diese Position ist für einen energetischen Profi mit einem starken Basis-Track-Record in der Projektausführung, die einen sinnvollen nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere zu nehmen. Wir suchen Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, die sich bei unabhängigen Managementprojekten auszeichnen, in denen der Erfolgsweg weitgehend definiert ist, aber qualifizierte Ausführung, aktive Koordinierung, Anpassungsfähigkeit, Adoption und Werterhaltung erfordert. In dieser Rolle wird Ihr primärer Einfluss darauf bestehen, dass die nahtlose Projektauslieferung und die treibende Nutzerannahme gewährleistet werden, dass Zeitlinien erfüllt werden und sofortige Ergebnisse erfolgreich in Geschäftsabläufe eingebettet werden. Während die Vertrautheit mit strukturellen Rahmenbedingungen wichtig ist, wird sich Ihr Tagesfokus stark auf strenge, praktische Ausführung und Verwaltung der "Mechanik" der Lieferung auswirken. Diese Rolle bietet eine robuste Start- und Landebahn für eine langfristige berufliche Entwicklung; als Sie diese Kernergebnisse meistern, werden Sie einen klaren Weg haben, um Ihren Umfang zu erweitern, zunehmend mehrdeutige Umgebungen zu navigieren und zu breiteren strategischen und unternehmerischen Verantwortlichkeiten zu wachsen. Wir begrüßen Anwendungen von abgeschlossenen Projekt- und Change Management-Profis über alle Führungsprofile. Erkennen wir unsere Notwendigkeit, Fähigkeiten in einer zunehmend datengetriebenen Umgebung zu skalieren, für eine unserer verfügbaren Positionen sind wir speziell an Kandidaten interessiert, die die Lücke zwischen technischen Teams – einschließlich Software-Ingenieure und Datenwissenschaftler – und Geschäftsausführung überbrücken können. Erfahrung oder ein starkes Verständnis von Data Science- und Analytics-Projekten sowie demonstrierte digitale Neugier und breites Wissen in Bereichen wie Generative AI und Large Language Models werden in dieser Rolle als kritischer Erfolgsfaktor hoch geschätzt. Als Business & Program Management Leader werden Sie
• Partner mit dem betriebswirtschaftlichen Verantwortlichen und Team, um die Entwicklung einer Vision und Strategie für die molekülübergreifende Arbeit voranzutreiben.
• Umfang, Plan und Durchführung der Programm-/Projekt-Roadmap, um sicherzustellen, dass Lösungen angenommen werden und der beabsichtigte Wert innerhalb des vereinbarten Zeitrahmens und in iterativer Weise realisiert wird.
• Bewahren Sie genaue Pläne und Unterlagen, um sicherzustellen, dass Risiken und Probleme sofort erfasst, verfolgt und kommuniziert werden.
• Bereiten Sie klare Daten und Statusaktualisierungen vor, um Entscheidungsträger zu unterstützen und sicherzustellen, dass Regierungssitzungen produktiv sind und auf sachlichen Fortschritten beruhen.
• Fokus auf konsequente Anwendung von PPD-Lieferstandards, um ein Projekt reibungslos laufen zu lassen.
• Teamprozesse für die Entwicklung von kritischen Lieferungen beizutragen und zu verwalten.
• Ermöglichen Sie eine fundierte Entscheidungsfindung innerhalb des Teams, einschließlich der Erleichterung von Entscheidungspunkten mit Leitungsorganen.
• Projektspezifische Ergebnisse in Zusammenarbeit mit Project Lead & Sponsor messen.
• Optimieren Sie die Teamleistung, indem Sie Team-Normen, effektive Entscheidungsfindung, Fahrfortschritt, Meeting Design/Facilitation, Vereinfachung der Prozesse/Arbeit
• Das breitere Geschäft ist sich der Strategie/Projekt und dessen Auswirkungen bewusst, Risiken und Chancen frühzeitig zu identifizieren.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Folgenabschätzungen korrekt sind und die Interessenvertreter informiert werden.
• Unterstützung der Adoption durch die Vorbereitung von Führern und Teams durch klare Botschaft über das, was sich verändert, warum und was es für sie bedeutet.
• Proaktiv Fahnen potenzieller Adoptionsrisiken, die Sicherstellung der "Abstimmung des Endbenutzers" ist in der Projektentscheidung vertreten. Erkennt den Widerstand auf der Endbenutzerebene und adressiert ihn durch eine klare Kommunikation. Wer bist du?
• Sie sind talentiert und leidenschaftlich
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Contexte et portée de la position Ce poste est conçu pour un professionnel énergique avec une solide expérience fondamentale dans l'exécution de projets qui cherche à faire un pas significatif dans leur carrière. Nous recherchons des candidats qui excellent dans la gestion indépendante de projets où la voie du succès est largement définie, mais qui nécessitent une exécution compétente, une coordination active, l'adaptabilité, l'adoption et le maintien en valeur. Dans ce rôle, votre principal impact sera d'assurer une exécution transparente des projets et d'encourager l'adoption par les utilisateurs, de s'assurer que les délais sont respectés et que les résultats immédiats sont intégrés avec succès dans les flux de travail opérationnels. Bien qu'il soit important de connaître les cadres structuraux, votre attention quotidienne sera fortement orientée vers l'exécution rigoureuse et pratique et la gestion de la « mécanique » de la prestation. Ce rôle offre une piste solide pour le perfectionnement professionnel à long terme; alors que vous maîtrisez ces résultats de base, vous aurez une voie claire pour élargir votre portée, naviguer dans des environnements de plus en plus ambigus et devenir des responsabilités stratégiques et d'entreprise plus larges. Nous accueillons les candidatures de professionnels de la gestion du projet et du changement dans tous les profils de leadership. Reconnaissant notre besoin d'étendre nos capacités dans un environnement de plus en plus axé sur les données, pour l'un de nos postes disponibles, nous sommes particulièrement intéressés par les candidats qui peuvent combler l'écart entre les équipes techniques, y compris les ingénieurs en logiciels et les data savants, et l'exécution des activités. L'expérience ou une bonne compréhension des projets Data Science and Analytics, conjuguée à une curiosité numérique démontrée et à de vastes connaissances dans des domaines tels que l'IA Generative et les grands modèles linguistiques, seront hautement valorisés comme un atout essentiel au succès de ce rôle. En tant que chef de la gestion des affaires et des programmes, vous
• S'associer avec l'entreprise responsable et l'équipe pour conduire le développement d'une vision et d'une stratégie pour le travail d'activation des molécules.
• Portée, planification et exécution de la feuille de route du programme/projet pour s'assurer que les solutions sont adoptées et que la valeur prévue est réalisée dans les délais convenus et de manière itérative.
• Tenir des plans et des documents précis, en veillant à ce que les risques et les problèmes soient rapidement saisis, suivis et communiqués.
• Préparer des données claires et des mises à jour de l'état d'avancement pour aider les décideurs, en veillant à ce que les réunions sur la gouvernance soient productives et fondées sur des progrès concrets.
• Mettre l'accent sur l'application cohérente des normes d'exécution de la DPP pour assurer le bon déroulement d'un projet.
• Contribuer et gérer les processus d'équipe pour l'élaboration de produits essentiels.
• Permettre la prise de décisions éclairées au sein de l'équipe, y compris en facilitant les points de décision avec les organes de gouvernance.
• Mesurer les résultats spécifiques du projet en collaboration avec le responsable du projet et le promoteur.
• Optimiser les performances de l'équipe en favorisant les normes de l'équipe, la prise de décision efficace, la progression, la conception/facilitation des réunions, la simplification des processus et du travail
• Veiller à ce que l'ensemble des entreprises soient conscientes de la stratégie/projet et de son impact, en identifiant rapidement les risques et les possibilités.
• Veiller à ce que les analyses d'impact soient exactes et à ce que les parties prenantes soient informées.
• Soutenir l'adoption en préparant les dirigeants et les équipes à travers des messages clairs sur ce qui change, pourquoi et ce que cela signifie pour eux.
• Signaler de manière proactive les risques potentiels d'adoption, en veillant à ce que la « voix de l'utilisateur final » soit représentée dans la prise de décision du projet. Identifie la résistance au niveau de l'utilisateur final et la traite par une communication claire. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un talentueux et passionné

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner, Oncology (Sumatra)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of Roche organization, directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

Your Opportunity
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) acts as a trusted partner and key point of contact for stakeholders involved in the Oncology patient journey across Sumatera. As the local face of Roche, the PJP works closely with healthcare professionals, healthcare institutions, and cross-functional Roche teams to better understand patient and healthcare system needs and improve patient outcomes.

In this role, you will:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare professionals and relevant stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to better understand patient and healthcare system needs

• Develop a deep understanding of the patient journey, including key challenges, unmet needs, and opportunities to improve patient care and access within the assigned therapeutic area

• Collaborate with cross-functional Roche teams to identify, develop, and implement solutions that create meaningful value for patients, stakeholders, and the broader healthcare community

• Support the appropriate and compliant use of Roche products by sharing scientific and product information in a truthful, balanced, and patient-focused manner

• Lead stakeholder engagement planning and execution based on customer insights, healthcare landscape understanding, and evolving patient needs

• Identify opportunities for collaboration that help address barriers within the healthcare system and improve patient outcomes and experiences

• Coordinate and mobilize the appropriate internal expertise, resources, and support to respond effectively to stakeholder needs while ensuring a positive experience with Roche’s people, products, and services

Who you are
You are passionate about improving patient outcomes and building meaningful partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem. You bring a collaborative mindset, strong stakeholder engagement capabilities, and the ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving healthcare environment.
You bring:

• A university degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Business, Economics, or a related field; an advanced degree such as an MBA is a plus

• Experience in stakeholder engagement within the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or related industry, with the ability to build trusted long-term partnerships

• Good understanding of the Indonesia healthcare system and the broader healthcare ecosystem

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical industry regulations, ethical standards, and compliance requirements in Indonesia

• Understanding of patient journeys, treatment pathways, and stakeholder dynamics within the Oncology area

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders and functions

• Strategic thinking, learning agility, and an interest in innovation and healthcare transformation to help improve patient outcomes

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

• Acte come socio di fiducia e punto principale di contatto (non esclusivo) tra gli attori dell-ecosistema e Roche. Convivendo la necessità della comunità dei pazienti e di altri attori, priorità e assicura i risorse, e promove soluzioni che pronounouno più risultati rapidi.
• Se associati e collaboraa con altri attori coinvolti nell'esperienza del paziente per eliminare gli ostacoli e sfruttare le opportunità di aggiungere valore ai pazienti e alla comunità.

• Questa funzione è valida ad attrarre esperienza e interna risorse a livello locale e di rete, secondo necessità, anche in collaborazioneazione con altri PJP.
• Garanzia eccellenti esperienze sempre che le parti interessate dell-ecosistema partecipano con gli impiegati di Roche e si relatzionino con i loro prodotti e servizi. --- Requisiti
• Titolo di studio: laurea in Scienze, Economico-Administrativo/Cienze della Salute. Studi avanzati in Scienze della Salute e/o MBA sono un vantaggio aggiuntivo.
• Esperienza diferenziale: conoscenza intermedia-avanzata dell'inglese.
• Competenza: capacità di comprendere ed utilizzare strumenti digitali.
• Conoscenza e visione del business: solida esperienza in commercializzazione, affari medici e eccellenza nella creazione di esperienze per i clienti.
• Habilità relazionali: eccellenti capacità di relazione con tutte le parti interessate, tra cui l'associazione con Expertos de Área Terapeutica (TAE) e organizzazioni, con profonto conoscenza dell'esperienza dei pazienti e dei trattamenti relativi a malattie speciciche, consenttentogli generare solidi legami a livello dispecialti.
• Conoscenza e esperienza: lavoro ravvicinato con il settore delle istituzioni privati (assicurazioni, torri di controllo, amministrazioni).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

The IT Business Analyst possesses in-depth knowledge of the pharma clinical data management business domain and understanding of data engineering & analytics technologies, operating at the intersection of business strategy, data, and technology needs.

In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of clinical trial data and real-world data (RWD) systems, translating business needs into system requirements, oversee initiatives with full autonomy and lead analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions to ensure efficient acquisition and management of clinical trial data.

Who we are:

These systems are critical to drug development, powering clinical data review, safety reporting, operational insights for clinical teams, and support early development activities in the REDs. They provide data to the Analytical Data Science’s ecosystems to standardize and analyze data for regulatory submissions. In addition, standardized clinical data from these systems are essential to integrate with Roche’s specialized data modality platforms including omics, clinical imaging, and digital health technologies.

A key focus in this area will be to leverage emerging AI technologies to optimize clinical data acquisition data pipelines. This includes enriching metadata and building AI-ready datasets to enable autonomous agentic and human-in-the loop AI systems which are transforming the drug development process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

L'Analista IT Business possiede una conoscenza approfondita del dominio aziendale della gestione dei dati clinici e della comprensione delle tecnologie dell'ingegneria dei dati e dell'analisi, che operano nell'intersezione della strategia aziendale, dei dati e delle esigenze tecnologiche.

In questo ruolo, si applicano sistemi che pensano di navigare la complessità dei dati di prova clinica e sistemi di dati reali (RWD), traducendo le esigenze aziendali in requisiti di sistema, supervisionando iniziative con piena autonomia e sforzi di analisi di piombo in spazi altamente ambigui. Facendo da consulente di fiducia per la leadership, si forma attivamente roadmap a lungo termine, guidare il consenso attraverso la comunicazione persuasiva, e consiglia soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali per garantire l'acquisizione efficiente e la gestione dei dati di prova clinica.

Chi siamo:

Questo team è responsabile della fornitura di sistemi software per l'acquisizione e il trattamento dei dati di prova clinica Roche, servendo come fonte di verità in Roche Pharma. I sistemi di base in questo settore includono la cattura elettronica dei dati di Roche (EDC) - Medidata Rave, sistemi non-CRF e magazzini di dati clinici.

Questi sistemi sono fondamentali per lo sviluppo della droga, l'alimentazione della revisione dei dati clinici, la segnalazione della sicurezza, le intuizioni operative per i team clinici e supportano le attività di sviluppo precoce nei RED. Essi forniscono dati agli ecosistemi di Analytical Data Science per standardizzare e analizzare i dati per le presentazioni normative. Inoltre, i dati clinici standardizzati da questi sistemi sono essenziali per integrare con le piattaforme di modalità dati specializzate di Roche, tra cui omics, imaging clinico e tecnologie per la salute digitale.

Un focus fondamentale in questo settore sarà quello di sfruttare le tecnologie AI emergenti per ottimizzare le pipeline di dati di acquisizione di dati clinici. Ciò include l'arricchimento dei metadati e la costruzione di set di dati pronti per l'IA per consentire l'agente autonomo e sistemi AI a ciclo umano-in-the che stanno trasformando il processo di sviluppo della droga.

L'opportunità:

• Leadership & Delivery: Analisi aziendale leader per iniziative o flussi di lavoro con autonomia, coordinamento della complessità e della scala. Definisce e conduce gli sforzi di analisi in spazi altamente ambigui, traducendo complessi requisiti di dati in mappe di processo, epici, caratteristiche e storie degli utenti.

• Risolvere i problemi: conduce l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, definendo lo spazio dei problemi e guidando l'analisi completa delle cause radice che possono abbracciare i confini organizzativi. Proattivamente previene lo scopo strisciante, gestisce la complessità di vari ambiti di cambiamento, ed è in definitiva responsabile per i risultati di analisi aziendali garantendo l'allineamento tra funzioni e sistemi dipendenti.

• Gestione degli stakeholder: Identificare e coinvolgere le parti interessate chiave, compresa la gestione, sia attraverso i confini IT che organizzativi aziendali. Forma la strategia come consulente affidabile per la leadership, naviga attivamente i conflitti per raggiungere l'allineamento e potenzia i team nella gestione degli stakeholder.

• Impact & Strategy: Incrementa un impatto significativo su progetti e programmi garantendo la fornitura di soluzioni ad alto valore che si allineano alla strategia aziendale. Conduce la valutazione delle opzioni di soluzione strategica, tra cui analisi del valore avanzato e valutazione del rischio, e forma attivamente roadmap a lungo termine.

• Complessità: Funziona tipicamente su più sistemi attraverso la sotto-funzione, gestire efficacemente i requisiti altamente ambigui ed evolutivi. Dimostra un punto di vista end-to-end per analizzare i problemi, considerando come i dati scorre attraverso

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

Der IT Business Analyst verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse des Geschäftsbereichs Pharma Clinical Data Management und das Verständnis von Data Engineering & Analytics-Technologien, die an der Schnittstelle von Geschäftsstrategie, Daten und Technologieanforderungen arbeiten.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie das Systemdenken anwenden, um die Komplexität von klinischen Studiendaten und realen Datensystemen (RWD) zu steuern, Geschäftsanforderungen in Systemanforderungen zu übersetzen, Initiativen mit voller Autonomie zu überwachen und Analysebemühungen in sehr mehrdeutigen Bereichen zu leiten. Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungskräfte gestalten Sie aktiv langfristige Roadmaps, fördern den Konsens durch überzeugende Kommunikation und empfehlen optimale Technologielösungen, um eine effiziente Erfassung und Verwaltung von klinischen Studiendaten zu gewährleisten.

Wer wir sind:

Dieses Team ist für die Bereitstellung von Softwaresystemen für die Datenerfassung und -verarbeitung von Daten aus klinischen Studien von Roche verantwortlich und dient als Quelle der Wahrheit für Roche Pharma. Zu den grundlegenden Systemen in diesem Bereich gehören die elektronische Datenerfassung (EDC) von Roche - Medidata Rave, Nicht-CRF-Systeme und klinische Data Warehouses.

Diese Systeme sind für die Arzneimittelentwicklung von entscheidender Bedeutung, unterstützen die Überprüfung klinischer Daten, die Sicherheitsberichterstattung, operative Erkenntnisse für klinische Teams und unterstützen frühe Entwicklungsaktivitäten in den REDs. Sie liefern Daten an die Ökosysteme von Analytical Data Science, um Daten für regulatorische Einreichungen zu standardisieren und zu analysieren. Darüber hinaus sind standardisierte klinische Daten aus diesen Systemen unerlässlich, um in die spezialisierten Datenmodalitätsplattformen von Roche integriert zu werden, darunter Omics, klinische Bildgebung und digitale Gesundheitstechnologien.

Ein Schwerpunkt in diesem Bereich wird darin bestehen, neue KI-Technologien zu nutzen, um klinische Datenerfassungs-Datenpipelines zu optimieren. Dazu gehören die Anreicherung von Metadaten und die Erstellung von KI-fähigen Datensätzen, um autonome Agenten- und Human-in-the-Loop-KI-Systeme zu ermöglichen, die den Medikamentenentwicklungsprozess verändern.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Business Analysis Leadership & Delivery: Führen Sie Geschäftsanalysen für Initiativen oder Workstreams mit Autonomie, Koordination von Komplexität und Skalierung. Definiert und leitet Analysebemühungen in sehr mehrdeutigen Räumen und übersetzt komplexe Datenanforderungen in Prozessmaps, Epics, Features und User Stories.

• Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von Geschäftsproblemen, definiert den Problemraum und führt eine umfassende Ursachenanalyse durch, die organisatorische Grenzen überspannen kann. Proaktiv verhindert Scope Creep, verwaltet die Komplexität verschiedener Änderungsbereiche und ist letztlich für die Ergebnisse von Geschäftsanalysen verantwortlich, die eine Ausrichtung zwischen Funktionen und abhängigen Systemen gewährleisten.

Stakeholder-Management: Identifiziert und bindet wichtige Stakeholder, einschließlich des Managements, über IT- und Unternehmensgrenzen hinweg ein. Gestaltet die Strategie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater der Führung, steuert aktiv Konflikte, um eine Ausrichtung zu erreichen, und stärkt Teams im Stakeholder-Management.

Impact & Strategy: Fördert erhebliche Auswirkungen auf Projekte und Programme, indem es die Bereitstellung hochwertiger Lösungen sicherstellt, die mit der Geschäftsstrategie übereinstimmen. Leitet die Bewertung strategischer Lösungsoptionen, einschließlich fortschrittlicher Wertanalyse und Risikobewertung, und gestaltet aktiv langfristige Roadmaps.

• Komplexität: Funktioniert typischerweise auf mehreren Systemen in der Subfunktion und verwaltet effektiv sehr mehrdeutige und sich entwickelnde Anforderungen. Demonstriert einen End-to-End-Standpunkt, um Probleme zu analysieren, wenn man bedenkt, wie Daten über
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Analyste des affaires en TI - R-D en pharmacie

L'analyste d'affaires en TI possède une connaissance approfondie du domaine commercial de la gestion des données cliniques pharmaceutiques et de la compréhension des technologies d'ingénierie et d'analyse des données, fonctionnant à l'intersection de la stratégie d'entreprise, des données et des besoins technologiques.

Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez la pensée des systèmes pour naviguer dans la complexité des données d'essais cliniques et des systèmes de données du monde réel, traduire les besoins des entreprises en exigences du système, superviser les initiatives avec pleine autonomie et diriger les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus. En tant que conseiller de confiance pour le leadership, vous élaborerez activement des feuilles de route à long terme, susciterez un consensus grâce à une communication convaincante et recommanderez des solutions technologiques optimales pour assurer l'acquisition et la gestion efficaces des données des essais cliniques.

Qui nous sommes :

Cette équipe est chargée de fournir des systèmes logiciels pour l'acquisition et le traitement des données des essais cliniques de Roche, servant de source de vérité à Roche Pharma. Les systèmes fondamentaux dans ce domaine comprennent la saisie électronique des données Roches (EDC) - Medidata Rave, les systèmes non CRF et les entrepôts de données cliniques.

Ces systèmes sont essentiels à la mise au point des médicaments, à l'examen des données cliniques, à l'établissement de rapports sur l'innocuité, à l'information opérationnelle des équipes cliniques et au soutien des activités de développement précoce dans les DER. Ils fournissent des données aux écosystèmes de la Science des données analytiques afin de normaliser et d'analyser les données pour les présentations réglementaires. De plus, les données cliniques normalisées de ces systèmes sont essentielles pour s'intégrer aux plateformes de modalités de données spécialisées de Roche, y compris l'omique, l'imagerie clinique et les technologies numériques de la santé.

L'un des principaux objectifs dans ce domaine sera de tirer parti des nouvelles technologies d'IA pour optimiser les pipelines de données d'acquisition de données cliniques. Il s'agit notamment d'enrichir les métadonnées et de créer des ensembles de données prêts pour l'IA afin de permettre aux systèmes autonomes d'agents et d'humains dans la boucle de transformer le processus de développement des médicaments.

La possibilité :

• Analyse d'entreprise Leadership & Livraison : Diriger l'analyse d'entreprise pour les initiatives ou les flux de travail avec autonomie, coordination de la complexité et de l'échelle. Définit et dirige les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus, traduisant les exigences complexes en données en cartes de processus, en épopées, en caractéristiques et en histoires d'utilisateurs.

• Résolution des problèmes : Dirige l'analyse des problèmes d'affaires, la définition de l'espace de problèmes et la conduite d'une analyse globale des causes profondes qui peut couvrir les limites organisationnelles. Prévient de façon proactive l'évolution de la portée, gère la complexité des divers champs de changement et, en bout de ligne, rend compte des résultats de l'analyse opérationnelle en assurant l'harmonisation entre les fonctions et les systèmes dépendants.

• Gestion des parties prenantes : identifie et mobilise les parties prenantes clés, y compris la gestion, au-delà des frontières informatiques et organisationnelles. Forme la stratégie en tant que conseiller de confiance pour le leadership, navigue activement dans les conflits pour atteindre l'alignement, et habilite les équipes dans la gestion des intervenants.

• Impact & Stratégie : Conduit un impact significatif sur les projets et les programmes en assurant la prestation de solutions de grande valeur qui s'harmonisent avec la stratégie opérationnelle. Dirige l'évaluation des options de solutions stratégiques, y compris l'analyse de valeur avancée et l'évaluation des risques, et élabore activement des feuilles de route à long terme.

• Complexité : fonctionne généralement sur plusieurs systèmes à travers la sous-fonction, gérant efficacement des exigences très ambiguës et évolutives. Démontre un point de vue de bout en bout pour analyser les problèmes, en considérant comment les flux de données

jobs.title: Stażysta / Stażystka ds. Logistyki
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Szukamy zorganizowanej i skrupulatnej osoby, która wesprze nasz zespół w zarządzaniu obiegiem używanego sprzętu medycznego. Będziesz kluczowym ogniwem w procesie procesowania zwrotów – od momentu odebrania paczki, przez jej cyfrową ewidencję, aż po koordynację wysyłki do naszej centrali w Niemczech.

Twoja Rola:

• Obsługa przesyłek przychodzących: Odbieranie oraz fizyczne segregowanie paczek reklamacyjnych trafiających do magazynu.

• Ewidencja cyfrowa: Wprowadzanie danych o przesyłkach do systemów operacyjnych ( SAP / Rexis ).

• Wstępna diagnostyka: Klasyfikacja urządzeń pod kątem zgłoszonych usterek i uszkodzeń aparatury medycznej.

• Logistyka międzynarodowa: Identyfikacja i przygotowanie wysyłki paczek o statusie „krytycznym” do centrali w Mannheim w celu dalszej ewidencji.

• Współpraca z zespołem: Bieżąca komunikacja z działem serwisu i logistyki.

O Tobie:

• Wykształcenie: Minimum średnie (zapraszamy również studentów w trakcie nauki).

• Dyspozycyjność: Możliwość pracy 2 dni w tygodniu (grafik do ustalenia).

• Zdolności analityczne: Umiejętność trafnej klasyfikacji usterki na podstawie dokumentacji i stanu faktycznego.

• Komunikatywność: Jasne przekazywanie informacji i umiejętność pracy w zespole.

• Doskonała organizacja: Umiejętność priorytetyzacji zadań i dbałość o porządek w dokumentacji systemowej.​

Oferujemy:

• Elastyczność: Idealna praca dla osób łączących naukę z życiem zawodowym.

• Cenne doświadczenie: Możliwość pracy w profesjonalnym środowisku opartym na systemie SAP .

• Wpływ na jakość: Realny udział w procesie zapewniania bezpieczeństwa aparatury medycznej.

• Międzynarodowe standardy: Współpraca z centralą w Niemczech i kontakt z nowoczesnymi technologiami medycznymi.

Dodatkowe informacje:

• Miejsce pracy: Magazyn Sprzętu Medycznego (Teresin)

• Typ umowy: Umowa zlecenie (16 godzin tygodniowo)

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl .

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .
​

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Warsaw. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Gestión global de proyectos relacionados con la instalación, soporte y mantenimiento del software de gestión integral del Tratamiento Anticoagulante Oral (y otros productos POC). El dispositivo informático facilita la gestión integral descentralizada de los pacientes en tratamiento anticoagulante oral, gracias a una aplicación web ágil y flexible (y otros productos POC como CGM y NaPOC Operations. Asimismo facilita la integración de la información con otros sistemas del Área Sanitaria gracias al uso de estándares de comunicación.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión de instalaciones y actualizaciones.

• Formación al cliente final.

• Apoyo al cliente en incidencias, dudas, nuevos proyectos, etc.

• Gestión Documental de los proyectos e instalaciones

• Gestión de las conexiones de instrumentos.

• Soporte a la red de ventas

Perfil requerido:

• Ingeniería Técnica o superior de Informática de Sistemas o Telecomunicaciones

• Inglés Nivel Medio

• Conocimientos mínimo técnicos de BBDD

• Conocimientos de sistemas Windows y Linux

• Persona comunicativa

• Disponibilidad para viajar (esporádicamente)

Perfil Deseado:

• Conocimientos técnicos de BBDD (SQL, MysQL y Oracle)

• Conocimientos mensajería HL7 y Motor integración Mirth

• Conocimientos de herramientas de ticketing

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
