jobs.title: R&D Business Tools Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.
We are seeking a R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist to join our global support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how —understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools , enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, change requests) for high-accuracy execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

• Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

• Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

• System Proficiency: Ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

•
• Prior experience in enterprise business applications is desirable (e.g., Electronic Document Management Systems, Learning Management Systems, or Project Management tools).

• Education a

jobs.title: Cross-Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Roche diagnostics has a broad portfolio of 1000+ products across several business areas that include our widely-used molecular, pathology, near patient care and core lab solutions in conjunction with our diagnostics and healthcare insights digital solutions.

The Portfolio Management team works as part of the Portfolio and Project Management group to help each of these areas track and manage their portfolio from a strategic vantage point.

As part of the Portfolio Management team, the Cross-Portfolio Managers think holistically about the Diagnostics portfolio to ensure that strategic trade-offs are made to realize our overall strategic imperatives. Cross-Portfolio Managers work closely with colleagues from the broader Portfolio Management team including our Business Insights & Analytics Maangers to to develop tools and derive insights relevant for effective portfolio management.

The Opportunity

• You work closely with Customer Area Portfolio Managers, Business Analytics & Insights Managers, Project Managers and Finance to drive portfolio transparency and generate relevant portfolio insights for decision making

• You improve available portfolio tools and generate relevant reports to support strategic portfolio management

• You ensure excellent portfolio management by placing individual portfolio decisions in the context of the broader pipeline

• You enable overview of critical portfolio interdependencies

• You lead dedicated strategy initiatives across and within the different Roche Diagnostics customer areas

• You maintain expert knowledge of industry trends, competition, and current/emerging technologies to guide overall portfolio management

• You coach other members of the team, develop new skills and provide ongoing, constructive feedback on performance and progress toward goals and expectations

Who you are

• You hold an advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, or business (ideally a PhD, MD, or MBA)

• You have 3+ years of work experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategic development preferred

• You have a proven track record of influencing and presenting complex strategic topics to senior management and key stakeholders

• You possess strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills, with a demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and build quantitative models

• You are skilled at distilling complex or abstract problems into succinct strategic frameworks and tactical plans

• You have the ability to influence senior leadership through active listening, excellent communication, and strong facilitation skills

• You can clearly articulate critical analytical findings to senior leadership and drug development teams

• You effectively facilitate discussions with business leaders and cross-functional teams to develop insights and drive alignment on strategic decisions

Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference in patients’ lives. Apply now and join us in making an impact!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare soluti

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Data Scientist - Applied AI

About Our Team: Partnering Digital Solutions

Join our Partnering Digital Solutions team, a strategic group focused on maximizing partnership impact through digital and AI-enabled ecosystems to advance the Pharma and DIA Partnering business. We are at the forefront of innovation - building scalable data infrastructure, applying advanced data engineering practices, and integrating cutting-edge external capabilities to accelerate decision-making and unlock business value.

Our work spans across multiple high-impact initiatives, from developing intelligent data products to enabling end-to-end AI workflows. Whether it’s structuring complex data ecosystems or collaborating with external research institutions, this is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data and AI at Roche by directly supporting key strategic decisions across our global Partnering organization.

Responsibilities

As a Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in shaping and delivering AI and machine learning capabilities across the Partnering Digital Solutions ecosystem. You will work closely with product owners, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to develop scalable machine learning models, intelligent workflows, and data-driven solutions that improve visibility, prioritization, operational efficiency, and strategic decision making.
This role focuses on applied AI, machine learning, predictive modeling, and operational intelligence rather than purely research-oriented AI. You will help translate complex business challenges into scalable AI and analytics solutions that create measurable business impact across partnering operations.

You will be responsible for:

Machine Learning & Applied AI Solutions

• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI-enabled solutions that support partnering activities such as opportunity prioritization, portfolio intelligence, forecasting, operational insights, and decision support.

• Apply advanced analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, and emerging AI techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver scalable intelligence capabilities across the partnering ecosystem.

Model Development & Experimentation

• Lead exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and performance evaluation for machine learning and AI-enabled solutions.

• Design and evaluate multiple modeling approaches, establish appropriate evaluation metrics, and optimize models for scalability, reliability, and business impact.

Business Problem Solving & Decision Support

• Partner closely with business stakeholders and product teams to translate complex business challenges into analytical approaches, machine learning solutions, and scalable intelligence capabilities.

• Support data-driven prioritization and strategic decision making through actionable insights, predictive models, and operational intelligence.

AI & Intelligence Enablement

• Collaborate with AI, data, and engineering teams to operationalize AI-enabled capabilities and support the adoption of scalable intelligence solutions across partnering platforms and workflows.

• Evaluate and apply modern AI techniques including predictive modeling, NLP, LLM-enabled workflows, and intelligent automation approaches to enhance partnering operations and decision making.

Data & Intelligence Development

• Design and develop analytics solutions, dashboards, KPIs, and intelligence capabilities that improve visibilit

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data Scientist - AI applicato Informazioni sul nostro team: Partnering Digital Solutions Unisciti al nostro team di Partnering Digital Solutions, un gruppo strategico focalizzato sulla massimizzazione dell'impatto del partenariato attraverso ecosistemi digitali e abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale per promuovere il business di Pharma e DIA Partnering. Siamo all'avanguardia nell'innovazione: la costruzione di infrastrutture dati scalabili, l'applicazione di pratiche di ingegneria dei dati avanzate e l'integrazione di capacità esterne all'avanguardia per accelerare il processo decisionale e sbloccare il valore aziendale. Il nostro lavoro si estende su più iniziative ad alto impatto, dallo sviluppo di prodotti di dati intelligenti per consentire flussi di lavoro AI end-to-end. Che si tratti di strutturare ecosistemi di dati complessi o di collaborare con istituzioni di ricerca esterne, questa è un'opportunità unica per contribuire a plasmare il futuro dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale a Roche sostenendo direttamente le decisioni strategiche chiave in tutta la nostra organizzazione globale Partnering. responsabilità In qualità di Data Scientist, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione e nella fornitura di capacità di apprendimento automatico e di intelligenza artificiale nell'ecosistema Partnering Digital Solutions. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti, ingegneri di dati, architetti e stakeholder aziendali per sviluppare modelli scalabili di machine learning, flussi di lavoro intelligenti e soluzioni basate sui dati che migliorano la visibilità, la priorità, l'efficienza operativa e il processo decisionale strategico. Questo ruolo si concentra sull'IA applicata, l'apprendimento automatico, la modellazione predittiva e l'intelligenza operativa piuttosto che l'IA puramente orientata alla ricerca. Ti aiuterà a tradurre complesse sfide aziendali in soluzioni scalabili AI e analytics che creano un impatto commerciale misurabile attraverso le operazioni di partner. Sarete responsabili di: Apprendimento della macchina & Soluzioni AI applicate
• Progettazione, sviluppo e distribuzione di soluzioni di machine learning e AI-enabled che supportano attività di partner come la priorità delle opportunità, l'intelligenza del portafoglio, la previsione, le intuizioni operative e il supporto decisionale.
• Applicare l'analisi avanzata, la modellazione statistica, l'apprendimento automatico e le tecniche AI emergenti per risolvere problemi aziendali complessi e fornire funzionalità di intelligenza scalabile in tutto l'ecosistema partner. Sviluppo del modello e sperimentazione
• Analisi dei dati esplorativi di piombo, ingegneria delle caratteristiche, selezione dei modelli, formazione, convalida e valutazione delle prestazioni per l'apprendimento automatico e soluzioni AI-enabled.
• Progettare e valutare più approcci di modellazione, stabilire metriche di valutazione appropriate e ottimizzare i modelli per scalabilità, affidabilità e impatto aziendale. Risolvere i problemi aziendali e sostenere le decisioni
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali e i team di prodotti per tradurre complesse sfide aziendali in approcci analitici, soluzioni di machine learning e capacità di intelligenza scalabile.
• Supporta la priorità dei dati e il processo decisionale strategico attraverso intuizioni attuabili, modelli predittivi e intelligenza operativa. AI & Intelligence Enables
• Collaborare con i team AI, i dati e l'ingegneria per gestire le funzionalità abilitate all'IA e supportare l'adozione di soluzioni di intelligenza scalabile attraverso piattaforme di partner e flussi di lavoro.
• Valutare e applicare tecniche AI moderne, tra cui la modellazione predittiva, NLP, flussi di lavoro abilitati a LLM, e approcci di automazione intelligente per migliorare le operazioni di partner e il processo decisionale. Sviluppo dei dati e dell'intelligence
• Progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni di analisi, dashboard, KPI e funzionalità di intelligenza che migliorano la visibilità

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Data Scientist - Angewandte KI Über unser Team: Partner Digitale Lösungen Begleiten Sie unser Partnering Digital Solutions Team, eine strategische Gruppe, die sich auf die Maximierung der Partnerschaft durch digitale und AI-fähige Ökosysteme konzentriert, um das Pharma- und DIA-Partnering-Geschäft voranzutreiben. Wir sind an der Spitze der Innovation - Aufbau skalierbarer Dateninfrastruktur, Anwendung fortschrittlicher Data Engineering-Praktiken und Integration moderner externer Fähigkeiten, um Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen und Unternehmenswert zu entsperren. Unsere Arbeit erstreckt sich über mehrere hocheffiziente Initiativen, von der Entwicklung intelligenter Datenprodukte bis hin zu endseitigen KI-Workflows. Ob es um die Strukturierung komplexer Datenökosysteme oder die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Forschungseinrichtungen geht, dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, die Zukunft von Daten und AI bei Roche zu gestalten, indem sie direkt wichtige strategische Entscheidungen in unserer globalen Partnerorganisation unterstützen. Aufgaben Als Data Scientist spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Gestaltung und Bereitstellung von KI- und maschinellen Lernmöglichkeiten im gesamten Partnering Digital Solutions-Ökosystem. Sie arbeiten eng mit Produkteigentümern, Data Engineern, Architekten und Business Stakeholdern zusammen, um skalierbare maschinelle Lernmodelle, intelligente Workflows und datengesteuerte Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Sichtbarkeit, Priorisierung, operative Effizienz und strategische Entscheidungsfindung verbessern. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf angewandte KI, maschinelles Lernen, prädiktive Modellierung und operative Intelligenz statt rein forschungsorientierte KI. Sie werden dabei helfen, komplexe Geschäftsherausforderungen in skalierbare KI- und Analyselösungen zu übersetzen, die messbare Geschäftsauswirkungen in Partnergeschäften schaffen. Sie sind verantwortlich für: Maschinen und Anlagen
• Entwicklung, Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von maschinellem Lernen und KI-fähigen Lösungen, die Partneraktivitäten wie Gelegenheitspriorisierung, Portfolio Intelligence, Prognosen, operative Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungsunterstützung unterstützen.
• Erzielen Sie fortschrittliche Analysen, statistische Modellierung, maschinelles Lernen und aufstrebende KI-Techniken, um komplexe Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen und skalierbare Intelligenzfunktionen im gesamten Partner-Ökosystem zu bieten. Modellentwicklung & Experimente
• Führende Datenanalyse, Feature Engineering, Modellauswahl, Schulung, Validierung und Leistungsbewertung für maschinelles Lernen und AI-fähige Lösungen.
• Konzipieren und evaluieren Sie mehrere Modellierungsansätze, erstellen Sie geeignete Bewertungsmetriken und optimieren Sie Modelle für Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Geschäftsauswirkung. Business Problemlösung und Entscheidungsunterstützung
• Partner eng mit Geschäftspartnern und Produktteams zusammen, um komplexe geschäftliche Herausforderungen in analytische Ansätze, maschinelle Lernlösungen und skalierbare Intelligenzfunktionen umzusetzen.
• Unterstützung der datengesteuerten Priorisierung und strategischen Entscheidungsfindung durch handlungsfähige Erkenntnisse, Prädiktionsmodelle und operative Intelligenz. KI & Intelligenz aktivieren
• Mit KI-, Daten- und Ingenieurteams zusammenarbeiten, um KI-fähige Fähigkeiten zu implementieren und die Einführung skalierbarer Intelligenzlösungen auf Partnerplattformen und Workflows zu unterstützen.
• Evaluierung und Anwendung moderner KI-Techniken, einschließlich prädiktiver Modellierung, NLP, LLM-fähige Workflows und intelligente Automatisierungsansätze zur Verbesserung der Partnerschaftsoperationen und Entscheidungsfindung. Daten- und Nachrichtenentwicklung
• Design und Entwicklung von Analyselösungen, Dashboards, KPIs und Intelligenz-Funktionen, die Visibilit verbessern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Scientifique des données - AI appliquée À propos de notre équipe: Partenaires Solutions numériques Rejoignez notre équipe de Solutions numériques partenaires, un groupe stratégique axé sur la maximisation de l'impact du partenariat grâce aux écosystèmes numériques et à l'IA pour faire progresser les activités de Partenariats Pharma et DIA. Nous sommes à l'avant-garde de l'innovation - construire une infrastructure de données évolutive, appliquer des pratiques avancées en matière d'ingénierie des données et intégrer des capacités externes de pointe pour accélérer la prise de décisions et débloquer la valeur commerciale. Notre travail s'étend à de multiples initiatives à impact élevé, depuis le développement de produits de données intelligents jusqu'aux flux de travail d'IA de bout en bout. Qu'il s'agisse de structurer des écosystèmes de données complexes ou de collaborer avec des institutions de recherche externes, il s'agit d'une occasion unique de contribuer à façonner l'avenir des données et de l'IA à Roche en appuyant directement les décisions stratégiques clés de notre organisation mondiale de partenariat. Responsabilités En tant que Data Scientist, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'élaboration et la fourniture de capacités d'IA et d'apprentissage automatique dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème des solutions numériques partenaires. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de produits, les ingénieurs de données, les architectes et les intervenants commerciaux pour développer des modèles d'apprentissage automatique évolutives, des workflows intelligents et des solutions axées sur les données qui améliorent la visibilité, la priorisation, l'efficacité opérationnelle et la prise de décisions stratégiques. Ce rôle est axé sur l'intelligence artificielle appliquée, l'apprentissage automatique, la modélisation prédictive et l'intelligence opérationnelle plutôt que sur la recherche. Vous aiderez à traduire des défis d'affaires complexes en solutions d'IA et d'analyse évolutives qui créent un impact commercial mesurable dans les opérations de partenariat. Vous serez responsable : Apprentissage automatique et solutions d'IA appliquées
• Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA qui soutiennent des activités de partenariat telles que la priorisation des opportunités, le renseignement de portefeuille, les prévisions, les perspectives opérationnelles et le soutien à la décision.
• Appliquer des techniques avancées d'analyse, de modélisation statistique, d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA émergentes pour résoudre des problèmes d'affaires complexes et fournir des capacités d'intelligence évolutives dans l'écosystème partenaire. Développement et expérimentation de modèles
• Diriger l'analyse des données exploratoires, l'ingénierie des caractéristiques, la sélection des modèles, la formation, la validation et l'évaluation des performances pour l'apprentissage automatique et les solutions compatibles avec l'IA.
• Concevoir et évaluer plusieurs approches de modélisation, établir des paramètres d'évaluation appropriés et optimiser les modèles pour l'évolutivité, la fiabilité et l'impact commercial. Résolution des problèmes d'affaires et soutien à la décision
• S'associer étroitement avec les parties prenantes et les équipes de produits pour traduire les défis complexes en approches analytiques, solutions d'apprentissage automatique et capacités d'intelligence évolutives.
• Appuyer la hiérarchisation axée sur les données et la prise de décisions stratégiques au moyen d'éléments concrets, de modèles prédictifs et de renseignements opérationnels. IA & Intelligence Activement
• Collaborer avec les équipes d'intelligence artificielle, de données et d'ingénierie pour opérationnaliser les capacités d'intelligence artificielle et soutenir l'adoption de solutions d'intelligence évolutives sur les plateformes de partenariat et les flux de travail.
• Évaluer et appliquer les techniques modernes d'intelligence artificielle, y compris la modélisation prédictive, la NLP, les flux de travail compatibles avec la LLM et les approches d'automatisation intelligentes pour améliorer les opérations de partenariat et la prise de décisions. Développement de données et de renseignements
• Concevoir et développer des solutions analytiques, des tableaux de bord, des KPI et des capacités de renseignement qui améliorent la visibilité

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist - Research & Development (Clinical Laboratories)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Procurement Specialist - Research & Development (Clinical Laboratories)
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Procurement Specialist in Clinical Laboratories, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

As a Procurement Specialist in Clinical Laboratories, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Clinical Laboratories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degre

jobs.title: Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join us at a pivotal moment in healthcare—one driven by our market-leading success and expansion strategy." As the UK market leader in immunohistochemistry (IHC) and Digital Pathology for Cellular Pathology/Histology, we work directly with healthcare partners to deliver essential products and solutions globally. We have a strong product portfolio, a clear pipeline for future success, and an excellent team.

Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, you will be joining our expanding sales team at an exciting time of growth. Due to our continued market success and expansion plans, we are recruiting an additional highly motivated individual to to play a vital part in reshaping the healthcare landscape. Your deep understanding of customer needs and our collaborative environment will ensure continued success in a highly impactful field.

The role

Thanks to our strong history of success we have an exciting opportunity for an additional highly motivated individual to join our Tissue Diagnostics sales team in the Central UK region, covering the West of Central England or Wales . You will be promoting the value proposition of our products with key clinical, procurement and finance stakeholders in West of Central England or Wales.
As part of your remit, you will mainly focus on:

• Taking a lead in the account sales strategy and execution for the product portfolio on you territory, you will work closely with Customer Account Managers, Product Specialists, Managed Laboratory Service Team and Workflow IT Specialists.

• Managing and coordinating complex pan pathology procurements, utilising self-discipline and a creative approach to ensure sales methodology is delivered on time and in full. This will involve engagement with all levels of the key decision making team, including senior management.

• Identifying market development and changes in NHS landscape on your territory (payment,procurement, tendering, and NHS processes) to maximise opportunities/minimise threats.

• Developing innovative strategies to retain existing Roche sites and acquire new sites.

Your profile

• Educated to BSc (Hons) /BA Degree or equivalent in a life science or with related experience such as a biomedical scientist background and preferably with previous experience of field sales/or knowledge of laboratories and the Roche Tissue Diagnostics product portfolio.

• You will be skilled in defining customer needs and building strong and effective relationships and have knowledge of best practices in Cellular pathology (especially IHC) and cancer pathways.

• In order to be effective in this role you will need to be resilient, tenacious and both adaptable and flexible to work within a changing environment.

• You have the blend of discipline to follow best practice and creativity to re-define what that looks like. You will understand barriers to acceptance of new solutions and be able to drive positive sales outcomes.

• You will be self-motivated, focused and methodical, with the ability to work alone, yet readily communicate and share knowledge to the team.

• You will have the ability to sell with high credibility and be able to turn strategy into actionable implementation.

• You will drive commercial excellence in your territory by using the latest digital sales engagement tools.

Why Join Us?

This is a fantastic opportunity to work within an exciting and diverse industry and within a highly successful team whilst developing and gaining invaluable knowledge and experiences in the process.

jobs.title: Innovation & Sustainability Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship in Innovation & Sustainability

For students in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences fields

Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world.

Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within?

The Position

As an intern, you will contribute to a project focused on research on assessing & reducing the environmental impact of synthetic polymer excipients in the Pharmaceutical Industry by identifying and evaluating safer biodegradable alternatives. The project explores how polymers used in pharmaceutical formulations may contribute to microplastic pollution in municipal water systems and aims to support more sustainable product design in light of evolving regulatory expectations such as EU REACH 2026. Within your first 3 months, you are expected to assess target polymers, research promising biodegradable substitute materials, analyze supplier and production feasibility, and contribute to a final technical report and strategic roadmap. Your work will support Roche’s sustainability ambitions by addressing biodiversity and water-related impacts, advancing sustainable products, and encouraging the use of more environmentally responsible raw materials. This internship offers a high-impact opportunity to work on an innovative topic at the intersection of pharmaceutical science, sustainability, and environmental protection.

The Opportunity

• Conduct a product-based preliminary analysis of target polymers

• Research and evaluate potential biodegradable alternatives for relevant synthetic polymer excipients

• Assess production feasibility and supply landscape for alternative materials, including scalability, supplier availability, quality standards, and regulatory considerations

• Compare synthetic and biodegradable options across environmental impact, ecotoxicity, pharmaceutical performance, and compliance criteria

• Explore how polymer choice influences product life cycle sustainability, from raw material sourcing through use and disposal

• Support the development of a strategic roadmap for improving or replacing selected synthetic polymers with more sustainable alternatives

• Prepare a final technical report and presentation summarizing findings, trade-offs, and recommendations

• Collaborate with stakeholders across functions to gather input and support a multidisciplinary evaluation process

Who You Are

You are enrolled or have completed your Master’s or PhD studies at a university, preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences within the last 12 months and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of at least 3 months.

Preferred Qualifications Are

• Familiar with bioprocesses, biochemical or biological

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Internship in Innovation & Sustainability For students in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences fields Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world. Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within? The Position As an intern, you will contribute to a project focused on research on assessing & reducing the environmental impact of synthetic polymer excipients in the Pharmaceutical Industry by identifying and evaluating safer biodegradable alternatives. The project explores how polymers used in pharmaceutical formulations may contribute to microplastic pollution in municipal water systems and aims to support more sustainable product design in light of evolving regulatory expectations such as EU REACH 2026. Within your first 3 months, you are expected to assess target polymers, research promising biodegradable substitute materials, analyze supplier and production feasibility, and contribute to a final technical report and strategic roadmap. Your work will support Roche’s sustainability ambitions by addressing biodiversity and water-related impacts, advancing sustainable products, and encouraging the use of more environmentally responsible raw materials. This internship offers a high-impact opportunity to work on an innovative topic at the intersection of pharmaceutical science, sustainability, and environmental protection. The Opportunity
• Conduct a product-based preliminary analysis of target polymers
• Research and evaluate potential biodegradable alternatives for relevant synthetic polymer excipients
• Assess production feasibility and supply landscape for alternative materials, including scalability, supplier availability, quality standards, and regulatory considerations
• Compare synthetic and biodegradable options across environmental impact, ecotoxicity, pharmaceutical performance, and compliance criteria
• Explore how polymer choice influences product life cycle sustainability, from raw material sourcing through use and disposal
• Support the development of a strategic roadmap for improving or replacing selected synthetic polymers with more sustainable alternatives
• Prepare a final technical report and presentation summarizing findings, trade-offs, and recommendations
• Collaborate with stakeholders across functions to gather input and support a multidisciplinary evaluation process Who You Are You are enrolled or have completed your Master’s or PhD studies at a university, preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences within the last 12 months and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of at least 3 months. Preferred Qualifications Are
• Familiar with bioprocesses, biochemical or biological

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Service Engineer – Medical Diagnostics (Stoke-on-Trent to Wrexham)
A Healthier Future. It’s What Drives Us.
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate, to continuously advance science, and to ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Together, we’re creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
Roche Diagnostics presents an exceptional opportunity for you to leverage your technical expertise while providing vital, life-saving support to our valued customers.
As an integral member of the Central Customer-Centric Field Support Team in the UK, this role offers the possibility of field-based assignments across Stoke and surrounding areas or focusing on a designated customer base. (North Wales, Shropshire, and Staffordshire)

The Opportunity: Technical Excellence in the Field
Ideal Location: Based out of Stoke or the surrounding areas to the west, with excellent access to motorway networks.
As a Field Service Engineer, your focus is to ensure the seamless operation and maximum uptime of Roche’s innovative Systems/Products, ranging from serum work area, pre/post analytics and our digital portfolio.
You will utilise a combination of on-site support and remote diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex electro-mechanical faults efficiently. Additionally, you will perform preventive maintenance and generate insightful reports to enhance operational efficiency across assigned customer sites.
Key Responsibilities

• Deliver Essential Support: Deliver electro-mechanical hardware support, including routine proactive and reactive tasks and technical training.

• Resolve Complex Faults: Perform troubleshooting and fault resolution, conduct preventive maintenance, and generate reports to enhance operational efficiency.

• Customer Training: Provide technical training and guidance to customers, enabling them to excel in the use of Roche diagnostic systems.

• Compliance & Administration: Maintain rigorous administration and regulatory documentation to ensure compliance and efficient service delivery.

• Stakeholder Management: Build productive relationships with peers and key stakeholders to align service and sales objectives seamlessly.

• Service Excellence: Attend internal review meetings to showcase progress, discuss objectives, and ensure service excellence.

Who you are
We are seeking resilient, adaptable, and customer-focused individuals who thrive on solving technical challenges and exceeding expectations. Ideally, you will bring:

• Educational Qualifications: A degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering is preferred. Candidates with equivalent experience at the HNC/HND level with a proven track record are also encouraged to apply.

• Experience: Extensive experience within the IVD industry, with a history of delivering exceptional technical support.

• Skills: Excellent analytical ability, self-motivation, advanced troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a collaborative team environment.

• Attributes: Resilience, tenacity, motivation to exceed customer expectations, and the ability to grow and mentor others through training, coaching, and continuous development.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Please submit your CV in English.
The role is based in Estonia.

As a Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP), you will serve as a strategic thought partner, advisor, and consultant to the business. You will ensure financial excellence and compliance in our daily operations while guiding decision-making on resource allocation. Your role is to bridge the gap between financial data and actionable strategy, ensuring that prioritized business areas receive the support necessary to deliver outstanding value to patients.

Key Areas of Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Strategic Partnering and Performance

• Support the local business planning, budgeting and forecasting in close collaboration with wider Baltics team.

• Guide strategic resource allocation decisions and oversee the financial performance of the affiliate’s operating expenses.

• Provide relevant insights and recommendations through regular performance reporting and dashboards to facilitate decision-making.

Local Stewardship, Governance & Operational Excellence

• Act as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics, and Roche's Code of Conduct while maintaining robust internal control standards.

• Oversee essential local financial tasks including payment approvals, local reporting and others as required.

• Serve as primary local contact for local government authorities

• Lead local tax compliance, including alignment of global requirement to local regulation (for example: impact calculations for co-payment schemes; dividend payment support; and preparation for statutory audits).

• Identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and efficiency gains in finance processes and systems.

• Support the organizational transition to updated ERP systems.

Cluster & Regional Collaboration

• Act as a role model for collaboration within the Baltic countries, ensuring a unified approach to financial challenges and opportunities.

• Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects and initiatives as business needs evolve within the Baltics and the wider region

• As part of the broader Finance community, participate in above-country squads to leverage network effects and achieve desired outcomes.

Who You Are

• Entrepreneurial Mindset : Proactively identify opportunities, take calculated risks, and drive innovative solutions to challenges.

• Strategic Agility : Ability to navigate both strategic and operational tasks while adapting to rapidly shifting priorities.

• Effective Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.

• Collaborative Influence : Ability to influence and work effectively with different teams and functions across the cluster and within the broader Roche finance community.

Qualifications & Experience

• University degree (Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field)

• Strong understanding of Estonian accounting and tax regulations

• 5+ years of relevant experience in Finance Business Partnering, Controlling or a similar strategic finance role

• Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or Healthcare sector is an advantage

• Experience with ERP systems, SAP highly preferred

• Fluent in Estonian and English (written and spoken)

jobs.title: Legal/Compliance Partner（社内弁護士）
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
募集要項：社内弁護士（法務・コンプライアンス部門）

職務の目的と使命

ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社の「Doing now what patients need next」という企業理念のもと、法務・コンプライアンス部門の一員として会社の法的及びコンプイアンスリスクを適切に管理し、事業の発展に貢献する職種です。 私たちの組織は、チームワークで貢献することを大切にしています。単なる法律解釈にとどまらず、組織一丸となって、業務の仕組み化やAIの活用や法務DXの推進を含めた運用の改善にも積極的に関わっていただける方を募集します。

主な職務内容

法務業務とコンプライアンス（法令遵守・企業倫理）業務の双方において、幅広い領域をバランスよくお任せします。

• 法務相談・契約関連業務
• 各事業部門からの法務相談への対応、および事業推進における良き相談相手としての支援

• 契約書の作成、審査、交渉の支援（高度な専門領域、海外や特定の法域が関わる契約、紛争の危険がある案件などへの対応）

• 外部弁護士との連携および委託業務の管理

• コンプライアンス・組織基盤への貢献
• 法令遵守・企業倫理全般の推進、各種研修や監査実務の実施

• 内部通報（適切な通報対応）に関する調査の支援

• 「判断基準の共有書庫」の整備など、部内の仕組み化（法務運用の効率化）への参画

求める経験・能力

• 必須要件
• 日本の弁護士資格をお持ちの方

• 仕事で使える水準の英語力（英語に対し高い学習意欲のある者でも可）（海外との連携、調査対応などで使用、目安：読み書きに加え、会議等で意思疎通が図れるレベ ル）

• 組織の一員としてお互いに「補い合い」、協調して業務を進められる高い協調性

• 法律知識だけでなく、組織への貢献や事業への深い理解を前向きに楽しめる姿勢

• 歓迎要件
• 弁護士としての実務経験（資料内では3〜7年程度を想定していますが、意欲や潜在能力も考慮します）

• 業界経験者、未経験共に歓迎です

求める人物像

• 組織として働くことに楽しみを感じる方

• チームワークを発揮することが好きな方

• 会社全体の変化を楽しみ、柔軟に適応・推進できる方

• 事業に寄り添い、会社の発展のために法律の観点から自発的に提案・貢献ができる方

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：社内弁護士（法務・コンプライアンス部門）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする
給与
　　 基本給（月額）：400,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）：22,000円～
　　 時間外固定手当（月額）：68,065円～（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　 ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　 ＜補足＞ ■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）
コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・その他
社会保険：　健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険

受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙

募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
La persona en este cargo actúa como vínculo de la compañía con las cuentas asignadas para favorecer la imagen corporativa y ofrecer propuestas de valor. Debe administrar las cuentas de manera rentable mediante la planeación de cuotas de venta, manejo de inventarios y negociaciones para cumplir los objetivos. Además, es responsable de desarrollar nuevos modelos de negocio e implementar estrategias para incrementar las ventas en instituciones públicas y privadas, gestionando proyectos con distribuidores y hospitales.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
● Lograr los objetivos de venta y participación de mercado mensuales, cuatrimestrales y anuales en las cuentas y territorios asignados.
● Realizar pronósticos de necesidades por producto y cuenta para maximizar el potencial de ventas del territorio.
● Implementar planes de acción para asegurar el desplazamiento del producto y ofrecer soluciones integrales.
● Desarrollar actividades de promoción visitando médicos, asociaciones, hospitales (Privados y Públicos) y distribuidores para detectar necesidades del mercado.
● Realizar análisis de datos para tomar decisiones estratégicas fundamentadas, reduciendo riesgos y aumentando la competitividad.

● Identificar oportunidades en sectores donde no se tiene presencia y desarrollar una propuesta comercial.

• Estudios universitarios completos y graduación son un requerimiento

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. An 11-month internship at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

In this internal customer-facing role, you will join the Finance team acting as a strategic partner to Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and other global functions for one academic year. RDT is our global community of technologists committed to designing the digital future of medicine. Your mission will be to guide the organization through solid financial stewardship, with a clear focus on results, productivity, and cross-functional business transformation initiatives.

You will have the opportunity to receive on-the-job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attending in-person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid. We are open to applications from all over Spain, but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to encourage collaboration, networking, and exposure to multidisciplinary teams and international stakeholders.

Last but not least, you will receive mentorship from a Roche tutor who will provide continuous feedback to support your professional development. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Main responsibilities as an intern:

As an active member of our finance squad, your work will directly impact our strategy by:

Organizational & Restructuring Support: Provide high-impact analytical and operational support to the RDT Finance Enterprise Partnering team during its global organizational restructuring process and other global functions.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate daily with global finance and technology teams on digital transformation initiatives, ensuring the standardization of internal processes and the exchange of best practices.

Strategic Partnering (Customer-facing) : Act as a strategic point of contact for RDT's global teams and product owners, facilitating their financial understanding and transforming complex financial data into agile, automated, and transparent tools.

Tactical Impact Monitoring: You will assist in tracking digital strategies and internal financial plans to ensure RDT aligns with Roche’s long-term healthcare vision. Through an entrepreneurial lens, you will help monitor financial flows and learn how daily technical and financial decisions create sustainable value.

What are we looking for?

> Academic Background: University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Business Administration (ADE), Finance, Economics , or dual degrees (e.g., ADE + Computer Engineering / Business & Technology / Data Analytics) that successfully bridge business and technology.

> Core Skills & Mindset:

• Financial & Business Mindset : Strong foundational analytical skills with the ability to see the story behind the numbers. Highly results-oriented, productive, and eager to quickly grasp the mechanics of the company’s value chain.

• Collaboration & Communication : Natural team player with the interpersonal skills needed to bridge the gap between finance and technical teams, translating financial data into simple, actionable insights across diverse cultures.

• Proactive Growth : An e

We are at the forefront of innovation - building scalable data infrastructure, enabling intelligent workflows, and integrating advanced AI capabilities to accelerate decision-making and unlock business value.

Our work spans multiple high-impact initiatives, including AI-enabled partnering solutions, intelligent data products, workflow automation, and enterprise-scale data and AI integrations. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of AI-enabled partnering at Roche by operationalizing innovative capabilities that directly support strategic decisions across our global Partnering organization.

Responsibilities

As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will play a critical role in enabling and operationalizing AI and intelligence capabilities across the Partnering Digital Solutions ecosystem. You will work closely with product owners, data engineers, Data Scientists, architects, and business stakeholders to implement scalable AI-enabled workflows, integrations, automation solutions, and intelligent applications that support partnering operations and decision making.

This role combines AI enablement, integration engineering, workflow orchestration, cloud-native solution development, and operationalization of AI capabilities at enterprise scale. In addition, the role offers opportunities to contribute to modern web application development and user-facing AI experiences where needed.

You will be responsible for:

AI Workflow & Solution Enablement

• Support the implementation and operationalization of AI-enabled solutions across partnering platforms and intelligence products.

• Develop and integrate AI workflows that support automation, decision support, insights generation, and orchestration of AI-enabled capabilities across the partnering ecosystem.

System Integration & API Development

• Develop and maintain APIs and integration services that connect AI capabilities, enterprise platforms, and data ecosystems.

• Enable seamless integration between internal platforms, external data sources, AI services, and workflow orchestration frameworks.

AI & Agent Integration:

• Support the integration of AI services, LLM-based applications, and agentic workflows into enterprise solutions and partnering processes.

• Collaborate with AI and data teams to operationalize intelligent capabilities and scalable automation workflows.

Cloud-Native Solution Development

• Build and deploy scalable services and integrations using cloud-native technologies and AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, and API-based architectures.

• Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and Roche security standards

Data & Platform Integration

• Support integration of structured and unstructured data sources across partnering platforms, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.

jobs.title: Project Manager CAPEX
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
With an eye to the future, we are actively shaping the continued development of the Roche site in Rotkreuz. The Engineering & Project department makes a vital contribution to this endeavor: It holds the responsibility for the strategic advancement of the site and all capital investments in buildings and facilities (CAPEX). This encompasses complex construction projects as well as the realization of infrastructure and modern process plants in the areas of production and research. In all our activities, we place particular emphasis on sustainability, safety (SHE), quality, and cost-effectiveness.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you are responsible for:

• Accountable that the project design and execution meets project objectives outlined in the approved Credit Application, URB, URS, project charter, PEP (scope, functionality, capacity, cost, schedule, SHE, sustainability, maintenance & reliability, quality, construction safety)

• Establish, onboard and lead the engineering team, coordinate their activities and acquire the necessary resources

• Ensure compliance with corporate and site directives / SOP’s, local laws and building codes

• Implement project controls (scope, cost, schedule, progress, risk, change mgmt.) and ensure monthly cost and schedule forecast of the project (PMR) from PI to HO

• Report project status, key issues and corrective actions to project SC on a regular basis

Who you are:

• Bachelor or Master/University degree in engineering, construction, etc.

• Min 5-10 years work experience as project manager in capital projects

• Experience managing DIA process projects.

• Excellent collaboration, teambuilding and communication skills at all levels of the project

• Proven ability to lead large teams working in a matrix environment

• Very good understanding of customer needs

• Excellent project mgmt and planning skills

• Very good analytical and problem solving skills

Be part of our 'Engineering & Project' team in Rotkreuz, apply now !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Software Developer (C#) for a hybrid engineering (75%) and Scrum Master (25%) role in Spain. You will take ownership of the full software development lifecycle - leveraging your deep expertise in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 to build high-performance applications - while also guiding the development team through Agile principles as a servant leader.
If you thrive on navigating ambiguity, utilizing modern AI-supporting tools, and are passionate about both exceptional code quality and team empowerment, this is the perfect opportunity to make a lasting technical impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering & Development (75%)

• Software Development Lifecycle : Participate fully in all phases of software development, including feasibility studies, design, development, testing, bug fixing, and ongoing software maintenance.

• Design & Implementation: Produce unit and subsystem specifications based on software requirements, project architecture, and guidelines. Accurately design and implement code, including the necessary tests to verify functionality against specifications.

• Team Collaboration & Planning: Self-organizing and proactive in defining, estimating, planning, and implementing work packages within the development team. Provide timely work status updates and issue notifications to the team and project management.

• Quality Assurance & Review: Conduct thorough reviews and analysis of personal source code and, upon request, the source code of peers. Review application design, functionality, usability, and performance to drive enhancements.

• Ambiguity Management: Possess the ability to navigate ambiguity and maintain forward progress.

• Role Type: Function as a Fullstack Developer.

Scrum Master Responsibilities (25%)

• Act as a servant leader for the development team, applying Scrum principles to facilitate progress, resolve conflicts, and increase transparency.

• Empower the team by removing blockers and applying proven Agile techniques to drive continuous improvement.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who excels at navigating ambiguity and taking end-to-end ownership of technical problems. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about data-heavy infrastructure, and thrive when facilitating team progress and empowering others to succeed.

Qualifications & Skills:

Education and General Experience

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT,

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Manufacturing Operator contributes to producing reliable products and supplies with effective operations in an empowered organization. As part of a dynamic team, the Manufacturing Operator is responsible for collaborating with their team to operate automated equipment and systems to perform a wide variety of complex tasks related to assembly, printing, fill and kitpack manufacturing operations.

The Manufacturing Operator recognizes and elevates safety, equipment, and product problems, contributing to the achievement of production goals. Utilizes validated software and systems to maintain processes, batch records, and inventory control. Ensures all production related documentation is in compliance with quality system regulations. May be responsible for low complexity training of new employees and sharing best practices. They must have good communication and organizational skills and the ability to identify opportunities that would drive the business forward.

This is an essential position supporting the organizational goals requiring attendance on weekends, holidays, and during emergency or exceptional conditions.

Responsibilities:

Production

◦ Executes the process of assembly, filling, labeling & packaging equipment of varying complexity and in accordance with production manufacturing records, operating procedure requirements to produce finished intermediates and final kits while meeting production targets.
◦ Performs basic transactions within highly complex systems and controls in a regulated manufacturing environment (e.g., receive, process, build product/materials, facilitate material availability, SAP transactions/confirmations).
• ◦ Runs automated systems/equipment and sequences of operation, including: equipment setup, operation, and cleaning; monitoring and performing basic troubleshooting.
• ◦ Participates in the execution of protocol/validations.
• ◦ Maintains the ability to be a subject matter expert (SME) in one or more areas of production.
• ◦ Contributes to daily end-of-shift reports and pass downs.

Safety and Quality

◦ Maintains Right to Operate and ensures that all processes are performed in a safe and healthy manner; Addresses and escalates any potentially unsafe hazards; Provides feedback during investigation of safety hazards, incidents, and near misses using safety reporting tools.
• ◦ Performs tasks/transactions in the quality system to ensure we achieve our quality objectives.
• ◦ Understands the expectations of audit readiness (OSHA, FDA, QSR, GMP, ISO, etc.); may be required to answer questions about processes on the spot.
• ◦ Maintains accurate and complete system transactions, ensuring material traceability, and inventory accuracy (e.g., receipt, storage, issuance of materials, and other inventory transactions).
• ◦ Provides feedback on NCR investigations, reworks, and corrective actions.
• ◦ Adheres to 95% or above internal training compliance

Continuous Improvement

• ◦ Performs 6S activities, gathers/meets cycle times, and develops/follows standard work; identifies and implements process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives utilizing lean tools.
• ◦ Participates and contributes in tier meetings.
• ◦ May participate in the collection of data for daily metrics purposes and to support operational excellence initiatives and improvements.
• Teamwork and Collaboration
• ◦ Proactively collaborates with peers in other shifts/functions to ensure daily targets are achieved.
• ◦ Assists in the successful onboarding of new employees and contractors.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Backend Python Engineer to build robust, scalable APIs and services that power our digital products in the life sciences sector. Working closely with our Frontend/UX team and Data Scientists, you will design the backend infrastructure required to process, manage, and serve complex bioinformatics and machine learning data.

In this highly collaborative role, you will tackle challenges ranging from optimizing database queries for massive datasets to architecting cloud-native solutions on AWS. We value engineers who are comfortable exploring complex data structures, establishing clean API boundaries, and ensuring high reliability as we scale our platforms to support critical scientific innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain high-performance, asynchronous backend services and robust RESTful APIs.

• Architect, deploy, and manage scalable and secure cloud infrastructure, utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.

• Design efficient database schemas, manage complex data relationships, execute seamless migrations, and ensure performant query optimization for massive datasets.

• Build and maintain data pipelines to ingest, normalize, and process large volumes of structured and unstructured scientific and bioinformatics data.

• Champion engineering excellence by writing clean, testable code, implementing comprehensive automated testing, and maintaining reliable CI/CD pipelines.

• Partner directly with the UX/Frontend team to establish seamless API integrations, and collaborate with Data Scientists to bring machine learning models into production workflows.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who thrives on solving complex backend challenges. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about clean API boundaries, and excel at transforming data infrastructure to drive meaningful progress.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with Python as your primary language.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including robust API design and experience building and scaling RESTful systems.

• Solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, schema migrations, and query optimization.

• Proven experience building, deploying, and managing scalable infrastructure in cloud environments, ideally utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• A strong focus on code quali
