jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a visionary Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer to shape the future of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this hybrid leadership role, you will be the driving force behind the user interfaces and complex dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

Operating at the intersection of UX design and high-performance frontend engineering, you will translate complex bioinformatics, PCR, and sequencing data into intuitive, lightning-fast web applications. If you are passionate about building scalable UI architectures and graphing millions of data points to drive scientific innovation, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture:

• Act as the bridge between UX, Frontend, and Backend teams, driving architecture and design discussions to establish robust technical solutions and API designs (REST/GraphQL).

• Lead the end-to-end frontend implementation of enterprise-scale business applications deployed on AWS.

• Mentor and guide junior frontend engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, code quality, and continuous learning.

UX Engineering & System Design:

• Own the user experience for highly complex data tools, ensuring seamless workflows for data scientists and researchers.

• Champion, maintain, and expand our internal component library (R-Design System) to ensure visual consistency across all products.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/SCRUM environment to map out user journeys and interface requirements.

Advanced Frontend & Data Visualization:

• Build scalable, responsive, and highly interactive frontends using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS.

• Architect high-performance data visualization solutions capable of rendering millions of data points smoothly in the browser using D3.js.

• Interface directly with AWS cloud services and help shape backend interface requirements.

Who You Are
You are an engineering champion and a collaborative technical leader who is passionate about leveraging technology to transform medicine. You thrive when navigating ambiguity, enjoy solving complex data challenges, and excel at empowering your team through technical mentorship.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript MVC frameworks, with deep, proven expertise in Vue.js.

• Strong practical experience with D3.js, including optimizin

jobs.title: Office & Workplace Experience Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Our office at Trattnerhof 1 isn’t just a place to work; it’s a three-floor hub of digital innovation and collaboration. We are looking for a proactive Team Lead to lead our office squad and ensure our physical environment keeps pace with our digital evolution.

As our Office & Workplace Experience Lead , you won't just manage a front desk (which we don’t have, btw); you will be the architect of our "Office-as-a-Service" philosophy. You will lead a team of three people and manage external vendors to provide a world-class experience for our employees and the many global visitors who call our office their favorite place to work.

The Anchor of our Hub: While many of our roles offer high flexibility for remote work, the nature of this leadership position requires a consistent on-site presence. You are the face of the office and the primary caretaker of our physical culture, ensuring that whether it's a Monday morning or a high-stakes workshop Friday, the site is buzzing and functional.

Your upcoming mission

• Lead & Empower: Mentor and lead our Office Team (3 people), fostering a culture of service excellence and proactive problem-solving.

• Global Collaboration Host: Orchestrate the experience for global Roche partners and international visitors. From high-level workshops to cross-site collaboration weeks, you ensure every visitor feels the unique welcoming energy of our site.

• Workspace Innovation: Continuously improve our 3-floor office for hybrid usage. You’ll find creative ways to make our space work for both high-energy collaboration and global virtual meetings.

• Building & Facility Management: Take full ownership of building maintenance, improvements, and construction projects. You’ll be the point of contact for external providers and contractors.

• Employee Experience: Maintain the spirit and continuously improve our space for our 250+ on-site staff, ensuring our office reflects our vibrant culture from the moment someone walks through the door.

Essential skills for your mission:

• You are a "people person" with a technical backbone. You understand that a broken coffee machine is a crisis, but a poorly planned office layout is a strategic hurdle.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years of relevant work experience

• Experience: You have a proven track record in Office Management, Facility Management, and Project Management, preferably within a professional digital or tech-heavy environment.

• Language Skills: You have native-level German skills (essential for local vendor management and legal compliance) and excellent English (our "official" company language and the key to greeting our global partners).

• Leadership Style: You lead with empathy and a "can-do" attitude. You enjoy being "where the action is" and thrive on the daily interactions that come with being on-site while always keeping the big picture in mind.

• Hospitality Mindset: You treat office management like premium hospitality, anticipating the needs of workshop facilitators and ensuring our facilities support seamless collaboration.

• Organizational Talent: You can juggle multiple projects at once without losing your cool.

Bonus skills:

• Experience with office construction project management

• Experience in a corporate / global environment

What to expect:

• Ambitious and passionate people building m

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Timkl est une entreprise de services en santé de nouvelle génération née en 2019 d’une démarche soutenue par le groupe Roche , acteur majeur de la santé en France et premier investisseur dans l’innovation santé. Nous proposons une prestation de suivi renforcé pour tous les patients diabétiques sous insulinothérapie par pompe, y compris ceux équipés des systèmes les plus innovants, comme la boucle fermée.

Notre modèle est aujourd’hui accessible sur tout le territoire français hexagonal. Il est co-construit avec les acteurs de soins, parmi lesquels : les pharmaciens, les infirmiers libéraux, les diabétologues et les médecins généralistes.

Tu as le goût du challenge ?
Tu souhaites t'impliquer dans le développement d’un modèle innovant pour améliorer la prise en charge des personnes vivant avec un diabète? Prends part à cette aventure au sein d'une équipe motivée et dynamique.

Responsabilités Principales :

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe marketing / ventes, tes missions auront pour objectif d’aider à la stratégie et au pilotage de l’activité commerciale :

• Réseaux Sociaux : Accompagnement pour le lancement de Timkl sur le réseau Instagram

• Communication Partenaires : Lancement des Newsletters Professionnels de Santé

• Relation Presse : aide à la rédaction de communiqué de presse selon l’actualité, travailler la relation avec les journalistes de l’environnement diabète

• GSite - intranet interne: Mise à jour des pages en appliquant la charte graphique et en s’assurant auprès des "page owner" que les informations sont à jour.

• Veille marché & environnement France : Nourrir les équipes marketing, ventes et administration commerciale des évolutions de marché, des concurrents et des nouvelles tendances. Analyser et traiter les chiffres clés du marché grâce à des bases de données en open data)

• Veille presse : mise en place d’un processus de partage auprès collaborateurs Timkl sur l’environnement diabète.

Idéalement, tu correspondes au profil suivant :

• Tu prépares actuellement un diplôme d'étude supérieur pour valider votre cursus M2 (Domaines: Ecole de commerce / Business intelligence : ).

• Tu es dynamique, autonome, organisé(e)

• Tu as la capacité de manipuler des données et des chiffres, avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux business opérationnels et de la collaboration avec des organisations transversales.

• Tu fais preuve d’agilité dans l’utilisation d’Excel et dans la représentation des données sous forme de graphiques.

• Tu possèdes une vision stratégique, une curiosité naturelle et des compétences en analyse de marché.

• Tu as des connaissances d’un outil de CRM (Salesforce ou autre).

• Tu démontres une capacité d’analyse et de synthèse.

Poste basé à Montbonnot (Isère, 38)

Stage de 6 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 /
Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
● Nous considérons les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
● Tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler en amont de l’entretien.
● Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact et l’avancée pour la santé de tous.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature

jobs.title: Pathology Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pathology Solutions Specialist

The Opportunity:

The Pathology Solutions Specialist in Tissue Diagnostics is responsible for protecting and growing the High Medical Value IHC portfolio and research market share. Implements sales plans designed to achieve established revenue and financial goals. Knows and understands the Advanced Staining competitive landscape including product, sales tools, and pricing for Roche Pathology Lab and all competitors. Leverages current business relationships to maintain and grow current customer base. Works in coordination with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers to call on perspective and current customers. Works closely with Account Managers to sell capital equipment to most prominent health systems, hospitals and reference laboratories, either via capital expenditures or bundling with reagents.

Has a complete knowledge of company products and services, and is viewed as an expert by the company and customers. May be tasked with sales of new or strategic products. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise. Focuses on critical, large, complex, high-visibility, strategic or tactically important accounts. Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments.

Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field based role - the territory includes: OH, PA & WV . Candidate must reside within 50 miles of the territory border. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role.

Job Facts:

• Assumes an active leadership role during the development and implementation of capital equipment sales strategies to attain assigned sales objectives. Intimacy with company and competitive market dynamics.

• Provides professional leadership in planning, organizing, and controlling balanced sales growth, continued account penetration, and customer satisfaction.

• Utilizes strong product/market knowledge and sales experience to manage complex sales and resolve customer questions and concerns.

• Continuously builds knowledge of current industry trends, competitive information, and industry/technical knowledge and shares with other Roche colleagues.

• Responsible for the effective management of sales funnel by identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Establishes and works with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers to build strong client relationships that allow for growth, profitability and predictability. Communicates with other relevant Roche functions to ensure needed sales support and delivery of programs/products.

• Effectively utilizes internal sales and operations support teams to advance the sale.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience required with the highest level of sales proficiency

Preferred:

• PhD or Master's Degree

• Expertise in competitive business and instrumentation, reimbursement landscape, and all other product lines.

• Leadership presence and business acumen with an understanding of the IHC and Anatomic Pathology laboratory landscape and the ability to create/drive solutions with others.

• Proven success in previou

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Specialista delle Soluzioni di Patologia L'Opportunità Il Specialista delle Soluzioni di Patologia in Diagnostica tissutale è responsabile della protezione e dell'aumento della quota di mercato dei prodotti ad alto valore medico IHC e di ricerca. Implementa i piani di vendita progettati per raggiungere gli obiettivi di logica e finanziaria stabilità. Conosce e comprende il panorama competitivo delle colorazioni avanzate, inclusi prodotti, strumenti di vendita e prezzi per Roche Pathology Lab e tutti i concorrenti. Utilizzare i rapporti commerciali esistenti per mantenere e aumentare la base di clienti esistenti. in coordinamento con gli Account Manager e gli Strategic Account Manager per contattare i clienti potenziali e esistenti. a stretto contatto con gli Account Manager per vendere l'attrezzatura di capitale alle principali strutture sanitarie, ospedali e laboratori di riferimento, tramite acquisti di capitale o bundle con i reagenti. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e dei servizi dell'azienda e viene considerato un esperto dall'azienda e dai clienti. Essere incaricati delle vendite di nuovi o prodotti strategici. sui problemi di ampia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede l'evaluazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella selezione dei metodi e delle tecniche per ottenere le soluzioni. Si connette con il personale interno ed esterno nel proprio campo di competenza. Si concentra sui conti critica, di grandi dimensioni, complessi, ad alta visibilità, strategici o tatticamente importanti. Agisce in modo indipendente per determinare i metodi e le procedure per i nuovi o speciali incarichi. È responsabile del mantenimento e dell miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e dell'ottenimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso le azioni quotidiane. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo - il territorio includono: OH, PA & WV. Il candidato deve stabilire entro 50 miglia dal confine del territorio. Non sono previsti beneficiari di trasferimento per questo ruolo. Il lavoro del lavoro * Assume un ruolo di leadership attiva durante lo sviluppo e l'implementazione delle strategie di vendita dell'attrezzatura di capitale per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita assegnati. Conoscenza completa dell'azienda e della dinamica del mercato competitivo. * Indicae una leadership professionale nella pianificazione, nell'organizzazione e nel controllo della crescita delle vendite bilanciate, della ricerca continua dei conti e della soddisfazione del cliente. * Utilizza la forte conoscenza del prodotto/mercato e l'esperienza di vendita per gestire le vendite complesse e risolvere le domande e le intenzioni dei clienti. * Continua a costruire la conoscenza delle attuali tendenze del settore, delle informazioni competitive e della conoscenza tecnica del settore e la condivisione con i poteri di Roche. * È responsabile della gestione efficace della pipeline delle vendite attraverso l'accettazione delle opportunità e la creazione e l'implementazione delle soluzioni. * Stabilisce e lavora con gli Account Manager e gli Strategic Account Manager per costruire relazioni con i clienti forti che permettono la crescita, la conseguente e la prevedibilità. Comunica con le altre funzioni di Roche pertinenti per garantire il supporto alle vendite e la consegna dei programmi/prodotti. * Utilizza in modo efficace i team interni di supporto alle vendite e alle operazioni per avanzare la vendita. Chi sei? * Hai un Diploma di Laurea o un'esperienza equivalente * Hai 5+ anni di esperienza di vendita o equivalente, con il più alto livello di professionalità nelle vendite Preferito: * Dottorato o Master * Esperienza nella concorrenza aziendale e nell'istrumentazione, nel paesaggio del rimborso e in tutte le altre linee di prodotti. * Presenza di leadership e acume per gli affari con una comprensione del paesaggio IHC e di Patologia anatomica e la capacità di creare/driven

Lavora a stretto contatto con gli Account Manager per vendere l'attrezzatura di capitale alle principali strutture sanitarie, ospedali e laboratori di riferimento, tramite acquisti di capitale o bundle con i réactifi. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e dei servizi dell'azienda e viene considerato un esperto dall'azienda e dai clienti. Potrebbe essere incaricato delle vendite di nuovi o prodotti strategici. jobs.title: Team Lead Clinical Trial Payment Operations

titleByLocale.it: Capo Team Clinical Trial Payment Operations
titleByLocale.en: Team Lead Clinical Trial Payment Operations
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe Clinical Trial Payment Operations

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Team Lead Clinical Trial Payment Operations
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

The Team Lead Clinical Trail Payment Operations will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating the payment-related activities for our Clinical Studies within the team. This includes managing the team, ensuring efficient operations, handling people management tasks, and cultivating relationships with stakeholders and customers. The role demands a combination of payment expertise and leadership competencies to drive the team's performance and meet organizational standards and objectives.

Your Opportunity

Team Coordination and Management:

• Coordinate and manage the team’s daily activities in payment processing and related tasks

• Perform people management activities, including onboarding, offboarding, training, and development of team members

• Facilitate regular team meetings to ensure smooth communication and collaboration

• Provide functional expertise and guidance to the team, sharing knowledge and best practices

Payment Processing Activities:

• Oversee the regional processing of payments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies

• Monitor payment-related KPIs, quality, and budget adherence

• Track performance, compliance, costs, and deviations in payment processes

• Actively participate in the day-to-day operations of payment processing

Stakeholder and Relationship Management:

• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships to ensure satisfaction and alignment with business objectives

• Act as a primary point of contact for stakeholder inquiries and concerns

• Manage outsourcing activities and relationships with external service providers

Regulatory and Compliance:

• Ensure all payment activities are in line with legal, regulatory, and company standards and codes of practice

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements

• Implement and monitor compliance measures within the team

Who You Are:

• The ideal candidate should be motivated and skilled professional with a solid background in financial processes, particularly in calculating and processing complex payments and team leadership

• You should thrive in dynamic environments, have exceptional problem-solving abilities, and possess a strong commitment to both team and stakeholder satisfaction

• You should bring a collaborative approach, excellent communication skills, and a validated track record of leadership success

• You are someone who holds University degree in Finance, Accounting, or related business discipline with 2-3 years of team management and practical experience in payment processing or related financial activities

• Proficiency in SAP, MDMS, and other approval tools

Leadership Competencies:

• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated success in team coordination and stakeholder management. Alternatively, you are an identified talent showing high growth potential in leadership and are ready to take the first steps into leadership

• Proven ability to provide guidance and support to team members in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, and a growth mindset

Skills:

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Proficiency in English

• Ability to interpret and analyze payment-related data and performance metrics

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

Personal Attributes:

• Agile mindset to adapt to changing circumstances and handle ambiguou

jobs.title: Product Manager, Neurology & Core IA

titleByLocale.it: Product Manager, Neurologia e Core IA

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Product Manager, Neurology & Core IA

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Who We Are:
Core Lab Marketing is a place for passionate leaders who are determined to make an impact for patients, customers and for the organization. We aspire to deliver better health outcomes for all patients by providing comprehensive solutions to Core Laboratories supporting Integrated Health Networks and Reference Labs. We are committed to creating a positive culture and focus on the values of the team and its members. We take responsibility for our actions and deliver on our commitments, while also prioritizing work/life balance to ensure everyone thrives both personally and professionally. The team emphasizes learning and development and we empower team members to speak openly.

We represent Roche’s commitment to lead with science in order to develop transformational solutions that help improve patient outcomes and simplify lab operations. As the Core Lab market leader in the US, the Core Lab team excels at the identification, commercialization and the full end-to-end management of reagent solutions that enable our customers to deliver on their overarching priorities, including improving patient outcomes.

The Opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced professional who is driven by deep customer insights and strong business acumen to bring value to laboratorians, physicians, and patients in the Neurology and Core Immunoassay portfolios - drivers of over $300M in annual revenue. As a key owner of these portfolios, the PM is responsible for developing a comprehensive portfolio/product strategy, identifying product requirements and market potential for new IVD and Research Use Only solutions in partnership with Global and US colleagues, and maintaining and growing all on-market Neurology and Core IA solutions in the US.

This role requires proven technical prowess, exceptional project management and prioritization skills, written and verbal communication, and the ability to lead and influence without authority. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills are crucial, as this role collaborates with numerous business partners - Marketing, Sales, Customer Insights, Finance, Pricing, MSA, RSN, Customer Service, Regulatory, Supply and Demand Planning, Global, and other key stakeholders. This individual will be the technical expert and the voice of the customer, ensuring our portfolio remains competitive, high-quality, and a leader within the market.

This is a pivotal time in the Neurology space. Roche’s Neurology portfolio continues to be a fast-evolving market, with Core IA being a highly stable revenue driver. The Product Manager plays a significant role in the long-term success of both of these areas.

Job Facts:

• The Product Manager, Neurology, RUO& Core IA portfolios, reports to the Group Marketing Manager and serves as a member of the Reagents team - a team responsible for the product management of all Clinical Chemistry and Immunoassay products

• Responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive portfolio/product strategy that includes product requirements, pricing strategy, and launch logistics to accomplish business objectives

• Responsible for gathering customer insights and utilizing those insights to influence the g

jobs.title: Estágio em Finanças - Propostas Comerciais
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Estagiário(a) de Finanças e Propostas Comerciais você terá a oportunidade de criar impacto sendo essencial para o time, auxiliando na criação, revisão e envio das propostas comerciais da afiliada. Se você tem vontade de aprender e possui os requisitos necessários, junte-se a nós para aprimorar-se continuamente em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

A Oportunidade:

• Você elabora e acompanha as propostas comerciais para a equipe de Diagnóstica, oferecendo uma visão financeira estratégica para as demandas dos clientes.

• Você auxilia na revisão, no acompanhamento e no controle das propostas com os clientes, contribuindo ativamente para o cumprimento das cláusulas financeiras estabelecidas.

• Você gerencia stakeholders de diferentes áreas e realiza conexões com marketing, vendas e finanças para garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais da companhia.

• Você apoia o uso de ferramentas para o gerenciamento e acompanhamento contínuo dos indicadores gerenciais (KPIs).

• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários e atua diretamente nas suas implementações.

• Você colabora com a equipe de pricing na execução, análise e definição das estratégias de precificação para produtos e serviços.

• Você suporta o time de finanças na preparação das análises de rentabilidade e de preços.

• Você prepara apresentações e mantém uma interface clara e contínua com a equipe de liderança.

Quem você é:

• Você possui habilidade colaborativa, gosta de lidar com pessoas, tem comunicação clara e assertiva e se adapta facilmente a contextos de mudanças.

• Você demonstra agilidade no aprendizado, foco e organização nas atividades processuais, e proatividade para buscar melhorias.

• Você está cursando o Ensino Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas (a partir do 2º ano de formação).

• Você possui forte habilidade analítica, facilidade com números e dados, e extrema atenção aos detalhes.

• Você tem conhecimento intermediário em Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, etc.) e valoriza o trabalho em equipe em seu dia a dia.

Diferenciais:

• Você tem conhecimento prático em ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, SQL, Python, R).

• Você possui nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado para interações corporativas.

Benefícios de recolocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Direct Sales Manager- Diagnostics Roche
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what ma kes us Roche.
This role is based in the Diagnostics division where we focus on sustaining and increasing market share in existing accounts through high-value medical solutions. We operate with a customer-centric and holistic approach, delivering innovative proposals to our key stakeholders, clients, and patients to drive long-term business growth and sustainability.

The Opportunity

As the Direct Sales Manager, your main focus will be to achieve commercial objectives by innovating, co-creating, and identifying new business opportunities. You will build deep relationships with key accounts to implement comprehensive, high-value medical diagnostic solutions.

• You plan and execute commercial growth strategies in existing and new markets by interpreting data and utilizing market insights.

• You build and maintain strategic networking relationships with high-level account stakeholders, including C-level executives, presidents, financial directors, medical directors, and laboratory heads.

• You monitor and manage institutional budgets, expenditures, and revenues to protect and maximize organizational profitability.

• You design effective commercial strategies, tailored sales presentations, and communication action plans that address specific client needs.

• You collaborate cross-functionally with internal departments such as Logistics, Production, and Finance to ensure solutions align with operational capabilities.

• You analyze the competitive landscape, target markets, and public/private market data to identify differentiators and increase overall market share.

• You manage and lead engagement spaces with potential new clients to expand relationships and secure new business opportunities.

• You negotiate commercial conditions, evaluate operational or legal risks, and implement continuous improvement actions to maximize customer satisfaction.

​
Who you are

• You hold a University Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

• You possess years of professional experience within the Diagnostic Industry.

• You possess years of successful experience in commercial, sales management, or marketing functions & p roven track record of leading high-performance teams.

• You have a strong strategic and systemic vision, with the proven ability to interpret complex market data and translate it into successful action plans.

• You demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communication skills, allowing you to easily build environments of trust and manage stress effectively.

• You are highly motivated, adaptive to change, resilient, and thrive in an Agile and collaborative team environment.

• Advanced English and Spanish are required for this role.

Location: Based in Quito, Ecuador.
Reporting to: Commercial Director of Diagnostics.

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

• Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 50% overnight travel.
Our ideal candidate would reside in Omaha, Nebraska.
Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering

• Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Requirements

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Nebraska is $71,100- $132,000 annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

jobs.title: Business Partner (Advisory) Team Lead (Mandarin Speakers)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Business Partner (advisory) Team Lead, you will lead a team of Business Partners (advisory) in the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization within one of the regions. The Business Partner (advisory) partners flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, the Business Partner (advisory) provides coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensures effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters.

Working closely with P&C colleagues, this leader will lead 13 BPAs spread across different countries, supporting different enterprises and an open and diverse work culture based on trust and performance. Your activities uphold Roche's reputation as an attractive employer – today and going forward.

• Team Leadership and Culture: Manage all employment decisions (hiring, development, performance, compensation), establish the team's budget, act as an escalation point, and build an engaging culture aligned with Roche Leadership commitments.

• Service Delivery: Ensure high customer and employee satisfaction by providing urgent, high-quality, end-to-end P&C solutions and successfully completing cases and projects.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with PSS teams, P&C chapters, and enabling functions (Finance, IT, Procurement) across regions to ensure consistent and effective service delivery and global consistency.

• Strategic P&C Guidance (Business Acumen): Offer immediate, short-term strategic guidance to leaders on core P&C needs like succession, talent management, performance, and compensation, leveraging P&C experts for timely solutions.

• Process and Compliance: Consult, advise, and train leaders on global P&C processes and system topics (e.g., new system launches, global grading), ensuring alignment with policies and compliance with legislative requirements.

• Trusted Partner in P&C Areas (Leadership): Serve as a trusted partner to leaders, diagnosing and proposing fit-for-purpose approaches for complex P&C topics (e.g., talent, compensation, change management, conflict resolution).

• Data-Driven Insights and Innovation: Oversee the analysis of P&C/business data and metrics (e.g., turnover, talent review data) to inform critical decisions, proactively address organizational needs, and recommend innovative solutions.

Who you are

In this position, you will be leading a team of Business Partners (advisory) focusing on an area of practice(s). You will be working with stakeholders from various functions and across levels within the organization. Strong leadership competencies and demonstrated success in change management are critical.

You bring the following skills and competencies:

• P&C Expertise and Business Acumen: Requires a passionate, knowledgeable P&C professional with the ability to navigate the P&C system, leverage different functions for business impact, and use data/insights for problem-solving and innovation in a fast-paced, global, and virtual environment.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Security and Compliance Expert, ERP Data Platform
Are you passionate about Information Security and Compliance, specifically in ERP environments with a focus on data integrity and governance? Join a global team where you'll lead the change as a Security and Compliance expert in optimizing processes through experience and automation.
The Mission
Your primary mission is to ensure that the organization's technology landscape, data practices, and security measures do not expose the business to legal penalties, financial loss, or reputational damage. As a recognized expert, you will implement and maintain security, authorization, and compliance standards for SAP ERP platform systems and data products, providing leadership across both on-premise and cloud SAP Data platform ecosystems.

The Opportunity

• Platform Security: Implement and maintain security, authorization, and compliance standards for SAP platforms (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA, and SAP Datasphere). Develop and mature capabilities in cloud compliance and security, particularly within SAP Datasphere.

• Regulatory Alignment & Framework Management: Continuously monitor relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) and industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) to ensure the platform remains ahead of global compliance requirements.

• Policy Development & Data Governance: Drive the creation and refinement of internal policies and data governance frameworks to maintain high standards of integrity, security, and structured data handling.

• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Deputy and Control Owner , taking accountability for the end-to-end ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting) lifecycle, GxP controls, and other relevant regulations.

• Monitoring & Remediation: Lead weekly and monthly monitoring of SoD (Segregation of Duties) conflicts via GRC dashboards, work with SoD Champions to mitigate risks, and address non-compliant items flagged in the SAP Security Standards Roche documentation.

• System Integrity: Oversee application error reviews (e.g., failed jobs) and sign off on monitoring results in tools like ICAt to provide evidence for control checks.

• Access Governance: Perform quarterly reviews of Critical access , GRC FireFighter roles (Controllers, Owners, Admins), and HANA DB users, initiating timely removals to maintain a "least privilege" environment.

• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR IT audit support by defining control activities, approving auditor documentation, and acting as the primary point of contact for auditors during peak cycles (Sep/Oct).

• Strategic Direction: Set technological development directions by analyzing and implementing new solutions, tools, and IT standards, with a focus on data governance, validation, and automation.

• Risk Assessment: Annually review and update the System Risk Assessment (SRA) and Data Classification to ensure alignment with the Minimum Security Baseline.

• Process Optimization: Actively conduct innovation projects to optimize processes, introduce new solutions, and increase efficiency through automation in Data products.

• Collaboration: Partner with system teams and stakeholders to ensure task ownership, bridge data privacy awareness gaps, and onboard/train new team members on ICFR control activities.

Who You Are

• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, IT, or Engineering with a minimum of 5 years’ post-secondary experience in SAP Security and a deep understanding of Compliance.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esperto di sicurezza e conformità, piattaforma dati ERP Sei appassionato di sicurezza e conformità dell'informazione, in particolare negli ambienti ERP con un focus sull'integrità e la governance dei dati? Unisciti a un team globale in cui guiderai il cambiamento come esperto di sicurezza e conformità nell'ottimizzazione dei processi attraverso l'esperienza e l'automazione. La missione La vostra missione primaria è garantire che il paesaggio tecnologico dell'organizzazione, le pratiche di dati e le misure di sicurezza non espongono l'azienda a sanzioni legali, perdita finanziaria, o danni reputazionali. In qualità di esperto riconosciuto, implementerai e manterrai standard di sicurezza, autorizzazione e conformità per i sistemi e i prodotti di dati della piattaforma SAP ERP, fornendo leadership sia sugli ecosistemi della piattaforma SAP Data on-premise che sul cloud. L'opportunità
• Sicurezza della piattaforma: implementare e mantenere standard di sicurezza, autorizzazione e conformità per le piattaforme SAP (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA e SAP Datasphere). Sviluppare e maturare funzionalità nella conformità e nella sicurezza del cloud, in particolare all'interno di SAP Datasphere.
• Allineamento normativo e gestione quadro: monitorare costantemente le normative pertinenti (ad esempio, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) e gli standard del settore (ad esempio, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) per garantire che la piattaforma resti davanti ai requisiti di conformità globali.
• Politica di sviluppo e governance dei dati: guidare la creazione e la raffinatezza delle politiche interne e dei quadri di governance dei dati per mantenere elevati standard di integrità, sicurezza e gestione dei dati strutturati.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Vice and Control Owner , tenendo conto della responsabilità del ciclo di vita ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting), dei controlli GxP e di altre normative pertinenti.
• Monitoraggio e riparazione: Condurre il monitoraggio settimanale e mensile dei conflitti SoD (Segregation of Duties) tramite cruscotti GRC, lavorare con SoD Champions per mitigare i rischi e affrontare gli elementi non conformi contrassegnati nella documentazione di SAP Security Standards Roche.
• Integrità di sistema: supervisionare le recensioni degli errori delle applicazioni (ad esempio, lavori falliti) e firmare il monitoraggio dei risultati in strumenti come ICAt per fornire prove per i controlli di controllo.
• Access Governance: Eseguire recensioni trimestrali di accesso critico , GRC FireFighter ruoli (Controllers, Owners, Admins), e HANA DB utenti, avviando rimozioni tempestive per mantenere un ambiente "meno privilegio".
• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR Il supporto dell'audit IT definendo le attività di controllo, approvando la documentazione dell'auditor e fungendo da punto di contatto primario per gli auditor durante i cicli di picco (Sep/Oct).
• Direzione strategica: Impostare le direzioni di sviluppo tecnologico analizzando e implementando nuove soluzioni, strumenti e standard IT, con un focus sulla governance dei dati, la convalida e l'automazione.
• Valutazione del rischio: rivedere e aggiornare annualmente la valutazione del rischio di sistema (SRA) e la classificazione dei dati per garantire l'allineamento con la Baseline di sicurezza minima.
• Ottimizzazione dei processi: condurre attivamente progetti di innovazione per ottimizzare i processi, introdurre nuove soluzioni e aumentare l'efficienza attraverso l'automazione dei prodotti Data.
• Collaborazione: Partner con i team di sistema e le parti interessate per garantire la proprietà delle attività, colmare le lacune di consapevolezza della privacy e formare nuovi membri del team sulle attività di controllo ICFR. Chi sei
• Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea in Informatica, IT o Ingegneria con un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza post-secondaria in SAP Security e una profonda comprensione della conformità.

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Sicherheits- und Compliance-Experte, ERP-Datenplattform Sind Sie leidenschaftlich über Informationssicherheit und Compliance, speziell in ERP-Umgebungen mit dem Fokus auf Datenintegrität und Governance? Begleiten Sie ein globales Team, in dem Sie den Wandel als Sicherheits- und Compliance-Experte bei der Optimierung von Prozessen durch Erfahrung und Automatisierung vorantreiben. Die Mission Ihre Hauptaufgabe ist es, sicherzustellen, dass die Technologielandschaft der Organisation, Datenpraktiken und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen das Geschäft nicht auf rechtliche Strafen, finanziellen Verlust oder Rufschäden aussetzen. Als anerkannter Experte implementieren und pflegen Sie Sicherheits-, Berechtigungs- und Compliance-Standards für SAP ERP-Plattformsysteme und Datenprodukte, die sowohl über On-Premise- als auch Cloud-Systeme der SAP Data-Plattform führen. Die Chance
• Plattformsicherheit: Umsetzung und Aufrechterhaltung von Sicherheits-, Berechtigungs- und Compliance-Standards für SAP-Plattformen (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA und SAP Datasphere). Entwickeln und reifen Fähigkeiten in der Cloud-Compliance und -Sicherheit, insbesondere in SAP Datasphere.
• Regulatorische Ausrichtung & Rahmenmanagement: Kontinuierlich relevante Regelungen (z.B. DSGVO, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) und Industriestandards (z.B. ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) überwachen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Plattform weiterhin den globalen Compliance-Anforderungen entspricht.
• Policy Development & Data Governance: Die Schaffung und Verfeinerung interner Politiken und Data Governance-Frameworks, um hohe Standards an Integrität, Sicherheit und strukturiertem Datenhandling zu erhalten.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Deputy and Control Owner , unter Berücksichtigung der Verantwortung für den end-to-end ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting) Lebenszyklus, GxP-Kontrollen und andere relevante Vorschriften.
• Monitoring & Sanierung: Führen Sie wöchentliche und monatliche Überwachung von SoD-Konflikten (Segregation of Duties) über GRC-Dashboards, arbeiten mit SoD-Champs zusammen, um Risiken zu mindern und nicht-konforme Objekte, die in der SAP-Sicherheitsstandards Roche-Dokumentation markiert sind, anzusprechen.
• Systemintegrity: Übersehen Sie die Fehlerbeurteilungen der Anwendung (z.B. gescheiterte Arbeitsplätze) und melden Sie sich bei der Überwachung der Ergebnisse in Werkzeugen wie ICAt an, um Nachweise für Kontrollkontrollen zu liefern.
• Access Governance: Führen Sie vierteljährliche Bewertungen von Critical Access, GRC FireFighter Rollen (Controller, Eigentümer, Admins) und HANA DB-Nutzer aus, die rechtzeitige Entfernungen zur Aufrechterhaltung einer "Least Privileg"-Umgebung einleiten.
• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR IT-Audit-Unterstützung durch Definition von Kontrolltätigkeiten, Genehmigung der Auditor-Dokumentation und als primärer Ansprechpartner für Auditoren während der Spitzenzyklen (Sep/Oct).
• Strategische Richtung: Setzen Sie technologische Entwicklungsrichtungen durch Analyse und Implementierung neuer Lösungen, Tools und IT-Standards, mit einem Fokus auf Daten-Governance, Validierung und Automatisierung.
• Risikobewertung: Jährliche Überprüfung und Aktualisierung der System-Risikobewertung (SRA) und der Datenklassifizierung, um die Anpassung an die Mindestsicherheit Baseline sicherzustellen.
• Prozessoptimierung: Aktive Durchführung von Innovationsprojekten zur Optimierung von Prozessen, Einführung neuer Lösungen und Steigerung der Effizienz durch Automatisierung in Datenprodukten.
• Zusammenarbeit: Partner mit Systemteams und Stakeholdern, um Aufgabeneigentum zu gewährleisten, Datensicherheitslücken zu überbrücken und neue Teammitglieder auf ICFR-Kontrolltätigkeiten zu trainieren. Wer bist du?
• Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, IT oder Engineering mit mindestens 5 Jahren postsekundärer Erfahrung in SAP Security und einem tiefen Verständnis der Compliance.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Expert en sécurité et conformité, ERP Data Platform Êtes-vous passionné par la sécurité et la conformité de l'information, en particulier dans les environnements ERP, en mettant l'accent sur l'intégrité et la gouvernance des données? Rejoignez une équipe mondiale où vous dirigerez le changement en tant qu'expert en sécurité et conformité dans l'optimisation des processus par l'expérience et l'automatisation. La Mission Votre mission principale est de s'assurer que le paysage technologique, les pratiques en matière de données et les mesures de sécurité de l'organisation n'exposent pas l'entreprise à des pénalités légales, à des pertes financières ou à des dommages à sa réputation. En tant qu'expert reconnu, vous appliquerez et maintiendrez des normes de sécurité, d'autorisation et de conformité pour les systèmes et les produits de données SAP ERP, assurant ainsi un leadership à la fois sur site et dans les écosystèmes de la plateforme SAP Data Cloud. L'opportunité
• Sécurité des plateformes: Mettre en œuvre et maintenir des normes de sécurité, d'autorisation et de conformité pour les plateformes SAP (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA et SAP Datasphere). Développer et développer des capacités en matière de conformité et de sécurité cloud, en particulier dans SAP Datasphère.
• Alignement de la réglementation et gestion du cadre: surveiller en permanence les réglementations pertinentes (par exemple, RGPD, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) et les normes de l'industrie (par exemple, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) afin de s'assurer que la plateforme reste en avance sur les exigences mondiales de conformité.
• Développement des politiques et gouvernance des données: Favoriser la création et le perfectionnement de politiques internes et de cadres de gouvernance des données pour maintenir des normes élevées d'intégrité, de sécurité et de traitement structuré des données.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Agir en tant que propriétaire de système adjoint et propriétaire de contrôle, en prenant la responsabilité du cycle de vie de bout en bout ICFR (contrôle interne des rapports financiers), des contrôles GxP et d'autres règlements pertinents.
• Surveillance et réparation: Diriger la surveillance hebdomadaire et mensuelle des conflits de SoD (ségrégation des fonctions) via les tableaux de bord du GRC, travailler avec les champions de SoD pour atténuer les risques et traiter les éléments non conformes signalés dans la documentation SAP Security Standards Roche.
• Intégrité du système: Surveiller les examens d'erreurs d'application (par exemple, les emplois échoués) et signer le suivi des résultats dans des outils comme ICAt pour fournir des preuves pour les contrôles.
• Gouvernance de l'accès : Effectuer des examens trimestriels de l'accès critique, des rôles de FireFighter du GRC (Contrôleurs, Propriétaires, Administrateurs) et des utilisateurs de HANA DB, en initiant des suppressions en temps opportun pour maintenir un environnement « le moins privilégié ».
• Leadership de l'audit : chef de file du CIRF Soutien à la vérification de la TI en définissant les activités de contrôle, en approuvant la documentation de l'auditeur et en agissant comme principal point de contact pour les vérificateurs pendant les cycles de pointe (sept/oct).
• Orientation stratégique: Définir des orientations de développement technologique en analysant et en mettant en œuvre de nouvelles solutions, outils et normes informatiques, en mettant l'accent sur la gouvernance des données, la validation et l'automatisation.
• Évaluation des risques : Revoir et mettre à jour chaque année l'évaluation des risques du système et la classification des données afin d'assurer l'alignement sur la base minimale de sécurité.
• Optimisation des processus : Mener activement des projets d'innovation pour optimiser les processus, introduire de nouvelles solutions et accroître l'efficacité grâce à l'automatisation des produits Data.
• Collaboration: partenariat avec les équipes du système et les parties prenantes pour assurer l'appropriation des tâches, combler les lacunes en matière de sensibilisation à la protection des données et former de nouveaux membres d'équipes aux activités de contrôle du CIRF. Qui vous êtes
• Éducation et expérience: Baccalauréat en informatique, en informatique ou en génie avec un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience postsecondaire en sécurité SAP et une compréhension profonde de la conformité.

jobs.title: 抗感染治疗领域经理
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
As an intern on the global Early in Career (EiC) team, you will have ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects. You will be a key member of the Human Resources Department at Roche, which encompasses many critical areas of talent attraction, recruitment, and talent development. The EiC team is key to executing on the company’s investment in early talent (internships, rotational programs, and other entry-level opportunities) for the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.
The intern will be based in Shanghai, China, to support the APAC EiC Partner and Specialist in the daily creation of unparalleled EiC experiences that foster development, networking, and community for interns at Roche and its affiliates. The intern will focus on the StartUp China Development Program, Roche’s flagship talent development programme in China. Find out more about the program here .

• Help EiC Partner and Specialist in daily operations and execution of various strategies across the region and/or globe

• Ensure flawless China talent program delivery, especially on events/ activities management

• Interface with operations executives & vendors for execution excellence

• Contribute to the China talent program interaction via data and insights generation

• Support online and offline university career fairs and engagement events

• Research the EiC best practices across the region and/or globe
Required qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s degree or related experience in HR management, organizational development, communications, and or business/related field

• Student organization and/or leadership experience is preferred

• Experience in HR recruiting, talent development, or marketing via coursework or previous internship is preferred

• Proficiency in both spoken and written Mandarin and English

• Demonstrated good communication, collaboration, personal agility, and resilience

• Knowledge of MS Office and Google Suite is a plus

• Able to work at least 3 days per week for 6 months
Program highlights:

• Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects

• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry

• Lead or participate in designing and coordinating program events and initiatives for the EiC candidate experience

• Create a new professional & personal development curriculum, including hosting networking opportunities, workshops, and panel discussions

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche´s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines.

Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. This position is located in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC), a department within the small molecule research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, where we pave, in a diverse, ambitious and innovative environment, the path to bring drug
candidates from early research into development.

The Opportunity

As an Intern in our team your main tasks will include:

• Execute and support the optimization of screening assays using liquid handling systems to accelerate the pre-formulation pipeline.

• Perform "head-to-head" manual assays at the bench to compare, validate, and troubleshoot results against automated processes, ensuring consistency and accuracy.

• Interpret complex datasets to provide recommendations on process improvements and formulation viability.

Who You Are

• You are a meticulous and independent experimentalist who enjoys troubleshooting

• You hold a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or Automation with lab experience, degree completed no more than 12 months prior to the internship start date

• You have proven experience operating liquid handlers (ideally Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).

• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Additional Information

• Desired Start Date: October 1, 2026 (Negotiable)

• Workload: 100%

• Duration: 12 months

• Note: This internship is not suitable for a Master’s or PhD thesis.

Application Process

To be considered for this position, please upload the following documents:

• Current CV

• Cover Letter

• Copy of Diplomas

Requirements for Non-EU/EFTA Citizens: due to Swiss regulations, the following documents are mandatory for your application:

• Proof of Enrollment: You must remain officially enrolled at your university for the entire duration of the internship.

• Mandatory Internship Letter: An official document from your university confirming that the internship is a required part of your curriculum.

Have we piqued your interest? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche ́s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Questa posizione si trova in Chimica Preclinica, Manifattura e Controlli (pCMC), un dipartimento all'interno della piccola organizzazione di ricerca molecola in modalità terapeutiche pRED, dove pave, in un ambiente diverso, ambizioso e innovativo, il percorso per portare droga candidati dalla prima ricerca allo sviluppo. L'opportunità Come Interno nel nostro team i vostri compiti principali includono:
• Eseguire e supportare l'ottimizzazione dei saggi di screening utilizzando sistemi di gestione liquida per accelerare il processo di pre-formulazione.
• Eseguire saggi manuali "head-to-head" in panchina per confrontare, convalidare e risolvere i risultati contro processi automatizzati, garantendo coerenza e precisione.
• Interpretare i set di dati complessi per fornire raccomandazioni sui miglioramenti del processo e sulla fattibilità della formulazione. Chi sei
• Sei uno sperimentatore meticoloso e indipendente che gode della risoluzione dei problemi
• Hai una laurea magistrale in chimica, scienze farmaceutiche, ingegneria chimica, o automazione con esperienza di laboratorio, laurea completata non più di 12 mesi prima della data di inizio stage
• Hai dimostrato esperienza di gestione dei liquidi (di solito Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).
• Buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali in inglese. Informazioni aggiuntive
• Data di inizio desiderata: 1 ottobre 2026 (negoziabile)
• Carico di lavoro: 100%
• Durata: 12 mesi
• Nota: Questo stage non è adatto per una tesi di laurea o dottorato. Processo di applicazione Per essere considerato per questa posizione, si prega di caricare i seguenti documenti:
• CV attuale
• Lettera di copertina
• Copia dei diplomi Requisiti per i cittadini non UE/EFTA: a causa della normativa svizzera, i seguenti documenti sono obbligatori per la vostra richiesta:
• Prova di iscrizione: devi rimanere ufficialmente iscritto alla tua università per tutta la durata dello stage.
• Mandatory Internship Letter: Un documento ufficiale della tua università conferma che lo stage è una parte richiesta del tuo curriculum. Ti interessa? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti di applicazione completi! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• Interpret komplexe Datensätze, um Empfehlungen zu Prozessverbesserungen und Formulierungsfähigkeit zu geben. Wer bist du?

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce de Roche (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Ce poste est situé dans la chimie préclinique, la fabrication et les contrôles (pCMC), un département au sein de l'organisme de recherche sur les petites molécules dans les Modalités thérapeutiques pRED, où nous posons, dans un environnement diversifié, ambitieux et innovateur, la voie pour apporter des médicaments les candidats des premières recherches au développement. L'opportunité En tant que stagiaire de notre équipe, vos tâches principales seront les suivantes :
• Exécuter et soutenir l'optimisation des tests de dépistage à l'aide de systèmes de manipulation des liquides pour accélérer le pipeline de préformulation.
• Effectuer des essais manuels « tête à tête » au banc pour comparer, valider et dépanner les résultats par rapport aux processus automatisés, en assurant la cohérence et la précision.
• Interpréter des ensembles de données complexes pour formuler des recommandations sur l'amélioration des processus et la viabilité de la formulation. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un expérimental méticuleux et indépendant qui aime le dépannage
• Vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en chimie, sciences pharmaceutiques, génie chimique ou automatisation avec expérience de laboratoire, diplôme complété au plus 12 mois avant la date de début du stage
• Vous avez prouvé l'expérience d'utilisation de gestionnaires de liquides (idéalement Tecan/Fluent/Freedom EVO).
• Bonnes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais. Informations complémentaires
• Date de début souhaitée : 1er octobre 2026 (négociable)
• Charge de travail: 100%
• Durée: 12 mois
• Note: Ce stage n'est pas adapté pour une maîtrise ou une thèse de doctorat. Processus de demande Pour être considéré pour ce poste, veuillez télécharger les documents suivants :
• CV actuel
• Lettre de couverture
• Copie des diplômes Exigences pour les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE: en raison de la réglementation suisse, les documents suivants sont obligatoires pour votre demande:
• Preuve d'inscription: Vous devez rester officiellement inscrit à votre université pendant toute la durée du stage.
