jobs.title: Accounts Payable Intern (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Intern – Accounts Payable supporting the China region , you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our financial operations. You will ensure our accounting processes deliver exceptional impact through meticulous document handling, timely invoice processing, and effective communication in Mandarin — helping our global business units maintain the financial health required to deliver care to patients.
The Opportunity

• You manage the full cycle of AP documentation , from receiving and sorting to barcoding and pre-archiving, ensuring all records are ready for further processing.

• You validate and process PO and contract-based invoices, Non-PO invoices, and prepayments with high attention to detail.

• You support financial accuracy by reviewing supplier open items, investigating non-successful payments, and performing balance sheet account reconciliations.

• You contribute to month-end excellence by participating in closing activities and preparing operational KPI reports based on affiliate requirements.

• You act as a bridge for our China stakeholders , handling internal and external queries in Mandarin and building effective partnerships with vendors.

• You engage in continuous improvement by supporting system integration testing, participating in team projects, and initiating process enhancements.

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing or hold a Degree or Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• You are fluent in Mandarin (Mandatory) , as this role specifically supports our affiliates and vendors in China ; you are also proficient in English.

• You have a strong interest in corporate finance and accounting , with a desire to learn best practices in a global shared services environment.

• You have a working knowledge of MS Office tools ; familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a significant advantage.

• You are a proactive communicator who enjoys resolving queries and working collaboratively within a "Buddy System" framework.

• You are available for a minimum internship duration of six (6) months .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Operativo del Sito PTSH ITOT

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As ITOT Site Operation Manager, you will be the driver of business opportunities enabled by information and operational technologies. As the business partner to the campus your focus is always on site priorities including Make, Assess, Release and delivering the pipeline of new products in alignment with network priorities under RDT organization. Being accountable for the end to end ITOT landscape, you are the strategic RDT interface for development of digital technology and processes, risk and relationship management. In addition, you take a key role in the digitalization of PT's global manufacturing network, which targets to deliver reliable PT network defi ned services through standardization of the ITOT environment. Your contribution will be fundamental to embed the new operating model and culture into the entire function. As PT endeavors a lean and agile way of working, you will be infl uencing and coordinating a growing, global contingent of employees in shifting mentalities and agile ways of working. What you'll be working on Provide strong inspirational, engaging leadership and coaching to direct reports and develop the next generation of leaders while nurturing a culture of agility and collaboration following Roche Leadership commitment Catalyze organizational growth, negotiate and infl uence through being a coach, change agent, trainer, mentor and sounding board for team members, develop team people and skill up the ITOT site team’s capability in digitalization and leadership Lead ITOT site operation team and manage the external vendor to provide the sustainable and reliable ITOT service for site operations to contribute site business goals and meet the PTSH defi ned KPI including, RFT,OEE,OLT, deviation, and etc. Develop and maintain a high digital capability ITOT team for PTSH site operation Accountable for cross-functional teams in an agile set-up, taking the role of advising, educating and challenging the status quo with a customer oriented E2E mindset Ultimately driving end-to-end Make Assess Release (MAR) digital capability to support PTSH site manufacturing, warehouse logistic, maintenance, technical transfer, qualifi cation & validation, quality and Lab business to ensure the business commitment is delivered. As accountable for the site IT OT Operation Services and Product Portfolio, ensure overall production strategy and commitments are met, supported by a conductive environment for robust manufacturing execution and continuous improvement. In partnership with PTSH Site Leadership team colleagues, take a key role in defi ning the site operation execution activities together with site head and SLT, identifying business opportunities and co-creating technology-enabled strategies in alignment with overall Manufacturing Site and Network level Themes & Epics. Facilitate continuous improvement of prioritized initiatives and operational processes, ensuring mobilization of needed resources and skills to advance the ITOT system life-cycle, including cybersecurity remediation, systems, equipment and digital integration, deployment, upgrades. Defi ne the site digital roadmap and responsible for the execution and effectiveness review, identify the site business opportunities and leading the digital execution initiation, identify the site business risks and defi ne the mitigation actions in ITOT areas and provide professional digital consulting to
business. Be fully accountable for site ITOT operation fi nancial target to ensure the service running and ne

jobs.title: Global Study Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalization and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity
In this role, you will be the driving force behind the design and execution of our global clinical studies. As a Global Study Lead, you ensure that scientific innovation reaches patients through meticulously planned and high-quality clinical evidence generation.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer plus tôt, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous voyons nous-mêmes et nos clients comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel ensemble. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins et en tirant parti de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous nous rapprochons de leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent croître et de nouvelles façons de faire peuvent être essayées - ce qui donne lieu à des produits compétitifs qui parviennent plus rapidement aux patients. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaborant avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales cruciales, conçoit et exécute des études cliniques et offre un soutien sur le marché. En fin de compte, nous produisons des preuves cliniques exhaustives qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique des produits - facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits dans le monde entier afin que nous puissions sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous serez le moteur de la conception et de l'exécution de nos études cliniques mondiales. En tant que responsable d'une étude mondiale, vous veillez à ce que l'innovation scientifique atteigne les patients grâce à une génération de preuves cliniques méticuleusement planifiée et de haute qualité.
• Diriger avec Impact: Des équipes d'études mondiales directes et pleinement responsables pour les résultats de l'étude, assurant la qualité, le budget et les délais sont respectés avec excellence.
• Stratégie de mise en forme des données probantes : Collaborer avec des partenaires interfonctionnels pour élaborer des scénarios novateurs de production de données probantes, y compris des données factuelles et des stratégies cliniques mondiales.
• Conception de l'étude principale : Élaborer des protocoles d'étude de haute qualité, des plans de validation et des documents essentiels pour guider la réussite de la recherche clinique.
• Encourager la collaboration : établir et maintenir des relations solides avec des experts internes, des partenaires pharmaceutiques et des chercheurs internationaux pour apporter un savoir-faire externe dans notre processus d'innovation.
• Superviser l'excellence opérationnelle : assurer une supervision stratégique des activités externalisées, y compris la gestion des CRO et les relations avec les consultants, afin d'assurer une exécution transparente des études.
• S'assurer de l'état de préparation: Champion respect des normes mondiales (comme ICH-GCP) et assurer l'état de préparation à l'audit et à l'inspection à chaque étape du cycle de vie de l'étude. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur stratégique et un leader collaboratif qui prospère dans un environnement matriciel et rapide. Vous êtes passionné par la mise en avant des patients et vous êtes déterminé à maintenir les plus hautes normes d'intégrité dans la recherche clinique.
• Leader expérimenté : vous apportez une expérience reconnue en opérations cliniques ou en développement de produits au sein de l'industrie de la santé, avec une expérience éprouvée de projets complexes.
• Fondation académique: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou d'un domaine connexe (un diplôme avancé est un plus).

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalization and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster.

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life.

The Opportunity

• Lead global study teams with full accountability for high-quality clinical trial deliverables, managing timelines, milestone execution, and multi-million-dollar clinical budgets.

• Design and execute innovative global operational study strategies in cross-functional collaboration with Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Research & Development teams.

• Develop and validate fundamental study documentation, including clinical protocols, design validation plans, and essential investigator templates.

• Deliver robust operational oversight for diverse clinical programs, including Investigator-Initiated Studies, Early Adopter Programs, and strategic partner collaborations.

• Manage international clinical vendor portfolios (CROs, functional consultants, medical advisors), leading selection processes and driving high-performance execution.

• Build collaborative, high-impact partnerships with international medical investigators, opinion leaders, and global alliance partners to integrate cutting-edge healthcare expertise into operational designs.

Who You Are

• You bring a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a closely related field, combined with established experience in global clinical operational roles.

• You possess strong, practical expertise managing clinical study development phases (from initial planning and start-up through conduct to active study close-out).

• You demonstrate deep working knowledge of international clinical regulations and standards (such as ICH-GCP, IVDD/IVDR, MDR, or FDA guidelines) to proactively maintain inspection-readiness.

• You are an agile communicator and collaborative leader, capable of resolving complex problems, building cross-functional consensus, and guiding project teams through fast-paced, matrixed environments.

• You are deeply passionate about fostering an environment of belonging, working seamlessly across diverse regions, cultures, and time zones to put the needs of patients first.

Together, we’ll advance along the whole patient journey with the aspiration to prevent, stop and cure diseases.

• Vous apportez un minimum d'un baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, santé, ou un domaine étroitement lié, combiné avec une expérience établie dans les rôles opérationnels cliniques mondiaux.

jobs.title: Global Study Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalization and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster.

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life.

The Opportunity
As a Global Study Lead, you are at the heart of our clinical research efforts. You will lead cross-functional global study teams with full accountability for delivering high-quality clinical studies that transform patient care.

• Lead with Impact: Take full ownership of study deliverables, ensuring quality, budget, and timelines are met while fostering a culture of excellence and collaboration.

• Shape the Strategy: Partner with Program Leadership to develop innovative evidence-generation scenarios, including real-world evidence and global clinical strategies.

• Design the Future: Create essential study documents, including protocols and reports, ensuring the highest standards of scientific rigor.

• Drive Collaboration: Oversee operational aspects of Investigator Initiated Studies, Research Collaborations, and companion diagnostics studies in partnership with Pharma leaders.

• Ensure Operational Excellence: Manage study-level budgets and provide strategic oversight to external partners and CROs to ensure seamless execution.

• Advocate for Compliance: Maintain audit and inspection readiness by adhering to global regulations and standard operating procedures.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker and a collaborative leader who thrives in a dynamic, international environment. You are passionate about clinical research and dedicated to bringing innovative solutions to patients.

• Experienced Leader: You bring a proven track record in global clinical study management, with the ability to lead diverse teams through all study phases from planning to close-out.

• Strategic Communicator: You excel at building and maintaining strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external experts to drive business goals.

• Detail-Oriented & Results-Driven: You have a sharp eye for quality and a commitment to delivering projects on time and within budget.

• Regulatory Savvy: You possess a deep understanding of global clinical trial regulations and guidelines (e.g., GCP).

• Educational Foundation: You hold a university degree in a scientific or healthcare-related field, or have equivalent professional experience in clinical operations.

Ready to help us lead the way in healthcare? Together, we’ll advance along the whole patient journey w

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche in 50 Worten
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird.
Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben.
Das macht uns zu Roche.

Beschreibung Abteilung/Team
Wir bei Roche in Penzberg arbeiten an der Spitze der diagnostischen Innovation . In unserem Team R&D Testentwicklung Product Quality im Bereich Klinische Chemie bieten wir Dir die Chance, Deinen Impact auf die Patientengesundheit weltweit zu maximieren.
Du möchtest Deine Expertenrolle vertiefen, Verantwortung übernehmen und Dich gleichzeitig intern weiterentwickeln? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Wir bieten Dir ein Umfeld, das wissenschaftliche Neugier und technologische Exzellenz fördert und Dir den Freiraum gibt, Deine Expertise autonom und lösungsorientiert einzubringen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten/Position
Als R&D Engineer (w/m/d) bist Du maßgeblich an der Entwicklung und Sicherung der Produktqualität unserer vollautomatisierten In-vitro -Diagnostika beteiligt.

• Projekt-Highlights: Du arbeitest aktiv an spannenden Reagenzprojekten mit Fokus auf der klin. Chemie und bist in die Arbeit unserer PartnerChannels eingebunden, die unsere diagnostischen Lösungen erweitern.

• Entwickler-Mindset: Du arbeitest bei der Entwicklung, Optimierung und Überarbeitung von In-vitro -Diagnostika für die Klinische Chemie mit.

• Wissenschaftliche Tiefe: Du planst und führst eigenständig anspruchsvolle analytische Experimente zur Entwicklung, Charakterisierung und Optimierung von Assays durch.

• Technologische Exzellenz: Die selbstständige Adaption und Validierung von Testmethoden auf modernen Analyseautomaten (z.B. cobas c / Integra Systeme) ist Dein Kerngebiet.

• Datengestützte Entscheidungen: Du wertest experimentelle Daten eigenverantwortlich aus, beurteilst sie kritisch und bereitest die Ergebnisse unter Anwendung statistischer Methoden grafisch und schriftlich auf.

jobs.title: Laborant Qualitätskontrolle (m/w/d, befristet)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:
Der Bereich Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist weltweit der wichtigste Roche Diagnostics Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen und Zwischenprodukten für die gesamte diagnostische Produktion von Roche. Die Einheit Qualitätskontrolle ist verantwortlich für die Analytik und Freigabe dieser Produkte. Der Fokus für diese Stelle liegt auf molekularbiologischer und immunologischer Analytik und funktionellen Freigabemethoden.

Das Team:
Im modernen Labor der Gruppe DOZQSX erwarten dich 13 Kolleginnen, welche im engen Austausch untereinander und mit weiteren Gruppen der Qualitätskontrolle arbeiten. Zur Seite stehen dir Laborassistenten, die den Laborbetrieb planen und Fragen rund um die Analytik beantworten können. Über die Gruppen hinaus sind wir mit den Schnittstellen Musterziehung, Planung und Produktion eng vernetzt. Dich erwartet ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es dir leichtmachen wird, Fuß zu fassen. Wir haben eine ausgewogene Mischung aus langjährig erfahrenen und jungen Mitarbeitern. Die gute und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit im Team ist ein wichtiger Baustein unseres Erfolgs.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du führst Analytik im Bereich Molekularbiologie (z.B. RealTime PCR, Nukleinsäureaufreinigung) und Sequenzierung (NGS) durch

• Du wertest Analytik-Ergebnisse selbstständig aus und dokumentierst diese gemäß DIN ISO / GMP bzw. geltenden Arbeitsanweisungen

• Du erkennst, dokumentierst und bearbeitest Abweichungen

• Du pflegst deinen Laborarbeitsplatz und übernimmst die Verantwortung für Equipment

• Du führst eigenständig Testmessungen im Rahmen von Validierungen sowie Optimierungen analytischer Testmethoden durch

• Anfallende Zusatzaufgaben sowie Spezialanalysen erledigst du nach Einweisung durch deinen Vorgesetzten selbstständig

Die Bereitschaft zum Einsatz in einem biologischen Labor mit Arbeiten gemäß IfSG, GenTG sowie Biostoffverordnung und dort der Umgang mit infektiösem Material ist für die Position erforderlich. Die Position erfordert außerdem die Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (Früh- und Spätschicht), einschließlich der Arbeit an Wochenenden.

Dein Profil:
Für diese Position bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Deine Ausbildung zum Laborant Chemie/Biologie (m/w/d) oder CTA/BTA/PTA/LTA/MTA bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen

• Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrungen in Next Generation Sequencing-Workflows und in der molekularbiologischen Analytik, insbesondere im Bereich von RealTime PCR (z. B. LightCycler) und Nukleinsäureaufreinigung (z.B. MagNA Pure, High Pure).

• Du hast eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem analytischen Labor im Bereich Qualitätskontrolle (GMP) gesammelt.

• Du beherrschst die gängigen EDV-Anwendungen (z.B. MS-Office, Google Tools, SAP)

• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit, Kommunikationsstärke sowie der Mut für neue Ideen zeichnen Dich aus

• Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team zählen zu deinen Stärken

• Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Projekt-Umfeld mit schnell wechselnden Anforderungen wohl

Diese Position ist befristet auf 24 Monate ab Einstellung.

Deine Bewerbung
Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch.
Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Islamabad
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love
Your Opportunity ​

• The primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche.

• Responsible for Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs.

• Disease landscape understanding and products knowledge.

• Responsibility of Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support its appropriate use.

• Broad understanding of his/her therapeutic area and its respective future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Awareness of disease Diagnosis

• HCP education (pre-approved & post-approved products)

• Patients’ Access to available funds e.g PBM/SSP & others

• Proactive communication with HCPs on PSP

• PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• Responsible to report incident/accident immediately to SHE department. Attend / complete all requisite on-line and F2F trainings (Role specific, Safety Responsibility and Compliance) within specified time limit to ensure the learning outcome after the training has been implemented.

• Responsible to own the SHE goals as individual goals and play his/her part to achieve the goal in line with strategies/action plan.

• Identifies, collects and immediately reports all safety related information on Roche products to Local

• Safety Responsible as per Roche requirements and local regulations.

• Responsible for maintenance of records (electronic and physical as per the Local Core Map policy.

• Any other duties that maybe assigned from time to time as required by the business.

Who you are
EDUCATION

• Science degree ( Pharm D / Dentistry will be an added advantage)

• Business Degree is a plus

EXPERIENCE & KNOWLEDGE

• Minimum 3 years of relevant therapeutic area experience

• Consistent track record of achieving objectives, collaboration and team work

• Experience in agile ways of working is a plus

• Cross functional experience

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience

• excellence.

• Growth mindset

• Deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling

• engagement at the specialist level.

• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on

• future-based solutions.

• Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research.

What we offer
Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders.

Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions. We strive for excellence and extraordinary results and take a genuine interest in our people and their well-being, and our patients.

Take pride in knowing you can make a difference to millions of patients worldwide in developing diagnostics and treatments for oncology, neuroscience, inflammation, immunology, ophthalmology, rare disease

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer C#
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
Every role at Roche contributes uniquely to delivering greater value to patients and healthcare systems. In this role, you will join a dynamic engineering team in Spain, driving technical excellence and shaping solutions that transform lives.
As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will take ownership of the entire software development lifecycle—from early feasibility studies and architectural design to implementation and testing—leveraging your deep expertise to build robust, high-performance applications.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive all phases of the software development lifecycle, including feasibility studies, architectural design, development, testing, bug fixing, and continuous software maintenance.

• Translate complex software requirements and project architecture into clear unit and subsystem specifications.

• Design and implement high-quality, robust code, ensuring comprehensive test coverage to verify full functionality against specifications.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer/Scrum Master C#
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
In this unique role, you will combine high-impact hands-on engineering with servant leadership to guide your development team toward continuous improvement. You will join a highly collaborative team environment where you will drive the full software development lifecycle while championing Agile methodologies.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive all phases of the software development lifecycle, from feasibility studies and application design to testing, bug fixing, and software maintenance.

• Design, implement, and test high-quality code utilizing C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.

• Act as a Scrum Master and servant leader for the development team, facilitating progress, resolving blockers, and increasing workplace transparency.

• Empower the team by applying proven Agile techniques, fostering conflict resolution, situational awareness, and continuous improvement.

• Collaborate proactively within self-organizing teams to define, estimate, and plan high-impact work packages.

• Leverage modern AI-supporting tools throughout the entire development lifecycle to optimize coding, testing, and troubleshooting workflows.

• Review application designs, functionality, and source code to champion technical excellence and drive ongoing enhancements.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative technical professional who excels at navigating ambiguity. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are deeply passionate about exceptional code quality, and thrive when empowering cross-functional teams to succeed.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a strong background in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.

• Proven experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile Facilitator for a software development team diligently applying Scrum practices and theory.

• Certification in Scrum methodologies (such as CSM or PSM I) alongside deep knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, and team empowerment techniques.

• Solid experience with SQL Server, including database design and utilizing ORMs like Entity Framework.

• Practical understanding of modern development ecosystems, including Git/GitHub version control and setting up basic build environments.

• Exceptional English communication and interpersonal skills, with a natural ability to connect teams and resolve conflicts.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

At Ro

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Rust)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
In this foundational role, you will act as our premier Rust expert, spearheading the strategic migration of our core execution engines, algorithms, and high-performance systems from C# to Rust. You will join a forward-thinking and collaborative environment where your technical vision shapes the future of our engineering stack.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the strategic migration of legacy C# (.NET) codebases, execution engines, and complex algorithms into highly optimized, safe, and concurrent Rust applications.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance software components throughout the full software development lifecycle.

• Define all aspects of development for the new stack, establishing rigorous coding standards, workflows, and appropriate build and CI/CD environments.

• Provide technical guidance, expertise, and coaching to developers, playing a central role in upskilling the team and building internal Rust expertise from the ground up.

• Monitor team progress to ensure consistency with the initial architectural design, technical vision, and quality standards.

• Ensure all software strictly complies with requirements for quality, security, modifiability, and extensibility while leveraging modern AI-supporting tools to optimize efficiency.

Who You Are
You are a visionary technical leader and a passionate educator who thrives when navigating ambiguity and driving technological evolution. You possess deep engineering intuition, love tackling complex architectural challenges, and excel at empowering others to adopt new modern paradigms.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production-grade Rust applications.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will balance hands-on engineering with architectural leadership to shape the technical vision of our software solutions. You will join a collaborative and high-performing team environment where your ideas drive meaningful change.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive the full software development lifecycle from feasibility studies and design to testing, bug fixing, and continuous software maintenance.

• Design, implement, and test clean, high-quality code utilizing C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.

• Formulate and implement comprehensive architectural visions, defining development standards, robust workflows, and coding methodologies for the engineering team.

• Translate complex functional and non-functional requirements into highly scalable, secure, and extensible system architectures.

• Provide continuous technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to developers, empowering team members to reach their full potential.

• Leverage cutting-edge AI-supporting tools throughout the development lifecycle to optimize efficiency and accelerate innovation.

• Collaborate proactively within self-organizing Agile teams (Scrum/Kanban) to estimate, plan, and deliver impact-driven software packages.

Who You Are
You are a proactive and collaborative technical leader who thrives when navigating ambiguity. You possess an analytical mindset, are passionate about mentoring others, and are eager to apply modern technology to solve complex healthcare challenges.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and overseeing complex, scalable architectures.

• Strong proficiency in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0, alongside hands-on experience with SQL Server, database design, and ORMs like Entity Framework.

• Deep knowledge of modern development practices, including Agile methodologies, Git/GitHub version control, and establishing build environments.

• Natural capability to coach, mentor, and elevate the skills of fellow engineering team members.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and collaborate across cross-functional teams.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to exc

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Development Engineer/ Mathematician/ Data Analyst , you will be a vital part of our development team in Spain, focusing on our innovative Blood Gas & Electrolyte Analyzers. You will transform complex physical measurement data into precise, life-saving results through mathematical excellence.

• Robust Algorithms: Develop and refine sophisticated methods, algorithms, and failsafes that extract highly reliable results from physical measurement data. Drive projects from initial conception through to rigorous testing and final completion.

• Model the Future: Create mathematical models and provide expert statistical consulting (including Design of Experiments and Validation) to drive data-driven decision-making and product excellence.

• Bridge Science and Compliance: Implement biometric methods into specification documents, ensuring our products meet the highest health authority requirements and regulatory standards.

• Drive Product Approvals: Support global product launches by developing solid statistical rationales and customized solutions for ongoing product maintenance.

• Unlock Insights: Extract, clean, and visualize large datasets, collaborating with an interdisciplinary team to present actionable insights that drive medical innovation.

• Lead as a Technical Expert: Act as a central point of contact and own the technical solutions, providing the rationale necessary to ensure product quality and scientific integrity.

Who You Are
You are an analytical thinker, solution-oriented who enjoys working in a team at the intersection of engineering, mathematics, physics, and medical technology. You thrive in collaborative, international environments, not hesitant to proactively raise your voice and you are passionate about using your quantitative skills to improve patient care.

• Quantitative Expert: You hold a Master's degree or higher in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.

• Experience: You ​have 7+ years of professional industry related experience.

• Control Engineering/Signal Processing Specialist: You have deep knowledge of system identification, model-based filtering, and classic or model-predictive control methods.

• Sensor & Modeling Pro: You bring experience in modeling electrochemical sensors and optimizing robust calibration methods to ensure precision.

• Statistical Powerhouse: You are highly proficient in modern statistical software such as MATLAB (preferred), Pyt

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Rolle
Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:

• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast idealerweise eine dreijährige abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA) (m/w/d).

• Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, ggf. in der Parenteralia Herstellung zeichnet Dich aus.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Hygienebereich und in der Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer Jaen
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Field Service Engineer (Jaén)
• Misión
En Roche Diagnostics, estamos comprometidos no solo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.
En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.
El Field Service Engineer presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente, garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva, convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor de Roche, y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.
Responsabilidades Principales
Operaciones Técnicas y Servicio Operativo:
● Excelencia operativa: Ejecutar de forma impecable los procedimientos de mantenimientos preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos, instalaciones y modificaciones de los sistemas asignados, así como que la experiencia del cliente alrededor de todas esas intervenciones sea excelente.
● Monitorización: Incorporar y promover el uso de herramientas digitales en el seguimiento de los clientes asignados para evolucionar hacia un modelo de servicio más eficiente, proactivo y orientado a maximizar la experiencia del cliente.
● Reporte y calidad: Registrar te en el CRM todas las actividades realizadas (remotas o in situ ), garantizando la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación según los estándares de la organización.
● Planificación: Asegurar el seguimiento y cumplimiento en tiempo y forma de las modificaciones y mantenimientos mediante el uso del Dashboard de Servicio, en las cuentas asignadas.
Gestión de Cuentas Clave:
● Referencia técnica: Actuar como referente en la gestión del cliente de las cuentas clave de Jaén así como referente a nivel nacional ( cross country ) en el soporte e implementación de las cuentas estratégicas.
● Gestión dedicada (100% enfocada en satisfacción y KPIs): Proporcionar un servicio integral y proactivo, implementando decisiones que optimicen la prestación del servicio e impacten positivamente en la experiencia del cliente.
• Resolución de Problemas y Soporte Proactivo:
• ● Atención al cliente: Establecer y mantener una comunicación excelente y proactiva, informando sobre actualizaciones de reactivos, sistemas y controles de calidad.
• ● Gestión de incidencias: Resolver de forma eficiente quejas y reclamaciones, procesando las modificaciones solicitadas y proporcionando un seguimiento constante hasta la resolución completa.
• ● Sinergia comercial: Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para abordar las necesidades de los clientes y respaldar las ventas de soluciones y ofertas de servicio.

Requisitos: Formación y Experiencia
• ● Formación Académica: Grado en Ingeniería (Electrónica, Mecánica, Biomédica, Ingeniería Técnica o disciplinas afines).
• ● Experiencia Requerida:

Gestión de Cuentas Clave: ● Referencia técnica: Actuar como referente en la gestión del cliente de las cuentas clave de Jaén así como referente a nivel nacional ( cross country ) en el soporte e implementación de las cuentas estratégicas. ● Gestión dedicada (100% enfocada en satisfacción y KPIs): Proporcionar un servicio integral y proactivo, implementando decisiones que optimicen la prestación del servicio e impacten positivamente en la experiencia del cliente.
• Resolución de Problemas y Soporte Proactivo:
• ● Atención al cliente: Establecer y mantener una comunicación excelente y proactiva, informando sobre actualizaciones de reactivos, sistemas y controles de calidad.
• ● Gestión de incidencias: Resolver de forma eficiente quejas y reclamaciones, procesando las modificaciones solicitadas y proporcionando un seguimiento constante hasta la resolución completa.

• ● Formación Académica: Grado en Ingeniería (Electrónica, Mecánica, Biomédica, Ingeniería Técnica o disciplinas afines).
• ● Experiencia Requerida:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Buscamos un profesional para proporcionar servicio científico/técnico a sistemas y soluciones implementadas en las instalaciones de clientes en el área de las tecnologías de la información.

¿Quiénes somos?
En Roche, somos pioneros en el campo de la biotecnología y nos dedicamos a mejorar la salud y el bienestar de las personas en todo el mundo. Con un enfoque en la innovación y la excelencia, buscamos talentos excepcionales que se unan a nuestro equipo y contribuyan a nuestros objetivos.

El Field Services presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas:
Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor que Roche y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.

Descripción del puesto:

Proporcionar soporte técnico integral y de alta visibilidad al cliente, incluyendo:

• Instalación y configuración de equipos: Liderar la instalación y configuración de analizadores y soluciones en el laboratorio del cliente, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos y estándares de la compañía.

• Ejecución de mantenimientos (preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos) e instalaciones para alcanzar y mantener un nivel operativo excelente en todos los instrumentos, reactivos y software asignados, y capacitar a los usuarios en su uso.

• Establecer y mantener una comunicación proactiva, seguimiento y colaboración excelente con el cliente, incluyendo la notificación de actualizaciones de reactivos, controles de calidad y la implementación de nuevos protocolos.

• Proporcionar información científica y técnica experta a los clientes sobre el portfolio completo de Roche Diagnostics.

• Gestión y Optimización del workflow: configurar, monitorizar y optimizar continuamente los flujos de trabajo y las rutas de las muestras en las soluciones automatizadas, definiendo prioridades para maximizar la eficiencia operativa de las soluciones y el cumplimiento de los tiempos de respuesta.

• Mejorar y optimizar los procesos de instalación, configuración y formación al usuario, garantizando la sostenibilidad y la satisfacción del cliente mediante el uso de herramientas digitales de la compañía.

• Reporte y documentación rigurosa: Reportar toda la actividad (remota o in situ) en el CRM y asegurar la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación en cliente, siguiendo los estándares de calidad de reporte.

• Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para satisfacer las necesidades del cliente y apoyar activamente la venta de soluciones y las ofertas de servicio de la compañía.

• Maximizar la eficiencia de todas las intervenciones de servicio e implementar un mantenimiento predictivo y proactivo de los equipos a través de la gestión y monitorización remota.

• Monitorizar y analizar los Indicadores Clave de Servicio (KPIs) en las cuentas asignadas para garantizar la excelencia del servicio al cliente.

Información del Puesto:

• Requisitos Educativos: Formación en Grado en Ingeniería técnica, electrónica, biomédica o similar (Ciencias de la Salud)

• Requisitos Especiales:
• Nivel fluido español

• Dominio del inglés

• Residencia preferente: Santiago, se valorarán otras zona s.

• Movilidad geográfica en territorio nacional

• Flexibilidad horaria: turno deslizante

Con un enfoque en la innovación y la excelencia, buscamos talentos excepcionales que se unan a nuestro equipo y contribuyan a nuestros objetivos. El Field Services presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor que Roche y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente. Descripción del puesto: Proporcionar soporte técnico integral y de alta visibilidad al cliente, incluyendo:
• Instalación y configuración de equipos: Liderar la instalación y configuración de analizadores y soluciones en el laboratorio del cliente, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos y estándares de la compañía.
• Ejecución de mantenimientos (preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos) e instalaciones para alcanzar y mantener un nivel operativo excelente en todos los instrumentos, reactivos y software asignados, y capacitar a los usuarios en su uso.
• Establecer y mantener una comunicación proactiva, seguimiento y colaboración excelente con el cliente, incluyendo la notificación de actualizaciones de reactivos, controles de calidad y la implementación de nuevos protocolos.
• Proporcionar información científica y técnica experta a los clientes sobre el portfolio completo de Roche Diagnostics.
• Gestión y Optimización del workflow: configurar, monitorizar y optimizar continuamente los flujos de trabajo y las rutas de las muestras en las soluciones automatizadas, definiendo prioridades para maximizar la eficiencia operativa de las soluciones y el cumplimiento de los tiempos de respuesta.
• Mejorar y optimizar los procesos de instalación, configuración y formación al usuario, garantizando la sostenibilidad y la satisfacción del cliente mediante el uso de herramientas digitales de la compañía.
• Reporte y documentación rigurosa: Reportar toda la actividad (remota o in situ) en el CRM y asegurar la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación en cliente, siguiendo los estándares de calidad de reporte.
• Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para satisfacer las necesidades del cliente y apoyar activamente la venta de soluciones y las ofertas de servicio de la compañía.
• Maximizar la eficiencia de todas las intervenciones de servicio e implementar un mantenimiento predictivo y proactivo de los equipos a través de la gestión y monitorización remota.
• Monitorizar y analizar los Indicadores Clave de Servicio (KPIs) en las cuentas asignadas para garantizar la excelencia del servicio al cliente. Información del Puesto:
• Requisitos Educativos: Formación en Grado en Ingeniería técnica, electrónica, biomédica o similar (Ciencias de la Salud)
• Requisitos Especiales:
• Nivel fluido español
• Dominio del inglés
• Residencia preferente: Santiago, se valorarán otras zona s.
• Movilidad geográfica en territorio nacional
• Flexibilidad horaria: turno deslizante

jobs.title: Disease Area Partner - Cairo
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Step into a transformative role with us as an Disease Area Partner, where you will be at the heart of the evolving landscape of healthcare. Driven by groundbreaking innovation, greater patient empowerment, and the expanding wealth of medical information, our ecosystem is adapting to new challenges and heightened demands on public resources.
As an Disease Area Partner, you will work locally, deeply integrated within the healthcare community, focusing exclusively on building meaningful stakeholder relationships without the constraints of sales targets or incentives. This allows you to focus entirely on delivering impactful, needs-based support for patients and healthcare providers.

Your Impact

• Steward Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner

• Implement campaigns with customers and distribute promotional materials as per marketing plan and customer needs

• Organize group meetings in major hospitals

• Propose new ideas related to campaigns, promotional material to the pod and are responsible for the implementation after approval.

• Gathering Data & Insights from the market that would help the pod to make decisions.

• The DA partner focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Identifies important customers and keeps customer Personas up-to-date.

• Continuously revises and updates the customer list & no. of patients in cooperation with the pod.

• Positively participates in Internal meetings to review and discuss: achievements, Opportunities/challenges, Competitors activities.

• Reporting Adverse Events to the Local Safety Unite within Roche timelines.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Who you are

• You bring 1-2 years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry.

• You have good business acumen, with desired experience in commercialization, medical, and customer experience excellence, and can leverage digital tools effectively

• You demonstrate a personal commitment to improving the patient journey, with a strong drive to create value and impact on the ecosystem

• You embody a strategic vision to enhance patient journeys and embed this within your actions

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and contribute

• You maintain a growth mindset, learning and unlearning rapidly, experimenting, and sharing insights within and beyond Roche

• You display integrity in every action, upholding honesty, ethics, and authenticity

• You bring excellent stakeholder engagement skills, effectively partnering with therapeutic area experts (TAEs), organizations, and ideally with patient advocacy groups (PAGs)

• You are fluent in the local language and proficient in English, facilitating collaboration across Roche’s broader enterprise.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empo

jobs.title: Alternant - Ventes terrain sur Marseille (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Présentation générale :
En tant que membre de l’équipe Ventes, tu seras chargé(e) de participer au développement des ventes de la marque Accu Chek® et tu garantieras la satisfaction des clients afin de contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs Roche diagnostics France. Tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec un Sales product specialist expert chargé de t’accompagner dans ton alternance.

Nous proposons plusieurs contrats d’alternance au niveau national (affectation sur une région en fonction de votre lieu d’habitation/Ecole et de votre rythme d’alternance).

Quel sera ton impact?
Après une première partie d’alternance au siège pour vous familiariser avec notre approche ventes et rencontrer nos différents services supports (Marketing, vente à distance, SAV...) vous intégrerez nos équipes en région et prendrez part au développement commercial et au suivi des points de vente de
votre secteur géographique.

En véritable ambassadeur:

• Promouvoir la gamme Accu Chek® auprès des pharmaciens d’officine et des prescripteurs

• Gérer, en binôme avec votre manager, un portefeuille clients et le développement des ventes de votre secteur via une analyse précise des besoins/potentiel clients ;

• Participer à l’élaboration et au déploiement des plans d'actions clients pour assurer la croissance en CA des officines, le développement de nos parts de marché Tests et Lecteurs, ainsi que la satisfaction/fidélisation clients ;

• Prendre part aux négociations des contrats de partenariat et assurer le suivi des contrats et des offres commerciales ;

• Assurer la formation des équipes officinales, notamment sur l’utilisation des produits ;

• Participer à des évènements pour représenter la société Roche Diabetes Care France auprès des interlocuteurs régionaux (rencontres, réunions de professionnels de la santé, STAFF, congrès) ;

• Assurer une veille et remonter les informations pertinentes au département ventes et marketing opérationnel (concurrence, évolutions ...) ;

• Assurer un reporting régulier de votre activité via les outils CRM du Groupe.

Ton ADN?

• Tu es étudiant(e) et prépares une formation supérieure BAC+5 en alternance (type Ingénieur/Ecole de commerce/IAE)

• Tu justifies idéalement d’une première expérience acquise en stage ou en alternance dans le domaine commercial/business développement (pharmacie/cosmétique/GMS/grande consommation...);

• Doté(e) d’une sensibilité commerciale, tu aimes être sur le terrain,

• Tu as le sens de l’organisation, des responsabilités.

• Tu as le goût du challenge et aimes argumenter pour défendre ton point de vue et tes idées;

• Tu es reconnue(e) pour ton sens du relationnel, ton ouverture d’esprit, ton adaptabilité et ta proactivité ;

• Tu possèdes obligatoirement le permis B et êtes mobile (Mobilité régionale requise).

Alternance de 24 mois à compter de Septembre 2026
Basé aux alentours de Marseille (13)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

• Cette alternance va te permettre de développer ton sens du service en écoutant activement les besoins des clients et en offrant des solutions adaptées avec professionnalisme.

• Nous considérons les alternants et les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés.

• Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.

• Conformément à la réglementation, nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement,
n’hésite pas à nous

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms

titleByLocale.it: Senior Security Ingegnere (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms
titleByLocale.en: Senior Security Engineer (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms
titleByLocale.de: Senior Security Ingenieur (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Security Ingénieur (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Impact

Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud — supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment.
Do you want to make a meaningful impact as a Security Engineer focused on secure access and network security? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed environment? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

What You Will Do

As a Security Engineer on the Secure Access team, you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor who brings both deep technical expertise and the energy to drive improvements independently.

Purpose
The Secure Access team engineers, delivers, and supports the solutions used to provide secure network access across the corporate environment — spanning on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. The team provides hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable in a regulated industry context.

Key Activities and Deliverables

• Design, implement, and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions.

• Administer and support GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including policy management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle operations.

• Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and improve consistency across security configurations.

• Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations in GitHub.

• Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and change management compliance.

• Ensure security solutions meet regulatory requirements and support audit and compliance activities.

• Proactively identify gaps in access controls and propose improvements with a self-driven, solution-oriented mindset.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated secure access capabilities.

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

Job Skills Required

• High energy, self-motivated, and capable of owning work end-to-end with minimal direction.

• Accountability/Problem Solving : Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, clearly defining the security problem scope and driving root cause analysis for security breaches or vulnerabilities

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Strong customer focus with a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic.

• Collaborative and communicative — comfortable working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, documentation, and operational excellence.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Qualifications and Experience Required

• 5-7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, with a focus on network security and secure access technologies.

• Demonstrated hands-on experie
