Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Dans Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), nous nous efforçons de faire confiance à l'intégrité de nos données et de nos processus, à l'agilité et à une transparence inégalée avec les autorités sanitaires, les patients et la société. L'opportunité En tant que responsable principal de la qualité au sein de notre équipe de processus d'assurance de la qualité et d'affiliation, vous apporterez une diversité de réflexion et d'expertise technique dans différentes disciplines de qualité pour soutenir l'organisation Roche/Genentech. Dans ce rôle pivot, vous concevrez et fournirez des stratégies, des vérifications et des conclusions d'assurance de la qualité fondées sur les risques pour les produits, les filiales et les processus post-approbation. Vous agirez en tant que partenaire de confiance auprès des principaux intervenants commerciaux, en guidant la collaboration interfonctionnelle pour assurer le respect des normes de qualité mondiales tout en naviguant dans des paysages réglementaires complexes.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'AQ : établir des partenariats avec les intervenants commerciaux pour définir de façon indépendante l'AQ, évaluer les risques et adapter les stratégies à l'aide du cadre essentiel à la qualité (CtQ) dans l'ensemble des secteurs du GCP, du GVP et des instruments médicaux.
• Définir et diriger les audits : Déterminer les audits requis, tirer parti de l'analyse des données pour élaborer des méthodologies et gérer de manière indépendante le processus d'audit de bout en bout, de la préparation à l'établissement de rapports.
• Gérer les problèmes de qualité : gérer les problèmes de qualité de façon indépendante, suivre les constatations systématiques pour améliorer les processus et augmenter les risques importants pour la gestion des PDQ.
• Conclusion sur la qualité et communication avec les parties prenantes: évaluer de manière indépendante les positions de qualité afin d'orienter les plans d'action en matière de conformité. Diriger des présentations de risques de haut niveau et des discussions stratégiques avec les intervenants commerciaux, les représentants des pharmaciens, les Affaires juridiques et réglementaires.
• Diriger et appuyer les inspections des autorités sanitaires : préparation des responsables, formation du personnel et gestion des principales inspections réglementaires (par exemple, FDA, EMA), présentation confiante de stratégies et de conclusions de qualité.
• Diriger le leadership et le mentorat du PDQ : contribuer à l'orientation stratégique à long terme du PDQ, diriger des projets de conformité et agir comme un mentor dévoué pour développer des responsables de qualité au sein de l'équipe. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur proactif et stratégique qui prospère dans un environnement collaboratif et matriciel et qui est passionné par les résultats de qualité. Vous possédez une solide connaissance du numérique et des données, vous permettant de transformer les données en idées, et vous êtes à l'aise de poser des questions difficiles pour soutenir les résultats de la PDQ. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• une vaste expertise en qualité : une solide expérience dans le processus de développement des médicaments et les essais cliniques, avec une solide expérience interfonctionnelle dans le GCP, le GVP/PV, ou les matériels médicaux/saMD.
• leadership en matière d'inspection : une expérience éprouvée des principales inspections des autorités sanitaires (comme la FDA ou l'EMA), y compris la préparation à l'inspection et la gestion après inspection.
• Analyse et réflexion critique: compétences avancées en résolution de problèmes avec un état d'esprit proactif et basé sur le risque et la capacité d'utiliser des outils de visualisation de données et de données pour conduire les décisions.
• Influencer et communiquer : compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des relations avec une capacité éprouvée de négocier des solutions efficaces et d'influencer les acteurs seniors.
• Leadership inclusif: Expérience de la gestion de projets dans des équipes mondiales et multiculturelles, avec une passion pour le coaching et le mentorat.
• Qualifications académiques: un baccalauréat ou l'équivalent dans un domaine scientifique ou lié à la qualité (un diplôme avancé est préféré). Lieu

jobs.title: Team Lead Engineering Edge Defense
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area
The Edge Defense team belongs to the Network Security organization, a cornerstone of Information Security. We provide the technologies and services that protect the entire network against IT Security incidents and digital threats.
The core stack of this team includes:

• Perimeter Defense: Network Firewalls and DDoS Mitigation

• Modern Architecture: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services

• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP

​
Job Responsibilities

• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Define the digital roadmap for Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) and Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) across the most external facing network segments, both on-premise and in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Operational Excellence & Automation: Drive an "Automation First" mindset for external network security, leveraging APIs and scripting to replace manual work with scalable security code ("Shift Left").

• Cloud-Native Security: Lead the security strategy for the complex multi-cloud footprint (AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on securing the perimeter and network edge in the cloud.

• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Edge Defense technologies, from discovery to global scale, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, excluding GxP for non-manufacturing focus).

• Business Translation: Connect technical security performance of the external network to broader business outcomes, ensuring security is an accelerator for R&D and other non-manufacturing environments.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand customer and business needs to shape the strategic direction and digital roadmap for the Edge Defense product, focusing on delivering high-value outcomes.

Who You Are

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Information Security is an asset

• 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry is an asset

• 5+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams

​
Education

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field or equivalent experience

• Professional Information Security certifications are a plus (e.g. CISSP, CISM)

​
Technical Skills

• Proven background and solid foundation in Information Security specifically in Network Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (e.g., Cisco ISE), and ZTNA solutions

• Experience in multi-cloud environments is a plus

• Operational Excellence: Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) and Continuous Improvement methodologies

• Automation

jobs.title: Global Clinical Master Data Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The mission of the Global Clinical Supply Chain Organisation (PTDS) is to ensure that no patient is left without treatment and no clinical trial is delayed. Our vision is to provide innovative and sustainable clinical supply solutions to anyone, anywhere, at any time. By joining our team, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s diverse and robust biopharmaceuticals pipeline, encompassing over 100 molecules in approximately 500 clinical trials across seven disease areas in more than 80 countries.

The Opportunity

As our Global Clinical Master Data Specialist, you will serve as the backbone of our clinical supply chain, ensuring that global production and distribution systems run seamlessly by managing the critical data that fuels our operations. In this role, your impact and responsibilities will include:

• End-to-End Data Stewardship: Manage GMP/Quality-relevant master data lifecycle processes, creating and updating Material Masters, Classifications, and business partner/vendor data.

• Production Data Management: Oversee production-related data architectures, including the precise maintenance of Master Recipes, Bills of Materials (BOM), and Production Versions.

• System Integration & Synchronization: Ensure flawless data alignment across SAP R3P Clinical, S/4HANA, APO, and OMP landscapes to fully support global distribution and production planning.

• Lifecycle Governance & Change Management: Lead Engineering Change Management (ECM) workflows and coordinate Engineering Change Requests (ECR) alongside MDGM workflows with global requestors.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Pharma Affiliates to successfully translate operational needs into accurate system configurations.

• Technical & Operational Administration: Act as the single point of contact for master data troubleshooting, while managing system user accounts and roles via the Corporate Identity Management (CIDM) platform.

• Compliance & Continuous Improvement: Oversee Quality Records within VEEVA (Deviations, CAPAs), update SOPs/SPTs, and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to lead process optimization initiatives.

Who you are

You are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for data integrity within the life sciences, looking to make a meaningful impact on global clinical trials. To be successful in this role, you bring the following qualifications and skills:

• Educational Background: You possess a University degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.

• Industry Expertise: You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Master Data Management, with a strong preference for background knowledge in Clinical Supply within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Regulatory Knowledge: You demonstrate a deep, foundational understanding of GMP and GCP guidelines, ensuring all data meets rigorous corporate and industry quality standards.

• Advanced Technical Proficiency: You are highly skilled in navigating and maintaining complex enterprise systems, specifically expert-level knowledge of SAP R3P Clinical, S/4HANA, MDGM, APO, and OMP.

• Quality Systems Management: You are proficient with VEEVA pla

jobs.title: 2026 Technology Transfer Associate Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Technology Transfer Group plays a crucial role in guaranteeing a steady supply of medications to patients by expertly managing and executing projects and transfers within the Roche Pharma portfolio. As a key component of the Pharma Technical Strategy organization, we drive product strategies by seamlessly transferring processes and knowledge across different sites. Our End-to-End project leadership, from sourcing to registration, ensures optimal speed, coordination, and flexibility, thereby enhancing the agility and resilience of the Roche Pharma supply chain. Collaborating closely with other teams within the Pharma Technical organization, we are committed to continuous improvement and implementation.

The Opportunity:

• As a Technology Transfer Associate Intern, you will be a key player in empowering our Technology Transfer Team. Your mission will be to examine and improve our current processes, templates, systems, and tools. Working closely with the Technology Transfer Portfolio Manager, you will supervise Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and support the development, analysis, and reporting of valuable business insights to a diverse range of stakeholders. Additionally, you will partner with Global Technology Transfer Leaders (GTTLs) on key projects and handle various administrative tasks as needed. Your contributions will drive innovation and efficiency within our team.

• Collaborate with Tech Transfer Leads to maintain and improve Database (Airtable) and Dashboard (Tableau) for efficient data Assist in onboarding new Tech Transfer Leads, generate key reports for stakeholders and leadership teams, and develop onboarding materials.

• Process Standardization: Work with the Portfolio Manager and various stakeholders to streamline and standardize the End-to-End Tech Transfer Portfolio Management Processes.

• Lead the update of the Tech Transfer Academy’s content, including GSP078, and author the Quarterly Newsletter.

• Manage team drives, sites, processes, templates, systems, and tools, and support the organization, facilitation, and documentation of Tech Transfer for Future (TF) meetings.

Who You Are:

• You hold an undergraduate degree in sciences, digital healthcare, life sciences, or related fields.

• You are currently enrolled in a Masters program in the fields of Biotechnology or closely related fields.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

• Knowledge and experience in project management principles, Agile methodologies, data analytics, and visualization tools.

• Experience working with cross-functional and virtual teams.

• Ability to build positive relationships with stakeholders, excellent facilitation, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.

• Capability to communicate optimally across all organizational levels.

• High drive to manage multiple priorities and a willingness to handle tasks of varying complexity.

• Continuous learning demeanor and proficiency in Microsoft and Google Suites, with a willingness to learn gSites and SharePoint.

Additional Information:

Location: Hybrid, Based in Mississauga (minimum 3 days in the office)
Hours: full-time (35 hours per week)
Length: This position is a 12-month work term (full-time) and is expected to begin in September 2026.

Please note that relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 57 416,00 and 75 358,50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualification

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, we are redefining the global customer journey through integrated end-to-end supply chain and operational excellence. Our team focuses on driving consulting excellence across our commercial affiliates and regions, establishing global best practices, and enhancing visibility and performance across the affiliate network. By utilizing data, process insights, and IT systems, we collaborate within the O2C Customer Journey / Value Stream Committee to support portfolio prioritization, roadmap definition, and strategic decision-making that delivers real impact and measurable results across our division.

We are seeking a Lead Customer Success Manager Order-to-Cash to step into a pivotal, high-impact role. In this position, you will act as a trusted strategic advisor and sparring partner to our senior executive leadership and O2C Value Stream representatives. You will conduct high-impact consulting engagements, identify strategic efficiencies, and drive the sustainable implementation of global best practices, directly transforming how Roche manages Order-to-Cash operations globally.

The Opportunity

• Develop Scalable Frameworks : Deliver consulting excellence by developing market-oriented O2C consulting packages, business cases, and implementation roadmaps that drive measurable performance improvements across process, people, data, systems, and governance.

• Monitor Performance & Solve Challenges : Leverage Customer & Process Insights to proactively monitor performance, recommend improvements, and connect affiliates with the right internal networks to solve complex business operations and functional challenges.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche Diagnostics, ridefiniamo il percorso globale del cliente attraverso la supply chain end-to-end integrata e l'eccellenza operativa. Il nostro team si concentra sulla guida della consulenza di eccellenza attraverso le nostre affiliate commerciali e regioni, stabilendo best practice globali, e migliorando la visibilità e le prestazioni in tutta la rete di affiliazione. Utilizzando dati, approfondimenti di processo e sistemi IT, collaboriamo all'interno del Comitato O2C Customer Journey / Value Stream per supportare la priorità del portafoglio, la definizione della roadmap e il processo decisionale strategico che offre risultati reali e misurabili in tutta la nostra divisione. Stiamo cercando un Lead Customer Success Manager Order-to-Cash per entrare in un ruolo cruciale, ad alto impatto. In questa posizione, si agirà come consulente strategico di fiducia e partner sparring per la nostra leadership executive senior e rappresentanti O2C Value Stream. Condurrai impegni di consulenza ad alto impatto, identificherai le efficienze strategiche e guiderai l'implementazione sostenibile delle best practice globali, trasformando direttamente il modo in cui Roche gestisce le operazioni Order-to-Cash a livello globale. L'opportunità
• Lead Strategic Consulting Engagements: Guidare gli impegni di consulenza O2C ad alto impatto su affiliati e regioni commerciali per ottimizzare i processi, valutare le prestazioni attuali e tradurre intuizioni su roadmap eseguibili e orientate alle prestazioni.
• Servire come consulente fiducioso: agire come consulente primario e partner di sparring per regioni, affiliati e stakeholder senior; i titolari di iniziative di consulenza mentor per garantire un impegno ottimale, aspettative allineate e la consegna di priorità aziendali di successo.
• Champion Continuous Improvement: Guidare l'innovazione coinvolgendo attivamente gli affiliati per migliorare tutti gli abilitatori, tra cui Process Design, People & Organization, Policy & Guidelines, Measurement & Motivation (ad esempio, Process Insights), Business Data e IT Systems & Technology.
• Rappresentare il viaggio clienti di O2C: Servire come volto del flusso di valore verso regioni e affiliati, facilitare l'accesso agli abilitatori, fornire una guida esperta sulle migliori pratiche, e riportare le esigenze di affiliazione alla più ampia rete globale di O2C.
• Sviluppare Quadri Scalabili: fornire consulenza di eccellenza sviluppando pacchetti di consulenza O2C orientati al mercato, casi aziendali e roadmap di implementazione che guidano miglioramenti misurabili delle prestazioni attraverso processi, persone, dati, sistemi e governance.
• Monitorare le Performance & Solve Sfide: Leverage Customer & Process Insights per monitorare proattivamente le prestazioni, consigliare miglioramenti e collegare gli affiliati con le reti interne giuste per risolvere complesse operazioni aziendali e sfide funzionali.
• Drive Governance & Capability Building: Contribuisci attivamente al Comitato O2C Value Stream per sostenere la priorità del portafoglio e il processo decisionale strategico, servendo al tempo stesso come punto di riferimento primario per la formazione O2C, il contenuto di creazione di capacità e l'escalation di esperti. Chi sei
• Professionista istruito ed esperto: Si possiede un Master in Business Administration, Information Technology, o un campo correlato, con 10+ anni di consulenza e di esperienza sanitaria (idealmente nel settore Diagnostica), tra cui un minimo di 5 anni in operazioni commerciali, Supply Chain, o Business Process Management.
• O2C e Supply Chain Expert: Possiedi una comprensione approfondita delle operazioni di business O2C, dei framework di customer experience e delle operazioni della supply chain di Diagnostics end-to-end, inclusi

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche Diagnostics definieren wir die globale Customer Journey durch integrierte End-to-End-Versorgungskette und operative Exzellenz. Sie werden wirkungsstarke Beratungsengagements durchführen, strategische Effizienzen identifizieren und die nachhaltige Umsetzung globaler Best Practices vorantreiben, indem Sie direkt transformieren, wie Roche Order-to-Cash-Operationen global verwaltet. Die Chance
• Lead Strategic Consulting Engagements: Fahren Sie hocheffiziente O2C-Beratungsengagements über kommerzielle Affiliate und Regionen hinweg, um Prozesse zu optimieren, aktuelle Leistung zu bewerten und Einblicke in ausführbare, leistungsfähige Roadmaps zu übersetzen.
• Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater fungieren: Gesetz als primärer Berater und Sparring-Partner für Regionen, Affiliate und Senior Stakeholder; Mentor-Consulting-Initiative-Besitzer, um ein optimales Engagement, ausgerichtete Erwartungen und erfolgreiche Lieferung von Geschäftsprioritäten sicherzustellen.
• Champion Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Antriebsinnovation durch aktiv engagierte Partner, um alle Enabler zu verbessern, einschließlich Process Design, People & Organization, Politik & Guidelines, Measurement & Motivation (z.B. Process Insights), Business Data und IT Systems & Technology.
• Repräsentieren Sie die O2C Customer Journey : Servieren Sie als Gesicht des Value Streams in Richtung Regionen und Affiliate, erleichtern Sie den Zugang zu den Enablern, bieten kompetente Beratung über bewährte Praktiken, und bringen Affiliate braucht zurück zum breiteren globalen O2C-Netzwerk.
• Entwicklung skalierbarer Rahmen: Beratung durch die Entwicklung marktorientierter O2C-Beratungspakete, Geschäftsfälle und Implementierungs-Roadmaps, die messbare Leistungsverbesserungen über Prozess, Menschen, Daten, Systeme und Governance hinweg antreiben.
• Überwachen Sie Performance & Solve Challenges: Verlassen Sie Kunden- & Prozess-Insights, um die Leistung proaktiv zu überwachen, Verbesserungen zu empfehlen und Verbindungen mit den richtigen internen Netzwerken zu verbinden, um komplexe Geschäftsvorgänge und funktionelle Herausforderungen zu lösen.
• Drive Governance & Capability Building : Mit dem O2C Value Stream-Komitee aktiv zur Unterstützung von Portfoliopriorisierung und strategischer Entscheidungsfindung bei gleichzeitigem Einsatz als primärer Bezugspunkt für O2C-Ausbildung, fähigkeitsaufbauende Inhalte und Experteneskalation. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche Diagnostics, nous redéfinissons le parcours client mondial à travers une chaîne d'approvisionnement intégrée de bout en bout et l'excellence opérationnelle. Notre équipe met l'accent sur l'excellence en matière de consultation dans nos filiales commerciales et nos régions, l'établissement de pratiques exemplaires à l'échelle mondiale et l'amélioration de la visibilité et des performances dans l'ensemble du réseau des filiales. En utilisant les données, les connaissances sur les processus et les systèmes de TI, nous collaborons au sein du Comité du cheminement client/flux de valeur de l'O2C pour appuyer l'établissement des priorités du portefeuille, la définition de la feuille de route et la prise de décisions stratégiques qui produisent un impact réel et des résultats mesurables dans notre division. Nous recherchons un chef de file en matière de réussite client, Order-to-Cash, pour entrer dans un rôle central à fort impact. Dans ce poste, vous agirez à titre de conseiller stratégique et de partenaire de confiance auprès de nos cadres supérieurs et représentants de O2C Value Stream. Vous effectuerez des missions de consultation à fort impact, identifierez les gains d'efficacité stratégiques et dirigerez la mise en œuvre durable des meilleures pratiques mondiales, transformant directement la façon dont Roche gère les opérations de l'ordre à la caisse à l'échelle mondiale. L'opportunité
• Lead Strategic Consulting Engagements : Diriger les engagements de consultation O2C à haut impact dans les filiales commerciales et les régions pour optimiser les processus, évaluer les performances actuelles et traduire les idées en feuilles de route exécutables et axées sur les performances.
• Servir de conseiller fiable : agir en tant que conseiller principal et partenaire principal pour les régions, les filiales et les parties prenantes de haut niveau; conseiller les responsables d'initiatives pour assurer un engagement optimal, harmoniser les attentes et assurer la bonne exécution des priorités opérationnelles.
• L'amélioration continue du champion : stimuler l'innovation en engageant activement les affiliés à améliorer tous les facilitateurs, y compris la conception des processus, les personnes et l'organisation, les politiques et les lignes directrices, la mesure et la motivation (p. ex., les données sur les processus), les données d'affaires et les systèmes et technologies informatiques.
• Représenter le parcours client de l'O2C : servir de visage au Stream de valeur pour les régions et les filiales, faciliter l'accès aux facilitateurs, fournir des conseils d'experts sur les meilleures pratiques et ramener les besoins des filiales au réseau mondial plus large d'O2C.
• Élaborer des cadres évolutifs : Offrir l'excellence en matière de consultation en élaborant des trousses de consultation axées sur le marché, des analyses de rentabilisation et des feuilles de route de mise en oeuvre qui permettent d'améliorer les performances de façon mesurable dans les processus, les personnes, les données, les systèmes et la gouvernance.
• Surveiller les performances & Résoudre les défis : Tirer parti de Customer & Process Insights pour surveiller les performances de façon proactive, recommander des améliorations et connecter les affiliés aux bons réseaux internes pour résoudre les opérations complexes et les défis fonctionnels.
• Favoriser la gouvernance et le renforcement des capacités : contribuer activement au comité de suivi de la valeur de l'OC2C pour appuyer la hiérarchisation des portefeuilles et la prise de décisions stratégiques, tout en servant de point de référence principal pour la formation de l'OC2, le contenu du renforcement des capacités et l'escalade des experts. Qui vous êtes
• Professionnel formé et expérimenté: Vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en administration des affaires, technologie de l'information, ou un domaine connexe, avec 10+ ans d'expérience en conseil et en soins de santé (idéalement dans le domaine du diagnostic), y compris un minimum de 5 ans en opérations commerciales, chaîne d'approvisionnement, ou gestion de processus d'affaires.
• O2C et Supply Chain Expert : Vous possédez une compréhension approfondie des opérations commerciales d'O2C, des cadres d'expérience client et des opérations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de bout en bout Diagnostics – inclus

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join our diverse, open, and friendly team as an Intern – Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer in Mississauga, where we leverage technology to revolutionize the practice of medicine. You will have the unique opportunity to collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams to design and deploy high-quality data solutions, focusing heavily on Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve patient outcomes. Bring your enthusiasm for technological advancements to help us achieve our mission: to do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

• Collaborate with experienced Data Scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams to address complex problems using modern NLP technologies and LLMs.

• Assist in building robust data and deployment pipelines for machine learning models.

• Contribute to the development, deployment, and performance tuning of innovative machine learning models based on business and functional requirements.

• Document and communicate design and implementation details effectively while assisting the AI team in making key technical decisions.

• Partner with clients and informatics departments to deploy scalable solutions, actively participating in troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

• Thrive in a knowledge-sharing team environment that deeply values diverse experiences and a variety of perspectives.

Who You Are:

• You are a passionate, customer-focused, and enthusiastic individual with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. You communicate effectively and enjoy working with diverse, virtual teams from different locations and cultural backgrounds.

• Your minimum qualifications and experience include:

• You are currently pursuing a Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., mathematics, statistics, computer science) or a Life Sciences degree with significant computational experience.

• You have programming capabilities in languages such as Python or R, alongside an awareness of good coding practices and test-driven development.

• You bring experience or coursework related to Large Language Model (LLM) applications development (e.g., RAG, code interpreter) and a basic understanding of building LLM data/deployment pipelines.

• You possess exposure to ML/AI toolkits (such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, AWS SageMaker) and basic knowledge of cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) and MLOps technologies.

• You hold basic knowledge of development tools like git, bash, Linux, and CI/CD tools, with proven scripting and automation skills.

Additional Information:

• Location: Mississauga, ON.

• Modality: Hybrid (majority of days in the office).

• Full time (35 hours per week)

• Duration 12 months with an approximate start date in September 2026.

jobs.title: Lead Controls & Finance Enablement (d/f/m)
Finance Enterprise Partner- Roche Diag
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As an FEP you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our commercial strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organisation (including the Finance Excellence Partner), to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey.

The Opportunity:

• You serve as a key business partner to the commercial organization, acting as a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and establishing close contact with customers .

• You partner with the business to support and co-lead touchpoints alongside the customer journey with a strong enterprise mindset .

• You balance resource allocation across competing priorities and provide strategic advice on the financial implications of proposed business activities .

• You contribute to developing a coherent affiliate commercial strategy, optimizing processes such as business planning, opportunity prioritization, and creative strategies for revenue generation .

• You ensure financials remain on track to achieve targeted business results, proactively advising on deviations and delivering corrective actions .

• You support the business and customers in co-creating new business models, quantifying value, and providing optimal pricing transparency .

• You propose and drive strategic ideas for P&L improvement, including upsell opportunities, efficiency/waste reduction, and risk mitigation .

• You play an active role in ensuring sustainable commercial deals by considering risk evaluations, analyzing competitor assumptions, and implementing pricing strategies .

Who you are:
- You hold a University degree in Finance, Business Administration, Ind Ing, or Economics.
- You possess strong business and financial acumen, with a proven track record of working directly with and for the customer .
- You demonstrate an entrepreneurial, commercial, and customer-centric mindset with the ability to synthesize financial and operational information into a holistic picture .
- You possess strong analytical skills, are a data-driven decision-maker, and act as a systems thinker who understands upstream and downstream impacts .
- You are a highly collaborative professional who thrives in a networked environment, actively seeking input and building relationships cross-departments and across geographies .
- You are fluent in English, both written and spoken .

Preferred:

• You have deep knowledge and expertise in local healthcare systems, market dynamics, and the competitor landscape .

• You have a passion for delivering tangible value for customers, patients, and the business .

• You possess excellent negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to support successful win-win outcomes .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de la surveillance et des services publics (2 ans terminés)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTD) bringt bahnbrechende Therapien aus der klinischen Phase auf den Markt, um jeden Patienten zu bedienen - und dies jeden Tag. Unser Kerngeschäft ist die Entwicklung sicherer, innovativer und wirksamer Arzneimittel unter Einsatz modernster Technologien für Herstellungsverfahren (Wirkstoff und Arzneimittel), klinische Versorgung, Formulierung, Verpackung und analytische Entwicklung.
Das Plant Support & Compliance - Infrastructure & Calibration DP (PTDC-T) Team ist verantwortlich für Kalibrierung und Infrastruktur (inkl. Monitoring & Utilities) im Bereich Drug Product (DP).

Die Möglichkeit

Als Monitoring & Utilities Specialist unterstützt du die Bereiche PTDN-A DP Clinical Supply Center Parenterals und PTDC-P Pharmaceutical & Solid State Development.
In dieser Rolle bist du für die Sicherstellung des cGMP-Status unserer Infrastruktur (u. a. HVAC, Reinstmedien sowie Kühl- und Bruträume) verantwortlich. Du optimierst bestehende Systeme, bewältigst technische Herausforderungen und steuerst sämtliche Anpassungen an Anlagen und Prozessen.

Zu den Hauptaufgaben gehören:

• Durchführung von Raumqualifizierungen und -klassifizierungen

• Validierung / Qualifizierung / Change Control: Qualifizierung und Validierung von Infrastrukturanlagen und Erstellung der erforderlichen Dokumentation. Koordination und Umsetzung von Änderungen mit internen Partnern und externen Dienstleistern.

• Betreuung von Infrastruktur und Facilities, insbesondere Lüftungsanlagen und Reinräume.

• Monitoring & Trending: Erstellung/Bearbeitung von Monitoring-Konzepten (Raummonitoring / Reinstmedien) und Durchführung von Trendings

• Qualitätsmanagement: Erstellung/Bearbeitung von Deviations (inkl. Ursachenanalyse (RCA)), CAPAs, Changes und GMP-Vorschriften

• Problem Solving: Durchführung von Troubleshootings, sowie Ausarbeitung von technischen Optimierungen.

• Subject Matter Expert (SME) bei Behörden- und Selbstinspektionen

Wer du bist:

• Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Engineering / Life Science Studium (z.B. Pharmatechnologie, Verfahrenstechnik, Biotechnologie) oder vergleichbare Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie

• Fachkenntnisse: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Qualifizierung von Infrastrukturanlagen (z. B. HVAC und Reinräume) im GMP-regulierten Umfeld.

• Qualitätsmanagement: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Erstellung/Bearbeitung von Deviations inkl. RCA, CAPAs, Changes und GMP-Vorschriften.

• Soft Skills: Sie bringen Offenheit, Teamgeist, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, exakte Arbeitsweise, Zuverlässigkeit, Flexibilität, Kommunikationsstärke und Eigeninitiative mit.

• EDV- Kenntnisse: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Standard-PC-Programmen, IT- und Dokumentenmanagement-Systemen (z.B. Veeva Vault, SAP, ELVIS, eVAL)

• Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Jede Rolle bei Roche macht einen Unterschied im Leben von Patienten. Sei dabei, um die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung gemeinsam mit uns zu gestalten und bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf und Arbeitszeugnissen!

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTD) lancia terapie innovative dalla fase clinica per servire ogni paziente - ogni giorno. Il nostro core business è lo sviluppo di farmaci sicuri, innovativi ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia per i processi produttivi (sostanze attive e farmaceutici), la cura clinica, la formulazione, l'imballaggio e lo sviluppo analitico. Il team DP (PTDC-T) è responsabile della taratura e dell'infrastruttura (incluso il monitoraggio e le utilità) nel campo del prodotto Droga (DP). La possibilità Come Specialista di Monitoraggio e Utilità, supporta lo sviluppo di PTDN-A DP Clinical Supply Center Parenterals e PTDC-P Pharmaceutical & Solid State Development. In questo ruolo, si è responsabili di garantire lo stato cGMP della nostra infrastruttura (ad esempio HVAC, pulizia dei media e camere fredde e fredde). Ottimizzare i sistemi esistenti, padroneggiare le sfide tecniche e controllare tutte le regolazioni di impianti e processi. Le attività principali includono:
• attuazione delle qualifiche e delle classificazioni spaziali
• Validazione / Qualificazione / Cambiamento di controllo: Qualifica e convalida dei sistemi di infrastruttura e creazione della documentazione richiesta. Coordinamento e attuazione delle modifiche con partner interni e fornitori di servizi esterni.
• Infrastrutture e strutture, in particolare sistemi di ventilazione e camere pulite.
• Monitoraggio e tendenze: Creazione/Edizione dei concetti di monitoraggio (controllo dello spazio/media pura) e attuazione delle tendenze
• Gestione della qualità: Deviazioni (compresa l'analisi delle cause (RCA), CAPAs, modifiche e regole GMP
• Risolvere i problemi: condurre i problemi, nonché sviluppare le ottimizzazioni tecniche.
• Soggetto esperto di materia (PMI) per le autorità e le ispezioni autonome Chi sei:

The Position
The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 30% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside within the service region, which includes: Orange County, Los Angeles County (Northern & Central), and Ventura County. Multiple Roles Available.

Die Position

Roche Support Network hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Kunden außergewöhnlichen Support zu bieten.

• Als Field Engineering Specialist reisen Sie und präsentieren Ihre Expertise in der technischen Reparatur und Installation für Roche zugewiesene Produktlinien.

• Sie bieten wertvolle Dienstleistungen für Laborkunden in Ihrem zugewiesenen Gebiet.

• Die Rolle umfasst routinemäßige technische Unterstützung, Service vor Ort, Reparatur und Installation von Roche-Produkten.

• Sie dienen als Kundenkontakt für technische und servicerelevante Fragen und führen vorbeugende Wartungen durch.

• Die Position erfordert die Diagnose und Lösung von mechanischen, Hardware-, Software- und Systemfehlern.

• Sie dokumentieren alle Aktivitäten, tragen zur Qualitätsverbesserung bei und konzentrieren sich auf die Maximierung der Kundenzufriedenheit.

Wer Du bist:

• High-School-Diplom und 2 Jahre technische Schule oder gleichwertige militärische Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung sind erforderlich.

jobs.title: Associate Quality Lead (Quality Assurance Programs)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As an Associate Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) function, you will play a vital role in supporting the delivery of quality-focused strategies that reinforce trust in our Quality Management System (QMS). Working with a high degree of independence, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure our clinical and safety data meets rigorous global regulatory standards.

In this dynamic position, you will have the unique opportunity to champion a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. By leveraging data analytics and digital tools, you will help optimize data collection and provide key insights that directly support our mission of delivering life-changing medicines to patients faster and more securely.

The Opportunity:

• Implement Quality Strategies: Support the design, execution, and tracking of risk-based quality management strategies across the PDQ portfolio.

• Deliver Quality Assurance: Execute targeted activities to assess quality assurance status and generate confidence in our end-to-end systems.

• Manage Quality Data: Enhance data collection procedures, perform ad-hoc analyses, and deliver high-quality data insights to fulfil external regulatory needs.

• Present to Health Authorities: Demonstrate the effective implementation of quality strategies.

• Drive Compliance Projects: Participate in departmental or cross-functional compliance initiatives aimed at optimizing daily operations.

• Champion Innovation: Drive the adoption of innovative digital tools and technologies into daily workflows to foster a proactive quality culture.

• Foster Collaboration: Build and maintain an inclusive, supportive work environment while executing departmental goals and initiatives under limited supervision.

• Audit Execution : Utilize AI and automated tools to execute audits and synthesize audit evidence.

• Inspection Support : Provide logistical and compliance support for GCP inspections, including scribe duties and back-room document QC.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, organized professional looking to elevate your career in quality management within a global, life-changing industry. You thrive in environments that value continuous learning, offer room for professional growth, and empower you to work independently to make a genuine impact on patient outcomes.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• A Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or quality-related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and 1-3 years' of experience.

• Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with a foundational understanding of product development and GxP regulations (e.g., GCP, GVP, MDR).

• Strong digital and data literacy, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable quality insights.

• Exceptional organizational and execution skills, alongside a demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects proactively.

• Developing expertise in Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors and functional group operations.

• Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong presentation skills.

Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting.

#MQRS

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 89,256.00 and 117,148.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company

As an Associate Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) function, you will play a vital role in supporting the delivery of quality-focused strategies that reinforce trust in our Quality Management System (QMS). Working with a high degree of independence, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure our clinical and safety data meets rigorous global regulatory standards. In this dynamic position, you will have the unique opportunity to champion a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. By leveraging data analytics and digital tools, you will help optimize data collection and provide key insights that directly support our mission of delivering life-changing medicines to patients faster and more securely. The Opportunity:
• Implement Quality Strategies: Support the design, execution, and tracking of risk-based quality management strategies across the PDQ portfolio.
• Deliver Quality Assurance: Execute targeted activities to assess quality assurance status and generate confidence in our end-to-end systems.
• Manage Quality Data: Enhance data collection procedures, perform ad-hoc analyses, and deliver high-quality data insights to fulfil external regulatory needs.
• Present to Health Authorities: Demonstrate the effective implementation of quality strategies.
• Drive Compliance Projects: Participate in departmental or cross-functional compliance initiatives aimed at optimizing daily operations.
• Champion Innovation: Drive the adoption of innovative digital tools and technologies into daily workflows to foster a proactive quality culture.
• Foster Collaboration: Build and maintain an inclusive, supportive work environment while executing departmental goals and initiatives under limited supervision.
• Process Mapping : Support process mapping activities to enable the documentation and visualization of simple workflows within the QMS.
• Inspection Support : Provide logistical and compliance support for GxP inspections, including scribe duties and back-room document QC. Who You Are: You are a proactive, organized professional looking to elevate your career in quality management within a global, life-changing industry. You thrive in environments that value continuous learning, offer room for professional growth, and empower you to work independently to make a genuine impact on patient outcomes. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• A Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or quality-related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and 1-3 years of experience .
• Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with a foundational understanding of product development and GxP regulations (e.g., GCP, GVP, MDR).
• Strong digital and data literacy, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable quality insights.
• Exceptional organizational and execution skills, alongside a demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects proactively.
• Developing expertise in Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors and functional group operations.
• Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong presentation skills. Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting. #MQRS The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 89,256.00 and 117,148.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-relate

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste du génie sur le terrain

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

• Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires 60%-70% daily travel.
Our ideal candidate would reside in the Winston-Salem, NC and Surrounding areas which include Greensboro, NC / Kernersville, NC / Clemmons, NC / Salisbury, NC / Charlotte, NC and will include travel to South Carolina and Virginia.
Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering

• Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Requirements

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of North Carolina is $71,100- $132,000 annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsibilities:

Quality and Safety:

● Maintain the Right to Operate and ensure that all processes are performed safely and healthily; Address and escalate any potentially unsafe hazards.
● Ensure accuracy and completeness of all procedures and instructions related to the proper receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials as it relates to FDA, OSHA, FAA, QSR, ISO, Good Manufacturing Practices, manufacturing exception events (MEEs), and other Roche policies and procedures.
• ● Audit readiness (OSHA, FAA, FDA, etc.); Performs department initiatives to prepare for internal/external audits and inspections.
• ● Timely reporting of safety hazards, incidents, and near misses.
• ● Completes all assigned training. Responsible for maintaining 95% or above training compliance.

Production:

• ● Performs daily assigned standard work according to the department’s governing processes (i.e., GSP’s, OPs, QPs, or SOPs)
• ● Ensures materials are distributed on time and accurately per the production schedule.
• ● Inventory counting and adherence to inventory control processes.
• ● Provides support to non-operations stakeholders with their good receipts, allocation, movements, and shipments.
• ● Learns and operates automated systems/equipment, and sequences of operation, including Equipment setup, operation, and cleaning; Monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting of equipment.
• ● Responsible for daily attendance in Tier meetings.
• ● Responsible for the operation of powered industrial vehicles in a safe and compliant manner.
• ● Required to handle or manage hazardous materials.

Continuous Improvement:

● Organize and maintain logistics areas according to 6S principles.
● Identifies gaps and may participate in process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean principles and tools.

Teamwork and Collaboration:

• ● Proactively collaborate with peers in other shifts/functions to achieve daily targets.
• ● Support the leaders to maintain and cultivate the organization's culture. Collaborate with the team and leaders to achieve departmental goals.
• ● Communicates outside the department with manufacturing and associated organizations. Performs other duties as assigned.

Who you are:

Education/Experience:
• ● High School Diploma/GED required
• ● 1 year of relevant work experience, preferably in a GMP environment
• ● 1 year of experience operating power industrial vehicles

Knowledge Skills and Abilities:
• ● Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement
• ● Ability to read, write and comprehend English
• ● Strong communication skills - written and verbal
• ● Ability to be flexible and agile in a fast-paced, constantly changing, and high-volume environment.
• ● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• ● Ability to use PC-based applications and general data entry skills
• ● Previous experience with ERP systems; SAP preferred
• ● Ability to work with cross-functional teams
• ● Self-motivated

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• Over 8 years of GMP-related experience, with strong proficiency in microbial testing and aseptic techniques.
GMP相关工作经验8年以上，熟悉微生物实验无菌操作。

• Performance of microbiological testing of product stream samples (excipients, bulk, packaging materials and finished products) to meet product release timelines.
执行产品流样品（辅料、半成品、包材和成品）的微生物测试以满足产品放行计划。

• Performance of environmental and critical utility testing in accordance with Chinese GMP, EU GMP and cGMP regulations and Roche/Genentech standards.
根据中国GMP，欧盟GMP，美国cGMP法规和罗氏/基因泰克的标准进行环境监控和关键设施的测试。

• Performance of microbiological testing of stability samples to meet stability program requirements.
执行稳定性样品的微生物测试以满足稳定性研究计划的要求。

• Supporting manufacturing operations by timely completion of direct material sampling and ID testing.
及时完成直接物料的取样及鉴别测试以支持生产运营。

• Continuous improvement of testing processes and technology, in collaboration with ASAT, to drive right first time and efficiencies.
与ASAT合作，对流程和技术进行持续改进，提高一次成功率和工作效率。
Qualification and validation of microbiological test methods.
微生物测试方法的确认与验证。

• Supporting continuous improvement of manufacturing processes and technology, in collaboration with MSAT, by process validation and cleaning validation
与MSAT合作，通过工艺验证和清洁验证支持生产工艺和技术的持续改进。

• Supporting investigations of microbial contamination in production processes, classified environments, and critical utility systems.
支持在生产工艺、洁净环境和关键设施系统中发生的微生物污染的调查。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe cybersecurity plays a critical role in protecting innovation, safeguarding patient trust, and enabling healthcare transformation globally. As part of our Informatics organization, you will contribute to strengthening Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities in a highly collaborative, global, and complex environment.

Your Opportunity
As a Cybersecurity Analyst within the Monitoring & Incident Response team, you will lead and support strategic cybersecurity initiatives while partnering with global stakeholders across multiple business and technology domains. You will help drive security best practices, contribute to complex security programs, and support the continuous evolution of Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities.

In this role, you will:

• Lead and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives and strategic programs across global and cross-functional environments

• Provide expert guidance and advisory support on complex cybersecurity challenges, incident response activities, and security-related risk considerations

• Partner with stakeholders across Informatics and business teams to align cybersecurity priorities with organizational objectives

• Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of security processes, standards, and best practices

• Analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and recommend effective and scalable security solutions

• Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive alignment, decision-making, and execution across initiatives

• Mentor and support team members while contributing to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence

• Stay informed on industry trends, emerging threats, and evolving cybersecurity practices to help strengthen Roche’s overall security posture

Who you are
You are a strategic and collaborative cybersecurity professional who is comfortable navigating complex environments, influencing stakeholders, and balancing technical depth with business impact. You are able to work effectively across global teams while bringing a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.

You bring:

• A Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a reputable university

• At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, incident response, or related cybersecurity domains within complex enterprise environments

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and global teams in matrix organizations

• Good understanding of cybersecurity principles, security frameworks, risk management, and enterprise security practices

• The ability to analyze complex technical and business problems and translate them into actionable solutions

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships

• Experience contributing to large-scale initiatives, process improvements, or transformation programs within cybersecurity or technology organizations

• A continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging technologies, cybersecurity trends, and innovation

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
職務の目的
ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” 、Healthcare Excellence (HCE)　本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」を具現化するため、薬事グループは、薬事許認可プロセスマネジメントを通じて許認可を取得/維持することで、我々の検査に患者がアクセスできる環境を確保します。

職務内容
弊社製品（免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の試薬、機器、プログラムなど）の薬事申請担当者として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、Medical Scientific Affairs、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、以下の業務を行っていただきます。

• 製品導入関連部署（Global Regulatory Team、ビジネスチーム、メディカルチームなど）と連携して、合理的な薬事導入戦略を立案する

• PMDA相談等の実施、行政（厚労省、PMDA）担当者、Global担当者との折衝を通して、論理的かつ合理的な体外診断用医薬品、医療機器（プログラム医療機器を含む）の製造販売の許認可申請および取得、並びに許認可の維持を遂行する

• 社内での薬事関連業務（変更管理、包材・各種資料の確認など）の遂行

• ジュニアスタッフの人財育成

求める経験

• 体外診断用医薬品あるいは医療機器（プログラム医療機器の経験であれば尚可）の薬事申請業務の経験（3年以上）を有すること。

• 経験年数とともに職責を広げ、業務を自律的・主体的に進め、成果を上げた経験。

求める知識・スキル、マインドセット

• 薬事関連法規に関する一般的な知識。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学に関連する学位（同等もしくはそれ以上でも可）。生化学・免疫・遺伝子・病理検査、プログラム医療機器に関する知識があれば尚可。

• 論理的な思考力、並びに文章構成力（正確性を含む）。

• 日常業務に限らず各種プロジェクトにおいても職務グレードによらず、業務/プロジェクトを自律的・主体的に進めることができるリーダーシップ。

• 関連部署とのコミュニケーション力、調整能力。

• 薬事スペシャリストとして、新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。

• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。

ヘルスケアのリーディングカンパニーで薬事スペシャリストとして活躍できるポジションです。ロシュ・グローバルとの繋がりも密接であり、グローバルなキャリアを望む方にも、社内留学制度など、グローバル・キャリア・パスをサポートする体制が整備されています。

試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：Regulatory Affairs Specialist
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする
給与

　　 住宅手当（月額）：22,000円～
　　 時間外固定手当（月額）：68,065円～（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　 ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　 ＜補足＞ ■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）
コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）

福利厚生・その他
社会保険：　健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険

受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙

A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Commercial Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
The Commercial Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the sales team to ensure smooth and efficient commercial operations. This role involves coordinating various activities, managing documentation, and assisting in the execution of sales strategies.

Main Responsibilities
- Coordinate and manage field operations, including site visits, customer meetings, and on-site project management
- Assist in the development and implementation of commercial strategies to meet company goals
- Work closely with the sales team to support business development efforts and client relationship management
- Conduct market research and gather data on competitors, customer needs, and industry trends
- Support the sales team in the preparation of proposals, contracts, and other documentation
- Coordinate and monitor sales projects, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met
- Maintain and update customer databases, sales records, and other relevant documentation
- Assist in the presentation of promotional materials and sales presentations
Track and analyse sales performance metrics, preparing reports for management
- Communicate with clients to gather requirements, provide updates, and ensure satisfaction
- Collaborate with internal departments to facilitate the smooth execution of commercial activities
- Handle inquiries from customers, providing accurate and timely information
- Ensure compliance with quality and regulatory requirements in all activities carried out

Who you are?
Required Experience and Education
- Bachelor’s degree (Bac +3) in Science, Management, or equivalent
- Experience in commercial support or field coordination required
- Experience in the IVD (In Vitro Diagnostics) market is preferred
- Proficiency in IT tools (CRM, Excel)

Required Competencies and Skills
- Strong organizational skills
- Excellent communication abilities
- Keen eye for detail.
- Client centricity and cross functional collaboration

Note: This is a contractor role. The employment contract for this position will be established through a third-party agency

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position

Senior Business Analyst DIA Commercial Customer Pricing

The Principal Business Analyst possesses in-depth knowledge of the business domain, relevant technologies, and organizational strategy to provide holistic, enterprise-wide consulting advice. In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of interconnected systems, overseeing initiatives with full autonomy and leading analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions for sustainable business transformation.

Description of the area

Join our Diagnostics Commercial function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Organization and become the vital bridge between strategic business vision and cutting-edge AI delivery. In this role, you will champion the scaling and evolution of our Sales Price Advisor (SPA)—a sophisticated, AI-driven dynamic pricing engine designed to revolutionize customer quotation strategies and operations.

Positioned at the dynamic intersection of AI and Commercial Business, you will act as a true hybrid professional. This is a unique opportunity to shape high-impact technical data foundations while driving high-level business stakeholder engagement within a collaborative, globally dispersed team of experts. We are seeking a highly motivated professional with a strong growth mindset and a passion for working directly with business stakeholders; in turn, we are fully committed to training and upskilling the right candidate to bridge any gaps in technical capabilities or specific domain knowledge.

The opportunity:

• Business & Technology Liaison: Acts as the primary bridge between commercial business stakeholders and technical AI/data delivery teams, translating complex pricing needs into clear, actionable technical specifications.

• Strategic Content Leadership: Autonomously oversees large-scale, highly ambiguous initiatives, defining analysis efforts, navigating complex frameworks, and delegating work while ensuring top-tier quality of business analysis deliverables.

• Accountability & Problem Solving: Leads cross-functional root-cause analysis to solve complex business problems, proactively prevents scope creep, and takes ultimate ownership of aligning deliverables with broader corporate objectives.

• Stakeholder Management & Advisory: Serves as a trusted advisor to leadership to shape long-term business strategy, actively navigates and resolves cross-organizational conflicts, and empowers teams in stakeholder engagement.

• Strategic Impact & Risk Evaluation: Drives project value by leading advanced value analysis and risk assessments on strategic solutions, taking a holistic (micro and macro) approach to shape long-term product and program roadmaps.
