A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Business Analyst DIA Prezzo commerciale del cliente Il Principal Business Analyst possiede una conoscenza approfondita del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie rilevanti e della strategia organizzativa per fornire consulenza olistica e aziendale. In questo ruolo, si applicheranno sistemi che pensano di navigare nella complessità dei sistemi interconnessi, supervisionando iniziative con piena autonomia e principali sforzi di analisi in spazi altamente ambigui. Facendo da consulente di fiducia per la leadership, si forma attivamente roadmap a lungo termine, spingere il consenso attraverso la comunicazione persuasiva, e consigliare soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali per la trasformazione aziendale sostenibile. Descrizione della zona Unisciti alla nostra funzione di diagnostica commerciale all'interno dell'Organizzazione Roche Digital Technology (RDT) e diventare il ponte vitale tra la visione aziendale strategica e la consegna AI all'avanguardia. In questo ruolo, sarete campione dello scaling e dell'evoluzione del nostro Sales Price Advisor (SPA)—un sofisticato motore di prezzi dinamico AI-driven progettato per rivoluzionare le strategie e le operazioni di quotazione dei clienti. Posizionato all'incrocio dinamico di AI e Commercial Business, si agirà come un vero professionista ibrido. Questa è un'opportunità unica per modellare le basi di dati tecnici ad alto impatto mentre guida l'impegno degli stakeholder aziendali di alto livello all'interno di un team di esperti collaborativo e disperso a livello globale. Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista altamente motivato con una forte mentalità di crescita e una passione per lavorare direttamente con gli stakeholder aziendali; a sua volta, siamo pienamente impegnati a formazione e upskilling il candidato giusto per colmare eventuali lacune nelle capacità tecniche o specifiche conoscenze di dominio. L'opportunità:
• Business & Technology Liaison: agisce come il ponte principale tra gli stakeholder commerciali e i team tecnici di AI/data delivery, traducendo le complesse esigenze dei prezzi in specifiche tecniche chiare e attuabili.
• Leadership dei contenuti strategici: supervisiona autonomamente iniziative su larga scala, altamente ambiguee, definendo gli sforzi di analisi, navigando quadri complessi e delegando il lavoro, garantendo al contempo la qualità superiore dei risultati delle analisi aziendali.
• Responsabilità & Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi cross-functional root-cause per risolvere problemi aziendali complessi, previene proattivamente lo scopo strisciare, e prende la massima proprietà di allineare i deliverables con obiettivi aziendali più ampi.
• Stakeholder Management & Advisory: Serve come consulente di fiducia per la leadership per modellare la strategia aziendale a lungo termine, naviga attivamente e risolve i conflitti cross-organizzativi e potenzia i team nell'impegno degli stakeholder.
• Valutazione strategica dell'impatto e del rischio: guida il valore del progetto attraverso analisi avanzate del valore e valutazioni dei rischi sulle soluzioni strategiche, adottando un approccio olistico (micro e macro) per modellare le roadmap del prodotto e del programma a lungo termine.
• Gestione del ciclo di vita del motore SPA: gestisce il ciclo di vita dei requisiti end-to-end, dall'elicitazione iniziale e dall'analisi alla realizzazione di miglioramenti continui per il motore SPA, collaborando strettamente con i team tecnici backend per ottimizzare l'integrazione del sistema, la consegna dei dati e i modelli AI sottostanti.
• Global Roll-Out: portare l'imbarco di affiliati globali alla soluzione SPA sul lato IT, garantendo un'adozione e un allineamento senza soluzione di continuità con gli standard aziendali.
• Value Demonstration & System Support: Owns ed esegue report mensile di misurazione del valore SPA, analizzando set di dati complessi per quantificare l'impatto aziendale

Beschreibung der Fläche Begleiten Sie unsere Diagnostics Commercial Funktion innerhalb der Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Organisation und werden Sie die entscheidende Brücke zwischen strategischer Unternehmensvision und modernster KI-Lieferung. In dieser Rolle werden Sie die Skalierung und Entwicklung unseres Sales Price Advisors (SPA) vorantreiben – eine anspruchsvolle, AI-getriebene dynamische Preis-Engine, die entwickelt wurde, um die Angebotsstrategien und den Betrieb der Kunden zu revolutionieren. An der dynamischen Schnittstelle von AI und Commercial Business werden Sie als echtes Hybrid-Profi fungieren. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, hochpräzise technische Datenfundamente zu formen und gleichzeitig hochrangige Unternehmensbeteiligungen innerhalb eines kollaborativen, global verteilten Expertenteams zu betreiben. Wir suchen einen hoch motivierten Profi mit einem starken Wachstumsgeist und einer Leidenschaft für die direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Interessenvertretern der Wirtschaft. Wir sind wiederum verpflichtet, den richtigen Kandidat zu trainieren und zu formulieren, um Lücken in technischen Fähigkeiten oder spezifischem Domänenwissen zu überwinden. Die Gelegenheit:
• Business & Technology Liaison: Aktiviert als primäre Brücke zwischen kommerziellen Interessenvertretern und technischen KI/Datenlieferteams, wobei komplexe Preisanforderungen in klare, handlungsfähige technische Spezifikationen umgesetzt werden.
• Strategische Content Leadership: Autonom überwacht groß angelegte, hochdeutige Initiativen, die Analysebemühungen definieren, komplexe Rahmenbedingungen navigieren und die Arbeit delegieren und gleichzeitig eine qualitativ hochwertige Qualität der Business-Analyse liefern.
• Rechenschaftspflicht und Problemlösung: Leads cross-funktionale Root-Cause-Analyse, um komplexe Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen, proaktiv verhindert Umfangkriechen, und nimmt ultimatives Eigentum an der Ausrichtung von Lieferungen mit breiteren Unternehmenszielen.
• Stakeholder Management & Advisory: Er dient als vertrauenswürdiger Berater der Führung, um langfristige Geschäftsstrategie zu gestalten, aktiv navigiert und grenzübergreifende Konflikte zu lösen und Teams im Stakeholder-Einsatz zu befähigen.
• Strategische Impact & Risk Evaluation: Betreibt den Projektwert, indem er fortschrittliche Wertanalysen und Risikobewertungen auf strategische Lösungen durchführt und einen ganzheitlichen (Mikro- und Makro) Ansatz zur Gestaltung langfristiger Produkt- und Programm-Roadmaps einleitet.
• SPA Engine Lifecycle Management: Verwaltet den End-to-End-Anforderungs-Lebenszyklus – von der ersten Elicitation und Analyse bis zur Einführung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen für die SPA-Engine, die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Backend-Tech-Teams zur Optimierung der Systemintegration, Datenlieferung und der zugrunde liegenden AI-Modelle.
• Global Roll-Out: Führen Sie das Onboarding globaler Affiliate an die SPA-Lösung auf der IT-Seite und sorgen für eine nahtlose Übernahme und Ausrichtung von Unternehmensstandards.
• Value Demonstration & System Support: Besitzt und führt monatliche SPA-Wert-Messberichte aus, analysiert komplexe Datensätze, um die Auswirkungen des Geschäfts auf ein
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Analyste principal des affaires DIA Prix des clients commerciaux L'analyste principal des affaires possède une connaissance approfondie du domaine des affaires, des technologies pertinentes et de la stratégie organisationnelle pour fournir des conseils-conseils holistiques à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez la pensée des systèmes pour naviguer dans la complexité des systèmes interconnectés, superviser les initiatives avec pleine autonomie et diriger les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus. En tant que conseiller de confiance pour le leadership, vous élaborerez activement des feuilles de route à long terme, susciterez un consensus grâce à une communication persuasive et recommanderez des solutions technologiques optimales pour la transformation durable des entreprises. Description de la zone Rejoignez notre fonction Diagnostics Commercial au sein de l'organisation Roche Digital Technology (RDT) et devenez le pont vital entre la vision d'entreprise stratégique et la prestation d'IA de pointe. Dans ce rôle, vous serez le champion de l'échelle et de l'évolution de notre Sales Price Advisor (SPA), un moteur de tarification dynamique sophistiqué et piloté par l'IA, conçu pour révolutionner les stratégies et les opérations de cotation des clients. Positionné à l'intersection dynamique de l'IA et des affaires commerciales, vous agirez comme un véritable professionnel hybride. Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de façonner des bases de données techniques à haut impact tout en favorisant l'engagement des intervenants de haut niveau au sein d'une équipe d'experts collaborative et dispersée à l'échelle mondiale. Nous recherchons un professionnel hautement motivé avec une forte croissance d'esprit et une passion pour travailler directement avec les acteurs du monde des affaires; à son tour, nous nous engageons pleinement à former et à renforcer le candidat approprié pour combler toute lacune dans les capacités techniques ou les connaissances spécifiques du domaine. L'occasion :
• Liaison entre les entreprises et les technologies: constitue le premier pont entre les acteurs commerciaux et les équipes techniques chargées de la fourniture des données et de l'IA, traduisant les besoins complexes en matière de tarification en spécifications techniques claires et réalisables.
• Leadership stratégique du contenu : Supervise de façon autonome des initiatives à grande échelle et très ambiguës, définit les efforts d'analyse, navigue dans des cadres complexes et délégade le travail tout en assurant une qualité supérieure des résultats d'analyse.
• Responsabilisation et résolution des problèmes : dirige l'analyse interfonctionnelle des causes profondes pour résoudre des problèmes d'affaires complexes, prévient de façon proactive l'évolution de la portée et s'approprie en dernier ressort l'alignement des produits livrables sur des objectifs généraux.
• Gestion et conseil des parties prenantes : sert de conseiller de confiance au leadership pour façonner une stratégie opérationnelle à long terme, naviguer et résoudre activement les conflits interorganisations et responsabiliser les équipes dans l'engagement des parties prenantes.
• Évaluation de l'impact stratégique et des risques : Conduit la valeur du projet en menant des analyses de valeur avancées et des évaluations des risques sur des solutions stratégiques, en adoptant une approche holistique (micro et macro) pour façonner les feuilles de route à long terme des produits et des programmes.
• Gestion du cycle de vie du moteur SPA : Gère le cycle de vie des exigences de bout en bout – de la sollicitation initiale et de l'analyse à la réalisation d'améliorations continues pour le moteur SPA, en s'associant étroitement avec les équipes techniques de backend pour optimiser l'intégration du système, la livraison des données et les modèles d'IA sous-jacents.
• Global Roll-Out: Diriger l'intégration des filiales mondiales à la solution SPA du côté informatique, en assurant l'adoption et l'alignement sans heurts avec les normes de l'entreprise.
• Démonstration de valeur et support du système: possède et exécute des rapports mensuels de mesure de valeur SPA, en analysant des ensembles de données complexes pour quantifier l'impact d'une entreprise

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，协助带教人员向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Safety, Health, Environment (SHE) & Facility Officer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Safety, Health and Environment (SHE), Security and Facilities Officer is responsible for overarching facility management, which includes managing the office building, security, space management, and company vehicles, all aimed at safeguarding company assets and ensuring a safe working environment. They are also responsible for managing local Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) systems, as well as business continuity management in compliance with local legislation and SHE policy. This role extends to leading the development and implementation of local SHE initiatives in collaboration with the One Roche Leadership Teams.

As a SHE Security and Facilities Officer, you will oversee SHE, facility, and business continuity operations across the Pharma, Diagnostics, and Diabetes Care business. You will report directly to the General Manager and be a crucial member of the Emergency Management Team, participating in Affiliate Governance Committee meetings as necessary.

What you will be working on:

• SHE Objectives and Goals: Promote SHE activities in alignment with local and global Roche SHE objectives, monitor legal compliance, and ensure corrective actions are reviewed and implemented.

• Advisory and Support: Advise and support site senior and line management on SHE-related topics and concerns, promoting compliance with local legal regulations and Roche SHE provisions.

• Emergency Management: Lead and facilitate the emergency management team, develop and manage the local (Roche internal) emergency management system, and advise external emergency response teams during incidents.

• Training and Documentation: Develop and provide SHE training for all employees, prepare and maintain the SHE handbook, and establish a system for receiving, documenting, and responding to SHE-related reports and complaints.

• Risk Analysis and Audits: Implement and document a risk analysis process, conduct periodic SHE inspections, and report critical SHE situations, accidents, incidents, and occupational injuries.

• Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor and document the implementation of SHE programs, emissions, energy and material use, and the progress of actions related to SHE goals, providing regular reports on SHE KPIs.

• Financial and External Relations: Manage financial provisions for health and environmental liabilities with the finance department, and establish and maintain contacts with local SHE authorities, professional organizations, and the public while leading the Business Continuity Management Team.

• Facility and Maintenance Management: Ensure the facility is fully operational with all utilities functioning properly, schedule and supervise maintenance and repair work, implement waste management, oversee office renovations, and ensure legally required documents and permits are available.

• Security Management: Support and advise senior management, line management, and employees on all security matters, ensure compliance with legal security regulations and Roche requirements, manage critical security situations, and establish contacts with law enforcement and professional organizations.

• Involvement in Projects: Participate in major projects, including design phases, to represent and integrate security considerations and requirements, and report critical security incidents to superiors and the Chief Security Officer.

• Fleet Management: Oversee fleet management, including planning, managing, coordinating, and supervising the acquisition, utilization, maintenance,

jobs.title: Healthcare Systems Partner (Policy & Access)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every patient deserves the best care possible. We are looking for a visionary Healthcare Systems Partner (HSP) to serve as a local face of Roche Philippines. In this function-agnostic role, you will be a catalyst for change, working at the heart of the healthcare ecosystem to shape a future where innovation is accessible to all.

• Subject matter expertise in developing Policy & Access

• Influence healthcare ecosystem shaping

• Patient focussed opportunity to make impact now

Role Purpose
As an Healthcare Systems (Policy & Access) Partner (HSP), you are an empowered leader dedicated to strengthening the Philippine healthcare system. You will move beyond traditional boundaries to identify shared purposes with government bodies, regulators, payers, and patient advocates. Your mission is to co-create sustainable solutions that dismantle barriers to care and deliver significantly better outcomes for patients and society.

What you will work on:
Key Responsibilities include but not limited to the following:

• Ecosystem Innovation: Drive transformative healthcare innovation by partnering with external stakeholders to create long-term value for the Philippine patient community.

• Trusted Partnership: Act as the primary, trusted point of contact for high-level system stakeholders, managing complex relationships with transparency and integrity.

• VACC Leadership: Embody the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model to influence both internal strategies and external healthcare movements.

• Strategic Bridging: Connect Roche’s global expertise and internal networks with the local ecosystem to facilitate knowledge exchange and secure vital resources.

• Policy & Access: Influence healthcare policy development and infrastructure building to improve local models of care and patient journeys.

• System Shaping: Identify systemic roadblocks and co-develop solutions that enhance the efficiency and equity of the healthcare environment.

• Knowledge Leadership: Stay at the forefront of healthcare trends, providing deep insights into local governance, funding, and regulatory processes.

Who you are:

• Strategic System Thinker: You possess a "systems thinking" mindset with the ability to listen deeply to stakeholder needs and connect them to broader health goals.

• Experienced Leader: You bring a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and managing complex, high-stakes projects within the healthcare sector.

• Healthcare Expert: You have a deep understanding of healthcare systems, governance, and the nuances of the Philippine regulatory and payer landscape.

• Policy Advocate: You ideally bring experience in policy-making or public affairs, with the ability to navigate and influence legislative or institutional frameworks. Experience and/or ability to review and write healthcare policy related documents preferred.

• Entrepreneurial & Self-Managed: You are a proactive self-starter who thrives in a networked environment and is comfortable with ambiguity.

• Educational Background: You hold a University degree in Science, Economics, or Business. An MBA or advanced Life Science degree is highly regarded.

• Bilingual Communicator: You are fluent in the local language and have a high proficiency in English to ensure seamless collaboration with our global teams.

• Technology Savvy: You effectively leverage AI and other advanced technologies to drive efficiency and generate strategic insights.

This field-based role may require

jobs.title: AI Business Development Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The role
​
You’ll work alongside a dynamic team in a fast paced environment shaping how AI can enhance the strategic capabilities of Business Development. This is an opportunity to blend business insight, creativity, and technical curiosity to help build a next-generation partnership and insights platform within Roche.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across multiple departments to clearly define project requirements, implement use cases, and validate AI-driven applications.

• Design and build lightweight, no-code/medium-code generative AI tools and assistants to automate or enhance internal workflows and processes.

• Develop and refine AI-enhanced solutions that support diverse corporate use cases, enhancing efficiency and strategic decision-making.

• Provide comprehensive training and ongoing support to users and teams to ensure successful adoption and effective use of AI-based applications.

• Troubleshoot and optimize solutions based on continuous user feedback and emerging business requirements.

• Continue to maintain and update AI capabilities within corporate business development applications, maintaining awareness of emerging trends and best practices

• Develop and update documentation and knowledge bases for corporate business development AI tools

Who You Are

• Recent graduate in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field

• Experience using GenAI tools like ChatGPT (Custom GPTs), Gemini (Gems), or other AI assistants, and building data visualizations, such as Tableau dashboards

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for documenting AI use cases and translating between technical tools and business needs

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail

• Collaborative mindset with experience working effectively across multiple teams in a fast-paced, dynamic corporate environment

• Familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud (preferred)

Who We Are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. At Roche, we believe diversity and inclusion are essential values for our success. We have a special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams.

Are you ready to apply?
We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Analyst, you will act as a senior Solution Consultant in China Everyday AI and Core Collaboration&Productivity Suite areas, independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain’s Everyday AI scenarios, related technologies(Google workplace & MS365, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans.
In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You are expected to be a tech champion for Everyday AI toolsets and lifting the business users’ expertise, hands-on with no-code/low-code AI products to rapidly build AI workflows and mockups for business validation. Also, you will lead the M365 migration project, specifically analyzing Google Service specific business scenarios to determine migration paths or alternative solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, e.g. Everyday AI/Google/M365, without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Serve as the Solution Owner for China Everyday AI toolsets, defining the evolution of the China Everyday AI toolkit by orchestrating global AI offerings. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems in collaboration and productivity domain, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals. Interface with business partners to present AI workflow mockups, using rapid prototyping to align expectations and secure buy-in.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies (e.g. Gemini, Copilot, Coze, M365, Google), and their interdependencies. Independently applies to

Does a rewarding career with a progressive, high-tech business, excite you?

Roche Diagnostics has a superb opportunity for you to grow your skills whilst directly supporting our customers in the Omagh, Enniskillen and border regions , surrounding areas and being part of the field based Engineering team in Ireland.

The successful candidate will provide frontline support covering electro-mechanical hardware routine proactive/reactive work, technical training, upskilling of customers and ensuring all administration and regulatory documentation is maintained. As the first responder for technical, Applications and IT related issues, you will be expected to build your system understanding around the entire customer solution to include information solutions and applications of the Roche diagnostic products.

Key activities will include troubleshooting and ownership of faults, preventative maintenance, fault related data analysis and generation of reports to improve efficiency across Roche’s product portfolio.

You will be accountable for the successful delivery/uptime and overall customer experience of their relevant service offering and you will be accountable for the core service activities efficiently and productively, supporting your customer base.

You will work with peers and key stakeholders to ensure a seamless “sales-service” alignment approach and a differentiated customer offering/solution. You will be a key member of the Technical Services Team in Ireland ensuring the right people are in the right place, with the right skills, capabilities and competencies at the right time.

You should be resilient, and tenacious. You thrive under pressure, working effectively as part of a close-knit team in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment with shifting priorities and multiple deadlines. With strong analytical skills, you are at ease working with technical, scientific and numeric information.

For this position, it is essential that you are already based in the Omagh, Enniskillen or border regions . With this intent in mind, applicants will only be considered if they are currently residing within this geographical area.

You will be expected to work closely with the wider team and all other areas of Roche to provide best-in-class service for our customers.

Key Responsibilities

• Technical success in the delivery of our service offering for our customers, putting the customers at the centre of what we do and working with other technical managers.

• Technical effectiveness by championing and upholding technical excellence in the execution of technical activities across systems, processes, data, capability and competence.

• Technical Customer Centricity by ensuring that we support our customers, react to customer and market demands and continuously strive to achieve technical excellence, inc. continuous improvement and change as necessary.

• Employee Impact by role modelling flexibility, creativity and teamwork behaviours and building effective cross-functional/cross-regional collaboration to multiply your impact.

• Ideally Degree-educated, or Diploma level in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent demonstrable experience, you will possess a thorough and up-to-date understanding of the IVD industry and have solid experience in implementing best-in-class support.

• With the ability to provide effective support for pathology laboratory solutions, you will be motivated by exceeding customer expectations and instilling knowledge.

• Efficienza tecnica sostenendo e sostenendo l'eccellenza tecnica nell'esecuzione di attività tecniche attraverso sistemi, processi, dati, capacità e competenze.

jobs.title: Customer Excellence & Digital Transformation Partner

titleByLocale.it: Partner di Eccellenza e Trasformazione Digitale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Customer Excellence & Digital Transformation Partner, you will play a key role within our Supply Chain organization, combining operational Customer Service responsibilities with a strong focus on digital transformation and process optimization. This is a hybrid position designed for someone who enjoys both hands-on operational work and contributing to a more automated, efficient, and customer-centric future.
You will manage daily Order-to-Cash activities while also helping identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve customer interactions, and support the transition from manual operations to digital-first solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer end to end order flow: order management, invoicing, pricing discrepancies, operational incidents and collecting activities within SAP and Order-to-Cash workflows

• Provide customer support through phone and email while ensuring high-quality service and timely issue resolution

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders across Supply Chain, Finance, Logistics, and Commercial teams to ensure smooth operations

• Identify repetitive manual activities and contribute ideas to improve efficiency through automation, digital tools, and AI solutions

• Support digital transformation initiatives by helping customers adopt online ordering, automated workflows, and more agile ways of working

Who You Are

• Experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Billing, Order Management, or related operational environments

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with a customer-oriented mindset

• Analytical and proactive profile with interest in process improvement and operational excellence

• Curious about digital transformation, automation, AI, and new technologies applied to business processes

• Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-paced environments with an agile and collaborative mindset

Technical & Digital Skills

• SAP or ERP systems experience is highly valued

• Familiarity with CRM tools and Order-to-Cash processes

• Advanced Excel and strong data accuracy mindset

• Interest or experience in automation, digital workflows, or AI-driven solutions

• Understanding of Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices

Languages

• Fluent Spanish

• Professional English

• Catalan is a plus

What We Offer
At Roche, you will join an innovative and collaborative environment where operational excellence and digital transformation go hand in hand. This role offers the opportunity to develop both customer-facing and strategic skills while contributing to projects that improve efficiency, automation, and customer experience within a global healthcare organization.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end "Order to Cash" journey, ensuring that every interaction adds value to our clinicians and patients. You will act as a Catalyst for change, moving from reactive processing to proactive customer consultancy, helping our partners optimize their ordering patterns and embrace digital ecosystems. The role provides an end-to-end visibility and responsibility in terms of order lifecycle, from the moment the orders are captured in our systems, pricing topics, logistics fulfillment as well as billing & collecting. jobs.title: Workforce Optimization Intern (External Workforce)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is part of the Integrated Workforce Strategies Chapter within the People & Culture organization. Our purpose is to enable the business to achieve its ambitious goals while anticipating and adapting to a rapidly changing environment. We elevate the way leaders shape our future workforce by providing data-driven, skills-based workforce planning solutions to the business, such as Strategic Workforce Planning. We are also developing Roche-wide innovative frameworks to support closing our gaps (e.g. borrowing skills by leveraging external partners, bridging skill gaps by flowing skills to the most impactful work). Shaping new planning solutions, creating insights and automating processes as well as working with cross-functional partners offers you great learning opportunities.

The Opportunity

As an intern in the Workforce Optimization team for a 6-month period, your main focus will be learning about External Workforce Management at Roche globally and innovative concepts to manage the external workforce lifecycle process, while deploying solutions to support workforce strategies.

You will analyze data, generate reports and insights, prepare presentations and drive data-driven recommendations for decision making related to the External Workforce at Roche. You will also contribute to the automation of our analytics and implement innovative ideas to create efficiencies in our data & insights world.

Who you are

• You are in your Bachelor or Master studies at a Hungarian University in the field of economics, business administration, HR Management, STEM subjects or similar

• Ideally, you already have had (e.g. previous internship) experience in HR, Procurement and/or project management

• You have a passion for conceptual and data-driven working and are detail-oriented when conducting analysis

• You can address complex problems and develop effective solutions

• You think creatively and you enjoy supporting projects (e.g. workshop preparation, creation of effective presentations)

• You have expertise in Office or Google Suite, esp. Excel or GoogleSheets, Data analysis; experience with SQL is a plus

• You are motivated to work independently in a collaborative and dynamic environment and can adapt to different needs

• You have a can-do attitude and growth mindset

• You demonstrate a high level of social competence and are able to communicate efficiently in English

General information

Start date: July 2026
Possible work locations: Budapest (first location)
Workload: at least 30 hours/week
Duration: 6 months

Skills Needed

• Excel or Google Sheet (required)

• PowerPoint or Google Slide (required)

• Data Analysis &interpretation

• Agile

• Creating processes & frameworks

• Creative Thinking

• English language

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Timkl est une entreprise de services en santé de nouvelle génération née en 2019 d’une démarche soutenue par le groupe Roche , acteur majeur de la santé en France et premier investisseur dans l’innovation santé. Nous proposons une prestation de suivi renforcé pour tous les patients diabétiques sous insulinothérapie par pompe, y compris ceux équipés des systèmes les plus innovants, comme la boucle fermée.

Notre modèle est aujourd’hui accessible sur tout le territoire français hexagonal. Il est co-construit avec les acteurs de soins, parmi lesquels : les pharmaciens, les infirmiers libéraux, les diabétologues et les médecins généralistes.

Tu as le goût du challenge ?
Tu souhaites t' impliquer dans le développement d’un modèle innovant pour améliorer la prise en charge des personnes vivant avec un diabète? Prend part à cette aventure au sein d'une équipe motivée et dynamique.

Présentation de la mission :
Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire / un(e) alternant dynamique pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Chargé de la transformation numérique via nos nouveaux outils IA.

Dans le cadre de l’accélération numérique de notre entreprise, tu seras chargé de définir et déployer une approche afin d’améliorer la maîtrise et l’efficience des équipes opérationnelles à l'utilisation de leurs outils et systèmes métier, mais aussi d’identifier comment ces équipes peuvent intégrer les outils d'intelligence artificielle à leur disposition dans leurs processus quotidiens.

L’objectif de ta mission : améliorer nos pratiques actuelles pour accompagner nos professionnels de santé partenaires. (Médecins, Pharmaciens, Centres Hospitaliers)

Quel sera ton impact ?
Dans le cadre de ce stage / alternance, nous te proposons de :

• Collaborer avec les équipes de management, et en collaborer avec nos équipes informatiques, conduire des projets visant à identifier comment optimiser et rendre plus efficaces les activités quotidiennes internes grâce aux outils (incluant IA).

• Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l’utilisation de nouvelles solutions numériques et outils métiers, en assurant une adoption fluide et efficace.

• Proposer et mettre en place des programmes de formation destinés aux collaborateurs pour les aider à maîtriser les outils numériques.

Ton ADN :

• Tu prépares une formation supérieure bac+4 ou bac+5 ; avec une spécialisation en informatique, systèmes d’information, intelligence artificielle, ou management des technologies.

• Tu as une forte appétence pour les systèmes de gestion de l’information et les outils d’IA (comme les plateformes de machine learning, les outils d’analyse de données, etc.).

• Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences analytiques, et une capacité à prendre du recul pour comprendre le fonctionnement d’un système

• Tu es rapide, structuré(e), curieux(se) et un bon relationnel,

• On te reconnait une aptitude certaine à vulgariser les outils.

Poste basé à Montbonnot (Isère, 38)
Stage de 6 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 /
Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
● Nous considérons les stagiaires / les alternants comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
● Tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler en amont de l’entretien.
● Tu che

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is a fixed-term maternity cover position.

The Opportunity:
As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and German

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Affairs Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

The opportunity
Within the Pharma Organisation Medical Affairs serves as the bridge between clinical development and the commercialization of medicines. The domain is increasingly focused on External Stakeholder Engagement, aiming to derive deep insights into unmet medical needs, treatment barriers, and patient perceptions of data. By synthesizing these insights, Medical Affairs shapes the organization’s overall strategic direction. As an IT Business Analyst in this space, you will support the digital transformation of how scientific evidence is generated, managed, and communicated to the global medical community.

• End-to-End Workstream Management: Independently drive and manage comprehensive business analysis workstreams, navigating ambiguous problem spaces and adapting standard frameworks to deliver clear, structured outcomes.

• Problem Solving & Requirements Accountability: Lead domain research and root cause analysis to define comprehensive requirements, contribute heavily to technical solution selection, and propose creative process improvements.

• Technical Landscape & Product Strategy Alignment: Maintain a holistic view of how various technical components fit into the overall product strategy, formulating technical strategies that align directly with broader organizational objectives.

• Application & Data Domain Mastery: Serve as the authoritative Subject Matter Expert (SME) by bridging the gap between business processes and technical execution, maintaining expert knowledge of the end-to-end information lifecycle and data transformations.

• Cross-Functional & Site-Level Collaboration: Operate at the product or site level to directly influence technical decisions, leading cross-functional teams to resolve complex business or systems issues.

• Knowledge Sharing & Community Engagement: Act as a technical mentor to junior team members, actively present at internal tech events (e.g., Tech Talks, DevOps Days), and engage in initiatives outside the regular project scope to drive engineering innovation.

Who you are

• Professional Experience: Bring 5+ years of Business Analysis or consultancy experience, including at least 3+ years within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• Workstream & Requirement Management: Proven ability to independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams, navigate ambiguous requirements, and translate them into strategic implementation plans.

• Technical BA Proficiency: Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, documentation, traceability, and change management, with the ability to apply standard process and usability analysis tools.

• Data Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, data visualization techniques, relational databases, and non-relational data structures.

• Stakeholder & Problem Solving Skills: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to prioritize effectively, maintain a big-picture strategic view, and propose process improvements .

The Position
Timkl est une entreprise de services en santé de nouvelle génération née en 2019 d’une démarche soutenue par le groupe Roche , acteur majeur de la santé en France et premier investisseur dans l’innovation santé. Nous proposons une prestation de suivi renforcé pour tous les patients diabétiques sous insulinothérapie par pompe, y compris ceux équipés des systèmes les plus innovants, comme la boucle fermée.

Notre modèle est aujourd’hui accessible sur tout le territoire français hexagonal. Il est co-construit avec les acteurs de soins, parmi lesquels : les pharmaciens, les infirmiers libéraux, les diabétologues et les médecins généralistes.

1. Finalités du poste:

L’infirmier Coordinateur réalise la formation des professionnels de santé et est leur référent.

• Il assure un support auprès des professionnels de santé pour la prise en charge des patients.

• Il assure également et en collaboration avec le professionnel de santé, la formation technique initiale et continue du patient diabétique sous pompe à insuline.

L’activité d’infirmier coordinateur est un poste clé nécessitant une sensibilité à l’importance du suivi et de l’accompagnement du patient sous pompe dans le respect de la réglementation, de la prescription médicale
ainsi que des process internes.

2- Relations clés :

● Manager direct : Responsable infirmiers

o Travail en transversalité avec :
▪ Responsable des ventes et responsables de Région
▪ Assistantes administratives et commerciales
▪ Gestionnaire administration commerciale
▪ Responsable affaires réglementaires
▪ Responsable formation
▪ Equipe marketing

● Relations externes :
o Pharmaciens et infirmiers d’Etat libéraux
o Prescripteurs
o Infirmiers d'éducation diabète des centres initiateurs
o IPA

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Disease Area Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Providing Medical Expertise

• Providing deep scientific expertise to form differentiation strategy for company’s pipeline and portfolio.

• Acting as a medical expert throughout all stages of the product lifecycle.

• Leadership in medical portion of the integrated strategy and shaping a scientifically sound value story for products.

Customer Engagement and Insight Collection

• Proactive scientific engagement with therapeutic area experts (TAEs) and other stakeholders in full alignment with the integrated strategy.

• Establishing and maintaining effective professional peer-to-peer relationships.

• Conducting high-quality non-commercial events to disseminate relevant data and build trust among clinicians.

• Systematic collection and analysis of external scientific and clinical insights to translate them into strategic recommendations for cross-functional teams (Squad).

Evidence Generation

• Participating in development and implementation of the local data generation strategy.

• Supporting Non-Interventional Studies (NIS), Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS), and projects using Real-World Evidence/Data (RWE/RWD).

• Collaboration with Clinical Operations (PDG) regarding strategic clinical trial site selection and engagement.

Health Technology Assessment (HTA) and Access

• Providing scientific expertise and active participation in preparation of HTA dossiers and interactions with regulatory authorities.

• Validation of scientific data integrity and ensuring clinical relevance of HTA submissions.

• Integrating medical perspectives into solutions that support patient journey and expand access to innovations.

Operational Excellence and Compliance

• Ensuring all medical activities are executed in accordance with corporate policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Strict adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) standards.

• Management of Medical Information enquiries and ensuring correctness of any content generated using Artificial Intelligence.

Education/Qualification:

Education: Full higher education in the field of medicine, pharmacy, or natural sciences (MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).
Experience: Previous work experience in Medical Affairs departments, clinical research, or possession of deep clinical expertise in the relevant therapeutic area.
Languages: Fluent English (required for global cooperation).

Additional Requirements:
Strategic Thinking: Ability to act autonomously and work in complex cross-functional environments.
Digital Literacy: Skills in working with artificial intelligence tools and ability to oversee AI content.
Communication: Ability to articulate complex scientific data and maintain a direct, respectful, peer-to-peer dialogue.
Entrepreneurial Approach: Focus on creating value for patients and the healthcare system without compromising compliance.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employe

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Expert

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di consegna di campagne digitali

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Expert in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful execution of digital campaign content projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. Supporting Global Campaign Coordinators, you manage the end-to-end coordination of campaigns across channels, ensuring standards are met. You guide Campaigns Delivery Specialists on complex projects, improve processes, and incorporate stakeholder feedback for continuous improvement. Additionally, you oversee team operations, monitor project statuses, forecast demand, identify risks, and support issue resolution. You also assist the global brand engagement manager with strategic planning to align digital campaign content delivery with future needs.

Who you are
You are an experienced digital marketing project manager, ideally in pharma or life sciences, with strong organizational and problem-solving skills to manage multiple projects, mitigate risks, and meet deadlines. Skilled at building stakeholder relationships and mentoring team members, you foster a collaborative, high-performing environment. With a strategic mindset, you support Global Campaign Coordinators in executing successful campaigns and ensuring operational excellence. In this position you will be focusing on

• Oversee Operational Activities: Coordinate content delivery operations to ensure smooth and efficient processes.

• Initiative Management: Pilot new initiatives and expand organizational services within your expertise.

• Project Monitoring: Lead calls to track project status, identify risks, and connect with global brand teams, engagement managers, and production teams.

• Mentorship: Guide Campaigns delivery specialists, resolve operational issues, mentor junior team members, and assist with onboarding.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead retrospective sessions to foster learning and improvement across therapeutic areas.

• Strategic Support: Assist global brand managers with content creation strategies aligned to organizational objectives.

• Stakeholder Communication: Incorporate feedback, adapt content requests, and facilitate alignment while supporting brand engagement managers in client relations.

​For this position, you bring the following qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

• 5+ years of project management experience, ideally in digital marketing or content creation.

• Strong knowledge of digital marketing, campaign management, problem-solving, multitasking, and proficiency in project management tools and content management systems.

• Exceptional interpersonal skills with experience collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders and mentoring team members.

• Familiarity with pharmaceutical industry standards, including global and local compliance and regulatory concepts (preferred).

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty

jobs.title: LTO Regulatory Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche UK

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity

Imagine working for an organization that puts people at the heart of everything they do, where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes. At Roche, our number one priority is our patients, and we believe that every person plays a key role in achieving this mission.
As a Regulatory Partner at Roche UK, you will be a vital part of our UK Regulatory Chapter. You will leverage your regulatory and scientific expertise to shape and drive strategic initiatives. This is your opportunity to make a difference and be part of a company dedicated to improving lives.

UK Regulatory Group Responsibilities
The Regulatory group collaborates with the wider business to translate the constantly evolving requirements of the UK regulatory environment into Roche policies, procedures, solutions, and strategies that ensure compliance and maximize the value for patients.
Our activities encompass:

• Clinical Trial Applications

• National Licensing Applications

• Early Access to Medicines Applications

• National components of medicines authorization via the European Centralized procedure

The team serves as Roche's primary contact with the MHRA, requiring effective cross-functional collaboration at both local and global levels, as well as the capability to negotiate and influence externally. Regulatory Partners need to be adaptable and entrepreneurial to identify opportunities, while maintaining a focused approach on ensuring compliance and playing a key role in retaining Roche UK's License to Operate.

Who You Are
You are a passionate regulatory expert with a clear vision for improving patient outcomes. With broad and comprehensive expertise within the UK regulatory environment, you will lead foundational work and partner with the business to solve complex regulatory issues impacting the chapter and/or wider business. You will contribute to the development of squad/chapter-based strategic plans and goals, and actively participate in the learning and development of other chapter members. You will have the ability to understand scientific and technical information relating to an assigned portfolio of Roche products.

You also bring :

• A Scientific University degree

• Extensive experience in UK Regulatory Affairs

• Proven experience managing UK submissions post-Brexit

• Experience providing strategic and technical advice

• In-depth knowledge and experience of UK and EU regulatory requirements and procedures

• A proven track record of developing, implementing, and communicating regulatory strategies

• Excellent documentation skills to ensure high-quality and timely submissions

• Experience as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in defined subject areas or therapeutic areas

• Experience in mentoring peers, as well as managing stakeholder relationships

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambi

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Job Summary:

The Core Lab Implementation Consultant demonstrates and positions the end-to-end value of the Roche portfolio of solutions (systems) and Roche Consulting services to our customers. This field-based position creates value by focusing on implementing complex automated laboratory solutions to improve the customers' desired future state. This position partners with customers and internal stakeholders (sales, global Roche Consulting teams, RSN, marketing, IT, and other teams) to address customers' unique priorities, challenges, and needs through continuous improvement efforts, including (but not limited to) collecting and reviewing customer feedback, refining methods/tools, performing complex analyses, and recommending solutions. This position utilizes a consultative approach and technical expertise to ensure the customer is prepared and the Roche solution is verified to be implemented and deliver expected results.

The Opportunity:

• Verify and validate that the proposed Roche solution still meets or exceeds customers' expected results before Implementation

• Provide implementation support to customers and installation teams; collaboratively develop detailed customer installation requirements with customers, Roche Support Network, Workflow Consulting, and other teams

• Responsible for identifying opportunities to optimize the implemented Roche solution and collaborating with appropriate Roche partners to take action to accomplish optimization

• Collaborate with RC team members to develop metrics that provide data for process measurement; identify indicators for future improvement opportunities; collect data to identify root causes of problems; measure performance against process requirements; align improvement to performance targets

• Collaborate with fellow Roche Consulting colleagues to use, refine, and evolve proprietary tools and techniques to generate high-value deliverables, best practices, and methods delivering differentiated, value-creating consulting services and position Roche’s portfolio of solutions

• Perform related administrative duties such as creating and submitting expense, reports, and status reports and adhere to any additional regulatory requirements

Who You Are:

The ideal candidate is a seasoned laboratory professional with wide-ranging experience addressing complex issues, requiring in-depth analysis and evaluation of many factors. Exercising appropriate judgment in selecting evaluation methods and determining solution criteria is critical. The ideal candidate demonstrates agility in a rapidly changing, matrixed organization and is comfortable operating in an evolving, ambiguous environment. Additionally, the ideal candidate is comfortable coordinating the activities of others, networking with internal and external senior personnel in areas of expertise, and networking with key contacts outside the area of expertise.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Sciences or closely related scientific/technical discipline.

• Experience with process mapping, statistical and reporting tools

• 5 years of experience in Operations, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory or equivalent, including experience in s

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description / Description of the Area
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Technical Business Analyst with experience in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) to support the delivery and continuous improvement of customer identity services.
The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear requirements and ensuring scalable, secure, and user-centric CIAM solutions. This role combines business analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder engagement, and delivery support in a complex enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities
Business Analysis and Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to customer identity, registration, authentication, consent, profile management, and access journeys.

• Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

• Challenge and refine requirements to ensure clarity, feasibility, and business value.

• Support prioritization of demand, backlog items, and roadmap initiatives.

Solution Design and Delivery Support

• Work closely with architects, engineers, and product teams to shape fit-for-purpose CIAM solutions.

• Support design discussions by bringing process, customer journey, and business context.

• Ensure requirements are traceable through delivery, testing, and implementation.

• Participate in release planning, change activities, and deployment readiness.

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration

• Engage with business, security, legal, compliance, digital, and IT stakeholders across multiple functions.

• Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and decision meetings.

• Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and options clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

• Support alignment with privacy and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and related frameworks.

• Ensure customer identity processes reflect governance, auditability, and security expectations.

• Contribute to control documentation and evidence gathering where required.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities to simplify CIAM processes and customer journeys.

• Support KPI tracking, service improvement initiatives, and process optimization.

• Stay informed on CIAM trends, identity standards, and digital customer expectations.

Qualifications
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Experience

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.

• Experience in Identity & Access Management, Customer Identity, digital platforms, or customer-facing systems.

• Experience working in enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of CIAM concepts such as registration, authentication, SSO, MFA, consent, profile lifecycle, and access control.

• Familiarity with identity standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.

• Ability to interpret APIs, system integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies.

• Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Visio, Miro, or equivalent collaboration platforms.

• Familiarity with SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAP CDC) or similar CIAM p

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a Marketing Lead (Fixed Term) who will report to the Marketing and Customer Engagement Head and be responsible for the Lung portfolio.

As a Marketing Lead, your mission is to create value through meaningful benefits for patients, the business, external stakeholders, and health systems. By working with patient journey partners (PJPs) and healthcare system partners (HSPs), and other cross-functional enablers, value can be added in various ways, such as product innovation, treatment pathway design, a new patient service, technologies/capabilities that improve operational efficiency, global knowledge sharing, or external collaboration.

Responsibilities:

• Develop specific marketing strategies for therapeutic areas within the organization, working together cross-functionally with Medical and Access Leads.

• Build and implement an effective plan for Omnichannel engagement via leveraging different channels and tools. Focus on building Omnichannel capabilities internally and externally to provide meaningful customer experiences that add value to patients, collaborating closely with the Digital team.

• Manage P&L to ensure resources are utilized effectively and in accordance with the business outcomes

• Ensure continuous sales and logistics forecasting, working closely with the PJPs and Finance team.

• Interpret and translate scientific data into commercial implications, analyze data, and make strategic recommendations.

• In case of new launches, build and propose a suitable Go-to-Market Strategy via defining pricing, distribution channels, and sales strategies, working with Access and Launch Excellence Leads.

• Provide marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches and monitor budget and expenditures.

• Participate in national and international congresses, scientific meetings, and global implementation/update meetings to keep the knowledge updated for commercialization strategies.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, act as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and contribute to creating value to the patient journey through supporting and enabling the PJPs in implementing successful projects for the ecosystem in line with Roche Code of Conduct and principles.

• Working beyond the local organization, align and collaborate with broader networks, provide support to global networks and other affiliates, and be accountable for ensuring collaboration with the networks and local leads to identify new opportunities, initiatives, and solutions to answer stakeholder needs and to drive value for the patients.

• Prepare and update the training materials and provide internal education and training programs to the customer engagement teams and other lead roles in the affiliate when necessary.

• Generate mar-com strategies working together with the communication department. Support the PJPs in setting the Therapeutic Area or other communication strategy and creation/adaptation of local Therapeutic Area messages, materials, and communication content for digital platforms.

Mindset and Behaviours:

• We Before Me Mindset: Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche

• System thinker, self-managed and self-dir

titleByLocale.it: Direttore del gruppo senior, sviluppo e processi di sicurezza
titleByLocale.en: Senior Group Director, Safety Development & Processes
titleByLocale.de: Senior Group Direktor, Safety Development & Processes
