jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Synthetic Molecules Technical Development (PTDC) ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Herstellung von Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP), sowie die analytische Entwicklung und Qualitätskontrolle unseres Portfolios von synthetischen Molekülen. PTDC arbeitet dabei eng mit wichtigen Partnern in den Bereichen Forschung und frühe Entwicklung (pRED / gRED) sowie der globalen technischen Entwicklung (PTD) zusammen.

In PTDC werden aus synthetischen Molekülen Medikamente hergestellt. Wir entwickeln robuste, kosteneffiziente Herstellungsprozesse und schaffen Wissen durch Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in einem kooperativen Umfeld.

Die Möglichkeit

Das Team von SHE Support & Compliance (PTDC-T) ist verantwortlich für die Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umweltschutz in den Bereichen DS und DP. Diese Rolle ist von entscheidender Bedeutung, um eine robuste, proaktive Sicherheitskultur in den Herstellbereichen zu fördern und zu stärken. Die Aufgaben gliedern sich wie folgt:

• Unterstützung des SGU-Chemikers bei der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsanordnungen sowie der Kontrolle der allgemeinen Ordnung und Sauberkeit in Produktions- und Laborgebäuden.

• Durchführung diverser Sicherheitsrundgänge sowie Kontrolle bei der Einhaltung von Vorschriften und Auflagen.

• Ausstellen von Arbeitsbewilligungen und Verwaltung von Sicherheitsmaterialien.

• Unterstützung bei Ereignisabklärungen sowie aktive Hilfestellung bei Havarien und Ereignissen.

• Durchführung von Sicherheitsschulungen für die Mitarbeitenden.

• Einweisung, Betreuung und Kontrolle von Fremdhandwerkern vor Ort.

• Kontrolle, Unterhalt und Dokumentation der sicherheitskritischen Gebäudeinfrastruktur.

Wer Sie sind

Für diese Position bringen Sie folgende Qualifikationen und Fachkenntnisse mit:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im technischen/pharmazeutischen Bereich (z.B. Chemie-/Pharmatechnologe, Pharmakant, Chemikant) oder eine höhere technische Fachausbildung bzw. ein Studium.

• Zusatzausbildung zum Sicherheitsassistent/-in, Sicherheitsfachmann/-frau EKAS oder Spezialist/-in Arbeitssicherheit und Gesundheitsschutz (ASGS) als willkommener Pluspunkt.

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im SGU-Umfeld sowie ein solides Verständnis im Bereich der chemischen / pharmazeutischen Herstellung.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache.

• Geübt im Umgang mit IT-Systemen sowie eine neugierige und offene Haltung gegenüber der digitalen Welt.

• Selbstständige, initiative und integre Persönlichkeit mit hoher Sozialkompetenz, Flexibilität, inklusivem Denken und ausgeprägter Teamorientierung.

• Ergebnis- und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung, Kundenorientierung und faktenbasierte, konsequente Entscheidungen.

• Selbstmotiviert und entwicklungsorientiert mit dem Anspruch, sich stetig weiterzubilden.

• Mutiges Auftreten, um die eigene Position zu vertreten, unangenehme Themen offen zur Sprache zu bringen und konstruktives Feedback einzufordern.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass für eine Anstellung in diesem Bereich ein einwandfreier Strafregisterauszug zwingend erforderlich ist.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le développement technique des molécules synthétiques (PTDC) est responsable du développement et de la production de la substance médicamenteuse (DS), du produit pharmaceutique (DP), ainsi que du développement analytique et du contrôle de la qualité de notre portefeuille de molécules synthétiques. PTDC travaille en étroite collaboration avec d'importants partenaires de la recherche et du développement précoce (PRED / GRED) et du développement technique mondial (PTD). Dans le PTDC, les médicaments sont produits à partir de molécules synthétiques. Nous développons des procédés de fabrication robustes et rentables et créons des connaissances grâce à l'innovation et à l'amélioration continue d'un environnement coopératif. La possibilité L'équipe de SHE Support & Compliance (PTDC-T) est responsable de la sécurité, de la santé et de la protection de l'environnement dans les domaines du DS et du PDD. Ce rôle est crucial pour promouvoir et renforcer une culture de sécurité solide et proactive dans les zones de production. Les tâches sont les suivantes :
• Soutien du chimiste SGU dans le respect des dispositions de sécurité et le contrôle de l'ordre général et de la propreté dans les bâtiments de production et de laboratoire.
• la mise en oeuvre de divers programmes de sécurité et de contrôle conformément aux règlements et aux exigences.
• Délivrer des permis de travail et gérer les matériaux de sécurité.
• Soutien à la clarification des événements et à l'assistance active en cas d'accidents et d'événements.
• Mise en place d'une formation à la sécurité pour les employés.
• Instruction, soins et contrôle des commerçants étrangers sur place.
• Contrôle, entretien et documentation de l'infrastructure de construction essentielle à la sécurité. Qui vous êtes Pour ce poste, vous apporterez les qualifications et l'expertise suivantes:
• Achèvement de la formation professionnelle dans le domaine technique/pharmaceutique (par exemple chimie/pharmacologique, pharmaceutique, chimique) ou de la formation ou de l'étude technique supérieure.
• Une formation supplémentaire pour l'assistant de sécurité, le spécialiste de la sécurité EKAS ou le spécialiste de la sécurité et de la santé au travail (ASGS) comme point de bienvenue.
• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience dans l'environnement SGU et une solide compréhension dans le domaine de la production chimique/pharmaceutique.
• Compétences linguistiques en allemand dans l'écriture et la parole ainsi que bonne connaissance de l'anglais.
• Travaille avec les systèmes informatiques et une attitude curieuse et ouverte envers le monde numérique.
• Indépendants, initiatives et personnalité intégrée avec une grande compétence sociale, flexibilité, pensée inclusive et forte orientation de l'équipe.
• Résultat et fonctionnement responsable en mettant l'accent sur l'amélioration continue, l'orientation client et les décisions factuelles et cohérentes.
• Automotivé et orienté vers le développement avec l'obligation de continuer à se développer.
• L'apparence mutuelle pour représenter sa propre position, pour aborder ouvertement les problèmes désagréables et pour demander des commentaires constructifs. Avons-nous réveillé votre intérêt ? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui ! Veuillez télécharger tous vos documents de candidature : CV, certificats de formation et certificats de travail. Veuillez noter qu'un retrait satisfaisant des casiers judiciaires est absolument nécessaire pour l'emploi dans ce domaine. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the microbiological testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Microbiology lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely data to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

• Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

• Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.
● By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of microbiology supplies

• Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• CCS Support: Support the establishment of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) for the aseptic production line.

• Environmental Monitoring (EM): Support EMPQ execution according to the project timeline.

• Microbiology Method Validation: Support the microbiology methods transfer, including supporting the confirmation of cleaning and disinfection processes, and the efficacy of disinfectants.

• Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies
● 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on microbiology and aseptic processes. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
● Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and microbiological testing.
● Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.
● Fluent communications skills in English
● Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role

Are you ready to use your technical talents to make a direct impact on patient lives worldwide?

Our Roche Motherwell Center of Excellence is one of Scotland’s premier, cutting-edge technology corridors. Forget the dull, legacy manufacturing floors—this facility boasts high-grade, automated cleanrooms and advanced bio-containment spaces that will genuinely challenge and elevate your technical expertise.

We are seeking a dedicated and ambitious Maintenance Engineer to play a pivotal role in sustaining the production of our life-saving diagnostic sensors. Operating within a high-precision, cleanroom environment, you will be responsible for ensuring the total operational reliability and safety of advanced manufacturing equipment while strictly maintaining its validated state.

This role demands an agile professional who can perfectly balance proactive Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) with rapid, high-level troubleshooting to safeguard product efficacy and patient safety. Whether you are a seasoned professional or an engineer in the early stages of your career, your expertise will directly contribute to the success of our world-class diagnostic site.

Key Responsibilities

• Preventative Maintenance & Reliability: Generate, execute, and manage comprehensive preventative maintenance programs (PMs) on advanced production equipment to maximize operational uptime and minimize unplanned downtime.

• Reactive Troubleshooting & RCA: Diagnose and resolve complex mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic system failures within a high-pressure, medical device production environment to eliminate supply gaps.

• Regulatory Compliance: Maintain meticulous records and data integrity in strict accordance with ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, and GxP standards to ensure equipment remains in its validated state.

• Equipment Validation: Support Quality and Engineering teams during the execution of IQ/OQ/PQ (Installation, Operational, and Performance Qualification) protocols for new or modified machinery.

• Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement equipment optimization projects to systematically improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and manufacturing productivity.

• Documentation & Change Control: Lead or support updates to manufacturing documentation, including work instructions, risk assessments, and formal change control processes.

• Safety & Environment: Adhere strictly to all Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) protocols, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and strict cleanroom gowning/contamination control procedures.

• Inventory & Contractor Oversight: Proactively manage inventory levels for critical components to ensure rapid response times. Coordinate third-party contractor site visits, performing rigorous reviews of RAMS (Risk Assessments and Method Statements) and supervising works.

• Stakeholder Interaction & Teamwork: In this role, you will serve as a vital technical linchpin. You will work cross-functionally with key stakeholders across the business, including the Sensor Production Team, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Equipment Support Group, Quality, Procurement, Finance, and SHE teams to drive operational excellence and ensure compliance.

Requirements & Key Skills

• Education: College or degree qualification in an appropriate engineering discipline, or significant equivalent relevant hands-on work experience.

• Industry Experience: Significant experience as a hands-on maintenance engineer within a highly regulated m

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul ruolo Sei pronto a usare i tuoi talenti tecnici per avere un impatto diretto sulla vita dei pazienti in tutto il mondo? Il nostro Roche Motherwell Center of Excellence è uno dei principali corridoi tecnologici della Scozia. Dimenticate i piani di produzione più omogenei, questa struttura vanta camere pulite automatizzate di alta qualità e spazi avanzati di biocontenimento che sfidano e e elevano le vostre competenze tecniche. Stiamo cercando un ingegnere di manutenzione dedicato e ambizioso per svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nel sostenere la produzione dei nostri sensori diagnostici salvavita. Operando all'interno di un ambiente di pulizia ad alta precisione, sarete responsabili di garantire la totale affidabilità operativa e la sicurezza delle apparecchiature di produzione avanzate mantenendo rigorosamente il suo stato convalidato. Questo ruolo richiede un professionista agile che può perfettamente bilanciare la manutenzione preventiva pianificata (PPM) proattiva con risoluzione rapida e di alto livello per salvaguardare l'efficacia del prodotto e la sicurezza del paziente. Che tu sia un professionista esperto o un ingegnere nelle prime fasi della tua carriera, la tua esperienza contribuirà direttamente al successo del nostro sito diagnostico di livello mondiale. Principali responsabilità
• Manutenzione preventiva e affidabilità: Generare, eseguire e gestire programmi di manutenzione preventiva completi (PM) su apparecchiature di produzione avanzate per massimizzare i tempi operativi e minimizzare i tempi di fermo non pianificati.
• Risoluzione dei problemi reattivi & RCA: diagnosticare e risolvere guasti complessi di sistemi meccanici, elettrici e pneumatici all'interno di un ambiente di produzione di dispositivi medici ad alta pressione per eliminare le lacune di alimentazione.
• Compliance regolamentare: Mantenere registri meticolosi e l'integrità dei dati in stretta conformità con ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820 e standard GxP per garantire che le apparecchiature rimangano nel suo stato convalidato.
• Validazione delle apparecchiature: Support Quality and Engineering team durante l'esecuzione dei protocolli IQ/OQ/PQ (Installation, Operational e Performance Qualification) per macchinari nuovi o modificati.
• Miglioramento continuo: Individuare e implementare i progetti di ottimizzazione delle attrezzature per migliorare sistematicamente l'efficacia delle attrezzature globali (OEE) e la produttività di produzione.
• Documentazione & Cambia controllo: portare o sostenere gli aggiornamenti alla documentazione di produzione, comprese le istruzioni di lavoro, le valutazioni dei rischi e i processi di controllo formale dei cambiamenti.
• Sicurezza e ambiente: aderire strettamente a tutti i protocolli di sicurezza, salute e ambiente (SHE), inclusi Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) e rigorose procedure di controllo dell'abbigliamento/contaminazione delle stanze pulite.
• Inventory & Contractor Oversight: gestire in modo attivo i livelli di inventario dei componenti critici per garantire tempi di risposta rapidi. Coordinare le visite del sito di terzi appaltatori, eseguendo rigorose recensioni di RAMS (Valutazioni di rischio e dichiarazioni di metodo) e supervisione di lavori.
• Stakeholder Interaction & Teamwork: In questo ruolo, servirai come un pilastro tecnico vitale. Potrai lavorare in modo trasversale con le parti interessate chiave in tutto il business, tra cui il team di produzione sensori, ingegneria dei processi, ingegneria delle attrezzature, gruppo di supporto attrezzature, qualità, appalti, finanza e team SHE per guidare l'eccellenza operativa e garantire la conformità. Requisiti e competenze chiave
• Istruzione: diploma universitario o laurea in una disciplina ingegneristica appropriata, o significativa esperienza lavorativa equivalente.
• Esperienza dell'industria: Esperienza significativa come ingegnere di manutenzione pratico all'interno di un m altamente regolamentato

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Über die Rolle Sind Sie bereit, Ihre technischen Talente zu nutzen, um direkte Auswirkungen auf das Patientenleben weltweit zu machen? Vergessen Sie die langweiligen, alten Fertigungsböden – diese Anlage verfügt über hochwertige, automatisierte Reinräume und erweiterte Bio-Containment-Räume, die Ihre technische Expertise wirklich herausfordern und erhöhen wird. • Gerätevalidierung: Unterstützung von Qualitäts- und Engineering-Teams bei der Ausführung von IQ/OQ/PQ (Installation, Operational und Performance Qualification) Protokollen für neue oder geänderte Maschinen.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Analyse und Implementierung von Anlagenoptimierungsprojekten zur systematischen Verbesserung der Gesamteffizienz (OEE) und der Fertigungsproduktivität.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos du rôle Êtes-vous prêt à utiliser vos talents techniques pour avoir un impact direct sur la vie des patients dans le monde? Notre centre d'excellence Roche Motherwell est l'un des premiers couloirs technologiques d'Écosse. Oubliez les planchers de fabrication ternes et anciens – cette installation dispose de salles de nettoyage automatisées de qualité supérieure et d'espaces de biocontainment avancés qui vont vraiment défier et élever votre expertise technique. Nous cherchons un ingénieur de maintenance dévoué et ambitieux pour jouer un rôle central dans le maintien de la production de nos capteurs de diagnostic de sauvetage. Fonctionnant dans un environnement de haute précision et propre, vous serez responsable d'assurer la fiabilité opérationnelle totale et la sécurité des équipements de fabrication avancés tout en maintenant strictement son état validé. Ce rôle exige un professionnel agile qui peut parfaitement équilibrer l'entretien préventif proactif avec un dépannage rapide et de haut niveau pour préserver l'efficacité du produit et la sécurité des patients. Que vous soyez un professionnel chevronné ou un ingénieur au début de votre carrière, votre expertise contribuera directement au succès de notre site de diagnostic de classe mondiale. Principales responsabilités
• Maintenance préventive et fiabilité: Générer, exécuter et gérer des programmes complets de maintenance préventive (PM) sur des équipements de production avancés pour maximiser les temps d'arrêt opérationnels et minimiser les temps d'arrêt imprévus.
• Dépannage réactif & RCA: Diagnostiquer et résoudre les défaillances complexes du système mécanique, électrique et pneumatique dans un environnement de production de dispositifs médicaux haute pression pour éliminer les lacunes d'approvisionnement.
• Conformité réglementaire: Tenir des registres méticuleux et l'intégrité des données en stricte conformité avec la norme ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820 et les normes GxP pour s'assurer que l'équipement reste dans son état validé.
• Validation de l'équipement: Support des équipes de qualité et d'ingénierie lors de l'exécution des protocoles IQ/OQ/PQ (Installation, Exploitation et Performance Qualification) pour les machines nouvelles ou modifiées.
• Amélioration continue: identifier et mettre en œuvre des projets d'optimisation de l'équipement pour améliorer systématiquement l'efficacité globale de l'équipement (EEE) et la productivité de fabrication.
• Documentation et contrôle des changements : Mise à jour de la documentation de fabrication, y compris les instructions de travail, les évaluations des risques et les processus officiels de contrôle des changements.
• Sécurité et environnement: respecter strictement tous les protocoles de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement (SHE), y compris Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) et les procédures strictes de contrôle de la toilette et de la contamination.
• Surveillance de l'inventaire et de l'entrepreneur : gérer proactivement les niveaux d'inventaire des composantes essentielles afin d'assurer des temps d'intervention rapides. Coordonner les visites d'entrepreneurs tiers, effectuer des examens rigoureux de la RAMS (Évaluation des risques et énoncés de méthodes) et superviser les travaux.
• Interaction avec les parties prenantes & Travail d'équipe: Dans ce rôle, vous serez un pivot technique essentiel. Vous travaillerez de façon interfonctionnelle avec des intervenants clés dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, y compris l'équipe de production de capteurs, l'ingénierie des procédés, l'ingénierie de l'équipement, le groupe de soutien de l'équipement, la qualité, l'approvisionnement, les finances et les équipes SHE, afin de stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle et d'assurer la conformité. Exigences et compétences clés
• Éducation : diplôme d'études collégiales ou d'études supérieures dans une discipline d'ingénierie appropriée, ou expérience de travail pratique significative.
• Expérience de l'industrie: Expérience significative en tant qu'ingénieur de maintenance pratique au sein d'un m hautement réglementé

jobs.title: Warehouse Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility realization, including but not limited to FAT, SAT, IOPQ etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Participate in the implementation of warehouse operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, etc. according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified in the daily operation in the warehouse.
Routine Operation:
Technical & Operational
● Material Handling: Receive raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Verify
quantity and inspect for damage or discrepancies against purchase orders and shipping
documents. Also including dangerous and chemical goods
● Storage and Inventory: Safely store materials in designated warehouse locations. Perform accurate and timely stocktaking, including cycle counts and physical inventories, to ensure stock accuracy.
● Documentation: Maintain precise and complete records for all warehouse activities, including receiving records, material transfer forms, and inventory records. Ensure all documentation is accurate and legible.
● Picking and Packing: Accurately pick materials for production orders or shipments. Stage materials in designated areas, ensuring they are ready for use or transport. Prepare finished goods for shipment, including packing, labeling, and documentation.
● System Operations: Operate the Warehouse Management System (WMS) or other inventory management software to record all material movements and transactions.
● Equipment Operation: Safely operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment. Perform pre-operational checks and report any maintenance issues.
● Other tasks assigned by AM.
Compliance & Safety
● Adhere to all GMP and SOPs to ensure the quality and integrity of all materials and products.
● Follow all SHE rules and regulations, including wearing appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintaining a clean and orderly work area.
● Report any deviations, quality issues, or safety hazards immediately to the supervisor/manager.
● Participate in team meetings, safety training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications
● A college degree or above in logistics management, warehouse management, or related fields (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred)
● Qualification of dangerous and chemical goods handling
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
● 3 years of experience in a warehouse or logistics environment.
● Experience operating a forklift and other material handling equipment.
● Familiarity with WMS (e.g. SAP, MES) and Microsoft Excel (data entry and basic reports)
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry
● Good communication with team members and cross function colleagues.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. That’s what drives us.
We are looking for a Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP) at Roche Diagnostics to serve as key business partner to the commercial organization and report to Finance Enterprise Partner Lead.
As a FEP, you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our commercial strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organization (including the Finance Excellence Partner), to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

• You partner with the business and support or co-lead touchpoints alongside the customer journey with an enterprise mindset.

• You balance resource allocation across competing priorities and provide advice on financial implications of proposed business activities.

• You are a key partner for developing a coherent affiliate commercial strategy as well as commercial business related processes such as business planning, opportunity prioritization and creative strategies for revenue generation.

• You ensure financials are on track to achieve targeted business results and metrics, or advise on deviations and corrective actions.

• You participate in FEP communities to learn, share and implement best practices across markets.

• You support the business and customers in co-creating new business models, quantifying value, and providing pricing transparency.

Who You Are

• You possess advanced controlling and reporting skills and expertly manage SAP Finance, as well as BO Analysis and/ or BEx Analyzer and Tableau Software.

• You have an entrepreneurial, commercial and customer centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.

• You have strong business and financial acumen and experience working with and for the customer.

• You are actively seeking input and building relationships with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• You are able to navigate a complex, challenging environment based on agile principles.

• You are fluent in English and Turkish.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Technical Product Owner for Web Experience, you will be a key driver in evolving Roche Diagnostics' global and regional digital ecosystem. You will enable scalable, customer-centric digital experiences that support healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients worldwide. This role sits at the heart of our digital transformation, bridging the gap between ambitious business needs and high-quality technical execution.

Your Responsibilities

• Own the Digital Backlog: You will prioritize and manage the backlog for Web Experience and Web Analytics platforms, translating business requirements into clear, actionable technical stories.

• Drive Global Delivery: Collaborate closely with engineering teams and external partners to drive sprint planning, testing, and successful releases.

• Shape Platform Capabilities: Support the continuous improvement of global websites, content publishing workflows, search discoverability, and personalization.

• Lead Technical Integrations: Coordinate activities across major platforms like Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), content repositories (DAM), and Marketing Automation ecosystems.

• Ensure Excellence & Compliance: Guarantee that all web solutions are secure, accessible, and compliant with global regulations such as GDPR.

• Facilitate Global Collaboration: Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, UX/UI specialists, and regional teams to ensure delivery consistency across the globe.

Who You Are

• You are a proactive technical leader who thrives in complex environments and possesses a deep understanding of how to build and scale global web platforms. You bring a collaborative mindset and the ability to influence both technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver measurable impact.

• Experienced Product Professional: You bring 5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Owner or Digital Product Manager, specifically delivering enterprise-level web platforms or portals.

• Agile Expert: You have a proven track record working with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFE.

• Technical Strategist: You possess a strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and connected digital architectures (e.g., CMS, DAM, and Analytics ecosystems).

• Skilled Communicator: You excel at managing stakeholders across diverse business and technical teams, simplifying complex technical concepts into clear priorities.

• Analytical Problem Solver: You have a natural ability to identify delivery risks and technical dependencies while maintaining a focus on quality and platform stability.

Ready to make a difference?
At Roche, you’re empowered to design your own learning path. With access to training, job rotations, and leadership development, we support your unique growth journey.

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche i

jobs.title: Solution Architect - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience

titleByLocale.it: Solution Architetto - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience
titleByLocale.en: Solution Architect - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience
titleByLocale.de: Solution Architect - Content Lieferkette & Web Experience
titleByLocale.fr: Solution Architecte - Content Chaîne d'approvisionnement & Web Experience

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Diagnostics, we are redefining how we connect with customers globally. We are seeking a Solution Architect - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience to lead the technical evolution of our next-generation ecosystem. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping modular, cloud-native, and AI-enabled customer engagement capabilities across global and local markets. You will work within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment alongside product leads, engineers, and strategic partners to translate business capabilities into future-state architecture.

Your Responsibilities

• Shape Architecture Strategy: Define and maintain the target architecture, integration patterns, and technical guardrails for our Content Supply Chain and Web Experience capabilities.

• Design Scalable Solutions: Create reusable, secure, and compliant end-to-end architectures spanning content planning, creation, storage, activation, and real-time personalization.

• Lead Ecosystem Integration: Direct technical architecture across premiere platforms, including Adobe Experience Cloud (Sites, Assets, Workfront, GenStudio), Veeva Vault PromoMats, and advanced Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).

• Govern Technical Quality: Drive robust non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, security, and global compliance standards (such as GDPR).

• Collaborate and Guide: Partner closely with Technical Product Owners and engineering teams to validate technical designs, manage architectural dependencies, and ensure sustainable deliveries.

• Foster Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, championing proof-of-concepts in AI-enabled content operations, dynamic content assembly, and enterprise content intelligence.

Who You Are

• You are a forward-thinking technical leader who thrives on turning complex digital ecosystem challenges into simplified, high-performing platform realities.

• You excel at bridging the gap between business vision and deep technical engineering, utilizing your exceptional stakeholder management skills to influence distributed global teams.

• Extensive Architecture Experience: 8+ years of proven success in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or complex digital platform engineering.

• Ecosystem Mastery: Demonstrated experience designing, integrating, and scaling enterprise web content management, digital asset management (DAM), and dynamic personalization technologies.

• Modern Engineering Mindset: Strong, practical understanding of cloud-native architectures, API-first delivery, integration patterns, and composable platform ecosystems.

• Technical Governance & Compliance: Robust knowledge of navigating non-functional requirements like web security, accessibility, performance optimization, and international data privacy regulations.

• Academic Foundation: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

• Nice-to-have highlights: Experience in regulated environments (such as life sciences or healthcare) or direct technical familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud and Veeva Vault platforms is highly valued.

At Roche, we embrace emerging innovations, like AI, to enhance the patient journey. If you’re passionate about new technology and thinking ahead, we want you to join us!

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 228,900.00 PLN-425,100.00 PLN. Final compensation will be deter

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Under the matrix leadership of the Safety Strategy Leader (SSL) and in collaboration with Portfolio Clinical Safety (PCS) colleagues to:
● Develop and maintain an understanding of the safety profile of their assigned product(s) or therapy areas. Develop and maintain an expert understanding of the safety profile of the assigned product(s) as well as understanding of the relevant strategic context (e.g., disease under study, safety profile of competitors, mechanism of action)
● Responsible for individual and aggregate case reporting activities including ICSR case management (medical review) and aggregate reporting (i.e. DSUR, PBRER)
● Responsible for signal detection and management activities including, but not limited to STAR maintenance, ISMP maintenance. Contribute to the strategy and review of safety assessments and drug safety reports for signals or issues (inc, product quality) or in response to Regulatory Authority requests
● Contribute to the development of the product safety strategy and provide drug safety input into the Clinical Development strategy
● Contributing to risk management activities including preparation and maintenance of CCDS, labeling document maintenance (including the IB), risk communications, RMP, REMS
● Contributing to study management from a safety perspective through SMT/PET activities and document review and maintenance across the development continuum (early phase to post marketing studies), including PASS
● Contribute to regulatory authority submissions (Investigational New Drug/IND applications, New Drug Applications/NDAs, Marketing Authorization Applications/MAAs, Variations, Renewals, etc.) by reviewing safety data and preparing relevant sections of the filing and submission packages in consultation with SPL
● Responsible for the preparation and maintenance of safety sections of the Company Core Data Sheet and/or Reference Safety Information in the IB
● Participate in and provide input for Drug Monitoring Committees (iDMC) or internal monitoring committee (IMC) meetings, as applicable
● In partnership with the SSL, support presentation of important safety issues to the Drug Safety Committee (DSC), Development Review Committee (DRC) and other internal and external review and governance committees as needed.
● Author or contribute to scientific publications (abstracts, posters, papers) for scientific meetings/journals
● Acts independently to manage safety responsibilities on study teams and in activities supporting safety science
● Take on the responsibility for specialised roles with PCS. These may include, but are not limited to; functional business process owner, subject matter expert.

(
• Responsibilities due to medical qualifications)
They will provide clinical medical expertise and decision-making, in areas where this is specifically required to support colleagues in PCS. Situations where qualified clinical medical input may typically be sought could include, but are not limited to:

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sotto la guida matrice del Safety Strategy Leader (SSL) e in collaborazione con i colleghi Portfolio Clinical Safety (PCS) a: ● Sviluppare e mantenere una comprensione del profilo di sicurezza dei loro prodotti assegnati o aree di terapia. Sviluppare e mantenere una comprensione esperta del profilo di sicurezza del prodotto/i assegnato, nonché la comprensione del contesto strategico rilevante (ad esempio, malattia in studio, profilo di sicurezza dei concorrenti, meccanismo di azione) ● Responsabile per le attività di reporting di casi individuali e aggregati, tra cui la gestione dei casi ICSR (revisione medica) e la reportistica aggregata (ad esempio DSUR, PBRER) ● Responsabile per le attività di rilevamento e gestione del segnale, tra cui, ma non limitato alla manutenzione STAR, manutenzione ISMP. Contribuire alla strategia e alla revisione delle valutazioni di sicurezza e delle relazioni sulla sicurezza dei farmaci per segnali o problemi (inc, qualità del prodotto) o in risposta alle richieste dell'Autorità di regolamentazione ● Contribuire allo sviluppo della strategia di sicurezza del prodotto e fornire input di sicurezza della droga nella strategia di sviluppo clinico ● Contribuire alle attività di gestione del rischio, tra cui la preparazione e la manutenzione di CCDS, l'etichettatura della manutenzione dei documenti (incluso IB), le comunicazioni di rischio, RMP, REMS ● Contribuire alla gestione dello studio da una prospettiva di sicurezza attraverso attività SMT/PET e la revisione e la manutenzione dei documenti attraverso il continuum di sviluppo (prima fase di studi post marketing), tra cui PASS ● Contribuire alle richieste dell'autorità di regolamentazione (Applicazioni di Nuovi farmaci/IND, Nuove Applicazioni di Droga/NDA, Applicazioni di Autorizzazione di Marketing/MAA, Variazioni, Rinnovi, ecc.) esaminando i dati di sicurezza e preparando le relative sezioni dei pacchetti di archiviazione e presentazione in consultazione con SPL ● Responsabile per la preparazione e la manutenzione delle sezioni di sicurezza della Scheda Dati Core e/o Informazioni di Sicurezza di riferimento nell'IB ● Partecipare e fornire input per i comitati di monitoraggio della droga (iDMC) o riunioni del comitato di monitoraggio interno (IMC), come applicabile ● In collaborazione con il SSL, la presentazione di importanti questioni di sicurezza al Comitato per la sicurezza della droga (DSC), il Comitato per la revisione dello sviluppo (DRC) e altri comitati di controllo e di governance interni ed esterni. ● Autore o contribuire a pubblicazioni scientifiche (abstracts, manifesti, documenti) per incontri scientifici/giorni ● agisce indipendentemente per gestire le responsabilità di sicurezza sui team di studio e nelle attività di supporto alla scienza della sicurezza ● Assumere la responsabilità per ruoli specializzati con PCS. Questi possono includere, ma non sono limitati a; proprietario di processo operativo, esperto di materia. (
• Responsabilità dovute a qualifiche mediche) Essi forniranno competenze mediche cliniche e processi decisionali, in aree in cui questo è specificamente richiesto per supportare i colleghi in PCS. Situazioni in cui l'ingresso medico clinico qualificato può in genere essere cercato potrebbero includere, ma non sono limitati a: ● Interpretazione dei dati rilevanti per la sicurezza, nell'ambito dell'esperienza acquisita durante la pratica in settori rilevanti di medicina clinica/assistenza sanitaria. ● Definire i tipi di domanda di sicurezza o problema di sicurezza, nel contesto di una molecola/programma, che possono richiedere specifiche valutazioni o decisioni di sicurezza medica. ● Effettuare valutazioni sull'impatto della pratica medica nel contesto di problemi di sicurezza della qualità del prodotto (ad esempio, nell'ambito di attività definite delineate nei processi gestiti da PT che richiedono una valutazione formale da parte di qualifiche mediche

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Sous la direction matricielle du chef de la stratégie de sécurité (CSS) et en collaboration avec des collègues du Portefeuille en sécurité clinique (SCP), pour : ● Développer et maintenir une compréhension du profil d'innocuité de leur produit ou de leurs zones thérapeutiques. Élaborer et maintenir une compréhension experte du profil d'innocuité du ou des produits assignés ainsi que de la compréhension du contexte stratégique pertinent (p. ex. maladie à l'étude, profil d'innocuité des concurrents, mécanisme d'action) ● Responsable des activités individuelles et globales de rapport de cas, y compris la gestion des cas du CISR (examen médical) et les rapports globaux (c.-à-d. DSUR, PBRER) ● Responsable des activités de détection et de gestion des signaux, y compris, sans s'y limiter, l'entretien STAR, ISMP. Contribuer à la stratégie et à l'examen des évaluations de l'innocuité et des rapports sur l'innocuité des médicaments pour les signaux ou les questions (y compris la qualité du produit) ou en réponse aux demandes de l'autorité réglementaire ● Contribuer à l'élaboration de la stratégie d'innocuité des produits et fournir des renseignements sur l'innocuité des médicaments dans la stratégie de développement clinique ● Contribuer aux activités de gestion des risques, y compris la préparation et l'entretien du SCD, la maintenance des documents d'étiquetage (y compris le BI), la communication des risques, le PGR, le SGRR ● Contribuer à l'étude de la gestion du point de vue de la sécurité par le biais des activités SMT/PET et de l'examen et de l'entretien des documents dans tout le continuum de développement (phase initiale à post-commercialisation), y compris le PASS ● Contribuer aux présentations d'autorités réglementaires (demandes de nouveaux médicaments/IND, demandes de nouveaux médicaments/DNA, demandes d'autorisation de mise en marché/AAM, modifications, renouvellements, etc.) en examinant les données d'innocuité et en préparant les sections pertinentes des dossiers de présentation et de présentation en consultation avec SPL ● Responsable de la préparation et de l'entretien des sections de sécurité de la fiche de données de base de l'entreprise et/ou des renseignements de référence sur la sécurité dans l'IB ● Participer aux réunions des comités de surveillance des médicaments ou des comités de surveillance interne (CIM) et y contribuer, selon le cas ● En partenariat avec le SSL, appuyer la présentation d'importantes questions d'innocuité au Comité de l'innocuité des médicaments, au Comité d'examen du développement et à d'autres comités d'examen et de gouvernance internes et externes, au besoin. ● Auteur ou contribution à des publications scientifiques (abstractions, affiches, articles) pour des réunions/journals scientifiques ● Assure une gestion indépendante des responsabilités en matière de sécurité au sein des équipes d'étude et des activités de soutien aux sciences de la sécurité ● Prendre en charge les rôles spécialisés avec PCS. jobs.title: Security Engineer - Vulnerability & Exposure Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche is dedicated to protecting our networks, systems, applications, and users from constantly evolving cyber threats. As a Security Engineer within the Vulnerability & Exposure Management team, you will play a critical role in identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and reducing cybersecurity risks across Roche’s global environment.

This role goes beyond reviewing scanner outputs. You will help investigate critical vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, improve security tooling and automation capabilities, and partner with stakeholders globally to strengthen Roche’s security posture.

You will join a collaborative and highly technical cybersecurity team that values innovation, curiosity, continuous learning, and proactive risk reduction.

Your Opportunity
In this role, you will:

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities impacting Roche systems and applications

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities identified through security tools and external programs, including bug bounty initiatives

• Research emerging threats and assess exploitability against Roche’s attack surface

• Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application, and security teams to drive remediation activities

• Assess company systems and web applications using automated and manual testing approaches

• Engineer and enhance vulnerability scanning, detection, automation, and monitoring capabilities

• Contribute to security monitoring and incident response activities within a global environment

• Develop scripts, detection logic, templates, and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across vulnerability and exposure management processes

Who you are
You bring a strong cybersecurity foundation combined with analytical thinking, technical curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving complex security challenges.

You also bring:

• Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of professional experience in information security, with demonstrated experience triaging, analyzing, and escalating security vulnerabilities

• Strong understanding of web application, network, endpoint, and cloud security concepts, including vulnerability management or attack surface management within complex enterprise environments

• Hands-on scripting or programming experience using languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Node.js, with familiarity in security tooling, detection logic, automation, or custom scripting

• Experience validating vulnerabilities, assessing exploitability, and supporting security monitoring or incident response activities

• Ability to communicate technical risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, while balancing operational priorities and research initiatives

• Passion for cybersecurity, continuous learning, and emerging security trends, with exposure to open-source security projects or modern AI-assisted engineering workflows considered advantageous

• Professional fluency in English, with industry certifications related to offensive or application security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE) and enterprise cloud security experience viewed as strong assets

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mill

jobs.title: Medical Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Medical Specialist is a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building deep and long-term connections with key customers, you will anticipate and proactively optimize medical practice, ensuring Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas. Operating with an end-to-end perspective, you will serve as a critical driver of competitiveness to accelerate our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, and maximize patient access to our life-changing innovations.

What you will be working on:
As a Medical Specialist, you will:

• Proactively contribute strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise to differentiate our portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Lead the medical component of the integrated local strategy, shaping a scientifically sound value story that reflects an end-to-end commercialisation.

• Spend a significant time in the field, proactively engaging Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and key stakeholders in full alignment with cross-functional roles.

• Drive proactive, pre-launch end-to-end strategies to anticipate future medical trends and shape local medical practice.

• Manage post-launch engagement to ensure the right patients are treated at the right time while expanding our scope to underserved patient populations.

• Establish effective peer-to-peer relationships, identify science-driven collaborations, and deliver high-quality, non-promotional medical education to external customers.

• Systematically collect, analyze, and translate clinical practice and patient insights into strategic, actionable recommendations for your squad.

• Independently manage the end-to-end execution of insight initiatives like advisory boards, ensuring strict adherence to compliance standards.

• Design and manage the local Integrated Evidence Plan (IEP), identifying evidence gaps and executing tactics like Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies.

• Provide clinical context and expertise to local Health Authority submissions to support high-quality regulatory approvals and product licenses.

Who You Are:
You have:

• Completed Medical degree along with prior experience in Medical Affairs or Clinical Research.

• A strong grasp of complex clinical data sets, including clinical trials and Real-World Evidence, with the ability to leverage digital and AI tools to shape strategy.

• A comprehensive understanding of the Bangladesh healthcare system, allowing you to seamlessly navigate the patient journey across public and private sectors.

• The capability to independently author scientific materials and conduct contextual material reviews utilizing a strong working knowledge of the Pharmaceutical Code of Marketing Practices.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, giving you the ability to build trust and have direct, respectful scientific exchanges on a peer-to-peer level.

• A growth mindset, an entrepreneurial spirit, and the comfort required to navigate ambiguity while proposing pragmatic, value-adding solutions.

• A highly collaborative nature that thrives when showing leadership, self-motivation, and accountability within a multi-skilled, cross-functional network.

This rol

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for an entrepreneurial, experienced Patient Journey Partner (PJP) Ophthalmology to join the Customer Engagement Center at Roche Pharmaceuticals A/S in Denmark.
In this strategic yet hands-on role, you will be the central point of contact for all health care stakeholders involved in the care pathway of patients with eye conditions (such as macular degeneration). As our "eyes and ears" in the field, you will bridge the gap between external stakeholder needs—such as ophthalmologists, clinic managers and regional healthcare authorities—and the expertise within our internal cross-functional business team. Your primary goal is to accelerate access to innovative treatments and significantly improve patient outcomes across Denmark's healthcare ecosystem.

The Opportunity:

• Map the Patient Journey: Identify bottlenecks in the healthcare ecosystem, leverage data-driven insights, and translate external findings into pragmatic national strategies.

• Build Sustainable Partnerships: Cultivate deep, trust-based relationships with ophthalmologists and key regional healthcare decision-makers to drive measurable improvements in healthcare access.

• Co-create Solutions: Act as a peer-level sparring partner for healthcare professionals to develop practical, scalable solutions that support the optimal use of medical innovations.

• Drive Lifecycle Impact: Champion the introduction and long-term implementation of innovative therapies, ensuring their clinical and economic value is recognized and utilized.

• Lead and Coach: Act as a natural mentor within your multidisciplinary team, aligning and coaching colleagues to ensure an integrated, agile approach.

Who You Are:

• Background: A Master’s degree in Medical Sciences, Pharmaceutical Science, Health Economics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant commercial or medical field experience within the pharmaceutical or medical device (MedTech) industry, e.g., as a Senior Ophthalmology Key Account Manager or Ophthalmology Medical Science Liaison.

• Certification: You possess the Atrium Consultant certification (Atrium-konsulentuddannelsen) or are willing to commence the training in accordance with Atrium's requirements upon your employment with Roche Pharmaceuticals A/S.

• Specialization: Deep knowledge of ophthalmology and an existing local ophthalmology HCP network in Denmark is highly preferred. Experience with ophthalmic medical equipment or digital health solutions is a strong plus.

• Mindset: An entrepreneurial "can-do" spirit. You think strategically but are equally excited to roll up your sleeves and implement complex projects pragmatically in a field-based role.

• Communication: Exceptional communication and listening skills. You are fluent in Danish and English.

• Leadership: Proven experience coaching or mentoring colleagues (formally or informally) to elevate team performance.

Why Roche?

For over 125 years, Roche has focused on "Doing now what patients need next." We empower our people to work autonomously in an agile environment, making decisions based on their unique expertise.

• Sustainability Leader: We take care of our planet. Since 2025, our locations run on 100% sustainable electricity, driving toward our 2045 net-zero climate goal.

• Your Growth, Your Path: We don't dictate your career track. We actively invest in your personal and professional development based on your unique ambitions.

• The

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Présentation de l’équipe :
Rattaché(e) à la Division Service Clients – Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) et reportant au Responsable Customer Support Hardware, tu prends en charge les demandes clients et les accompagner pour de l'assistance téléphonique

Quel sera ton impact ?
Tu seras amené(e) à travailler sur les missions suivantes :

• Réception et traitement des demandes clients

• documentation dans le CRM

• diagnostic de pannes et proposition de solutions

• utilisation des possibilités de support à distance

• identification et traitement des réclamations et des problèmes de qualité

• gestion de réclamations simples (communication avec RCSC et équipes filiales)

• identification des problèmes de qualité et escalade au niveau d’expertise supérieur

• participer aux différents projets innovants initiés au sein du service

• contribuer au partage des informations et à l’optimisation des pratiques

• assurer la progression de ses propres compétences.

Tu es quelqu'un qui veut influencer son propre développement. Tu recherches une entreprise où le titre du poste n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui tu es, mais le point de départ.

Ton ADN:

• Formation Bac + 2/Bac +3 dans les domaines de l’automatisme, de l’instrumentation, de l’électronique et de l’informatique. (ex : DUT/BUT Mesures physiques, G2II…)

• Formation dans le domaine de l'analyse de biologie médicale avec une spécialisation dans l’instrumentation biomédicale (Licence professionnelle ScVBM, Instrumentation et Maintenance Biomédicales…)

• Français courant

• Anglais est indispensable (B1-B2)

Alternance de 12 mois à compter de septembre 2026
Poste basé à Meylan (38)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Nous sommes convaincus qu’il est urgent de proposer des solutions thérapeutiques et de diagnostic dès aujourd’hui, tout en innovant pour l’avenir. Améliorer la vie des patients est notre raison d’être. Nous décidons et agissons avec courage. Et nous croyons fermement qu’une conduite responsable de nos activités servira le monde de demain. Rigueur scientifique, éthique irréprochable, accès à l’innovation médicale pour tous : tels sont nos engagements.

Chez Roche, nous considérons que la diversité est source d'innovation. Nous sommes ouverts à tous les profils et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail agréable et inclusif.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner & Country Connector Canada

In People & Culture, our vision is to bring our Roche purpose to life by unlocking the greatness in all our people and the organization. We are a catalyst for enabling high performance while nurturing a sense of belonging and an inclusive culture where we can all thrive. We build trust by protecting and creating value through our partnership with customers to deliver not just services, but impactful experiences.

At Roche, we have moved away from traditional, hierarchical HR structures to build an advanced, agile People & Culture (P&C) organization. Guided by our belief that experts should focus on expert work, our P&C model is organized into six core global chapters: Integrated Workforce Strategies, Business Partnering, People Rewards and Recognition, People Support Solutions, People Insights and Technology, and People Organizational Growth . Each chapter reports directly into its respective global function rather than a local matrix. As the Business Partner Commercial and Country Connector , you will operate at the intersection of this model. This role requires a professional who is highly skilled in and comfortable with informal leadership; you will need to successfully influence, collaborate with, and align a team of highly competent, specialized P&C colleagues without the reliance on a direct reporting line. This is a senior, strategic leadership role responsible for shaping and driving the people and culture strategy for the Commercial organisation in Canada. This position requires the mindset of a business leader and entrepreneur and partner with multiple leadership areas in a part of the business as part of a global network.

The position holds the additional responsibility of “ Country Connector ” with specific responsibilities for external system shaping, reputation management, collaboration with work councils as needed as well. In addition, this role connects and aligns the P&C ecosystem holistically across all Roche affiliates and legal entities in the country.

What you’ll do

Strategic Business Leadership

• Think beyond P&C and operate as a true business leader and entrepreneur and translate business objectives into impactful people strategies.

• Act as the lead P&C strategist for executive leaders, using deep business acumen to co-create long-range strategies focused on human capital, organizational design, and future-readiness.

• Direct and lead complex, enterprise-wide change initiatives and Work Product Teams (WPTs) as a change enabler, building leadership coalitions to drive meaningful shifts within the organization.

Executive Coaching & Influence for Impact

• Provides guidance on talent management, workforce strategies, organization design and reward and recognition in partnership with other subject-matter experts to develop high quality solutions

• Maintains broad-based knowledge of multiple leadership areas across the organization and its operations; uses knowledge of business and P&C insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose topics with a wide range of complexity

• Maintains knowledge of external environment and other related information on peer and comparison groups to effectively diagnose and implement strategies to help drive business decisions

• Provide expert organizational consulting to executive leadership, shaping a culture with shared values and behaviors.

• Apply systems thinking to recognize patterns

jobs.title: National Sales Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

Join Roche Diagnostics as the National Sales Lead for the Lusophone territory, based in our Midrand, Johannesburg hub. In this role, you will lead the territory team and define the business strategy to accelerate growth and expand our market share within the Southern Africa network.

Key Challenges
Strategic Planning

• To develop the business plan to support delivery of the affiliate strategic direction and budget targets by supporting the development of allocated account and account business plans, aligning with the overall strategy annually

• To manage sales of key customers by reviewing and analyzing key customers sales in conjunction with sales team, identifying any issues, gaps in performance or other anomalies, providing support to develop solutions and overseeing implementation with sales team as required

• To optimally manage resources (sales team, budgets, etc.) by utilizing and deploying resources in order to achieve the set targets daily

• To provide input to the definition of the action plans for the specific business area by managing that all sales plans and objectives are aligned to the overall strategic vision and direction as required

• To develop and implement new tools and local KPI’s by interpreting global tools and KPI’s, customizing as per local needs and business requirements and implementing as required

• To create additional tools and KPI’s when required by identifying need, engaging with business, developing and implementing as required

• To monitor market and customer movements by maintaining awareness and reacting effectively and proactively to these changes through the application of market intelligence and alignment of the sales strategy as required

Operations Planning and Management

• To manage effective and professional service delivery in line with the set Roche business principles to all customers by monitoring, mentoring and coaching sales team on an ongoing basis.

• To manage, coordinate and partake in the strategic aspects of specific key accounts, stakeholders and executives by participating in meetings, engaging with individuals and providing input to sales team as required

• To manage customer engagement and communications by tracking sales team activities, reviewing metrics and addressing any issues as and when required and quarterly

• To manage sales and profitability target achievement by tracking sales team activities, reviewing metrics and addressing any issues as and when required and monthly

• To manage the budget and expenditure by reviewing expense requests, authorizing expense claims and tracking against budget and Roche policies and procedures monthly

• To manage the Sales Conferences and Cycle Meetings by planning meetings and informing the key priorities, contributing to the meeting quarterly and as required

• To monitor and manage the Sales teams’ territory knowledge and understanding by reviewing and analyzing information, identifying trends and patterns, identifying areas for improvement, addressing issues and implementing corrective action as required

• To manage sales performance by identifying performance trends and anomalies, managing the implementation of corrective actions timeously and limiting
