jobs.title: Product Specialist (Clinical Laboratory Support)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

At Roche Diagnostics, we understand that behind every test result is a patient. Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is looking for a Hungarian-speaking Product Specialist who wants to transition from the laboratory bench to a regional expert role. Whether you are an engineer or a lab professional, your expertise can help shape the future of diagnostics.

Please note that this is a CONTRACTOR/CONTINGENT POSITION. You will be employed by our 3rd party service provider.

Special Focus: Are you a Lab Professional looking for a career shift?

• Tired of shift work? Join us for a structured, professional office/hybrid environment.

• Ready to drop the lab coat but keep the expertise? Your hands-on experience with analyzers, reagents, and daily lab challenges is exactly what our customers need.

• Want to see the bigger picture? Move from running tests to mastering the entire diagnostic ecosystem, including IT integrations and cutting-edge software.

Your Impact:

• Technical & Application Support: Provide expert remote guidance for Hungarian laboratories and hospitals on IVD systems.

• Agile Problem Solving: Use your diagnostic "gut feeling" and our remote tools to prevent system downtimes.

• Knowledge Sharing: Be the bridge between complex technology and the people who use it every day.

• Professional Travel: Combine a structured office/hybrid setup with occasional customer site visits - using them as perfect opportunities for hands-on learning and staying connected to the lab reality

Who You Are:

• Background: Degree in Biochemistry, Medical Biology, Laboratory Diagnostics, IT, or Engineering .

• Language: Native-level Hungarian is essential; strong English for international training and collaboration.

• Experience: If you have worked in a clinical laboratory (Biochemist, Lab Technician) or in technical support, you have a head start!

• Mindset: You are empathetic to customer needs, curious about how things work "under the hood," and enjoy a collaborative "Agile" culture.

• Mobility: You possess a valid driving license and are ready to hit the road when duty calls, turning occasional customer visits into a change of scenery

What’s in it for you?

• A prestigious career path in a global healthcare leader.

• Comprehensive technical training (we teach you the engineering part; you bring the lab logic).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integration
titleByLocale.en: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations
titleByLocale.de: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integrations

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Senior Technical Solution Owner – Cornerstone Application & Integration serves as the ultimate technical authority for our Cornerstone platform as a core enterprise solution supporting learning, talent, and people development processes. You are the “subject matter expert”, responsible for technical integrity, exploiting Cornerstones functionalities maximising the platform's business value while ensuring technical stability. This role provides clear ownership of the technical realization and integration ecosystem, leading data migration initiatives, with a strong outcome oriented mindset and ability to translate requirements into acceptance criteria and ensure successful solution delivery.
In this role, you serve as a high-level sparring partner to other seniors IT stakeholders, contributing with your deep-dive Cornerstone expertise. You bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution, ensuring that every integration - whether upstream from Core HR or to downstream systems - is seamless, scalable, and robust. Your span of control ranges from license management, platform performance and stability, compliance and audit readiness, release feature prioritization, to driving medium- to large-scale initiatives that enhance the value, adoption, and impact of the platform.
As a senior leader in this space, you shape the technical evolution of the Cornerstone platform based on business priorities and the platform’s technical dept, guide decision-making delivering respective change impact assessments, and ensure that platform capabilities are translated into meaningful business outcomes. You work closely with business stakeholders, product and technical teams, architects, and external partners to ensure the solution is scalable, user-centered, and fit for purpose. With your in depth Cornerstone expertise and your learning process acumen, you understand the context of changes and how they relate to business needs to proactively shape the learning landscape.
This role goes beyond operational delivery. It requires a strong understanding of stakeholder ecosystems, enterprise platforms, and business transformation, with a particular focus on ensuring that Cornerstone capabilities are aligned to strategic priorities, integrated into end-to-end people processes, and optimized to deliver measurable value .

Key Responsibilities
Audit & Compliance

• Validation & Audits : Ensure fully documented and validated system including change control and ensure compliant change administration on GXP application. Orchestrate audits and periodic reviews to ensure compliance resolving respective findings.

• Security & Access Control: Oversee tenant access, and perform Cornerstone account reviews, oversee and control access provisioning. Accountable for access provisioning, training assignment and training completion of workforce operating and using Cornerstone platform.

• Documentation : Lead delivery and regular update of Data Migration Plans, Operational Support Plans and Information Risk Assessment and Mitigation System documents such as security risk assessments, data processing agreements.

Technical Solution Ownership

• Functional Design & Innovation : Evaluate Cornerstone features, platform developments and integration requests to provide expert recommendations on how to simplify, harmonize, and innovate people-processes through technical enablement, understanding overall business change impact. Ensure the solution design supports end-to-end business process

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The People Support Solutions (PSS) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

The Opportunity:

Please note it is a fixed term opportunity until 14/06/2027.

As an Employee Lifecycle Management Specialist - German speaking​ you are part of a dynamic, vivid and spiritful Employee Lifecycle Management team supporting our Headquarters in Basel and our Swiss affiliates . The Employee Lifecycle Management teams deliver customer service and advisory support to HR and business partners on global HR systems and processes, ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with our customer-focused principles.

As a qualified expert, you are:

• Providing support, insight and explanation on HR systems as well as advisory and administrative activities in one or more main area of HR business processes and employee lifecycle events (eg. onboarding: recruitment and requisition support, offering, pre-employment and reference checks, hiring/onboarding, contract creation; employee changes: contract modifications, contingent workforce management, employee changes/moves, payroll & personal data changes; offboarding: terminations & offboarding support, retirement process, etc.)

• Providing customer service on HR related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting

• Supporting the embedding of the new ways of working, actively participating in the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives

• Behaving as role model to team members, showing positive and flexible attitude

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way

• Building relationships with HR colleagues within the PSS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, m

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 職務内容
• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。 ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応 ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明 ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成 ・保守契約の締結、請求

応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識
• ・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可

（歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方 ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション
• ・調整を取ってきた方 ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識 ・病院でのMEとしての経験

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサービスエンジニア
　　　　　• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
　　　　　　　　• ※本社での6か月間の研修後、仙台オフィスへ配属予定。
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 • 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 • 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 • 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　• ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Histology Associate (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Histology Associate (2nd shift) supports the functions of RTD histology laboratories in the performance of routine histotechniques. This is an essential position supporting the organizational goals requiring attendance on weekends, holidays and during emergency or exceptional conditions.

The Opportunity:

• Histotechniques (Tissue Sectioning and Staining)

• Demonstrates foundational histotechniques of embedding, microtomy, coverslipping, processing and primary staining.

• Operates laboratory or manufacturing equipment.

• Receives detailed directions on all work. Follows standard operating procedures.

• Monitors and prepares bulk reagents.

• May assist in preparation work for moderately complex techniques under the direction of more senior histology technicians.

• Proactively collaborates with peers and with other functions to ensure targets are achieved.

• Provides suggestions to improve work processes and laboratory equipment.

Quality and Safety

• Maintains Right to Operate and ensure that all processes are performed in a safe and healthy manner; Addresses and escalates any potentially unsafe hazards; Timely reports safety hazards, incidents and near misses using safety reporting tools.

• Navigates and understands the quality system and escalate issues.

• Accurately performs tasks in a regulated environment (OSHA, NMPA, FDA, etc.).

• Performs and documents all transactions and production instructions with accuracy related to the proper receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials as it relates to FDA, OSHA, QSR, ISO, Good Manufacturing Practices and other Roche policies and procedures.

• Recognizes minor issues with raw materials, equipment and lab safety, escalates as needed.

• Adheres to 95% or above internal training compliance.

Who you are?

• You have a High School Diploma or GED

• You have 1+ years in direct related histology experience. Experience with foundational histotechniques of embedding, microtomy, coverslipping, processing and primary staining. And experience with laboratory or manufacturing equipment.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Ability to read, analyze and follow Operating Procedures.

• Knowledge of basic manufacturing and laboratory techniques.

• Skilled use of word processing and email.

• Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement.

• Experience with Google products (gMail, gSheets, gDoc, etc), preferred.

• Experience with SAP required.

• Ability to read, write and comprehend English.

• Ability to work with cross-functional teams.

• Ability to be agile and accurate in a high-volume environment.

• Strong organizational skills, planning skills and attention to detail.

Physical conditions and PPE requirements:

• Required to stand, walk, sit, kneel, bend, crouch for a combined 4 or more hours per day.

• Required to push, pull, and lift a minimum of 25 pounds. Repetitive, consistent movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

• Required to have good near visual acuity to perform activities throughout the processes in the assigned area.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson is 43,900.00 - 81,500.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position

jobs.title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Key Account Manager (m/w/d) bei Roche Diagnostics bist Du das strategische Bindeglied, das Innovationen direkt dorthin bringt, wo sie den größten Unterschied machen: in das Herz unserer Gesundheitsversorgung. Mit Deinem Gespür für komplexe Kundenbedürfnisse gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Diagnostik aktiv mit und trägst dazu bei, dass Patient:innen schneller und präziser geholfen werden kann. In dieser Schlüsselrolle verwandelst Du Visionen in greifbare Ergebnisse und sicherst so unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg am Markt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen und kollegialen Vertriebsteams, das in ganz Deutschland vernetzt ist. Wir arbeiten Hand in Hand mit Expert:innen aus dem Service und dem Account Management, um für unsere anspruchsvollen Kundengruppen – von Universitätskliniken bis hin zu Laborfachärzten – die besten Lösungen zu finden. Gemeinsam meistern wir Herausforderungen mit einer Mischung aus Professionalität und echtem Teamgeist.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du betreust einen unserer Schlüsselkunden im Raum Berlin.

• Du entwickelst kundenspezifische Strategien und stellst deren erfolgreiche Implementierung sicher.

• Du planst, steuerst und monitorst die Geschäftsentwicklung in Deinem Bereich und führst fundierte Wettbewerbsanalysen durch.

• Du initiierst und leitest bereichsübergreifende Vertriebsaktivitäten und führst nationale Teams ohne direkte Weisungsbefugnis zum Erfolg.

• Du bringst aktiv Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung von Geschäftsfeldstrategien ein und arbeitest in zukunftsweisenden Projekten mit.

• Als Mentor unterstützt Du die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und übernimmst Verantwortung für ein Spezialthema wie z.B. Gerinnung oder Ausschreibungen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Naturwissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen, Medizin oder BWL) oder eine vergleichbare wissenschaftlich-technische Ausbildung.

• Du bringst mehrjährige Verkaufserfahrung im Gesundheitssektor mit und kennst Dich bestens im Diagnostikmarkt und dessen gesetzlichen Rahmenbedingungen aus.

• Du denkst unternehmerisch, kannst komplexe Projekte managen und bringst Erfahrung in der Führung innerhalb von Matrixstrukturen mit.

• Dein Auftreten ist professionell, glaubwürdig und gewinnend. Du besitzt die soziale Kompetenz, um Menschen zu integrieren und gemeinsam Lösungen zu finden. Du bist daran interessiert, kollaborative und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen .

• Der sichere Umgang mit Office-Programmen und CRM-Tools ist für Dich selbstverständlich, um Deine Erfolge transparent zu dokumentieren.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 19.06.2026 (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come Key Account Manager (m/w/d) Bei Roche Diagnostics Sei il collegamento strategico che porta le innovazioni direttamente a dove fanno la più grande differenza: al cuore della nostra assistenza sanitaria. Crea il tuo senso di complesse esigenze dei clienti Contribuisci attivamente al futuro della diagnostica e aiuti i pazienti ad essere aiutati più velocemente e più precisamente. In questo ruolo chiave, si trasformano visioni in risultati tangibili e quindi assicurano il nostro comune successo sul mercato. La tua nuova squadra: Si diventa parte di un team di vendita dinamico e collegiale che è in rete in tutta la Germania. Lavoriamo di pari passo con gli esperti: nella gestione del servizio e del conto per trovare le migliori soluzioni per i nostri esigenti gruppi di clienti – dalle cliniche universitarie agli specialisti di laboratorio. Insieme padroneggiamo le sfide con un mix di professionalità e spirito di squadra reale. responsabilità Ti aspetti
• Entra in uno dei nostri clienti chiave nella zona di Berlino.
• Sviluppare strategie personalizzate e garantire la loro implementazione di successo.
• Pianifica, controlla e monitora lo sviluppo aziendale nella tua zona e conduci analisi competitive sonore.
• L'utente avvia e conduce attività di vendita transfrontaliere e conduce le squadre nazionali al successo senza autorità diretta.
• Contribuisci attivamente alle idee per lo sviluppo delle strategie di business field e lavori con progetti orientati al futuro.
• Come mentore, appoggiate l'incorporazione di nuovi colleghi e assumete la responsabilità di un argomento speciale come la coagulazione o l'offerta. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta
• Hai completato gli studi (scienze naturali, ingegneria, medicina o BWL) o una formazione scientifica e tecnica comparabile.
• Porti diversi anni di esperienza di vendita nel settore sanitario e ti conosci bene nel mercato diagnostico e nel suo quadro giuridico.
• Pensate imprenditoriale, gestite progetti complessi e portate esperienza nella leadership all'interno di strutture a matrice.
• Il vostro aspetto è professionale, credibile e vincente. Hai la competenza sociale per integrare le persone e trovare soluzioni insieme. Sei interessato a costruire relazioni con i clienti collaborativi e a lungo termine.
• La gestione sicura dei programmi di ufficio e degli strumenti CRM è una questione naturalmente per voi di documentare i vostri successi in modo trasparente. Cosi' bene? E' meglio. Vi offriamo una varietà di migliori raccordi nelle nostre sedi. Solo con voi possiamo migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Si rende Roche unico con il vostro contributo. Ecco perché offriamo benefici eccezionali che vi aiutano a plasmare la vostra vita, la finanza e la salute come volete. Maggiori informazioni qui: https://go.roche.com/Candidate Benefits-DE Periodo di applicazione fino a: 19.06.2026 (applicazione possibile fino a quando il lavoro è pubblicato) La tua domanda Vi chiediamo i seguenti documenti:
• Profilo attuale del CV o della giornata di lavoro
• I certificati e le prove ufficiali (istruzione) Altri documenti non sono attualmente necessari. Si prega di notare che non è possibile aggiungere ulteriori documenti dopo l'invio della domanda. Iscriviti ora – siamo felici!
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position As Key Account Manager (m/w/d) bei Roche Diagnostics You are the strategic link that brings innovations directly to where they make the greatest difference: to the heart of our health care. Create your sense of complex customer needs You actively contribute to the future of diagnostics and help patients to be helped faster and more precisely. In this key role, you transform visions into tangible results and thus secure our common success on the market. Your new team: You become part of a dynamic and collegial sales team that is networked throughout Germany. We work hand in hand with experts: in the service and account management to find the best solutions for our demanding customer groups – from university clinics to laboratory specialists. Together we master challenges with a mix of professionalism and real team spirit. Responsibilities You're expecting
• You enter one of our key customers in the Berlin area.
• You develop custom strategies and ensure their successful implementation.
• You plan, control and monitor the business development in your area and conduct sound competitive analyses.
• You initiate and conduct cross-departmental sales activities and lead national teams to success without direct authority.
• You actively contribute ideas to the development of business field strategies and work with future-oriented projects.
• As a mentor, you support the incorporation of new colleagues and take responsibility for a special topic such as coagulation or tendering. Qualifications | That brings you
• You have completed studies (natural sciences, engineering, medicine or BWL) or comparable scientific and technical training.
• You bring several years of sales experience in the healthcare sector and know you well in the diagnostic market and its legal framework.
• You think entrepreneurial, manage complex projects and bring experience in leadership within matrix structures.
• Your appearance is professional, credible and winning. You have the social competence to integrate people and find solutions together. You are interested in building collaborative and long-term customer relationships .
• Safe handling of office programs and CRM tools is a matter of course for you to document your successes transparently. So good? It's better. We offer you a variety of top fittings at our locations. Only with you can we improve the life of patients. You make Roche unique with your contribution. That's why we offer exceptional benefits that help you shape your life, finance and health as you want. Find out more here: https://go.roche.com/Candidate Benefits-DE Application period up to at least: 19.06.2026 (application possible as long as the job is posted) Your application We ask you the following documents:
• Current CV or Workday profile
• Your official (education) certificates & evidence Other documents are not currently required. Please note that no further documents can be added after the application has been sent. Join now – we are happy!

• Dein Auftreten ist professionell, glaubwürdig und gewinnend. Du besitzt die soziale Kompetenz, um Menschen zu integrieren und gemeinsam Lösungen zu finden. Du bist daran interessiert, kollaborative und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen .
• Der sichere Umgang mit Office-Programmen und CRM-Tools ist für Dich selbstverständlich, um Deine Erfolge transparent zu dokumentieren. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 19.06.2026 (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que gestionnaire de compte clé (m/w/d) bei Roche Diagnostics Vous êtes le lien stratégique qui apporte les innovations directement là où elles font la plus grande différence : au cœur de nos soins de santé. Créez votre sens des besoins complexes des clients Vous contribuez activement à l'avenir des diagnostics et aidez les patients à être aidés plus rapidement et plus précisément. Dans ce rôle clé, vous transformez les visions en résultats tangibles et ainsi assurer notre succès commun sur le marché. Votre nouvelle équipe : Vous faites partie d'une équipe de vente dynamique et collégiale qui est mise en réseau dans toute l'Allemagne. Nous travaillons main dans la main avec des experts: dans le service et la gestion de compte pour trouver les meilleures solutions pour nos groupes de clients exigeants – des cliniques universitaires aux spécialistes de laboratoire. Ensemble, nous maîtrisons les défis avec un mélange de professionnalisme et d'esprit d'équipe réel. Responsabilités Vous vous attendez
• Vous entrez dans l'un de nos clients clés dans la région de Berlin.
• Vous développez des stratégies personnalisées et assurez leur mise en œuvre réussie.
• Vous planifiez, contrôlez et surveillez le développement de votre secteur et effectuez des analyses concurrentielles solides.
• Vous lancez et dirigez des activités de vente interministérielles et dirigez des équipes nationales vers le succès sans autorité directe.
• Vous contribuez activement à l'élaboration de stratégies d'entreprise et travaillez avec des projets orientés vers l'avenir.
• En tant que mentor, vous soutenez l'incorporation de nouveaux collègues et prenez la responsabilité d'un sujet particulier comme la coagulation ou l'appel d'offres. Qualités Ça t'amène.
• Vous avez terminé des études (sciences naturelles, génie, médecine ou BWL) ou une formation scientifique et technique comparable.
• Vous apportez plusieurs années d'expérience commerciale dans le secteur de la santé et vous connaissez bien sur le marché du diagnostic et son cadre juridique.
• Vous pensez à l'entrepreneuriat, à la gestion de projets complexes et à l'acquisition d'expérience en leadership au sein des structures matricielles.
• Votre apparence est professionnelle, crédible et gagnante. Vous avez la compétence sociale pour intégrer les gens et trouver des solutions ensemble. Vous êtes intéressé par l'établissement de relations collaboratives et à long terme avec la clientèle.
• Gestion sécuritaire des programmes de bureau et des outils de CRM est une question bien sûr pour vous de documenter vos réussites de manière transparente. C'est bon ? C'est mieux. Nous vous offrons une variété d'accessoires haut de gamme à nos emplacements. Seulement avec vous, nous pouvons améliorer la vie des patients. Vous faites Roche unique avec votre contribution. C'est pourquoi nous offrons des avantages exceptionnels qui vous aident à façonner votre vie, votre finance et votre santé comme vous le souhaitez. En savoir plus ici: https://go.roche.com/Candidate Benefits-DE Période de demande jusqu'au 19.06.2026 (application possible aussi longtemps que l'emploi est affiché) Votre demande Nous vous demandons les documents suivants :
• Profil actuel du CV ou du jour de travail
• Vos certificats et preuves officiels (éducation) D'autres documents ne sont pas requis actuellement. Veuillez noter qu'aucun autre document ne peut être ajouté après l'envoi de la demande. Rejoignez maintenant – nous sommes heureux!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 職務内容
• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。 ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応 ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明 ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成 ・保守契約の締結、請求

応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識
• ・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可

（歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方 ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション
• ・調整を取ってきた方 ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識 ・病院でのMEとしての経験

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサービスエンジニア
　　　　　• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス ※本社にて入社後6か月間の研修後、会社指定のオフィスにて本配属
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 • 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 • 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※入社にあたり転居が必要と会社が判断した場合は、社宅適用あり
　　 • 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　• ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Regulatory Program Specialist (Temporary-Secondment)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. This will be a temporary contract for 1 year.

Position summary: Individual contributor regulatory professional in PTR who continuously deepens regulatory expertise and boldly innovates to deliver “one submission, one approval” worldwide by partnering across functions (molecule teams, affiliates, policy, and key initiatives) to shape the regulatory/technical environment, maintain licenses and GxP/Code of Conduct compliance, and enable a flexible, efficient, and thriving organization that meets evolving business and patient needs.

The Opportunity:

• Accountable for global planning, tracking, and monitoring of key regulatory information to ensure internal/external compliance and effective execution of submissions.

• Participate in developing and implementing the regulatory data strategy and configuring submission data in regulatory information management systems, including partnering with PT, PD, pRED and gRED to enable a single regulatory data strategy and data flow across the systems environment.

• Execute end-to-end submission-support activities: perform defined steps in the submission process, edit/format technical documents (e.g., eCTD) to Roche/HA standards, coordinate document flow and version control in DMS, and partner with PTR Squad Members to plan, track, and deliver content on time while liaising with technical SMEs.

• Contribute to continuous improvement by providing input on future system enhancements, business process updates, submission model documents, and by managing/reporting regulatory data across regions and sites, including work with external vendors (e.g., OBE Vendor Alliance) and use of submission/RIM tools and technologies.

• Serve as Business Process Owner and/or Subject Matter Expert for specific regulatory information activities and technologies, including defining and maintaining regulatory master data to uphold Roche/HA data governance standards globally, developing process documentation, and delivering training as needed.

Who you are

• Applies in-depth knowledge of Roche and regulatory guidelines, laws, and best practices to perform complex system searches, prepare/analyze reports, assemble documentation, and ensure compliance with regulations, company policies, and business processes.

• Builds and maintains productive, trusted relationships across departments and with external partners/regulators; acts as a key resource/mentor for junior colleagues, including on sensitive cases, and supports project activities.

• Demonstrates a continuous improvement and learning mindset: stays abreast of internal/external developments, understands regulatory strategy and processes, adapts to change, and proactively seeks opportunities to learn and apply new skills across a broader range of deliverables.

• Influences team processes, project outcomes, and customer activities by driving internal and external awareness of regulations and contributing expertise to regulatory and operational decisions.

• Brings 1–2+ years’ experience in a similar role, preferably with a BA/BS (or equivalent) in English, biology, chemistry, pharmacy, a related field, or a lab-assistant degree (e.g., CTA, BTA, PTA).​

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.

#LI-DC1

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

W

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Network Security team secures Roche’s global connectivity through policy-driven, automated infrastructure. We design, build, and maintain enterprise solutions—including Internet Security, DDoS protection, VPNs, NAC, and Deep Packet Inspection—to mitigate risks across cloud and on-prem environments.

This is a temporary, fixed-term position

The Opportunity:

As a Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network, you will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle, global adoption, and engineering of our Network Access Control (NAC) and network segmentation systems. You will bridge the gap between high-level security policy and technical execution, leveraging automation to scale controls and advance our Zero Trust roadmap.

Key Responsibilities:

• NAC & Segmentation Engineering: Deploy and maintain Cisco ISE globally. Design endpoint profiling logic (IoT, Medical, Corporate), Dot1x/MAB workflows, and Cisco TrustSec (SGTs) for software-defined segmentation.

• Perimeter Security: Deploy and support Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) in high-availability (Active/Active and Active/Passive) configurations.

• Automation & Compliance: Manage security policies as code using automation workflows to eliminate manual friction. Implement automated network access policies based on device compliance.

• Operations & Visibility: Serve as the escalation lead for complex network security incidents, providing root-cause analysis and long-term architectural fixes. Build dashboards for real-time visibility into the connected landscape.

• Enablement: Design self-service tools that allow internal teams to autonomously consume network security controls.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent experience

• NAC Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and managing enterprise Cisco ISE deployments (TrustSec, Dot1x, MAB, and Profiling).

• Firewall Mastery: Proven experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Palo Alto NGFWs, including SSL decryption and threat prevention.

• Network & Security Foundations: Deep understanding of RADIUS, TACACS+, core routing/switching, and "Defense in Depth" architectures.

jobs.title: Quality Governance Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming healthcare and changing patients lives. As a global leader in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, we focus on driving scientific excellence and delivering innovative solutions that address some of the world’s most complex medical challenges. We believe that doing now what patients need next requires a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment where every individual is empowered to contribute to our shared purpose. Quality is at the heart of everything we do, ensuring that our life-saving treatments meet the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and compliance across the globe.

The Opportunity
As the Global Quality Governance Lead, you will support the implementation and operational execution of the Management Review of Quality (MRoQ) governance framework within the global PT Quality organization. Your core responsibilities and impact will include:

• Drive Governance Strategy: Define and execute the global MRoQ governance strategy, ensuring full alignment with enterprise quality objectives, business priorities, and global regulatory expectations.

• Orchestrate Global Review Cycles: Lead the end-to-end planning, coordination, and execution of global MRoQ cycles across diverse sectors, including Internal/External Manufacturing, Investigational Medicinal Products (IMP), and Cell & Gene Therapy.

• Facilitate Senior Decision-Making: Enable leadership and key decision-making forums by synthesizing complex quality performance data into high-quality, data-driven materials and executive-level insights.

• Standardize Frameworks and Tools: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve standardized MRoQ frameworks, templates, and digital tools to enable scalable, efficient, and consistent execution across the network.

• Manage Forum Outputs: Orchestrate governance review forums to ensure clear, documented outcomes, and establish robust systems for tracking accountability, actions, and risk-mitigation commitments.

• Foster Collaboration & Community: Build and lead a highly connected, cross-functional MRoQ governance community that champions transparency, process harmonization, and a strong culture of quality.

• Support Inspection Readiness: Act as a key delegate for MRoQ and quality governance responsibilities, providing vital support and presentation-ready documentation during regulatory inspections and internal audits.

Who you are
You are a disciplined, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a matrixed multinational environment. You bring the following qualifications, skills, and experience to the team:

• Educational Background: You possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline.

• Industry Experience: You bring 7 years++ of dedicated experience in a Quality (GxP) environment, with specific expertise in Quality Governance, QA, or Compliance within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

• Regulatory & Domain Knowledge: You maintain a strong working knowledge of GMP, GCP, and/or GDP regulations across multiple domains, such as clinical supply or commercial manufacturing.

• Governance Expertise: You have hands-on experience supporting, coordinating, or facilitating management reviews, quality council forums, or complex multi-tiered corporate governance processes.

• Analytical & Communication Capability: You are skilled at analyzing complex quality data and translating these insights into clear, actionable executive reporting and strategic me

The Position
Sobre Roche:
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad:
En Roche LATAM Training Center , buscamos un/a Becario/a de Entrenamiento altamente motivado/a para apoyar en la gestión operativa y digital de las iniciativas de capacitación para personal interno y clientes. Esta posición ofrece una oportunidad única para desarrollarte en un entorno regional, colaborando en proyectos estratégicos de formación, adopción digital y mejora continua de la experiencia de aprendizaje.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión y Soporte: Actuar como apoyo de contacto para la revisión de incidencias técnicas en el sistema de entrenamiento interno y asegurar el correcto uso de la plataforma estándar para clientes.

• Soporte a Usuarios: Brindar acompañamiento a usuarios internos (afiliadas de LATAM) en el uso de plataformas de entrenamiento como Cornerstone u otras.

• Comunicación: Apoyar en la difusión de comunicados, convocatorias, recordatorios y cápsulas informativas, utilizando herramientas digitales e IA en el día a día.

• Gestión de Agendas: Coordinar calendarios de entrenamientos, seguimiento de registros, confirmaciones, listas de espera y gestión de cancelaciones.

• Actualización de Contenidos: Mantener actualizada la información de cursos, materiales y sesiones dentro de las plataformas.

• Análisis: Generar reportes de uso de plataformas, métricas de participación, tasas de cancelación y análisis de feedback de los usuarios.

• Mejora Continua: Recopilar insights de usuarios para proponer mejoras en procesos, contenidos y experiencia de entrenamiento.

• Materiales y Cápsulas: Apoyar en la creación de cápsulas informativas, guías rápidas y materiales de apoyo para usuarios.

• Apoyo a Entrenamientos: Colaborar en la logística y ejecución de entrenamientos dirigidos a personal interno y clientes finales.

• Colaboración: Trabajar de manera cross-functional con equipos de Training, Digital, Comercial y Soporte.

Quién eres:

• Formación: Estudiante activo/a de últimos semestres en Administración, Comunicación, Sistemas o afines. No buscamos un perfil egresado.

• Perfil: Interés en el sector salud, entrenamiento, adopción digital y experiencia de usuario.

• Habilidades: Capacidad analítica, organización, atención al detalle y manejo de Excel (intermedio) y PowerPoint.

• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio (deseable manejo de portugués).

• Competencias: Proactividad, enfoque en el usuario, comunicación efectiva, aprendizaje ágil y trabajo colaborativo.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Účelem této pozice je zajišťovat servisní a aplikační podporu NPC přístrojů a systémů Roche, a to jako součást servisních služeb zákazníkům.

Hlavní odpovědnosti
●Vykonávat rutinní servisní a aplikační podporu na přístrojích Roche. To zahrnuje:
- instalaci a předávání přístrojů v místě určeném zákazníkem
- školení uživatelů
- řešení požadavků zákazníků reportovaných prostřednictvím zákaznického centra
- provádět údržbu přístrojů na základě popisu a časového rámce výrobce, pokud není údržba předepsaná, provádět kontroly funkčnosti na základě smlouvy
- diagnostikovat závady na základě žádostí zákazníků,
- pokud jsou přístroje Roche NPC zapojeny do sítě, provádět veškeré činnosti k zajištění provozu v síti ve spolupráci s IT specialisty Roche a zákazníka (instalace, konfigurace,diagnostika, uživatelské zaškolení)
● Dodržovat všechny zákonné normy a interní pravidla společnosti

Požadovaná kvalifikace a vlastnosti:
●Vysoká škola technického směru v oblasti chemie, biotechnologie atd.
●Střední škola podobného zaměřením a 3 roky praxe v oblasti zdravotnických přístrojů atp.

● Zvládání anglického jazyka na úrovni potřebné pro studium technické dokumentace a absolvování školení v anglickém jazyce
● Schopnost plánování a provádění samostatné práce u zákazníků v laboratořích a ochota přizpůsobit se časově
● Ochota cestování v rámci regionu
● Schopnost týmové spolupráce v rámci oddělení Professional Services a spolupráce s kolegy/němi z jiných oddělení
● Řidičský průkaz kat.B podmínkou
● Kvalifikační stupeň osoby pro samostatnou činnost dle NV 194/2022 Sb.(dříve §6 vyhl.50) výhodou
● Prozákaznický přístup, schopnost porozumět potřebám zákazníkům a být jim partnerem
● Předchozí pracovní zkušenost v oblasti technické podpory zdravotnických přístrojů je výhodou, ale není podmínkou

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer - Secure Access Network
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As a Cybersecurity Engineer - Secure Access Network , you will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle of our security products within the Network Security Product area. You will act as a technical implementer, bridging the gap between high-level security policy and high-performance technical execution.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• NAC Strategy & Engineering: Lead the global adoption and engineering of Network Access Control (NAC) and Network Segmentation solutions. You will be responsible for the end-to-end deployment and maintenance of Cisco ISE, refining endpoint profiling logic (IoT, Medical, Corporate), and managing Dot1x, MAB, and Guest Portals.

• Segmentation & Zero Trust: Architect and maintain Cisco TrustSec (SGTs) for software-defined segmentation and align security policies with the organization’s Zero Trust roadmap.

• Perimeter Security: Lead the deployment and support of Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) in high-availability configurations, ensuring security controls remain reliable across all network layers.

• Automation & Policy as Code: Drive operational excellence by managing security policies as code using Ansible, Terraform, or Python. You will develop visibility dashboards and provide root-cause analysis for complex escalations.

• Product Lifecycle Management: Manage technical workstreams from concept to production with minimal supervision, taking full ownership of the NAC product lifecycle.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical field.

• You have 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and managing enterprise-grade NAC solutions, specifically Cisco ISE (including TrustSec, Dot1x, MAB, and Profiling).

• You possess a proven track record in configuring and maintaining Palo Alto NGFW, including HA environments, SSL decryption, and threat prevention.

• You are experienced in Automation Engineering, using Ansible, Terraform, or Python to manage network security infrastructure at scale.

• You have a deep understanding of RADIUS, TACACS+, and core routing/switching (L2/L3) as they relate to security enforcement.

Preferred:

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and GitHub for version-controlled configurations and building CI/CD pipelines.

• Strong scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to develop self-service tools and custom API integrations.

• Experience in a regulated industry (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare, or Finance).

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

As an Account Executive - Molecular Diagnostics, you will:

• be responsible for promoting molecular diagnostic testing, including infectious disease, respiratory and transplantation.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role: The territory in Alabama, Mississippi (excluding Jackson) and the Florida Panhandle.
Travel: 50%

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience.

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience in diagnostics sales is strongly preferred

• Good oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting and problem solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: Sei un professionista esperto di vendite con un talento per risolvere sfide complesse? In questo ruolo, userai la tua esperienza per navigare diversi problemi e prendere decisioni strategiche che spingono il successo. Potrai gestire conti di medie e grandi dimensioni, superando gli obiettivi di vendita durante la costruzione di relazioni durature con i decisori chiave. Il vostro obiettivo sarà quello di espandere la vostra rete, identificare nuove opportunità e presentare proposte di valore convincenti. Con una profonda comprensione della nostra linea di prodotti, servirai come consulente affidabile, migliorando continuamente il nostro sistema di qualità attraverso le tue azioni quotidiane. Come amministratore del conto - Diagnostica molecolare, Lei:
• essere responsabile della promozione di test diagnostici molecolari, tra cui malattia infettiva, respiratoria e trapianto.
• contattare i clienti nuovi e esistenti per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita in conti mirati, sviluppando nuovi business, crescendo business esistente, mantenendo le relazioni con i clienti e risolvendo i problemi dei clienti. Ciò include l'individuazione e lo sviluppo di piani di conto strategici, lo sviluppo e la fornitura del messaggio differenziante e del valore economico quantificabile per prodotti e servizi, la vendita della differenziazione primaria dei prodotti Roche, il superamento e la gestione delle obiezioni e la negoziazione per ottenere le vendite.
• generare domanda e massimizzare la consapevolezza del prodotto lavorando e fornendo istruzione e informazioni ai clienti.
• implementa iniziative strategiche e piani per facilitare il processo di vendita e la produttività.
• lavorare con altri, se necessario o richiesto, per preparare proposte per conti assegnati. Presenta tutte le proposte di contratto ai clienti per massimizzare il business complessivo e la redditività, che possono richiedere alcune trattative.
• condurre e organizzare la pianificazione e il routing del territorio necessario per l'efficienza. Conduce l'analisi aziendale e la pianificazione.
• comunica le informazioni sul mercato competitivo internamente.
• reti e interfacce con i colleghi interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente coinvolti in organizzazioni di settore/clienti che influiscono sul business. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo: il territorio in Alabama, Mississippi (escluso Jackson) e la Florida Panhandle. Viaggi: 50% Chi sei?
• Corso di laurea o esperienza equivalente

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

You will manage the Reagent and Health Performance (RHP) team, overseeing headcount, budget, and logistics to ensure products are robust and sustainable. By setting high standards for efficiency, you’ll drive the seamless transition of complex assays across their entire lifecycle.

The Opportunity:

• Team Development: Hire, train, mentor, and develop team members to support individual career growth and team success.

• Technical Leadership: Manage commercialization of new products and post-launch monitoring of on-market products, risk evaluation of the on market portfolio, designing fit for purpose testing to assess product risks, and drive failure investigations.

• Program Management: Ensure milestones, timelines, and deliverables are met for development and on-market support projects.

• SAFe Agile Execution: Serve as a Product Owner in a SAFe Agile environment, driving team execution and priorities.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Partner cross-functionally to ensure alignment with company objectives and project commitments. You are highly effective at translating complex technical data into actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

• Collaborative Focus: Foster an open, innovative, and collaborative environment during process and assay development efforts.

• Operational Excellence: Refine team procedures, maintain key laboratories and equipment, and ensure compliance with health, safety, and Roche standards.

• Strategic Oversight: Actively explores new methodologies, processes, and new ways of working to improve reagent quality and overall efficiencies.

• Leadership Participation: Actively contribute to the ACT and OAD Leadership Team and other strategic initiatives.

​
Who you are:

• You have a BS (with 8+ yrs), or a MS (with 6+ yrs), or PhD (with 4+ yrs) in relevant scientific disciplines (e.g. Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology).

• You have 3 years of hands-on experience in scientific research and product development

• You have 1+ years of direct management and/or project management experience

• You maintain a deep understanding of principles in chemistry, biochemistry, and molecular biology, while exhibiting exceptional verbal and written communication skills to present complex information clearly.

• You showcase comprehensive knowledge in developing, implementing, and supporting reagent-based products in FDA/IVDR regulated environments.

• You demonstrate strong leadership capabilities to effectively motivate, guide, and manage within both matrixed and direct-line environments.

​
Preferred Qualifications:

• You have experience with SAFe Agile methodologies is highly valued.

​
The expected salary range for this position is 116,500-216,300 based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

Relocation benefits are available for this posting.

This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed here: Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Cloud & Edge Defense, you will be the primary architect and engineer responsible for the security of our global digital boundaries and multi-cloud ecosystems. Your mission is to secure our "front door" by designing and implementing high-performance traffic inspection solutions across AWS, GCP, and Azure using Palo Alto VM-Series as the central pillar. This is a technical "implementer" role where you will architect, design, build, and operate cloud network security infrastructure.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Design: Design and develop robust cloud network infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure, leveraging Palo Alto instances for deep traffic inspection.

• Advanced Palo Alto Engineering: Execute advanced configuration and management of Palo Alto solutions (VM-Series, Panorama), including complex upgrades and migrations in production.

• Cloud Programming & Automation: Leverage cloud vendor network infrastructures to configure and deploy security solutions via automated pipelines using Terraform and Python.

• Feature Enforcement: Implement and manage App-ID, User-ID, WildFire, Threat Prevention, SSL Decryption, and GlobalProtect to enforce a Zero Trust posture.

• Operational Excellence: Manage security policies as code and improve automation workflows and cross-platform orchestration to eliminate manual friction.

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Troubleshoot complex issues related to cloud-native routing, load balancing, and firewall inspection within multi-cloud environments.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical field.

• You have a proven track record of implementing network security controls in at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• You possess 3+ years of experience configuring and maintaining Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), including TLS inspection, WildFire, and GlobalProtect.

• You have proven experience using Ansible, Terraform, or Python to manage network security infrastructure at scale.

• You have a deep understanding of core protocols (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) and how they intersect with security enforcement.

Preferred:

• Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, AWS Certified Security, or Azure Security Engineer Associate certifications.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and GitHub to maintain version-controlled security configurations.

• Strong scripting skills in Python or Go to build custom API integrations between security platforms.

• Experience working in highly regulated environments such as Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare, or Finance.

• A self-starter with the ability to manage technical workstreams from concept to production with minimal supervision.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativ

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming healthcare and changing patients' lives for the better. As a global leader in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, we commit ourselves to scientific excellence, cutting-edge innovation, and sustainable growth. We believe that good business means a better world, and we achieve this by fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment where our people are empowered to push the boundaries of medical science and technology. Joining Roche means bringing your purpose to a team that values integrity, courage, and passion, ensuring that the right treatment reaches the right patient at the right time.

The Opportunity

• Drive System Strategy: Serve as the global Technology PT Product Owner for Learning Management technologies (specifically Cornerstone on Demand), effectively translating complex business requirements into standardized technical solutions.

• Manage Lifecycle & Governance: Direct the entire system lifecycle—including upgrades, system replacements, and retirements—while strictly adhering to established change management processes.

• Shape Product Roadmaps: Partner closely with the Global Learning Solutions (GLS) team to define product vision, align roadmaps, manage feature backlogs, and prioritize system enhancements.

• Ensure Compliance & Data Stewardship: Act as the dedicated Business Data Steward, ensuring unwavering GxP compliance, strict data governance, and adherence to global quality policies.

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Mobilize and lead high-performing, cross-functional teams spanning global Learning departments, business stakeholders, IT partners, and validation functions.

• Optimize Processes & Systems: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, manage deviations and CAPAs, and oversee master data validation within validated quality systems.

• Govern the Learning Ecosystem: Manage the integration and structural nuances of the learning ecosystem, ensuring seamless data flow, reporting, and interface connectivity across global manufacturing and commercial sites.

​
Who you are

• You possess deep technical expertise: You bring 7+ years of experience in Learning Management technology and platform management—specifically Cornerstone on Demand—ideally with Roche Super Admin-level competency.

• You are an expert in regulated environments: You possess a strong understanding of database management, data analytics, and software validation within validated or controlled pharmaceutical/healthcare environments (GMP, FDA, GxP).

• You are strategically and academically qualified: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field (or an equivalent qualification like a Federal Diploma of Higher Education) combined with a proven track record in formulating long-term computer system strategies.

• You are an Agile collaborator and communicator: You are highly skilled at utilizing Agile methodologies and possess exceptional communication skills to convey technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• You are an advanced Cornerstone administrator: You have mastered creating dynamic groups, modifying training components, building complex Reporting 2.0 dashboards, and resolving system configuration errors efficiently.

• You are a proactive problem solver: You possess a technical foundation paired with sharp business acumen, allowing you to troubleshoot intricate system issues, navigate escalation paths through ServiceNOW, a
