This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Product Manager

The Opportunity:
Roche Diagnostics is seeking an innovative Senior Product Manager to join our Near Patient Care (NPC) diagnostics marketing team. In this role, you will act as the technical and commercial business owner for several portfolios, inclusive of Molecular Point of Care, Immunoassay and Clinical Chemistry, and Blood Gas and Electrolytes.

We are seeking a professional with a passion for product excellence through on-market planning and product stewardship while simultaneously managing product lifecycles, pricing strategies, and global stakeholder alignment. You will help shape the US launch plans for on-market instrument menu expansion as well as new platforms while serving as the primary liaison between many cross-functional groups across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as the definitive technical expert and business owner for the utility and use of assigned products in the marketplace.

• Partner with demand planning teams to gather data and create product forecasts and business plans that drive growth.

• Generate and execute product launch plans inclusive of pricing strategies, customer segmentation, and sales enablement.

• Collaborate with global business partners to drive US market requirements into current and future product portfolios; influence global life cycle teams on specific product requirements.

• Responsible for internal processes driving software/hardware updates, and product expirations. Serve as the strategic lead on product availability and back-order management for the field sales force.

• Utilize high-level stakeholder management skills to influence teams without formal authority to ensure alignment, proactively identify bottlenecks, and mobilize resources to keep complex, long-term projects on track and achieve business milestones

• Own the annual business plan for your future portfolio, including the development and implementation of tactics and the evaluation of performance through business reviews.

• Influence the business plan for on market products through the business planning process with additional Near Patient Care marketers and cross-functional partners

• Instilling leadership through others by acting as a role model to drive impactful business solutions and positive change, encouraging, motivating and empowering others and helping others to success.

• Develops business area mastery to include understanding of market segments, business model, analysis of key metrics that define success, forecasting sales and product, share performance, trends, competition, customer critical success factors and needs through interaction with customers for integration with programs.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field

• You hold 5 years of marketing, business, sales or relevant business experience

Preferred:

• Strong project management skills

• Strong stakeholder management skills

• Experience working across multiple life-science subject matter areas

• High level executive presence

• Ability to influence cross-functional teams

• High intellectual curiosity and attention to detail

• Ability to travel moderately as dictated by business need

• Ability to manage multiple projects

• Regulatory and compliance awareness (e.g. USDA, ISO 9000, CLIA, FDA, GMP), ISO 9000, CLIA, FDA, GMP)

Location:

• This position is based onsite in our Indianapolis campus.

• No relocation benefits are provided for this role.

jobs.title: Histology Process Lead (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Second Shift: 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM

As the Histology Process Lead you will oversee the operational processes of the 2nd shift histology team to ensure workflow efficiency and support business goals. This role is responsible for delegating tasks to 2nd shift personnel while proactively collaborating with the 1st shift team and the 1st shift Process Lead. You will provide essential line support, ensure quality and training compliance, and assist the Histology Supervisor in meeting overall production schedules and customer service expectations.

The Opportunity

Quality and Safety

• Maintains Right to Operate by ensuring all processes are performed safely; addresses and escalates hazards; timely reports incidents and near misses

• Maintains the quality system and achieves quality objectives

• Ensures audit readiness (OSHA, FAA, FDA, etc.) and represents team during internal audits/inspections

• Ensures accuracy and completeness of procedures for receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials per FDA, OSHA, FAA, QSR, ISO, GMP, MEE, and Roche policies

• Coordinates training completion and execution (NCRs, OJT, Operating Procedures, Work Instructions); maintains >95% training compliance

• Ensures inventory accuracy and adherence to inventory control processes (TECO, Cycle counts, etc.)

• Assists with NCR investigations, reworks, corrective actions, and document changes including writing new or updating work instructions and OPs

Production

• Monitors, balances, and delegates work to employees and contractors to achieve production goals and schedule adherence

• Provides 20-40% line support including receive, material handling, product build, formulation, material availability, SAP transactions, packet review, audits, and resource allocation

• Interfaces with complex systems and controls in a regulated manufacturing environment

• Ensures daily end-of-shift reports and pass downs are completed for proper communication between shifts and teams

• Effectively leads multiple production lines

• Coordinates maintenance and calibration of equipment in responsible areas

Continuous Improvement

• Ensures adherence to 6S, cycle times, and standard work; identifies and implements process improvements

• Facilitates and/or participates in Tier Meetings and staff meetings

• Troubleshoots problems, engages support functions, and assists in implementing preventative measures

• Collects, populates, and trends daily metrics (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery) to identify gaps and support operational excellence

Teamwork and Collaboration

• Proactively collaborates with peers across shifts and functions to achieve daily targets; provides performance feedback to leadership on employee contribution, attendance, and quality

• Ensures successful onboarding of new employees and contractors; participates in the interview process

• Performs other duties as assigned by management

Who You Are

• You have an Associate’s Degree

• You have 3 years Relevant work experience, preferably in GMP environment

• Experience leading teams or projects preferred.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement and previous experience with ERP systems and SAP

• Proficient with Google products (gMail, gSheets, gDoc, etc)

• High degree of initiative with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Ability to read, write and comprehend English; strong communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong organizationa

jobs.title: CRM Product Manager & Team Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

In this newly established blended role, you will combine senior individual contribution in product management (70%) with operational team leadership (30%). As a Product Manager, you will provide hands-on execution support, translate business needs into functional requirements, and manage backlog hygiene.
As a Team Lead, you will establish, structure, and lead the new Pharma CRM Support Team for the US market—initially managing one direct report with the opportunity to scale the operation in the foreseeable future.

Key Responsibilities:

• Team Leadership & Support Establishment (30%): Build up and operationalize the new Pharma CRM Support Team. Define and implement support workflows, incident triage protocols, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) tailored to US business needs. Provide day-to-day mentorship and serve as the primary escalation point for critical CRM support issues.

• Product & Delivery Support (70%): Translate business needs into clear user stories, functional requirements, and explicit acceptance criteria. Develop detailed business process flows and independently maintain product backlogs and JIRA priorities as directed by leadership.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the strategic liaison between the US support team, technical development squads, QA, vendors, and business leadership.

• Quality Assurance & Operations: Support Software Quality Assurance (SQA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, execution, and defect tracking. Assist with ongoing CRM enhancements, minor configuration changes, and data validation outputs.

• Compliance & Audit: Ensure all product documentation and support logs strictly align with Life Sciences compliance and audit guidelines.

Who you are:

• Experience: 5–8 years of experience supporting CRM platforms, with mandatory experience working within Life Sciences, Commercial, or Medical CRM environments.

• Team Leadership Readiness: Proven experience or strong readiness to step into a Team Lead role, with a track record of mentoring team members, managing workloads, or setting up operational workflows.

• Product Management Competency: Strong experience writing detailed user stories, tracking functional requirements, and mapping complex business processes.

• Tools & Ecosystems: Advanced, hands-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, and CRM Service Desks (or equivalent ticketing frameworks).

• Stakeholder & Soft Skills: Exceptional communication skills to build a strong team culture, drive accountability, and confidently manage expectations with US business partners and executive stakeholders.

Preferred:

• Platform Expertise: Specific, hands-on experience with Salesforce or Veeva CRM architectures.

• Framework Design: Demonstrated ability to design support intake structures and end-to-end SLA tracking mechanisms from scratch.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we ca

jobs.title: Principal Statistical Methodology Data Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Statistical Methodology Data Scientists play a strategic role in enabling the adoption of fit-for-purpose statistical methodologies to drive scientific rigor and decision-making excellence. This team serves as a center of excellence focused on consultation, education, and outreach to ensure that innovative and appropriate methods are applied across programs and portfolios.

Statistical Methodology Data Scientists collaborate closely with project teams, biostatisticians, and cross-functional stakeholders to identify methodological needs, prototype solutions (e.g., estimand frameworks, trial simulations, covariate adjustment strategies), and support scalable adoption through training, templates, and open source software/tools. They engage in portfolio-level analyses, scenario modeling, and quantitative frameworks that inform go/no-go decisions and optimize clinical strategy.
The team also maintains key external relationships, representing the company in consortia, scientific working groups, and regulatory collaborations to stay at the forefront of methodological advances in the pharmaceutical industry.

The Opportunity:

• You serve as a methodological thought partner to study teams, providing expert guidance on complex design and analysis across programs

• You lead the development and institutionalization of methodologies that improve decision-making at trial and portfolio levels (e.g., quantitative go/no-go criteria, simulation frameworks, model-based projections)

• You shape cross-functional understanding of innovative statistical methods through consultation, publications, and leadership of education efforts

• You anticipate regulatory trends and industry shifts, integrating relevant methodologies into internal practices and guiding external engagements

• You act as a connector across teams, surfacing recurring challenges and co-creating scalable solutions to elevate analytical excellence in the organization

• You drive external collaboration through active participation in consortia, joint working groups, or regulatory-facing initiatives

• You mentor junior staff and influence the strategic direction of Statistical Methodology through thought leadership, vision-setting, and capability building

Who you are:

• You hold a PhD (or equivalent experience) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline

• You have 7 + years of experience designing and applying advanced analytics to complex biomedical data in clinical trial research

• You bring deep expertise in statistical computing and advanced modeling, with a track record of developing novel or custom analytical solutions

• You are recognized as a technical expert and thought partner within the organization or broader field

• You have experience mentoring others and contributing to internal standards, strategy, or capability development

• You show respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace

Preferred:

• Experience developing novel or fit-for-purpose analytical methods for different types of datasets

• Demonstrated leadership in designing scalable workflows or frameworks adopted across multiple projects or teams

• Track record of influencing portfolio- or program-level decisions through rigorous analytical insights

• Publications, presentations, or internal white papers that showcase innovative analytical thinking

• Thought leadership in emerging data science areas relevant to pharmaceutical development (e

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni Gli scienziati collaborano strettamente con i team di progetto, i biostatisti e gli stakeholder interfunzionali per identificare le esigenze metodologiche, le soluzioni prototipi (ad esempio, i framework estimand, le simulazioni di prova, le strategie di regolazione covariate), e supportano l'adozione scalabile attraverso la formazione, i modelli e i software/tool open source. Essi si impegnano in analisi a livello di portafoglio, modelli di scenari e quadri quantitativi che informano le decisioni di go/no-go e ottimizzano la strategia clinica. Il team mantiene anche relazioni esterne chiave, che rappresentano l'azienda in consorzi, gruppi di lavoro scientifici e collaborazioni normative per rimanere all'avanguardia di progressi metodologici nell'industria farmaceutica. - Lei funge da partner di pensiero metodologico per studiare i team, fornendo una guida esperta sulla progettazione complessa e l'analisi attraverso i programmi - Lei guida lo sviluppo e l'istituzionalizzazione di metodologie che migliorano il processo decisionale a livello di prova e di portafoglio (ad esempio, criteri di go/no-go quantitativi, quadri di simulazione, proiezioni basate sui modelli) - Forma la comprensione interfunzionale dei metodi statistici innovativi attraverso la consultazione, le pubblicazioni e la leadership degli sforzi educativi - anticipa le tendenze normative e i cambiamenti del settore, integrando metodologie rilevanti nelle pratiche interne e guidando gli impegni esterni - Lei agisce come un connettore tra i team, affrontando sfide ricorrenti e creando soluzioni scalabili per elevare l'eccellenza analitica nell'organizzazione - Lei guida la collaborazione esterna attraverso la partecipazione attiva a consorzi, gruppi di lavoro congiunti, o iniziative di controllo - Tu mentore personale junior e influenzare la direzione strategica della Metodologia statistica attraverso la leadership di pensiero, la visione-setting e la costruzione di capacità
• Requisiti - Lei possiede un dottorato (o un'esperienza equivalente) in Scienza dei dati, Statistica, Scienza informatica, o una disciplina quantitativa correlata - Hai 7 + anni di esperienza nella progettazione e nell'applicazione di analisi avanzate a dati biomedici complessi nella ricerca clinica - Portate una profonda esperienza nel calcolo statistico e nella modellazione avanzata, con un track record di sviluppo di soluzioni analitiche innovative o personalizzate - Lei è riconosciuto come esperto tecnico e partner di pensiero all'interno dell'organizzazione o più ampio campo - Hai esperienza di mentoring altri e contribuire a standard interni, strategia o sviluppo delle capacità - Lei mostra rispetto per le differenze culturali quando interagisce con i colleghi nel lavoro globale Preferenze - Esperienza nello sviluppo di metodi analitici innovativi o idonei per diversi tipi di dataset - Dimostrata leadership nella progettazione di flussi di lavoro scalabili o framework adottati in più progetti o team - Tracciare il record di influenzare le decisioni di portafoglio o di livello programma attraverso rigorosi approfondimenti analitici - Pubblicazioni, presentazioni o carte bianche interne che mostrano un pensiero analitico innovativo - La leadership di pensiero nelle aree di scienza dei dati emergenti rilevanti per lo sviluppo farmaceutico

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mansioni Méthodologie statistique Données Les scientifiques collaborent étroitement avec les équipes de projet, les biostatisticiens et les intervenants interfonctionnels pour déterminer les besoins méthodologiques, les solutions prototypes (p. ex., cadres d'estimand, simulations d'essai, stratégies d'ajustement covariables) et soutenir l'adoption évolutive par la formation, les modèles et les logiciels/outils libres. Ils procèdent à des analyses au niveau du portefeuille, à la modélisation de scénarios et à des cadres quantitatifs qui éclairent les décisions d'aller-retour et d'optimiser la stratégie clinique. L'équipe entretient également des relations externes clés, représentant l'entreprise dans des consortiums, des groupes de travail scientifiques et des collaborations en matière de réglementation pour rester à l'avant-garde des progrès méthodologiques dans l'industrie pharmaceutique. - Vous servez de partenaire de réflexion méthodologique pour les équipes d'étude, fournissant des conseils d'experts sur la conception et l'analyse complexes à travers les programmes - Vous dirigez l'élaboration et l'institutionnalisation de méthodologies qui améliorent la prise de décisions au niveau des essais et des portefeuilles (par exemple, critères quantitatifs de go/no-go, cadres de simulation, projections basées sur des modèles) - Vous façonnez la compréhension interfonctionnelle des méthodes statistiques innovantes par la consultation, les publications et le leadership des efforts d'éducation - Vous anticipez les tendances réglementaires et les changements dans l'industrie, en intégrant les méthodologies pertinentes dans les pratiques internes et en guidant les engagements externes - Vous agissez comme un connecteur entre les équipes, affrontant les défis récurrents et co-créant des solutions évolutives pour élever l'excellence analytique dans l'organisation - Vous dirigez la collaboration externe en participant activement à des consortiums, des groupes de travail conjoints ou des initiatives axées sur la réglementation - Vous mentorez le personnel subalterne et influencez l'orientation stratégique de la méthodologie statistique par le leadership de la pensée, l'établissement de la vision et le renforcement des capacités
• Requisiti - Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat (ou d'une expérience équivalente) en science des données, en statistique, en informatique ou dans une discipline quantitative connexe - Vous avez 7 ans et plus d'expérience en conception et application d'analyses avancées à des données biomédicales complexes dans la recherche clinique - Vous apportez une expertise approfondie dans le calcul statistique et la modélisation avancée, avec une expérience de développement de solutions analytiques nouvelles ou personnalisées - Vous êtes reconnu comme expert technique et partenaire de réflexion au sein de l'organisation ou dans un domaine plus large - Vous avez de l'expérience en tant que mentor et contribuez au développement de normes, de stratégies ou de capacités internes - Vous montrez du respect pour les différences culturelles quand vous interagissez avec des collègues dans le monde du travail Préférez - Expérience de la mise au point de méthodes d'analyse nouvelles ou adaptées à différents types de données - Leadership démontré dans la conception de workflows ou de cadres évolutifs adoptés par plusieurs projets ou équipes - Suivre l'évolution des décisions au niveau des portefeuilles ou des programmes par des analyses rigoureuses - Publications, présentations ou livres blancs internes présentant une réflexion analytique innovante - Le leadership de la pensée dans les nouveaux domaines de la science des données pertinents au développement pharmaceutique

jobs.title: Senior Statistician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

This role is within Biostatistics, a core function within Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. Biostatistics identifies opportunities to apply the full breadth of data, digital, and design capabilities to deploy innovative methods across PDD, PD and the broader Roche Pharma organization.

As trusted analytical partners in end-to-end drug development, Biostatistics leverages data to drive scientifically rigorous programmatic decisions across Roche’s Development portfolio; Biostatistics designs robust trials and analysis plans that increase the probability of technical success, accelerating timelines to advance Roche’s clinical pipeline and promote regulatory success — ultimately bringing medicines to our patients faster.

The Opportunity:

• Independently drive statistical contributions to clinical trial design, ensuring strict alignment with scientific objectives and study endpoints.

• Deliver and quality-review critical statistical study documents, including comprehensive statistical analysis plans and protocols.

• Design and perform sophisticated data analyses, proactively identifying potential challenges and implementing robust statistical solutions.

• Serve as the functional expert for Biostatistics and PDD at the Study Team level, ensuring scientific and statistical rigor across all deliverables.

• Partner proactively with global cross-functional teams to align project deliverables, timelines, and strategic clinical goals.

• Interpret, contextualize, and clearly communicate analysis results to cross-functional stakeholders, directly influencing study-level decisions.

• Provide functional guidance, scientific leadership, and informal mentoring to less experienced statisticians within a matrix organization.

Who you are:

You are a strategic, independent thinker who thrives on solving complex technical challenges while keeping the bigger picture in mind. You enjoy collaborating in multicultural global environments and possess a unique ability to translate intricate data concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• An MSc or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a closely related quantitative field.

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in clinical trial statistics within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO setting, ideally spanning multiple phases of drug development (early and late stage).

• A solid understanding of regulatory expectations, statistical methodologies for clinical development, and familiarity with CDISC standards.

• Hands-on experience and proficiency in SAS and/or R programming languages.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to present complex technical concepts clearly and influence senior stakeholders.

• Demonstrated agility, problem-solving skills, and a track record of working autonomously while fostering strong, inclusive relationships in a global workplace.

Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 115,328.00 and 151,368.00 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 職務内容
• 医療機関の臨床検査室を中心に、生化学(血液検査等)・免疫検査用の試薬・
• 検査機器などの提案営業をお任せします。

担当数は10～20施設。
• 病院の経営層(事務長・院長等)や臨床検査技師などの現場担当者と
• リレーションを構築し、抱えている課題を抽出。
• 経営・業務の効率化に向け、当社が持つリソースを組み合わせて、
• 課題を解決するソリューション観点で営業に取り組んでいただきます。

応募条件
業界を問わず、法人営業の経験をお持ちの方／キーマンアプローチの経験ある方

◎モノ売りではなく、自分のアイデアでお客様の課題解決に貢献したい方
• ◎業界トップクラスの企業で自己成長に取り組みたい方
• ◎関係各所へのコミュニケーション・調整を図れる方
• ◎将来はグローバルな視点で活躍したい方

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 大宮オフィス　〒330-0854埼玉県さいたま市大宮区桜木町1-10-16シーノ大宮ノースウイング　10F
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 • 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 • 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 • 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 職務内容
• 医療機関の臨床検査室を中心に、生化学(血液検査等)・免疫検査用の試薬・
• 検査機器などの提案営業をお任せします。
• 担当数は10～20施設。
• 病院の経営層(事務長・院長等)や臨床検査技師などの現場担当者と
• リレーションを構築し、抱えている課題を抽出。
• 経営・業務の効率化に向け、当社が持つリソースを組み合わせて、
• 課題を解決するソリューション観点で営業に取り組んでいただきます。

応募条件
• 業界を問わず、法人営業の経験をお持ちの方／キーマンアプローチの経験ある方
• ◎モノ売りではなく、自分のアイデアでお客様の課題解決に貢献したい方
• ◎業界トップクラスの企業で自己成長に取り組みたい方
• ◎関係各所へのコミュニケーション・調整を図れる方
• ◎将来はグローバルな視点で活躍したい方

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 • 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 • 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 • 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission Statement
Finance Enterprise Partner is a critical role to maximize Revenue and Profitability by acting as a Co-driver and Guardian of the business.
The role's core mission is to provide a holistic, forward-looking financial view of the Japanese In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) market, enabling leaders to make faster, better strategic decisions.
Finance Enterprise Partner is not a support function but an active co-pilot of business performance, sitting at the intersection of finance, strategy, and commercial execution to establish a profit-driven company culture to achieve long-term company ambition.

Core Responsibilities
Finance Enterprise Partner will mainly focus on three core pillars:

1. Financial Planning & Analysis
[Planning & Forecasting]

• Lead & facilitate the rolling forecast events: drive annual budget, monthly forecast, and mid-term planning, ensuring strict alignment with commercial strategy.

• Design and maintain comprehensive financial models: incorporate volume, price, product mix and cost assumptions to ensure robust and agile financial planning.

[Performance Monitoring & Visualization]

• Drive performance reviews with clear and actionable visualization: produce executive-level dashboards and visualize performance by portfolio, product, and segment to foster shared understanding and clarify current financial positioning for next actions.

• Own the Gross Margin bridge analysis and prepare financial commentary, KPI scorecards, and forward-looking outlooks to clearly explain variances between actuals, budget, and prior periods with clear business narratives.

[Business Insights & Scenario Planning]

• Provide actionable business insights: proactively identify risks and opportunities in P&L and bring data-driven recommendations, focusing on actionable strategies beyond mere analysis. Translate macro market trends (pricing pressure, tender cycles, aging demographics) into quantified financial impact and scenario analysis.

2. Advanced management decision support
[Strategic Profitability Management]

• Evaluate and challenge current strategies for new and existing businesses. Conduct product-level and customer-level margin analysis to identify revenue growth opportunities, surface dilutive contracts, and prioritize high-value segments.

[Financial modeling for Complex Deals]

• Partner on strategic deals: build deal-level financial models, ROI analyses, pricing frameworks, and risk-adjusted projections. Participate in key customer strategic business reviews, providing top management with value-added financial insights and suggestions, bringing financial credibility to commercial discussions.

[Smart Risk Taking & Problem Solving]

• Enable "Smart Risks" for complex business cases: establish a collaborative system with business members to advance tough and highly complex business cases. Maximize value by providing expert quantitative analysis, consultation, and improvement proposals that drive strategic decisions.

3. Foster Profit-Driven Culture & Establish Organizational Governance
[Profit-Driven Culture]

• Foster financial acumen across the organization: contribute to profitability improvement and cultural change by embedding a mindset where all employees routinely engage in activities for profit improvement as their own responsibility.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position Summary
As the Chief of Staff for the Roche Diagnostics Japan Enabling Team, you will play a key role in the effective functioning and strategic success of the Japan Dia organization. Reporting to the Chapter Lead, ET Office (Dottedly to GM Japan), you will work side by side with the Dia Japan GM and Dia Japan Enabling Team as the “Chief of Staff”.
In this role, you will be involved in the strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders and network teams. In addition, you will work with the ET to translate vision/ strategy to actionable deliverables and assist them in facilitating effective decision-making. You will follow through and update the ET on progress of these deliverables as well as communication to employees through dashboard or other avenues. You will work with ET to prioritize on agenda and work through the backlog. And you will plan, convene and facilitate ET meetings to ensure objectives are achieved.

You will be responsible to:
● Support Japan Dia GM to develop short- and long-term priorities (business, financial and people) aligned to Roche Dia business objectives, by engaging in strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders
and network teams.
● As Chief of Staff, support the ET to ensure they are setting and achieving outcomes, while building and maintaining an environment that keeps the team focused on top priorities.
● Convene and facilitate the ET meetings, plan the agenda and support the team in timely, well-informed decision making.
● Design and facilitate effective meetings by prioritizing key objectives, balancing content review with discussion, and moderating dialogue.
● Strengthen ET cohesiveness by working with the P&C and regular exchanges with individual ET members.
● Increase ET effectiveness; Facilitate the formation of ET squads, make accountability clear, track and monitor ET decisions and backlog; hold ET members accountable to decisions and backlog.
● Lead, supported by administrative staff, on all aspects of logistics and planning of ET meetings.
● Collaborate with the GM and subject matter experts to develop communications and presentation materials for various speaking engagements.

Who you are
Professional and Technical Requirements:
- Degree / Masters in life sciences with typically with 3-5+ years of relevant experience in the life science sector in a similar capacity that may be directly comparable to Diagnostics and/or Pharmaceuticals is an advantage.
- Strategy consulting background and skill set would be desirable.
- Strong leadership experience, preferably with experience leading diverse teams and/or highly complex matrix leadership of enterprise-level projects.
- Strong business sense with a solid understanding of the healthcare industry and experience operating in a regulated environment.

Experience, Skills, Knowledge:

- Fully bilingual in Japanese and English in verbal, writing, and reading
- A systems thinker who can connect the dots between functions and processes in terms of broader business implications, including tactical, strategic, and enterprise dependencies.
- A strong collaborator, able to cultivate a strong and trusting relationship with executive leaders, proven experience in stakeholder management.
- Ability to work effectively in ambiguity and manage through change, able to work effectively across cultures and highly matrix organization
- Be detail-oriented with exce

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di gestione dei dati di canale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Main Tasks & 
• Responsibilities:
Provide actionable data with reliable quality and integrity. Work closely with senior leadership team to fulfil management’s requirement on channel data.
1. Accuracy of collected information, drawing on deep business analysis to fulfil channel management’s requirement on channel strategy and channel operation
2. Develop Channel Data management process to optimize data utilization and support business development
3. Build up Channel Data analysis system to effectively support channel performance management
4. Monitor Channel data and operation process to lead channel data optimization on the process
5. Lead or participate cross function projects, provide business expertise and improve efficiency
6. Regional distributors related issues follow up, including but not limited to: Channel data issues; Channel data validation; Data appeal follow up; DA findings follow up; Distributor data training, onsite inventory verification, etc.

Education& 
• Qualifications:
Bachelor Degree in Appropriate discipline
Proficiency in both spoken and written English
Good command of MS office software application

Experience:
A minimum of 5 years’ related working experience
Professional Capabilities/Skills:
Good data acumen, and preferably data analytics and mining tools
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to effectively resolve issues of a complex nature.
Planning & Organizing Capability
Customer Orientation & Relationship Management
Integrity and team work are core values
Meticulous attention to detail

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
会社概要
当社は、スイスのバーゼルに本拠地を置き、世界100カ国以上でビジネスを展開しているヘルスケアのグローバルカンパニーです。
「医薬品事業」と「診断薬事業」の2つの事業を主軸とし、革新的な薬剤、疾患の早期発見や正確な検査のための診断関連機器・試薬などのソリューションを通じて、幅広い領域で医療に貢献しています。
また、グループの強みを生かして、病気の要因に応じて治療を行う「個別化医療」をグループ戦略の中心に据えています。多くの企業が社外でビジネスパートナーを見つける中、当社は、医療全体を幅広く網羅する製品において自由なコラボレーションができる点で、他社と一線を画しています。このことは、開発初期段階において極めて重要な意味を持ちます。医薬品事業と診断薬事業の双方の広域にわたる深い知識やノウハウを備えている当社は、個別化医療の最先端で活躍し、個別化医療を実現するのに理想的な環境にあります。

募集背景
ますます多様化する医療環境を背景としてメディカルのビジネス貢献の重要性が高まる中、ロシュのVision ”Doing now what patients need next” を実現するため、この度Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）の人員を募集します。

募集ポジション
職種: Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）スペシャリスト

職務の目的
ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” を具現化するため、Healthcare Excellence 本部 (HCE) MSAグループは、臨床上の意思決定の変革および患者アクセスの拡大のため、戦略的にエビデンスと検査需要を創出し、Roche製品とソリューションの臨床実装を促進します。

業務内容
弊社の有する製品は幅広い専門領域（循環器、内分泌・代謝、感染症、Neurology、Critical Care、Oncology、Women's Health等）をカバーしており、MSAグループでは、2つに分けたUnitが、それぞれ複数の疾患領域に対応しています。各人が、そのUnitが担当する疾患領域の中で複数の疾患領域を担当し、ほかのメンバーと協力しながら、チームとして以下の業務を担います。

Clinical Development （臨床開発）

• 会社全体で合意した製品の優先度を踏まえて、適切なタイミングでの製品の確実な上市を目指す。

• 上市後を見据え戦略的に開発を遂行するとともに、ビジネス戦略の策定にも貢献する。

Scientific Interaction （医学的・科学的見地からのKOLエンゲージメントとエビデンス創出）

• 医学専門家とのコミュニケーションを通じて、アンメットメディカルニーズに関わるインサイトを収集する。

• インサイトに基づいて、臨床上の意思決定の変革および患者アクセスの拡大のため、戦略的にエビデンスを創出し、検査の需要を喚起する。

• さらに関連部署と連携もしながら、ロシュ製品の新たな価値の創造と臨床実装の促進・普及を進める。

HCE本部の一翼として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、薬事グループ、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、HCE本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」に貢献します。

必要な能力・マインドセット
【必須】

• 資格・学位：医療系資格（医師、歯科医師、薬剤師、看護師等）又は学位（関係する修士号又は博士号）

• 価値の創造：上記の資格又は学位を活用して医学的な知見に基づく価値の創造を行い、顧客視点で当社の成長に必要な貢献を具体化できること。

• 意欲：新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。特に、経験したことのない疾患領域であっても、貪欲に学び、その学びをチームに共有できることを求めています。

• リーダーシップ：日常業務だけでなく、プロジェクトにおいて、職務グレードによらずに、リーダーとなって業務を行うことがあり、こういった場面でリーダーシップを発揮できること。

• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。

• ホリスティックな視点：総合的なメディカル戦略を考え、実行できること。

• コミュニケーションスキル：複数人で一つの疾患領域を担当するため、チームメンバーと協業することを楽しめること。

• 英語力：英語の読み書きができること。

【歓迎】

• 製薬、医療機器、または診断薬企業でのメディカルアフェアーズまたは臨床開発の経験を計３年程度以上あれば歓迎します。なお、未経験でも医療系資格又は学位を有していればキャッチアップすることが可能な環境を用意しており、キャッチアップに努める意欲を生かしていただきたいと考えています。

• ビジネスレベルの英会話が可能であれば歓迎します。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）スペシャリスト
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする
給与
　　 基本給（月額）：400,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）：22,000円～
　　 時間外固定手当（月額）：68,065円～（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　 ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　 ＜補足＞ ■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）
コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など&

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 会社概要 当社は、スイスのバーゼルに本拠地を置き、世界100カ国以上でビジネスを展開しているヘルスケアのグローバルカンパニーです。 「医薬品事業」と「診断薬事業」の2つの事業を主軸とし、革新的な薬剤、疾患の早期発見や正確な検査のための診断関連機器・試薬などのソリューションを通じて、幅広い領域で医療に貢献しています。 また、グループの強みを生かして、病気の要因に応じて治療を行う「個別化医療」をグループ戦略の中心に据えています。多くの企業が社外でビジネスパートナーを見つける中、当社は、医療全体を幅広く網羅する製品において自由なコラボレーションができる点で、他社と一線を画しています。このことは、開発初期段階において極めて重要な意味を持ちます。医薬品事業と診断薬事業の双方の広域にわたる深い知識やノウハウを備えている当社は、個別化医療の最先端で活躍し、個別化医療を実現するのに理想的な環境にあります。 募集背景 ますます多様化する医療環境を背景としてメディカルのビジネス貢献の重要性が高まる中、ロシュのVision ”Doing now what patients need next” を実現するため、この度Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）の人員を募集します。 募集ポジション 職種: Medical Scientific Affairs（MSA）スペシャリスト 職務の目的 ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” を具現化するため、Healthcare Excellence 本部 (HCE) MSAグループは、臨床上の意思決定の変革および患者アクセスの拡大のため、戦略的にエビデンスと検査需要を創出し、Roche製品とソリューションの臨床実装を促進します。 業務内容 弊社の有する製品は幅広い専門領域（循環器、内分泌・代謝、感染症、Neurology、Critical Care、Oncology、Women's Health等）をカバーしており、MSAグループでは、2つに分けたUnitが、それぞれ複数の疾患領域に対応しています。各人が、そのUnitが担当する疾患領域の中で複数の疾患領域を担当し、ほかのメンバーと協力しながら、チームとして以下の業務を担います。 Clinical Development （臨床開発）
• 会社全体で合意した製品の優先度を踏まえて、適切なタイミングでの製品の確実な上市を目指す。
• 上市後を見据え戦略的に開発を遂行するとともに、ビジネス戦略の策定にも貢献する。 Scientific Interaction （医学的・科学的見地からのKOLエンゲージメントとエビデンス創出）
• 医学専門家とのコミュニケーションを通じて、アンメットメディカルニーズに関わるインサイトを収集する。
• インサイトに基づいて、臨床上の意思決定の変革および患者アクセスの拡大のため、戦略的にエビデンスを創出し、検査の需要を喚起する。
• さらに関連部署と連携もしながら、ロシュ製品の新たな価値の創造と臨床実装の促進・普及を進める。 HCE本部の一翼として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、薬事グループ、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、HCE本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」に貢献します。 必要な能力・マインドセット 【必須】
• 資格・学位：医療系資格（医師、歯科医師、薬剤師、看護師等）又は学位（関係する修士号又は博士号）
• 価値の創造：上記の資格又は学位を活用して医学的な知見に基づく価値の創造を行い、顧客視点で当社の成長に必要な貢献を具体化できること。
• 意欲：新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。特に、経験したことのない疾患領域であっても、貪欲に学び、その学びをチームに共有できることを求めています。
• リーダーシップ：日常業務だけでなく、プロジェクトにおいて、職務グレードによらずに、リーダーとなって業務を行うことがあり、こういった場面でリーダーシップを発揮できること。
• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。
• ホリスティックな視点：総合的なメディカル戦略を考え、実行できること。
• コミュニケーションスキル：複数人で一つの疾患領域を担当するため、チームメンバーと協業することを楽しめること。
• 英語力：英語の読み書きができること。 【歓迎】
• 製薬、医療機器、または診断薬企業でのメディカルアフェアーズまたは臨床開発の経験を計３年程度以上あれば歓迎します。なお、未経験でも医療系資格又は学位を有していればキャッチアップすることが可能な環境を用意しており、キャッチアップに努める意欲を生かしていただきたいと考えています。
• ビジネスレベルの英会話が可能であれば歓迎します。 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Genomics Data Scientist (2 year contract)

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des données génomiques (contrat de 2 ans)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Institute of Human Biology (IHB) is a newly established research center in Basel, Switzerland, dedicated to advancing the understanding of disease biology through the use of human model systems. The institute fosters dynamic collaboration among biologists, engineers, and data scientists, bridging the gap between academic and pharmaceutical research. Closely associated with Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development (pRED), we partner with leading academic institutions both locally and globally to address grand challenges with bold, innovative science.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly motivated and talented Genomics Analysis Data Scientist to work at the interface of exploratory academic research and process innovation in a leading Biopharma company. You will join the Institute of Human Biology (IHB), collaborating with scientists and engineers to design and implement computational pipelines and frameworks for the analysis of large-scale transcriptomic, genomic, epigenetic data from single-cell spatial and bulk sequencing experiments.

Your work will enable quantitative readouts from complex human model systems and directly support biological discovery. Working in a fast-paced research environment, you will contribute to the advancement of next-generation human model systems, analytical pipelines and open-source software tools used by the broader bioimaging community.

Who you are

• You have completed an M.S. and/or PhD in computational biology or a closely related field within the past 3 years.

• Proficiency in Python & R and familiarity with relevant scientific and visualization frameworks

• Proficiency in data analysis and statistical methods

• Experience with modern software engineering tools and methods

• Background in designing scalable solutions for high-performance computing or cloud environments is a plus

• Prior training and/or experience in machine learning would be advantageous

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to a non-technical audience

• Team player with the ability to also work independently and proactively

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Istituto di Biologia Umana (IHB) è un nuovo centro di ricerca a Basilea, in Svizzera, dedicato a promuovere la comprensione della biologia delle malattie attraverso l'uso di sistemi di modello umano. L'istituto promuove la collaborazione dinamica tra biologi, ingegneri e scienziati di dati, colmando il divario tra ricerca accademica e farmaceutica. In stretta collaborazione con Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development (pRED), collaboriamo con le principali istituzioni accademiche sia a livello locale che globale per affrontare grandi sfide con la scienza audace e innovativa. L'Opportunità
• Stiamo cercando uno scienziato di dati di analisi genomica altamente motivato e di talento per lavorare all'interfaccia di ricerca accademica esplorativa e innovazione di processo in una società leader Biopharma. Ti unirai all'Istituto di Biologia Umana (IHB), collaborando con scienziati e ingegneri per progettare e implementare pipeline e framework computazionali per l'analisi di dati transcriptomic su larga scala, genomici, epigenetici da esperimenti di sequenziamento su singolo cellulare e su larga scala. Il vostro lavoro consentirà la lettura quantitativa da complessi sistemi di modello umano e supporterà direttamente la scoperta biologica. Lavorando in un ambiente di ricerca veloce, contribuirete all'avanzamento di sistemi di modelli umani di nuova generazione, condutture analitiche e strumenti software open source utilizzati dalla più ampia comunità di bioimaging. Chi sei? - Hai completato un M.S. e/o un PhD in biologia computazionale o un campo collegato correlato entro gli ultimi 3 anni. - Profondità in Python & R e familiarità con struttura scientifica e di visualizzazione imposta. - Profondità nell'analisi dati e metodi statistici. - Esperienza con strumenti e metodi di ingegneria software moderni. - Background in progettazione di soluzioni scalabili per definizione ad alta prestazione o ambienti cloud è un plus. - Formazione precedente e/o esperienza in apprendimento automatico sarebbe vantaggiosa. - Eccellenti abilità di scrittura e comunicazione orale, con la capacità di spiegare concetti tecnici in modo chiaro a un pubblico non tecnico. - Collaboratore di squadra con la capacità di lavorare anche in modo indipendente e proattivo. Compensazione e Benefici Questa posizione offre anche un pacchetto di beneficiari interessati. Scopri di più su come ricompensiamo i nostri dipendenti a Roche. Chi siamo Una salute più futura ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100'000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a avanzare la scienza, assicurando a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti di Diagnostica. Ci aiutiamo a esplorare nuove possibilità, a favorire la creatività e a mantenere le nostre ambizioni alte, così possiamo fornire soluzioni per la salute che hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo insieme un futuro più sano. Roche è un Datore di Lavoro Uguale Opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Institute of Human Biology (IHB) is a newly established research center in Basel, Switzerland, dedicated to advancing the understanding of disease biology through the use of human model systems. The institute fosters dynamic collaboration among biologists, engineers, and data scientists, bridging the gap between academic and pharmaceutical research. Closely associated with Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development (pRED), we partner with leading academic institutions both locally and globally to address grand challenges with bold, innovative science.

The Opportunity

The position is raised as part of the initiative to establish a Data Analytics platform in IHB, referred to as A-IHB. We are looking for a highly motivated and talented Image Analysis Data Scientist to work at the interface of exploratory academic research and process innovation in a leading Biopharma company. You will join the Institute of Human Biology (IHB), collaborating with scientists and engineers to design and implement computational pipelines and frameworks for the analysis of large-scale and time-resolved 3D imaging data.

Your work will enable quantitative readouts from complex human model systems and directly support biological discovery. Working in a fast-paced research environment, you will contribute to the advancement of next-generation human model systems, analytical pipelines and open-source software tools used by the broader bioimaging community.

You will work closely with experienced data scientists and software engineers, receiving guidance while progressively taking ownership of your projects. For efficient interactions with collaborators you will work primarily onsite. You will be responsible to:

• Apply and adapt state-of-the-art image analysis methods to solve biologically relevant problems in collaboration with IHB scientists

• Design, implement, and validate scalable image analysis pipelines for terabyte-scale 3D imaging datasets

• Translate disease biology questions into quantitative computational workflows with guidance from senior team members

• Contribute to codebases following best practices in software engineering

• Proactively communicate progress, results, and challenges to collaborators

• Continuously expand your expertise in image analysis, computational biology, and scientific software development

• Present results to interdisciplinary audiences within IHB

Who you are

• Advanced degree (PhD or MSc with relevant experience) in computational sciences, computer science, electrical engineering, or related fields

• Proficiency in Python and familiarity with relevant scientific and visualization frameworks

• Experience with modern software engineering tools and methods

• Background in designing scalable solutions for high-performance computing or cloud environments is a plus

• Proficiency in concepts of Computer Vision and related methods in Deep Learning

• Proficiency in data analysis and statistical methods

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to a non-technical audience

• Team player with the ability to also work independently and proactively

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthca

jobs.title: Clinical Study Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a Clinical Study Manager to lead the operational execution of our secondary data use Real World Evidence (RWE) activities and international clinical studies. In this role, you will coordinate end-to-end study operations across global sites, ensuring that our clinical programs deliver high-quality data safely, efficiently, and ethically. You will work within a highly collaborative, matrixed team environment where your leadership directly helps us bring medical innovations to patients faster.

Your Responsibilities

• Lead Study Teams: Build and guide cross-functional, borderless study teams, establishing clear accountabilities, deliverables, and a psychologically safe environment where everyone can thrive.

• Manage End-to-End Trial Operations: Maintain comprehensive study plans, risk mitigation strategies, site selection procedures, and vendor oversight protocols from activation through to clinical closure.

• Oversee Financials & Agreements: Manage study budgets, track metrics, review work orders, and negotiate study agreements to ensure highly cost-effective operations with minimal variances.

• Drive Global Regulatory Compliance: Ensure absolute adherence to international clinical trial guidelines (such as Good Pharmacovigilance Practices and Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices), relevant local regulations, and inspection readiness.

• Direct Vendor & Site Deliverables: Maintain strict oversight of external vendors, tracking performance metrics, resolving systematic operational issues, and organizing necessary training.

• Develop Strategic Recruitment Plans: Analyze trial feasibility data across multiple countries to make data-driven recommendations on site distribution, patient numbers, and retention strategies.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, strategic operational leader with a passion for clinical excellence and cross-functional collaboration. You bring a growth mindset, excel at solving complex operational problems under tight deadlines, and possess deep listening and empathy skills that inspire your teams.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Proven Clinical Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading successful study teams through all operational stages of clinical studies or secondary data use projects.

• Regulatory Expertise: A clear understanding and practical experience applying global clinical quality requirements, regulations, and pharmacovigilance standards.

• Strategic Planning & Risk Management: Strong organizational awareness with a proactive planning mindset, including the ability to embed operational contingencies.

• Financial & Vendor Acumen: Experience successfully managing trial budgets, processing vendor agreements, and handling external system integrations.

• Exceptional Communication: Well-developed written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to present clear directions, influence cross-functionally, and resolve conflicts.

Together, we’ll advance along the whole patient journey with the aspiration to prevent, stop and cure diseases. Join us in building a healthier future!

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.
This job is posted in multiple locations. If you're applying for the role in an alternative location where pay transparency regulations apply, the Talent Acquisition Partner will share the local pay information with you ahead of any business interview.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta: - Proven Clinical Leadership: esperienza dimostrata leader team di studio di successo attraverso tutte le fasi operative di studi clinici o progetti di utilizzo dei dati secondari. - Competenza normativa: una chiara comprensione e un'esperienza pratica che applicano requisiti di qualità clinica globale, regolamenti e standard di farmacovigilanza. - Strategic Planning & Risk Management: Forte consapevolezza organizzativa con una mentalità proattiva di pianificazione, compresa la capacità di incorporare contingenze operative. - Financial & Vendor Acumen: L'esperienza di gestire con successo i bilanci di prova, l'elaborazione degli accordi dei fornitori e la gestione delle integrazioni di sistema esterne. - Comunicazione eccezionale: competenze di comunicazione scritte e verbali ben sviluppate, con una comprovata capacità di presentare chiare direzioni, influenzare trasversalmente e risolvere i conflitti. descriptionByLocale.de:
Descrizion Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wir suchen einen Clinical Study Manager, der die operative Durchführung unserer Aktivitäten zur Nutzung von Real World Evidence (RWE) und internationalen klinischen Studien leitet. In dieser Rolle koordinieren Sie den gesamten Studienbetrieb an globalen Standorten und stellen sicher, dass unsere klinischen Programme qualitativ hochwertige Daten sicher, effizient und ethisch liefern. Sie arbeiten in einer hochgradig kooperativen, matrixförmigen Teamumgebung, in der Ihre Führung uns direkt hilft, medizinische Innovationen schneller zu Patienten zu bringen.
• Ihre Aufgaben Leitende Studienteams: Aufbau und Führung funktionsübergreifender, grenzenloser Studienteams, Festlegung klarer Rechenschaftspflichten, Ergebnisse und einer psychologisch sicheren Umgebung, in der jeder gedeihen kann. - Manage End-to-End Trial Operations: Pflegen Sie umfassende Studienpläne, Risikominderungsstrategien, Standortauswahlverfahren und Vendor-Überwachungsprotokolle von der Aktivierung bis zum klinischen Abschluss. - Überwachen von Finanzen und Vereinbarungen: Verwalten Sie Studienbudgets, verfolgen Sie Metriken, überprüfen Sie Arbeitsaufträge und verhandeln Sie Studienvereinbarungen, um einen kostengünstigen Betrieb mit minimalen Abweichungen zu gewährleisten. Globale Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Vorschriften: Gewährleistung der absoluten Einhaltung internationaler Richtlinien für klinische Studien (wie Good Pharmacovigilance Practices und Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices), einschlägiger lokaler Vorschriften und Inspektionsbereitschaft. Direct Vendor & Site Deliverables: Behalten Sie eine strenge Aufsicht über externe Anbieter, verfolgen Sie Leistungskennzahlen, lösen Sie systematische Betriebsprobleme und organisieren Sie notwendige Schulungen. - Entwicklung strategischer Rekrutierungspläne: Analysieren Sie Machbarkeitsdaten für Studien in mehreren Ländern, um datenbasierte Empfehlungen für die Verteilung von Websites, Patientenzahlen und Aufbewahrungsstrategien abzugeben. Wer du bist Sie sind eine proaktive, strategische Führungskraft mit einer Leidenschaft für klinische Exzellenz und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit. Sie bringen eine wachstumsorientierte Denkweise mit, zeichnen sich durch die Lösung komplexer operativer Probleme unter engen Fristen aus und besitzen tiefe Zuhör- und Empathiefähigkeiten, die Ihre Teams inspirieren. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: Nachgewiesene klinische Führung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung, die erfolgreiche Studienteams durch alle operativen Phasen klinischer Studien oder sekundärer Datennutzungsprojekte führt. Regulatory Expertise: Ein klares Verständnis und praktische Erfahrung mit der Anwendung globaler klinischer Qualitätsanforderungen, Vorschriften und Pharmakovigilanz-Standards. Strategisches Planungs- und Risikomanagement: Starkes Organisationsbewusstsein mit proaktiver Planungsmentalität, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, betriebliche Eventualitäten einzubetten. - Financial & Vendor Acumen: Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Verwaltung von Testbudgets, der Verarbeitung von Lieferantenvereinbarungen und dem Umgang mit externen Systemintegrationen. Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation: Gut entwickelte schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, klare Richtungen zu präsentieren, funktionsübergreifend zu beeinflussen und Konflikte zu lösen. Entschädigung und Vorteile Diese Position bietet auch ein attraktives Leistungspaket. Erfahren Sie mehr darüber, wie wir unsere Mitarbeiter bei Roche belohnen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous cherchons un gestionnaire d'études cliniques pour diriger l'exécution opérationnelle de nos données secondaires en utilisant les activités Real World Evidence (RWE) et les études cliniques internationales. Dans ce rôle, vous coordonnerez les activités d'étude de bout en bout dans tous les sites mondiaux, en veillant à ce que nos programmes cliniques fournissent des données de haute qualité de façon sûre, efficace et éthique. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement d'équipe fortement collaboratif et matricielle où votre leadership nous aide directement à apporter des innovations médicales aux patients plus rapidement.
• Vos responsabilités - Équipes d'étude principales : Construisez et guidez des équipes d'étude interfonctionnelles et sans frontières, établissant des responsabilités claires, des produits livrables et un environnement psychologiquement sûr où chacun peut prospérer. - Gérer les opérations d'essai de bout en bout : Maintenir des plans d'étude approfondis, des stratégies d'atténuation des risques, des procédures de sélection des sites et des protocoles de surveillance des fournisseurs, de l'activation jusqu'à la fermeture clinique. - Superviser les finances et les ententes : gérer les budgets d'étude, suivre les paramètres, examiner les ordres de travail et négocier des ententes d'étude pour assurer des opérations hautement rentables avec des écarts minimes. - Assurer la conformité à la réglementation mondiale : assurer le respect absolu des lignes directrices internationales sur les essais cliniques (comme les bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance et les bonnes pratiques de pharmacoépidémiologie), les règlements locaux pertinents et la préparation à l'inspection. - Produits livrables directs : maintenir une surveillance stricte des fournisseurs externes, suivre les mesures de rendement, résoudre les problèmes opérationnels systématiques et organiser la formation nécessaire. - Élaborer des plans stratégiques de recrutement : analyser les données sur la faisabilité des essais dans plusieurs pays afin de formuler des recommandations axées sur les données sur la distribution des sites, le nombre de patients et les stratégies de rétention. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader opérationnel proactif et stratégique avec une passion pour l'excellence clinique et la collaboration interfonctionnelle. Vous apportez un état d'esprit de croissance, excellez dans la résolution de problèmes opérationnels complexes dans des délais serrés, et possédez des compétences d'écoute et d'empathie profondes qui inspirent vos équipes. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez : - Leadership clinique prouvé : Expérience démontrée menant des équipes d'étude réussies à toutes les étapes opérationnelles des études cliniques ou des projets d'utilisation de données secondaires. - Expertise en matière de réglementation : Une compréhension claire et une expérience pratique en appliquant les exigences mondiales en matière de qualité clinique, les règlements et les normes de pharmacovigilance. - Planification stratégique et gestion des risques : Une forte sensibilisation organisationnelle avec un état d'esprit de planification proactif, y compris la capacité d'intégrer les imprévus opérationnels. - Accumen financier et fournisseur : Expérience de la gestion réussie des budgets d'essai, du traitement des accords avec les fournisseurs et du traitement des intégrations externes. - Communication exceptionnelle : Compétences bien développées en communication écrite et verbale, avec une capacité prouvée de présenter des orientations claires, d'influencer interfonctionnellement et de résoudre des conflits. Rémunération et avantages sociaux Cette position offre également un ensemble attrayant d'avantages. Découvrez comment nous récompensons nos employés à Roche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain.

jobs.title: Study Start Up Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose, Objectives and Scope of Position
As a member of the PDG Country Study Start Up Team, your primary focus is to drive and facilitate efficient study start-up processes to contribute to the delivery of clinical trials to patients. You will enable innovative clinical trial delivery, address study start up needs across various therapeutic areas, and ensure seamless trial execution for patients, investigators, and clinical site staff. Collaboration with local country teams, global study teams, and CROs is essential to this role.

Key 
• Responsibilities
This role focuses on the efficient and compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials by executing effective start-up strategies while maintaining regulatory compliance. Additionally, this role involves managing amendments throughout the study lifecycle. You will bring subject matter expertise and may work cross functionally in the following areas below:

Study Start Up Strategy & Execution:
Support and execute study start-up strategies for faster site activations, collaborating with internal and external teams, CROs, and sites. Help identify issues, follow regulations/SOPs, and assist with Health Authority/Ethics Committee communication. Track submissions in relevant systems and stay updated on regulatory requirements.

Informed Consent Form (ICF) Management:
Assist in preparing/adapting ICFs, supporting IRB/EC/HA submissions and changes, and archiving approvals.

Clinical Trial Submissions & Regulatory Coordination:
Prepare and manage submission packages for regulatory bodies and health authorities. Assist in responding to RFIs and ensure timely document submission to the TMF. Support study amendments and notifications.

Site Documentation & Compliance:
Collect and verify site documents (CVs, etc.). Assist with translations, patient materials, and biobank details. Learn local document needs and timelines. Support local vendors (excluding CROs) if needed.

Budgeting & Contract Management:
Provide assistance with contract negotiations & execution (confidentiality, indemnity, amendments). Collaborate with internal/external partners on financial/legal compliance. Help update contract system data for planning.

Payment Oversight:
Assist in overseeing site payments, escalations, and reporting via shared service centers and in compliance with site contracts. Help ensure financial/regulatory compliance for local operations. Participate in accrual/purchase order planning and reconciliation.

Qualifications
● Degree (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) in life sciences or equivalent. Postgraduate degree or master’s degree highly desirable

Skills and Competencies
● Fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
● Fluency in written and spoken language(s) of the host country is mandatory.

IMPACT LEVELS
Acquires basic knowledge to assist with study start-up in clinical trials and drug development, including learning about the clinical trial industry and how trials work. Completes tasks following standard procedures and guidance.
Gains practical skills in clinical trial study start-up by assisting with the execution of country clinical trial start-up activities.
Assists with process improvements and changes by completing assigned tasks. Offers basic input based on observations.
Follows directions for clinical trial study start-up projects. Can organize simple tasks.
Works with other groups within PDG to complete assigned tasks in delivering projects.
Learns about and follows ICH, GCP, and regulatory guidelines for clinic
