jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
您是谁
您负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

您的机会:
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: 治疗领域专员
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【岗位职责】

• 战略项目管理与跨部门协同

• 项目全周期追踪：协助推进 CE-ON 核心战略项目的落地、执行与精细化管理，确保各节点高效交付。

• 跨团队赋能协作：协调并组织跨部门、跨治疗领域的复盘与知识分享会，促进内部高效 协同与信息共享。

• 商业敏锐度与多维数据洞察

• 已上市产品分析：收集、清洗并整合市场及销售多维数据，通过深度分析挖掘业务增长点，识别潜在挑战。

• 晚期管线产品策略支持：动态追踪竞争格局、临床进展及准入政策环境，协助开展市场调研项目，为核心业务决策提供可视化化支持与前瞻洞察建议。

创新商业模式与数智化探索

• 前沿趋势研究：系统性调研海内外医疗健康领域的创新商业模式，深入探索 AI 及数智化在眼科与神经科学领域的实际应用场景。

高层会议与策略工作坊

• 核心资产输出：参与 CE-ON 策略工作坊及大型业务会议（如年会）的筹备，协助进行 业务Slides及会议材料的撰写、整合与校对。

• 专题调研支持：针对大型会议核心议题进行特定课题的资料检索、推演与输出。

【任职要求】

• 专业背景：医药、生命科学、公共卫生等相关专业优先。

• 核心经验：必须具备管理咨询公司或医药咨询公司的实习/工作经验，具备良好的结构化思维。

• 核心技能：熟练掌握 Excel 数据分析及高品质 PPT 制作技能；熟练使用各类AI工具；具备优秀的英语听说读写能力。

• 素质模型：具备强烈的责任心、优秀的敏捷学习能力与跨团队沟通协作能力，能适应多任务并行的节奏。

• 到岗时间：每周实习 3-5 天，持续 3 个月以上（能长期实习者优先）。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
As an intern on the global Early in Career (EiC) team, you will have the opportunity to participate in challenging and impactful business-critical projects. You will be a key member of the Integrated Workforce Strategy (IWS) organization of the Human Resources Department at Roche which encompasses many critical areas of talent attraction, talent pipelining and recruitment. The EiC team is key to executing on the company’s investment in early talent (internships, rotational programs and other entry-level opportunities) for the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.

The intern will be based in Selangor, Malaysia and support the APAC EiC Partner and Specialist in the daily creation of unparalleled EiC experiences that foster development, networking, and community for interns at Roche and its affiliates.

• Help EiC Partner and Specialist in daily operations and execution of various strategies across the region and/or globe

• Develop university mapping across the region to share Roche opportunities with students

• Maintain the Job Portal Account in Universities across the region

• Support in the analysis of intern data and generating data insights

• Support online and offline university career fair and engagement event management, including event planning, logistic preparation and onsite support

• Research the EiC best practices in across the region and/or globe

Required qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor or Master’s degree or related experience in HR management, organizational development, communications and or business/related field

• Student organization and/or leadership experience is preferred

• Experience in HR, Marketing or recruiting experience via coursework or previous internship is preferred

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Mandarin

• Demonstrated good communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills

• Knowledge of MS Office, Google Suite is a plus

• Available for the internship duration between 3 - 6 months

Program highlights:

• Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects

• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry

• Lead or participate to design and coordinate program events and initiatives for the EiC candidate experience

• Create new professional & personal development curriculum, including hosting networking opportunities, workshops, and panel discussions

• Participate in volunteer projects, social events, and team-building activities

jobs.title: Tax Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary :
Responsible for RDSL Tax related operations including Head Office and Branch Offices, to ensure company tax compliance, mitigate company tax risk, and optimize tax savings.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities :

• Perform tax analysis, tax advice, planning and filing

• Communicate with tax authorities in different cities in China periodically and build up good relationship with tax authorities

• Review company internal process and transactions, take actions to control the tax risk

• Monitor TP fluctuations, document and defend TP positions, and manage the rationality of pricing adjustments with local authorities

• Answer Tax related inquiries and provide advice and solutions proactively

• Support company projects/global projects, self-initiate projects for process improvement

• Learn and distribute updated information on tax laws and regulations to finance team and related operation team (include proper training)

• Support Internal Audit / KPMG audit and ensure RDSL tax area meet Internal Audit/KPMG audit/ICFR requirement /KPMG

• Prepare & update Tax related SOP in time SOP Other projects or tasks assigned by line manager

• Conduct business in full compliance including but not limited to Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, Roche Safety, Security Health and Environmental Protection

Basic Requirements of the Job :

Education & Qualifications :

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

• Accountant certification, CPA/CTA is preferred

• Good computer knowledge: excel/word/PowerPoint

• Good command of English, both oral/written

• SAP experience is a plus

• Familiarity with automation and AI tools

• Open to cross functional projects and opportunities

Experience :

• At least 5 years’ accounting/auditing/tax related experience in multinational or accounting firms

• Familiar with IAS & PRC Accounting Standard /PRC Tax laws , regulations

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Project Manager (woj. lubelskie)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche

Roche Diagnostics is a division of Roche, a science-driven company committed to advancing healthcare and enhancing lives. We are powered by our diverse, talented teams of award-winning scientists, experts, and professionals, all dedicated to innovating and finding better ways to prevent, diagnose, and monitor diseases.

Join a team dedicated to transforming healthcare through innovative laboratory solutions. As Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in implementing high-quality projects, optimizing customer workflows, and driving operational excellence, positioning Roche as a trusted partner in healthcare innovation. We are seeking a candidate based in the lubelskie voivodeship.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and manage strategic and operational projects for customers in alignment with Roche’s goals

• Collaborate with stakeholders to optimize business processes and enhance customer experiences

• Implement new workflows, laboratory systems, and ICT platforms, ensuring seamless integration

• Support sales and marketing teams with tender opportunities and contribute to customer sales development

• Foster collaboration with internal teams and external partners to strengthen expertise and strategy

Who you are:

• You live in lubelskie voivodeship

• Valid driver’s license and readiness to travel extensively within Poland

• You have minimum 5 years of experience in project management, preferably in healthcare or laboratory settings

• Proficient in modern planning and office software with proven experience in planning tools

• University degree

• Fluent in Polish and English

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities, with a customer-centric focus

• Demonstrated success in managing complex projects and collaborating across teams

• Knowledge of hospital and laboratory organizational structures is a plus

• A proactive team player with commercial acumen

What you get:

• Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive private medical care for employees and their families, life insurance, and confidential psychological, legal, and financial support through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Finances & Future: Active support for retirement savings via the Employee Pension Plan (PPE) with a high company contribution, along with annual performance bonuses and jubilee rewards.

• Company Car

• Sports & Integration: MultiSport card co-financing, active internal sports clubs (running, cycling, football), and modern office amenities including relaxation zones and bike infrastructure.

• Growth & Perks: Subsidies for languages, certifications, and postgraduate studies, alongside clear internal career paths within the global structure.

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche first-hand? Check out our blog!
https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche

The controller of your personal data is Roche Polska Sp. z o.o., ul. Domaniewska 28, 02-672 Warsaw. The data is processed for the purpose of recruitment. You have the right to access your data, rectify it, delete it, limit processing, transfer it and - if processing is based on your consent - withdraw this consent at any time. Contact the Data Protection Officer at: Ochrona.danych@roche.com. More information on the principles of processing your personal data by Roche at the link:

jobs.title: Sales Executive - Thanh Hóa
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
As a Sales Executive you will manage Account and Ensure Sales Achievement in Assigned Territory & Product lines, assist District Sales Manager in relieving their duties whenever necessary

Your opportunity

• Manage existing Accounts actively to ensure long-term partnership and customer satisfaction pro-actively

• Develop new accounts with proper and close follow-up of sales opportunity

• Develop and maintains good customer relationships with important and relevant personnel

• Proactive and creative solve problems in managing customers’ complaint by proper investigation and close follow-up in resolving issues (eg: product deliveries/application troubleshooting)

• Coordinate with Distribution partner /Third Party to better serve customers

• Work closely with the Professional Service team to deliver the post-sales service for the maximum customers’ satisfaction.

Who you are

• Have Bachelor in Health/Science

• Have 3 year multinational companies experience in Pharmaceutical/ Diagnostic/ Healthcare industrial sales

• Have effective communication and interpersonal skill

• Have creative problem solving and negotiation skill

• Have customer complaint handling skill

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Disease Area Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Title: Disease Area Marketing Lead

As DAML, you will be building the marketing strategy for the assigned brands and overall disease area; and be responsible for ensuring the marketing strategy gets delivered with confidence and conviction in working closely with the cluster marketing and broader teams. You will connect with the CEETRIS/ global teams to pull brand solutions from the network and help develop via work packages where gaps exist. You will be a member of the Cross Functional Pan India Disease Squad; and report into the Disease Area squad Lead.
The Opportunity

• You will be Co-creating portfolio strategy, plans and objectives leveraging outside in perspective

• Build the integrated DA and Brand Plan along with the DA Squad Lead, the cross functio nal Pan India DA team, and importantly the PPOCs across India. It will be critically important the strategy is built on the insights gained from the PJPs and HSPs and the cluster teams. They are closest to our customers and their insights need to lead the strategy development.

• You will be building strong relationships with the identified key stakeholders from Key Doctors, Accounts or Government stakeholders to build Roche equity and gain customer insights - to incorporate into our work.

• You will ensure compliance of the marketing strategy with Roche and Local guidelines for all Roche Initiatives and develop Patient Persona based solutions.

• You will liaison with Global & regional team for brand related campaigns, cross Pollination of Best Practices and share insights from cluster specific data on patients, diseases, patient journey etc and design solutions to increase patient impact

• Design of awareness campaigns solving for patient journey challenges & calculate ROIs and support customization of pricing. In this context, the role provides commercial insights to inform Access & Medical functions, but does not own decision-making for pricing, commercial contracting, reimbursement, etc. Marketing and field insights will be generated using methodologies that comply with data privacy laws, competition laws, and ethical standards.

• You will gather insights and prepare effective pre-launch / launch strategies for new assets in the respective disease areas ensuring that the latest innovations reach patients in need

Who you are
We are seeking a highly collaborative, process-oriented Marketing Postgraduate with 5+ years of specialized experience within the Oncology therapeutic area (specifically lung or liver cancer). This individual will possess a powerful combination of commercial acumen, strong alliance management capabilities, and a proven track record of high-impact marketing execution within the complex Indian healthcare ecosystem.
Key Competencies & Qualifications

• Oncology Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Indian healthcare ecosystem , emerging market landscapes, and specific clinical nuances of lung/liver oncology.

• Commercial & Strategic Marketing: Strong mastery of marketing fundamentals, a data-driven insight generation mindset, and a history of flawless campaign execution.

• Alliance Management & Collaboration: Exceptional networking and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to manage complex external alliances and drive cross-functional teamwork.

• Operational Rigor & Project Management: A highly structured, process-oriented approach backed by strong project management skills, fluency in modern productivity tools, and strict compliance with organizational SOPs an

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Experience Required- 6+ years

The Accounts Payables ERP Solution Architect designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions within the Accounts Payables context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust ERP implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization.

Description of the area
Our landscape in the Accounts Payables area integrates SAP ECC and S/4HANA with diverse procurement platforms to support the Invoice-to-Pay lifecycle. We ensure seamless processing from invoice receipt and compliant financial approval workflows through to the successful delivery of payment instructions to the Treasury solution.

You will play a key role in navigating the transition from legacy environments to modern ERP standards, ensuring integration resilience and scalability as we re-engineer our global ERP landscape through the ASPIRE program.
You will serve as the critical interface for translating business requirements into technical/ IT language. Your primary mission is to deeply explore and define the functional "why" behind business requests, ensuring that every technological solution is built upon a foundation of clearly mapped processes and validated organizational needs.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs ERP solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific solution context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle, and aligns with the architecture community for proper governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned ERP solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and ontologies for the solution and the related interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, needed NFRs, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility for the solution, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap within the solution context. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific ERP technologies for product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within the Accounts Payable product scope, managing the architectural complexities of specific ERP applications or components. In ad

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you ready to shape the future of employee care and social sustainability at Roche?

As the Head of People Local Care Solutions , you will define and lead our local People Care strategy in Switzerland, ensuring operational excellence across social sustainability, counseling and career transitions initiatives. Joining the Switzerland Catalyst Network, you will serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Senior Management, translating global frameworks into impactful local practices that enhance the long-term employee experience.

Your Opportunity

In this role, you will lead two teams (Employee Counseling and New Orientation Center Coaches) to cultivate an inclusive, resilient, and psychologically safe work environment where every employee feels a sense of belonging.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Social Sustainability Architecture : Shape, operationalize, and lead the strategy for local social sustainability priorities and designing frameworks that foster an inclusive and psychologically safe work culture. Align local wellbeing and mental health initiatives with our global Sustainability Strategy, bridging internal partners and external social insurance networks.

• Strategic Leadership: Define and implement the future collaboration model and strategic direction for the People Care department, ensuring alignment with country-wide priorities.

• Team Evolution: Lead the department's transition into an agile, merged team structure, driving continuous learning, professional growth, and skill-based career paths.

• Policy & Compliance: Serve as a strategic advisor on policy development and organizational design, ensuring full compliance with Swiss social security laws and wider legislation.

• Transformation & Employability: Partner with Senior Management on the "people side" of organizational changes, overseeing outplacement measures, Social Plans, and negotiations with employee representatives.

• Counseling & Case Management: Enable early intervention strategies and oversee the holistic reintegration process for employees facing long-term absences.

• Crisis & Stakeholder Care: Ensure robust resourcing and leadership for local Crisis Management teams (e.g., Threat Management, Family Assistance) and foster high-trust relationships with employee networks.

Who You Are

You are an empathetic, strategic leader who thrives in complex, matrix environments. You bring a systemic mindset to highly sensitive personnel matters and are passionate about experimenting with new, agile ways of working.

To success in this role, you bring:

• Education: A Master’s degree in Social Sustainability, Psychology, Social Work, Human Resources, or a related field.

• Experience: 8+ years of professional experience, including at least 5 years of direct or matrix leadership managing multidisciplinary teams.

• Expertise: Proven success in social sustainability strategy (mental health, wellbeing) and an extensive command of Swiss social insurance frameworks (IV, UVG, KTG) and labor legislation.

• Skills: Fluency in both German and English; strong emotional intelligence, discretion, and boundary-setting capabilities.

• Digital Mindset: High proficiency with case management software, HRIS (Workday), and an openness to leveraging AI tools to enhance advisory workflows.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei pronto a plasmare il futuro dell'assistenza ai dipendenti e della sostenibilità sociale a Roche? In qualità di responsabile delle soluzioni per la cura locale, definirai e guiderai la nostra strategia locale per la cura del popolo in Svizzera, garantendo l'eccellenza operativa nelle iniziative di sostenibilità sociale, consulenza e transizione di carriera. Entrando nella rete svizzera Catalyst, sarai un consulente strategico di fiducia per la gestione senior, traducendo i quadri globali in pratiche locali di impatto che migliorano l'esperienza dei dipendenti a lungo termine. La tua opportunità In questo ruolo, guiderai due squadre (Employee Counseling and New Orientation Center Coaches) per coltivare un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, resiliente e psicologicamente sicuro dove ogni dipendente sente un senso di appartenenza. Le tue responsabilità chiave includono:
• Social Sustainability Architecture: Forma, operativizza e guida la strategia per le priorità della sostenibilità sociale locale e la progettazione di quadri che favoriscono una cultura del lavoro inclusiva e psicologicamente sicura. Allineare il benessere locale e le iniziative di salute mentale con la nostra strategia globale di sostenibilità, corrompere i partner interni e le reti di assicurazione sociale esterne.
• Leadership Strategica: Definire e implementare il futuro modello di collaborazione e la direzione strategica per il dipartimento People Care, garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità a livello nazionale.
• Team Evolution: guidare la transizione del dipartimento in una struttura agile e unificata del team, guidare l'apprendimento continuo, la crescita professionale e percorsi di carriera basati sulle competenze.
• Politica e conformità: Servire come consulente strategico per lo sviluppo delle politiche e il design organizzativo, garantire il pieno rispetto delle leggi sulla sicurezza sociale e della legislazione in vigore.
• Transformation & Employability: Partner con Senior Management sul lato "persona" dei cambiamenti organizzativi, supervisionando misure di outplacement, piani sociali e trattative con i rappresentanti dei dipendenti.
• Consulenza & Case Management: Abilitare le strategie di intervento precoce e supervisionare il processo di reintegrazione olistica per i dipendenti che si trovano ad affrontare assenze a lungo termine.
• Crisis & Stakeholder Care: Garantire una solida risonanza e leadership per i team locali di Crisis Management (ad esempio, Threat Management, Family Assistance) e promuovere relazioni di alta fiducia con le reti dei dipendenti. Chi sei Sei un leader strategico empatico che prospera in ambienti complessi e matrici. Porti una mentalità sistemica a questioni di personale altamente sensibili e sono appassionati di sperimentare nuove, agili modi di lavorare. Per il successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Istruzione: un Master in Sostenibilità Sociale, Psicologia, Lavoro Sociale, Risorse Umane, o un campo correlato.
• Esperienza: 8+ anni di esperienza professionale, tra cui almeno 5 anni di leadership diretta o matrice che gestiscono team multidisciplinari.
• Competenza: comprovato successo nella strategia di sostenibilità sociale (salute mentale, benessere) e un ampio comando dei quadri assicurativi sociali svizzeri (IV, UVG, KTG) e della legislazione sul lavoro.
• Competenze: Fluenza sia in tedesco che in inglese; forte intelligenza emotiva, discrezione e capacità di regolazione dei confini.
• Digital Mindset: alta competenza con il software di gestione dei casi, HRIS (Workday), e un'apertura per sfruttare gli strumenti AI per migliorare i flussi di lavoro di consulenza. Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Sind Sie bereit, die Zukunft der Mitarbeiterpflege und sozialen Nachhaltigkeit bei Roche zu gestalten? Als Head of People Local Care Solutions definieren und leiten Sie unsere lokale People Care-Strategie in der Schweiz, um betriebliche Exzellenz in den Bereichen soziale Nachhaltigkeit, Beratung und Karriere-Übergänge zu gewährleisten. Als vertrauenswürdiger strategischer Berater für Senior Management, der globale Rahmen in effektvolle lokale Praktiken überträgt, die die langjährige Mitarbeitererfahrung verbessern. Ihre Chance In dieser Rolle führen Sie zwei Teams (Mitarbeiterberatung und New Orientation Center Coaches) an, um eine integrative, widerstandsfähige und psychisch sichere Arbeitsumgebung zu kultivieren, in der jeder Mitarbeiter ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit empfindet. • Soziale Nachhaltigkeitsarchitektur: Gestalten, betreiben und führen die Strategie für lokale soziale Nachhaltigkeitsprioritäten und die Gestaltung von Rahmenbedingungen, die eine integrative und psychisch sichere Arbeitskultur fördern. Fördern Sie lokale Wohlfahrts- und psychische Gesundheitsinitiativen mit unserer globalen Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie, überbrücken Sie interne Partner und externe Sozialversicherungsnetze.
• Strategische Führung: Definieren und implementieren Sie das zukünftige Kollaborationsmodell und strategische Ausrichtung für die Abteilung People Care, um die Ausrichtung auf landesweite Prioritäten zu gewährleisten.
• Team Evolution: Führen Sie den Übergang der Abteilung in eine agile, zusammengeführte Teamstruktur, treiben kontinuierliches Lernen, professionelles Wachstum und fachkundige Karrierewege.
• Policy & Compliance: Als strategischer Berater für Politikentwicklung und Organisationsdesign, um die Einhaltung der schweizerischen Sozialversicherungsgesetze und breiteren Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten.
• Transformation & Employability: Partner mit Senior Management auf der "Menschenseite" organisatorischer Veränderungen, Überwachung von Outplacement-Maßnahmen, Sozialplänen und Verhandlungen mit Arbeitnehmervertretern.
• Beratung & Case Management: Ermöglichen Sie frühzeitige Interventionsstrategien und beaufsichtigen Sie den ganzheitlichen Wiedereingliederungsprozess für Mitarbeiter mit langfristigen Abwesenheiten.
• Crisis & Stakeholder Care: Gewährleistung einer robusten Beschaffung und Führung für lokale Crisis Management-Teams (z.B. Threat Management, Family Assistance) und Pflege hochkarätiger Beziehungen zu Mitarbeiternetzwerken. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein empathischer, strategischer Führer, der in komplexen, Matrix-Umgebungen lebt. Sie bringen eine systemische Denkweise auf hochsensible Personalangelegenheiten und sind leidenschaftlich, mit neuen, agilen Arbeitsmöglichkeiten zu experimentieren. Zum Erfolg in dieser Rolle bringen Sie:
• Ausbildung: Masterstudium Soziale Nachhaltigkeit, Psychologie, Soziale Arbeit, Humanressourcen oder ein verwandten Bereich.
• Erfahrung: 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, darunter mindestens 5 Jahre direkte oder Matrix-Führung, die multidisziplinäre Teams verwaltet.
• Expertise: Bewiesener Erfolg in der sozialen Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie (Menschengesundheit, Wohlbefinden) und einem umfangreichen Befehl der Schweizer Sozialversicherungsrahmen (IV, UVG, KTG) und Arbeitsgesetzgebung.
• Fähigkeiten: Fluency in Deutsch und Englisch; starke emotionale Intelligenz, Diskretion und grenzübergreifende Fähigkeiten.
• Digital Mindset: Hohe Kompetenz mit Case-Management-Software, HRIS (Workday) und eine Offenheit, AI-Tools zu nutzen, um beratende Workflows zu verbessern. Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir würden gerne von Ihnen hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt, um diese spannende Gelegenheit zu erkunden! Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir des soins aux employés et de la durabilité sociale à Roche? En tant que responsable de People Local Care Solutions , vous définirez et dirigerez notre stratégie locale de People Care en Suisse, assurant l'excellence opérationnelle dans les initiatives de durabilité sociale, de conseil et de transition de carrière. En vous inscrivant au réseau Catalyst Suisse, vous serez un conseiller stratégique de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs, traduisant les cadres mondiaux en pratiques locales efficaces qui améliorent l'expérience des employés à long terme. Votre opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez deux équipes (Employee Counseling and New Orientation Center Coaches) pour cultiver un environnement de travail inclusif, résistant et psychologiquement sûr où chaque employé se sent un sentiment d'appartenance. Vos principales responsabilités comprendront :
• Architecture de durabilité sociale : façonner, opérationnaliser et diriger la stratégie pour les priorités locales de durabilité sociale et concevoir des cadres qui favorisent une culture du travail inclusive et psychologiquement sûre. Aligner les initiatives locales en matière de bien-être et de santé mentale sur notre stratégie mondiale de durabilité, en reliant les partenaires internes et les réseaux d'assurance sociale externes.
• Leadership stratégique: Définir et mettre en œuvre le modèle de collaboration futur et l'orientation stratégique du département des soins aux personnes, en veillant à l'alignement sur les priorités nationales.
• L'évolution de l'équipe : Diriger la transition du département vers une structure d'équipe agile et fusionnée, conduire l'apprentissage continu, la croissance professionnelle et les parcours professionnels axés sur les compétences.
• Politique et conformité: servir de conseiller stratégique pour l'élaboration des politiques et la conception organisationnelle, assurant le plein respect des lois suisses sur la sécurité sociale et de la législation plus large.
• Transformation et employabilité: partenariat avec la haute direction du côté des personnes des changements organisationnels, supervision des mesures de délocalisation, des plans sociaux et des négociations avec les représentants des employés.
• Counseling & Case Management: Permettre des stratégies d'intervention précoce et superviser le processus de réinsertion holistique des employés en situation d'absence de longue durée.
• Crise et prise en charge des parties prenantes : assurer un solide ressourcement et un leadership pour les équipes locales de gestion de crise (p. ex., gestion des menaces, aide à la famille) et favoriser des relations de confiance avec les réseaux d'employés. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader empathique et stratégique qui prospère dans des environnements matriciels complexes. Vous apportez un état d'esprit systémique à des questions de personnel hautement sensibles et êtes passionné par l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de travail agiles. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Éducation : Maîtrise en durabilité sociale, psychologie, travail social, ressources humaines ou domaine connexe.
• Expérience : 8 ans et plus d'expérience professionnelle, dont au moins 5 ans de leadership direct ou matriciel en gestion d'équipes multidisciplinaires.
• Expertise : succès prouvé dans la stratégie de durabilité sociale (santé mentale, bien-être) et maîtrise étendue des cadres d'assurance sociale suisses (IV, UVG, KTG) et de la législation du travail.
• Compétences : maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais ; intelligence émotionnelle forte, discrétion et capacités de délimitation.
• Digital Mindset: Haute compétence avec le logiciel de gestion de cas, HRIS (Workday), et une ouverture à la mise à profit des outils d'IA pour améliorer les flux de travail consultatifs. Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 salariés

jobs.title: Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责
市场研究与分析

• 协助进行HCC治疗市场调研，收集和整理竞争对手信息

• 支持市场数据分析，制作市场现状报告

• 跟踪行业动态和医疗政策变化

医学沟通支持

• 协助整理医学信息和产品数据

• 参与学术会议的准备和后期总结工作

• 支持医学沟通材料（幻灯片、单页等）的制作

项目支持

• 协助组织产品培训、医学讲座等市场活动

• 整理和管理项目文档、数据和资料库

• 协助追踪市场活动的执行进展

• 协助医生咨询和信息反馈的汇总分析

• 参与市场活动现场的支持工作

其他协助性工作

• 完成主管交派的其他临时性工作任务

• 参与部门会议和项目讨论

任职资格
必须具备：

• 本科及以上学历（应届毕业生或在校学生均可）

• 医学、药学、生物学、市场营销或相关专业背景优先

• 良好的中文书面和口头沟通能力

• 熟练使用Microsoft Office（Word、Excel、PowerPoint）

• 学习能力强，工作主动认真，有团队合作精神

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Experte für Exportkontrolle & Zoll (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Einheit
Import/Export Compliance ist mit 30 Mitarbeitenden für die korrekte Abwicklung des gesamten Außenhandels aller Roche-Unternehmen an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg verantwortlich. Dies umfasst Zoll und Exportkontrolle einschließlich Zolltarifierung und Exportkontroll-Klassifizierung. Mannheim und Penzberg verfügen über verschiedenste Produktionseinheiten für Pharma- und Diagnostics-Produkte, die zu einem großen Teil aus Drittländern beliefert werden. Mannheim als globaler Hub der Diagnostics Division versorgt die weltweiten Roche Niederlassungen mit einer hohen Sendungsanzahl.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du bearbeitest sämtliche Abweichungen vom Standard-Exportprozess sowie unvollständige Ausfuhranmeldungen hinsichtlich zollspezifischen Fragestellungen wie beispielsweise Codierungen, Storno und Nachbearbeitung

• Zu den Aufgaben zählt das Monitoring von Ausgangsvermerken und das Bearbeiten der Nachforschungsnachricht vom Zoll

• Ebenso bist Du für die Beantwortung von Anfragen des Statistischen Bundesamts und aller relevanten Schnittstellen bezüglich zollspezifischen Fragestellungen zuständig

• Du prüfst Payments aus Embargoländern und gibst diese frei

• Als Experte für Zoll und Außenwirtschaft bist Du für alle Fragen rund um die Exportkontrolle und direkter Kontakt zu BAFA, BIS und OFAC verantwortlich

• Du bist bestens vertraut mit Allgemein- und Einzelgenehmigungen, übernimmst die Vorbereitung der Dokumentation zur Lizenzbeantragung und koordinierst den Informationsfluss zwischen den verschiedenen Partnern

• Du erfasst und pflegst erteilte Lizenzen im SAP-System GTS

• Desweiteren übernimmst Du die Export-Zollthemen bei GTS-Sperren und prüfst kritische Anträge hinsichtlich Materialeigenschaften, klassifizieren diese und klären die Lizenzausnahmen bzw. vorhandene Lizenzen ab

• Das Pflegen und Schulen der SOPs gehört ebenso zu deinen Aufgaben, wie das Reporting und Einholung von Nachweisen über die tatsächlich ausgeführten Mengen unter den Lizenzen gemäß den Lizenzkonditionen

Dein Profil

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium mit Schwerpunkt Außenwirtschafts- oder Zollrecht oder ähnlichen Studiengang

• Langjährige (mind. 5 Jahre) Erfahrung und Kenntnisse im Bereich Export-Kontrolle mit Kontakten zu BAFA, BIS und OFAC zeichnen dich aus

• Die Zollprozesse im Export sind Dir bestens bekannt

• Du überzeugst mit fundiertem Wissen im Bereich Außenwirtschaftsrecht, Exportkontrollrecht und Zollrecht und hast möglichst sehr gute Kenntnisse in SAP GTS Export

• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind selbstverständlich

CV only - einfach Lebenslauf hochladen und Bewerbung absenden.

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: (Sr( AI Engineering Consultant.
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
Serving as the Lead Architect of AI Transformation, this role is the visionary and technical engine behind redefining how the organization builds software. Much like a technical evangelist and researcher, you will bridge the gap between "Research AI" and "Applied AI Engineering." Your mission is to revolutionize the engineering lifecycle through AI, establish world-class methodologies for AI-native product development, and act as a high-impact coach to transition the entire engineering team into an AI-augmented powerhouse. You will ensure we don't just "use AI," but fundamentally change how we engineer for the future.

The Opportunity:

AI-Driven Engineering Transformation

• Methodology Research: Deeply research and define the next generation of software engineering workflows (e.g., Software 2.0, Agentic Workflows, AI-assisted coding architectures).

• Process Redesign: Diagnose existing engineering bottlenecks and deploy AI tools/frameworks to automate and optimize the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), achieving radical efficiency gains.

• Evolutionary Catalyst: Serve as a "Strategic Catalyst" to steer the engineering culture toward an AI-Native mindset.

Product Engineering & AI Integration

• AI Engineering Excellence: Design and oversee the implementation of robust, scalable AI engineering patterns (LLMOps, RAG architectures, and fine-tuning pipelines) to bring AI capabilities into the core product portfolio.

• Agile Prototyping: Rapidly translate the latest breakthroughs in AI research (from multi-modal models to reasoning-step optimizations) into production-ready features with an agile, hands-on approach.

• Technical Interpretation: Translate complex algorithmic logic and technical constraints into actionable business roadmaps and product strategies.

Capability Building & Knowledge Hub

• Master Educator: Design and lead high-level AI training programs for senior engineers and architects, focusing on Prompt Engineering, model evaluation, and AI-native architecture.

• AI Knowledge Hub: Build and iterate an enterprise-level repository of AI best practices, reusable code patterns, and internal benchmarks to ensure consistent technical excellence.

• Talent Coaching: Mentor engineering leads on how to leverage AI to scale their own teams’ output and creative capacity.

Who you are:

Education & Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

• A proven track record of open-source contributions or technical thought leadership in the AI space.

Experience

• 5+ years of senior engineering experience, with at least 3+ years specifically focused on deploying AI/ML systems at scale.

• Experience in Digital Transformation or leading large-scale engineering team transitions is highly preferred.

Professional Capabilities/Skills

• AI Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in LLMs, Generative AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and modern AI infrastructure (GPU orchestration, vector databases).

• Engineering Methodology: Strong opinions, weakly held, on software architecture, clean code in the age of AI, and "Human-in-the-loop" engineering systems.

• Business Acumen: The ability to match bleeding-edge AI capabilities with specific market pain points and IVD/Tech business scenarios.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional communication and "Change Management" capabilities—the ability to inspire a team to unlearn old habits an

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description:

Throughout our 125-year history, Roche has grown into one of the world’s largest biotech companies and a global supplier of transformative innovative solutions across major disease areas.
At Roche, we believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are confident in both decision and action, we believe that good business means a better world.

We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology .
In Roche Digital Technology, we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.

You will be responsible for the Consolidation and Management of the solutions intended for Identity Verification and External Collaborator Management, you will design, build, and deliver next-generation solutions that operate at a global scale You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.

Your team:
As a Specialist External Workforce Identity, you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.

Your key responsibilities:

• Contribute to the end to end integration of the External Collaborators Management and the Identity Verification security solutions, producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.

• Identify Verification: Partner with Product owners from P&C and act as a core member driving the ID Verification product offering, leading initiatives to upgrade secure access controls for modern enterprises

• External Collaborators Management: Partner with Business owners and act as point of contact to understand their requirements and translate them into technical requirements and implementation steps

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.

• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and coordinate the Security Components migration from the acquired company to Roche Standards.

• Design and maintain the mid-term strategy for enhancing our security components..

• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implementing changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management

• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve

• Occasional international travel is required

Required skills and experience:

• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.

• 5-7 years of experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry and in providing solutions aligned with standards, security, validation, capacity and high availability.

• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures

• Strong hands-on technical skills with an IT operations background. Knowledge on infrastructure

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility realization, including but not limited to FAT, SAT, IOPQ etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Participate in the implementation of warehouse operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, etc. according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified in the daily operation in the warehouse.
Routine Operation:
Technical & Operational
● Material Handling: Receive raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Verify
quantity and inspect for damage or discrepancies against purchase orders and shipping
documents. Also including dangerous and chemical goods
● Storage and Inventory: Safely store materials in designated warehouse locations. Perform accurate and timely stocktaking, including cycle counts and physical inventories, to ensure stock accuracy.
● Documentation: Maintain precise and complete records for all warehouse activities, including receiving records, material transfer forms, and inventory records. Ensure all documentation is accurate and legible.
● Picking and Packing: Accurately pick materials for production orders or shipments. Stage materials in designated areas, ensuring they are ready for use or transport. Prepare finished goods for shipment, including packing, labeling, and documentation.
● System Operations: Operate the Warehouse Management System (WMS) or other inventory management software to record all material movements and transactions.
● Equipment Operation: Safely operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment. Perform pre-operational checks and report any maintenance issues.
● Other tasks assigned by AM.
Compliance & Safety
● Adhere to all GMP and SOPs to ensure the quality and integrity of all materials and products.
● Follow all SHE rules and regulations, including wearing appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintaining a clean and orderly work area.
● Report any deviations, quality issues, or safety hazards immediately to the supervisor/manager.
● Participate in team meetings, safety training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications
● A college degree or above in logistics management, warehouse management, or related fields (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred)
● Qualification of dangerous and chemical goods handling
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
● 3 years of experience in a warehouse or logistics environment.
● Experience operating a forklift and other material handling equipment.
● Familiarity with WMS (e.g. SAP, MES) and Microsoft Excel (data entry and basic reports)
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry
● Good communication with team members and cross function colleagues.

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy Project
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
1. Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
Roche is hiring for an expanding operation in Shanghai and is seeking to expand its site leadership team, with growing Drug Product operations. We are looking for people who have significant experience in Sterile Drug Product operations, in a leadership position, who can bring investments through qualification and into steady state operations.
Roche is advancing a transformative, strategic expansion of its Drug Product operations in Shanghai, establishing a new, state-of-the-art manufacturing site integral to its global supply network. To drive this critical initiative, we seek a Head of Strategy Projects for both New DP site and the existing Small molecule site
As the Head of Strategy Projects , you will play a pivotal role within the Business Support organization. You are the architect of our risk management and strategic roadmap. You will bridge the gap between high-level vision and operational execution, ensuring our resources are funneled into the priority projects.
You need to work closely with OE and Digital team to deliver strategy and performance by collaboration in below main areas:

• Portfolio Integration: Translates PT China Ops strategy into a prioritized roadmap of actionable projects. Collaborates with OE & Digital to ensure performance improvement initiatives are integrated into the site portfolio with the correct resource allocation.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
職務内容（Responsibilities）
人事データ管理・システム運用

• 給与、税金、社会保険、勤怠、国内外の福利厚生等に関する、人事業務（P&C）プロセスを支えるシステムデータのメンテナンスおよび管理。

• Workdayと外部ベンダー間のデータ連携（インテグレーション）を監視・エラー解消し、正確かつタイムリーな処理を担保。

• 各給与サイクルにおける、一括アップロード（マスアップロード）ファイルの作成・処理・照合。

• カスタマーサービス・社内対応

• 支給、勤怠、福利厚生に関する従業員からの問い合わせ対応、リクエスト管理、トラブルシューティング。

• 国内の勤怠・休暇ポリシーに基づき、従業員の入力内容の正確性を確認するための、各マネージャーやリーダーとの連絡・調整。

• 一次対応を行うP&Cサポートチームへの指導やアドバイスの提供。

• 業務改善・ナレッジ管理

• 最新の業務プロセスを常に把握し、関連文書（ナレッジアーティクル：KA、標準作業手順書：SWI）の更新・ナレッジ共有を主導。

• サービス向上や継続的な業務改善（プロセスの最適化）に向けた施策の提案・実行。

• 必要に応じた各種プロジェクト活動への参加。

• コンプライアンス・成果管理

• 担当国（日本）の法律、顧客要件、社内規制に沿った法令遵守（コンプライアンス）の徹底。

• 定義されたKPIおよびServiceNowのOKRに基づいた、確実なオペレーションの遂行。

• 問題発生時における、最初から最後まで責任を持った対応（エンド・ツー・エンドの当事者意識）の徹底。

• ビジネスニーズに応じた、国内のその他人事務務（給与・勤怠・福利厚生以外）のサポート。

部門間コラボレーション（Cross-Functional Collaboration）
質の高いサービスを継続的に提供するため、国内外の人事メンバーや社内顧客と強固な信頼関係を構築します。地域（リージョン）およびグローバルの同僚と密に連携し、「People Support Solutions」ネットワーク全体で一貫性のある効果的なサービスを提供。コラボレーションを通じて地域間の標準化（一貫性）を推進し、人事部門のビジョン達成に貢献します。
成果物（Outputs & Deliverables）

• People Support Solutions全体のパフォーマンス向上への継続的な貢献。

• 一貫した高品質なサービスと、ホスピタリティ（カスタマーケア）精神の実践による、高い社内顧客満足度の達成（ステークホルダーからのフィードバックにより測定）。

求める人物像（Who you are）
このポジションでは、特定の地域（日本など）の従業員グループを担当するチームに所属し、組織内のさまざまな部門や役職のメンバーと協力しながら業務を遂行します。
求める経験・スキル（Experience）

• 実務経験： 給与計算事務および福利厚生管理における1〜3年の実務経験（シェアードサービスセンター（SSC）やBPO環境での経験をお持ちの方歓迎）。

• 専門知識： 給与計算のサイクルおよびプロセスに関する知識。日本の勤怠・休暇関連の法令や実務知識。

• PCスキル： 高度なExcelスキル（ピボットテーブル、VLOOKUP関数など）。

• 適性・能力：

• 細部への優れた注意力（正確性）とデータ分析能力。

• マトリクス組織（多角的な報告ラインを持つ組織）において成果を出した実績。

• スピード感があり、変化の激しい環境で主体的に動き、複数の優先タスクを効率的に処理できる能力。

• 変化が多く、先の見通しが立ちにくい（アンビギュアスな）多文化・グローバル環境で活躍できる能力。

• 語学力： ビジネスレベルの英語コミュニケーションスキル（読み書き・会話）。

• 歓迎条件： 人事ジェネラリスト（人事全般）としての実務ノウハウ・経験。

求めるコア能力（Core capabilities）

• 顧客中心の思考（カスタマー・セントリシティ）： 日々の業務を通じて相手のニーズを先回りし、文化的背景への配慮や適切な対応ができること。

• 当事者意識（アカウンタビリティ）： 部分最適ではなく「全体への影響」を視野に入れ、確実な成果を出すために周囲のメンバーを巻き込めること。

• 問題解決能力： 周囲の声に耳を傾け、批判的思考（クリティカルシンキング）を用いて業務プロセスの改善につなげられること。

• 成長マインドセット（グロースマインドセット）： 現状維持にとどまらず、新しい学習機会を模索し、フィードバックを素直に受け入れ、自らも周囲に与えられること。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 契約社員
（期間の定めのある雇用：契約期間 2年、 契約更新の可能性はあるが、業務の必要性がある場合に限り、勤務状況、業務遂行能力、健康状態、および当社の経営状況等により判断する。また、通算契約期間は5年を上限とする）
試用期間: なし

業務内容
（雇い入れ直後）：Payroll & Benefits Specialist
（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動なし

就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり
※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：350,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　＜補足＞賞与：年1回
　　 諸手当：通勤手当、時間外勤務手当　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生
社会保険：健康

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione
• Payroll, Tempo, Vantaggi Specialist
• Riepilogo della posizione Il team Payroll, Time & Benefits si concentra sul payroll, sui benefici, sulla gestione delle assenze, sul servizio clienti e sul supporto consultivo a dipendenti, manager e partner commerciali che garantiscono il completamento del processo end-to-end in linea con i principi focalizzati sul cliente per garantire che le Roche People Practices lavorino per il business. In qualità di Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, l'utente è responsabile dell'esecuzione delle attività di manutenzione e di gestione dei dati del sistema HR in modo tempestivo e accurato, a supporto dei processi aziendali P&C nell'area del payroll, dell'imposta, dell'assicurazione sociale, del tempo e di diversi benefici locali e globali. ecc. Contribuisci anche al miglioramento continuo della consegna di P&C People Support Solutions attraverso l'analisi delle interazioni e la collaborazione con altre funzioni P&C all'interno e all'esterno di P&C People Support Solutions. Hai bisogno di una vasta comprensione tra processi e strumenti HR locali, così come gli impatti a valle locali e globali sulla gestione del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, finanza, approvvigionamento, IT, ecc. Questo è accoppiato con forte focus del cliente, capacità di comunicazione e orientamento della soluzione. responsabilità ● Consegna del servizio ○ Esegui le attività di manutenzione e di gestione dei dati del sistema a sostegno dei processi aziendali P&C nell'area di payroll, fiscale, assicurazione sociale, tempo, diverse amministrazioni locali e globali delle prestazioni, ecc (dettagli si riferiscono al catalogo dei servizi del paese)
• ○ Fornire il servizio clienti sulle attività relative a pagamento, tempo e benefici, come la risoluzione delle richieste, la gestione delle richieste e la risoluzione dei problemi.
• ○ Comprendere e avere conoscenze lavorative sulle politiche locali di tempo/assenza. ○ Corrispondenza con i manager e i leader per confermare l'accuratezza dell'ingresso di tempo/assenza dei dipendenti.
• ○ Gestire, elaborare e conciliare i file di caricamento di massa per tutte le frequenze di pagamento. Monitorare i flussi di dati da/per Workday a Vendor per accuratezza
• ○ Assicurarsi che le integrazioni siano elaborate tempestivamente e risolvono eventuali errori che garantiscono un trattamento accurato
• ○ Assicurare la conformità normativa in linea con i paesi, i clienti e le normative.
• ○ Sviluppare e gestire le relazioni e le comunicazioni chiave degli stakeholder per collaborare in modo mirato ai risultati proattivi e dei clienti.
• ○ Supporta i capitoli P&C nelle attività di manutenzione del sistema.
• ○ Fornire assistenza e consulenza ai team di supporto P&C di primo livello.
• ○ Essere aggiornati sui processi, possedere lo sviluppo della conoscenza sui processi e contribuire all'aggiornamento delle documentazioni rilevanti (KA, SWIs).
• ○ Partecipare alle attività di progetto come richiesto
• ○ Assicurare la fornitura di servizi coerente e affidabile per i clienti serviti.
• processi di implementazione e iniziative per garantire un miglioramento continuo e un miglioramento del servizio.
• ○ Assicurare la cessazione della proprietà della risoluzione
• ○ Assicurare le operazioni secondo KPI e ServiceNow OKRs definiti. ○ Paese di supporto attività non-PTB sulle esigenze aziendali, se applicabile. ● Collaborazione trasversale
• Costruire relazioni con i colleghi P&C e con i clienti per garantire l'efficacia della consegna dei servizi in corso.
• ○ Collaborare con i coetanei all'interno della regione e a livello globale per garantire che la rete People Support Solutions fornisca servizi coerenti ed efficaci ai nostri clienti.
• ○ Ottieni la nostra visione P&C guidando la consistenza locale attraverso la collaborazione. ● uscite e consegne
• ○ Contributo continuo al miglioramento delle prestazioni delle Soluzioni di Supporto Persone
• ○ Raggiungere alta soddisfazione del cliente attraverso una consegna costante e di alta qualità e l'applicazione del principl di assistenza clienti

As Tender and Supply Chain Business Partner , you will partner closely with local, regional, and global teams as well as external distributors and public stakeholders to co-create seamless supply chain strategies and maximize our private and public tender success. You are the ultimate bridge connecting our commercial ambition with operational excellence.

Your responsibilities

• Demand Planning: Partner closely with internal stakeholders and distributors to review, phase, and discuss demand forecasts to ensure target alignment.

• Logistics & Shipments: Manage planned forecasts with precise delivery phasing; communicate schedule updates transparently to HQ Supply Chain.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Tender & Supply Chain Business Partner, Iraq

Oggetto
Stiamo cercando un agile, strategico Tender & Supply Chain Business Partner per agire come un co-pilota affidabile per il nostro mercato Iraq. In questo ruolo, si andrà oltre la gestione logistica tradizionale.
In qualità di partner commerciale Tender e Supply Chain, partnerrai a stretto contatto con i team locali, regionali e globali, nonché con i distributori esterni e gli stakeholder pubblici per creare strategie di supply chain senza soluzione di continuità e massimizzare il nostro successo privato e pubblico. Sei l'ultimo ponte che collega la nostra ambizione commerciale con l'eccellenza operativa.

Le tue responsabilità

1- Supply Chain & ottimizzazione dell'inventario

• Pianificazione della domanda: Partner a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni e i distributori per rivedere, analizzare le previsioni della domanda per garantire l'allineamento degli obiettivi.

• Logistica & Spedizioni: Gestisci le previsioni pianificate con una precisa fase di consegna; comunica gli aggiornamenti dei programmi in modo trasparente alla catena di fornitura HQ.

• Gestione delle scorte: supervisionare efficacemente la salute dell'inventario, tra cui l'autorizzazione di aggiustamenti delle scorte, il monitoraggio delle date di scadenza e il monitoraggio CDI (Giorni dell'inventario).

• Gestione degli ordini: Gestisci ordini di acquisto locali (LPO) da agenti locali in stretto coordinamento con Global HQ.

• Magazzino Prontezza Allineamento: Rimanere strettamente allineati con i team di qualità globali per monitorare la disponibilità dei magazzini di distribuzione.

2- Gestione del Tender end-to-End

• Supervisione completa del ciclo di vita: guidare il follow-up continuo sulle offerte pubbliche da annunci iniziali fino a contrarre firme, phasing di consegna e l'esecuzione finale.

• Allineamento degli Stakeholder: Assicurare tutte le approvazioni interne richieste prima della presentazione delle offerte.

• KIMADIA Liaison: gestire tutte le comunicazioni relative a quote di gara, premi finali e modifiche contrattuali necessarie. Assicurarsi che i rapporti di scarico siano rapidamente protetti da KIMADIA.

3. Convalida finanziaria & Eccellenza commerciale

• Stewardship finanziaria: agire come custode attivo del flusso di merci e del flusso di denaro. Partner con il Dipartimento delle Finanze per monitorare le consegne, garantire pagamenti di fattura, validare sanzioni, ecc...

• Data & Analytics: Stabilire un modo sistematico per analizzare le sfide / le opportunità logistiche attraverso i framework basati sui dati, permettendoci di identificare gli spazi bianchi strutturali e fornire report approfonditi e periodici ai principali stakeholder.

4. Partenariato e integrazione transfrontaliera

• Collaborazione Stakeholder: Partner proattivamente con tutti i principali stakeholder interni, tra cui Regolazione, Qualità, Finanza, Pricing, Compliance, ecc. per allineare le strategie di approvvigionamento, risolvere i colli di bottiglia logistici e garantire la disponibilità del mercato senza soluzione di continuità.

5. Compliance, Governance & Role Ambassadorship

• Ambasciatore Rappresentanza: costruire una reputazione stellare per il tuo ruolo monitorando le prestazioni e assicurando ai partner interni/esterni di vedere il dipartimento come un alleato strategico di fiducia.

• Corporate Governance: rispettare rigorosamente i principi aziendali, le politiche locali e globali e i requisiti di salute e sicurezza in ogni momento.

You are the ultimate bridge connecting our commercial ambition with operational excellence.

Your responsibilities

1- Supply Chain & Inventory Optimization

• Demand Planning: Partner closely with internal stakeholders and distributors to review, phase, and discuss demand forecasts to ensure target alignment.

2- End-to-End Tender Management

• KIMADIA Liaison: Manage all communications regarding tender quotations, final awards, and necessary contract amendments. Ensure unloading reports are promptly secured from KIMADIA.

3. Financial Validation & Commercial Excellence

• Financial Stewardship: Act as an active guardian of both the flow of goods and the flow of money. Partner with the Finance Department to track deliveries, secure invoice payments, validate penalties, etc...

• Data & Analytics: Establish a systematic way to analyze logistical challenges / opportunities through data-driven frameworks, allowing us to identify structural white spaces and deliver insightful, periodic reports to key stakeholders.

4. Cross-Functional Partnership & Integration & Compliance

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner proactively with all relevant internal stakeholders—including Regulatory, Quality, Finance, Pricing, Compliance, etc. to align on supply strategies, resolve logistical bottlenecks, and ensure seamless market readiness.

5. Compliance, Governance & Role Ambassadorship

Die Position
Tender & Supply Chain Business Partner, Irak

Zweck
Wir suchen einen agilen, strategischen Tender & Supply Chain Business Partner, der als vertrauenswürdiger Co-Pilot für unseren Irak-Markt fungiert. In dieser Rolle gehen Sie über das traditionelle Logistikmanagement hinaus.

Ihre Verantwortung

1- Supply Chain & Inventory Optimierung

• Bedarfsplanung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern und Distributoren, um Nachfrageprognosen zu überprüfen, zu phasen und zu diskutieren, um die Zielausrichtung sicherzustellen.

2- End-to-End Tender Management

• KIMADIA Liaison: Verwalten Sie alle Mitteilungen bezüglich Angeboten, endgültigen Auszeichnungen und notwendigen Vertragsänderungen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Entladeberichte umgehend von KIMADIA gesichert werden.

3. Finanzvalidierung und kommerzielle Exzellenz

• Finanzverwaltung: Handeln Sie als aktiver Hüter sowohl des Warenflusses als auch des Geldflusses. Partnerschaft mit der Finanzabteilung, um Lieferungen zu verfolgen, Rechnungszahlungen zu sichern, Strafen zu validieren usw.

• Corporate Governance: Halten Sie sich jederzeit strikt an Unternehmensgrundsätze, lokale und globale Richtlinien sowie Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsanforderungen.

• Sie verfügen über eine nachgewiesene Erfahrung im pharmazeutischen Supply Chain Management, mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz im Umgang mit komplexen
