jobs.title: Associate Manager - Scheduler
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Support manager to design and implement planning workflows, including MRP, production scheduling, and capacity planning, aligned with SAP, MPS systems

• Collaborate with IT and project teams to ensure seamless integration and alignment of SAP, and MPS systems with production and supply chain workflows

• Perform the creation, validation, and maintenance of master data to enable efficient planning in SAP and MPS systems.

• Work closely with key stakeholders, including production, quality, and engineering, to establish robust planning practices that support qualification and start-up milestones.

• Assist manager to set up a team and people hiring schedule to build a competitive team that meets the project and operation ramp up plan.

Routine Operation:

• Optimize site capacity and resource planning during budget cycles based on various factors including sales demand, working days impacted by projects, period costs, inventory strategy, etc.

• Settle down the Master Production Schedule (MPS) on a monthly basis, influence key local/global stakeholders to maintain production constancy and stability in terms of site benefits, period costs, capacity utilization, etc.

• Single point of contact with global PTS teams for DS/DP/SEMP supply of local products and related LCC initiation, implementation, follow up and coordination.

• Work out Material Requirement Plan (MRP) based on master production plan. Communicate changes of MRP with production planner and other impacted cross functional teams.

• Trace the whole process of material purchasing, delivering, testing and releasing. Ensure the inventory of packaging materials and excipients can fully support site production requirements with safety stock prepared per agreement.

• Responsible for Safety Stock strategy per business requirement and agreement with procurement to mitigate supply shortage risk.

• Host weekly Production Planning meeting, lead cross functional teams to integrate all necessary site activities and projects.

• Draft out Weekly/Daily Production Schedule based on Master Production Schedule and revise according to realistic production circumstances, make sure FG supplies are consistently produced and released timely to meet business requirements.

• Run shift model simulations for production team analysis and decision making as a reliable consultant. Consolidate data & info to re-assess site capacity planning and propose shift model adjustments whenever necessary based on business needs.

Qualification and Experience
E ducation/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Supply Chain Management, Biotechnology, Manufacturing field and above.

Job Required Competencies

• 10 or more years of experience in operation experience in the GMP production environments, with proven expertise in production planning, supply chain planning, MNC preferred.

• Experienced in new planning system startup readiness and ramp up.

• Strong knowledge of MRP concepts, production scheduling methodologies, and capacity planning strategies.

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and execution skills, with the ability to effectively drive project progress and solve complex issues.

• Able to think strategically and translate strategies into actionable plans

• Fluent communication skills in English to collaborate with team members and stakeholders

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we rewa

jobs.title: Filling Associate Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

• ﻿﻿Build and retain an inclusive workforce and foster an environment where diversity of thought and perspective are valued.

• Maintain an inclusive team that values diversity of thought.

• Maintain strong partnerships with leaders to ensure alignment on strategic projects and daily operations.

• ﻿﻿Take the responsibility for department daily SHE management, implement site SHE procedure and program, and achieve site corporate /site SHE KPI. Promote SHE culture and improve employee safety behavior.

• ﻿﻿Manage performance and development team members to achieve organizational goals and employee personal and professional growth.

• Support manager to build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿Maintain a culture of continuous improvement and model lean leadership principles.

• Maintain a culture of transparent, high performance, empowerment and innovation culture.

Technical

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, equipment selection, URS review, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• As a key role, support to establish an effective operation system in alignment with the Roche’s standards, including manufacturing system, CCS strategy, people training and qualification system.

• Lead to establish the procedures related to aseptic techniques, good aseptic practices on the shop floor, and other relevant processes for aseptic production execution.

• Participate in CCS strategy implementation in operation to ensure a sustaining sterility assurance program setting up.

• Support the filling manager to establish the site aseptic training program and implement it, ensure only qualified people perform GMP lots’ manufacturing.

• Ensure team's competencies in performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, depyrogenating, filling and stoppering, crimping.

• Participate in tech transfer, collaboration with other functions to ensure the success of new product manufacturing.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation compliance with regulations, maintain sterile conditions, and achieve high-quality production standards .

• Ensure total readiness of manufacturing suites, including housekeeping, machine, materials, documents and other resources to ensure product delivery in time and within budget.

• Arrange the filling shifts in routine production, participate in operation as an aseptic SME and perform daily review of production batch record, deviation according to schedule.

• Lead annual aseptic operators’ qualification, provide on-the-job training to support formalized technical and GMP training.

• Oversee the daily operation, monitoring, and maintenance of filling equipment to ensure compliance with aseptic requirements .

• Supervise aseptic operations during production and intervene promptly in case of abnormalities .

• Participate in the response of regulator audit and global quality audit as SME during regulatory inspections and audits.

• Raise deviation and involve the root cause investigation, including appropriate escalation where needed to ensure closure of deviation within the set timeline.

• Raise change control and provide assessment.

• Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Your opportunity
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）

• Understand and implement both strategic and tactical plan to realize market opportunities

• Maintain good engagement with KOLs, and target regional key customers

• Participate in brand strategy and action plan development and communication with the brand team and cross-functional team

• Drive execution excellence in innovative disease management campaigns

• Develop Speaker management system and maintain operation excellence on speaker management

• Seamlessly collaborate within the marketing team, advocate continuous improvement and best practice sharing

• Provide support to department projects and take initiative in creative ideas of execution excellence

• Communicate and collaborate effectively with other brand relevant departments

Who you are
Qualification and Experience 能力与经验

Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书

• Bachelor above

• Medical, marketing, commerce preferred

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• MNC background

• Minimum 3-5 years’ experience of Marketing/Sales

• 2-3 years Pharmaceutical or relevant Marketing experience preferred

• Good communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English (oral and writing)

• Strong Project Management capabilities, self-motivated and results-driven

• Strong execution capability, strong cross-functional communication

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We believe that meaningful impact starts with how we connect—with patients, healthcare professionals, and each other. If you are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving business growth in the healthcare space, this opportunity could be for you.

The Opportunity
As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for managing sales performance, developing strategic customer relationships, and promoting Roche Diagnostics’ product portfolio within your assigned territory. You will play a key role in driving sustainable business growth while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and alignment with Roche’s global standards.

In this role, you will:

• Achieve or exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory and account planning

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers to establish long-term partnerships

• Identify and develop new business opportunities across Roche Diagnostics products and services

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to execute commercial activities effectively

• Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and provide insights to support business strategy. Deliver timely and accurate reporting

• Ensure proper management of operational processes including contract documentation and supply coordination

• Contribute to a collaborative team environment with a strong focus on customer satisfaction

Who you are
You are driven, resilient, and able to navigate a dynamic, customer-facing environment. You take ownership of your territory, are proactive in identifying opportunities, and are committed to delivering results.

You bring:

• Bachelor’s degree in any field; Life Sciences background is an advantage, with a minimum of 3 years of sales experience in Diagnostics, Medical Devices, or Pharmaceutical industry

• Understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, including hospital or institutional structures

• Ability to work independently and deliver results with minimal supervision

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders effectively

• Proficiency in English (written and spoken) and basic digital literacy

• Demonstrated learning agility and willingness to adapt to new products and business areas

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are currently seeking a Finance Enterprise Partner to join our team at Roche Diagnostics Austria.

As an FEP (Finance Enterprise Partner) you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our commercial strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organisation to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As an FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey.

Main Responsibilities

• Strategic Partnership: Serve as a key business partner, co-leading customer journey touchpoints with an enterprise-wide mindset.

• Financial Advisory: Balance resource allocation across competing priorities and advise on the financial impact of business initiatives.

• Commercial Strategy: Collaborate on developing affiliate strategies, business planning, and creative revenue-generation models.

• Knowledge Sharing: Engage with FEP communities to adopt and implement global best practices locally.

• P&L Optimization: Drive profitability by identifying upsell opportunities, reducing risks, and improving operational efficiency.

• Executive Communication: Translate complex financial data into compelling "storyboard" presentations for executive decision-making.

• Culture & Collaboration: Lead and facilitate cross-functional workshops and events to strengthen team engagement.

• Process Innovation: Apply end-to-end thinking to radically simplify workflows, from deal calculation to contract monitoring.

Competencies

• Commercial and customer centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.

• Understanding of Corporate Finance, Financial Modelling, Insights Collection & Trend Prognosis.

• Understanding of data modeling to guide decision-making, solve problems, provide analytical insight and business judgment to support strategic and tactical initiatives across the affiliate.

• Strategic thinking and ability to translate business goals into financial plans.

• High level of social competence and ability to accurately record and efficiently communicate in English. (German is a plus but not a must)

• You have 2-5 years of experience in finance (ideally in a sales-focused or commercial role) and are familiar with SAP or equivalent ERP systems

We offer a gross salary starting at € 56.000 per year and attractive benefits. Flexible working hours, workplace health promotion and various sports programs, just to name a few. Depending on your qualifications and experience, overpayment is possible.

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Incident Response Operations)

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Analyst, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities,

Business Intelligence (BI) Lead
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad or Chennai

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai to drive analytics & technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

The Opportunity

As a Business Intelligence (BI) Lead, you will drive the end to end delivery of Business Intelligence solutions while serving as the go-to person in conversations with our partners. This is a true leadership role. The ideal candidate brings the right blend of technical depth and business understanding to navigate conversations around feasibility, data challenges, tool selection, and delivery timelines with confidence, keeping discussions productive and moving forward. Beyond responding to what is asked, you will be a thought partner to our stakeholders, proactively suggesting better approaches to visualizing data, identifying more meaningful KPIs, and recommending data sources or methods that stakeholders may not have considered.

All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

As a Business Intelligence (BI) Lead, you will:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for business leaders to gather requirements, manage expectations, and provide transparent project timelines across multiple workstreams

• Assess and recommend the right BI approach for a given problem, considering data availability, platform capabilities, and business context, and communicate trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences

• Drive the design and delivery of enterprise-grade BI applications (Tableau), ensuring scalability, performance, security and data governance

• Lead data discovery sessions to identify new data sources and ensure the underlying data warehouse architecture supports long-term BI reporting needs

• Guide the translation of business requirements into analytics prototypes that provide meaningful business and data insights

• Oversee data and BI analysis efforts, including review of source systems, KPI definitions and aggregations, ensuring quality and consistency

• Review and guide the development of Tableau applications, ensuring reporting components from multiple data sources are integrated effectively

• Create and understand Figma-based prototypes to understand the "user journey" of data. Translate these designs into functional KPIs for BI developers

• Provide oversight of the end to end BI ecosystem (Desktop, Server, and Cloud), ensuring best practices in dashboard performance, security and scalability

• Mentor and guide team members, fostering a collaborative environment and contributing to overall team growth

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering or other technical disciplines) and 7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, with a progressive shift from hands-on development to leading delivery and stakeholder engagement

• Strong foundation in Tableau development, dashboarding, data modeling and reporting techniques, with the ability to guide a

È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Per far progredire continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni future. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. È questo che ci rende Roche. Roche ha istituito il Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) a Chennai per guidare soluzioni di analytics e tecnologiche, collaborando con affiliate Roche in tutto il mondo. L'opportunità Come Business Intelligence (BI) Lead, guiderai la consegna end-to-end delle soluzioni di Business Intelligence fungendo da persona di riferimento nelle conversazioni con i nostri partner. Questo è un vero ruolo di leadership. Il candidato ideale porta la giusta combinazione di profondità tecnica e comprensione aziendale per affrontare con sicurezza le conversazioni su fattibilità, sfide dati, scelta degli strumenti e tempistiche di consegna, mantenendo le discussioni produttive e in movimento. Oltre a rispondere a ciò che viene chiesto, sarai un partner di pensiero per i nostri stakeholder, suggerendo proattivamente approcci migliori per visualizzare i dati, identificare KPI più significativi e raccomandare fonti di dati o metodi che gli stakeholder potrebbero non aver considerato. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Business Intelligence (BI) Lead
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad or Chennai

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai to drive analytics & technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

The Opportunity

As a Business Intelligence (BI) Lead, you will drive the end to end delivery of Business Intelligence solutions while serving as the go-to person in conversations with our partners. This is a true leadership role. The ideal candidate brings the right blend of technical depth and business understanding to navigate conversations around feasibility, data challenges, tool selection, and delivery timelines with confidence, keeping discussions productive and moving forward. Beyond responding to what is asked, you will be a thought partner to our stakeholders, proactively suggesting better approaches to visualizing data, identifying more meaningful KPIs, and recommending data sources or methods that stakeholders may not have considered.

All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

As a Business Intelligence (BI) Lead, you will:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for business leaders to gather requirements, manage expectations, and provide transparent project timelines across multiple workstreams

• Assess and recommend the right BI approach for a given problem, considering data availability, platform capabilities, and business context, and communicate trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences

• Drive the design and delivery of enterprise-grade BI applications (Tableau), ensuring scalability, performance, security and data governance

• Lead data discovery sessions to identify new data sources and ensure the underlying data warehouse architecture supports long-term BI reporting needs

• Guide the translation of business requirements into analytics prototypes that provide meaningful business and data insights

• Oversee data and BI analysis efforts, including review of source systems, KPI definitions and aggregations, ensuring quality and consistency

• Review and guide the development of Tableau applications, ensuring reporting components from multiple data sources are integrated effectively

• Create and understand Figma-based prototypes to understand the "user journey" of data. Translate these designs into functional KPIs for BI developers

• Provide oversight of the end to end BI ecosystem (Desktop, Server, and Cloud), ensuring best practices in dashboard performance, security and scalability

• Mentor and guide team members, fostering a collaborative environment and contributing to overall team growth

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering or other technical disciplines) and 7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, with a progressive shift from hands-on development to leading delivery and stakeholder engagement

• Strong foundation in Tableau development, dashboarding, data modeling and reporting techniques, with the ability to guide a

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.

• Guider la traduction des exigences opérationnelles en prototypes d'analyse qui fournissent des informations utiles sur les activités et les données

• Superviser les activités d'analyse des données et des BI, y compris l'examen des systèmes sources, des définitions et des regroupements de l'ICP, en veillant à la qualité et à la cohérence

• Examiner et orienter l'élaboration des applications Tableau, en veillant à ce que les éléments de déclaration provenant de plusieurs sources de données soient intégrés efficacement;

• Créer et comprendre des prototypes basés sur Figma pour comprendre le « parcours utilisateur » des données. Traduire ces conceptions en KPI fonctionnels pour les développeurs BI

• Assurer la supervision de l'écosystème BI de bout en bout (Desktop, Server et Cloud), en assurant les meilleures pratiques en matière de performance, de sécurité et d'évolutivité du tableau de bord

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent (informatique, génie ou autres disciplines techniques) et d'une expérience de plus de 7 ans en intelligence des affaires, avec un passage progressif du développement pratique à la prestation de services et l'engagement des parties prenantes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This intermediate IT Infrastructure Engineer independently solves a range of technical business problems and contributes to challenging projects requiring deep knowledge in their area. You will design, build, test, and implement resilient solutions, evaluate new technologies, and contribute to technical documentation and standards. Strong problem-solving and communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and consulting internal or external stakeholders.

At Roche, we aren't just managing IPs; we’re building the automated backbone of our company. We’re looking for a tech-curious graduate to join us as a DDI Automation Engineer. You won't just be watching from the sidelines, you’ll be diving into BlueCat Network solutions, writing code to automate workflows, and learning how to manage massive-scale infrastructure. If you love solving puzzles and hate doing the same task twice, you’ll fit right in.

Job Responsibilities

• As an DDI Automation Engineer, your daily contributions will balance operational excellence with long-term engineering projects:

• Automation Engineering: Transition manual workflows into scalable "Infrastructure as Code" (IaC) models using modern scripting and automation frameworks.

• Technical Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose and resolve complex network incidents, performing root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

• Lifecycle Management: Support the full deployment lifecycle of BlueCat solutions, including the installation, configuration, and strategic upgrading of network components.

• Infrastructure Optimization: Monitor and refine core DDI services to ensure 100% uptime and optimal network performance.

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Skilled in solving a wide range of business problems with technology in creative and effective ways. Independently applies a complete understanding of theories and concepts from one’s technical discipline to address difficult problems. Contributes to delivery in challenging projects and designs, builds, tests, and implements (first-time deployments) integrated, resilient, and reliable solutions.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques to solve a variety of problems of larger scope and complexity. Evaluates promising technologies across two or more areas via proofs of concept (PoCs) to assess feasibility for business needs. Stays aware of operational challenges, works with product teams to provide internal escalation support for resolving incidents, and produces/maintains documentation for end-to-end designs and component standards. Responsible for the completion of milestones associated with specific projects.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates and presents complex information, issues, and potential solutions on assigned projects and to cross-functional teams. Networks with senior internal and external personnel within their area of expertise. Represents the organization on assigned projects and serves as a consultant to internal/external stakeholders on technical matters.

• Impact/Strategy: Plays a lead role responsible for key deliverables on projects and influences the decisions and direction of the project. May lead small project teams and mentor/lead individuals in the workgroup. Ensures that solutions and components comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and that technology designs adhere to the organization’s architectural strategy, policies, and dire

jobs.title: Global Product Planner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Über diese Position
Die Global Product Planner als Teil der Dia Supply Chain verantwortet die globale Produktverfügbarkeit über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg. Sie steuern aktiv Bestandsstrategien, erstellen Lieferpläne in Abstimmung mit Produktion und Lieferanten und agieren als zentrale Schnittstelle in S&OP-Prozessen, um eine lückenlose Versorgung sicherzustellen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du bist verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung der globalen Produktverfügbarkeit für ein bestimmtes Produktportfolio, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf die Verfügbarkeit an allen regionalen und zentralen Lagerstandorten. Hier eine detaillierte Aufstellung der Aufgaben:

• Die Erstellung und Genauigkeit der Lieferplanung auf der Grundlage der globalen Nachfrage, abgestimmt auf die Kapazitäten der Hersteller/Lieferanten liegt in Deinem Verantwortungsgebiet

• In Zusammenarbeit mit den funktionalen Leitern und dem Lifecycle-Teams stellst Du die Produktverfügbarkeit während der Phase der Markteinführung und der Auslaufphase von Produkten sicher

• Die Festlegung globaler Sicherheitsstandards für das definierte Produktportfolio gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstellung zuverlässiger Handlungsempfehlungen für Hersteller/Lieferanten zum Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP) und Master Production Schedule (MPS)

• Du leitest im Bedarfsfall den Eskalationsprozessen in Bezug auf die globale Produktverfügbarkeit ein

• Die Genauigkeit und kontinuierliche Anpassung der Stammdaten (MRP) verantwortet Du ebenso, wie die globale Produktallokationen in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Supply-Chain-Funktionen, regionalen Funktionen, Lifecycle-Teams und Herstellern/Lieferanten

• Außerdem nimmst Du an globalen Initiativen innerhalb der Dia-Supply Chain teil und fungiert ggf. als Fachexperte (SME) für einen bestimmten Produktplanungsprozess

Dein Profil

• Du hast ein erfolgreich absolviertes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft mit der Fachrichtung Supply Chain

• Außerdem mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Logistik mit internationalem Fokus

• Du kennst die logistischen Prozesse und hast Erfahrung in der Planung (Produktion oder Logistik)

• Mit großer Eigeninitiative und Begeisterung treibst Du die Themen in Deinem Verantwortungsbereich voran

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in logistischen Konzepten und Prozessen sowie MS Office sind Voraussetzung

• Auch sind fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher) erforderlich

Die Stelle ist bis 31.12.2028 befristet.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit aussagekräftigem Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen.

Compensation & Benefits

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Technical CIAM Tester - RDT Identity & Access Management

titleByLocale.it: Tester tecnico CIAM - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.en: Technical CIAM Tester - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.de: Technical CIAM Tester - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.fr: Technical CIAM Tester - RDT Identity & Access Management

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Tester with experience in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) to support the quality assurance and continuous improvement of customer identity services.
The successful candidate will be responsible for validating secure, scalable, and seamless CIAM solutions across customer registration, authentication, consent, profile management, integrations, and access journeys. This role combines technical testing, defect analysis, stakeholder collaboration, compliance awareness, and delivery support within a complex enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities
Test Planning and Execution

• Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, and test data.

• Execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing for CIAM services and connected applications.

• Validate customer journeys such as registration, login, password reset, profile updates, consent capture, MFA, and account recovery.

• Support release readiness through structured planning, execution, and reporting of test activities.

Technical and Integration Testing

• Validate APIs, webhooks, SSO flows, federation integrations, and downstream system interactions.

• Test identity protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.

• Verify data flows, profile synchronization, consent records, and access behavior across integrated systems.

• Support testing of CIAM platform changes in SAP Customer Data Cloud (SAP CDC) and connected enterprise environments.

• Support non-functional testing activities such as reliability, resilience, and performance coordination where required.

Defect Management and Quality Assurance

• Identify, document, reproduce, and track defects with clear evidence and technical detail.

• Work closely with engineers, analysts, and product teams to prioritize and resolve issues efficiently.

• Perform retesting and regression validation following defect remediation.

• Promote quality standards, traceability, and risk-based testing practices.

Governance, Compliance, and Service Processes

• Support testing activities aligned with GxP expectations, Computer System Validation (CSV) frameworks, and internal quality standards where applicable.

• Contribute to audit evidence, validation documentation, and control traceability.

• Work within IT service management processes including incident, problem, change, and release management.

• Support operational workflows and testing coordination through ServiceNow.

Collaboration and Delivery Support

• Work closely with developers, architects, business analysts, product owners, and support teams.

• Participate in sprint ceremonies, planning sessions, refinement meetings, and release activities.

• Communicate testing progress, quality risks, blockers, and recommendations to stakeholders.

• Support production validation activities after deployments where required.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, test data management, and testing efficiency.

• Contribute to automation initiatives and reusable testing assets.

• Stay informed on CIAM trends, identity standards, and evolving customer expectations.

Qualifications
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Experience

• Proven experience as a Technical Tester, QA Engineer, Test Analyst,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect (Demand to Pay, Travel & Expense Management) focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex enterprise context. In this role, you will play a critical role in translating complex business requirements into technical designs for the T&E solutions which includes the Concur platform and other systems, ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise systems and driving continuous improvement. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for the T&E landscape, and serve as a key leader and point of escalation for Concur-related issues within the organization.

Your Responsibilities

• Design T&E solutions that meet product requirements and enterprise standards across a multiple-solution context, managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions while ensuring configurations adhere to data privacy (GDPR/CCPA) and audit requirements.

• Define and drive reference architectures, ensuring that Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), taxonomies, ontologies, and integration pathways are documented and published for the T&E product.

• Develop comprehensive architecture documentation and manage data flows between Concur and other enterprise systems, including Workday, SAP ERP, ServiceNow (EPP), IQVIA, and Oversight.

• Lead the design and management of non-standard integrations utilizing RESTful APIs, WebServices, and secure SFTP, leveraging middleware platforms such as Mulesoft and Denodo.

• Optimize system performance and business objectives by utilizing reporting systems and data platforms, including Concur Intelligence, Snowflake, and standard reporting configurations.

• Proactively contribute to the development of global Architecture Practices and provide technical oversight and mentoring to product teams.

• Maintain the roadmap for T&E solutions, evaluating external technology trends—such as AI-driven expense categorization and RPA— to enhance value and manage technical debt.

Who You Are

• You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions within the Concur platform, with at least 5 years focused on integration enhancements to and from Concur Intelligence, Travel, and Expense.

• You possess expert-level knowledge of the Concur modules and a proven track record of integrating them with SAP ERP, HR systems (Workday), and other enterprise applications.

• You are experienced in RESTful API consumption, data transformation via middleware (Mulesoft/Denodo), and creating conceptual and logical data models.

• You are capable of maintaining a vision for multiple solutions and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape.

• You bring exceptional negotiation skills and the ability to communicate difficult concepts, influencing stakeholders to adopt different points of view or innovative solutions.

• You have a strong understanding of database concepts, SQL, web services, and XML/JSON data formats.

• You understand financial accounting principles and industry-specific T&E best practices; experience with pharmaceutical industry regulations is a significant plus.

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; a "Certified Professional - Expense Configuration" credential is preferred.

​
#RDT2026

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw G

We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
As a Sales Executive you will manage Account and Ensure Sales Achievement in Assigned Territory & Product lines, assist District Sales Manager in relieving their duties whenever necessary

• Develop new accounts with proper and close follow-up of sales opportunity

• Develop and maintains good customer relationships with important and relevant personnel

• Proactive and creative solve problems in managing customers’ complaint by proper investigation and close follow-up in resolving issues (eg: product deliveries/application troubleshooting)

• Work closely with the Professional Service team to deliver the post-sales service for the maximum customers’ satisfaction.

Who you are

• Have Bachelor in Health/Science

• Have 3 year multinational companies experience in Pharmaceutical/ Diagnostic/ Healthcare industrial sales

• Have effective communication and interpersonal skill

• Have creative problem solving and negotiation skill

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Industriemechaniker (m/w/d) - Anlagen- und Betriebstechnik
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche in 50 Worten

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird.
Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben.
Das macht uns zu Roche.

Die Abteilung | Das Team

Angetrieben durch unsere Vision „Trusted Partner – Technical Solutions for your success“ tragen wir als Hauptabteilung „Technical Solutions & Services“ täglich nachhaltig dazu bei, dass am Roche-Standort Penzberg die komplexen technischen Bedarfe unserer Anlagenbetreiber in die Realität umgesetzt werden.
Unser Mandat im Gewerk „Manufacturing Technologies“ zielt auf die Wiederherstellung der Funktionalität und Betriebsbereitschaft unserer Produktionsanlagen ab, um eine höchstmögliche Anlagenverfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten. In unserem Aufgabengebiet arbeiten wir im engen Schulterschluss mit internen technischen Gewerken sowie Fremdfirmen zusammen, um gemeinsam die ununterbrochene Versorgung der Patientinnen und Patienten mit Medikamenten und Diagnostika sicherzustellen.
Hierbei liegt unser Fokus auf der mechanischen Instandhaltung sowie auf Umbau- und Optimierungsmaßnahmen an produktions- und prozesstechnischen Anlagen. Um diese Mission bestmöglich zu erfüllen, ergreifen wir täglich leidenschaftlich und eigenverantwortlich die Initiative. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen motivierten Industriemechaniker (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Anlagen- und Betriebstechnik, der es versteht, unseren Leistungen durch Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen ein Gesicht zu geben.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Selbstständige Bearbeitung von Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen an Produktions- und Prozessanlagen mit dem Schwerpunkt Pumpen-, Rührwerks-, Trenn- und Abfülltechnik sowie logistischen Förderanlagen

• Koordination und Steuerung externer Servicepartner im Rahmen ihrer Tätigkeit

• auftragsbezogene Ersatzteilbeschaffung

• Dokumentation durchgeführter Tätigkeiten unter Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsvorgaben sowie interner Richtlinien und Regelwerke

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Technik-Teams bei der Bearbeitung ihrer Aufträge

• Eigenständige Analyse und Behebung von mechanischen Betriebsstörungen im Rahmen einer 24/7 - Rufbereitschaft

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du verfügst über eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Industriemechaniker (m/w/d) im Bereich Betriebstechnik, Maschinen- und Anlagenbau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung im industriell-technischen Umfeld.

• Du konntest bereits praktische Erfahrungen und Fertigkeiten in der Instandhaltung von Maschinen und Anlagen sammeln.

• Idealerweise bringst du durch Fort- und Weiterbildungen zusätzlich fundierte Fachkenntnisse mit.

• Das Arbeiten in einem GxP- und ATEX-regulierten Umfeld stellt für dich kein Hindernis dar.

• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit gängigen PC-Anwendungen und verfügst über mindestens grundlegende Englischkenntnisse.

• Kenntnisse mit gängigen SAP PM Systemen (P1U/P1S) wären von Vorteil, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung.

• Dein Arbeitsstil ist serviceorientiert sowie selbstständig, und du bist es gewohnt, auch in hektischen Zeiten stets den Überblick zu behalten.

• Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und die Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team zeichnen dich aus.

Deine Bewerbung
Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online Deinen Lebenslauf sowie vorhandene Zeugnisse hoch.
Zum aktuellen

Die Abteilung | Das Team Angetrieben durch unsere Vision „Trusted Partner – Technical Solutions for your success“ tragen wir als Hauptabteilung „Technical Solutions & Services“ täglich nachhaltig dazu bei, dass am Roche-Standort Penzberg die komplexen technischen Bedarfe unserer Anlagenbetreiber in die Realität umgesetzt werden. Unser Mandat im Gewerk „Manufacturing Technologies“ zielt auf die Wiederherstellung der Funktionalität und Betriebsbereitschaft unserer Produktionsanlagen ab, um eine höchstmögliche Anlagenverfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten. In unserem Aufgabengebiet arbeiten wir im engen Schulterschluss mit internen technischen Gewerken sowie Fremdfirmen zusammen, um gemeinsam die ununterbrochene Versorgung der Patientinnen und Patienten mit Medikamenten und Diagnostika sicherzustellen. Hierbei liegt unser Fokus auf der mechanischen Instandhaltung sowie auf Umbau- und Optimierungsmaßnahmen an produktions- und prozesstechnischen Anlagen. Um diese Mission bestmöglich zu erfüllen, ergreifen wir täglich leidenschaftlich und eigenverantwortlich die Initiative. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen motivierten Industriemechaniker (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Anlagen- und Betriebstechnik, der es versteht, unseren Leistungen durch Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen ein Gesicht zu geben. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
• Selbstständige Bearbeitung von Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen an Produktions- und Prozessanlagen mit dem Schwerpunkt Pumpen-, Rührwerks-, Trenn- und Abfülltechnik sowie logistischen Förderanlagen
• Koordination und Steuerung externer Servicepartner im Rahmen ihrer Tätigkeit
• auftragsbezogene Ersatzteilbeschaffung
• Dokumentation durchgeführter Tätigkeiten unter Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsvorgaben sowie interner Richtlinien und Regelwerke
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Technik-Teams bei der Bearbeitung ihrer Aufträge
• Eigenständige Analyse und Behebung von mechanischen Betriebsstörungen im Rahmen einer 24/7 - Rufbereitschaft Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Du verfügst über eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Industriemechaniker (m/w/d) im Bereich Betriebstechnik, Maschinen- und Anlagenbau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung im industriell-technischen Umfeld.
• Du konntest bereits praktische Erfahrungen und Fertigkeiten in der Instandhaltung von Maschinen und Anlagen sammeln.
• Idealerweise bringst du durch Fort- und Weiterbildungen zusätzlich fundierte Fachkenntnisse mit.
• Das Arbeiten in einem GxP- und ATEX-regulierten Umfeld stellt für dich kein Hindernis dar.
• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit gängigen PC-Anwendungen und verfügst über mindestens grundlegende Englischkenntnisse.
• Kenntnisse mit gängigen SAP PM Systemen (P1U/P1S) wären von Vorteil, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung.
• Dein Arbeitsstil ist serviceorientiert sowie selbstständig, und du bist es gewohnt, auch in hektischen Zeiten stets den Überblick zu behalten.
• Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und die Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team zeichnen dich aus. Deine Bewerbung Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online Deinen Lebenslauf sowie vorhandene Zeugnisse hoch. Zum aktuellen

jobs.title: Internship Robotics - 12 months
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In a global, cross-functional environment the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

The Opportunity

As our Intern you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on automating and tooling in the context of development and product care of complex diagnostics systems, consisting of fluidics, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical and biochemistry elements.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Elaboration of (Cobots-) Robotics concepts within a laboratory environment, to support our vision of a dark lab by fully automating laboratory operation and workflows.

• Programming, testing and maintaining of newly created and existing automated solutions within our laboratories.

• Supporting our Integration Teams with the installation of Robotics Solutions within our laboratory environment.

• Plan, coordinate and execute small work packages within your area of responsibility including reporting and escalation of topics or issues to the management.

• Be able to work as an individual as well as part of a team.

Who You Are

You are excited to start your professional career in the medical diagnostics industry and bring the following qualifications:

• You are currently enrolled as a Bachelor- / Master student or have recently graduated (within the last 12 months), preferably in computer science with specific knowledge in e.g. robotics and/or vision, electrical engineering or systems engineering or equivalent.

• Excellent spoken and written command of English (German is an advantage).

• You are able to communicate appropriately with different target groups.

• Knowledge of one or more programming languages (e.g. Python, C#/NET, LabVIEW etc.)

• You are motivated to build, manage and foster relationships and networks within the department and the related projects.

• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues, conceptual and creative thinking.

• Due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university as part of the application documents, stating that an internship is mandatory.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Intern Equipment Lifecycle Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our team's purpose is to ensure the optimal performance, accuracy, and reliability of measuring tools and testing equipment. By doing so, we enable our partners to enhance operational efficiency, maintain high-quality standards, and ensure safety and compliance. Through the global ASPIRE program, we are defining and deploying our future ERP solution based on SAP S/4 HANA, driving simplified and harmonized global business processes.

The Opportunity

Joining our innovative and multicultural team as an intern allows you to apply your studies directly to impactful global healthcare projects while gaining deep insights into change management and SAP S/4 HANA implementation. Furthermore, you will build invaluable networks across the Roche organization, opening doors for potential future career opportunities based on your performance.

Your tasks will include:

• Data & System Support: Assist in the creation and maintenance of equipment master data, monitoring status updates, and supporting partner functions for calibration and maintenance requests.

• Digital Transformation & Migration: Support preparation activities for data migration load cycles in close collaboration with local Equipment Management partners.

• Quality & Compliance: Assist in monitoring maintenance and calibration orders, reviewing certificates, and drafting non-conformity reports when deviations occur.

• Testing & Collaboration: Support the creation of end-to-end (E2E) test case scenarios by collaborating with cross-functional departments across the ION network.

• Training & Documentation: Help identify training needs and proactively assist in the creation of training materials for Equipment owners and managers.

• Operational Support: Assist the Maintenance team regarding the transition of Mobile Maintenance into the ASPIRE platform, including basic cost and time-optimization analyses.

• General Administration: Coordinate small team meetings, prepare presentation materials, and help improve basic departmental operations (e.g., archiving systems, documentation libraries).

Who You Are

You are driven to shape your own professional growth in an environment that empowers you to pursue your passions on a global, cross-functional scale.
You will be a great fit for this role if you bring the following qualifications and skills:

• Time commitment: Please note that this is a full-time internship requiring a 40-hour/week commitment.

• Education: Currently enrolled or graduated within the last 12 months in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, Life Sciences, or a related discipline).

• Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with an interest in data management, process mapping, and ERP systems (exposure to SAP is a plus, but not required).

• Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a customer-centric mindset.

• Adaptability: Eager to learn about the Roche organization, global supply chains, and quality compliance frameworks.

• Languages: Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional local language skills (e.g. German) are an asset.

• Due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university as part of the application documents, stating that an internship is mandatory.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us

Furthermore, you will build invaluable networks across the Roche organization, opening doors for potential future career opportunities based on your performance. Your tasks will include:
• Data & System Support: Assist in the creation and maintenance of equipment master data, monitoring status updates, and supporting partner functions for calibration and maintenance requests.
• Digital Transformation & Migration: Support preparation activities for data migration load cycles in close collaboration with local Equipment Management partners.
• Quality & Compliance: Assist in monitoring maintenance and calibration orders, reviewing certificates, and drafting non-conformity reports when deviations occur.
• Testing & Collaboration: Support the creation of end-to-end (E2E) test case scenarios by collaborating with cross-functional departments across the ION network.
• Training & Documentation: Help identify training needs and proactively assist in the creation of training materials for Equipment owners and managers.
• Operational Support: Assist the Maintenance team regarding the transition of Mobile Maintenance into the ASPIRE platform, including basic cost and time-optimization analyses.
• General Administration: Coordinate small team meetings, prepare presentation materials, and help improve basic departmental operations (e.g., archiving systems, documentation libraries). Who You Are You are driven to shape your own professional growth in an environment that empowers you to pursue your passions on a global, cross-functional scale. You will be a great fit for this role if you bring the following qualifications and skills:
• Time commitment: Please note that this is a full-time internship requiring a 40-hour/week commitment.
• Education: Currently enrolled or graduated within the last 12 months in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in a relevant field (e.g., Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, Life Sciences, or a related discipline).
• Analytical Mindset: Strong attention to detail with an interest in data management, process mapping, and ERP systems (exposure to SAP is a plus, but not required).
• Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a customer-centric mindset.
• Adaptability: Eager to learn about the Roche organization, global supply chains, and quality compliance frameworks.
• Languages: Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional local language skills (e.g. German) are an asset.
• Due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university as part of the application documents, stating that an internship is mandatory. Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity! Who we are A healthier future drives us

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Roche Kaiseraugst è una pietra angolare della rete globale di produzione e logistica di Roche. Più di 1.900 persone sono impiegate in questo sito, che ospita il più grande e innovativo impianto di imballaggio di Roche in tutto il mondo.
Il gruppo QC Packaging Speed Testing fa parte dell'organizzazione QC PMD e garantisce gli standard di alta qualità dei materiali di imballaggio primari e secondari utilizzati nelle nostre operazioni di produzione. In qualità di Intern nel team Packaging Speed Testing, le tue principali responsabilità includono i principali sottoprogetti e lo sviluppo organizzativo.

L'opportunità
Come nostro tirocinante collaborerai con le interfacce chiave come Quality Assurance, Laboratories, Gestione della Qualità del Fornitore, Sviluppo di Imballaggi, Magazzino, Procurement e Pianificazione. Questo ti fornisce un'ampia panoramica sul lavoro dell'unità di qualità e del centro di produzione.
Sosterrete attivamente il team di prova della velocità di imballaggio nelle operazioni quotidiane e nei progetti attuali. Nel processo, imparerai come applicare i requisiti Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) in un ambiente pratico e costruire solide competenze di gestione del progetto. Inoltre, le vostre responsabilità includono

• Sottoprogetti di guida e gestione

• Sostegno alle iniziative di sviluppo organizzativo

• Introduzione di elementi di gamificazione

• Contribuire all'ottimizzazione del processo

Chi sei
Sei aperto a nuove idee e non hai paura di sfidare il pensiero convenzionale. Vi piace lavorare in un ambiente orientato alle prestazioni, caratterizzato da rispetto reciproco, dialogo aperto e collaborazione. Roche vi offre un ambiente dinamico e internazionale con numerose opportunità di sviluppo.

• Studente in psicologia, innovazione o campo scientifico – attualmente iscritto o laureato negli ultimi 12 mesi

• Modo di lavoro organizzato e strutturato

• Forte capacità di ragionamento spaziale

• personalità orientata al team e comunicativa

• Alto livello di iniziativa, di assertività e di persuasione

• Affidabile e dettagliatamente focalizzato, l'esperienza in un ambiente GMP-regolamentato è un plus

• Proficiente in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Ulteriori informazioni

• Data di inizio: agosto/settembre 2026

• Carico di lavoro: 100%

Processo di applicazione
Si prega di inviare la domanda completa, tra cui:

• Il tuo CV

• Una lettera di motivazione convincente

• Un certificato di iscrizione (se si sta attualmente studiando) O i laureati recenti possono anche iniziare uno stage con noi entro 12 mesi dalla data di laurea.

• Per i cittadini non UE/EFTA: Certificato dell'università che afferma che uno stage è obbligatorio (richiesto a causa delle normative)

Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
